categories.description_en: Photographic genres, lighting and camera techniques, from studio portrait to street, product and scientific imaging.
categories.description_de: Fotografische Genres, Lichtführung und Kameratechniken, vom Studioporträt über Street und Produkt bis zur wissenschaftlichen Bildgebung.

categories.description_en: Historic photographic processes, film stocks, darkroom prints and the physical traces of analogue media.
categories.description_de: Historische Fotoverfahren, Filmmaterialien, Dunkelkammerabzüge und die physischen Spuren analoger Medien.

categories.description_en: Film stills and moving-image looks defined by era, national cinema, colour process, lens or broadcast format.
categories.description_de: Filmstills und Bewegtbild-Looks, geprägt von Epoche, Filmkultur, Farbverfahren, Objektiv oder Sendeformat.

categories.description_en: Hand-made marks on canvas, paper and walls, sorted by medium: oil, watercolour, ink, chalk, marker and everyday tools.
categories.description_de: Handgemachte Spuren auf Leinwand, Papier und Wand, sortiert nach Medium: Öl, Aquarell, Tusche, Kreide, Marker und Alltagswerkzeug.

categories.description_en: Recognisable epochs and movements of (mostly Western) art, from cave painting to contemporary figuration.
categories.description_de: Erkennbare Epochen und Strömungen der (überwiegend westlichen) Kunst, von der Höhlenmalerei bis zur zeitgenössischen Figuration.

categories.description_en: Regional painting, print, textile and ornament traditions from around the world, each with its own palette and visual grammar.
categories.description_de: Regionale Mal-, Druck-, Textil- und Ornamenttraditionen aus aller Welt, jede mit eigener Palette und Bildsprache.

categories.description_en: Relief, intaglio, lithographic and stencil prints, plus the press and office copying processes whose artefacts are instantly recognisable.
categories.description_de: Hoch-, Tief-, Flach- und Durchdruck sowie Pressen- und Bürokopierverfahren mit sofort erkennbaren Spuren.

categories.description_en: Images built from physical stuff such as paper, fabric, glass, clay, wood, toys or food, shown as real objects.
categories.description_de: Bilder aus echtem Material wie Papier, Stoff, Glas, Ton, Holz, Spielzeug oder Lebensmitteln, gezeigt als reale Objekte.

categories.description_en: Applied illustration genres for editorial, books, science, technology, entertainment and tattoo.
categories.description_de: Angewandte Illustrationsgenres für Editorial, Buch, Wissenschaft, Technik, Unterhaltung und Tattoo.

categories.description_en: Comic traditions and animation techniques, from ligne claire and manga to cel, CG, stop-motion and experimental film.
categories.description_de: Comictraditionen und Animationstechniken, von Ligne claire und Manga bis zu Cel-, CG-, Stop-Motion- und Experimentalfilm.

categories.description_en: Posters, covers, lettering and printed ephemera where type, layout and reproduction define the look.
categories.description_de: Plakate, Cover, Schrift und Drucksachen, bei denen Typografie, Layout und Reproduktion den Look bestimmen.

categories.description_en: One fixed set of information rendered in many visual languages, from today's generic AI defaults to historical plates, pictograms and hand-drawn notes.
categories.description_de: Ein und dieselbe Information in vielen Bildsprachen, vom generischen KI-Standardlook über historische Tafeln und Piktogramme bis zur Handnotiz.

categories.description_en: Computer-made images: pixel art, retro hardware, game art, 3D renders, generative code, glitches and AI model signatures.
categories.description_de: Computergemachte Bilder: Pixel-Art, Retro-Hardware, Spielegrafik, 3D-Renderings, generativer Code, Glitches und KI-Signaturen.

categories.description_en: Named aesthetics from web culture, UI trends, youth subcultures and social-media eras, from GeoCities and Y2K to -core moodboards and memes.
categories.description_de: Benannte Ästhetiken aus Netzkultur, UI-Trends, Jugendkulturen und Social-Media-Epochen, von GeoCities und Y2K bis zu -core-Moodboards und Memes.

styles.era_origin: Studio lighting convention derived from Dutch Golden Age painting, standard in portrait studios throughout the 20th century.
visual_markers: single key light high at 45 degrees with a small triangle of light on the shadow side
deep shadows with very little fill
styles.prompt_fragment: photographed as a low-key studio portrait: single large softbox high at 45 degrees, Rembrandt triangle of light on the shadow side, minimal fill, hand-painted mottled grey-brown canvas backdrop, deep falloff into shadow, muted earthy colors, medium-format 80mm lens rendering, fine natural surface texture with pores and fibres intact
styles.avoid: Avoid airbrushed skin, bokeh-blurred city lights and teal-orange grading; the backdrop must be a painted canvas, not a digital gradient.
styles.feasibility_note: Lighting pattern renders reliably; skin gets over-smoothed unless pores and texture are requested explicitly.
styles.short_de: Dunkles Studioporträt mit einem hohen seitlichen Licht, das auf der Schattenwange ein kleines Lichtdreieck lässt; nach Rembrandts Gemälden benannt und im 20. Jahrhundert Standard in Porträtstudios.
styles.short_en: Dark studio portrait with one high side light leaving a light triangle on the shadowed cheek; borrowed from Rembrandt's paintings, a standard of 20th-century portrait studios.
styles.era_de: 20. Jh., Porträtstudios; Vorbild niederländische Malerei des 17. Jh.
styles.era_en: 20th century, portrait studios; modelled on 17th-century Dutch painting
markers_en: single high key light at 45 degrees
small light triangle on the shadowed cheek

styles.era_origin: Established in mid-20th-century magazine photography (1940s-60s), showing sitters in their workplaces and homes.
visual_markers: subject fills only about a third of the frame
setting and tools of the trade clearly legible
styles.prompt_fragment: environmental portrait: subject placed within their own workplace or home and filling about a third of the frame, 35mm wide-normal lens, deep depth of field so every tool and object stays legible, mixed window and practical light with gentle fill, calm posed stillness, natural colors, editorial magazine sensibility
styles.avoid: Avoid shallow-focus background blur that erases the setting, and avoid centring the subject in an empty space.
styles.feasibility_note: Context-rich environments render well; the model blurs backgrounds unless deep focus is stated.
styles.short_de: Porträt eines Menschen an seinem Arbeitsplatz oder zu Hause, klein im Bild, Umgebung und Werkzeuge scharf; in Magazinen seit den 1940er-Jahren verbreitet.
styles.short_en: Portrait showing a person in their workplace or home, small in the frame with tools and surroundings sharp; a staple of mid-20th-century magazine photography.
markers_de: Person füllt etwa ein Drittel des Bildes
markers_en: subject fills about a third of the frame

styles.era_origin: Hollywood studio publicity portraiture, roughly 1925-1950.
visual_markers: black and white with silvery tonal gradations
butterfly lighting with a small shadow under the nose
hand-retouched luminous skin from large-format negatives
styles.prompt_fragment: 1930s-40s studio glamour photograph in black and white: butterfly key light from high front casting a small shadow under the nose, glowing hair light and rim, pitch-black background, hand-retouched luminous skin from a large-format negative, sculpted cheekbones, silky tonal gradations, theatrical pose, slight soft-focus diffusion
styles.avoid: Avoid modern color grading and digital crispness; keep it monochrome with the soft silvery glow of retouched large-format film, not HDR contrast.
styles.feasibility_note: Lighting and monochrome tonality hold well; poses can drift toward modern fashion.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not prompt for the likeness of specific film stars.
styles.short_de: Schwarzweißes Studioporträt mit Butterfly-Licht, leuchtendem Haarlicht und stark retuschierter Haut, entstanden für die Werbung der Hollywood-Studios von Mitte der 1920er bis 1950.
styles.short_en: Black-and-white studio portrait with butterfly lighting, glowing hair light and heavily retouched skin, made for Hollywood studio publicity between the mid-1920s and 1950.
markers_en: butterfly light with small shadow under the nose
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine Ähnlichkeit mit bestimmten Filmstars anfordern.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not prompt for the likeness of specific film stars.

styles.era_origin: Cosmetics advertising from the 1950s, perfected with digital retouching in the 2000s.
visual_markers: clamshell lighting (beauty dish above, reflector below)
styles.prompt_fragment: high-end beauty campaign photograph: very tight crop, clamshell lighting with beauty dish above and silver reflector below, round catchlights, dewy highlights on the cheekbones, meticulously retouched yet visible skin texture, crisp makeup detail, seamless pale backdrop, symmetrical composition, clean commercial color
styles.avoid: Avoid plastic, poreless skin and fantasy glow; ask for retouching that keeps pores so it reads as photography, not a render.
styles.feasibility_note: Very close to the model's default; the hard part is keeping real skin texture.
styles.sensitivity_note: Reinforces narrow beauty ideals; vary skin tones and ages consciously.
styles.short_de: Sehr enger, symmetrischer Gesichtsausschnitt im Clamshell-Licht mit feuchtem Glanz und retuschierter Haut; Bildsprache der Kosmetikwerbung seit den 1950er-Jahren.
styles.short_en: Very tight, symmetrical face close-up under clamshell lighting with dewy highlights and retouched skin; the visual language of cosmetics advertising since the 1950s.
markers_en: clamshell lighting: beauty dish above, reflector below
styles.sensitivity_de: Verstärkt enge Schönheitsideale; Hauttöne und Alter bewusst variieren.
styles.sensitivity_en: Reinforces narrow beauty ideals; vary skin tones and ages deliberately.

styles.era_origin: Annual-report and staff-directory portraiture from the 1980s; online profile photos since the 2000s.
visual_markers: head-and-shoulders crop with body slightly angled
neutral grey seamless or mottled backdrop
styles.prompt_fragment: corporate headshot: head-and-shoulders crop, body angled slightly with face toward camera, soft large key light with fill, neutral grey seamless or lightly mottled backdrop, polite approachable expression, business attire, sharp eyes, 85mm lens, clean neutral color, even repeatable exposure suitable for a staff directory
styles.avoid: Avoid cinematic bokeh, dramatic shadows and golden light; the look is deliberately bland, evenly lit and repeatable.
styles.feasibility_note: Easy for the model; applied to non-human subjects it becomes a usable humorous device.
styles.short_de: Gleichmäßig ausgeleuchtetes Brustporträt in Businesskleidung vor neutralem Grau, seit den 1980ern in Geschäftsberichten, seit den 2000ern in Online-Profilen.
styles.short_en: Evenly lit head-and-shoulders portrait in business clothes against neutral grey, used for annual reports since the 1980s and for online profiles since the 2000s.
markers_en: neutral grey seamless or mottled backdrop

styles.era_origin: School picture days in North America and Europe; mottled and laser backdrops peaked in the 1980s-90s.
visual_markers: flat flash with faint shadow behind the shoulder
posed head tilt and forced smile
styles.prompt_fragment: 1980s-90s school picture-day portrait: mottled blue backdrop or swirling laser-beam background, flat flash with a faint shadow behind the shoulder, slightly forced smile and posed head tilt, chest turned at an angle, color-negative print with mild magenta cast and soft grain, rounded print corners, studio-chain uniformity
styles.avoid: Avoid flattering cinematic light and modern sharpness; keep the cheap, uniform, slightly awkward production-line feel.
styles.feasibility_note: Laser and mottled backdrops render convincingly; the characteristic head tilt is sometimes lost.
styles.sensitivity_note: Never use with likenesses of real minors.
styles.short_de: Schulfoto vor fleckig-blauem oder Laser-Hintergrund, mit flachem Blitz und gestellter Kopfneigung; typisch für Schulfotos der 1980er- und 90er-Jahre, vor allem in Nordamerika.
styles.short_en: Picture-day portrait with mottled blue or laser-beam backdrop, flat flash and a posed head tilt; typical of North American school photos of the 1980s–90s.
markers_en: flat flash with faint shoulder shadow
posed head tilt and forced smile
styles.sensitivity_de: Nie mit dem Abbild realer Minderjähriger verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Never use with likenesses of real minors.

styles.era_origin: US shopping-mall makeover portrait studios of the late 1980s and 1990s.
visual_markers: heavy soft-focus diffusion with glowing highlights
teased hair, sequins, denim or feather boa
styles.prompt_fragment: late-1980s mall makeover glamour portrait: heavy soft-focus diffusion filter with glowing highlights, hand posed under the chin, over-the-shoulder glance, teased voluminous hair, sequins or denim, smoky pastel gradient backdrop, cross-star filter sparkle on highlights, airbrushed skin, soft vignette, slightly faded color print
styles.avoid: Avoid crisp modern editorial lighting; the diffusion haze and earnest kitsch have to stay strong.
styles.feasibility_note: Diffusion and kitsch props render well; star-filter sparkles are sometimes left out.
styles.sensitivity_note: 'Glamour Shots' is the trademark of a portrait chain; use descriptive wording in prompts, not the brand name.
styles.short_de: Stark weichgezeichnetes Makeover-Porträt mit toupiertem Haar, Hand unterm Kinn, pastellfarbenem Nebelhintergrund und Sternfilter-Glitzer, aus Fotostudios in US-Shoppingmalls der späten 1980er und 1990er.
styles.short_en: Heavily diffused makeover portrait with teased hair, hand-under-chin pose, pastel smoke backdrop and star-filter sparkles, from US shopping-mall studios of the late 1980s and 1990s.
markers_de: Hand unterm Kinn oder Blick über die Schulter
markers_en: teased hair, sequins or feather boa
styles.sensitivity_de: „Glamour Shots“ ist die Marke einer Studiokette; im Prompt beschreibend formulieren, nicht den Markennamen nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: 'Glamour Shots' is a portrait chain's trademark; use descriptive wording in prompts, not the brand name.

styles.era_origin: Standardized ID photography of the 20th century; biometric norms since the 2000s.
styles.prompt_fragment: biometric passport photograph: strictly frontal and centred, neutral expression with closed mouth, eyes level, plain light-grey background, flat shadowless lighting, head filling the standard template proportion, no artistic styling, slightly cool compressed color like a booth or drugstore print, tight head-and-shoulders crop
styles.avoid: Avoid any smile, tilt, bokeh or mood lighting; the point is bureaucratic neutrality.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders easily; works well as a comparison baseline.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not generate passport-style images of real people or combine them with document templates, because that edges toward identity-document forgery.
styles.short_de: Streng frontales, neutrales Gesicht vor hellgrauem Grund in flachem, schattenlosem Licht, nach den Passbildregeln des 20. Jahrhunderts und biometrischen Normen seit den 2000ern.
styles.short_en: Strictly frontal, neutral face on plain light grey under flat shadowless light, following ID-photo rules of the 20th century and biometric standards since the 2000s.
styles.era_de: 20. Jh.; biometrisch seit Mitte der 2000er, weltweit
styles.era_en: 20th century; biometric since the mid-2000s, worldwide
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine Passbilder realer Personen erzeugen oder mit Dokumentvorlagen kombinieren; das grenzt an Ausweisfälschung.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not create passport-style images of real people or pair them with document templates, as that edges toward ID forgery.

styles.era_origin: Systematized by Alphonse Bertillon in Paris in the 1880s (front and profile); booking photos ever since.
visual_markers: front view and side profile side by side
styles.prompt_fragment: police booking photograph: harsh direct flash, flat expression, subject in front of a height-chart wall with horizontal measurement lines, front view and side profile side by side, plain placard with an invented booking number, greenish fluorescent ambient light, hard unflattering shadow behind
styles.avoid: Avoid glamorized noir lighting; it should feel institutional and unflattering.
styles.feasibility_note: Height charts render well; keep placard text invented and short.
styles.sensitivity_note: Strongly stigmatizing: never apply to real, identifiable people or use it to imply criminality of real groups. Use only with fictional characters, animals or objects.
styles.short_de: Erkennungsdienstliches Foto mit Frontal- und Profilansicht, hartem Blitz, Messlatte und Nummerntafel; das Format geht auf Alphonse Bertillons Pariser System der 1880er-Jahre zurück.
styles.short_en: Police booking photo with front and profile views, harsh flash, height chart and number placard; the format goes back to Alphonse Bertillon's Paris system of the 1880s.
styles.era_de: seit den 1880ern, Paris; weltweit bei der Polizei
styles.era_en: since the 1880s, Paris; police use worldwide
markers_en: front view and profile side by side
styles.sensitivity_de: Stark stigmatisierend: nie mit realen, erkennbaren Personen oder zur Kriminalisierung realer Gruppen verwenden, nur mit fiktiven Figuren, Tieren oder Gegenständen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Strongly stigmatizing: never use with real, identifiable people or to imply criminality of real groups; only with fictional characters, animals or objects.

styles.era_origin: Coin-operated photo booths from 1925 (New York); chemical booth strips throughout the 20th century.
visual_markers: vertical strip of four frames with white borders
expression changes from frame to frame
harsh frontal flash and plain curtain backdrop
styles.prompt_fragment: vertical photo-booth strip of four small frames separated by white borders, each a slightly different pose or expression, harsh frontal flash, plain curtain backdrop, silver-gelatin black and white with uneven chemical development, faint stains and drying marks, slightly crooked framing, tight head-and-shoulders crops
styles.avoid: Avoid a single image or a clean digital collage; the four frames must differ and show chemical imperfection.
styles.feasibility_note: Four-frame layout is reliable; identity consistency across frames can drift.
styles.short_de: Senkrechter Streifen aus vier kleinen Schwarzweißbildern mit wechselndem Ausdruck, hartem Licht und Vorhang dahinter, aus Fotoautomaten, die 1925 in New York aufkamen.
styles.short_en: Vertical strip of four small black-and-white frames with changing expressions, harsh light and curtain backdrop, from coin-operated booths introduced in New York in 1925.
styles.era_de: ab 1925, New York; im 20. Jh. weltweit
markers_de: senkrechter Streifen mit vier weiß gerahmten Bildern
Ausdruck wechselt von Bild zu Bild
markers_en: vertical strip of four white-bordered frames
expression changes from frame to frame
harsh frontal light and curtain backdrop

styles.era_origin: Studio technique established in mid-20th-century portrait, fashion and advertising photography.
visual_markers: almost entirely white and pale tones
a few small dark accents defining form
styles.prompt_fragment: high-key photograph: almost entirely white and pale tones, overexposed pure-white seamless background, soft wraparound light that removes shadows, low contrast, only a few small dark accents such as eyes or edges defining the form, airy and graphic, fine detail kept in the highlights
styles.avoid: Avoid muddy grey midtones and gradient vignettes; the white must read as a deliberate choice, not flat overexposure.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable; occasionally adds unwanted grey vignetting.
styles.short_de: Fast vollständig weißes Bild mit überstrahltem Hintergrund, schattenlosem Rundumlicht und wenigen dunklen Akzenten; Studiotechnik aus Porträt-, Mode- und Werbefotografie der Jahrhundertmitte.
styles.short_en: Almost entirely white image with blown-out background, shadowless wraparound light and only a few dark accents; a studio technique of mid-20th-century portrait, fashion and advertising.
styles.era_en: mid-20th century to today, studio photography
markers_de: fast nur Weiß und helle Töne
markers_en: almost entirely white and pale tones

styles.era_origin: Developed for medical and dental close-up photography in the 1950s; adopted by fashion photography in the late 1990s-2000s.
visual_markers: thin dark halo shadow outlining the subject
styles.prompt_fragment: ring-flash photograph: perfectly frontal shadowless light, ring-shaped catchlights, thin even dark halo shadow tracing the outline against a close plain wall, slight vignette, glossy highlights on skin and surfaces, punchy saturated colors, flat graphic depth, late-1990s fashion-magazine edge
styles.avoid: Avoid softbox modelling and blurred backgrounds; the hallmark is the halo shadow around the outline and the flat frontal light.
styles.feasibility_note: Halo shadow comes out when the backdrop is described as close; ring-shaped catchlights are hit or miss.
styles.short_de: Flaches, schattenloses Frontallicht mit ringförmigen Spitzlichtern und dünnem dunklem Schattensaum um das Motiv; 1952 für die Dentalfotografie entwickelt, um 2000 von der Mode übernommen.
styles.short_en: Flat, shadowless frontal light with ring-shaped catchlights and a thin dark halo around the subject; built for dental close-ups in 1952, adopted by fashion around 2000.
styles.era_en: 1950s medical use; fashion from the late 1990s
markers_de: dünner dunkler Schattensaum um die Kontur
markers_en: thin dark halo shadow around the outline

styles.era_origin: Private amateur photography with consumer cameras and drugstore prints, roughly 1960s-1990s (German term 'Knipser' established by Timm Starl, 1995).
visual_markers: on-camera flash with red-eye and hard wall shadow
tilted horizon and careless framing with cut-off edges
faded color print drifting to orange and magenta
white print border, sometimes rounded corners
styles.prompt_fragment: amateur family snapshot from a 1970s-80s album: cheap fixed-focus camera, on-camera flash with red-eye and a hard shadow on the wall, slightly tilted horizon, careless off-centre framing with cut-off edges, faded color print shifting toward orange and magenta, soft grain, white print border, unstaged everyday moment
styles.avoid: Avoid good composition and golden-hour light; the charm is unskilled framing and degraded print chemistry.
styles.feasibility_note: Faded colors and flash work well; truly awkward framing must be stated explicitly or the model recomposes neatly.
styles.sensitivity_note: 'Instamatic' is a Kodak product name; it appears only as an alias and is not needed in prompts.
styles.short_de: Familienfoto von Laien mit Rote-Augen-Blitz, schiefem Horizont, angeschnittenen Rändern und verblasstem Orange-Magenta-Abzug; private Knipserfotografie, etwa 1960er bis 1990er.
styles.short_en: Amateur family photo with red-eye flash, tilted horizon, cut-off edges and a faded orange-magenta print; private snapshot photography with cheap cameras, roughly 1960s to 1990s.
markers_de: Kamerablitz mit roten Augen und hartem Wandschatten
verblasster Abzug mit Orange- und Magentastich
markers_en: on-camera flash with red-eye and hard wall shadow
faded print drifting to orange and magenta
styles.sensitivity_de: „Instamatic“ ist ein Kodak-Produktname; er steht nur als Alias da und gehört nicht in den Prompt.
styles.sensitivity_en: 'Instamatic' is a Kodak product name; it appears only as an alias and is not needed in prompts.

styles.era_origin: Smartphone multi-frame HDR from the mid-2010s and synthetic portrait-mode blur from 2016.
visual_markers: flattened HDR skies and lifted shadows
fake bokeh with cut-out errors around fine edges
styles.prompt_fragment: unedited smartphone photo: vertical 3:4 frame, 26mm wide-angle perspective with mild edge stretching, aggressive multi-frame HDR flattening the sky and lifting shadows, oversharpened edges, watercolor-like noise-reduction smear in dark areas, synthetic portrait-mode blur with cut-out errors around fine edges, neutral-cool auto white balance
styles.avoid: Avoid professional lighting and real optical bokeh; the computational artifacts are the point.
styles.feasibility_note: Wide angle and HDR flatness render; specific artifacts such as cut-out halos need explicit wording and may still be cleaned up.
styles.short_de: Unbearbeitetes Handyfoto mit Weitwinkelverzerrung, plattem HDR, Überschärfung, verschmierter Rauschunterdrückung und künstlicher Porträtmodus-Unschärfe; Look der Smartphone-Bildverarbeitung seit Mitte der 2010er.
styles.short_en: Unedited phone photo with wide-angle stretch, flattened HDR, oversharpening, smeary noise reduction and fake portrait-mode blur; the smartphone processing look since the mid-2010s.

styles.era_origin: Wedding and influencer photography of the 2010s, driven by shared editing presets.
visual_markers: overexposed creamy whites and lifted matte blacks
styles.prompt_fragment: light-and-airy lifestyle photograph: golden-hour backlight with soft sun flare, overexposed creamy whites, lifted matte blacks, pastel desaturated greens, warm glowing skin, 85mm wide-open shallow depth of field, posed-candid laughter or movement, preset-driven uniformity typical of 2010s wedding and influencer feeds
styles.avoid: Use only as deliberate contrast: this is close to the generic AI image, so its flare and creamy bokeh should not leak into other styles.
styles.feasibility_note: Trivial; the model drifts here by default.
styles.short_de: Helles Gegenlicht-Lifestylefoto mit Sonnenreflex, cremig überbelichtetem Weiß, mattem Schwarz und pastelligem Grün; über Presets in der Hochzeits- und Influencer-Fotografie der 2010er verbreitet.
styles.short_en: Bright, backlit lifestyle photo with sun flare, creamy overexposed whites, matte blacks and pastel greens; spread through shared editing presets in 2010s wedding and influencer photography.

styles.era_origin: Royalty-free microstock libraries of the late 1990s to the 2010s.
visual_markers: exaggerated cheerful expressions and over-explicit gestures
spotless generic office or kitchen settings
styles.prompt_fragment: generic microstock photograph: bright flat high-key lighting, spotless generic setting, models with exaggerated cheerful expressions and over-explicit gestures, staged teamwork or pointing poses, clean saturated colors, perfectly white whites, shallow depth of field, ample empty space for copy, no grit or ambiguity
styles.avoid: Use as a contrast example; keep it obviously staged rather than letting it drift into cinematic or editorial.
styles.feasibility_note: Effortless for the model.
styles.sensitivity_note: Tokenistic 'diverse team' staging is part of the cliché; handle representation respectfully.
styles.short_de: Hell ausgeleuchtete, makellose Szenen mit übertrieben fröhlichen Models, überdeutlichen Gesten und Freiraum für Text; der Einheitslook lizenzfreier Microstock-Archive von den späten 1990ern bis in die 2010er.
styles.short_en: Brightly lit, spotless scenes with over-cheerful models, explicit gestures and empty space for copy; the generic look of royalty-free microstock libraries from the late 1990s to 2010s.
styles.sensitivity_de: Alibihaft inszenierte „diverse Teams“ gehören zum Klischee; Repräsentation respektvoll behandeln.
styles.sensitivity_en: Tokenistic 'diverse team' staging is part of the cliché; handle representation with respect.

styles.era_origin: 35mm rangefinder street and humanist photography of the 1930s-1960s, especially Paris and New York.
visual_markers: visible silver grain and rich blacks
thin black frame border from full-frame printing
styles.prompt_fragment: classic 1950s street photograph on 35mm black-and-white film: candid unposed moment, 35mm lens at eye level, layered composition with figures caught mid-step against strong geometric lines, available light, visible silver grain, rich blacks and grey midtones, slight motion blur, full-frame print with thin filed black border
styles.avoid: Avoid posed subjects, HDR clarity and digital-clean monochrome; it should feel caught, not constructed.
styles.feasibility_note: Grain and tonality hold; compositions can be too tidy and centred.
styles.short_de: Ungestellte Schwarzweißszene auf Kleinbildfilm, auf Augenhöhe erfasst, mit gestaffelten Figuren, klarer Geometrie und sichtbarem Korn; verwurzelt in Paris und New York, 1930er bis 1960er.
styles.short_en: Candid black-and-white scene on 35mm film, caught at eye level with layered figures, strong geometry and visible grain; rooted in Paris and New York, 1930s–1960s.
markers_en: thin black border from full-frame printing

styles.era_origin: American art photography of the 1970s that made color acceptable for banal everyday subjects (landmark MoMA show 1976).
visual_markers: saturated dye-transfer colors with deep reds and greens
banal everyday subject treated as worthy
flat midday sun or quiet overcast
styles.prompt_fragment: 1970s American New Color photograph: banal everyday scene treated as a worthy subject, saturated dye-transfer color with deep reds, greens and cyan sky, flat midday sun or quiet overcast, casual yet precise framing, color slide grain, period signage and objects, democratic attention to the ordinary
styles.avoid: Avoid dramatic light, nostalgia filters and orange-teal grading; the color is rich but the moment is deliberately unspectacular.
styles.feasibility_note: Palette works well; the model tends to add drama unless 'banal' and 'unspectacular' are stressed.
styles.sensitivity_note: Associated with famous named photographers; describe the approach instead of naming them.
styles.short_de: Satte Farbfotos banaler Alltagsszenen in flachem Licht, beiläufig und doch genau komponiert; amerikanische Kunstfotografie der 1970er, durchgesetzt mit einer MoMA-Ausstellung 1976.
styles.short_en: Saturated colour photographs of banal everyday scenes in flat light, framed casually but precisely; American art photography of the 1970s, established by a 1976 MoMA exhibition.
markers_de: satte Dye-Transfer-Farben, tiefes Rot und Grün
markers_en: saturated dye-transfer colour with deep reds and greens
styles.sensitivity_de: Eng mit bekannten Fotografen verbunden; den Ansatz beschreiben statt Namen zu nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Associated with famous named photographers; describe the approach instead of naming them.

styles.era_origin: British colour documentary photography of the mid-1980s, using flash in bright daylight.
visual_markers: hard on-camera flash even in sunlight
close crops of leisure, food and consumer kitsch
sunburnt skin and cheap plastic textures
styles.prompt_fragment: satirical color documentary photograph: hard on-camera flash fired in bright daylight, oversaturated candy colors, close crops of everyday leisure and consumer kitsch, sunburnt skin, cheap food and plastic textures rendered with brutal clarity, wry humor, 1980s seaside-and-supermarket atmosphere, medium-format color negative
styles.avoid: Avoid tasteful soft light and polished advertising gloss; the look is deliberately garish, close and gently mocking.
styles.feasibility_note: Flash-in-daylight saturation renders well; the humor depends on the motif.
styles.sensitivity_note: Closely tied to a living British photographer; do not name him or recreate specific images. The irony can tip into class mockery.
styles.short_de: Grelle Nahaufnahmen von Freizeit, Essen und Konsumkitsch, hart angeblitzt bei hellem Tageslicht; britische Farbdokumentarfotografie der 1980er mit satirischem Unterton.
styles.short_en: Garish close-ups of leisure, food and consumer kitsch lit by hard flash in bright daylight; British colour documentary photography of the 1980s, satirical in tone.

markers_en: close crops of leisure, food and kitsch
styles.sensitivity_de: Eng mit einem bekannten britischen Fotografen († 2025) verbunden; ihn nicht nennen, keine konkreten Bilder nachstellen und die Ironie nicht in Klassenspott kippen lassen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Closely tied to one well-known British photographer (died 2025); do not name him or recreate specific images, and keep the irony from tipping into class mockery.

styles.era_origin: Japanese avant-garde photography around the magazine Provoke, 1968-1969.
visual_markers: harsh flash or streetlight at night
styles.prompt_fragment: late-1960s Japanese avant-garde photograph in the are-bure-boke manner: rough push-processed black-and-white film with enormous grain, motion blur and missed focus, tilted fragmentary framing, crushed blacks and blown whites, harsh flash or streetlight, restless raw energy, printed on high-contrast paper
styles.avoid: Avoid clean monochrome and readable centred compositions; the image should feel unstable, harsh and almost abstract.
styles.feasibility_note: Model keeps subjects too legible and grain too fine; push the wording hard.
styles.sensitivity_note: Main protagonists include living photographers; do not name them.
styles.short_de: Körnige, verwackelte, unscharfe Schwarzweißfotos mit schiefem, bruchstückhaftem Ausschnitt und abgesoffenen Schatten; aus der japanischen Fotoavantgarde um die Zeitschrift Provoke, 1968/69.
styles.short_en: Grainy, blurred, out-of-focus black-and-white photos with tilted, fragmentary framing and crushed blacks; from Japanese avant-garde photography around the magazine Provoke, 1968–69.

markers_en: harsh flash or streetlight at night
styles.sensitivity_de: Zu den Hauptvertretern gehören lebende Fotografen; sie nicht namentlich nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Its main protagonists include living photographers; do not name them.

styles.era_origin: US Resettlement Administration / Farm Security Administration photography project, 1935-1944.
visual_markers: large- or medium-format black and white
weathered wood, cloth and skin textures
full tonal range with archival print tone
styles.prompt_fragment: 1930s social-documentary photograph: large-format black-and-white negative, frontal dignified framing, natural overcast or harsh dust-bowl sunlight, weathered textures of wood, cloth and skin, full tonal range with silvery highlights, quiet unsentimental gaze, slight edge vignetting and archival print tone
styles.avoid: Avoid sepia filters and dramatized misery; dignity and plain frontal composition matter more than drama.
styles.feasibility_note: Tonality and period textures render convincingly.
styles.sensitivity_note: Depicts poverty: avoid aestheticizing the hardship of real communities, and do not create fake 'historical' documents.
styles.short_de: Würdevolle, frontale Schwarzweißfotos ländlicher Armut mit verwitterten Oberflächen und vollem Tonwertumfang, entstanden 1935–1944 im Auftrag der US-Behörde Farm Security Administration.
styles.short_en: Dignified, frontal black-and-white photographs of rural poverty with weathered textures and full tonal range, made for the US Farm Security Administration project, 1935–1944.
markers_en: large- or medium-format black and white
full tonal range, archival print tone
styles.sensitivity_de: Zeigt Armut: die Not realer Gemeinschaften nicht ästhetisieren und keine falschen „historischen“ Dokumente erzeugen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Depicts poverty: do not aestheticize real communities' hardship or create fake 'historical' documents.

styles.era_origin: Newspaper and agency photography of the 20th century; digital wire photography since the late 1990s.
visual_markers: peak moment of a live event
telephoto compression or close wide-angle immersion
foreground obstructions such as heads, arms, microphones
styles.prompt_fragment: news-agency photograph: decisive moment at a live event, 70-200mm telephoto compression or close 24mm immersion, available light with high-ISO noise, foreground obstructions like heads, arms and microphones at the frame edge, slightly imperfect framing, neutral color with no stylized grading, factual immediacy
styles.avoid: Avoid cinematic grading, perfect composition and posed subjects; credibility depends on visible imperfection.
styles.feasibility_note: Convincing, which is also what makes it a risk.
styles.sensitivity_note: Realistic fake news photos of real people, events or crises can mislead; avoid real persons and label results as illustrations.
styles.short_de: Höhepunkt eines Live-Ereignisses im vorhandenen Licht, mit dem Tele verdichtet oder nah im Weitwinkel, in neutralen Farben; Zeitungs- und Agenturfotografie seit dem frühen 20. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Peak moment of a live event in available light, telephoto-compressed or shot close and wide, with neutral colour; newspaper and agency photography since the early 20th century.
markers_de: Tele-Verdichtung oder Weitwinkel aus der Nähe
angeschnittene Köpfe, Arme, Mikrofone am Rand
markers_en: peak moment of a live event
telephoto compression or close wide angle
foreground obstructions at the frame edge
styles.sensitivity_de: Realistische Fake-Pressefotos realer Personen, Ereignisse oder Krisen können täuschen; keine realen Personen zeigen und Ergebnisse als Illustration kennzeichnen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Realistic fake news photos of real people, events or crises can mislead; avoid real persons and label results as illustrations.

styles.era_origin: From the Crimean War (1850s); the grainy hand-held 35mm combat aesthetic runs from the Spanish Civil War and WWII through Vietnam.
visual_markers: dust and smoke diffusing harsh light
desaturated earth tones or black and white
styles.prompt_fragment: frontline conflict photograph: hand-held 35mm film shot on the move, motion blur and tilted horizon, heavy grain, dust and smoke diffusing harsh sunlight, desaturated earthy palette or black and white, low crouching viewpoint, fragmentary chaotic composition, exhaustion and urgency rather than heroism
styles.avoid: Avoid heroic action-movie framing and explosions as spectacle; keep it raw, restrained and human.
styles.feasibility_note: Model may soften or refuse violent content; works best for aftermath, rest and ruins.
styles.sensitivity_note: Highly sensitive: never present real conflicts, victims or atrocities as fact, avoid gore and propaganda framing, and keep use fictional and clearly illustrative.
styles.short_de: Aus der Hand fotografierte Frontbilder mit Bewegungsunschärfe, schiefem Horizont, grobem Korn und rauchgefiltertem Licht; seit den 1850ern, der Kleinbild-Look entstand zwischen Spanischem Bürgerkrieg und Vietnam.
styles.short_en: Hand-held frontline photos with motion blur, tilted horizon, heavy grain and smoke-filtered light; documented since the 1850s, its 35mm look formed from the 1930s to Vietnam.
markers_de: Staub und Rauch streuen hartes Licht
markers_en: dust and smoke diffusing harsh light
desaturated earth tones or black and white
styles.sensitivity_de: Hochsensibel: reale Konflikte, Opfer oder Gräuel nie als Tatsache darstellen, keine drastische Gewalt oder Propaganda-Inszenierung, nur fiktional verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Highly sensitive: never present real conflicts, victims or atrocities as fact, avoid gore and propaganda framing, and keep use fictional.

styles.era_origin: Intimate diary-like art photography of the 1970s-90s, peaking in 1990s grunge and anti-fashion editorials.
visual_markers: point-and-shoot direct flash in cramped interiors
color negative with saturated reds and greenish shadows
styles.prompt_fragment: intimate diaristic snapshot: point-and-shoot direct flash in a cramped dim interior, color-negative film with saturated reds and greenish shadows, hard flash shadow on the wall, messy unstyled surroundings, candid closeness and unguarded expression, visible skin blemishes, slight overexposure on the nearest surface, 1990s grain
styles.avoid: Avoid glamour retouching and tidy styling, and do not romanticize emaciation or drug use.
styles.feasibility_note: Flash and color-negative cast render well.
styles.sensitivity_note: The 1990s 'heroin chic' label glamorized drug use and extreme thinness; avoid those connotations. The genre is tied to living photographers, so do not name them.
styles.short_de: Intime Blitzfotos mit der Kompaktkamera in engen, unaufgeräumten Räumen, satte Farbnegative, unverstellte Nähe; tagebuchartige Kunstfotografie der 1970er bis 90er und Anti-Mode-Strecken der 90er.
styles.short_en: Intimate point-and-shoot flash photos in cramped, messy rooms, with saturated colour negative and unguarded closeness; diary-like art photography of the 1970s–90s and 1990s anti-fashion editorials.
markers_de: Farbnegativ mit sattem Rot, grünlichen Schatten
markers_en: direct point-and-shoot flash in cramped rooms
colour negative with saturated reds, greenish shadows
styles.sensitivity_de: Das Etikett „Heroin Chic“ der 90er verklärte Drogenkonsum und extreme Magerkeit, diese Anklänge meiden; lebende Fotografen des Genres nicht nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: The 1990s 'heroin chic' label glamorized drug use and extreme thinness, so avoid those connotations; do not name the genre's living photographers.

styles.era_origin: Roman celebrity street photographers from the late 1950s; tabloid press of the 1990s-2000s.
visual_markers: subject startled or shielding the face
glare on sunglasses and car paint
styles.prompt_fragment: tabloid paparazzi photograph at night: blasting on-camera flash, subject startled mid-step or shielding the face, background falling to near-black, specular glare on sunglasses and car paint, other flashes firing in frame, hurried off-angle composition, overexposed foreground, high-contrast early-2000s digital look
styles.avoid: Avoid red-carpet posing and flattering cinematic light; it must feel intrusive and hurried.
styles.feasibility_note: Flash falloff and glare render reliably.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not use with real celebrities or private individuals; it simulates invasion of privacy.
styles.short_de: Nachtaufnahme mit grellem Aufsteckblitz, fast schwarzem Hintergrund und einer überrumpelten Person, die ihr Gesicht abschirmt; von römischen Promifotografen der späten 1950er bis zur Boulevardpresse der 2000er.
styles.short_en: Night shot with blasting on-camera flash, near-black background and a startled subject shielding the face; from Roman celebrity photographers of the late 1950s to 2000s tabloids.
markers_de: überrumpelte Person schirmt das Gesicht ab
markers_en: glare on sunglasses and car paint
styles.sensitivity_de: Nicht mit realen Prominenten oder Privatpersonen verwenden; der Stil simuliert einen Eingriff in die Privatsphäre.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not use with real celebrities or private individuals; it simulates an invasion of privacy.

styles.era_origin: Club and nightlife photography from the 1990s, ubiquitous on 2000s party blogs.
visual_markers: colored ambient lights smeared into streaks and ghost trails
styles.prompt_fragment: nightlife photograph with slow-sync flash: subject frozen sharp by direct flash while colored club lights smear into streaks and ghost trails behind, deliberate camera twist during exposure, sweaty glare on skin, dark crowded background, saturated magenta and blue ambient light, playful chaotic energy, late-2000s party-blog look
styles.avoid: Avoid clean neon cyberpunk scenes; the essence is sharp flash combined with smeared ambient motion.
styles.feasibility_note: Light streaks render well; the combination of a sharp core and a ghosted edge is inconsistent.
styles.short_de: Der Blitz friert die Person scharf ein, während die lange Belichtung farbige Clublichter zu Schlieren verwischt; Technik der Partyfotografie seit den 1990ern, allgegenwärtig auf Partyblogs der 2000er.
styles.short_en: Flash freezes the subject sharp while a long exposure smears coloured club lights into streaks behind; a nightlife technique from the 1990s, ubiquitous on 2000s party blogs.
markers_en: ambient lights smeared into streaks and ghosts

styles.era_origin: Fashion magazines from the 1930s; contemporary editorial conventions since the 1990s.
visual_markers: full-length framing with generous negative space
unexpected location used as a set
styles.prompt_fragment: high-fashion magazine editorial: angular sculptural pose, full-length or three-quarter frame with generous negative space, unexpected location treated as a set, hard strobe mixed with daylight, bold styling as the focal point, crisp medium-format detail, confident art direction, aloof expression, subtle film-like grain
styles.avoid: Avoid catalog smiles, generic bokeh portraits and glossy beauty skin; pose and concept should feel deliberately strange.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders well; poses can default to generic model stances.
styles.short_de: Modestrecke mit kantigen, skulpturalen Posen, markantem Styling und ungewöhnlichen Orten als Kulisse, in hartem Blitz- und Tageslicht; aus Modemagazinen seit den 1930er-Jahren.
styles.short_en: Fashion story with angular, sculptural poses, bold styling and unusual locations as sets, lit by hard strobe and daylight; from fashion magazines since the 1930s.
styles.era_de: seit den 1930ern; heutige Form seit den 1990ern, international
styles.era_en: 1930s to today; current form since the 1990s, international
markers_en: unexpected location used as a set

styles.era_origin: Mail-order catalogs of the 20th century; standardized online retail since the 2000s.
visual_markers: straight-on full-length framing at a consistent crop
styles.prompt_fragment: e-commerce catalog photograph: pure white or light-grey seamless background, flat even high-key lighting, straight-on full-length framing at a consistent crop, neutral standing pose, accurate true-to-life color, minimal soft floor shadow, no props or mood, every texture and seam clearly visible
styles.avoid: Avoid artful lighting and lifestyle context; standardization is the aesthetic.
styles.feasibility_note: Easy and consistent.
styles.short_de: Produkt oder Model vor weißer oder hellgrauer Hohlkehle in flachem, gleichmäßigem Licht, stets gleich gerahmt und farbtreu; vom Versandhauskatalog bis zum standardisierten Onlinehandel.
styles.short_en: Product or model on white or light grey seamless in flat, even light, framed identically every time with accurate colour; from mail-order catalogues to standardized online retail.

markers_en: straight-on framing at a consistent crop

styles.era_origin: Commercial product photography; standardized for online retail since the 2000s.
visual_markers: smooth gradient highlights from large softboxes
styles.prompt_fragment: commercial packshot: object isolated on pure white background, three-quarter view from slightly above, large softboxes producing smooth gradient highlights along the edges, subtle contact shadow or mirror reflection beneath, focus-stacked edge-to-edge sharpness, accurate neutral color, no props, labels and textures crisply legible
styles.avoid: Avoid dark dramatic backgrounds, splashes and lens flare; it is a neutral catalog record.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable; small label text may garble.
styles.sensitivity_note: Use invented product labels, not real brands.
styles.short_de: Freigestelltes Produkt auf reinem Weiß, leicht von oben in Dreiviertelansicht, mit weichen Softbox-Reflexen und feinem Kontaktschatten; Standard der Werbe- und Onlineshop-Fotografie.
styles.short_en: Product isolated on pure white, seen from slightly above in three-quarter view, with smooth softbox highlights and a faint contact shadow; standard in commercial and online-shop photography.
styles.era_de: seit dem 20. Jh.; im Onlinehandel seit den 2000ern
styles.era_en: 20th century to today; online retail since the 2000s
styles.sensitivity_de: Erfundene Etiketten verwenden, keine echten Marken.
styles.sensitivity_en: Use invented product labels, not real brands.

styles.era_origin: Print and TV advertising since the 1980s, digitally composited since the 2000s.
visual_markers: product centred heroically from a low angle
styles.prompt_fragment: advertising hero shot: product heroically centred from a slightly low angle, dark gradient background, sculpting strip lights creating bright rim highlights, frozen liquid splash and condensation droplets, glossy reflective surface, perfect symmetry, ultra-clean digitally composited finish

styles.sensitivity_de: Erfundene Produkte und Etiketten verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Use invented products and labels.

styles.era_origin: Magazine and brand still-life photography of the 2010s.
visual_markers: seamless paper and plinths in two or three bold flat colors
single hard light with crisp geometric shadows
physical set-built props such as cut paper and acrylic
styles.prompt_fragment: contemporary editorial still life: objects balanced in a precise, slightly absurd arrangement on painted plinths and seamless paper in two or three bold flat colors, single hard light casting crisp geometric shadows, set-built props of cut paper and acrylic, tactile matte surfaces, witty conceptual staging, medium-format clarity
styles.avoid: Avoid dark dramatic product lighting and digital gradients; keep physical props and flat matte color fields.
styles.feasibility_note: Color fields and hard shadows render cleanly; surfaces can look too CGI-smooth.

gebaute Requisiten aus Papier und Acryl
markers_en: two or three bold flat colour fields
single hard light with crisp geometric shadows
set-built props of cut paper and acrylic

styles.era_origin: The term 'knolling' was coined in 1987 in a furniture workshop; flat lays became a social-media staple in the 2010s.
visual_markers: objects aligned at right angles in a grid
equal spacing, sorted by size or color
styles.prompt_fragment: overhead flat-lay photograph shot exactly top-down: components and objects laid out at right angles in a tidy grid with equal spacing, plain matte background, soft shadowless daylight, no perspective convergence, everything sorted by size or color, crisp detail, catalog-like order
styles.avoid: Avoid angled perspectives, piles and decorative clutter; the strict right-angle order is the style.
styles.feasibility_note: Grid order holds well; objects occasionally overlap or the view tilts slightly.
styles.short_de: Gegenstände senkrecht von oben, rechtwinklig im gleichmäßigen Raster ausgerichtet; der Begriff Knolling stammt von 1987, Flat Lays verbreiteten sich in den 2010ern über soziale Medien.
styles.short_en: Objects shot straight down, aligned at right angles in an evenly spaced grid; the term knolling dates from 1987, flat lays spread on 2010s social media.
markers_de: gleiche Abstände, nach Größe oder Farbe sortiert
markers_en: objects aligned at right angles in a grid
equal spacing, sorted by size or colour

dark slate, stone or weathered wood surfaces
muted earthy palette with one luminous accent
intentional crumbs, drips and rumpled linen

bewusste Krümel, Tropfen und zerknittertes Leinen

dark slate, stone or weathered wood

visual_markers: harsh flat studio flash with everything in focus
garish oversaturated color with yellow-orange cast
busy props: patterned tablecloths, brown stoneware, candles
stiff frontal arrangement and printed-paper feel
styles.prompt_fragment: 1970s cookbook photograph: harsh flat studio flash, everything in focus, garish oversaturated color print with a yellow-orange cast, glossy glazed surfaces, elaborate garnish, busy props such as patterned tablecloths, brown stoneware and candles, stiff frontal arrangement, slightly faded printed-page feel
styles.avoid: Avoid modern food styling, shallow depth of field and soft natural window light.
styles.feasibility_note: Color cast and prop styling come through well.

markers_en: harsh flat flash, everything in focus
busy props: patterned cloths, brown stoneware, candles

styles.era_origin: Reaction against Pictorialism: Neue Sachlichkeit in 1920s Germany and Group f/64, founded in California in 1932.
visual_markers: edge-to-edge sharpness from a stopped-down view camera
full tonal scale from deep black to luminous white
close formal studies of form and texture
styles.prompt_fragment: straight black-and-white photograph: large-format view camera stopped down to f/64, edge-to-edge sharpness, full tonal scale from deep black to luminous white, close formal study of form and texture, objective unmanipulated rendering, smooth gelatin-silver contact print, red-filter darkened sky where sky appears
styles.avoid: Avoid soft focus, heavy grain and digital HDR halos; it is clean, precise and tonally rich.
styles.feasibility_note: Tonal range and sharpness render convincingly.
styles.short_de: Gestochen scharfe Schwarzweißfotos aus der stark abgeblendeten Großformatkamera, mit vollem Tonwertumfang und genauen Formstudien; Group f/64 in Kalifornien ab 1932, parallel zur Neuen Sachlichkeit.
styles.short_en: Razor-sharp black-and-white photographs from a stopped-down view camera with full tonal scale and close studies of form; Group f/64 in California from 1932, paralleled by German New Objectivity.
markers_de: voller Tonwertumfang von Tiefschwarz bis Weiß
nahe Studien von Form und Oberfläche
markers_en: edge-to-edge sharpness from a stopped-down view camera
full tonal scale from deep black to bright white
close formal studies of form and texture

styles.era_origin: Avant-garde photography of the 1920s-30s around the Bauhaus and Soviet Constructivism.
styles.prompt_fragment: 1920s avant-garde New Vision photograph: extreme worm's-eye or bird's-eye viewpoint, steep diagonal composition, radical cropping, strong cast-shadow patterns and repeated structures, high-contrast black-and-white gelatin-silver print, modernist enthusiasm for technology and geometry
styles.avoid: Avoid eye-level centred views and soft tonality; the disorienting angle is the point.
styles.feasibility_note: Extreme angles render well when stated explicitly.
styles.sensitivity_note: Soviet Constructivist imagery carries political propaganda connotations.
styles.short_de: Schwarzweißfotos aus extremer Frosch- oder Vogelperspektive mit steilen Diagonalen, radikalen Anschnitten und Schlagschattenmustern; Avantgarde der 1920er und 30er um Bauhaus und sowjetischen Konstruktivismus.
styles.short_en: Black-and-white photographs from extreme worm's- or bird's-eye angles with steep diagonals, radical crops and cast-shadow patterns; 1920s–30s avant-garde around the Bauhaus and Soviet Constructivism.
styles.sensitivity_de: Bildwelten des sowjetischen Konstruktivismus tragen politische Propaganda-Bezüge.
styles.sensitivity_en: Soviet Constructivist imagery carries political propaganda connotations.

styles.era_origin: Students of Bernd and Hilla Becher at the Kunstakademie Düsseldorf from the late 1970s; a dominant art-photography idiom of the 1990s.
styles.prompt_fragment: deadpan large-format color photograph: strictly frontal central viewpoint, emotionless distance, even overcast light without shadows, muted cool palette, extreme edge-to-edge detail as from an 8x10 negative, no decisive moment, monumental museum-print presence, subject presented like a specimen
styles.avoid: Avoid drama, golden light and expressive angles; neutrality and detail are everything.
styles.feasibility_note: Frontal neutrality renders well; the model tends to add mood unless told not to.
styles.sensitivity_note: Several of the school's protagonists are living; do not name them or recreate specific works.
styles.short_de: Großformatige Farbfotos, streng frontal in gleichmäßigem Wolkenlicht, gedämpft und extrem detailreich; aus der Becher-Klasse der Kunstakademie Düsseldorf ab Ende der 1970er.
styles.short_en: Large-format colour photographs, strictly frontal in even overcast light, muted and extremely detailed; from the Becher students at the Düsseldorf art academy, late 1970s onward.
styles.sensitivity_de: Mehrere Hauptvertreter leben noch; sie nicht nennen und keine konkreten Werke nachstellen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Several of the school's protagonists are living; do not name them or recreate specific works.

styles.era_origin: Developed by Bernd and Hilla Becher from 1959 with industrial structures.
visual_markers: grid of nine to fifteen black-and-white photographs
same kind of object in each panel
styles.prompt_fragment: typological grid of nine to fifteen black-and-white photographs in rows with white margins, each showing a different variant of the same kind of subject, identical frontal viewpoint, scale and centred framing, flat overcast sky or neutral ground, neutral grey tonality, encyclopedic comparative order
styles.avoid: Avoid varying angles, color or atmosphere between panels; strict sameness of method lets differences of form show.
styles.feasibility_note: Grid layout reliable; consistent viewpoint across many panels sometimes drifts.
styles.short_de: Raster aus neun bis fünfzehn Schwarzweißfotos, die Varianten eines Objekttyps aus derselben frontalen Ansicht zeigen; Methode von Bernd und Hilla Becher, begonnen 1959.
styles.short_en: Grid of nine to fifteen black-and-white photos showing variants of one type of object from the same frontal viewpoint; method of Bernd and Hilla Becher, begun in 1959.
markers_de: Raster aus neun bis fünfzehn Fotos
markers_en: grid of nine to fifteen photographs
same type of object in each panel

styles.era_origin: Named after the 1975 exhibition 'New Topographics: Photographs of a Man-Altered Landscape' at George Eastman House.
visual_markers: banal human-altered landscape: tract houses, lots, sheds
black and white or pale muted color
styles.prompt_fragment: 1970s New Topographics photograph: subject set within a banal human-altered landscape of tract housing, lots, fences and industrial sheds, detached neutral viewpoint from a slight elevation, flat bright light, wide view with high horizon, large-format clarity, black and white or pale muted color, no romance or drama
styles.avoid: Avoid golden hour, dramatic skies and picturesque nature; the anti-picturesque is the point.
styles.feasibility_note: Banal suburban settings come out well; the model sometimes beautifies the light.
styles.short_de: Distanzierte, nüchterne Ansichten von Reihenhaussiedlungen, Parkplätzen und Hallen in vom Menschen veränderter Landschaft, ohne Romantik; benannt nach einer Ausstellung von 1975 in Rochester.
styles.short_en: Detached, evenly lit views of tract houses, parking lots and sheds in a man-altered landscape, without romance; named after a 1975 exhibition at George Eastman House, Rochester.
markers_en: banal altered landscape: tract houses, lots, sheds
black and white or pale muted colour

styles.era_origin: Large-format staged narrative photography from the late 1970s, peaking in the 1990s-2000s.
visual_markers: elaborately constructed scene frozen at an ambiguous moment
dusk light blended with practical lamps and set lighting
figures absorbed and unaware of the camera
styles.prompt_fragment: large-format staged tableau photograph: elaborately constructed scene frozen at an ambiguous narrative moment, dusk light blended with practical lamps and film-set lighting, uncanny stillness, every corner in deep focus, muted cinematic palette, figures absorbed and unaware of the camera, meticulous production design
styles.avoid: Avoid teal-orange movie grading and shallow bokeh; the tableau is deep-focus, still and quietly unsettling.
styles.feasibility_note: Lighting mix renders well; deep focus must be insisted on.
styles.sensitivity_note: Main practitioners are living artists; do not name them or recreate specific works.
styles.short_de: Aufwendig gebaute Szenen, in einem mehrdeutigen Moment erstarrt, durchgehend scharf und von Dämmerlicht, Lampen und Setlicht beleuchtet; großformatige Kunstfotografie seit den späten 1970ern.
styles.short_en: Elaborately built scenes frozen at an ambiguous moment, deep-focused and lit by dusk, lamps and set lights; large-format art photography from the late 1970s onward.
markers_de: gebaute Szene, im mehrdeutigen Moment erstarrt
Dämmerlicht gemischt mit Lampen und Setlicht
versunkene Figuren, die die Kamera nicht bemerken
markers_en: constructed scene frozen at an ambiguous moment
dusk light mixed with practical lamps and set lighting
figures absorbed, unaware of the camera
styles.sensitivity_de: Die Hauptvertreter sind lebende Künstler; sie nicht nennen und keine konkreten Werke nachstellen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Its main practitioners are living artists; do not name them or recreate specific works.

styles.era_origin: Digital photo compositing since the 1990s, popular online in the 2010s.
visual_markers: consistent light and shadows across elements
styles.prompt_fragment: conceptual surreal photo composite: realistic photographic elements combined into an impossible situation with shifted scale or physics, one clear visual metaphor, minimal uncluttered background, consistent lighting and shadows across elements, polished digital finish, muted harmonious palette
styles.avoid: Avoid fantasy glow and painterly overload; one clear idea, photographically believable.
styles.feasibility_note: Native strength of image models.
styles.short_de: Realistische Fotoelemente, digital zu einer unmöglichen Szene mit einer einzigen Bildidee verschmolzen; seit den 1990ern verbreitet, in den 2010ern ein Social-Media-Phänomen.
styles.short_en: Realistic photo elements merged digitally into one impossible scene built on a single visual idea; practised since the 1990s and widely shared online in the 2010s.
markers_de: stimmiges Licht und Schatten über alle Elemente
markers_en: consistent light and shadows across all elements

styles.era_origin: Fine-art landscape photography with dense neutral-density filters, popular since the 2000s.
visual_markers: water turned to mist, clouds to streaks
one isolated element in vast negative space
styles.prompt_fragment: minimalist fine-art long exposure: several-minute exposure through a dense neutral-density filter turning water into mist and clouds into radial streaks, square black-and-white frame, one isolated element in vast smooth negative space, silvery gradients, calm geometric balance
styles.avoid: Avoid busy detail, saturated color and HDR; emptiness and smoothness carry the image.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders well.
styles.short_de: Schwarzweiße Langzeitbelichtungen über mehrere Minuten: Wasser wird zu Nebel, Wolken ziehen sich zu Streifen, ein einzelnes Motiv steht im Leerraum; Fine-Art-Landschaftsfotografie seit den 2000ern.
styles.short_en: Black-and-white exposures of several minutes that turn water to mist and clouds to streaks around one isolated element; fine-art landscape genre popular since the 2000s.
markers_de: Wasser als Nebel, Wolken als Streifen
ein einzelnes Motiv in viel Leerraum
markers_en: water smoothed to mist, clouds drawn into streaks
one isolated element in vast negative space

styles.era_origin: View-camera architectural photography, shaped by modernist architecture photography of the 1920s-60s.
visual_markers: perfectly parallel verticals from shift movements
crisp raking sunlight with hard geometric shadows
emphasis on planes, materials and structure
styles.prompt_fragment: classic architectural photograph: view camera with shift movements keeping all verticals perfectly parallel, crisp raking sunlight and hard geometric shadows, deep clear sky, precise two-point perspective, emphasis on planes, materials and structure, black-and-white or restrained color, impeccable large-format sharpness
styles.avoid: Avoid ultra-wide distortion, converging verticals, HDR and lens flare.
styles.feasibility_note: Model often lets verticals converge; state 'perfectly vertical lines, shift lens'.
styles.short_de: Architekturaufnahmen mit der Fachkamera: stürzende Linien korrigiert, harte Sonne, klare Flächen und Materialien; geprägt von der Architekturfotografie der Moderne in Europa und den USA, 1920er–1960er.
styles.short_en: Large-format architectural photographs with perfectly parallel verticals, hard sunlight and clean planes; shaped by modernist architecture photography in Europe and the US, 1920s–1960s.
markers_de: klares Streiflicht mit harten geometrischen Schatten
Betonung von Flächen, Material und Konstruktion
markers_en: perfectly parallel verticals via shift movements
crisp raking sunlight with hard geometric shadows
emphasis on planes, materials and structure

styles.era_origin: Mid-century modernist house photography of the 1950s-60s; standard for architecture and hotel photography since.
visual_markers: warm interior light glowing through glass
long tripod exposure with straight verticals
styles.prompt_fragment: twilight architectural photograph at blue hour: deep cobalt sky balanced against warm tungsten interior light glowing through large glass walls, long tripod exposure, perfectly straight verticals, still reflections on water or polished floors, serene emptiness, mid-century modernist elegance, soft tonal transitions
styles.avoid: Avoid neon cyberpunk tones and overcooked HDR; the warm-cool balance should be subtle and natural.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable.
styles.short_de: Außenaufnahmen in der Dämmerung, bei denen tiefblauer Himmel und warmes Innenlicht hinter Glas im Gleichgewicht stehen; aus der kalifornischen Architekturfotografie der Nachkriegsmoderne, heute Standard für Architektur und Hotels.
styles.short_en: Twilight exteriors balancing a deep cobalt sky against warm interior light glowing through glass; from mid-century modernist house photography in California, later standard for architecture and hotels.
markers_en: warm interior light glowing through glass
long tripod exposure with straight verticals

styles.era_origin: Shelter and design magazines; current editorial conventions since the 2000s.
visual_markers: straight verticals at around 24mm without distortion
soft window light as the main source
styles.prompt_fragment: editorial interior photograph: calm one-point frontal perspective with perfectly straight verticals, soft natural window light as the main source, styled but lived-in details, restrained natural palette, lens around 24mm without distortion, balanced exposure keeping window views slightly bright, quiet uninhabited atmosphere
styles.avoid: Avoid fisheye wide angles, all-lights-on HDR and showroom gloss.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders well; close to a default interior look.
styles.short_de: Ruhige, frontale Raumansichten im weichen Fensterlicht, mit geraden Vertikalen und gestylten, aber bewohnt wirkenden Details; gängige Bildsprache von Wohn- und Designmagazinen seit den 2000ern.
styles.short_en: Calm, frontal views of rooms in soft window light with straight verticals and styled but lived-in details; the editorial convention of design and home magazines since the 2000s.
markers_en: soft window light as main source

styles.era_origin: Online real-estate listings with bracketed HDR tonemapping, roughly 2005-2015.
visual_markers: flat grey shadows and oversaturated color
styles.prompt_fragment: real-estate listing photograph with overcooked HDR: 14mm ultra-wide view from a corner, stretched furniture at the edges, every lamp switched on, tonemapped halos around windows, flat grey shadows, oversaturated colors, cartoonishly blue replaced sky, crunchy local contrast, slightly crooked verticals
styles.avoid: Avoid tasteful interior styling; the exaggerated tonemapping artifacts are the point.
styles.feasibility_note: HDR halos and wide-angle stretch render convincingly.
styles.short_de: Überbearbeitete Exposé-Fotos aus der Raumecke mit Ultraweitwinkel, alle Lampen an, Halos um die Fenster, flache Schatten und eingesetzter Himmel; typisch für Immobilienportale etwa 2005–2015.
styles.short_en: Overprocessed listing photos from an ultra-wide corner view, with every lamp on, haloed windows, flat shadows and a pasted blue sky; typical of online real-estate ads around 2005–2015.

styles.era_origin: Urban-exploration online communities from the late 1990s; German 'Lost Places' scene of the 2000s-10s.
visual_markers: decaying interiors with peeling paint, rust and moss
shafts of dusty light through broken windows
muted palette with cold teal shadows
styles.prompt_fragment: urban exploration photograph: abandoned decaying interior with peeling paint, rust, moss and debris, shafts of dusty light through broken windows, symmetrical tripod composition, muted desaturated palette with cold teal shadows, detailed HDR-like texture, silent melancholic emptiness
styles.avoid: Avoid horror-movie fog and creatures; the mood is quiet melancholy, not fright.
styles.feasibility_note: Decay textures render very well.
styles.short_de: Aufnahmen verlassener, verfallender Gebäude mit abblätternder Farbe, Rost und staubigem Licht durch kaputte Fenster; aus der Urbex-Szene der späten 1990er, im deutschsprachigen Raum als „Lost Places“ bekannt.
styles.short_en: Photographs of abandoned, decaying buildings with peeling paint, rust and dusty light through broken windows; from urbex online communities of the late 1990s and Germany's 'Lost Places' scene.
markers_de: verfallene Innenräume mit abblätternder Farbe, Rost und Moos
markers_en: decaying interiors with peeling paint, rust and moss
shafts of dusty light through broken windows
muted palette with cold teal shadows

styles.era_origin: Urban and suburban night photography under sodium streetlights, 1970s-2010s, before LED streetlights.
visual_markers: deep inky shadows and dark-blue sky
styles.prompt_fragment: long-exposure night photograph under sodium-vapor streetlights: monochromatic orange-yellow pools of light, greenish fluorescent spill from windows, deep inky shadows, faint dark-blue sky, empty still scene, tripod sharpness, subtle film grain, quiet suburban loneliness
styles.avoid: Avoid magenta-cyan neon cyberpunk and rain-soaked blockbuster grading; this is a monochrome-orange, very quiet night.
styles.feasibility_note: Sodium monochrome renders well when neon is explicitly excluded.
styles.short_de: Stille, menschenleere Nachtszenen im orangegelben Licht von Natriumdampflampen, mit tiefen Schatten und dunkelblauem Himmel; Nachtfotografie in Stadt und Vorstadt aus der Zeit vor der LED-Straßenbeleuchtung.
styles.short_en: Still, empty night scenes lit by orange-yellow sodium streetlights against inky shadows and a dark-blue sky; urban and suburban night photography before the switch to LED lighting.

styles.era_origin: Calendar and travel-magazine color landscape photography; graduated-filter and HDR era since the 2000s.
visual_markers: ultra-wide lens with a strong foreground element
leading lines to a distant focal point
styles.prompt_fragment: classic golden-hour landscape photograph: ultra-wide lens low to the ground with a strong foreground element, leading lines toward a distant focal point, warm low sunlight raking across the terrain, saturated sky with dramatic clouds, graduated-filter balanced exposure, front-to-back sharpness, calendar-ready polish
styles.avoid: Use as a deliberate contrast: this is the AI-default landscape and should not bleed into other styles.
styles.feasibility_note: The model's default landscape.
styles.short_de: Weitwinkellandschaften mit markantem Vordergrund, Führungslinien und warmem Streiflicht unter dramatischem Himmel; Kalender- und Reisemagazin-Ästhetik seit den 1970ern, digital perfektioniert seit den 2000ern.
styles.short_en: Wide-angle landscapes with a strong foreground, leading lines and warm low sunlight under a dramatic sky; calendar and travel-magazine look since the 1970s, digitally polished since the 2000s.
markers_de: durchgehende Schärfe von vorn bis hinten
markers_en: ultra-wide lens with strong foreground element
leading lines to a distant focal point

styles.era_origin: Aerial photography since balloon flights in 1858; the consumer-drone top-down aesthetic since the mid-2010s.
visual_markers: tiny figures with long low-sun shadows
repeating textures of fields, roofs or water
styles.prompt_fragment: straight-down aerial drone photograph: nadir view flattening the world into graphic patterns, tiny figures and objects casting long low-sun shadows, repeating textures of fields, roofs or water, crisp detail, no horizon, strong color fields, map-like geometric composition
styles.avoid: Avoid oblique postcard aerials and tilt-shift blur; the flat, map-like top-down geometry is the look.
styles.feasibility_note: Top-down geometry renders well; scale consistency of tiny figures varies.
styles.short_de: Senkrechte Draufsichten ohne Horizont, die Felder, Dächer und Wasser zu grafischen Mustern verflachen; Luftbilder gibt es seit 1858, diesen Look seit den Hobbydrohnen Mitte der 2010er-Jahre.
styles.short_en: Straight-down views without horizon that flatten fields, roofs and water into graphic patterns; aerial photography dates to 1858, this top-down look to consumer drones of the mid-2010s.
styles.era_en: since 1858 (France); drone look since the mid-2010s
markers_de: wiederkehrende Strukturen von Feldern, Dächern oder Wasser
markers_en: tiny figures with long low-sun shadows
repeating textures of fields, roofs or water

styles.era_origin: Telephoto nature photography from the 1970s; contemporary competition aesthetics since the 2000s.
visual_markers: critical focus on the eye with catchlight
foreground and background melted into blur
styles.prompt_fragment: wildlife photograph with a 600mm telephoto lens: eye-level viewpoint, critical focus on the eye with a natural catchlight, foreground and background dissolved into smooth blur, compressed perspective, natural habitat colors, authentic behavior moment, fine fur or feather detail, slight high-ISO noise
styles.avoid: Avoid fantasy lighting and glossy, sculpted animals; keep natural behavior and ambient light.
styles.feasibility_note: Native strength; tends toward over-perfect sharpness.
styles.short_de: Tieraufnahmen auf Augenhöhe mit langem Tele, das Auge gestochen scharf, Vorder- und Hintergrund in Unschärfe aufgelöst; etabliert seit den 1970ern, geprägt von Fotowettbewerben seit den 2000ern.
styles.short_en: Eye-level telephoto shots of wild animals with the eye in sharp focus and surroundings melted into blur; established since the 1970s, refined by photo competitions since the 2000s.
markers_de: Schärfe exakt auf dem Auge mit Lichtreflex
Vorder- und Hintergrund in weicher Unschärfe
markers_en: critical focus on the eye with catchlight
foreground and background melted into blur

styles.era_origin: Close-up photography since the early 20th century; focus stacking common since the 2000s.
visual_markers: razor-thin focus plane or focus-stacked detail
micro-textures invisible to the naked eye
diffused flash on a soft dark or pastel background
styles.prompt_fragment: macro photograph at 1:1 to 5:1 magnification: extreme close-up revealing micro-texture, razor-thin plane of focus or focus-stacked detail, diffused twin flash, tiny dewdrops, soft dark or pastel background, surprising scale, crisp surface structures invisible to the naked eye
styles.avoid: Avoid fantasy glowing particles and miniature-world clichés; real optical magnification with natural textures.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable.
styles.short_de: Extreme Nahaufnahmen im Maßstab 1:1 oder größer, die Mikrostrukturen mit hauchdünner Schärfeebene oder per Focus-Stacking zeigen; seit dem frühen 20. Jh., Stacking verbreitet seit den 2000ern.
styles.short_en: Extreme close-ups at life size or larger, revealing micro-textures with razor-thin focus or focus stacking; close-up photography since the early 20th century, stacking common since the 2000s.
styles.era_de: seit dem frühen 20. Jh.; Focus-Stacking seit den 2000ern
styles.era_en: since the early 20th century; focus stacking since the 2000s
markers_de: weicher Blitz vor dunklem oder pastelligem Hintergrund
markers_en: micro-textures invisible to the naked eye
diffused flash on soft dark or pastel background

styles.era_origin: Underwater photography developed from the 1920s-50s; digital dive photography since the 2000s.
visual_markers: blue-green water absorbing red with distance
sun rays and rippled surface light
optional over-under split at the waterline
styles.prompt_fragment: underwater photograph: blue-green water absorbing red with distance, foreground lit by twin strobes revealing true colors, floating particles and backscatter, sun rays and rippled light from the surface, optional over-under split with the waterline across the frame, wide-angle dome-port distortion, rising bubbles
styles.avoid: Avoid crystal-clear swimming-pool water; real water has particles, falloff and color loss.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders well; split shots occasionally misalign the waterline.
styles.short_de: Blaugrünes Wasser, das Rot mit der Entfernung schluckt, blitzbeleuchteter Vordergrund in echten Farben, Schwebeteilchen und Sonnenstrahlen von oben; seit den 1890ern, digitale Tauchfotografie seit den 2000ern.
styles.short_en: Blue-green water swallowing red with distance, strobe-lit foregrounds in true colour, backscatter and sun rays from the surface; practised since the 1890s, digital dive photography since the 2000s.
styles.era_de: seit den 1890ern, Frankreich; digital seit den 2000ern
styles.era_en: since the 1890s, France; digital since the 2000s
markers_de: blaugrünes Wasser, Rot verschwindet mit der Distanz
Sonnenstrahlen und Lichtkringel von der Oberfläche
optional Split-Shot über und unter der Wasserlinie
markers_en: blue-green water absorbing red with distance
sun rays and rippled surface light
optional over-under split at the waterline

styles.era_origin: Digital astro-landscape photography since high-ISO sensors of the late 2000s.
visual_markers: Milky Way core arching over a faint foreground
green airglow and orange light-pollution glow at the horizon
low-level light painting on the foreground
styles.prompt_fragment: nightscape astro-landscape photograph: Milky Way core arching over a faint foreground, pinpoint stars, subtle green airglow and orange light-pollution glow at the horizon, 20-second exposure on a wide fast lens, gentle low-level light painting on the foreground, high-ISO noise, deep blue-black sky
styles.avoid: Avoid oversaturated purple fantasy galaxies and impossible star density.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders well; tends to oversaturate the galactic core.
styles.short_de: Weite Nachtlandschaften mit dem Bogen der Milchstraße über einem schwach beleuchteten Vordergrund und punktförmigen Sternen; digitales Genre, möglich geworden durch rauscharme Sensoren seit Ende der 2000er.
styles.short_en: Wide night landscapes with the Milky Way core arching over a faintly lit foreground and pinpoint stars; digital genre made possible by high-ISO sensors since the late 2000s.
markers_de: Milchstraßenzentrum als Bogen über dunklem Vordergrund
grünes Airglow und orange Lichtverschmutzung am Horizont
markers_en: Milky Way core arching over a faint foreground
green airglow and orange light pollution at the horizon
gentle light painting on the foreground

styles.era_origin: Telescope astrophotography; narrowband sulfur-hydrogen-oxygen color mapping popularized by space-telescope imagery from the 1990s.
visual_markers: wispy nebular filaments and dust lanes
narrowband false color in gold, teal and blue
styles.prompt_fragment: deep-sky telescope image: hours-long stacked exposure, wispy nebular filaments and dust lanes, narrowband false color mapped to gold, teal and blue, stars with four-pointed diffraction spikes, deep black background, fine noise in faint regions, scientific rather than fantasy rendering
