styles.avoid: Avoid fantasy space art with planets and rainbow glows; keep astronomical structure and scientific restraint.
styles.feasibility_note: Nebulae look plausible; non-astronomical motifs have to be reframed as nebulae or constellations.
styles.sensitivity_note: 'Hubble palette' refers to a NASA/ESA telescope and is used only as a descriptive technical term.
styles.short_de: Lang belichtete, gestackte Teleskopaufnahmen von Nebeln und Galaxien, oft in Schmalband-Falschfarben aus Gold, Türkis und Blau; diese Farbzuordnung machten Weltraumteleskop-Bilder der 1990er bekannt.
styles.short_en: Long stacked telescope exposures of nebulae and galaxies, often in narrowband false colour of gold, teal and blue; the mapping was popularized by space-telescope images from the 1990s.
styles.era_en: since the 1880s; narrowband look since the 1990s
markers_de: Schmalband-Falschfarben in Gold, Türkis und Blau
markers_en: wispy nebular filaments and dust lanes
narrowband false colour in gold, teal and blue
styles.sensitivity_de: „Hubble-Palette“ steht hier nur als technischer Fachbegriff für die Farbzuordnung.
styles.sensitivity_en: 'Hubble palette' is used only as a descriptive technical term for the colour mapping.

styles.era_origin: Commercial scanning electron microscopes since 1965.
visual_markers: data bar with scale bar and magnification
styles.prompt_fragment: scanning electron micrograph: grayscale secondary-electron image with enormous depth of field, bright glowing edges from the edge effect, crisp microscopic surface topography, no natural color or an optional flat false-color tint, black surroundings, data bar along the bottom with scale bar and magnification
styles.avoid: Avoid colorful fantasy microscope imagery and shallow depth of field.
styles.feasibility_note: Very convincing; numbers in the data bar can be gibberish, so keep them short.
styles.short_de: Graustufenbilder aus dem Rasterelektronenmikroskop mit enormer Schärfentiefe, hell leuchtenden Kanten und Datenleiste mit Maßstab; wissenschaftliche Standardbilder, seit 1965 kommerzielle Geräte verfügbar wurden.
styles.short_en: Grayscale electron-microscope images with enormous depth of field, glowing edges and a data bar with scale; standard scientific imagery since commercial scanning electron microscopes appeared in 1965.
markers_en: data bar with scale and magnification

styles.era_origin: Light microscopy of stained tissue sections; H&E staining standard since the late 19th century.
visual_markers: circular eyepiece field with dark vignette
slight chromatic fringing and uneven focus
styles.prompt_fragment: brightfield light micrograph of a stained section: circular eyepiece field with dark vignette, hematoxylin-and-eosin pink and violet staining, translucent cellular structures, thin-slice flatness, slight chromatic fringing and uneven focus, glass-slide imperfections, small scale bar
styles.avoid: Avoid 3D-rendered cells and neon glows; histology is flat, translucent and pink-purple.
styles.feasibility_note: Overall look good; applying it to arbitrary motifs means translating them into cell-like structures.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not create fake diagnostic images.
styles.short_de: Lichtmikroskopische Ansichten dünner Gewebeschnitte, mit Hämatoxylin und Eosin rosa und violett gefärbt, flach und durchscheinend; Standardfärbung in Pathologie und Biologie seit dem späten 19. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Light-microscope views of thin tissue sections stained pink and violet with hematoxylin and eosin, flat and translucent; standard staining of pathology and biology since the late 19th century.
markers_en: circular eyepiece field with dark vignette
styles.sensitivity_de: Nicht für gefälschte Diagnosebilder verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not create fake diagnostic images.

styles.era_origin: Fluorescence microscopy from the early 20th century; confocal laser scanning widespread since the 1980s-90s.
visual_markers: separate glowing channels in green, magenta and blue
fine filament networks and bright nuclei
styles.prompt_fragment: confocal fluorescence micrograph: pure black background, structures glowing in separate channels of green, magenta and blue, fine filament networks and bright nuclei, slight channel overlap producing white, photon noise in dim areas, scale bar in a corner, scientific precision
styles.avoid: Avoid sci-fi neon scenes; fluorescence is clean biological structure on black.
styles.feasibility_note: Aesthetic renders well; non-biological motifs must be reinterpreted as stained structures.
styles.short_de: Strukturen leuchten in getrennten Kanälen in Grün, Magenta und Blau auf reinem Schwarz, feine Filamente und helle Zellkerne; Fluoreszenzmikroskopie seit den 1910ern, konfokal seit den 1980ern.
styles.short_en: Structures glowing in separate green, magenta and blue channels on pure black, fine filaments and bright nuclei; fluorescence microscopy since the 1910s, confocal laser scanning since the 1980s.
markers_de: getrennt leuchtende Kanäle in Grün, Magenta, Blau
markers_en: separate glowing channels in green, magenta and blue
fine filament networks and bright nuclei

styles.era_origin: Since Röntgen's discovery in 1895; artistic X-rays of flowers and objects since the 1930s.
visual_markers: dense parts bright, soft parts faint
overlapping layers seen through each other
lead position markers and labels at the edge
styles.prompt_fragment: radiograph: translucent grayscale image revealing internal structure, dense parts bright white and soft parts faint grey, overlapping layers seen through each other, black surrounding air, slight blur and film grain, lead position markers and small labels at the edge, clinical light-box presentation
styles.avoid: Avoid glowing blue sci-fi holograms; real X-rays are grayscale, flat and translucent.
styles.feasibility_note: Translucency renders convincingly; anatomy is approximate.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not produce fake medical records of real people.
styles.short_de: Durchscheinende Graustufenbilder, in denen Dichtes weiß und Weiches blass erscheint und Schichten sich überlagern; seit Röntgens Entdeckung 1895 im Einsatz, künstlerisch seit den 1930ern.
styles.short_en: Translucent grayscale images where dense parts show white and soft parts faint, layers overlapping; in use since Röntgen's discovery in 1895, artistically since the 1930s.
markers_en: dense parts bright, soft parts faint
overlapping layers seen through each other
lead position markers and labels at the edge
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine gefälschten medizinischen Befunde realer Personen erzeugen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not produce fake medical records of real people.

styles.era_origin: Military and industrial thermal cameras from the 1960s-70s; common in building inspection since the 2000s.
visual_markers: soft blurry heat gradients instead of texture
styles.prompt_fragment: thermal camera image: ironbow false-color palette running from black and violet through red and orange to white-hot yellow, soft blurry heat gradients instead of surface texture, low resolution, temperature scale bar along one side, centre crosshair with numeric readout, slight sensor noise
styles.avoid: Avoid ordinary photos with an orange filter; heat, not light, defines brightness.
styles.feasibility_note: Palette and UI overlay render well; heat logic (warm bodies, cold windows) is approximate.
styles.short_de: Falschfarbene Wärmebilder in der Ironbow-Palette von Schwarz und Violett bis weißglühendem Gelb, weich und niedrig aufgelöst, mit Temperaturskala; aus Militär- und Industriekameras der 1960er und 1970er.
styles.short_en: False-colour heat images in the ironbow palette, black and violet to white-hot yellow, soft and low-resolution with scale bar; from military and industrial cameras of the 1960s–70s.
markers_de: Fadenkreuz in der Mitte mit Messwert
markers_en: ironbow false-colour palette, black to white-hot
soft heat gradients instead of texture

styles.era_origin: Developed by August Toepler in 1864; iconic in aerodynamics and heat-flow studies.
visual_markers: invisible air made visible as plumes and shock waves
smooth grey gradients or rainbow color-filter variant
circular field from a concave mirror
styles.prompt_fragment: schlieren photograph: invisible air made visible as rising heat plumes, shock waves and turbulent wisps around the subject, rendered in smooth grey gradients or a rainbow color-filter variant, circular field from a concave mirror, uniform backdrop, scientific laboratory clarity
styles.avoid: Avoid smoke, fire or glowing aura effects; schlieren shows refractive gradients, not smoke.
styles.feasibility_note: Model may render smoke instead of refractive plumes; referencing shock waves and convection helps.
styles.short_de: Unsichtbare Luftströmungen als Wärmefahnen, Stoßwellen und Verwirbelungen in Grauverläufen oder Regenbogenfarben; Labormethode, 1864 von August Toepler entwickelt.
styles.short_en: Invisible air made visible as heat plumes, shock waves and turbulent wisps in grey gradients or rainbow filter colours; laboratory method devised by August Toepler in 1864.
markers_de: unsichtbare Luft als Fahnen und Stoßwellen
markers_en: invisible air shown as plumes and shock waves
smooth grey gradients or rainbow colour-filter variant
circular field from a concave mirror

styles.era_origin: Microsecond electronic flash photography pioneered at MIT in the 1930s; liquid-drop art photography since the 2000s.
visual_markers: liquid crowns, droplets and shards suspended mid-air
styles.prompt_fragment: high-speed flash photograph: a split-second frozen by a microsecond flash, liquid crowns, droplets and shards suspended mid-air with perfect sharpness, plain black or white background, crisp specular highlights, scientific curiosity rather than advertising gloss
styles.avoid: Avoid motion blur and glossy beverage-ad styling; it should look like a lab experiment.
styles.feasibility_note: Splashes render convincingly; physics is approximate.
styles.short_de: Mit Mikrosekundenblitz eingefrorene Augenblicke: Flüssigkeitskronen, Tropfen und Splitter schweben vor schlichtem Hintergrund; in den 1930ern am MIT entwickelt, als Tropfenfotografie populär seit den 2000ern.
styles.short_en: Split-second moments frozen by microsecond flash: liquid crowns, droplets and shards hanging in mid-air before a plain background; pioneered at MIT in the 1930s.
styles.era_de: seit den 1930ern, USA; Tropfenfotografie seit den 2000ern
styles.era_en: since the 1930s, USA; drop art since the 2000s
markers_de: Flüssigkeitskronen, Tropfen und Splitter in der Luft
markers_en: liquid crowns, droplets and shards in mid-air

styles.era_origin: Serial motion studies with batteries of cameras from 1878.
visual_markers: grid of twelve to twenty-four consecutive frames
styles.prompt_fragment: 19th-century serial motion study: grid of twelve to twenty-four small consecutive frames showing successive phases of one movement, subject against a gridded measurement backdrop, frame numbers, side-on viewpoint, harsh sunlight, brownish albumen-print tonality with uneven exposure between frames
styles.avoid: Avoid modern sports-sequence montages and color; keep the scientific grid and period print tone.
styles.feasibility_note: Grid holds; phase-by-phase accuracy of the motion is approximate.
styles.short_de: Raster aus zwölf bis 24 aufeinanderfolgenden Einzelbildern, die die Phasen einer Bewegung vor einem Messraster zeigen; Serienfotografie mit Kamerabatterien, begonnen 1878 in Kalifornien.
styles.short_en: Grids of twelve to twenty-four consecutive frames showing the phases of one movement against a gridded backdrop; serial motion studies with camera batteries, begun in California in 1878.

styles.era_origin: Single-plate chronophotography in the 1880s; electronic stroboscopic multi-flash photography from the 1930s.
visual_markers: many discrete frozen copies of the subject in one frame
styles.prompt_fragment: stroboscopic multi-flash photograph: one frame holding many evenly spaced frozen copies of the moving subject overlapping along its trajectory, pure black background, crisp white flash highlights, fading repetitions, black-and-white scientific print with a faint measurement scale
styles.avoid: Avoid continuous motion blur and digital ghost effects; the repeats must be discrete and evenly spaced.
styles.feasibility_note: Repetition works; even spacing and consistent subject identity vary.
styles.short_de: Viele gleichmäßig verteilte, eingefrorene Abbilder eines bewegten Motivs in einem einzigen Bild vor Schwarz; Chronofotografie auf einer Platte ab den 1880ern in Frankreich, elektronischer Mehrfachblitz ab den 1930ern.
styles.short_en: Many evenly spaced, frozen copies of a moving subject in a single frame against black; single-plate chronophotography from 1880s France, electronic multi-flash photography from the 1930s.
markers_de: viele eingefrorene Abbilder in einem Bild
markers_en: many frozen copies of the subject in one frame

styles.era_origin: Artistic use of flatbed scanners since the 1990s.
visual_markers: contact surfaces pressed against glass razor-sharp and flattened
rapid blur and fade into a pitch-black void
even frontal scanner light, no perspective
faint linear scan streaks and color fringing from movement
styles.prompt_fragment: flatbed scanner image: objects pressed directly onto the glass with flattened contact surfaces razor sharp, parts lifting away quickly blurring and fading into a pitch-black void, even frontal scanner light, hyper-detailed texture, faint linear scan streaks, slight color fringing where something moved during the scan
styles.avoid: Avoid studio lighting and perspective depth; the scanner has no perspective and a very fast falloff.
styles.feasibility_note: Black falloff works; flattened contact areas are not always convincing.
styles.short_de: Direkt auf den Flachbettscanner gelegte Objekte, gestochen scharf, wo sie das Glas berühren, und ins Schwarz verschwimmend, wo sie sich abheben; künstlerische Praxis seit den 1990ern.
styles.short_en: Objects placed on a flatbed scanner, razor-sharp where they touch the glass and fading into black where they lift away; an art practice since the 1990s.
markers_de: schneller Übergang in Unschärfe und tiefes Schwarz
feine Scanstreifen und Farbsäume bei Bewegung
markers_en: contact surfaces razor-sharp and flattened against glass
rapid blur and fade into pitch-black void
faint scan streaks and colour fringing from movement

styles.era_origin: Museum, archaeological and conservation documentation standards of the 20th century.
styles.prompt_fragment: museum collection documentation photograph: object on neutral mid-grey card, even diffused copy lighting, orthogonal front view, color-checker target and centimetre scale ruler beside it, small accession-number label, sober neutral color accuracy, no shadows or styling, archival database presentation
styles.avoid: Avoid dramatic product lighting and lifestyle staging; it is an objective record.
styles.feasibility_note: Scale bars and color cards render well; small text may garble.
styles.sensitivity_note: Treat sacred or culturally sensitive artifacts and human remains with care; do not fabricate provenance records.
styles.short_de: Nüchterne, orthogonale Objektaufnahmen auf neutralem Grau mit Farbkarte, Zentimetermaßstab und Inventarnummer; Dokumentationsstandard von Museen, Archäologie und Restaurierung im 20. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Sober, orthogonal photos of objects on neutral grey with colour checker, centimetre scale and accession label; documentation standard of museums, archaeology and conservation in the 20th century.
styles.sensitivity_de: Sakrale oder kulturell sensible Objekte und menschliche Überreste mit Bedacht behandeln und keine Provenienzangaben erfinden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Treat sacred or culturally sensitive objects and human remains with care, and do not fabricate provenance records.

styles.era_origin: Forensic and metric police photography from the 1890s; modern evidence documentation.
styles.prompt_fragment: forensic evidence photograph: harsh direct flash, numbered yellow evidence markers beside items, L-shaped scale ruler, straight-on or overhead documentary angle, clinical uncomposed framing, cold color, ordinary objects made suspicious by method, no gore
styles.avoid: Avoid true-crime drama, blood and moody cinematic light; the dryness of procedure is the style.
styles.feasibility_note: Evidence markers and rulers render reliably.
styles.sensitivity_note: Never depict victims, bodies or real crimes; use only objects or clearly fictional scenes.
styles.short_de: Nüchterne Beweisfotos mit hartem Direktblitz, nummerierten gelben Markern und L-Maßstäben, frontal oder von oben aufgenommen; polizeiliche Dokumentationspraxis seit dem späten 19. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Clinical evidence photos in harsh direct flash with numbered yellow markers and L-shaped scales, shot straight on or from above; police documentation practice since the late 19th century.
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine Opfer, Leichen oder realen Verbrechen zeigen, nur Gegenstände oder erkennbar fiktive Szenen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Never depict victims, bodies or real crimes; use only objects or clearly fictional scenes.

styles.era_origin: Closed-circuit television surveillance, widespread since the 1980s-90s.
visual_markers: washed-out color or infrared monochrome night mode
styles.prompt_fragment: security camera still: high corner viewpoint looking down, wide-angle barrel distortion, low-resolution blurry frame with blocky compression artifacts, timestamp and camera-ID overlay text, washed-out color or infrared monochrome night mode, motion smear on moving figures, flat fluorescent lighting
styles.avoid: Avoid crisp detail and cinematic composition; the image is a machine's indifferent record.
styles.feasibility_note: Overlay and degradation render well; the model sometimes keeps too much detail.
styles.sensitivity_note: Fake surveillance stills of real people or places could be misused as fabricated evidence.
styles.short_de: Niedrig aufgelöste Bilder einer hoch angebrachten Eckkamera mit Weitwinkelverzerrung, Kompressionsblöcken und Zeitstempel, blass oder infrarot-monochrom; allgegenwärtige Videoüberwachung seit den 1980er- und 1990er-Jahren.
styles.short_en: Low-resolution frames from a high corner camera with wide-angle distortion, compression blocks and timestamp overlay, washed-out or infrared monochrome; ubiquitous closed-circuit surveillance since the 1980s–90s.
styles.sensitivity_de: Gefälschte Überwachungsbilder realer Personen oder Orte können als falsche Beweise missbraucht werden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Fake surveillance stills of real people or places can be misused as fabricated evidence.

styles.era_origin: Trip-wire flash wildlife photography from the 1890s; infrared trail cameras since the 1990s-2000s.
visual_markers: fixed low viewpoint at knee height
infrared night flash in monochrome grey
bright foreground falling off into black
data strip with date, time, temperature and moon phase
styles.prompt_fragment: trail camera capture: fixed low viewpoint at knee height, infrared night flash rendering everything in monochrome grey, glowing eye-shine, bright overexposed foreground fading into black, subject partly cut off at the frame edge, motion blur, data strip along the bottom showing date, time, temperature and a moon-phase icon
styles.avoid: Avoid well-composed wildlife portraits; the camera triggers blindly.
styles.feasibility_note: Very convincing, including the data strip.
styles.short_de: Von vorbeiziehenden Tieren ausgelöste Aufnahmen aus niedriger, fester Position, oft graues Infrarot-Nachtbild mit leuchtenden Augen und Datenleiste; vom Stolperdraht-Blitz der 1890er bis zur Infrarot-Wildkamera der 1990er.
styles.short_en: Low, fixed-angle shots triggered by passing animals, often grey infrared night flash with glowing eyes and data strip; from 1890s trip-wire flash to 1990s infrared trail cameras.
styles.era_de: seit den 1890ern, USA; Infrarot seit den 1990ern
styles.era_en: since the 1890s, USA; infrared since the 1990s
markers_de: heller Vordergrund, der ins Schwarz abfällt
Datenleiste mit Datum, Uhrzeit, Temperatur, Mondphase
markers_en: fixed low viewpoint at knee height
bright foreground falling off into black
data strip with date, time, temperature, moon phase

styles.era_origin: Telephoto sports photography since the 1960s; high-speed digital since the 2000s.
visual_markers: tight crop on tense expression and body
styles.prompt_fragment: professional sports photograph: 400mm telephoto from the sideline, peak action frozen at 1/2000 second, flying sweat droplets and debris, tight crop on intense expression and tensed body, background crowd dissolved into blurry color, hard stadium light or sunlight, punchy contrast
styles.avoid: Avoid video-game hero poses and dramatic sky composites; keep the journalistic angle and telephoto compression.
styles.feasibility_note: Native strength.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid real team kits, league logos and athlete likenesses.
styles.short_de: Teleaufnahmen vom Spielfeldrand, die den Höhepunkt der Aktion mit kürzester Belichtungszeit einfrieren, eng am angespannten Körper vor verschwommenem Publikum; professionelle Sportfotografie seit den 1960ern.
styles.short_en: Telephoto shots from the sideline freezing peak action at very short shutter speeds, tight on tense bodies against a blurred crowd; professional sports photography since the 1960s.
markers_de: Höhepunkt der Aktion bei 1/2000 s eingefroren
enger Ausschnitt auf Gesicht und Körperspannung
markers_en: tight crop on tense face and body
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine echten Trikots, Ligalogos oder erkennbaren Sportler darstellen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid real team kits, league logos and athletes' likenesses.

styles.era_origin: Classic motor-sport and street technique since the 1950s.
visual_markers: background smeared into long horizontal streaks
slight blur on moving limbs or wheels
styles.prompt_fragment: panning photograph: camera tracking the moving subject at a slow shutter speed so the subject stays sharp while the background smears into long horizontal streaks, slight blur on moving limbs or wheels, side-on viewpoint, strong sense of speed, natural light
styles.avoid: Avoid radial zoom blur and fully frozen backgrounds.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable.
styles.short_de: Das bewegte Motiv bleibt scharf, weil die Kamera bei langer Belichtungszeit mitgezogen wird, während der Hintergrund zu waagerechten Streifen verwischt; Technik aus Motorsport und Street seit den 1950ern.
styles.short_en: Moving subject kept sharp by panning at a slow shutter speed while the background smears into horizontal streaks; motor-sport and street technique since the 1950s.
markers_de: leichte Unschärfe an Gliedmaßen oder Rädern
markers_en: background smeared into long horizontal streaks
slight blur on moving limbs or wheels

styles.era_origin: Skateboard magazine photography of the 1980s-90s.
visual_markers: fisheye lens inches away, low angle
styles.prompt_fragment: 1990s skateboard-magazine photograph: fisheye lens inches away from a low angle, strongly curved horizon and architecture, multiple off-camera flashes freezing the action against a darkening dusk sky, gritty concrete textures, color-slide saturation, raw subcultural energy
styles.avoid: Avoid clean sports-ad gloss; the bent fisheye perspective and flash are essential.
styles.feasibility_note: Fisheye curvature and flash-against-dusk render well.
styles.short_de: Fisheye-Aufnahmen aus der Froschperspektive, dicht am Skater, mit gekrümmtem Horizont und entfesselten Blitzen, die den Trick vor dem Dämmerungshimmel einfrieren; Skatemagazin-Fotografie der 1980er und 1990er.
styles.short_en: Low-angle fisheye shots taken inches from the skater, with curved horizons, off-camera flashes freezing the trick and a darkening dusk sky; skateboard-magazine photography of the 1980s–90s.
markers_de: mehrere entfesselte Blitze frieren die Bewegung ein
markers_en: fisheye lens inches away, low angle

styles.era_origin: Rock concert photography from the 1960s; LED stage-lighting era since the 2010s.
visual_markers: stage haze backlit by colored spotlights
strong rim light and partial silhouette
saturated red, blue or magenta wash
crowd hands or heads in the foreground
styles.prompt_fragment: live concert photograph: stage haze lit by colored spotlights from behind, strong rim light and partial silhouette, high-ISO noise in the shadows, saturated red, blue or magenta wash, beams and flares of stage lights, motion blur, crowd hands or heads in the foreground, shot from the pit
styles.avoid: Avoid clean studio portraiture and implausibly perfect exposure.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid real performers' likenesses.
styles.short_de: Gegenlicht durch Bühnennebel, farbige Scheinwerfer, Kantenlicht und gesättigtes Rot, Blau oder Magenta mit sichtbarem Rauschen; Konzertfotografie aus dem Fotograben seit den Rockkonzerten der 1960er.
styles.short_en: Performers backlit through stage haze by coloured spotlights, rim-lit, in saturated red, blue or magenta with high-ISO noise; rock concert photography since the 1960s.
markers_de: Hände oder Köpfe des Publikums im Vordergrund
markers_en: stage haze backlit by coloured spotlights
strong rim light and partial silhouette
saturated red, blue or magenta wash
crowd hands or heads in the foreground
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine erkennbaren realen Musikerinnen und Musiker darstellen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid likenesses of real performers.

styles.era_origin: Dance photography since the 1930s; contemporary studio dance photography with powder and fabric since the 2000s.
visual_markers: flowing fabric or thrown powder trailing the gesture
styles.prompt_fragment: studio dance photograph: black void background, sculpting side and rim light, movement frozen at its apex with extended lines, flowing fabric or thrown powder trailing the gesture, graceful tension, precise timing, monochrome or limited palette
styles.avoid: Avoid ballroom stock clichés and blur that hides the form.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders well; anatomy in extreme poses can break.
styles.short_de: Bewegung am Scheitelpunkt eingefroren, vor schwarzem Grund, modelliert durch Seiten- und Kantenlicht, mit wehendem Stoff oder geworfenem Puder; zeitgenössische Studio-Tanzfotografie seit den 2000ern.
styles.short_en: Movement frozen at its apex against black, sculpted by side and rim light, trailed by flowing fabric or thrown powder; contemporary studio dance photography since the 2000s.
styles.era_de: seit den 1930ern; Studio-Look mit Puder und Stoff seit den 2000ern
styles.era_en: since the 1930s; powder-and-fabric studio look since the 2000s

styles.era_origin: Tilt-lens miniature effect, popular from the mid-2000s.
visual_markers: narrow horizontal band of sharp focus
styles.prompt_fragment: tilt-shift miniature effect: elevated vantage point looking down on the scene, a narrow horizontal band of sharp focus with strong blur above and below, boosted saturation and contrast, bright sunlight, making real life look like a toy model
styles.avoid: Avoid eye-level views and general background blur; the effect needs a high viewpoint and a thin band of focus.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable.
styles.short_de: Erhöhte Blickpunkte mit schmalem Schärfestreifen, starker Unschärfe darüber und darunter und kräftigen Farben, sodass echte Szenen wie Modellbau wirken; populär seit Mitte der 2000er.
styles.short_en: Elevated views with a narrow band of focus, heavy blur above and below and boosted colour that make real scenes look like toy models; popular from the mid-2000s.
markers_en: narrow horizontal band of sharp focus

styles.era_origin: Since the 19th century; in-camera and digital double exposures popular again in the 2010s.
visual_markers: second image visible where the first is dark
silhouette filled with a second scene
styles.prompt_fragment: in-camera double exposure: two photographs layered translucently, the second image showing through where the first is darkest, silhouette edges filled with the texture of a second scene, highlights blending to white, ghostly overlap, film grain
styles.avoid: Avoid polished digital masking; real double exposures blend by light, not by cut-outs.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders well; tends toward the clean digital silhouette-fill version.
styles.short_de: Zwei Bilder durchscheinend übereinander, das zweite erscheint in den dunklen Partien des ersten, oft als Silhouette mit einer zweiten Szene; seit dem 19. Jh., Revival in den 2010ern.
styles.short_en: Two images layered translucently in one frame, the second showing through the darks of the first, often a silhouette filled with another scene; since the 19th century.
styles.era_de: seit dem 19. Jh.; Revival in den 2010ern
styles.era_en: since the 19th century; revival in the 2010s
markers_de: zweites Bild in den Schatten des ersten sichtbar
Silhouette mit einer zweiten Szene gefüllt
markers_en: second image visible in the darks of the first
silhouette filled with a second scene

styles.era_origin: Experimental technique of the 20th century, popular in fine-art landscape photography since the 2000s.
visual_markers: entire frame streaked by camera motion
directional blur along the dominant lines
styles.prompt_fragment: intentional camera movement photograph: half-second exposure while sweeping the camera, the whole frame dissolved into painterly streaks and color bands, no sharp details anywhere, soft impressionistic forms, directional blur following the dominant lines
styles.avoid: Avoid a sharp subject on a blurred background; the whole frame moves.
styles.feasibility_note: The model keeps the subject sharp; stress 'entire frame blurred'.
styles.short_de: Das ganze Bild löst sich in malerische Wischer und Farbbänder auf, weil die Kamera während einer etwa halbsekündigen Belichtung bewegt wird; in der Fine-Art-Landschaftsfotografie verbreitet seit den 2000ern.
styles.short_en: The whole frame dissolved into painterly streaks by moving the camera during a half-second exposure; an experimental technique popular in fine-art landscape photography since the 2000s.
markers_en: entire frame streaked by camera motion

styles.era_origin: Light-trail motion studies from 1889; artistic light drawing since the mid-20th century.
visual_markers: glowing hand-drawn lines and loops in the air
styles.prompt_fragment: light painting photograph: long exposure in darkness, glowing hand-drawn light lines and loops traced through the air, selectively flashlight-lit surfaces, ghostly translucent traces of moving figures, scattered sparks, deep black surroundings
styles.avoid: Avoid neon signage and digital glow; strokes should be irregular, hand-moved light trails.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders well; strokes can look too clean.
styles.short_de: Leuchtende Linien und Schleifen, die bei Langzeitbelichtung im Dunkeln mit Lichtquellen in die Luft gezeichnet werden; hervorgegangen aus Bewegungsstudien in Frankreich 1889, künstlerisch seit den 1930ern.
styles.short_en: Glowing lines and loops drawn in the air with handheld lights during a long exposure in darkness; from 1889 motion studies in France, artistic use since the 1930s.
markers_de: leuchtende, frei gezeichnete Linien und Schleifen
markers_en: glowing hand-drawn lines and loops in the air

styles.era_origin: Infrared film since the 1930s; converted digital cameras since the 2000s.
visual_markers: deep black sky with brilliant white clouds
pale luminous skin with dark eyes
styles.prompt_fragment: black-and-white infrared photograph: foliage and grass glowing bright white, deep black sky with brilliant white clouds, pale luminous skin, dark eyes, soft halation around highlights, dreamlike tonality, coarse film grain
styles.avoid: Avoid an ordinary monochrome conversion; white vegetation and a black sky are essential.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable when white foliage and black sky are stated.
styles.short_de: Schwarzweißbilder im nahen Infrarot: Laub leuchtet weiß, der Himmel wird schwarz unter strahlenden Wolken, Haut wirkt blass; Infrarotfilm seit den 1930ern, umgebaute Digitalkameras seit den 2000ern.
styles.short_en: Black-and-white near-infrared images where foliage glows white, skies turn black under brilliant clouds and skin looks pale; infrared film since the 1930s, converted digital cameras since the 2000s.
styles.era_de: seit 1910 (USA); Film ab den 1930ern, digital seit den 2000ern
styles.era_en: since 1910 (USA); film from the 1930s, digital since the 2000s
markers_de: tiefschwarzer Himmel mit strahlend weißen Wolken
markers_en: deep black sky with brilliant white clouds

styles.era_origin: Announced by Louis Daguerre in Paris in 1839; the dominant portrait process until the mid-1850s.
visual_markers: iridescent blue-violet tarnish halo creeping from the edges
ornate stamped brass mat inside a hinged leather case
extremely fine detail with cool silver-grey monochrome
stiff, posed stillness from long exposure
styles.prompt_fragment: rendered as an 1840s daguerreotype: mirror-polished silvered copper plate, image shifting between positive and negative, razor-fine detail, cool silver-grey tones, iridescent blue-violet tarnish creeping in from the edges, wiped scratches and dust, set behind an ornate brass mat in a hinged leather case, stiff posed stillness from long exposure
styles.avoid: Avoid warm sepia paper texture and modern shallow-focus sharpness; it must read as a reflective metal plate, not a brown print.
styles.feasibility_note: The case, mat and tarnish halo render well. True mirror reflectivity and the positive-negative shift are only suggested.
styles.short_de: Spiegelnd polierte, versilberte Kupferplatten mit feinsten Details, die je nach Blickwinkel zwischen Positiv und Negativ kippen, mit schillerndem Anlauf im Klappetui; 1839 in Paris vorgestellt.
styles.short_en: Mirror-polished silvered copper plates with razor-fine detail that flip between positive and negative, edged by iridescent tarnish in hinged cases; announced in Paris in 1839.
markers_de: schillernd blauvioletter Anlauf von den Rändern her
extrem feine Details in kühlem Silbergrau
steife, gestellte Ruhe durch lange Belichtung
markers_en: iridescent blue-violet tarnish creeping from the edges
ornate brass mat in a hinged leather case
extremely fine detail in cool silver-grey
stiff, posed stillness from long exposure

styles.era_origin: William Henry Fox Talbot's process of 1839-1841 (calotype paper negative); common until the albumen print replaced it in the 1850s.
visual_markers: matte reddish- to purple-brown image sunk into paper fibres
soft mottled detail from a paper negative
uneven brushed edges of the sensitised area
styles.prompt_fragment: as a salted paper print from a paper negative, 1840s-1850s: matte reddish-brown to purple-brown image sunk into the paper fibres, soft diffuse detail with mottled paper-negative texture, low contrast, faded highlights, foxing spots, uneven brushed edges of the sensitised area, slight vignetting, quiet static composition
styles.avoid: Avoid glossy surfaces and crisp detail, and do not drift into albumen's sheen and card mount or into a uniform sepia filter.
styles.feasibility_note: Paper fibre and softness come through, but models tend to over-sharpen and add too much contrast.
styles.short_de: Matter, rötlich- bis violettbrauner Abzug, dessen Bild in den Papierfasern liegt, meist von einem Papiernegativ kopiert; das früheste Papierverfahren, um 1840 von Talbot in England eingeführt.
styles.short_en: Matte reddish- to purple-brown print whose image lies in the paper fibres, usually from a paper negative; the earliest paper process, introduced by Talbot in Britain around 1840.
markers_de: matt rötlich- bis violettbraunes Bild in den Papierfasern
markers_en: matte reddish- to purple-brown image in the paper fibres
soft, mottled detail from a paper negative
uneven brushed edges of the coated area

styles.era_origin: Introduced by Louis-Désiré Blanquart-Evrard in 1850; the dominant print process until the 1890s.
visual_markers: glossy egg-white surface with fine crazing
warm purplish-brown to chocolate tones with yellowed highlights
thick gilt-edged card mount with embossed studio imprint
painted studio backdrop and posing-stand stiffness
styles.prompt_fragment: as an albumen print from the 1860s-1890s mounted on a cabinet card: glossy egg-white surface with fine crazing, warm purplish-brown to chocolate tones, yellowed faded highlights, sharp collodion-negative detail, painted studio backdrop and posing-stand stiffness, thick gilt-edged card mount with embossed studio imprint below, rounded corners
styles.avoid: Avoid modern smiles, relaxed candid poses and neutral grey tones; it should not look like a sepia filter over a digital photo.
styles.feasibility_note: Card mount and brown tonality render reliably; the fine surface crazing varies.
styles.short_de: Glänzender, warmbrauner Abzug auf eiweißbeschichtetem Papier, meist als Visitenkartenporträt oder Kabinettkarte aufgezogen; der übliche Atelierabzug von den 1850ern bis in die 1890er.
styles.short_en: Glossy, warm brown print on egg-white-coated paper, usually mounted as a carte de visite or cabinet card; the standard studio portrait print from the 1850s to the 1890s.
markers_de: warme violett- bis schokoladenbraune Töne, vergilbte Lichter
dicker Karton mit Goldschnitt und Atelierprägung
markers_en: glossy egg-white surface with fine crazing
warm purplish- to chocolate-brown tones, yellowed highlights
thick card mount with gilt edge and studio imprint
painted backdrop and stiff studio pose

styles.era_origin: Based on Frederick Scott Archer's collodion process (1851); patented in the USA by James Ambrose Cutting in 1854, popular through the 1860s.
visual_markers: creamy pale highlights floating on deep black
glass plate backed with flaking black varnish
stamped brass mat in a velvet-lined hinged case
faint gold tint on cheeks or jewellery
styles.prompt_fragment: as a cased ambrotype, 1850s-1860s: collodion positive on glass backed with black varnish, creamy pale highlights floating on deep black shadows, slightly underexposed, flaking backing revealing clear glass, faint rose tint on the cheeks and gilded jewellery, framed by a stamped brass mat inside a velvet-lined hinged case
styles.avoid: Avoid the mirror sheen of a daguerreotype and the raw metal edge of a tintype; keep the glass-and-case presentation.
styles.feasibility_note: The case presentation renders well. The flaking backing and depth of the glass are sometimes lost.
styles.short_de: Unterbelichtetes Kollodiumnegativ auf Glas, das vor schwarzem Hintergrund als Positiv erscheint, im kleinen Klappetui verwahrt; günstigerer Nachfolger der Daguerreotypie in den 1850ern und 1860ern.
styles.short_en: Underexposed collodion negative on glass that reads as a positive against a black backing, kept in a hinged case; a cheaper successor to the daguerreotype in the 1850s–60s.
markers_de: cremig blasse Lichter auf tiefem Schwarz
rosig getönte Wangen und vergoldeter Schmuck
markers_en: creamy pale highlights on deep black
glass plate with flaking black varnish backing
stamped brass mat in a velvet-lined case

styles.era_origin: Collodion process by Frederick Scott Archer (1851); tintype patented by Hamilton Smith (USA) in 1856; revived by contemporary wet-plate photographers since the 2000s.
visual_markers: olive-grey to cream monochrome on a dark lacquered metal plate
blue-sensitive tonality: white skies, darker freckled skin
swirling pour marks, comet streaks, silver drips at uneven edges
shallow focus from a brass portrait lens
styles.prompt_fragment: as a wet plate collodion tintype: monochrome image on a dark lacquered iron plate, olive-grey to cream tones, blue-sensitive emulsion so skies blow out white and skin looks darker and freckled, shallow focus from a brass portrait lens, swirling pour marks, comet streaks and silver nitrate drips along uneven plate edges, scratched varnish
styles.avoid: Avoid sepia tint and clean rectangular borders; the chaotic plate edges and blue-sensitive tones are what make it read as collodion.
styles.feasibility_note: The model knows the modern wet-plate look well. Pour edges and comets render convincingly.
styles.short_de: Kollodiumbild auf dünner, schwarz lackierter Eisenplatte, olivgrau und blauempfindlich; ab 1856 billiges Jahrmarktsporträt, seit den 2000ern von Nassplatten-Fotografen wiederbelebt.
styles.short_en: Collodion photograph on a thin, black-lacquered iron plate, olive-grey and blue-sensitive; a cheap fairground portrait from 1856 and revived by wet-plate photographers since the 2000s.
markers_de: olivgraues bis cremiges Monochrom auf dunklem Blech
weißer Himmel, dunklere Haut mit betonten Sommersprossen
Gießspuren, Kometen und Silbertropfen am Rand
markers_en: olive-grey to cream monochrome on dark metal
pour marks, comets and silver drips at the edges
shallow focus from a brass portrait lens

styles.era_origin: Invented by Sir John Herschel in 1842; used by Anna Atkins for botanical photograms from 1843 and later as the architectural blueprint process.
visual_markers: deep Prussian-blue shadows and white paper highlights
visible brushstroke edges of hand-coated emulsion
styles.prompt_fragment: as a cyanotype: deep Prussian-blue shadows and white paper highlights, iron-based contact print on heavy watercolour paper, visible brushstroke edges of the hand-coated emulsion, slight bleeding and uneven coating, soft detail, no tones other than blues, sun-printed matte surface
styles.avoid: Avoid a plain blue colour filter over a photo or glossy digital blues; keep the paper texture and brushed coating edges, and do not slip into engineering-blueprint linework.
styles.feasibility_note: A very recognisable look that holds well, including the brushed edges.
styles.short_de: Preußischblau-weißer Kontaktabzug aus Eisensalzen, im Sonnenlicht belichtet; 1842 von John Herschel erfunden, von Anna Atkins für Algen-Fotogramme genutzt und später als Blaupause verbreitet.
styles.short_en: Prussian-blue and white contact print made with iron salts and sunlight; invented by John Herschel in 1842, used by Anna Atkins for algae photograms and later for blueprints.
markers_en: deep Prussian-blue shadows, white paper highlights
brushed edges of the hand-coated emulsion

styles.era_origin: Patented by William Willis in England in 1873; favoured by fine-art printers into the 1930s and revived from the 1970s.
visual_markers: matte uncoated cotton paper with the image embedded in the fibres
very long smooth tonal scale, warm silvery greys
styles.prompt_fragment: as a platinum-palladium print: matte uncoated cotton paper with the image embedded in the fibres, extraordinarily long smooth tonal scale from warm silvery grey to soft velvety black, no gloss, delicate highlight separation, slightly warm neutral tone, barely visible hand-coated brush marks at the edges, quiet contemplative fine-art presentation
styles.avoid: Avoid deep glossy blacks and the punchy contrast of digital black-and-white conversions; it should feel soft, matte and warm-grey.
styles.feasibility_note: The subtle tonality is easily lost and often collapses into generic black and white.
styles.short_de: Matter Abzug, bei dem Platin oder Palladium direkt im ungestrichenen Papier liegt, mit sehr langer, warmgrauer Tonskala; 1873 von William Willis patentiert, seit den 1970ern wiederbelebt.
styles.short_en: Matte print with platinum or palladium embedded in uncoated paper and a very long, warm-grey tonal scale; patented by William Willis in 1873, revived since the 1970s.
markers_de: mattes, ungestrichenes Baumwollpapier, Bild in den Fasern
sehr lange, weiche Skala warmer Silbergraus
markers_en: matte uncoated cotton paper, image in the fibres
very long, smooth scale of warm silvery greys

styles.era_origin: International art-photography movement c. 1885-1915 (Linked Ring, Photo-Secession).
visual_markers: soft-focus lens with halated, glowing highlights
tonal masses instead of fine detail
matte warm-grey to brown paper with drawn border lines
styles.prompt_fragment: as a Pictorialist art photograph around 1900: uncorrected soft-focus lens diffusing highlights into a luminous haze around a sharp core, tonal masses instead of detail, misty atmosphere, painterly tonalist composition, warm grey to brown tones, matte textured paper, hand-drawn border lines, subdued twilight or backlight
styles.avoid: Avoid modern glow filters and Gaussian blur; the softness should come from an uncorrected lens with a sharp core and halated highlights.
styles.feasibility_note: Mood and softness hold well; borders and paper texture are mostly reliable.
styles.short_de: Weichgezeichnete Kunstfotografie, die mit Tonflächen statt Details arbeitet und auf mattem Papier wie Malerei wirken soll; internationale Bewegung von etwa 1885 bis 1915.
styles.short_en: Soft-focus art photograph built from tonal masses rather than detail, printed on matte paper to resemble painting; an international movement of about 1885 to 1915.
markers_de: mattes warmgraues bis braunes Papier mit gezogenen Randlinien
markers_en: soft-focus lens with glowing, haloed highlights
tonal masses instead of fine detail
matte warm-grey to brown paper with drawn border lines

styles.era_origin: Process by Alphonse Poitevin (1855); popularised as an art process by Robert Demachy and Alfred Maskell in 1894.
visual_markers: earthy pigment colours in layered coats
rough watercolour paper and painterly loss of detail
styles.prompt_fragment: as a gum bichromate print: pigment suspended in hardened gum arabic brushed onto rough watercolour paper, painterly loss of fine detail, visible brush strokes and granulation, several layered colour coats slightly misregistered, earthy pigments like burnt sienna, indigo or terre verte, soft grainy shadows, handmade art print
styles.avoid: Avoid an outright painting with drawn outlines; proportions and tones should stay photographic, only softened by pigment.
styles.feasibility_note: The painterly texture can tip over into an ordinary watercolour painting.
styles.short_de: Malerisch wirkender Fotodruck aus Pigment in gehärtetem Gummiarabikum, in mehreren Schichten aufgetragen; seit den 1850ern bekannt, ab den 1890ern von Kunstfotografen wie Demachy und Kühn genutzt.
styles.short_en: Painterly print of pigment in hardened gum arabic, brushed on in layers; known since the 1850s and adopted by Demachy, Kühn and other art photographers in the 1890s.
markers_en: rough watercolour paper, painterly loss of detail

styles.era_origin: Proposed by E. J. Wall and realised by C. Welborne Piper in England in 1907; popular with Pictorialist clubs into the 1930s.
visual_markers: dabbed, stippled ink texture over a photographic base
lost highlight detail and soft-edged forms
styles.prompt_fragment: as a bromoil print: bleached silver print re-inked by hand with stiff brushes, oily lithographic ink stippled into swollen gelatine, painterly dabbed texture, lost detail in the highlights, deep velvety brown-black shadows, soft-edged forms, matte surface, Pictorialist mood with mist and soft light
styles.avoid: Avoid oil-painting brushstrokes and colour; it is a monochrome ink stipple over a photographic base.
styles.feasibility_note: The stippled ink texture is often reduced to generic grain.
styles.short_de: Gebleichter Silberabzug, der von Hand mit harten Pinseln eingefärbt wird und eine getupfte, malerische Struktur erhält; 1907 in England entwickelt, bei Kunstfotografen bis in die 1930er beliebt.
styles.short_en: Bleached silver print re-inked by hand with stiff brushes, giving a dabbed, painterly texture; devised in England in 1907 and popular with Pictorialist clubs into the 1930s.
markers_en: dabbed, stippled ink over a photographic base

styles.era_origin: Practised from the 1840s; peaked with Yokohama export albums (1860s-1900s) and tinted studio portraits through the 1950s.
visual_markers: thin transparent tints over a monochrome print
some areas left uncoloured and monochrome
styles.prompt_fragment: as a hand-coloured black-and-white photograph: thin transparent oil or watercolour tints brushed over a sepia or grey silver print, rosy cheeks, pastel blue sky, colouring slightly over the edges, uneven saturation, some background areas left monochrome, gently matte paper, vintage studio or souvenir print feel
styles.avoid: Avoid modern AI colourisation with full, even, realistic colour; tints must be thin, selective and slightly imprecise.
styles.feasibility_note: Selective, imperfect tinting works well when spelled out explicitly.
styles.sensitivity_note: Yokohama export albums often staged exoticised scenes for Western buyers; avoid stereotyped 'oriental' staging.
styles.short_de: Schwarzweiß- oder Sepiafoto, von Hand mit dünnen Öl- oder Aquarelllasuren koloriert; seit den 1840ern üblich, besonders in Yokohama-Exportalben und in Atelierporträts bis in die 1950er.
styles.short_en: Black-and-white or sepia photograph tinted by hand with thin oil or watercolour glazes; common from the 1840s, notably in Yokohama export albums and studio portraits until the 1950s.
markers_de: dünne, lasierende Farbe über monochromem Abzug
Farbe leicht über die Konturen gemalt
markers_en: thin transparent tints over a monochrome print
styles.sensitivity_de: Die Yokohama-Exportalben inszenierten oft exotisierende Szenen für westliche Käufer, daher stereotype „orientalische“ Inszenierungen vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Yokohama export albums often staged exoticised scenes for Western buyers, so avoid stereotyped 'oriental' staging.

styles.era_origin: Developed by Jean-Pierre Sudre in France in the 1960s from a late-19th-century etch-bleach reversal process.
visual_markers: dark areas lifted as wrinkled translucent emulsion veils
bare paper showing where emulsion was rubbed away
styles.prompt_fragment: as a mordançage print: gelatin silver print whose dark areas have lifted off as wrinkled translucent veils of emulsion, partly rubbed away to bare paper, rusty brown-orange and sepia tones from redevelopment and oxidation, cracked skin-like texture, dramatic eroded edges, ghostly fragile appearance
styles.avoid: Avoid scratch-overlay grunge textures; the damage must follow the dark tones as lifted emulsion.
styles.feasibility_note: Lifted veils are hard to get; results often become generic distressed texture.
styles.short_de: Silbergelatineabzug, dessen dunkle Partien sich in einem sauren Bleichbad als runzelige Emulsionsschleier ablösen; in den 1960ern von Jean-Pierre Sudre in Frankreich entwickelt.
styles.short_en: Silver gelatin print treated with an acidic bleach so the dark areas lift off as wrinkled veils of emulsion; formulated by Jean-Pierre Sudre in France in the 1960s.
markers_de: dunkle Partien als runzelige, durchscheinende Schleier abgehoben
blankes Papier, wo die Emulsion abgerieben ist
markers_en: dark areas lifted as wrinkled translucent veils
bare paper where emulsion was rubbed off

styles.era_origin: Lith developers come from graphic arts; lith printing on ordinary photo papers became a fine-art technique in the 1980s-90s.
visual_markers: hard peppery grain in the shadows
warm salmon-peach highlights against cold charcoal shadows
high local contrast with creamy highlights
styles.prompt_fragment: as a lith print: silver gelatin paper developed in weak lith developer, hard peppery grain in the shadows, soft creamy highlights, colour split between warm salmon-peach highlights and cold charcoal shadows, high local contrast, slightly unpredictable tonality, matte fibre paper with a visible border
styles.avoid: Avoid even sepia toning or clean neutral black and white; the warm-highlight, cold-shadow split and coarse shadow grain are essential.
styles.feasibility_note: The colour split renders. The specific shadow grain from infectious development is only approximated.
styles.short_de: Schwarzweißabzug in stark verdünntem Lithentwickler, mit pfeffrigem Korn in den Schatten und warmen, pfirsichfarbenen Lichtern; Fine-Art-Technik der Dunkelkammer seit den 1980ern und 1990ern.
styles.short_en: Black-and-white print developed in dilute lith developer, with peppery grain in the shadows and warm, peach-coloured highlights; a fine-art darkroom technique since the 1980s and 1990s.
markers_de: hartes, pfeffriges Korn in den Schatten
warme lachsfarbene Lichter, kalte anthrazitgraue Schatten
markers_en: hard, peppery grain in the shadows
warm salmon highlights against cold charcoal shadows

styles.era_origin: Described by Armand Sabattier in 1862; turned into an art form by Surrealist photographers in Paris around 1929-1932.
visual_markers: thin bright Mackie lines outlining contours
styles.prompt_fragment: as a solarised silver print using the Sabattier effect: partial tonal reversal where some highlights turn grey-black, thin bright Mackie lines outlining contours, metallic dreamlike tonality, black and white with silvery sheen, surreal 1930s darkroom-experiment feel, clean studio lighting, dark background turned grey
styles.avoid: Avoid full negative inversion or a digital curves filter; the reversal is partial and edges glow with Mackie lines.
styles.feasibility_note: Partial reversal works. Clean Mackie lines are inconsistent.
styles.short_de: Schwarzweißbild mit teilweise umgekehrten Tonwerten und hellen Linien an den Konturen, entstanden durch Zwischenbelichtung beim Entwickeln; 1862 beschrieben, um 1930 von Pariser Surrealisten genutzt.
styles.short_en: Black-and-white image with partly reversed tones and thin bright lines along the contours, made by re-exposing during development; described in 1862 and used by Paris Surrealists around 1930.
markers_de: feine helle Mackie-Linien an den Konturen
markers_en: thin bright Mackie lines around contours

styles.era_origin: Gelatin silver papers from the 1880s; sepia toning and real-photo postcards peaked c. 1905-1940.
visual_markers: warm chocolate-brown tones on smooth semi-matte paper
narrow white border with handwritten caption
silvering, corner creases and album wear
styles.prompt_fragment: as a sepia-toned gelatin silver print from the 1910s-1940s: warm chocolate-brown image on smooth semi-matte paper, crisp but gentle detail, deep brown blacks, cream highlights, narrow white border with a handwritten caption, slight silvering and corner creases, like a real-photo postcard or family album print
styles.avoid: Avoid a flat brown filter over a modern sharp image; keep period lens rendering, period clothing logic and physical print wear.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable, but it can drift into the generic 'vintage sepia' AI cliché unless the print wear is described.
styles.short_de: Warmbrauner Silbergelatineabzug, oft als Fotopostkarte oder Albumbild mit weißem Rand und handschriftlicher Notiz; typisch für die Jahre von etwa 1905 bis 1940.
styles.short_en: Warm brown gelatin silver print, often a real-photo postcard or album print with a white border and handwritten caption; typical of the years from about 1905 to 1940.
markers_de: warme schokoladenbraune Töne auf halbmattem Papier
schmaler weißer Rand mit handschriftlicher Notiz
markers_en: warm chocolate-brown tones on semi-matte paper
narrow white border with handwritten caption

styles.era_origin: Patented by the Lumière brothers in 1903 and marketed from 1907 into the 1930s; the first practical colour photography.
visual_markers: shimmering mosaic of dyed starch grains
muted pastel palette of rose, sage and violet
glass transparency with cracked varnish and vignetting
styles.prompt_fragment: as an Autochrome Lumière colour plate: pointillist mosaic of dyed potato-starch grains giving a soft shimmering texture, muted pastel palette of rose, sage green and violet, dark clumping specks, long-exposure stillness, dreamy low contrast, viewed as a glass transparency with slight vignetting and cracked varnish
styles.avoid: Avoid modern colour saturation and crisp sharpness; colour must feel granular, powdery and subdued.
styles.feasibility_note: The pastel palette is reliable. The distinctive starch-grain mosaic tends to smooth into generic grain.
styles.sensitivity_note: Lumière is a historic name, not a current brand issue.
styles.short_de: Farbfoto auf einer Glasplatte mit eingefärbten Kartoffelstärkekörnern, das wie ein weiches, flirrendes Pastellmosaik wirkt; 1903 von den Brüdern Lumière patentiert und ab 1907 verkauft.
styles.short_en: Colour photograph on a glass plate coated with dyed potato-starch grains, seen as a soft, shimmering pastel mosaic; patented by the Lumière brothers in 1903, sold from 1907.
markers_de: gedämpfte Pastelltöne in Rosa, Salbeigrün und Violett
Glasplatte mit gerissenem Lack und Vignette
markers_en: shimmering mosaic of dyed starch grains
muted pastel rose, sage green and violet
glass plate with cracked varnish and vignetting

styles.era_origin: Demonstrated by James Clerk Maxwell in 1861 and used by Sergei Prokudin-Gorsky c. 1905-1915; later revived as the Harris shutter devised by Kodak's Robert S. Harris.
visual_markers: moving elements split into red, green and blue ghosts
styles.prompt_fragment: as a three-colour separation photograph combined from red, green and blue exposures taken moments apart: static elements in natural colour, anything that moved split into vivid red, green and blue ghost fringes, slight overall misregistration, colour-shifted plate edges at the borders, softly faded early-1900s tones
styles.avoid: Avoid a uniform RGB-split glitch across the whole frame; still areas must stay in clean natural colour.
styles.feasibility_note: The model rarely limits the fringes to moving parts only; results often become global chromatic aberration.
styles.short_de: Farbbild aus drei Aufnahmen durch Rot-, Grün- und Blaufilter, bei dem alles Bewegte farbige Säume zeigt; 1861 von Maxwell vorgeführt, um 1905–1915 von Prokudin-Gorski genutzt.
styles.short_en: Colour image combined from red, green and blue filtered exposures, so anything that moved shows coloured fringes; shown by Maxwell in 1861, used by Prokudin-Gorsky around 1905–1915.
markers_de: Bewegtes in rote, grüne und blaue Geisterbilder zerlegt
markers_en: moving elements split into red, green and blue ghosts

styles.era_origin: Invented by Hans Jakob Schmid at Orell Füssli in Zürich in the 1880s; licensed to the Detroit Photographic Company in the 1890s and popular until about 1914.
visual_markers: slightly invented colours: turquoise water, ochre stone
fine litho grain and soft sky gradients
travel-postcard view with printed margin caption
styles.prompt_fragment: as a Photochrom print around 1895: colour lithograph made from a black-and-white negative, flat translucent ink layers in muted yet vivid tones, slightly unnatural turquoise water and ochre buildings, soft sky gradients, fine litho grain, painterly colour separations, travel-postcard view with a small printed caption in the margin
styles.avoid: Avoid accurate photographic colour and saturated modern HDR; colours should feel slightly invented, flat and lithographic.
styles.feasibility_note: The palette and lithographic flatness render convincingly.
styles.sensitivity_note: 'Photochrom' was the trademark of Photoglob Zürich and is now a historic process name. Some period views exoticise colonial destinations, so avoid stereotypes.
styles.short_de: Farblithografie nach einem Schwarzweißnegativ mit flächigen, leicht unwirklichen Farben; in den 1880ern bei Orell Füssli in Zürich erfunden und bis etwa 1914 für Reiseansichten beliebt.
styles.short_en: Colour lithograph made from a black-and-white negative, with flat, slightly unreal colours; invented at Orell Füssli in Zurich in the 1880s, popular for travel views until about 1914.
markers_de: leicht erfundene Farben: türkises Wasser, ockerfarbener Stein
Reiseansicht mit gedruckter Bildunterschrift am Rand
markers_en: slightly invented colours: turquoise water, ochre stone
fine litho grain and soft sky gradients
travel view with printed caption in the margin
styles.sensitivity_de: „Photochrom“ ist ein historischer Markenname; manche Ansichten der Zeit exotisieren koloniale Reiseziele, daher Stereotype vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: 'Photochrom' is a historic trade name; some period views exoticise colonial destinations, so avoid stereotypes.

styles.era_origin: Fox Talbot's photogenic drawings (1834-1839); reinvented by Christian Schad (1919), Man Ray's 'Rayographs' and Bauhaus photograms in the 1920s.
visual_markers: glowing white silhouettes on deep black
translucent grey overlaps for transparent objects
soft halos where objects lifted from the paper
no lens perspective, flat contact composition
styles.prompt_fragment: as a cameraless photogram: objects laid directly on photographic paper and exposed to light, rendered as glowing white silhouettes and translucent grey shapes on deep black, soft halos where objects lifted from the paper, layered transparencies, no perspective or lens, flat graphic composition on black-and-white gelatin silver paper
styles.avoid: Avoid 3D shading and camera perspective; everything is a flat contact shadow.
styles.feasibility_note: Silhouette logic works, but the model sometimes adds photographic perspective and shading.
styles.short_de: Kameraloses Bild: Gegenstände liegen direkt auf dem Fotopapier und erscheinen als weiße Silhouetten auf Schwarz; seit den 1830ern bekannt, um 1920 von Schad, Man Ray und Moholy-Nagy wiederentdeckt.
styles.short_en: Cameraless image of objects laid on photo paper and exposed, leaving white silhouettes on black; known since the 1830s, revived around 1920 by Schad, Man Ray and Moholy-Nagy.
markers_de: leuchtend weiße Silhouetten auf tiefem Schwarz
weiche Höfe, wo Objekte nicht auflagen
markers_en: glowing white silhouettes on deep black
soft halos where objects lifted off the paper

styles.era_origin: Rooted in Talbot's 1830s photogenic drawings; revived as an alternative process by contemporary artists from the 2000s.
visual_markers: unexpected peach, salmon, lavender and ochre hues
fine vein detail where moisture touched the paper
styles.prompt_fragment: as a lumen print: botanical or found objects sun-printed directly onto old black-and-white photo paper without development, unexpected colours of peach, salmon, lavender, mauve and ochre, fine vein detail where moisture touched the paper, soft gradients, organic stains and blotches, flat contact composition
styles.avoid: Avoid cyanotype blue and true photographic perspective; the colours come from unprocessed silver paper.
styles.feasibility_note: The palette is reachable. Moisture details and contact logic vary.
styles.short_de: Gegenstände werden ohne Entwickler stundenlang im Sonnenlicht auf Schwarzweißpapier belichtet und hinterlassen unerwartete Pfirsich-, Lavendel- und Ockertöne; seit den 2000ern verbreitetes Alternativverfahren.
styles.short_en: Objects laid on black-and-white photo paper and exposed to sunlight for hours without developer, leaving unexpected peach, lavender and ochre tones; a revived alternative process since the 2000s.
markers_de: unerwartete Pfirsich-, Lachs-, Lavendel- und Ockertöne
feine Aderzeichnung, wo Feuchtigkeit das Papier berührte
markers_en: unexpected peach, salmon, lavender and ochre hues
fine vein detail where moisture touched the paper

styles.era_origin: Invented by the Belgian artist Pierre Cordier in 1956.
visual_markers: ochre, brown, pale gold and black tones
abstract forms that only loosely echo the subject
styles.prompt_fragment: as a chemigram: cameraless image painted with developer, fixer, varnish and resists directly on light-exposed photographic paper, organic cell-like patterns, marbled chemical flows, crackled resist edges, ochre, brown, pale gold and black tones, abstract forms only loosely echoing the subject
styles.avoid: Avoid a literal photographic rendering of the subject; it must look chemical and painted on paper.
styles.feasibility_note: Abstract chemical textures work. Keeping the subject readable is hard.
styles.short_de: Abstraktes, kameraloses Bild, bei dem Entwickler, Fixierer und Abdeckmittel wie Lack oder Wachs direkt auf Fotopapier wirken; 1956 vom belgischen Künstler Pierre Cordier erfunden.
styles.short_en: Abstract cameraless image made by applying developer, fixer and resists such as varnish or wax directly to photographic paper; invented by the Belgian artist Pierre Cordier in 1956.
markers_de: Ocker, Braun, blasses Gold und Schwarz
abstrakte Formen, die ein Motiv nur andeuten
markers_en: ochre, brown, pale gold and black tones
abstract forms loosely echoing a subject

styles.era_origin: Introduced by Kodak in 1935 (movie film) and 1936 (slides); discontinued in 2009, with the last processing in December 2010.
visual_markers: rich clean blacks with fine grain
styles.prompt_fragment: as a 1950s-1970s 35mm colour slide on slow, fine-grained reversal film: vivid but natural saturation, deep warm reds and yellows, rich clean blacks, fine grain, slightly cool shadows, crisp detail, bright sunlit daylight, mid-century colour clothing and signage, full-frame 3:2 composition with deep focus
styles.avoid: Avoid modern teal-orange grading and creamy shallow depth of field; keep deep focus and contrasty daylight colour.
styles.feasibility_note: A well-known look that renders reliably.
styles.sensitivity_note: 'Kodachrome' is a Kodak trademark, used as the clearest descriptor of the film look.
styles.short_de: Feinkörniger, niedrigempfindlicher Diafilm mit tiefen, warmen Rottönen, sattem Schwarz und natürlicher Sättigung; von Kodak 1935 bis 2009 hergestellt, prägend für Amateur- und Magazinfotos der Nachkriegszeit.
styles.short_en: Fine-grained colour slide film with deep warm reds, rich blacks and natural saturation; made by Kodak from 1935 to 2009, typical of mid-century amateur and magazine photography.
styles.sensitivity_de: „Kodachrome“ ist eine Marke von Kodak und dient nur als Bezeichnung des Looks.
styles.sensitivity_en: 'Kodachrome' is a Kodak trademark and is used only as the name of the look.

styles.era_origin: Kodak Ektachrome was introduced in 1946 and moved to the E-6 process in 1977; it was discontinued in 2012 and reintroduced in 2018.
visual_markers: cool clean colour with crisp blues
high contrast with little shadow latitude
styles.prompt_fragment: as an E-6 colour slide on cool-toned reversal film: cool clean colour with crisp blues and cyan-tinted shadows, neutral to slightly cold whites, high contrast with little shadow latitude, fine grain, crisp edges, slightly underexposed for saturation, 1970s-90s editorial travel feel
styles.avoid: Avoid Kodachrome's warm red bias and the soft pastels of negative film.
styles.feasibility_note: The difference from Kodachrome is subtle, and the result tends to merge into generic 'vintage film'.
styles.sensitivity_note: 'Ektachrome' is a Kodak trademark, used as a film-look descriptor.
styles.short_de: Diafilm mit kühlen, klaren Farben, knackigem Blau und harter Gradation, entwickelt im E-6-Prozess; 1946 von Kodak eingeführt, 2012/13 eingestellt und seit 2018 wieder erhältlich.
styles.short_en: Colour slide film with cool, clean colours, crisp blues and hard contrast, processed in E-6; introduced by Kodak in 1946, discontinued in 2012–13 and reissued in 2018.
markers_de: hoher Kontrast, wenig Spielraum in den Schatten
styles.sensitivity_de: „Ektachrome“ ist eine Marke von Kodak und dient nur als Bezeichnung des Looks.
styles.sensitivity_en: 'Ektachrome' is a Kodak trademark and is used only as the name of the look.

styles.era_origin: Launched by Fujifilm in 1990; the defining landscape slide film of the 1990s-2000s.
styles.prompt_fragment: as a highly saturated fine-grain colour transparency: hyper-saturated colour, intensely vivid greens and magentas, contrasty shadows that block to black, rich deep blue skies, crisp fine grain, glowing dawn or dusk light, polarised clarity, medium-format landscape sharpness
styles.avoid: Avoid HDR halos and lifted shadows; Velvia's saturation comes with deep dark shadows, not glow.
styles.feasibility_note: Easy to get, but close to the over-saturated AI default, so stress the dark shadows.
styles.sensitivity_note: 'Velvia' is a Fujifilm trademark, used as a film-look descriptor.
styles.short_de: Feinkörniger Diafilm mit extremer Sättigung, leuchtendem Grün und Magenta und zulaufenden Schatten; 1990 von Fujifilm eingeführt, bis in die 2000er der Standardfilm der Landschaftsfotografie.
styles.short_en: Fine-grained slide film with extreme saturation, vivid greens and magentas and blocked shadows; launched by Fujifilm in 1990 and the standard film of landscape photographers into the 2000s.
styles.sensitivity_de: „Velvia“ ist eine Marke von Fujifilm und dient nur als Bezeichnung des Looks.
styles.sensitivity_en: 'Velvia' is a Fujifilm trademark and is used only as the name of the look.

styles.era_origin: Kodak Portra was introduced in 1998, with the current Portra 400 since 2010; a staple of wedding and editorial portraiture.
visual_markers: natural warm skin tones with real texture
low contrast with airy overexposed highlights
styles.prompt_fragment: as a scan of professional portrait colour negative film: soft pastel palette, natural warm skin tones, gentle low contrast, slightly overexposed airy highlights, creamy tonal roll-off, subtle visible grain, muted greens and pale blue skies, diffuse daylight, unretouched skin texture
styles.avoid: Avoid smooth plastic skin, orange-teal grading and heavy vignettes; keep honest grain and pastel softness.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders well; insist on visible grain and real skin texture.
styles.sensitivity_note: 'Portra' is a Kodak trademark, used as a film-look descriptor.
styles.short_de: Professioneller Farbnegativfilm mit weichen Pastelltönen, natürlich warmen Hauttönen und geringem Kontrast, oft reichlich belichtet; 1998 von Kodak eingeführt, Standard in Hochzeits- und Editorial-Fotografie.
styles.short_en: Professional colour negative film with soft pastels, warm natural skin and low contrast, often overexposed for airy highlights; introduced by Kodak in 1998 for wedding and editorial work.
markers_de: natürlich warme Haut mit echter Struktur
markers_en: natural warm skin tones with real texture
styles.sensitivity_de: „Portra“ ist eine Marke von Kodak und dient nur als Bezeichnung des Looks.
styles.sensitivity_en: 'Portra' is a Kodak trademark and is used only as the name of the look.

styles.era_origin: The era of drugstore minilab printing of consumer films like Kodak Gold and Fuji Superia, c. 1988-2005.
visual_markers: warm yellow-orange cast with greenish shadows
styles.prompt_fragment: as a 1990s drugstore-printed 4x6 snapshot on consumer colour negative film: warm yellow-orange cast, greenish-tinted shadows, punchy saturation, medium grain, auto exposure from a point-and-shoot, slightly soft plastic lens, glossy lab print with faint colour imbalance, casual everyday daylight framing
styles.avoid: Avoid professional lighting and perfect colour; keep the minilab's slight imbalance and amateur framing.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders reliably.
styles.sensitivity_note: Kodak Gold and Fuji Superia are trademarks and appear only as aliases.
styles.short_de: Glänzender 10×15-Abzug aus dem Drogerielabor von günstigem Farbnegativfilm, mit warmem Gelbstich, grünlichen Schatten und mittlerem Korn; der Alltagsschnappschuss von etwa 1988 bis 2005.
styles.short_en: Glossy 4×6-inch minilab print from cheap colour negative film, with a warm yellow-orange cast, greenish shadows and medium grain; the everyday snapshot look of about 1988–2005.
styles.sensitivity_de: Kodak Gold und Fuji Superia sind Marken und tauchen nur als Alternativnamen auf.
styles.sensitivity_en: Kodak Gold and Fuji Superia are trademarks and appear only as aliases.

styles.era_origin: CineStill (founded 2012) sells Kodak Vision3 500T motion-picture film with the remjet layer removed, which causes red halation.
visual_markers: red-orange halation rings around light sources
styles.prompt_fragment: as a night photograph on tungsten-balanced motion-picture colour film with its anti-halation backing removed: red-orange halation glow ringing every bright light source and highlight, cyan-teal shadows, mixed sodium and neon city light, visible grain, slightly soft contrast, cinematic after-dark mood
styles.avoid: Avoid neon cyberpunk over-saturation and clean digital night noise; the halation is a thin red glow around highlights.
styles.feasibility_note: Halation is well understood by the model.
styles.sensitivity_note: CineStill and Kodak Vision3 are trademarks, used as look descriptors.
styles.short_de: Nachtlook eines Kunstlicht-Kinofilms, der ohne Lichthofschutzschicht für Fotokameras verkauft wird, sodass rotorange Lichthöfe jede Lichtquelle umgeben; seit 2013 von CineStill in den USA vertrieben.
styles.short_en: Night look of tungsten-balanced cinema film sold for still cameras without its anti-halation layer, so red-orange halos ring every light; sold by CineStill in the USA since 2013.
styles.sensitivity_de: CineStill und Kodak Vision3 sind Marken und dienen nur als Bezeichnung des Looks.
styles.sensitivity_en: CineStill and Kodak Vision3 are trademarks and are used only as names of the look.

styles.era_origin: The unstable dyes of chromogenic prints from the 1950s-1980s, such as 126 Instamatic snapshots, fade predictably towards red-magenta.
visual_markers: white margin with printed month and year
styles.prompt_fragment: as a faded 1970s chromogenic colour print: cyan dye lost so everything drifts towards magenta-red and orange, washed-out lifted blacks, low contrast, square or rounded-corner print with the month and year printed in the white margin, slight curl and fingerprint marks, Instamatic snapshot framing
styles.avoid: Avoid tidy Instagram-style vintage presets; the shift must be strong, uneven and dye-faded.
styles.feasibility_note: The colour shift and print object render well.
styles.sensitivity_note: 'Instamatic' and 'Kodacolor' are Kodak trademarks and appear only as aliases.
styles.short_de: Farbabzug, dessen instabile Farbstoffe nach Magenta und Orange verblasst sind, mit flauen Schwärzen und aufgedrucktem Datum im weißen Rand; typisch für Abzüge der 1960er bis 1980er.
styles.short_en: Colour snapshot whose unstable dyes have faded towards magenta and orange, with lifted blacks and a date printed in the white margin; typical of 1960s–80s chromogenic prints.
markers_de: weißer Rand mit aufgedrucktem Monat und Jahr
markers_en: white margin with printed month and year
styles.sensitivity_de: „Instamatic“ und „Kodacolor“ sind Marken von Kodak und tauchen nur als Alternativnamen auf.
styles.sensitivity_en: 'Instamatic' and 'Kodacolor' are Kodak trademarks and appear only as aliases.

styles.era_origin: Shooting long-outdated stock became a deliberate lo-fi aesthetic during the analogue revival of the 2000s-2010s.
visual_markers: muddy lifted shadows from base fog
unpredictable green, purple or pink casts
blotchy density and faint edge leaks
styles.prompt_fragment: as a photograph on long-expired colour film: muddy lifted shadows with base fog, unpredictable colour shifts towards green, purple or pink, heavy coarse grain, reduced contrast and sensitivity, blotchy uneven density, faint light leaks at the edges, slightly underexposed dreamlike result
styles.avoid: Avoid the even red-magenta of a faded print; expired film shifts unpredictably and fogs.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders easily; describe one dominant cast for control.
styles.short_de: Foto auf lange abgelaufenem Farbfilm mit verschleierten Schatten, unberechenbaren Farbstichen und grobem Korn; ein bewusst gesuchter Lo-Fi-Look der Analog-Renaissance seit den 2000ern.
styles.short_en: Photograph on long-outdated colour film, with fogged shadows, unpredictable colour casts and coarse grain; a deliberate lo-fi look of the analogue revival since the 2000s.
markers_de: fleckige Dichte und leichte Lichteinfälle am Rand
markers_en: muddy lifted shadows from base fog
unpredictable green, purple or pink casts
blotchy density and faint edge leaks

styles.era_origin: Developing E-6 slide film in C-41 chemistry was popular in 1990s fashion, club and music photography and in the Lomography scene.
styles.prompt_fragment: as cross-processed slide film (E-6 developed in C-41): extreme contrast, blown highlights, saturated yellow-green and cyan casts, magenta-tinted skin or sky, crunchy grain, harsh colour shifts, 1990s fashion and music-magazine energy, hard flash or harsh sunlight
styles.avoid: Avoid tasteful pastel grading; the look is harsh, high-contrast and garish.
styles.feasibility_note: A strong, well-known look.
styles.short_de: Diafilm, in Negativchemie entwickelt: harter Kontrast, ausgefressene Lichter und grelle gelbgrüne und cyanfarbene Stiche; beliebt in der Mode-, Club- und Musikfotografie der 1990er.
styles.short_en: Slide film developed in colour-negative chemistry, giving harsh contrast, blown highlights and garish yellow-green and cyan casts; popular in 1990s fashion, club and music photography.

styles.era_origin: An old trick of exposing colour negative film through its base; popularised by the Lomography community and pre-rolled redscale films in the 2000s.
visual_markers: image soaked in red, orange and amber
styles.prompt_fragment: as a redscale photograph: colour negative film exposed through its base side, the whole image soaked in red, orange and amber tones, yellow highlights, deep brick-red shadows, almost no blue or green, heavy grain, warm apocalyptic sunset mood even in daylight
styles.avoid: Avoid a simple orange overlay; tones must run from yellow highlights to dark red shadows.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders reliably.
styles.short_de: Farbnegativfilm, der von der Rückseite belichtet wird, sodass das ganze Bild rot, orange und bernsteinfarben wird; ein alter Trick, in den 2000ern durch die Lomografie-Szene populär.
styles.short_en: Colour negative film exposed through its back, turning the whole image red, orange and amber with almost no blue; an old trick popularised by Lomography in the 2000s.
markers_de: Bild ganz in Rot, Orange und Bernstein
markers_en: image soaked in red, orange and amber

styles.era_origin: Invented by cinematographer Kazuo Miyagawa for Kon Ichikawa's 'Her Brother' (1960); widespread in late-1990s cinema.
visual_markers: harsh contrast with crushed metallic blacks
styles.prompt_fragment: as a bleach-bypass film print: silver retained in the image, desaturated muted colours, harsh high contrast, steel-grey cast, crushed metallic blacks, increased grain, silvery sheen over skin and surfaces, gritty war-film or thriller atmosphere
styles.avoid: Avoid teal-orange grading and glossy saturation; the image must feel drained and silvery.
styles.feasibility_note: Well understood, but close to the generic 'gritty cinematic' grade.
styles.short_de: Filmentwicklung ohne Bleichbad, bei der das Silber im Bild bleibt: entsättigte Farben, harter Kontrast und metallische Schwärzen; 1960 in Japan erstmals eingesetzt, verbreitet im Kino der späten 1990er.
styles.short_en: Film processing that skips the bleach, leaving silver in the image: drained colour, harsh contrast, metallic blacks; first used in Japan in 1960, common in late-1990s cinema.
markers_en: harsh contrast with crushed metallic blacks

styles.era_origin: Kodak Tri-X (35mm from 1954) pushed to 1600 ASA became the photojournalism look of the 1960s-80s.
visual_markers: hard contrast with blocked shadows and blown highlights
tilted handheld framing with slight motion blur
