styles.feasibility_note: Fine white hatching holds well.
styles.short_de: Weiße Linien, mit der Klinge aus einer schwarzen Tuscheschicht auf weißem Tongrund geschabt, dichte Schraffur und harter Kontrast; entstanden im 19. Jahrhundert in Großbritannien und Frankreich.
styles.short_en: White lines scraped with a blade from a black ink layer over white clay, giving tight hatching and stark contrast; 19th-century Britain and France, popular until the 1950s.
markers_de: weiße Linien aus schwarzem Grund geschabt

styles.era_origin: Graphite pencils since the 16th century, graded leads from the 1790s; academic tonal drawing from the 19th century onward.
styles.prompt_fragment: graphite pencil drawing on smooth drawing paper, full tonal range from hard to very soft leads, gradients softened with a blending stump, metallic graphite sheen in the darkest passages, highlights lifted with a kneaded eraser, faint directional strokes in the mid-tones, small smudges near the margins
styles.avoid: Avoid a desaturated photograph; the strokes and graphite sheen must stay visible.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable; sometimes too photographic.
styles.short_de: Bleistiftzeichnung über die ganze Tonwertskala, mit gewischten Verläufen, Grafitglanz in den Tiefen und herausradierten Lichtern; akademische Praxis seit dem 19. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Pencil drawing worked across the full tonal range, with stump-blended gradients, graphite sheen in the darks and lifted highlights; academic practice since the 19th century.
markers_en: metallic graphite sheen in the darks

styles.era_origin: Universal drafting practice in academies, animation and design studios.
visual_markers: visible ellipses, axes and perspective guides
styles.prompt_fragment: loose pencil sketch with visible construction: light searching lines, ellipses, center axes and perspective guidelines left in, multiple overlapping attempts at contours with the final line pressed darker, quick zigzag shading in shadows only, half-erased corrections, large areas left unfinished
styles.avoid: Avoid fully rendered polished shading; the process lines are the point.
styles.feasibility_note: Construction lines render convincingly.
styles.short_de: Lockere Bleistiftskizze, in der Hilfslinien, Ellipsen, Achsen und Fluchtlinien stehen bleiben, mit mehreren suchenden Konturen und dunklerer Endlinie; Standard an Akademien und in Designstudios.
styles.short_en: Loose pencil sketch with construction lines, ellipses, axes and perspective guides left visible, several searching contours and a darker final line; standard in academies and design studios.
markers_en: visible ellipses, axes and perspective guides

styles.era_origin: Used from the mid-20th century in comics, animation and print because non-photo blue was invisible to reproduction cameras.
visual_markers: graphite or ink clean-up over blue
styles.prompt_fragment: rough sketch in light non-photo blue pencil, loose cyan construction lines and gestures, selective tighter clean-up lines in graphite or black ink drawn over the blue, a few red-pencil accents, peg-hole punched animation paper, smudged blue shading, scribbled margin notes
styles.avoid: Avoid a finished colored-pencil illustration; the blue must read as underdrawing.
styles.feasibility_note: Blue and black layering works reliably.
styles.sensitivity_note: Animation-paper roughs can evoke specific animation studios; never name them.
styles.short_de: Vorzeichnung mit hellblauem Stift, den die Reprokamera nicht erfasste, darüber sauberere Linien in Grafit oder Tusche; seit Mitte des 20. Jahrhunderts in Comic, Trickfilm und Druckvorstufe.
styles.short_en: Rough sketch in cyan pencil, invisible to reproduction cameras, with tighter graphite or ink lines drawn over it; used in comics, animation and print from the mid-20th century.
styles.era_de: ab Mitte des 20. Jh., USA und international
styles.era_en: mid-20th century onward, USA and international
markers_de: Reinzeichnung in Grafit oder Tusche über dem Blau
markers_en: graphite or ink clean-up over the blue
styles.sensitivity_de: Skizzen auf Trickfilmpapier erinnern leicht an bestimmte Animationsstudios; diese nicht nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Animation-paper roughs can evoke specific animation studios; do not name them.

styles.era_origin: Among the oldest drawing media; central to academic and expressive drawing of the 19th-20th century.
styles.prompt_fragment: charcoal drawing on rough off-white paper, velvety deep blacks of compressed charcoal against soft smudged grays of vine charcoal, energetic gestural sweeps, finger and rag smears, broken strokes catching the paper tooth, scattered charcoal dust and smudged fingerprints in the margins
styles.avoid: Avoid clean pencil precision and soft digital-brush gradients.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable texture and smudging.
styles.short_de: Zeichnung mit Weiden- und Presskohle: samtiges Schwarz, verwischte Grautöne, schwungvolle Gesten; eines der ältesten Zeichenmittel, zentral für akademisches und expressives Zeichnen.
styles.short_en: Drawing in vine and compressed charcoal with velvety blacks, smudged greys and gestural sweeps; one of the oldest drawing media, central to academic and expressive drawing.
styles.era_de: seit der Urgeschichte; prägend im 19. und 20. Jh.

styles.era_origin: Academic studio technique, widely taught in modern drawing courses.
styles.prompt_fragment: subtractive charcoal drawing, the entire sheet first toned with a dark smoky layer of charcoal, the image pulled out of the darkness with kneaded and stick erasers, soft glowing lifted highlights, crisp eraser-edge marks, a few reinforced blacks, atmospheric dark ground
styles.avoid: Avoid a white background; the image must emerge from a dark tone.
styles.feasibility_note: The dark ground works; eraser marks can look like white paint.
styles.short_de: Kohletechnik, bei der das ganze Blatt zuerst dunkel grundiert und das Bild dann mit Radiergummis herausgeholt wird; gängige Übung im Zeichenunterricht.
styles.short_en: Charcoal technique in which the whole sheet is first toned dark and the image is lifted out with erasers, giving glowing lights; a common exercise in drawing courses.
styles.era_en: 20th century to today, art schools internationally

styles.era_origin: The compressed graphite-clay stick was invented in Paris in 1795 and became a staple of 19th-century academic and tonal drawing.
visual_markers: crisp angular strokes from square stick edge
styles.prompt_fragment: conté crayon drawing in sepia and black, crisp angular strokes from the stick's square edge combined with broad side-of-stick tones, grainy texture catching the ribs of laid Ingres paper, firmer and less smudged than charcoal, warm cream paper, a few white highlights
styles.avoid: Avoid soft charcoal blending; Conté is crisper, grainier and warmer.
styles.feasibility_note: Visually close to charcoal; square-edge strokes and sepia color help.
styles.sensitivity_note: Conté is a historic maker's name that became the generic term for the medium.
styles.short_de: Zeichnung mit kantigen Stiften aus gepresstem Pigment und Ton in Sepia, Bister oder Schwarz, schärfer und körniger als Kohle; 1795 in Paris erfunden.
styles.short_en: Drawing with square sticks of compressed pigment and clay in sepia, bistre or black, crisper and grainier than charcoal; invented in Paris in 1795.
markers_de: scharfe, kantige Striche von der Stiftkante
markers_en: crisp angular strokes from the square edge
styles.sensitivity_de: Conté ist ein historischer Herstellername, der zum Gattungsbegriff für das Medium wurde.
styles.sensitivity_en: Conté is a historic maker's name that became the generic term for the medium.

styles.era_origin: Taken up by Italian Renaissance draughtsmen in the late 15th century and popular through 18th-century French drawing.
styles.prompt_fragment: red chalk drawing in sanguine on warm cream laid paper, terracotta iron-oxide tone throughout, diagonal parallel hatching modeling the forms, softly rubbed halftones, darker pressure accents, chain lines and slight foxing in the old paper, unfinished study character
styles.avoid: Avoid adding other colors or pencil gray; keep it a single red-brown chalk.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable monochrome red chalk look.
styles.short_de: Einfarbige Zeichnung in rotbrauner Eisenoxidkreide mit diagonaler Schraffur und gewischten Halbtönen auf cremefarbenem Papier; von der italienischen Renaissance bis ins Frankreich des 18. Jahrhunderts.
styles.short_en: Single-colour drawing in reddish-brown iron-oxide chalk with diagonal hatching and rubbed halftones on cream paper; from the late-15th-century Italian Renaissance to 18th-century France.

styles.era_origin: Developed in 17th-century Flemish drawing and peaked in 18th-century French Rococo figure studies.
visual_markers: red, black and white chalk only
styles.prompt_fragment: trois crayons drawing in red sanguine, black chalk and white chalk on mid-tone buff or blue-gray paper, red for warm halftones, black for accents and deepest shadows, white heightening on the lights, delicate feathery hatching, softly rubbed transitions, 18th-century study-sheet elegance
styles.avoid: Avoid full-color pastel coverage; only the three chalks and the paper tone.
styles.feasibility_note: The three-chalk palette holds well.
styles.short_de: Zeichnung mit roter, schwarzer und weißer Kreide auf getöntem Papier, Rot für warme Halbtöne, Weiß für die Lichter; flämisch im 17. Jahrhundert, Höhepunkt im französischen Rokoko.
styles.short_en: Drawing in red, black and white chalk on mid-tone paper, red for warm halftones and white for highlights; Flemish 17th century, peaking in 18th-century French Rococo.
markers_de: nur rote, schwarze und weiße Kreide
markers_en: only red, black and white chalk

styles.name_en: Toned paper drawing heightened with white
styles.era_origin: Renaissance drawing on blue Venetian or prepared paper; standard in modern figure and product drawing on gray paper.
styles.prompt_fragment: drawing on mid-tone gray-blue paper, the paper itself serving as the halftone, shadows in black chalk or charcoal, highlights heightened with white chalk and touches of white gouache, crisp three-value structure, sparing marks, strong sense of volume and a single light direction
styles.avoid: Avoid a white paper background and any color beyond black, white and the paper tone.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable three-value rendering.
styles.short_de: Zeichnung auf getöntem Papier, das den Mittelton liefert, mit Schatten in schwarzer Kreide und Weißhöhungen; seit der Renaissance, bis heute im Figuren- und Produktzeichnen genutzt.
styles.short_en: Drawing on mid-tone paper used as the halftone, with black chalk shadows and white heightening; a Renaissance practice still used in figure and product drawing.
styles.era_de: seit dem 15. Jh., Italien und Deutschland; bis heute
styles.era_en: since the 15th century, Italy and Germany; still in use
markers_de: Lichter in weißer Kreide und Deckweiß

styles.era_origin: Medieval and Renaissance drawing, especially 15th-century Flemish and Italian workshops; a small contemporary revival.
styles.prompt_fragment: silverpoint drawing on a prepared ground of tinted bone-white gesso, extremely fine pale gray lines of uniform weight, delicate parallel hatching as the only tone, no smudging or erasing, lines oxidized to a soft warm brownish tarnish, low subdued contrast, meticulous Renaissance precision
styles.avoid: Avoid dark contrast and soft blending; silverpoint is pale, fine and strictly linear.
styles.feasibility_note: The pale delicacy holds, but the model tends to raise contrast toward graphite.
styles.short_de: Zeichnung mit einem Silberstift auf grundiertem Papier, extrem feine, blassgraue Linien, die zu warmem Braun nachdunkeln; verbreitet in flämischen und italienischen Werkstätten des 15. Jahrhunderts.
styles.short_en: Drawing with a silver stylus on a prepared ground, giving extremely fine pale grey lines that tarnish to warm brown; 15th-century Flemish and Italian workshops.
styles.era_de: 14.–16. Jh., Flandern und Italien; heute kleine Wiederbelebung
styles.era_en: 14th–16th century, Flanders and Italy; small revival today

styles.era_origin: Developed in the 16th century, flourishing in 18th-century portraiture and 19th-century Impressionism.
styles.prompt_fragment: soft pastel on toned sanded pastel paper, powdery chalky strokes layered and scumbled, paper tooth breaking up each mark, vibrant pigment with a dusty velvet bloom, some areas finger-blended and others left as crisp side-of-stick strokes, loose pigment dust along the bottom edge
styles.avoid: Avoid oil-paint gloss and smooth airbrush gradients.
styles.feasibility_note: Powdery texture renders well.
styles.short_de: Malen mit weichen, pudrigen Pastellkreiden auf getöntem oder gekörntem Papier, mit kreidigen Strichen und samtigem Schimmer; Blütezeit im Porträt des 18. Jahrhunderts und im Impressionismus.
styles.short_en: Painting with soft, powdery pastel sticks on toned or sanded paper, leaving chalky strokes and a velvety bloom; flourished in 18th-century portraiture and Impressionism.
styles.era_de: seit dem 16. Jh.; Blüte im 18. Jh. und 1870er–1890er, Europa
styles.era_en: since the 16th century; peaks in the 18th century and 1870s–1890s, Europe

styles.era_origin: Introduced in 1920s Japan as a school medium and in 1949 France as an artists' medium; common in school art since.
styles.prompt_fragment: oil pastel drawing, thick waxy buttery strokes pressed hard into the paper, smeared and finger-blended color, scratched sgraffito lines revealing the layer beneath, saturated bold hues, uneven coverage with paper flecks showing through, small waxy crumbs and smudges
styles.avoid: Avoid the chalky delicacy of soft pastel and clean digital edges.
styles.feasibility_note: Waxy texture is convincing.
styles.short_de: Dicke, wachsige, kräftig farbige Striche in Ölpastell, mit dem Finger verwischt und eingekratzt; Schulmaterial aus dem Japan der 1920er, Künstlerqualität aus Frankreich seit 1949.
styles.short_en: Thick, waxy, saturated strokes of oil pastel, smeared by finger and scratched into; a school medium from 1920s Japan and an artists' medium in France from 1949.

styles.era_origin: Artist-grade colored pencils from the early 20th century; a core medium of school drawing and contemporary illustration.
styles.prompt_fragment: colored pencil drawing on smooth white paper, colors layered in light directional hatching so hues mix optically, paper grain sparkling through the strokes, burnished waxy sheen in the most saturated areas, slightly soft edges, individual pencil strokes visible throughout, occasional wax bloom
styles.avoid: Avoid smooth airbrush blending and photoreal finish; individual strokes must stay visible.
styles.feasibility_note: Stroke texture holds well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Use generic terms, not pencil manufacturers' brand names.
styles.short_de: Geschichtete Buntstiftschraffur, in der sich die Farben optisch mischen, mit durchscheinendem Papierkorn und wachsigem Glanz in dichten Partien; verbreitet seit dem frühen 20. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Layered coloured-pencil hatching that mixes hues optically, with paper grain showing through and a waxy burnish in dense areas; common since the early 20th century.
styles.sensitivity_de: Allgemeine Begriffe verwenden, keine Markennamen von Stiftherstellern.
styles.sensitivity_en: Use generic terms, not pencil manufacturers' brand names.

styles.era_origin: An ancient rubbing practice, formalised as a Surrealist technique in 1925.
visual_markers: transferred wood grain, leaf and fabric textures
styles.prompt_fragment: frottage drawing made by rubbing graphite and wax crayon over paper laid on textured surfaces, forms assembled from transferred wood grain, leaf veins, fabric weave and coarse floorboards, ghostly embossed textures, uneven pressure, a few hand-drawn outlines added to clarify shapes
styles.avoid: Avoid clean conventional drawing; the textures must read as imprinted rubbings.
styles.feasibility_note: Textures render, but building recognisable forms from them is hit-or-miss.
styles.short_de: Bilder aus Holzmaserung, Blättern oder Gewebe, die durch Abreiben mit Bleistift oder Wachskreide aufs Papier übertragen werden; 1925 von Max Ernst als surrealistisches Verfahren entwickelt.
styles.short_en: Images built from textures of wood grain, leaves or fabric transferred by rubbing pencil or crayon over paper; formalised as a Surrealist technique by Max Ernst in 1925.
styles.era_de: seit 1925, Frankreich (Surrealismus); das Abreiben selbst ist uralt
styles.era_en: since 1925, France (Surrealism); rubbing itself is ancient
markers_en: transferred wood-grain, leaf and fabric textures

styles.era_origin: Academy practice since the Renaissance; timed one- to five-minute gesture poses became standard in 20th-century art teaching.
visual_markers: several quick studies on one sheet
styles.prompt_fragment: life-drawing session sheet on cheap off-white newsprint, several quick gesture studies of one to five minutes each, sweeping lines of action, simplified masses, hands and feet barely indicated, charcoal and conté marks of varying weight, pose times scribbled beside each study, yellowed paper with clip marks
styles.avoid: Avoid finished detailed rendering and stiff fashion poses.
styles.feasibility_note: Multiple-study layout and gesture energy render well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Life drawing traditionally uses nude models; keep motifs clothed or non-explicit to respect platform rules and context.
styles.short_de: Blatt mit schnellen, zeitlich begrenzten Bewegungsstudien nach dem lebenden Modell, mit schwungvollen Bewegungslinien und vereinfachten Massen auf Newsprint-Papier; Akademiepraxis seit der Renaissance.
styles.short_en: A sheet of quick timed gesture studies from a live model, with sweeping lines of action and simplified masses on newsprint; art-academy practice since the Renaissance.
styles.era_de: seit der Renaissance; Kurzposen Standard im Unterricht des 20. Jh.
styles.era_en: since the Renaissance; timed poses standard in 20th-century teaching
markers_de: mehrere schnelle Studien auf einem Blatt
markers_en: several quick studies on one sheet
styles.sensitivity_de: Aktzeichnen arbeitet traditionell mit unbekleideten Modellen; Motive bekleidet oder nicht explizit halten.
styles.sensitivity_en: Life drawing traditionally uses nude models; keep motifs clothed or non-explicit.

styles.era_origin: Renaissance artist-engineer notebooks and academic study sheets; a living sketchbook practice.
styles.prompt_fragment: sheet of studies from an artist's sketchbook, the subject drawn several times from different angles and scales, close-up details of parts, handwritten annotations and arrows, mixed sepia ink and pencil, scribbled measurements, aged coffee-toned paper with a ragged deckle edge
styles.avoid: Avoid a single centered hero image; the layout should be scattered and exploratory.
styles.feasibility_note: Layout works; annotations become pseudo-handwriting.
styles.sensitivity_note: Mirror-writing notebook pages strongly evoke one Renaissance master; do not name him or imitate specific sheets.
styles.short_de: Skizzenblatt, auf dem ein Motiv mehrfach aus verschiedenen Winkeln erscheint, mit Detailstudien, Pfeilen und handschriftlichen Notizen; von Renaissance-Notizbüchern bis zum heutigen Skizzenbuch.
styles.short_en: Sketchbook sheet with a subject drawn several times from different angles, close-up details, arrows and handwritten notes; from Renaissance notebooks to today's sketchbook practice.
styles.era_de: seit dem 15. Jh., Italien; heute international
styles.era_en: since the 15th century, Italy; international today
styles.sensitivity_de: Notizbuchseiten mit Spiegelschrift erinnern an einen bestimmten Renaissancemeister; keine konkreten Blätter nachahmen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Mirror-writing notebook pages evoke one specific Renaissance master; do not imitate particular sheets.

styles.era_origin: Japanese concept of light-dark harmony introduced to Western art teaching through an 1899 composition textbook.
visual_markers: only two or three flat values
styles.prompt_fragment: notan value study, the image reduced to two or three flat values of black, mid-gray and paper white, shapes simplified into interlocking abstract masses, no lines, no gradients, no small detail, drawn with gray and black markers as a small thumbnail inside a ruled pencil border on sketchbook paper
styles.avoid: Avoid gradients, outlines and detail; it is a pure value-design study.
styles.feasibility_note: Flat value reduction works well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Japanese aesthetic term; use it respectfully and avoid exoticising decoration.
styles.short_de: Tonwertstudie, die das Bild auf zwei oder drei flache, ineinandergreifende Tonflächen reduziert; ein japanisches Konzept, das Arthur Wesley Dow 1899 in den westlichen Kunstunterricht brachte.
styles.short_en: Value study reducing the image to two or three flat tones in interlocking shapes; a Japanese concept introduced to Western art teaching by Arthur Wesley Dow in 1899.
styles.era_de: japanisches Konzept; im westlichen Unterricht seit 1899, USA
styles.era_en: Japanese concept; in Western teaching since 1899, USA
markers_de: nur zwei oder drei flache Tonwerte
markers_en: only two or three flat values
styles.sensitivity_de: Japanischer Ästhetikbegriff; respektvoll verwenden, ohne exotisierende Dekoration.
styles.sensitivity_en: Japanese aesthetic term; use it respectfully, without exoticising decoration.

styles.era_origin: Universal; collected and valued as art since early-20th-century interest in children's drawings.
styles.prompt_fragment: drawing by a six-year-old child in wax crayons on cheap white paper, scribbled fills wandering outside the outlines, paper showing through waxy strokes, symbolic simplified figures, sky as a blue strip along the top, sun in a corner, ground line at the bottom, wildly inconsistent scale, uneven pressure
styles.avoid: Avoid adult illustration skill and cute stylised cartoon; it must look genuinely made by a child.
styles.feasibility_note: The model tends to make it too competent and cute; insist on child-level symbolism.
styles.short_de: Wachsmalbild, wie es kleine Kinder malen: symbolhafte Figuren, Himmelsstreifen, Sonne in der Ecke, übermalte Ränder und wild wechselnde Größen; seit dem frühen 20. Jahrhundert als Kunst beachtet.
styles.short_en: Wax-crayon drawing as a young child makes it: symbolic figures, sky strip, corner sun, scribbled fills and wild scale; valued as art since the early 20th century.
styles.era_de: universell; als Kunst beachtet seit dem frühen 20. Jh.
styles.era_en: universal; valued as art since the early 20th century

styles.era_origin: Introduced as a children's educational medium in the 1930s; also used in adult expressive practice.
styles.prompt_fragment: finger painting with thick glossy primary-colored finger paints on wrinkled paper, fingertip dabs and swirling smears, visible fingerprint ridges in the paint, colors mixing into muddy patches where they overlap, chunky simplified shapes, paper buckled from the wet paint
styles.avoid: Avoid brushstrokes and precise detail.
styles.feasibility_note: Paint texture works; fingerprint ridges are inconsistent.
styles.short_de: Dicke, glänzende Farbe in Grundfarben, mit den Fingerkuppen getupft und verwirbelt, mit Fingerabdrucklinien und schlammigen Mischtönen; 1931 von Ruth Faison Shaw als Kindermalmittel eingeführt.
styles.short_en: Thick glossy primary-coloured paint applied with fingertips in dabs and swirls, with fingerprint ridges and muddy mixes; introduced as a children's medium by Ruth Faison Shaw in 1931.

styles.era_origin: Classroom blackboards since the 19th century; decorative chalk menu boards a café and craft trend since the 2010s.
styles.prompt_fragment: chalk drawing on a dark green-black chalkboard, dusty white and pastel colored chalk strokes with grainy broken texture, ghostly half-erased smears of earlier drawings, fingertip smudges, chalk dust settling along the bottom wooden ledge, slight slate sheen
styles.avoid: Avoid neat digital chalk fonts and perfectly symmetric lettering.
styles.feasibility_note: Chalk texture is reliable; check any lettering for spelling.
styles.short_de: Weiße und farbige Kreide auf grünschwarzer Tafel, körnig gebrochene Striche und Reste weggewischter Zeichnungen; im Klassenzimmer seit dem 19. Jahrhundert, als Café-Tafel seit den 2010er-Jahren.
styles.short_en: White and coloured chalk on a green-black board, with grainy broken strokes and ghosts of erased drawings; classrooms since the 19th century, café menu boards since the 2010s.
styles.era_de: seit dem 19. Jh., Schule; Café-Tafeln seit den 2010ern
styles.era_en: since the 19th century, schools; café boards since the 2010s

styles.era_origin: Children's street play everywhere; thick sidewalk chalk mass-produced through the 20th century.
styles.prompt_fragment: thick sidewalk chalk drawing on gray asphalt, bright chalky pastel colors ground into the rough aggregate, pebbles and cracks interrupting the strokes, colored dust smeared by shoes, unevenly filled areas, seen from above in daylight with a few broken chalk sticks at the edge
styles.avoid: Avoid smooth surfaces; the asphalt grain must break up the color.
styles.feasibility_note: Asphalt texture renders convincingly.
styles.short_de: Dicke Straßenmalkreide auf Asphalt, die pastelligen Striche von Splitt, Rissen und Steinchen unterbrochen, von oben gesehen; Kinderspiel auf der Straße im ganzen 20. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Thick coloured chalk drawn on asphalt, its pastel strokes broken by grit, cracks and pebbles, seen from above; children's street play throughout the 20th century.

styles.era_origin: Italian madonnari street painting since the 16th century; anamorphic 3D pavement illusions from the 1980s.
visual_markers: illusion of depth opening into the pavement
styles.prompt_fragment: anamorphic 3D pavement painting in chalk and pastel, photographed from the single correct viewpoint so the image appears to open into or rise out of the street, convincing trompe-l'oeil depth and cast shadows, surrounding paving slabs and onlookers' feet at the edges, stretched distortion visible at the periphery
styles.avoid: Avoid real 3D objects or a CGI hole; it must read as flat chalk on pavement.
styles.feasibility_note: The illusion works but tends toward CGI; ask for chalk texture on the slabs.
styles.sensitivity_note: The madonnari tradition originally depicted religious images.
styles.short_de: Verzerrt gemaltes Kreidebild auf dem Pflaster, das von einem Standpunkt aus räumlich in die Straße zu reichen scheint; Wurzeln bei den italienischen Madonnari, anamorph seit den 1980ern.
styles.short_en: Chalk pavement painting distorted so that, from one viewpoint, it seems to open into or rise from the street; rooted in Italian madonnari, anamorphic since the 1980s.
styles.era_de: Madonnari seit dem 16. Jh., Italien; anamorph seit den 1980ern
styles.era_en: madonnari since the 16th century, Italy; anamorphic since the 1980s
markers_en: depth illusion opening into the pavement
styles.sensitivity_de: Die Madonnari-Tradition zeigte ursprünglich religiöse Bilder.
styles.sensitivity_en: The madonnari tradition originally depicted religious images.

styles.era_origin: Office and classroom whiteboards spread from the 1960s-90s; closely linked to workshop and sketchnoting culture.
styles.prompt_fragment: dry-erase marker drawing on a glossy office whiteboard, streaky black, blue, red and green marker lines thinning where the pen runs dry, faint ghost traces of previously erased diagrams, reflection glare from ceiling lights, quick boxy arrows and underlines, a couple of magnets and sticky notes at the edge
styles.avoid: Avoid a clean vector infographic layout; keep it improvised.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable; check any text for spelling.
styles.short_de: Streifige Zeichnung mit Whiteboard-Markern in vier Farben auf glänzender Tafel, mit Resten weggewischter Inhalte und Spiegelungen der Deckenlampen; Büro- und Schulalltag seit den 1990er-Jahren.
styles.short_en: Streaky four-colour dry-erase marker drawing on a glossy board, with ghosts of erased content and ceiling-light glare; office and classroom culture since the 1990s.
styles.era_de: seit den 1990ern, Büro und Schule, international
styles.era_en: since the 1990s, offices and schools internationally

styles.era_origin: Felt- and fibre-tip pens appeared in the 1960s and became standard for children's and casual drawing.
styles.prompt_fragment: felt-tip pen drawing with water-based fiber markers, saturated flat colors filled in streaky parallel strokes, darker stripes where strokes overlap, slight bleeding at the edges, some pens running dry into pale scratchy lines, paper pilling from overworking, bold black outlines
styles.avoid: Avoid the smooth blended gradients of alcohol markers.
styles.feasibility_note: Streak texture renders well.
styles.short_de: Zeichnung mit wasserbasierten Filz- oder Faserstiften, flächig und satt in streifigen Strichen ausgemalt, dunkler an Überlappungen; seit den 1960er-Jahren Alltags- und Kinderzeichenmittel.
styles.short_en: Drawing with water-based fiber-tip markers in flat saturated colours laid in streaky strokes, darker where they overlap; common in children's and casual drawing since the 1960s.

styles.era_origin: Standard presentation technique in automotive and industrial design studios from the 1960s to the 2000s.
styles.prompt_fragment: industrial-design marker rendering on layout paper, confident ballpoint construction lines with ellipses and perspective guides, cool gray marker tones laid in quick parallel strokes, reflections rubbed in with pastel chalk, crisp white gel-pen highlights on edges, a bold colored marker swash behind the object, dynamic three-quarter view
styles.avoid: Avoid CGI product rendering; keep marker streaks and construction lines visible.
styles.feasibility_note: Very convincing for products and vehicles.
styles.short_de: Produkt- oder Autozeichnung auf Layoutpapier mit Kugelschreiber-Konstruktion, grauen Markerstrichen, mit Pastellkreide eingeriebenen Reflexen und weißen Glanzlichtern; Standard in Designstudios der 1960er bis 2000er.
styles.short_en: Product or car drawing on layout paper with ballpoint construction lines, grey marker strokes, pastel-rubbed reflections and white highlights; standard in design studios from the 1960s to 2000s.

styles.era_origin: Refillable alcohol-based markers spread through manga, fashion and illustration from the late 1980s.
visual_markers: white gel highlights and bleed halos
styles.prompt_fragment: illustration colored with alcohol markers on smooth marker paper, flat-to-gradient blends with visible overlapping stroke streaks, slightly banded color transitions, saturated hues, fine black ink outlines, crisp white gel-pen highlights, small bleed halos where marker crossed the outlines
styles.avoid: Avoid digital cel shading; keep the streaks and bleed halos.
styles.feasibility_note: Marker streaks render reliably.
styles.sensitivity_note: Copic is a marker brand often used as shorthand for the look; the prompt uses the generic term.
styles.short_de: Mit Alkoholmarkern kolorierte Illustration: streifige Verläufe, leichte Farbstufen, feine schwarze Konturen und weiße Gelstift-Lichter; seit Ende der 1980er in Manga, Mode und Illustration verbreitet.
styles.short_en: Illustration coloured with alcohol-based markers, showing streaky blends, slight banding, fine black outlines and white gel highlights; spread through manga, fashion and illustration from the late 1980s.
markers_en: white gel highlights and bleed halos
styles.sensitivity_de: Copic ist eine Markermarke, die oft als Kürzel für den Look dient; der Prompt nutzt den Gattungsbegriff.
styles.sensitivity_en: Copic is a marker brand often used as shorthand for the look; the prompt uses the generic term.

styles.era_origin: Invented in the late 19th century; its golden age was 1970s-80s commercial illustration, album covers and pin-ups.
styles.prompt_fragment: 1970s-80s airbrush illustration on board, ultra-smooth sprayed gradients cut by hard frisket-masked edges, chrome-like reflective highlights, star-shaped glints, soft colored glows, fine overspray speckle around shapes, saturated sunset and cool metallic palette
styles.avoid: Avoid generic modern digital smoothness; frisket edges, speckle and the retro palette define it.
styles.feasibility_note: Retro airbrush reads clearly; without era cues it collapses into generic smooth digital art.
styles.short_de: Extrem glatte gesprühte Verläufe mit harten Maskenkanten, Chromreflexen, Sternglanzlichtern und Sprühnebel; das Gerät stammt aus dem späten 19. Jahrhundert, die Blütezeit war die Werbegrafik der 1970er und 80er.
styles.short_en: Ultra-smooth sprayed gradients with hard masked edges, chrome reflections, star glints and overspray speckle; the tool dates from the late 19th century, its heyday was 1970s–80s commercial art.

styles.era_origin: Emerged among street performers in Mexico City in the early 1980s and is now seen in tourist hotspots worldwide.
styles.prompt_fragment: street-performer spray paint art on glossy poster board, perfectly round shapes masked with lids and bowls, textures pressed in with crumpled magazine paper, scraped silhouettes, glowing cosmic fades from black to vivid magenta and cyan, speckled stars flicked on, glossy wet sheen
styles.avoid: Avoid detailed realism; subjects should reduce to silhouettes, circles and textured fades.
styles.feasibility_note: The texture tricks render; subjects stay legible only as silhouettes.
styles.short_de: Schnell gesprühte Bilder auf Hochglanzkarton mit über Deckel maskierten Planeten, Knüllpapier-Texturen und kosmischen Farbverläufen; ein Straßenkünstler-Genre aus dem Mexiko-Stadt der frühen 1980er.
styles.short_en: Fast spray-can pictures on glossy poster board with lid-masked planets, crumpled-paper textures and cosmic fades; a street-performer genre from early-1980s Mexico City.
markers_de: kosmische Verläufe von Schwarz zu Neon

styles.era_origin: Professional practice with pressure-sensitive tablets since the late 1990s.
styles.prompt_fragment: painterly digital painting made with textured brushes on a pressure tablet, visible flat color-picked strokes and hard-edged brush shapes, soft edges only where intended, slightly noisy canvas texture overlay, confident value grouping, rich but controlled saturation
styles.avoid: Avoid over-rendered smooth surfaces, rim light everywhere and glow effects; those pull it back to the AI default.
styles.feasibility_note: Native territory for the model, which is why it slides easily into the generic look.
styles.short_de: Digitale Malerei mit strukturierten Tablet-Pinseln, bei der flache, hartkantige Striche und gebündelte Tonwerte sichtbar bleiben statt glatt ausgearbeiteter Flächen; Profipraxis seit Ende der 1990er.
styles.short_en: Digital painting with textured tablet brushes that leaves flat, hard-edged strokes and grouped values visible instead of smooth rendering; professional practice since the late 1990s.

styles.era_origin: The converged online digital-painting look of the 2010s, amplified by text-to-image models since 2022.
visual_markers: glowing rim light and god rays
styles.prompt_fragment: ultra-smooth polished digital illustration, airbrushed flawless surfaces, glowing rim light and volumetric god rays, teal-and-orange color grading, centered heroic composition, shallow depth-of-field bokeh, floating sparkle particles, high saturation and clarity, every surface equally detailed
styles.avoid: Use only as a deliberate contrast reference; to escape it, add a physical medium, imperfections and a restricted palette.
styles.feasibility_note: This is the model's default attractor; it appears even unprompted.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid platform-name prompt clichés referencing art-hosting sites.
styles.short_de: Überglatter Digitallook mit wie gesprühten Oberflächen, Kantenlicht, Lichtstrahlen, Teal-Orange-Grading und Bokeh; der vereinheitlichte Online-Look der 2010er, seit 2022 durch Bildgeneratoren verstärkt.
styles.short_en: Over-smooth digital look with airbrushed surfaces, rim light, god rays, teal-and-orange grading and bokeh; the converged 2010s online look, amplified by image generators since 2022.
styles.era_en: 2010s, online; amplified by AI image generators since 2022
markers_en: glowing rim light and god rays
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine Prompt-Floskeln mit Namen von Kunstplattformen verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid prompt clichés that name art-hosting platforms.

styles.era_origin: Upper Paleolithic Europe, c. 40,000–12,000 years ago (Chauvet, Lascaux, Altamira).
visual_markers: red/yellow ochre, charcoal and manganese pigments on rough limestone
forms follow natural bulges of the rock
overlapping figures with no ground line or perspective
blown-pigment soft edges, hand stencils and dot clusters
styles.prompt_fragment: as Upper Paleolithic cave painting: red and yellow ochre, charcoal black and manganese brown pigment smeared and blown onto uneven cream limestone, forms following the bulges of the rock, confident contour lines, no ground line or perspective, overlapping figures, flickering torchlit cave wall, mineral crust, cracks and flaking pigment
styles.avoid: Avoid clean parchment backgrounds, symmetrical tribal-tattoo stylization and a glossy museum-lit look; keep the lumpy rock surface and the limited earth palette.
styles.feasibility_note: Rock texture and ochre palette render convincingly; human figures tend to get too detailed, so ask for schematic stick-like humans.
styles.short_de: Tiere und Zeichen in Ocker, Holzkohle und Manganschwarz auf Kalksteinwänden, der Wölbung des Felsens folgend, dazu Handnegative; Jungpaläolithikum in Europa, vor etwa 40.000 bis 12.000 Jahren.
styles.short_en: Animals and signs in ochre, charcoal and manganese on limestone cave walls, shaped by the rock's bulges, with hand stencils; Upper Paleolithic Europe, about 40,000–12,000 years ago.
markers_de: Ocker, Holzkohle und Mangan auf rauem Kalkstein
markers_en: ochre, charcoal and manganese on rough limestone

styles.era_origin: Ancient Egypt, Old to New Kingdom tomb and temple decoration, c. 2600–1000 BCE.
visual_markers: composite view: profile head with frontal eye and shoulders
flat mineral colors (Egyptian blue, ochres, malachite green)
columns of hieroglyphic ornament on cracked plaster
styles.prompt_fragment: in the manner of an ancient Egyptian tomb wall painting: flat mineral pigments (Egyptian blue, red and yellow ochre, malachite green, carbon black) on cracked lime plaster, figures in composite view with profile heads and frontal eyes and shoulders, horizontal registers on ground lines, hierarchical scale, crisp red-brown outlines, columns of hieroglyph-like ornament, faded and chipped surface
styles.avoid: Avoid gold-and-lapis tourist kitsch, 3D shading and fake readable hieroglyph text; keep figures flat, rigidly profiled and arranged in registers.
styles.feasibility_note: Composite poses and register layouts work well; hieroglyphs come out as invented glyphs, acceptable as ornament but never as real text.
styles.sensitivity_note: Uses funerary and religious iconography; avoid mocking or commercial use of deity imagery.
styles.short_de: Flache Mineralfarben auf Kalkputz, Figuren mit Kopf im Profil und frontalem Auge, in Bildstreifen gereiht; Grab- und Tempelmalerei des Alten Ägypten, ca. 2600–1000 v. Chr.
styles.short_en: Flat mineral colours on plaster, figures in composite view with profile head and frontal eye, arranged in registers; tomb and temple painting of ancient Egypt, c. 2600–1000 BCE.
markers_de: Kompositansicht: Kopf im Profil, Auge und Schultern frontal
markers_en: composite view: profile head, frontal eye and shoulders
flat Egyptian blue, ochres, malachite green
styles.sensitivity_de: Greift Grab- und Götterikonografie auf; Götterbilder nicht verspotten oder kommerziell ausschlachten.
styles.sensitivity_en: Draws on funerary and religious iconography; avoid mocking or commercial use of deity imagery.

styles.era_origin: Bronze Age Crete and Thera (Knossos, Akrotiri), c. 1700–1450 BCE.
visual_markers: bright red ochre, sky blue, saffron yellow on lime plaster
undulating banded backgrounds and wavy rock forms
conventional reddish-brown and pale skin tones
large fragment losses restored with plain plaster
styles.prompt_fragment: as a Bronze Age Aegean buon fresco: lively flowing outlines, flat areas of bright red ochre, sky blue, saffron yellow and white on lime plaster, undulating banded backgrounds and stylized wavy rock forms, wasp-waisted figures in elegant profile, conventional reddish-brown and pale skin tones, fragmentary surface with missing patches filled in plain plaster
styles.avoid: Avoid Egyptian rigidity and register grids; Minoan line is loose, rhythmic and naturalistic, with big fragment losses instead of uniform aging.
styles.feasibility_note: Tends to blend with Egyptian or Greek vase painting; mentioning fragmentary restoration and wavy backgrounds explicitly helps.
styles.short_de: Schwungvolle Umrisse und flächiges Rotocker, Himmelblau und Safrangelb auf Kalkputz, oft nur in Fragmenten erhalten; bronzezeitliche Wandmalerei aus Knossos und Akrotiri.
styles.short_en: Lively flowing outlines and flat red ochre, sky blue and saffron yellow on lime plaster, often fragmentary; Bronze Age wall painting from Knossos and Akrotiri.
styles.era_de: ca. 1700–1450 v. Chr., Kreta und Thera
markers_en: red ochre, sky blue, saffron yellow on lime plaster
conventional reddish-brown and pale skin tones

styles.era_origin: Developed in Corinth in the 7th century BCE, peak in Athens in the 6th century BCE.
visual_markers: glossy black silhouettes on orange terracotta
interior details incised through to the clay
meander and palmette bands on a curved surface
styles.prompt_fragment: as Archaic Greek black-figure vase painting: glossy black slip silhouettes on warm orange terracotta, interior details incised as fine scratched lines revealing the clay, sparse added white and purple-red, strict profile poses, decorative bands of meander, palmettes and tongues framing the scene, slight curvature of a pottery surface, small chips and worn glaze
styles.avoid: Avoid soft shading and painted-on black details; inner lines must be incised, and do not invert to clay-colored figures (that is red-figure).
styles.feasibility_note: Silhouettes and palette are reliable; incised lines sometimes become painted white lines or slip into red-figure logic.
styles.short_de: Glänzend schwarze Figurensilhouetten auf orangefarbenem Ton, Binnenzeichnung eingeritzt, sparsam Weiß und Purpurrot; griechische Vasenmalerei aus Korinth und Athen, 7.–6. Jh. v. Chr.
styles.short_en: Glossy black figure silhouettes on orange clay with incised inner lines and touches of white and purple-red; Greek pottery painting from Corinth and Athens, 7th–6th century BCE.
styles.era_de: 7.–6. Jh. v. Chr., Korinth und Athen
markers_de: glänzend schwarze Silhouetten auf orangem Ton
markers_en: glossy black silhouettes on orange terracotta
incised inner details showing the clay

styles.era_origin: Invented in Athens c. 530 BCE, dominant through the 5th century BCE.
visual_markers: figures reserved in orange clay against lustrous black
styles.prompt_fragment: as Classical Greek red-figure vase painting: figures left in the natural orange-red clay against a lustrous black slip background, anatomy and drapery drawn with fine raised black relief lines and diluted golden-brown washes, graceful contrapposto and three-quarter poses, meander and egg-and-dart borders, curved ceramic surface with subtle sheen and worn edges
styles.avoid: Avoid black silhouettes on orange (black-figure) and modern comic shading; the only contrast is clay against glossy black.
styles.feasibility_note: The two-tone system and fine line drawing hold well; anatomy lines can get too dense.
styles.short_de: Figuren bleiben tongrundig orange vor glänzend schwarzem Grund, gezeichnet mit feinen Relieflinien und verdünnten Lasuren; attische Vasenmalerei ab etwa 530 v. Chr.
styles.short_en: Figures reserved in orange clay against lustrous black, drawn with fine relief lines and diluted washes; Athenian vase painting from c. 530 BCE.
markers_de: verdünnte goldbraune Lasuren für die Anatomie
markers_en: figures reserved in orange clay on lustrous black

styles.era_origin: Roman Campania, the four Pompeian styles, 2nd century BCE to 79 CE.
visual_markers: deep cinnabar red, ochre and black wall panels
quick loose sketchy brushwork for figures
vignettes floating on flat color fields
sun-faded plaster with cracks and losses
styles.prompt_fragment: as a Roman Pompeian fresco: panels of deep cinnabar red, ochre yellow and black framed by painted illusionistic columns and garlands, figures and objects painted with quick loose brushstrokes and soft modelling, light airy vignettes floating on flat colored fields, sun-faded lime plaster with hairline cracks, scratches and missing patches
styles.avoid: Avoid clean digital fresco and Renaissance perspective; keep the fast, sketchy Roman brushwork and the strong red/black wall system.
styles.feasibility_note: The palette and plaster aging work reliably; the loose brushwork can get over-refined.
styles.short_de: Wandfelder in tiefem Rot, Ocker und Schwarz mit gemalter Scheinarchitektur und locker hingesetzten Bildfeldern; römische Fresken aus Kampanien, 2. Jh. v. Chr. bis 79 n. Chr.
styles.short_en: Wall panels in deep red, ochre and black with painted illusionistic architecture and loosely brushed floating vignettes; Roman frescoes from Campania, 2nd century BCE–79 CE.
styles.era_de: 2. Jh. v. Chr. – 79 n. Chr., Kampanien
markers_en: deep cinnabar red, ochre and black panels
vignettes floating on flat colour fields

styles.era_origin: Hellenistic and Roman world, 2nd century BCE to 5th century CE.
visual_markers: small irregular stone and glass tesserae
styles.prompt_fragment: as an ancient Roman floor mosaic: thousands of small irregular cut-stone and glass tesserae in muted marble whites, terracotta, ochre, slate grey and black, rows of tesserae following the contours of forms, visible grout lines, guilloche and meander border, worn uneven surface with missing tesserae and patches, shading built from stepped bands of color
styles.avoid: Avoid a perfect square pixel grid and glossy bathroom-tile sheen; tesserae must be irregular stone set in flowing rows.
styles.feasibility_note: Works well overall, but tesserae often become a uniform grid or blur into paint at small scale; ask for visibly irregular stones.
styles.short_de: Bilder aus kleinen, unregelmäßigen Stein- und Glassteinchen in gedeckten Naturtönen, mit sichtbaren Fugen und Ornamentbordüren; Fußböden der hellenistischen und römischen Welt.
styles.short_en: Pictures set from small irregular stone and glass tesserae in muted natural colours, with visible grout and ornamental borders; floors of the Hellenistic and Roman world.
styles.era_de: 2. Jh. v. Chr. – 5. Jh. n. Chr., Mittelmeerraum
markers_en: small irregular stone and glass tesserae
guilloche or meander border, missing tesserae

styles.era_origin: Roman Egypt, 1st–3rd century CE.
visual_markers: encaustic wax strokes on thin wooden panel
frontal bust with large dark eyes
warm ochre flesh, neutral grey-green ground
styles.prompt_fragment: as a Romano-Egyptian Fayum mummy portrait: encaustic hot wax and tempera on a thin wooden panel, frontal bust with large dark eyes looking directly out, warm ochre flesh modelled with thick directional strokes of wax, neutral grey-green background, touches of gold leaf, cracked and split wood grain, chipped edges and darkened surface
styles.avoid: Avoid smooth photographic skin and modern glamour lighting; wax strokes, frontality and the damaged panel are what make it read as ancient.
styles.feasibility_note: Excellent for single heads; multi-figure scenes break the convention.
styles.sensitivity_note: Originals are funerary portraits of real deceased people; never present generated images as genuine antiquities.
styles.short_de: Frontale Büste mit großen dunklen Augen, in Wachs und Tempera auf dünne Holztafel gemalt; Bildnisse, die im römischen Ägypten über die Mumie gelegt wurden, 1.–3. Jh. n. Chr.
styles.short_en: Frontal bust with large dark eyes, painted in wax and tempera on a thin wooden panel; funerary portraits placed over mummies in Roman Egypt, 1st–3rd century CE.
markers_de: frontale Büste mit großen dunklen Augen
markers_en: encaustic wax strokes on thin wooden panel
frontal bust with large dark eyes
warm ochre flesh on grey-green ground
styles.sensitivity_de: Die Originale sind Grabbildnisse realer Verstorbener; generierte Bilder nie als echte Antiken ausgeben.
styles.sensitivity_en: The originals are funerary portraits of real deceased people; never pass off generated images as genuine antiquities.

styles.era_origin: Byzantine Empire from the 6th century, continuing in the Orthodox tradition to today.
visual_markers: frontal solemn figures with almond eyes
olive flesh built up in layered highlights
styles.prompt_fragment: as a Byzantine icon: egg tempera on gessoed wooden panel with burnished gold-leaf background, frontal solemn figures with elongated noses and large almond eyes, olive-brown flesh built up with layered highlights, stylized drapery with fine gold hatching, inverse perspective in furniture and buildings, raised border, darkened varnish, craquelure and worn gilding
styles.avoid: Avoid naturalistic Renaissance volume, soft lighting and shiny CGI gold; keep the flat sacred frontality, inverse perspective and hand-laid gilding.
styles.feasibility_note: Gold ground, flesh layering and frontality render reliably; inverse perspective sometimes gets corrected to normal perspective.
styles.sensitivity_note: Icons are living sacred objects in Orthodox Christianity; avoid irreverent or parodic use of saint or Christ iconography and halos on profane subjects.
styles.short_de: Feierlich frontale Gestalten mit Mandelaugen vor poliertem Goldgrund, Eitempera auf Holz mit umgekehrter Perspektive; byzantinisch-orthodoxe Tradition seit dem 6. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Solemn frontal figures with almond eyes on burnished gold ground, in egg tempera on wood with inverse perspective; Byzantine and Orthodox tradition since the 6th century.
styles.era_de: seit dem 6. Jh., Byzanz und orthodoxe Welt
styles.era_en: since the 6th century, Byzantium and the Orthodox world
markers_en: solemn frontal figures with almond eyes
olive flesh built up in layered highlights
styles.sensitivity_de: Ikonen sind in der Orthodoxie lebendige Kultbilder; Christus- und Heiligendarstellungen nicht parodieren und profanen Motiven keine Nimben verleihen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Icons are living sacred objects in Orthodox Christianity; avoid irreverent or parodic use of Christ and saint imagery, and halos on profane subjects.

styles.era_origin: Late Antiquity and Byzantium, 5th–12th century (Ravenna, Constantinople, Norman Sicily).
visual_markers: tesserae set at varied angles catching light
hieratic frontal figures with dark outlines
styles.prompt_fragment: as a Byzantine wall mosaic: glittering gold glass smalti background, tesserae set at slightly varied angles so light sparkles unevenly, rich lapis blue, imperial purple, emerald and white, solemn frontal figures with dark outlines and stylized drapery lines, curved apse surface, candlelit shimmer, missing tesserae and plaster patches
styles.avoid: Avoid flat painted gold and the muted stone palette of Roman floor mosaics; this needs reflective glass tesserae and hieratic stillness.
styles.feasibility_note: The gold glitter renders well; tessera structure on faces tends to melt into smooth paint.
styles.sensitivity_note: Tied to Christian liturgical spaces; treat sacred figures respectfully.
styles.short_de: Streng frontale Figuren vor flirrendem Grund aus Goldglas-Smalten, leicht schräg gesetzt; Wand- und Apsismosaiken in Ravenna, Konstantinopel und im normannischen Sizilien, 5.–12. Jh.
styles.short_en: Hieratic frontal figures against a glittering ground of gold glass tesserae set at uneven angles; wall and apse mosaics of Ravenna, Constantinople and Norman Sicily, 5th–12th century.
markers_en: hieratic frontal figures with dark outlines
styles.sensitivity_de: Gehört in christliche Kirchenräume; heilige Figuren respektvoll behandeln.
styles.sensitivity_en: Tied to Christian liturgical spaces; treat sacred figures with respect.

styles.era_origin: Monasteries of Ireland and Britain, c. 650–900 CE.
visual_markers: orpiment yellow, verdigris green, purple on vellum, little or no gold
styles.prompt_fragment: as an early medieval Insular illuminated manuscript page: densely packed Celtic knotwork interlace, trumpet spirals and triskeles, elongated zoomorphic creatures biting their own tails, figures reduced to flat symmetrical patterns, borders outlined with rows of tiny red lead dots, mineral pigments of orpiment yellow, verdigris green, deep purple and red on mottled vellum
styles.avoid: Avoid tattoo-style 'Celtic' clip art in black on white and gold-heavy Gothic manuscripts; Insular pages are packed edge to edge and almost goldless.
styles.feasibility_note: The motif vocabulary works, but interlace strands often fail to weave over and under consistently.
styles.sensitivity_note: Sacred Christian manuscripts; isolated ring-cross 'Celtic' emblems are also used by far-right groups, so avoid those.
styles.short_de: Dichtes Flechtwerk, Trompetenspiralen und verschlungene Tierleiber in Mineralfarben auf Pergament, gesäumt von roten Punktreihen; Buchkunst irischer und britischer Klöster, ca. 650–900.
styles.short_en: Dense knotwork interlace, trumpet spirals and interlaced beasts in mineral colours on vellum, edged with red dots; manuscript art of Irish and British monasteries, c. 650–900.
markers_en: orpiment yellow, verdigris, purple, little gold
styles.sensitivity_de: Christliche Sakralhandschriften; das isolierte keltische Ringkreuz wird auch von Rechtsextremen genutzt und sollte gemieden werden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Sacred Christian manuscripts; isolated ring-cross 'Celtic' emblems are also used by far-right groups, so avoid them.

styles.era_origin: Western Europe, c. 1000–1200 (including Ottonian precursors).
visual_markers: flat zones of earthy red, ochre, blue, green
stiff figures with oversized hands and staring eyes
banded backgrounds, arched frames, no depth
styles.prompt_fragment: as Romanesque painting of around 1100: heavy dark outlines, flat zones of earthy red, ochre, deep blue and green on plain or horizontally banded backgrounds, stiff stylized figures with oversized hands and staring eyes, drapery reduced to repeating concentric folds, no depth or cast shadow, round arched frames, matte lime-plaster or parchment surface with fading
styles.avoid: Avoid Gothic elegance, heavy gold ornament and Renaissance depth; keep the blocky, monumental, almost cartoon-like simplicity.
styles.feasibility_note: Bold outlines and flat zones are easy; the model sometimes adds unwanted shading.
styles.sensitivity_note: Mostly Christian religious context; use sacred figures respectfully.
styles.short_de: Starre Figuren mit großen Augen und übergroßen Händen, schwere Konturen, flache erdige Farbzonen ohne Raumtiefe; Wand- und Buchmalerei Westeuropas, ca. 1000–1200.
styles.short_en: Stiff figures with staring eyes and oversized hands, heavy outlines and flat earthy colour zones without depth; church murals and book painting of Western Europe, c. 1000–1200.
markers_de: flache Zonen in Rot, Ocker, Blau, Grün
starre Figuren, große Hände, starrer Blick
markers_en: flat earthy red, ochre, blue, green zones
stiff figures, oversized hands, staring eyes
banded backgrounds, round arches, no depth
styles.sensitivity_de: Überwiegend christlich-religiöser Kontext; heilige Figuren respektvoll darstellen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Mostly Christian religious context; depict sacred figures respectfully.

styles.era_origin: Western Europe, 13th–15th century.
visual_markers: raised burnished gold leaf on vellum
ivy and acanthus borders with marginal drolleries
styles.prompt_fragment: as a late Gothic illuminated manuscript page: tempera and burnished raised gold leaf on cream vellum, slender swaying figures, tiled diaper-pattern or starry blue backgrounds, an ornate historiated initial, ivy-leaf and acanthus borders populated with tiny whimsical marginal creatures, columns of blackletter script, ruled lines, slight cockling and finger-worn edges
styles.avoid: Avoid the fantasy-RPG parchment look and modern serif type; keep vellum, blackletter, diaper patterns and the flat medieval space.
styles.feasibility_note: Layout, gold and borders render well; blackletter becomes illegible pseudo-text, which works as texture but not as real copy.
styles.short_de: Schlanke Figuren, erhabenes Polimentgold, historisierte Initialen und Rankenbordüren voller Drolerien neben gotischer Schrift auf Pergament; westeuropäische Buchmalerei des 13. bis 15. Jahrhunderts.
styles.short_en: Slender figures, raised burnished gold, historiated initials and ivy borders full of marginal drolleries beside blackletter script on vellum; Western European book painting, 13th–15th century.
markers_en: raised burnished gold leaf on vellum
ivy and acanthus borders with drolleries

styles.era_origin: France and the Southern Netherlands, c. 1480–1520.
visual_markers: hundreds of small scattered flowering plants
styles.prompt_fragment: as a late Gothic millefleurs tapestry: hand-woven wool and silk with visible weft ribs and hatching, a deep blue-green or madder-red ground densely strewn with hundreds of small flowering plants, figures and animals floating flat without horizon or shadow, faded vegetable-dye palette, slightly wavy edges, frayed threads and soft woven color transitions
styles.avoid: Avoid printed-fabric smoothness and photographic depth; the weave texture and evenly scattered flowers define the look.
styles.feasibility_note: The flower field and palette are reliable; the woven texture softens to paint unless it is stressed.
styles.short_de: Flache Figuren auf dunklem Grund, übersät mit Hunderten kleiner Blütenpflanzen, gewirkt in Wolle und Seide; Bildteppiche aus Frankreich und den südlichen Niederlanden, ca. 1480–1520.
styles.short_en: Flat figures on a dark ground strewn with hundreds of small flowering plants, woven in wool and silk; tapestries from France and the Southern Netherlands, c. 1480–1520.
styles.era_en: c. 1480–1520, France and the Southern Netherlands
markers_en: hundreds of small scattered flowering plants

styles.era_origin: 14th-century Siena and Florence and the International Gothic courts, c. 1300–1425.
visual_markers: elongated graceful figures in lapis and rose
styles.prompt_fragment: as a Trecento or International Gothic altarpiece panel: egg tempera on wood with tooled and punched gold-leaf ground, pointed Gothic arch framing, graceful elongated figures in flowing lapis-blue and rose drapery, stage-like boxy architecture with inconsistent perspective, stylized stepped rocks and tiny trees, delicate hatched modelling, craquelure and worn gilding
styles.avoid: Avoid correct linear perspective and soft oil-paint blending; keep the gold, the arches and the dollhouse spatial logic.
styles.feasibility_note: Gold tooling and arch frames are reliable; the 'wrong' perspective has to be asked for explicitly.
styles.sensitivity_note: Mostly Christian devotional imagery; use sacred figures respectfully.
styles.short_de: Schlanke, anmutige Figuren in Lapisblau und Rosa unter Spitzbögen, punzierter Goldgrund und puppenstubenhafte Architektur; Tafelmalerei aus Siena und Florenz bis zum Weichen Stil, ca. 1300–1425.
styles.short_en: Elongated graceful figures in lapis and rose under pointed arches, with punched gold ground and doll's-house architecture; Sienese and Florentine altarpieces and International Gothic, c. 1300–1425.
markers_de: gelängte Figuren in Lapisblau und Rosa
markers_en: elongated figures in lapis and rose
styles.sensitivity_de: Überwiegend christliche Andachtsbilder; heilige Figuren respektvoll darstellen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Mostly Christian devotional imagery; depict sacred figures respectfully.

styles.era_origin: Florence and central Italy, c. 1420–1490.
visual_markers: clear linear perspective with tiled floors and arches
styles.prompt_fragment: as Italian Early Renaissance painting: egg tempera or fresco with clear, even daylight, pale fresh palette of rose, sage, sky blue and terracotta, crisp contours and careful linear perspective with receding tiled floors and classical arches, calm statuesque figures, portraits in strict profile, sharply detailed distant hills, matte chalky surface with fine cracks
styles.avoid: Avoid sfumato haze, dramatic chiaroscuro and golden-hour glow; the light is cool, even and descriptive.
styles.feasibility_note: Perspective architecture and the pale palette hold well.
styles.short_de: Klares, gleichmäßiges Tageslicht, helle Temperafarben, scharfe Konturen und konsequente Zentralperspektive mit Fliesenböden und Bögen; Malerei in Florenz und Mittelitalien, ca. 1420–1490.
styles.short_en: Clear even daylight, pale fresh tempera colours, crisp contours and careful linear perspective with tiled floors and arches; Florentine and central Italian painting, c. 1420–1490.
markers_de: gestochen scharfe Hügel in der Ferne
markers_en: linear perspective with tiled floors and arches

styles.era_origin: Florence and Rome, c. 1490–1527.

styles.feasibility_note: Renders easily but drifts toward generic museum pastiche; naming pyramidal grouping and blue aerial distance helps.

styles.short_en: Idealized figures in stable pyramidal groups, soft sfumato transitions and bluish aerial perspective in balanced compositions; painting in Florence and Rome, c. 1490–1527.

textures of brocade, metal and glass

styles.era_origin: Italy, c. 1520–1600, spreading to Fontainebleau and Prague.
styles.prompt_fragment: as Italian Mannerist painting: unnaturally elongated limbs and small heads, twisting serpentine poses, crowded figures compressed into shallow ambiguous space, acid shot-silk colors shifting from pink to lime and lilac to yellow, cool porcelain skin, sharp contours, theatrical gestures, smooth enamel finish with aged varnish
styles.avoid: Avoid balanced High Renaissance harmony and warm naturalism; it should feel elegant, artificial and slightly unsettling.
styles.feasibility_note: Elongation and shot colors work; the model tends to normalize proportions unless they are stressed.
styles.short_de: Gelängte Körper mit kleinen Köpfen in gedrehten Posen, schillernde Changeant-Farben und gedrängter, unklarer Raum; italienische Malerei nach der Hochrenaissance, ca. 1520–1600.
styles.short_en: Elongated bodies with small heads in twisting poses, acid shot-silk colours and crowded, ambiguous space; Italian painting after the High Renaissance, c. 1520–1600, also Fontainebleau and Prague.

styles.era_origin: Rome c. 1600 (Caravaggio), spreading to Utrecht, Naples and Spain until c. 1650.

styles.prompt_fragment: as Baroque tenebrist oil painting: figures emerging from near-black darkness under a single hard raking light from high on one side, deep warm shadows swallowing half the forms, earthy palette of umber, vermilion and ochre, unidealized ordinary faces with weathered skin, frozen dramatic moment, close half-length cropping, dark varnished canvas
styles.avoid: Avoid cinematic rim lights, teal-orange grading and smooth skin; there is one harsh, unseen light source.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable; the risk is drifting into modern 'moody portrait' photography lighting.
styles.short_de: Figuren tauchen unter hartem Seitenlicht aus fast schwarzem Dunkel auf, mit ungeschönten Gesichtern und engem Halbfigurenausschnitt; Rom um 1600, dann Neapel, Utrecht und Spanien.
styles.short_en: Figures emerging from near-black darkness under a single hard side light, with unidealized faces and close half-length cropping; Rome around 1600, spreading to Naples, Utrecht and Spain.

styles.era_origin: Antwerp and Catholic Europe, c. 1610–1680.

pearly pink flesh with blue-green half-tones

styles.avoid: Avoid static symmetry and a cool, smooth academic finish; motion, flesh and brush energy carry the style.
styles.feasibility_note: Energy and palette work; crowded figure groups produce anatomy errors.
styles.short_de: Stürmische Diagonalkompositionen mit üppigen, bewegten Körpern, perlmuttrosa Haut, wehenden karmesinroten Stoffen und cremigen Lichtern; Antwerpener Malerei der Rubenszeit, ca. 1610–1680.
styles.short_en: Surging diagonal compositions of fleshy figures in motion, pearly pink skin, billowing crimson drapery and creamy highlights; Antwerp painting of the Rubens era, c. 1610–1680.

styles.era_origin: Rome in the 17th century, spreading to Central European churches and palaces in the 18th century.

styles.prompt_fragment: as a Baroque illusionistic ceiling fresco seen from directly below: painted architecture of balustrades and columns receding upward into an open luminous sky, figures foreshortened from beneath floating on clouds, soles of feet and billowing drapery, pale blue and golden-pink heavens, gilded stucco frame around the edges, faint plaster cracks
styles.avoid: Avoid normal eye-level viewpoints; the di sotto in sù foreshortening and painted architecture are essential.
styles.feasibility_note: Upward foreshortening of many figures causes anatomy errors; fewer figures work better.
styles.short_de: Gemalte Scheinarchitektur und Wolkenfiguren in steiler Untersicht öffnen die Decke zu einem lichten Himmel; illusionistische Kirchen- und Palastdecken, Rom im 17. Jahrhundert, später ganz Mitteleuropa.
styles.short_en: Painted architecture and cloud-borne figures seen steeply from below, opening the ceiling into a luminous sky; illusionistic ceilings in 17th-century Rome, later across Central Europe.
markers_de: gemalte Balustraden und Säulen, nach oben fluchtend
markers_en: painted balustrades and columns receding upward

styles.avoid: Avoid dramatic storms and close-up figures; the scene is calm, orderly and idealized, with only small staffage figures.

styles.sensitivity_note: Salon art is full of idealized female nudes and Orientalist fantasies; avoid exoticizing stereotypes.

styles.era_origin: Paris, introduced publicly by Georges Seurat in 1886.

styles.era_origin: Pont-Aven, Brittany, 1888 (Émile Bernard, Paul Gauguin).
