dark contour lines like cloisonné enamel
styles.prompt_fragment: as Synthetist cloisonnist painting: large flat areas of bold non-naturalistic color separated by dark blue or black contour lines like cloisonné enamel, simplified rhythmic forms, no modelling or cast shadows, decorative tilted ground planes in orange, vermilion, chrome yellow and deep green, matte paint on coarse canvas, symbolic dreamlike calm
styles.avoid: Avoid comic-style cel shading and vector smoothness; the paint stays matte and brushy inside the flat fields.
styles.feasibility_note: Flat fields and outlines are reliable; the canvas texture can disappear.
styles.sensitivity_note: The movement's 'primitivist' fascination with Breton and Polynesian people carries colonial stereotypes; avoid exoticized depictions.
styles.short_de: Große flache Felder unnatürlicher Farbe, von dunklen Konturen eingefasst wie Zellenschmelz, ohne Modellierung und Schlagschatten; entstanden 1888 in Pont-Aven in der Bretagne (Bernard, Gauguin).
styles.short_en: Large flat fields of non-naturalistic colour enclosed by dark contours like cloisonné enamel, without modeling or cast shadows; Pont-Aven, Brittany, 1888 (Bernard, Gauguin).
markers_en: large flat fields of non-naturalistic colour
styles.sensitivity_de: Die „primitivistische“ Faszination der Bewegung für Bretonen und Polynesier transportiert koloniale Klischees; exotisierende Darstellungen vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: The movement's 'primitivist' fascination with Breton and Polynesian people carries colonial stereotypes; avoid exoticized depictions.

visual_markers: patterned wallpaper, fabric and clothing merging into one surface
small dabs and checks of muted color
styles.prompt_fragment: as Nabis intimist painting: flattened domestic interior where patterned wallpaper, fabrics and clothing merge into one decorative surface, small dabs and checks of muted ochre, plum, sage and dusty rose, figures as simplified flat silhouettes, steep cropping inspired by Japanese prints, matte distemper on unprimed cardboard with visible brown ground
styles.avoid: Avoid clear figure-ground separation and glossy oil depth; pattern and figure should almost camouflage each other.
styles.feasibility_note: Pattern merging works; the model tends to separate figures from background too clearly.
styles.short_de: Wohnräume, in denen Tapetenmuster, Stoffe und Kleider zu einer flachen Fläche gedämpfter Farbtupfen verschmelzen, steil angeschnitten; Pariser Künstlergruppe um Vuillard und Bonnard, ca. 1888–1900.
styles.short_en: Domestic interiors where patterned wallpaper, fabrics and clothes merge into one flat surface of muted dabs, with steep cropping; Paris group around Vuillard and Bonnard, c. 1888–1900.
markers_de: kleine Tupfen und Karos in gedämpften Farben
markers_en: patterned wallpaper, fabric and clothes merging
small dabs and checks of muted colour

styles.era_origin: France and Belgium from the 1886 Symbolist manifesto, c. 1880–1910 across Europe.
visual_markers: muted violet, teal and old gold glowing from darkness
soft hazy pastel and oil textures
styles.prompt_fragment: as fin-de-siècle Symbolist painting: dreamlike enigmatic stillness, allegorical figures with closed eyes and pale faces, twilight atmosphere, muted jewel tones of violet, teal and old gold glowing out of darkness, soft hazy pastel and oil textures, floating or isolated motifs, mysterious mythic symbolism, decorative details and gilt highlights
styles.avoid: Avoid the sharpness of fantasy illustration and heroic action; it should be mute, inward and slightly morbid.
styles.feasibility_note: Mood is easy; the model tends to sharpen it into fantasy art.
styles.short_de: Traumhaft stille Bilder allegorischer Figuren in gedämpftem Violett, Petrol und Altgold vor dunklem Grund, entstanden um 1880–1910 vor allem in Frankreich und Belgien.
styles.short_en: Dreamlike, hushed paintings of allegorical figures in muted violet, teal and gold glowing out of darkness, from the French and Belgian Symbolist movement around 1880–1910.
styles.era_de: um 1880–1910, Frankreich und Belgien, dann ganz Europa
styles.era_en: c. 1880–1910, France and Belgium, then across Europe
markers_de: gedämpftes Violett, Petrol und Altgold auf dunklem Grund
markers_en: muted violet, teal and old gold on a dark ground
soft hazy pastel and oil textures
isolated floating motifs with gilt accents

styles.era_origin: Vienna, Secession founded 1897, c. 1897–1918.
visual_markers: naturalistic faces and hands emerging from flat gold fields
dense ornament of spirals, squares, eyes
styles.prompt_fragment: as Vienna Secession painting: naturalistic faces and hands emerging from flat fields of gold and silver leaf, dense ornamental patterns of spirals, squares, eyes and circles, rectilinear geometric framing, square format, contrast between three-dimensional skin and two-dimensional decoration, accents of black, white and jewel colors, slightly raised gesso relief
styles.avoid: Avoid an all-over shiny gold filter; restrict gold to the ornament, keep faces painted, and include the rectilinear geometric structure.
styles.feasibility_note: Works well but is an AI cliché; the geometric rectilinear structure lifts it above pastiche.
styles.short_de: Naturalistisch gemalte Gesichter und Hände in flächigem Blattgold mit dichtem Spiral- und Quadratornament, aus dem Umfeld der Wiener Secession um 1897–1918.
styles.short_en: Painted faces and hands set into flat fields of gold leaf and dense spiral and square ornament, from Vienna's Secession movement around 1897–1918.
markers_de: gemalte Gesichter und Hände in flachen Blattgoldfeldern
dichtes Ornament aus Spiralen, Quadraten und Augen
markers_en: painted faces and hands in flat gold-leaf fields
dense ornament of spirals, squares and eyes

styles.era_origin: Paris, Salon d'Automne 1905, c. 1905–1910.
visual_markers: green and orange shadows on faces
styles.prompt_fragment: as Fauvist painting: wild arbitrary pure color straight from the tube, green and orange shadows on faces, red trees and violet roads, broad spontaneous brushstrokes, simplified flat forms, raw canvas left bare between strokes, clashing complementaries, light created by color contrast rather than shading
styles.avoid: Avoid psychedelic neon gradients and digital saturation; Fauve color is painterly, chalky and unblended.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable; raw canvas gaps need explicit mention.
styles.short_de: Reine, ungemischte Farben direkt aus der Tube, grüne und orange Schatten, breite Pinselstriche mit freier Leinwand dazwischen; Paris, ab dem Herbstsalon 1905 bis etwa 1910.
styles.short_en: Pure, unblended colour straight from the tube, green and orange shadows and bare canvas between broad strokes, from the Fauves in Paris around 1905–1910.
markers_de: grüne und orange Schatten im Gesicht
markers_en: green and orange shadows on faces

styles.era_origin: Dresden 1905, Berlin until 1913.
visual_markers: jagged angular forms and mask-like faces
raw hasty strokes with dark outlines
styles.prompt_fragment: as German Brücke Expressionist painting: jagged angular forms and mask-like faces, harsh acidic colors of poison green, magenta, orange and Prussian blue, raw hasty brushstrokes with dark outlines, steeply tilted perspective and compressed space, elongated nervous figures, urban anxiety or raw nature, matte unvarnished paint
styles.avoid: Avoid smooth 'emotional art' with soft gradients; edges should look hacked, colors sour and the drawing deliberately crude.
styles.feasibility_note: Angularity and acid palette work; the model sometimes softens the crudeness.
styles.sensitivity_note: Some Brücke work borrowed from African and Oceanic objects in a colonial 'primitivist' way; avoid mask stereotypes.
styles.short_de: Kantige, maskenhafte Figuren in giftigem Grün, Magenta und Orange, grob umrissen in steil gekipptem Raum; Künstlergruppe Brücke, Dresden 1905 und Berlin bis 1913.
styles.short_en: Jagged, mask-like figures in sour greens, magentas and oranges with crude dark outlines and tilted space, from the Brücke group in Dresden and Berlin, 1905–1913.
markers_de: rohe, hastige Striche mit dunklen Konturen
markers_en: raw hasty strokes with dark outlines
styles.sensitivity_de: Die Brücke übernahm teils afrikanische und ozeanische Objekte mit kolonialem, „primitivistischem“ Blick; Masken-Klischees vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Some Brücke work borrowed African and Oceanic objects in a colonial 'primitivist' way, so avoid mask stereotypes.

visual_markers: rounded rhythmic forms and crystalline facets
animals and landscapes in prismatic color planes
styles.prompt_fragment: as Blaue Reiter Expressionist painting: luminous symbolic color with deep ultramarine, sun yellow and crimson, forms simplified into rounded rhythmic shapes and crystalline facets, animals and landscapes harmonized into prismatic color planes, glowing dark contours, spiritual lyrical mood, partial dissolution toward abstraction, matte oil on canvas
styles.avoid: Avoid the harsh urban nervousness of Brücke and generic low-poly facets; color here is warm, spiritual and harmonious.
styles.feasibility_note: Easily confused with Fauvism or Brücke; naming prismatic facets and spiritual color helps.
styles.short_de: Leuchtendes, symbolisch gemeintes Ultramarin, Gelb und Karmin, Tiere und Landschaften in runden und kristallinen Farbflächen; Münchner Kreis des Blauen Reiters, 1911–1914.
styles.short_en: Luminous symbolic ultramarine, yellow and crimson, with animals and landscapes broken into rounded and crystalline colour planes, from the Munich Blue Rider circle, 1911–1914.
markers_de: runde, rhythmische Formen und kristalline Facetten
Tiere und Landschaften in prismatischen Farbflächen
markers_en: rounded rhythmic forms and crystalline facets
animals and landscapes in prismatic colour planes

styles.era_origin: Germany, c. 1905–1925.
visual_markers: wood grain printing through black areas
styles.prompt_fragment: as a German Expressionist woodcut: stark black and white with coarse gouged marks, jagged angular forms, visible wood grain printing through the black areas, uneven hand-pressed ink with blotches and gaps, crude expressive simplification, occasional second color in rust red, printed on slightly yellowed thin paper
styles.avoid: Avoid clean linocut-vector edges and gradients; keep the splinters, grain and imperfect ink.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable; wood grain in the black areas sometimes needs extra emphasis.
styles.short_de: Harter Schwarz-Weiß-Druck mit groben Hohleisenspuren, Holzmaserung in den Schwarzflächen und ungleichmäßig eingefärbtem Handabzug; deutscher Expressionismus, etwa 1905–1925.
styles.short_en: Stark black-and-white prints with coarse gouge marks, wood grain showing in the blacks and uneven hand-pressed ink, made by German Expressionists around 1905–1925.
markers_en: wood grain printing through the blacks

styles.era_origin: Paris, 1909–1912 (Picasso, Braque).
visual_markers: subject fractured into small translucent facets
grid scaffolding of short lines and arcs
a few stenciled letters, forms barely legible
styles.prompt_fragment: as Analytic Cubist painting: subject fractured into many small translucent faceted planes seen from multiple viewpoints at once, near-monochrome palette of ochre, brown, grey and muted green, grid-like scaffolding of short straight lines and arcs, shallow compressed space, small dabbed brushstrokes, a few stenciled letters, forms barely legible
styles.avoid: Avoid the colorful 'cubist portrait' cliché with a profile nose on a frontal face; Analytic Cubism is nearly monochrome and almost abstract.
styles.feasibility_note: The model often outputs a decorative synthetic-cubist face instead of true fragmentation.
styles.short_de: Motive zersplittert in kleine, transparente Facetten in fast monochromem Ocker, Braun und Grau, aus mehreren Blickwinkeln zugleich; Picasso und Braque in Paris, 1909–1912.
styles.short_en: Subjects splintered into small translucent facets in near-monochrome ochre, brown and grey, seen from several viewpoints at once; Picasso and Braque in Paris, 1909–1912.
markers_de: Motiv in kleine, transparente Facetten zerlegt
fast monochromes Ocker, Braun und Grau
Gerüst aus kurzen Linien und Bögen
markers_en: subject fractured into small translucent facets
scaffolding of short lines and arcs

visual_markers: bolder flat colors with dots and stripes
styles.prompt_fragment: as Synthetic Cubist collage-painting: flat overlapping cut-out shapes, pasted newspaper fragments, faux wood-grain and wallpaper patterns, stenciled lettering, bolder flat colors with decorative dots and stripes, simplified sign-like forms recombined from several viewpoints, sand-textured paint, visible paper edges and glue stains
styles.avoid: Avoid 3D shading and the generic AI 'cubist face'; build the image from flat interlocking planes and collage materials.
styles.feasibility_note: Collage materials render well; real compositional cubist logic is hit or miss.
styles.short_de: Flache, überlappende Ausschnittformen mit eingeklebtem Zeitungspapier, imitierter Holzmaserung, Schablonenschrift und kräftigeren Farben; Pariser Kubismus ab 1912.
styles.short_en: Flat, overlapping cut-out shapes with pasted newspaper, faux wood grain, stenciled letters and brighter colours, from Paris Cubism after 1912.
markers_en: bolder flat colours, dots and stripes

styles.era_origin: Paris, c. 1912–1914 (term coined by Apollinaire; Robert and Sonia Delaunay).
visual_markers: rhythmic concentric color discs and arcs
styles.prompt_fragment: as Orphist painting: forms dissolved into rhythmic concentric color discs and arcs, prismatic spectrum of simultaneous contrasts, vibrating complementary pairs of orange and blue, red and green, fragments of cubist planes, lyrical movement of light and color, flat matte paint with visible brushwork
styles.avoid: Avoid rainbow gradients and perfect target circles; the discs are hand-painted and segmented.
styles.feasibility_note: Concentric discs render; keeping the subject recognizable is hit or miss.
styles.short_de: Formen lösen sich in rhythmische, von Hand gemalte Farbscheiben und Bögen mit flirrenden Komplementärkontrasten auf; Robert und Sonia Delaunay, Paris, um 1912–1914.
styles.short_en: Forms dissolved into rhythmic, hand-painted colour discs and arcs of vibrating complementary contrasts, developed by Robert and Sonia Delaunay in Paris around 1912–1914.
markers_de: flirrende Paare aus Orange/Blau und Rot/Grün
markers_en: rhythmic concentric colour discs and arcs

styles.era_origin: Italy, founding manifesto 1909, main phase 1909–1916.
styles.prompt_fragment: as Italian Futurist painting: dynamism of speed shown through repeated overlapping positions of the same form, sharp force-lines and interpenetrating fragmented planes, divisionist dabs of vivid color, diagonals radiating outward, noise and motion of machines and crowds, energetic angular composition, oil on canvas
styles.avoid: Avoid photographic motion blur and sci-fi chrome; motion must be painted as repetition and fragmented planes.
styles.feasibility_note: Repetition and force-lines work; the model sometimes substitutes photographic blur.
styles.sensitivity_note: Italian Futurism glorified war and became entangled with Fascism; avoid militaristic or fascist iconography.
styles.short_de: Geschwindigkeit als wiederholte, sich überlagernde Bewegungsphasen, Kraftlinien und einander durchdringende Flächen in divisionistischen Farbtupfern; italienischer Futurismus, 1909–1916.
styles.short_en: Speed painted as repeated overlapping positions, force-lines and interpenetrating planes in divisionist dabs of colour, from the Italian Futurist movement, 1909–1916.
styles.sensitivity_de: Der italienische Futurismus verherrlichte den Krieg und verband sich mit dem Faschismus; militaristische oder faschistische Bildsprache vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Italian Futurism glorified war and became entangled with Fascism, so avoid militaristic or fascist imagery.

styles.era_origin: London, 1914–1915 (magazine BLAST).
visual_markers: black, rust, khaki and steel blue with yellow accents
styles.prompt_fragment: as British Vorticist art: hard-edged angular machine-like forms converging toward a central vortex, jagged stepped and zigzag geometry, figures reduced to armored mechanical blocks, harsh palette of black, rust, khaki and steel blue with sudden yellow accents, static yet violent tension, flat crisp paint, bold blocky sans-serif typography fragments
styles.avoid: Avoid Futurist motion repetition and soft Cubist facets; Vorticism is static, hard, mechanical and blocky.
styles.feasibility_note: Often merges with Futurism or Art Deco; stress stillness and the central vortex.
styles.short_de: Harte, maschinenhafte Blöcke und Zickzackformen, die auf einen zentralen Wirbel zulaufen, in Schwarz, Rost, Khaki und Stahlblau; Londoner Gruppe um die Zeitschrift BLAST, 1914–1915.
styles.short_en: Hard-edged, machine-like blocks and zigzags converging on a central vortex in black, rust, khaki and steel blue, from the London group around BLAST, 1914–1915.
markers_de: Schwarz, Rost, Khaki und Stahlblau mit gelben Akzenten
markers_en: black, rust, khaki and steel blue with yellow accents

styles.era_origin: Moscow/Petrograd, 1915 (Kazimir Malevich, exhibition 0,10).
visual_markers: flat black, red, ochre and blue
styles.prompt_fragment: as Russian Suprematist composition: subject reduced to pure floating geometric forms — rectangles, bars, circles and crosses — on a white or off-white ground, dynamic diagonal arrangement, flat matte colors of black, red, ochre yellow and blue, weightless overlapping planes, slightly irregular hand-painted edges and aged cracked surface
styles.avoid: Avoid modern flat-design icons and perfect vector edges; keep the white space, the diagonals and the painted, cracked surface.
styles.feasibility_note: Geometry is easy; the challenge is keeping a trace of the subject recognizable.
styles.short_de: Flache Rechtecke, Balken und Kreise in Schwarz, Rot, Ocker und Blau, die diagonal auf weißem Grund schweben; 1915 von Kasimir Malewitsch in Russland begründet.
styles.short_en: Flat black, red, ochre and blue rectangles, bars and circles floating diagonally on a white ground, founded by Kazimir Malevich in Russia in 1915.
markers_de: flaches Schwarz, Rot, Ocker und Blau
markers_en: flat black, red, ochre and blue

styles.era_origin: Netherlands, 1917–1931 (Mondrian, van Doesburg).
visual_markers: asymmetric grid of thick black orthogonal lines
rectangles of primary red, yellow, blue
styles.prompt_fragment: as De Stijl Neoplasticist composition: subject abstracted into an asymmetrical grid of thick black horizontal and vertical lines, rectangles filled with flat primary red, yellow and blue and plenty of white and light grey, strict right angles, balanced asymmetry, matte hand-painted surface with faint brushwork and slight paint cracks
styles.avoid: Avoid perfectly digital vector grids and extra colors or diagonals; keep the painted, slightly imperfect canvas.
styles.feasibility_note: Grid and palette are trivial; the hand-painted surface and subject trace need emphasis.
styles.short_de: Asymmetrisches Raster aus dicken schwarzen Waagerechten und Senkrechten mit Feldern in Rot, Gelb und Blau auf Weiß; niederländische Gruppe De Stijl, 1917–1931.
styles.short_en: Asymmetric grids of thick black horizontals and verticals with rectangles of primary red, yellow and blue on white, from the Dutch De Stijl group, 1917–1931.
markers_de: asymmetrisches Raster aus dicken schwarzen Linien
Rechtecke in Rot, Gelb und Blau
markers_en: asymmetric grid of thick black lines
rectangles of primary red, yellow and blue

styles.era_origin: Zurich 1916, then Berlin, Hanover, Paris and New York until c. 1924.
visual_markers: chaotic photomontage of cut-out photos and machine parts
mixed typography in wildly different sizes and angles
rough scissor edges and glue marks
stamps, numbers, ink blots on yellowed paper
styles.prompt_fragment: as Dada photomontage-collage: chaotic absurd assemblage of cut-out black-and-white photographs, machine parts and newspaper fragments, mixed typography of wildly different sizes and fonts set at random angles, rough scissor edges and glue marks, ironic nonsense juxtapositions, stamped numbers and ink blots, yellowed paper ground
styles.avoid: Avoid tidy modern scrapbook collage and coherent surreal scenes; Dada is aggressive, random and anti-aesthetic.
styles.feasibility_note: Collage chaos is reliable; text fragments come out as gibberish, which fits the style.
styles.sensitivity_note: Berlin Dada photomontage was explicit political satire; be careful when montaging real public figures.
styles.short_de: Chaotische Collagen aus ausgeschnittenen Fotos, Maschinenteilen und Schrift in wild wechselnden Größen, mit groben Scherenkanten und Stempeln; Dada in Zürich, Berlin und anderswo, 1916–1924.
styles.short_en: Chaotic collages of cut-out photos, machine parts and type in clashing sizes, with rough scissor edges and ink stamps, from Dada in Zurich, Berlin and beyond, 1916–1924.
styles.era_de: 1916–um 1924, Zürich, Berlin, Hannover, Paris, New York
styles.era_en: 1916–c. 1924, Zurich, Berlin, Hanover, Paris, New York
markers_de: chaotische Fotomontage aus Fotos und Maschinenteilen
Schriften in wild wechselnden Größen und Winkeln
Stempel, Ziffern und Tintenkleckse auf vergilbtem Papier
markers_en: chaotic photomontage of photos and machine parts
mixed type in wildly different sizes and angles
rough scissor edges and glue marks
stamps, numbers and ink blots on yellowed paper
styles.sensitivity_de: Die Berliner Dada-Fotomontage war offene politische Satire; bei Montagen mit realen Personen des öffentlichen Lebens zurückhaltend sein.
styles.sensitivity_en: Berlin Dada photomontage was pointed political satire; take care when montaging real public figures.

styles.era_origin: Italy (Paris and Ferrara), c. 1911–1920 (de Chirico, Carrà).
styles.prompt_fragment: as Italian metaphysical painting: deserted piazza with arcades in steep conflicting perspectives, long raking late-afternoon shadows, deep green-turquoise twilight sky, faceless mannequins and enigmatic juxtaposed objects, flat smooth paint, ochre and brick-red architecture, eerie silent melancholy and frozen time
styles.avoid: Avoid melting objects and photoreal detail; this is sparse, flat, architectural and silent.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable; conflicting perspectives may be normalized.
styles.short_de: Menschenleere Plätze mit Arkaden unter grünlichem Dämmerhimmel, lange Schlagschatten und gesichtslose Gliederpuppen; de Chirico und Carrà in Italien, etwa 1911–1920.
styles.short_en: Deserted arcaded piazzas under a green twilight sky, long raking shadows and faceless mannequins, painted by de Chirico and Carrà in Italy around 1911–1920.

styles.era_origin: Weimar Germany, c. 1919–1933; named after the 1925 Mannheim exhibition.
visual_markers: cold merciless precision, smooth glazed surface
acidic grey-green, rust and poison pink
caricatural social types in confrontational poses
styles.prompt_fragment: as Weimar New Objectivity verist painting: cold, merciless precision and smooth glazed surface, unflattering portrait detail with sallow green-pink flesh, hard outlines, flat stage-like space, acidic palette of grey-green, rust and poison pink, sharp shadows, figures as social types, uneasy confrontational frontal poses, caricatural exaggeration
styles.avoid: Avoid flattering glamour and soft lighting; it should feel clinical, critical and slightly grotesque.
styles.feasibility_note: Works well; the model tends to soften the grotesque edge unless it is named.
styles.short_de: Kalt präzise, glatt lasierte Bildnisse mit fahlem Inkarnat, harten Konturen und säuerlichen Farben, die Gesellschaftstypen der Weimarer Republik zeigen, etwa 1919–1933.
styles.short_en: Coldly precise, smoothly glazed portraits with sallow flesh, hard outlines and acidic colours, showing social types in Weimar Germany, about 1919–1933.
markers_en: acidic grey-green, rust and poison pink
caricatured social types in frontal poses

styles.era_origin: Term coined by Franz Roh in 1925 for German post-Expressionism; American variant in the 1940s.
visual_markers: isolated figures and objects in eerie stillness
shallow clean space, cool even light
styles.prompt_fragment: as Magic Realist painting: hyper-clear, cool and smooth enamel-like paint, every edge sharp, figures and objects isolated in eerie stillness, slightly too-perfect plausible reality with a subtle uncanny displacement, shallow clean space, cool even light, muted greens, slate blues and pale flesh, frozen silent atmosphere
styles.avoid: Avoid outright fantasy and melting surrealism; the strangeness must stay quiet, plausible and implied.
styles.feasibility_note: Clarity and stillness work; the uncanny note needs precise wording.
styles.short_de: Überklare, emailglatte Malerei mit isolierten Figuren und Dingen in kühlem Licht und leiser Unheimlichkeit; der Begriff stammt von Franz Roh, Deutschland 1925.
styles.short_en: Hyper-clear, enamel-smooth paintings of isolated figures and objects in cool light with a quiet uncanny shift, named by Franz Roh in Germany in 1925.
styles.era_en: from 1925, Germany; US variant in the 1940s
markers_de: isolierte Figuren und Dinge in Starre
flacher, aufgeräumter Raum, kühles gleichmäßiges Licht
markers_en: isolated figures and objects in stillness
shallow clean space, cool even light

styles.era_origin: Paris after the 1924 Surrealist manifesto, veristic branch 1920s–1940s.
visual_markers: vast empty plain to a low horizon
clear luminous sky, long hard shadows
styles.prompt_fragment: as veristic Surrealist oil painting: impossible dreamlike juxtapositions painted with meticulous academic precision, vast empty plain stretching to a low horizon, clear luminous sky, long hard shadows, objects transformed, displaced or doubled, smooth invisible brushwork, uncanny silent atmosphere, small cracks of aged varnish
styles.avoid: Avoid fantasy-poster clutter and neon dreamscapes (the generic AI 'surreal' look); keep it sparse, deadpan and painterly.
styles.feasibility_note: Easy, which is why it collapses into AI cliché; sparseness and the painterly surface are the antidote.
styles.short_de: Unmögliche Traumszenen in akademischer Präzision, auf leeren Ebenen unter klarem Himmel mit langen Schatten; der illusionistische Zweig des Pariser Surrealismus, 1920er–1940er.
styles.short_en: Impossible dream scenes painted with academic precision on empty plains under clear skies and long shadows, the illusionistic branch of Paris Surrealism, 1920s–1940s.
markers_de: weite, leere Ebene bis zum tiefen Horizont
klarer, leuchtender Himmel, lange harte Schatten
markers_en: vast empty plain to a low horizon
clear luminous sky, long hard shadows

styles.era_origin: Paris, 1920s–1940s (automatic drawing, frottage, decalcomania).
visual_markers: flat red, blue, yellow, black accents
styles.prompt_fragment: as automatist Surrealist painting: playful biomorphic blobs and amoeba-like creatures, spontaneous automatic doodled lines, stars, eyes and crescent signs scattered over a washy ground, flat accents of red, blue, yellow and black, passages of decalcomania and frottage texture with accidental organic patterns, dreamlike hieroglyphic language
styles.avoid: Avoid photoreal veristic surrealism; here the subject dissolves into signs, blobs and textures.
styles.feasibility_note: Biomorphic signs render well; decalcomania and frottage often look like generic grunge.
styles.short_de: Verspielte biomorphe Formen, automatisch gekritzelte Linien, Sterne und Augen, dazu Décalcomanie- und Frottage-Strukturen; der abstrakte Zweig des Pariser Surrealismus, 1920er–1940er.
styles.short_en: Playful biomorphic blobs, doodled automatic lines, stars and eyes, with decalcomania and frottage textures, from the automatist branch of Paris Surrealism, 1920s–1940s.
markers_de: Zeichen aus Sternen, Augen und Mondsicheln
flache Akzente in Rot, Blau, Gelb und Schwarz
markers_en: flat red, blue, yellow and black accents

styles.era_origin: France and Europe, c. 1920–1935.
visual_markers: polished metallic sheen on skin and fabric
steel grey, emerald and deep red
skyscrapers or machines in the background
styles.prompt_fragment: as Art Deco painting: sleek tubular figures with smooth sculpted volumes, polished metallic sheen on skin and fabric, sharp geometric drapery folds, cool steel grey, emerald and deep red, stylized glossy hair, angular skyscrapers or machines in the background, glamorous detached elegance, crisp edges and lacquer-smooth surface
styles.avoid: Avoid generic gold-and-black Deco wallpaper patterns; this is painterly volume with cool machine-age gloss.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable; it can drift toward glossy AI fashion illustration.
styles.short_de: Glatte, röhrenhafte Figuren mit metallischem Glanz, scharf gebrochenen Gewandfalten und Wolkenkratzern im Hintergrund, in Stahlgrau, Smaragd und Rot; europäisches Art déco, 1920–1935.
styles.short_en: Sleek, tubular figures with polished metallic sheen, sharp geometric drapery and skyscraper backdrops in steel grey, emerald and red, from 1920s–1930s European Art Deco.
markers_de: metallischer Glanz auf Haut und Stoff
markers_en: polished metallic sheen on skin and fabric
steel grey, emerald and deep red
skyscrapers or machines in the background

styles.era_origin: United States, c. 1915–1940s.
visual_markers: industrial forms reduced to clean geometric planes
flat cool light with transparent ray facets
styles.prompt_fragment: as American Precisionist painting: industrial and architectural forms reduced to crisp clean geometric planes, razor-sharp edges, smooth surfaces with no visible brushwork, flat cool light with occasional transparent ray-like facets, clear blue sky, restrained palette of greys, whites, brick red and steel blue, emptied of people, orderly machine-age calm
styles.avoid: Avoid grimy industrial realism and dramatic lighting; it is immaculate, clean and geometric.
styles.feasibility_note: Clean geometry is reliable; scenes with people need special handling.
styles.short_de: Fabriken, Silos und Stadtbauten als klare geometrische Flächen mit messerscharfen Kanten, ohne Pinselspur und ohne Menschen; US-amerikanische Malerei, etwa 1915 bis in die 1940er.
styles.short_en: Factories, silos and city buildings reduced to crisp geometric planes with razor-sharp edges, no brushwork and no people, from American painting around 1915–1940s.
markers_de: kühles, flaches Licht mit transparenten Strahlenfacetten
markers_en: industrial forms as clean geometric planes
flat cool light with transparent ray facets

styles.era_origin: US Midwest, 1930s.
visual_markers: patterned crop rows and lollipop trees
smooth tempera and oil glaze finish
styles.prompt_fragment: as 1930s American Regionalist painting: rural scenes with rhythmically rolling, rounded hills and patterned crop rows, lollipop-like trees, sculptural simplified figures with elongated sinuous limbs, clear bright daylight, smooth egg-tempera and oil-glaze finish, ochre, sage, cornflower blue and barn red, nostalgic hard-edged storytelling
styles.avoid: Avoid cozy greeting-card Americana and soft lighting; the forms are stylized, sculpted and rhythmic.
styles.feasibility_note: Rolling-hill stylization works well.
styles.short_de: Ländliche Szenen aus dem Mittleren Westen mit runden, wogenden Hügeln, gemusterten Ackerreihen, kugeligen Bäumen und plastischen Figuren in hellem Tageslicht; USA, 1930er.
styles.short_en: Rural Midwest scenes with rolling rounded hills, patterned crop rows, lollipop trees and sculpted figures in bright daylight, from 1930s American Regionalism.
markers_en: patterned crop rows and lollipop trees

styles.era_origin: United States, c. 1920–1950.
visual_markers: solitary figures in diners, offices, hotel rooms
hard geometric wedges of light on walls
muted greens, ochres and brick reds
styles.prompt_fragment: as mid-century American Scene realist painting: solitary figures in diners, offices, hotel rooms or empty streets, hard geometric wedges of sunlight or electric light across walls, simplified flat planes of color, muted greens, ochres and brick reds, emotional distance and silent melancholy, cinematic voyeuristic framing, matte oil with quiet visible brushwork
styles.avoid: Avoid nostalgic diner kitsch and neon gloss; the mood is emptiness, stillness and stark light.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable; light wedges and flat planes are easy.
styles.short_de: Einsame Figuren in Diners, Büros und Hotelzimmern, harte Lichtkeile auf vereinfachten Farbflächen, stille Melancholie; amerikanischer Realismus der 1920er bis 1950er.
styles.short_en: Solitary figures in diners, offices and hotel rooms, cut by hard wedges of light across simplified colour planes, from American realist painting around 1920–1950.
markers_de: einsame Figuren in Diners, Büros, Hotelzimmern
markers_en: solitary figures in diners, offices, hotel rooms
muted greens, ochres and brick reds

styles.era_origin: Harlem, New York, c. 1920–1935 (Aaron Douglas and contemporaries).
visual_markers: concentric translucent rings and rays of light
layered tonal bands of one hue (violet, indigo, ochre, jade)
styles.prompt_fragment: as Harlem Renaissance modernist painting: figures as stylized flat silhouettes in profile, concentric translucent rings and rays of light radiating across the scene, layered tonal bands of a single hue in violet, indigo, ochre or jade, Art Deco and Cubist geometry, rhythmic jazz-age movement, smooth matte gouache surface
styles.avoid: Avoid caricatured or exoticized features and generic 'tribal' patterns; elegant, dignified silhouettes are central.
styles.feasibility_note: The concentric light rings work; prompt for dignified stylization to avoid stereotyped renderings.
styles.sensitivity_note: Rooted in Black American cultural history; avoid caricature or minstrel imagery, and do not strip the style of its cultural context.
styles.short_de: Flache Profilsilhouetten, durchzogen von konzentrischen, transparenten Lichtringen in gestuften Tönen einer Farbe; Bildkunst der Harlem Renaissance in New York, um 1920–1935.
styles.short_en: Flat profile silhouettes crossed by concentric translucent rings of light, in layered bands of a single hue, from the visual art of the Harlem Renaissance, c. 1920–1935.
markers_de: Geometrie aus Art déco und Kubismus
markers_en: concentric translucent rings and rays of light
layered tonal bands of one hue
styles.sensitivity_de: Wurzelt in der Kulturgeschichte des Schwarzen Amerika; Karikaturen und Minstrel-Bilder vermeiden und den kulturellen Kontext wahren.
styles.sensitivity_en: Rooted in Black American cultural history; avoid caricature or minstrel imagery and keep the style's cultural context.

styles.era_origin: United States and Europe, 1930s (Great Depression, Federal Art Project).
visual_markers: working people at labor or waiting
muted khaki, rust, slate and dusty blue
matte tempera or casein mural surface
styles.prompt_fragment: as 1930s Social Realist painting: working people at labor or waiting in lines, monumental simplified sculptural figures, muted earthy palette of khaki, rust, slate and dusty blue, strong outlines and flattened space, documentary seriousness with social critique, mural-scale composition, matte egg tempera or casein surface
styles.avoid: Avoid heroic glorification and a glossy finish (that is Socialist Realism); this is sober, empathetic and critical.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable; tone can tip into heroic propaganda unless 'critical' and 'sober' are stated.
styles.sensitivity_note: Political art tradition; depictions of poverty and labor should avoid exploitation.
styles.short_de: Arbeitende und Wartende als monumentale, vereinfachte Figuren in gedämpftem Khaki, Rost und Schiefergrau; sozialkritische Malerei und Wandbilder der Weltwirtschaftskrise, 1930er.
styles.short_en: Working people at labor or in breadlines as monumental, simplified figures in muted khaki, rust and slate, from Depression-era painting and murals of the 1930s.
markers_de: Arbeitende bei der Arbeit oder in Warteschlangen
gedämpftes Khaki, Rost, Schiefer und Staubblau
markers_en: working people at labor or waiting
muted khaki, rust, slate and dusty blue
styles.sensitivity_de: Politische Kunsttradition; Armut und Arbeit darstellen, ohne die gezeigten Menschen vorzuführen.
styles.sensitivity_en: A political art tradition; depict poverty and labor without exploiting the people shown.

styles.era_origin: Mexico, from 1921 into the 1950s (Rivera, Orozco, Siqueiros).
visual_markers: terracotta, maize yellow, deep green, indigo
styles.prompt_fragment: as Mexican Muralist fresco: monumental rounded sculptural figures packed into a dense narrative panorama, bold simplified volumes with strong outlines, earthy terracotta, maize yellow, deep green and indigo with vivid accents, machines and crowds interwoven, sweeping epic composition on a wall, matte buon-fresco plaster surface
styles.avoid: Avoid tourist 'Mexican' clichés like sombreros and papel picado; the style is epic, political and sculptural.
styles.feasibility_note: Rounded volumes and fresco surface work; dense narratives get muddled with too many figures.
styles.sensitivity_note: Explicitly political and tied to Mexican national and Indigenous identity; avoid stereotypes and decontextualized use of Indigenous imagery.
styles.short_de: Monumentale, rundplastische Figuren in dicht erzählten Panoramen aus Terrakotta, Maisgelb und Indigo auf Freskoputz; mexikanische Wandmalereibewegung der 1920er bis 1950er.
styles.short_en: Monumental, rounded figures packed into dense narrative panoramas in terracotta, maize yellow and indigo on fresco plaster, from Mexico's mural movement, 1920s–1950s.
markers_de: Terrakotta, Maisgelb, tiefes Grün und Indigo
markers_en: terracotta, maize yellow, deep green and indigo
styles.sensitivity_de: Ausdrücklich politisch und eng mit mexikanischer und indigener Identität verbunden; Klischees und aus dem Zusammenhang gerissene indigene Motive vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Explicitly political and tied to Mexican national and Indigenous identity; avoid stereotypes and decontextualized Indigenous imagery.

styles.era_origin: Soviet Union from 1932/1934, Eastern Bloc into the 1980s.
visual_markers: heroic idealized workers with upward gazes
red accents of banners and scarves
styles.prompt_fragment: as Socialist Realist oil painting: heroic idealized workers and farmers with optimistic upward gazes, low viewpoint making figures monumental, bright sunlit open skies, abundant fields, factories and machines, red accents of banners and scarves, academic naturalistic technique with loose confident brushwork, triumphant forward-looking mood
styles.avoid: Avoid ironic pop pastiche and grim realism; it is earnest, sunny, monumental and academically painted.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable; it tends to add real political symbols unless excluded.
styles.sensitivity_note: State propaganda style of the USSR and Eastern Bloc; avoid political symbols, leader cults and any endorsement of totalitarian messages.
styles.short_de: Heroisch idealisierte Arbeiter und Bauern in Untersicht unter sonnigem Himmel, mit Feldern, Fabriken und roten Fahnen; sowjetische Staatskunst ab 1934, im Ostblock bis in die 1980er.
styles.short_en: Heroic, idealized workers and farmers seen from below under sunny skies amid fields, factories and red banners, the Soviet state style from 1934 into the 1980s.
markers_de: heroisch idealisierte Arbeiter mit erhobenem Blick
rote Akzente durch Fahnen und Tücher
markers_en: heroic idealized workers with upward gazes
red accents of banners and scarves
styles.sensitivity_de: Propagandastil der Sowjetunion und des Ostblocks; politische Symbole, Personenkult und totalitäre Botschaften vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Official propaganda style of the USSR and Eastern Bloc; avoid political symbols, leader cults and endorsing totalitarian messages.

styles.era_origin: New York, 1940s–1950s, with parallel European Art Informel and Tachisme.
visual_markers: drips, splatters, poured skeins of enamel
styles.prompt_fragment: as Abstract Expressionist action painting: the subject only hinted at beneath a storm of large sweeping gestural brushstrokes, drips, splatters and poured skeins of enamel paint, all-over composition without a focal point, raw unprimed canvas showing, thick and thin passages, scraped and wiped areas, physical energy and spontaneity
styles.avoid: Avoid decorative pastel 'abstract wall art' and evenly distributed splatter texture; the gestures need scale, weight and urgency.
styles.feasibility_note: Abstraction is easy; keeping the motif faintly legible needs explicit instruction.
styles.short_de: Große, ausholende Gesten, Tropfspuren und gegossene Farbschlieren über die ganze rohe Leinwand ohne Bildzentrum; New Yorker Abstrakter Expressionismus der 1940er und 1950er.
styles.short_en: Large sweeping gestures, drips and poured skeins of paint spread all over raw canvas without a focal point, from New York Abstract Expressionism of the 1940s–1950s.

styles.era_origin: New York, late 1940s–1960s.
visual_markers: thin paint soaked into raw canvas
styles.prompt_fragment: as Color Field painting: the subject reduced to a few vast soft-edged fields or stained bands of luminous color, thin paint soaked into raw cotton canvas, hazy feathered borders where colors meet, minimal incident, meditative stillness, immersive scale, subtle variations of saturation within each field
styles.avoid: Avoid digital gradients and detailed objects; the motif may survive only as a faint silhouette or color relationship.
styles.feasibility_note: The model tends to reintroduce the full subject; describe the motif as reduced to color areas.
styles.short_de: Wenige große, weich begrenzte Farbfelder aus dünner, in die rohe Leinwand eingesogener Farbe mit verschwimmenden Rändern; New Yorker Malerei, späte 1940er bis 1960er.
styles.short_en: A few vast, soft-edged fields of thin colour soaked into raw canvas, with hazy borders and little incident, from New York, late 1940s to 1960s.
markers_de: dünne, in rohe Leinwand eingesogene Farbe
markers_en: thin paint soaked into raw canvas

styles.era_origin: Copenhagen, Brussels and Amsterdam, 1948–1951.
visual_markers: childlike fantastical creatures with staring eyes
thick raw paint in wild primaries and acid colors
styles.prompt_fragment: as CoBrA painting: spontaneous childlike fantastical figures and creatures with big staring eyes, crude bold outlines scrawled in black, thick raw paint in wild primary and acid colors, scratched and smeared surface, folk and children's drawing influences, joyful aggressive energy, flattened space
styles.avoid: Avoid cute cartoon mascots and clean outlines; it should look raw, fast and anarchic.
styles.feasibility_note: The model tends to tidy up the crudeness; ask for scratched, smeared paint.
styles.short_de: Kindlich-fantastische Wesen mit starren Augen, schwarz hingekritzelten Umrissen und dicker, roher Farbe in wilden Tönen; Gruppe CoBrA aus Kopenhagen, Brüssel und Amsterdam, 1948–1951.
styles.short_en: Childlike fantastical creatures with staring eyes, scrawled black outlines and thick raw paint in wild colours, from the CoBrA group of Copenhagen, Brussels and Amsterdam, 1948–1951.
markers_de: dicke, rohe Farbe in Grund- und Säurefarben
markers_en: thick raw paint in wild primaries and acid colours

styles.era_origin: United States, early 1960s.
styles.prompt_fragment: as 1960s comic-strip Pop Art painting: a single enlarged comic panel, thick black outlines, flat primary red, yellow and blue, skin and backgrounds filled with large evenly spaced Ben-Day dots, melodramatic close-up framing, optional speech balloon, mechanical deadpan finish of a printed image blown up on canvas
styles.avoid: Avoid modern superhero comic rendering with gradients and dynamic inking; keep the mechanical, flattened, ironic look.
styles.feasibility_note: Dots hold at large size; balloon text may be misspelled.
styles.sensitivity_note: Closely tied to specific artist estates and appropriated comic panels; do not recreate known panels or use comic publisher logos.
styles.short_de: Ein einzelnes, auf Leinwandgröße vergrößertes Comicpanel mit dicken schwarzen Konturen, flachen Grundfarben und großen Ben-Day-Punkten; amerikanische Pop-Art der frühen 1960er.
styles.short_en: A single comic panel blown up on canvas with thick black outlines, flat primaries and large Ben-Day dots, from American Pop Art of the early 1960s.
markers_en: flat primary red, yellow and blue
styles.sensitivity_de: Eng mit bestimmten Künstlernachlässen und angeeigneten Comicpanels verknüpft; keine bekannten Panels nachbauen, keine Verlagslogos verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Closely tied to specific artist estates and appropriated comic panels; do not recreate known panels or use publisher logos.

styles.era_origin: New York, early 1960s.
visual_markers: high-contrast photo reduced to flat black
styles.prompt_fragment: as 1960s Pop Art silkscreen print: high-contrast photographic image reduced to flat black halftone, garish flat color blocks of hot pink, turquoise, orange and lime laid slightly off-register beneath the black, uneven ink coverage and squeegee streaks, optionally repeated in a grid of variations, deadpan consumer-culture coolness
styles.avoid: Avoid neon gradients and smooth posterize filters; misregistration, ink skips and flat blocks are essential.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable; grid repeats may vary unintentionally in pose.
styles.sensitivity_note: Strongly associated with one artist estate; avoid real celebrities and branded consumer packaging.
styles.short_de: Kontrastreiche Fotos, auf flaches Schwarz reduziert, über grellen, versetzt gedruckten Farbflächen mit Rakelschlieren, oft im Raster wiederholt; New Yorker Pop-Art der frühen 1960er.
styles.short_en: High-contrast photos reduced to flat black over garish, off-register colour blocks with streaky ink, often repeated in grids, from New York Pop Art of the early 1960s.
markers_en: high-contrast photo reduced to flat black
styles.sensitivity_de: Stark mit dem Nachlass eines einzelnen Künstlers verbunden; keine realen Prominenten und keine Markenverpackungen verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Strongly associated with one artist's estate; avoid real celebrities and branded consumer packaging.

styles.era_origin: Europe and USA, 1960s (MoMA exhibition 'The Responsive Eye', 1965).
visual_markers: precise high-contrast stripes, checkers, concentric lines
styles.prompt_fragment: as 1960s Op Art: subject constructed from precise high-contrast black-and-white or complementary stripes, checkers and concentric lines, warped grids that create illusory bulges and depressions, vibrating moiré and optical flicker, hard flawless edges, flat matte acrylic, mathematical rigor
styles.avoid: Avoid psychedelic swirls and soft gradients; the illusion must come solely from precise geometric repetition.
styles.feasibility_note: Patterns render, but geometry drifts and lines merge; perfect moiré is unreliable.
styles.short_de: Präzise Streifen, Schachbretter und konzentrische Linien in Schwarz-Weiß oder Komplementärfarben, verzerrt zu scheinbaren Wölbungen und Flimmern; optische Kunst der 1960er in Europa und den USA.
styles.short_en: Precise black-and-white or complementary stripes, checks and concentric lines warped into illusory bulges and flicker, from 1960s optical art in Europe and the US.
markers_de: präzise kontrastreiche Streifen, Schachbretter, konzentrische Linien
markers_en: precise high-contrast stripes, checks, concentric lines

styles.era_origin: California and New York, late 1950s–1960s.
visual_markers: few crisp-edged flat unmodulated color areas
styles.prompt_fragment: as Hard-Edge painting: the subject reduced to a few crisp-edged flat areas of unmodulated color, razor-sharp boundaries, no visible brushwork or texture variation within fields, bold simple geometry and silhouettes, two to four saturated or subtly related colors, extreme economy, matte acrylic on large canvas
styles.avoid: Avoid trendy flat-vector illustration with drop shadows and many details; it is radically reduced, matte and painting-scaled.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable; the model may add unwanted detail or gradients.
styles.short_de: Wenige flache, ungebrochene Farbflächen mit messerscharfen Grenzen, ohne sichtbaren Pinselstrich und mit nur zwei bis vier Farben; Kalifornien und New York, späte 1950er–1960er.
styles.short_en: A few flat, unmodulated colour areas meeting at razor-sharp edges, with no visible brushwork and only two to four colours, from California and New York, late 1950s–1960s.

styles.era_origin: United States, late 1960s–1970s.
visual_markers: deadpan everyday scene from a snapshot
complex reflections in chrome and glass
styles.prompt_fragment: as 1970s Photorealist painting: deadpan everyday scene copied from a snapshot, everything in equally sharp focus, complex mirror reflections in chrome, glass and car paint, flat midday light, slightly faded 1970s photographic color, airbrush-smooth acrylic, subtle painterly giveaways at close inspection, cool neutral emotional distance
styles.avoid: Avoid glossy HDR 'hyper-detailed' AI rendering and shallow bokeh; the look is flat, evenly sharp and 1970s-colored.
styles.feasibility_note: Photographic detail is easy; avoiding generic AI gloss is the hard part, so stress 1970s color and deadpan framing.
styles.short_de: Alltagsszenen nach Schnappschüssen, überall gleich scharf, mit Spiegelungen in Chrom und Glas und blassen 1970er-Farben, glatt in Acryl gemalt; USA, späte 1960er–1970er.
styles.short_en: Everyday scenes copied from snapshots with equal sharpness throughout, chrome and glass reflections and faded 1970s colour, painted in smooth acrylic in the US, late 1960s–1970s.
markers_en: deadpan everyday scene from a snapshot

styles.era_origin: Vienna, from 1946, prominent from the late 1950s.
visual_markers: visionary dream scenes in Old Master mixed technique
styles.prompt_fragment: as Viennese Fantastic Realist painting: visionary dreamlike scenes rendered in Old Master mixed technique of egg tempera and oil glazes, jewel-like glowing colors, densely ornamented microscopic detail, crystalline and organic forms intertwining, mythic and esoteric symbolism, polished enamel surface, luminous underpainting shining through
styles.avoid: Avoid digital fantasy gloss and airbrushed sci-fi; the detail must feel hand-glazed in Old Master technique.
styles.feasibility_note: Detail is easy; it risks reading as generic fantasy art.
styles.short_de: Visionäre Traumszenen in altmeisterlicher Mischtechnik mit edelsteinhaft leuchtenden Lasuren, mikroskopisch feinem Ornament und esoterischer Symbolik; Wiener Schule, gegründet 1946.
styles.short_en: Visionary dream scenes in Old Master mixed technique, with jewel-like glazes, microscopic ornament and esoteric symbols, from the Vienna School founded in 1946.
markers_en: visionary scenes in Old Master mixed technique

styles.era_origin: Germany, Italy and the USA, late 1970s–1980s.
visual_markers: violent rapid brushwork on large raw canvas
thick impasto, drips and muddy passages
straw, sand or tar embedded in paint
styles.prompt_fragment: as 1980s Neo-Expressionist painting: large raw canvas with violent, rapid brushwork, crude deliberately clumsy figures, thick impasto and drips, aggressive clashing colors with muddy passages, scrawled lines, figures sometimes inverted or fragmented, mixed media like straw, sand or tar embedded in paint, unfinished rough edges
styles.avoid: Avoid polished expressive illustration; it should look urgent, ugly-beautiful and physically messy.
styles.feasibility_note: The model tends to make it too refined and coherent.
styles.short_de: Heftiger, schneller Pinselstrich, grobe Figuren, dicker Farbauftrag und Tropfspuren auf großen rohen Leinwänden, teils mit Stroh oder Sand; Deutschland, Italien und USA, späte 1970er–1980er.
styles.short_en: Violent, rapid brushwork, crude figures, thick impasto and drips on large raw canvases, sometimes with straw or sand; German, Italian and US painting, late 1970s–1980s.
markers_de: heftiger, schneller Pinselstrich auf roher Leinwand
Stroh, Sand oder Teer in der Farbe
markers_en: violent rapid brushwork on raw canvas
straw, sand or tar in the paint

styles.era_origin: France from the late 19th century (Henri Rousseau), later naive schools across Europe (e.g. Hlebine, Croatia).
visual_markers: every leaf and brick painted individually
styles.prompt_fragment: as naive art by a self-taught painter: flattened perspective and inconsistent scale, stiff frontal figures, every leaf, brick and blade of grass painted one by one with patient care, bright clear colors without atmospheric haze, sincere earnest detail, decorative symmetrical arrangement, smooth flat oil paint with naive dark outlines
styles.avoid: Avoid cute children's-book illustration and cartoon proportions; it is sincere, meticulous and earnest rather than cute.
styles.feasibility_note: The model tends to correct perspective and proportions; ask explicitly for inconsistent scale.
styles.sensitivity_note: The label 'primitive' is dated and condescending; describe the style as self-taught.
styles.short_de: Flache Perspektive, steife frontale Figuren, jedes Blatt und jeder Ziegel einzeln in klaren, hellen Farben gemalt; Malerei von Autodidakten seit Henri Rousseau, Frankreich, spätes 19. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Flattened perspective, stiff frontal figures, every leaf and brick painted singly in bright clear colours; self-taught painting since Henri Rousseau, late 19th-century France.
styles.era_de: seit dem späten 19. Jh., Frankreich, später ganz Europa
styles.era_en: since the late 19th century, France, later across Europe
markers_de: jedes Blatt und jeder Ziegel einzeln gemalt
markers_en: every leaf and brick painted individually
styles.sensitivity_de: Die Bezeichnung „primitiv“ ist veraltet und herablassend; besser von autodidaktischer Malerei sprechen.
styles.sensitivity_en: The label 'primitive' is dated and condescending; describe the style as self-taught.

styles.era_origin: Term 'Art Brut' coined by Jean Dubuffet in 1945; 'Outsider Art' by Roger Cardinal in 1972.
visual_markers: crayon, ballpoint, house paint on cardboard or scrap paper
styles.prompt_fragment: as Art Brut outsider art: obsessive dense patterning with horror vacui, every space filled with repeated marks, idiosyncratic handwritten notations, personal cosmological symbols, crayon, ballpoint and house paint on found cardboard or scrap paper, irregular proportions, intense unschooled conviction, stains, folds and torn edges
styles.avoid: Avoid the polished 'doodle art' look and tidy zentangle patterns; it should look compulsive and made from humble materials.
styles.feasibility_note: The model tends to beautify; handwriting becomes gibberish, which is acceptable here.
styles.sensitivity_note: Many outsider artists were psychiatric patients or marginalized people; avoid romanticizing mental illness or calling the style 'insane art'.
styles.short_de: Zwanghaft dichte Muster, eigenwillige Beschriftungen und private Kosmologien in Wachsmalkreide, Kugelschreiber oder Lackfarbe auf Altpapier; von Jean Dubuffet 1945 Art brut genannt.
styles.short_en: Obsessively dense patterns, idiosyncratic handwriting and private cosmologies in crayon, ballpoint or house paint on scrap paper; the art Jean Dubuffet named Art Brut in 1945.
styles.era_en: 20th century; term coined 1945 in France, 'Outsider Art' 1972
markers_de: Wachsmalkreide, Kugelschreiber, Lackfarbe auf Pappe oder Altpapier
markers_en: crayon, ballpoint, house paint on cardboard or scrap
styles.sensitivity_de: Viele Outsider-Künstler waren Psychiatriepatienten oder Ausgegrenzte; psychische Krankheit nicht romantisieren und nicht von „Irrenkunst“ sprechen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Many outsider artists were psychiatric patients or marginalized people; do not romanticize mental illness or call the style 'insane art'.

styles.era_origin: Los Angeles, late 1970s, popularized in the 1990s.
visual_markers: childhood kitsch, tattoo flash, hot-rod culture
styles.prompt_fragment: as Lowbrow Pop Surrealist painting: glossy meticulously smooth acrylic or oil, cute-creepy juxtapositions mixing childhood kitsch, vintage toys, tattoo flash and hot-rod culture, saturated candy colors against dark backgrounds, Old Master glazing applied to sugary subject matter, uncanny wide-eyed stares, ornamental painted frames and banners
styles.avoid: Avoid falling into generic glossy AI cuteness; push the unsettling narrative and the vintage kustom-culture references.
styles.feasibility_note: Easy, which makes it close to the AI default; the unsettling narrative and vintage references differentiate it.
styles.sensitivity_note: Signature motifs such as big-eyed figures are tied to identifiable living painters; do not imitate specific artists' character designs.
styles.short_de: Glänzend glatt gemalte Szenen, die Kinderkitsch, Tattoo-Flash und Hot-Rod-Kultur zu niedlich-unheimlichen Bildern verbinden; Lowbrow-Kunst aus Los Angeles seit den späten 1970ern.
styles.short_en: Glossy, meticulously smooth paintings mixing childhood kitsch, tattoo flash and hot-rod culture into cute-creepy scenes, from Los Angeles Lowbrow art of the late 1970s onward.
markers_en: childhood kitsch, tattoo flash, hot-rod culture
styles.sensitivity_de: Typische Motive wie großäugige Figuren sind mit lebenden Malern verbunden; keine Figurenentwürfe bestimmter Künstler nachahmen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Signature motifs such as big-eyed figures belong to identifiable living painters; do not imitate specific artists' character designs.

styles.era_origin: Paris in the early 1980s, worldwide since the 2000s.
visual_markers: crisp stencil edges with soft overspray
rough concrete or brick, peeling posters
styles.prompt_fragment: as stencil street art spray-painted on an urban wall: two- or three-tone cut-stencil image in black, grey and white with a single flat accent color, crisp stencil edges with soft overspray haze, paint drips running down, rough concrete or brick texture showing through, remnants of peeling posters and older tags around it
styles.avoid: Avoid clean vector posters with a fake wall texture; the spray mist, drips and wall surface must interact.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable; the wall-paint interaction sometimes looks pasted on.
styles.sensitivity_note: The look is strongly associated with one anonymous living artist; avoid imitating signature motifs or signatures.
styles.short_de: Mit der Sprühdose durch ausgeschnittene Schablonen auf Wände gebrachte Motive, meist zwei- bis dreitonig mit scharfen Kanten und Sprühnebel; entstanden Anfang der 1980er in Paris.
styles.short_en: Spray-painted images made through cut stencils on walls, mostly two or three tones with sharp edges and overspray; emerged in Paris in the early 1980s.
styles.sensitivity_de: Der Look wird stark mit einem anonymen, lebenden Street-Art-Künstler verbunden; dessen typische Motive und Signaturen nicht nachahmen.
styles.sensitivity_en: The look is closely tied to one anonymous living street artist; avoid copying signature motifs or tags.

styles.era_origin: New York subway writing culture, 1970s.
visual_markers: interlocking distorted letterforms with arrows and spikes
multiple outline layers and fill fades
aerosol texture on brick, train or concrete
styles.prompt_fragment: as spray-painted graffiti writing: interlocking, distorted letterforms with arrows, spikes and connections, multiple outline layers, fades and color-fill gradients, white highlights and 3D block shadows, cartoon character beside the piece, matte aerosol texture with slight overspray and drips, on a brick wall, train panel or concrete
styles.avoid: Avoid clean digital graffiti fonts; letters should be hand-sprayed with drips and real can control.
styles.feasibility_note: Letter structures look convincing as decoration, but legibility of specific words is unreliable.
styles.sensitivity_note: Graffiti on property is illegal in many places; avoid reproducing real crew tags.
styles.short_de: Gesprühte Schriftbilder mit ineinander verschlungenen, verzerrten Buchstaben, Pfeilen, Farbverläufen und 3D-Schatten; entwickelt von New Yorker Writern auf U-Bahn-Zügen in den 1970ern.
styles.short_en: Spray-painted lettering pieces with interlocking, distorted letters, arrows, fades and 3D shadows; developed by New York subway writers in the 1970s.
markers_de: verschlungene, verzerrte Buchstaben mit Pfeilen und Spitzen
mehrfache Outlines und Farbverläufe in der Füllung
Sprühtextur auf Ziegel, Zug oder Beton
markers_en: interlocking distorted letters with arrows and spikes
aerosol texture on brick, train or concrete
styles.sensitivity_de: Graffiti auf fremdem Eigentum ist vielerorts strafbar; keine echten Tags von Writern oder Crews nachbilden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Graffiti on other people's property is illegal in many places; do not reproduce real writers' or crews' tags.

styles.era_origin: International painting scene, 2010s–2020s.
visual_markers: loose brushwork alternating with flat areas
visible underdrawing, thin washes, raw edges
