styles.era_en: since ancient China; Europe from the 17th–18th c.
markers_en: newspaper strips showing under thin paint
matte poster paint with brush marks

styles.era_origin: European silhouette portraits from the 18th century; Swiss and German folk Scherenschnitt with symmetrical alpine scenes from the 19th century.
visual_markers: one sheet of black paper on white or cream ground
mirror symmetry from a central fold
styles.prompt_fragment: cut as a traditional Scherenschnitt from a single sheet of thin black paper mounted on cream card: everything in silhouette, figures in profile, connected lacy negative spaces, often mirror-symmetrical along a central fold, intricate ornamental borders, crisp scissor edges, no shading or colour, flat scan
styles.avoid: Avoid grey shading, gradients and disconnected floating pieces; a real paper cut stays one connected sheet.
styles.feasibility_note: The black silhouette look is reliable; single-sheet connectivity and true symmetry are often broken.
styles.short_de: Aus einem einzigen schwarzen Blatt geschnittene, auf hellen Karton geklebte Silhouetten, oft spiegelsymmetrisch mit spitzenartigen Durchbrüchen; Schattenrisse seit dem 18. Jh., Schweizer Volkskunst seit dem 19. Jh.
styles.short_en: Silhouettes cut from one black sheet on light card, often mirror-symmetrical with lacy openings; European portrait silhouettes from the 18th century, Swiss folk cuts from the 19th.
styles.era_de: seit dem 18. Jh., Europa; Schweizer Volkskunst ab dem 19. Jh.
styles.era_en: since the 18th century, Europe; Swiss folk tradition from the 19th century
markers_de: ein schwarzes Blatt auf hellem Grund
markers_en: one sheet of black paper on a light ground
mirror symmetry from a central fold

styles.era_origin: Papier collé emerged with Cubism around 1912; flat compositions of cut, hand-painted gouache paper became a mid-century modernist signature.
visual_markers: flat scissor-cut shapes from painted or coloured paper
overlaps with lifted edges and tiny glue shadows
styles.prompt_fragment: composed as a cut-paper collage: flat shapes cut by scissors from hand-painted gouache sheets and coloured papers, slightly irregular contours, overlapping pieces with faint lifted edges and tiny glue shadows, visible brush texture within each paper, bold limited palette, no rendered shading, photographed flat under even light
styles.avoid: Avoid vector-perfect edges and digital gradients; shapes must look scissor-cut with hand-painted paper texture, not like flat illustration.
styles.feasibility_note: Collage look holds well; the model sometimes adds unwanted shading or makes edges too clean.
styles.short_de: Mit der Schere aus bemaltem oder farbigem Papier geschnittene Flächen, überlappend geklebt und ohne Modellierung; vom kubistischen Papier collé 1912 bis zu den Gouache-Scherenschnitten der Jahrhundertmitte.
styles.short_en: Flat shapes cut with scissors from painted or coloured paper and glued in overlapping layers, without modelled shading; from Cubist papier collé of 1912 to mid-century gouache cut-outs.
markers_de: flache, scherengeschnittene Formen aus bemaltem Papier
markers_en: flat scissor-cut shapes of painted paper
overlaps with lifted edges and glue shadows

styles.era_origin: Déchirage is a 20th-century collage technique used in Dada and post-war abstraction; common in picture books and editorial illustration since.
visual_markers: ragged torn edges with a white fibrous rim
coloured papers mixed with magazine pages
halftone and print fragments inside pieces
styles.prompt_fragment: built as a torn-paper collage: pieces ripped by hand from coloured papers and old magazine pages, ragged edges revealing a white fibrous core, irregular organic shapes overlapping in layers, fragments of print and halftone visible within some pieces, slight curl at the edges, flat-lay photographed under soft diffuse light
styles.avoid: Avoid clean scissor or vector edges; the white torn fibre rim on every piece is the defining feature.
styles.feasibility_note: Torn white edges render well; text fragments on magazine pieces become gibberish.
styles.short_de: Von Hand gerissene Stücke aus Buntpapier und Zeitschriftenseiten, geschichtet, mit ausgefransten weißen Faserkanten; im Dadaismus ab 1916, später in Bilderbuch und Editorial-Illustration verbreitet.
styles.short_en: Hand-torn pieces of coloured paper and magazine pages layered with ragged white fibrous edges; used in Dada from 1916, later common in picture books and editorial illustration.
markers_en: ragged torn edges with a white fibrous rim
coloured papers mixed with magazine pages

styles.era_origin: Developed by Berlin Dada around 1918-1919 and Soviet Constructivists in the 1920s; revived in punk zines and editorial design.
visual_markers: cut-out black-and-white photos at clashing scales
flat red and black paper shapes
styles.prompt_fragment: assembled as a hand-made photomontage: cut-out black-and-white halftone photographs combined at clashing scales, hard scissor edges, flat red and black printed paper shapes, fragments of letterpress type, strong diagonals, visible paper grain, glue wrinkles and slight misregistration, scanned flat on yellowed paper
styles.avoid: Avoid seamless digital compositing and photographic blending; joins must stay visible as cut paper edges.
styles.feasibility_note: Collage aesthetics render well; typographic fragments may be nonsense text.
styles.sensitivity_note: Strongly associated with political propaganda and anti-fascist agitation (Berlin Dada, Soviet Constructivism); avoid copying specific historical works or propaganda symbols.
styles.short_de: Ausgeschnittene Schwarzweißfotos in kontrastierenden Maßstäben, kombiniert mit Schriftfragmenten, die Schnittkanten bleiben sichtbar; entwickelt von Berliner Dadaisten um 1918 und sowjetischen Konstruktivisten in den 1920ern.
styles.short_en: Cut-out black-and-white photographs combined at clashing scales with type fragments, joins left visible; developed by Berlin Dada around 1918 and Soviet Constructivists in the 1920s.
markers_en: cut-out black-and-white photos at clashing scales
styles.sensitivity_de: Eng mit politischer Propaganda und antifaschistischer Agitation verbunden; keine konkreten historischen Werke oder Propagandasymbole kopieren.
styles.sensitivity_en: Closely tied to political propaganda and anti-fascist agitation; avoid copying specific historical works or propaganda symbols.

styles.era_origin: Rooted in Victorian commonplace books and scrapbooks; the junk-journal mixed-media look spread through social media in the 2010s.
visual_markers: layered vintage ephemera: tickets, stamps, receipts
washi tape strips and paper clips
kraft paper, ledger scraps, pressed leaves
styles.prompt_fragment: arranged as a mixed-media junk journal page: layered vintage ephemera, ticket stubs, postage stamps, kraft paper and ledger scraps, strips of washi tape, paper clips, rubber-stamp marks, handwritten notes, a few pressed leaves, slight stains and creases, photographed flat-lay on a worn notebook spread in soft daylight
styles.avoid: Avoid sterile digital scrapbook templates with perfect drop shadows; it needs physical layering, wrinkles and imperfect tape.
styles.feasibility_note: Ephemera textures render well; legible handwriting is unreliable.
styles.short_de: Notizbuchseiten, beklebt mit Tickets, Briefmarken, Packpapier, Washi-Tape, Stempelabdrucken und Handschrift, zerknittert und fleckig; Erbe viktorianischer Sammelalben, in den 2010ern über Social Media verbreitet.
styles.short_en: Notebook pages layered with tickets, stamps, kraft paper, washi tape, rubber stamps and handwriting, creased and stained; descended from Victorian scrapbooks, spread on social media in the 2010s.
styles.era_de: 19. Jh. (viktorianische Alben); Junk Journals seit den 2010ern
styles.era_en: 19th century (Victorian scrapbooks); junk journals since the 2010s
markers_en: layered vintage ephemera: tickets, stamps, receipts
kraft paper, ledger scraps, pressed leaves

styles.era_origin: Ancient textile decoration worldwide; modern thread-painting and hoop-art embroidery boomed in the 2010s craft revival.
visual_markers: raised satin-stitch fills with directional sheen
styles.prompt_fragment: stitched as hand embroidery on natural linen: satin-stitch fills with directional thread sheen, long-and-short shading, stem-stitch outlines, French knots for dots, slightly raised textured surface, visible fabric weave between stitches, a few loose thread ends, framed in a wooden embroidery hoop, soft raking light
styles.avoid: Avoid a printed-on-fabric look and smooth gradients; colour transitions must be built from visible individual stitches.
styles.feasibility_note: Stitch texture and hoop presentation are reliable; small faces and text get muddy.
styles.short_de: Bilder aus farbigem Garn auf Leinen: Plattstichflächen, Stielstichkonturen und Knötchenstiche, oft im Stickrahmen gezeigt; uraltes Handwerk, in den 2010ern als Hoop Art wiederentdeckt.
styles.short_en: Coloured thread stitched on linen in satin-stitch fills, stem-stitch outlines and French knots, often in a hoop; an ancient craft, revived as hoop art in the 2010s.
styles.era_de: seit der Antike, weltweit; Stickrahmen-Revival in den 2010ern
styles.era_en: ancient, worldwide; hoop-art revival in the 2010s
markers_en: raised satin-stitch fills with directional sheen

styles.era_origin: Machine-embroidered insignia from early 20th-century military and scouting; a fashion and merch staple since the 1970s.
visual_markers: few flat thread colours, no gradients
styles.prompt_fragment: made as a machine-embroidered patch: dense satin and fill stitching in six to eight flat thread colours, thick raised merrowed border around the outline, twill fabric visible in unstitched areas, slight puckering and thread sheen, stitch direction changes defining shapes, photographed close up on denim or plain cloth
styles.avoid: Avoid printed gradients and hand-embroidery softness; keep colours flat, stitches machine-regular and the border thick and raised.
styles.feasibility_note: Patch format and border render well; small lettering frequently breaks.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid replicating military insignia, police badges or club/brand logos.
styles.short_de: Maschinengestickte Abzeichen in wenigen flachen Garnfarben auf Köper, mit dickem, erhabenem Rand; hervorgegangen aus Militär- und Pfadfinderabzeichen des frühen 20. Jh., seit den 1970ern Modeaccessoire.
styles.short_en: Machine-stitched badges in a few flat thread colours on twill, with a thick raised border; from early 20th-century military and scout insignia, common in fashion since the 1970s.
styles.era_de: frühes 20. Jh.; seit den 1970ern Modeartikel, USA und weltweit
styles.era_en: early 20th century; fashion staple since the 1970s, USA and worldwide
markers_en: few flat thread colours, no gradients
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine Militär- oder Polizeiabzeichen und keine Vereins- oder Markenlogos nachbilden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid replicating military insignia, police badges or club and brand logos.

styles.era_origin: Counted-thread embroidery documented since the 16th century; samplers popular in the 18th-19th centuries; ironic revival in the 2010s.
visual_markers: image built from tiny X stitches on a grid
styles.prompt_fragment: worked in counted cross-stitch on white Aida cloth: every pixel a tiny X of cotton floss on a visible square grid, stepped pixel-like contours, back-stitch outlines in dark thread, limited floss palette, unstitched fabric holes showing, slight thread fuzz, framed in a wooden hoop, close-up photograph
styles.avoid: Avoid smooth embroidery fills and digital pixel art; each cell must read as a physical X stitch on fabric.
styles.feasibility_note: The overall look is reliable, but grid consistency breaks and X stitches blur into fills at larger scales.
styles.short_de: Bilder aus kleinen x-förmigen Stichen auf sichtbarem Stoffraster, mit treppenartigen Pixelkonturen und dunklen Rückstichlinien; Mustertücher seit dem 16. Jh., ironisches Revival in den 2010ern.
styles.short_en: Images built from X-shaped stitches on a visible fabric grid, with stepped pixel-like contours and dark back-stitch outlines; samplers since the 16th century, ironic revival in the 2010s.
styles.era_de: seit dem 16. Jh., Europa; Revival in den 2010ern
styles.era_en: since the 16th century, Europe; revival in the 2010s
markers_de: Bild aus winzigen Kreuzstichen im Raster
markers_en: image of tiny X stitches on a grid

styles.era_origin: Japanese reinforcing running stitch from the Edo period, practised in rural northern Japan; revived with 2010s visible mending.
visual_markers: white cotton running stitches on indigo cloth
geometric wave, hemp-leaf and interlocking-circle patterns
styles.prompt_fragment: stitched in sashiko: even white cotton running stitches forming dashed lines on deep indigo-dyed cotton, images reduced to stitched outlines over geometric background patterns of waves, hemp leaves and interlocking circles, faded and slightly patched fabric, visible needle holes, flat textile photograph in soft light
styles.avoid: Avoid filled embroidery and multicoloured threads; sashiko is line-only dashes on indigo.
styles.feasibility_note: The indigo-and-white dash look works; even stitch spacing and traditional pattern geometry are inconsistent.
styles.sensitivity_note: Japanese folk craft with named traditional patterns; avoid mislabelling random patterns as authentic and avoid 'zen' orientalism.
styles.short_de: Japanische Vorstichstickerei mit gleichmäßigen weißen Strichen auf Indigobaumwolle, oft in geometrischen Mustern; entstand im ländlichen Nordjapan, um Arbeitskleidung zu verstärken und zu flicken.
styles.short_en: Japanese running-stitch embroidery: even white dashes on indigo cotton forming geometric patterns; developed in rural northern Japan to reinforce and patch workwear.
styles.era_de: Edo-Zeit (17.–19. Jh.), Nordjapan; Revival seit den 2010ern
styles.era_en: Edo period (17th–19th c.), northern Japan; revival since the 2010s
markers_en: white running stitches on indigo cloth
geometric wave, hemp-leaf and circle patterns
styles.sensitivity_de: Japanisches Volkshandwerk mit benannten traditionellen Mustern; beliebige Muster nicht als authentisch ausgeben und keine Zen-Exotik bedienen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Japanese folk craft with named traditional patterns; do not pass off random patterns as authentic or frame it as 'zen' exotica.

styles.era_origin: Stranded colourwork traditions from Shetland and Scandinavia since the 19th century; popular 'cosy' texture in illustration and branding.
styles.prompt_fragment: knitted in wool colourwork: the image formed by rows of visible V-shaped stockinette stitches, stepped colour changes like a knitting chart, soft fuzzy wool halo, slight stretch and uneven tension, ribbed border edges, three to six yarn colours, flat textile close-up in soft daylight
styles.avoid: Avoid smooth printed fabric and photographic detail; resolution is limited to one colour per stitch.
styles.feasibility_note: Knit texture renders well; stitch-accurate images and readable text are unreliable.
styles.short_de: Bild aus Reihen V-förmiger Maschen in wenigen Garnfarben wie bei Fair-Isle- und Norwegerpullovern; in Illustration und Branding als gemütliche Textur beliebt.
styles.short_en: Image built from rows of V-shaped knit stitches in a few yarn colours, as in Fair Isle and Norwegian sweaters; a popular cosy texture in illustration.
styles.era_de: seit dem 19. Jh., Shetland und Skandinavien
styles.era_en: since the 19th century, Shetland and Scandinavia

styles.era_origin: Japanese crocheted stuffed figures, popular worldwide since the early 2000s.
visual_markers: matte cotton yarn in solid colours
styles.prompt_fragment: crocheted as amigurumi: stuffed figures worked in tight spiral rounds of single-crochet stitches in matte cotton yarn, rounded simplified shapes, embroidered or black safety-bead eyes, sewn-on limbs with visible joins, slight yarn fuzz, solid colours, photographed on a plain surface in soft daylight
styles.avoid: Avoid smooth plush and 3D-rendered cute figures; every surface needs the crochet stitch grid.
styles.feasibility_note: Amigurumi is well represented; stitches can become too uniform and rubbery.
styles.short_de: Kleine gestopfte Häkelfiguren in festen Spiralrunden, mit vereinfachten runden Formen und Perlen- oder gestickten Augen; aus Japan, weltweit verbreitet seit Anfang der 2000er.
styles.short_en: Small stuffed figures crocheted in tight spiral rounds, with simplified rounded shapes and bead or embroidered eyes; from Japan, popular worldwide since the early 2000s.
markers_en: matte cotton yarn in solid colours

styles.era_origin: Industrial felting needles were adopted by hobby crafters from the 1980s; small wool figures became widespread in the 2000s.
visual_markers: fuzzy matte wool with stray fibres
styles.prompt_fragment: sculpted in needle-felted wool: soft dense matte forms with a fuzzy halo of stray fibres, colours blended by mixing wool roving, slight lumps and needle pock marks, no seams, tiny hand-sized figures, macro photographed on a wooden table in soft window light
styles.avoid: Avoid plush fabric with seams and glossy surfaces; it must look like compacted loose wool.
styles.feasibility_note: Fuzzy wool texture renders reliably.
styles.short_de: Kleine Figuren, bei denen lose Wolle mit Widerhakennadeln zu dichten, flauschigen, nahtlosen Formen verdichtet wird; Basteltechnik seit den 1980ern, verbreitet seit den 2000ern.
styles.short_en: Small figures sculpted by stabbing loose wool with barbed needles into dense, fuzzy, seamless forms; a hobby technique since the 1980s, widespread since the 2000s.
styles.era_de: als Basteltechnik seit den 1980ern, verbreitet seit den 2000ern
styles.era_en: craft use since the 1980s, widespread since the 2000s
markers_de: flauschige matte Wolle mit abstehenden Fasern
markers_en: fuzzy matte wool with stray fibres

styles.era_origin: Flat felt cut-out pictures in folk textiles, children's felt boards and Scandinavian craft; popular in 2010s handmade decor.
visual_markers: flat layered pieces of craft felt
styles.prompt_fragment: made from flat craft-felt appliqué: shapes cut from thick wool felt in solid colours, layered and sewn down with visible blanket and running stitches in contrasting thread, slightly fuzzy edges, buttons and beads as small details, no shading, flat-lay photograph on a felt background
styles.avoid: Avoid stuffed 3D forms and smooth vector flatness; it should be flat layered felt with visible stitches.
styles.feasibility_note: Simple shapes work well; thin lines and tiny details come out too fine for felt.
styles.short_de: Flache Bilder aus zugeschnittenem Bastelfilz, in Lagen aufgenäht mit sichtbaren Langettenstichen; verwurzelt in Volkstextilien und Kinder-Filztafeln, beliebt in der Handmade-Deko der 2010er.
styles.short_en: Flat pictures of cut craft-felt shapes, layered and sewn down with visible blanket stitches; from folk textiles and children's felt boards, popular in 2010s handmade decor.
styles.era_de: Volkstextilien und Filztafeln des 20. Jh.; Revival in den 2010ern

styles.sensitivity_note: Some woven traditions (Diné, Andean, kilim) carry cultural significance; avoid labelling generic designs as those traditions.

individual specular highlight on each bead
rows following the contours of shapes

styles.era_origin: Grew out of late 19th-century curve-stitching maths education; popular kit craft in the 1960s-70s and 2010s home decor.

styles.prompt_fragment: dyed in indigo shibori: deep indigo and white only, forms emerging from bound, folded and clamped resist patterns, soft feathered edges where the dye bled, repeating crinkled grids and spider-web rings, uneven saturation, visible cotton weave, flat textile photograph in daylight
styles.avoid: Avoid rainbow tie-dye and sharp vector shapes; contours must stay blurred and resist-dyed.
styles.feasibility_note: Abstract shibori patterns work well; figurative images come out too sharp to be credible.
styles.sensitivity_note: Japanese craft heritage; avoid generic 'zen' orientalism.

bubbles and streaks in hand-blown glass

styles.short_de: Aus Blockeis geschnitzte Figuren mit Meißelfacetten, mattierten Flächen, Luftblasen und Schmelzwasser, nachts oft farbig angestrahlt wie auf Winterfestivals in China, Japan und Russland.
styles.short_en: Carved block ice with chisel facets, frosted areas, trapped bubbles and meltwater, often lit in colour at night, as at winter festivals in China, Japan and Russia.
styles.era_de: traditionell in Russland, China, Japan; Festivals seit den 1960ern
styles.era_en: traditional in Russia, China, Japan; festivals since the 1960s
markers_de: klares und mattiertes Eis mit Meißelfacetten
markers_en: clear and frosted ice with chisel facets

styles.era_origin: Beach sand modelling as folk art; competitive sand sculpture festivals since the 1970s-80s.
visual_markers: compacted sand carved with crisp detail
styles.prompt_fragment: carved from compacted wet beach sand: grainy beige surfaces with crisp carved detail, terraced layers from the packing forms, crumbled edges and small erosion, footprints and buckets nearby, strong midday sunlight with sharp shadows, seaside or festival setting
styles.avoid: Avoid smooth stone or clay; sand must look granular and fragile.
styles.feasibility_note: Sand texture renders reliably.
styles.short_de: Aus verdichtetem nassem Sand geschnitzte Formen mit körniger Oberfläche, Stufen vom Einschalen und bröckelnden Kanten, bekannt von Strandkunst und Sandskulpturen-Festivals seit den 1970ern.
styles.short_en: Compacted wet sand carved into crisp, grainy forms with terraced packing layers and crumbling edges, from beach folk art and sand-sculpture festivals since the 1970s.
markers_en: crisp detail carved in compacted sand

styles.era_origin: Composite heads made of fruit and vegetables since the 16th century; food-styling art and edible bento art became popular online in the 2010s.
visual_markers: image composed of real recognisable ingredients
fruit, vegetables, herbs, grains as shapes and textures
styles.prompt_fragment: composed entirely from real food arranged as a flat lay: sliced fruit, vegetables, herbs, grains, bread and sauces used as shapes, lines and textures, each ingredient still recognisable, fresh moist surfaces, arranged on a plate or wooden board, overhead food-photography light
styles.avoid: Avoid painted food and ordinary food photography; the subject must be built out of ingredients.
styles.feasibility_note: Ingredient arrangement renders, but the image may collapse into a plated dish instead of reading as the motif.
styles.short_de: Bilder aus echten, erkennbaren Lebensmitteln, flach von oben arrangiert – von Arcimboldos Fruchtköpfen im 16. Jahrhundert bis zu Food Art und Bento-Motiven im Netz der 2010er.
styles.short_en: Images built from real, recognisable ingredients arranged as a flat lay, from Arcimboldo's 16th-century fruit heads to 2010s food art and character bento online.
markers_de: Obst, Gemüse, Kräuter und Körner als Formen
Flat Lay auf Teller oder Brett
markers_en: picture made of real, recognisable ingredients
fruit, vegetables, herbs and grains as shapes
flat lay on plate or board

styles.era_origin: Espresso milk-foam patterns from 1980s-90s Italian and Seattle coffee culture; free-pour and etching competitions since the 2000s.
visual_markers: soft poured shapes with feathered edges
styles.prompt_fragment: drawn as latte art: white milk microfoam on rich brown espresso crema in a round ceramic cup seen from above, soft poured shapes with feathered edges, fine etched lines pulled with a pin, tiny bubbles, slightly drifting outline, café table and saucer around
styles.avoid: Avoid sharp cartoon drawings in foam; contours should stay soft and fluid like poured milk.
styles.feasibility_note: Cup framing is reliable; detailed motifs look implausibly sharp for real foam.
styles.short_de: Muster aus weißem Milchschaum, in die Crema eines Espressos gegossen oder mit dem Stäbchen gezogen; entstanden in Italien und in Seattles Cafés der 1980er und 1990er.
styles.short_en: Patterns of white milk microfoam poured or etched onto espresso crema, developed in Italy and 1980s–90s Seattle coffee bars, now a barista competition discipline.
markers_de: weich gegossene Formen mit gefiederten Rändern
feine, mit der Nadel gezogene Linien
markers_en: soft poured shapes with feathered edges

styles.era_origin: Rolled sugarpaste decorating from British celebration cakes; sculpted novelty cakes boomed with 2000s TV baking shows.
visual_markers: smooth matte sugarpaste with soft rounded edges
styles.prompt_fragment: sculpted as a fondant cake: smooth matte sugarpaste covering soft rounded forms, pastel colours, piped royal-icing details, edible pearl-dust shimmer, slight elephant-skin cracks and cornstarch dusting, a cake board and a cut slice revealing sponge layers, bakery studio lighting
styles.avoid: Avoid plastic toy surfaces; show it is edible with sponge, icing and sugar dust.
styles.feasibility_note: Fondant look renders reliably.
styles.short_de: Plastisch geformte Torten mit glattem, mattem Fondantüberzug, Pastellfarben und Spritzglasur, verwurzelt in britischen Festtagstorten und populär geworden durch Backshows der 2000er.
styles.short_en: Cakes sculpted and covered in smooth matte sugarpaste with pastel colours and piped icing, rooted in British celebration cakes and popularised by 2000s TV baking shows.
markers_de: glatter, matter Fondant mit runden Kanten
markers_en: smooth matte sugarpaste with rounded edges
cake board and cut sponge layers

styles.era_origin: Victorian herbarium and pressed-flower pictures; Japanese oshibana as a recognised art form.
visual_markers: flattened real petals, leaves and stems
translucent faded colours with slight browning
styles.prompt_fragment: composed from real pressed flowers and leaves: paper-thin dried petals with visible veins, translucent faded colours with slight browning, stems and grasses used as lines, arranged flat on cream cotton paper, tiny glue specks, framed under glass, photographed in diffuse daylight
styles.avoid: Avoid fresh 3D flowers and painted botanical illustration; everything must be flattened real plant material.
styles.feasibility_note: Pressed texture reads well; complex motifs drift toward illustration.
styles.short_de: Bilder aus echten, flach gepressten Blüten, Blättern und Stängeln mit verblassten, durchscheinenden Farben, bekannt aus viktorianischen Alben und der japanischen Oshibana-Kunst.
styles.short_en: Pictures composed of real flattened petals, leaves and stems with faded translucent colours, known from Victorian pressed-flower albums and Japanese oshibana.
markers_de: flach gepresste echte Blüten, Blätter, Stängel
verblasste, durchscheinende Farben mit leichter Bräunung
markers_en: flattened real petals, leaves and stems
faded translucent colours with slight browning

styles.era_origin: Land Art / Earth Art movement from the late 1960s in the USA and UK; today a widespread ephemeral outdoor practice.
visual_markers: leaves, pebbles, sticks, petals arranged outdoors
forest floor, riverbank or beach setting
styles.prompt_fragment: arranged outdoors with natural materials only: fallen leaves sorted by colour into gradients, pebbles, sticks, petals, ice or sand laid on a forest floor, riverbank or beach, nothing glued, slightly imperfect placement, documentary photograph from above or eye level in soft overcast light
styles.avoid: Avoid man-made materials and digital glow; the work must look found, ephemeral and site-specific.
styles.feasibility_note: Natural arrangements render; figurative motifs come out too neat and illustrative.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid naming or copying signature works of living land artists.
styles.short_de: Arrangements aus Laub, Steinen, Zweigen oder Eis, vor Ort belassen und fotografiert; hervorgegangen aus der Land Art der späten 1960er in den USA und Großbritannien.
styles.short_en: Outdoor arrangements of leaves, stones, sticks or ice left on site and photographed, descended from the Land Art movement of the late 1960s in the USA and Britain.
styles.era_de: seit Ende der 1960er, USA und Großbritannien
styles.era_en: since the late 1960s, USA and UK
markers_de: Laub, Kiesel, Zweige und Blüten im Freien gelegt
markers_en: leaves, pebbles, sticks and petals arranged outdoors
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine lebenden Land-Art-Künstler nennen und keine ihrer bekannten Arbeiten kopieren.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not name or copy signature works of living land artists.

styles.era_origin: Neon gas-discharge signage from the 1910s, defining urban nights from the 1930s to the 1960s.
visual_markers: hand-bent glass tubes tracing continuous outlines
styles.prompt_fragment: formed as a hand-bent glass neon sign: continuous glowing gas tubes tracing simplified outlines, soft halo bloom on a dark brick wall, blacked-out tube sections where lines cross, visible electrodes, clear mounting clips and cables, slight unevenness in brightness, night photography
styles.avoid: Avoid generic synthwave neon glow on everything; neon only exists as physical tubes with mounts and connections.
styles.feasibility_note: Very well learned; it drifts into a generic cyberpunk palette unless tube hardware is emphasised.
styles.short_de: Von Hand gebogene Glasröhren, in denen Neongas leuchtet und durchgehende Konturen zeichnet; 1910 erstmals in Paris gezeigt, prägend für Großstadtnächte der 1920er bis 1960er.
styles.short_en: Hand-bent glass tubes glowing with neon gas and tracing continuous outlines, first shown in Paris in 1910 and typical of city nights from the 1920s to 1960s.
markers_en: hand-bent glass tubes tracing continuous lines

styles.era_origin: Emerged with flat design and digital-first magazines around 2012-2015 and dominated web and editorial publishing through the 2010s.
visual_markers: Conceptual visual metaphor using negative space
styles.prompt_fragment: rendered as a flat editorial vector illustration: solid shapes with no outlines, a restricted palette of four to five muted colors on an off-white ground, simplified geometric forms, clever use of negative space, no gradients or shading, crisp edges, slightly asymmetric layout with generous margins, conceptual magazine spot-illustration feel
styles.avoid: Avoid glossy gradients, drop shadows and 3D bevels, and keep figures from turning into the rubbery, big-limbed Corporate Memphis people.
styles.feasibility_note: Flat shapes and limited palettes render cleanly; the model sometimes sneaks in soft gradients or drop shadows.
styles.short_de: Vektorillustration aus konturlosen Farbflächen in vier bis fünf gedämpften Tönen, mit Bildmetaphern und Negativraum – typisch für digitale Magazine der 2010er.
styles.short_en: Vector illustration of solid outline-free shapes in four or five muted colours, built on visual metaphors and negative space, typical of 2010s digital magazines.

styles.era_origin: Popularized by Facebook's 2017 'Alegria' illustration system made by the studio Buck; the label 'Corporate Memphis' spread around 2020 once the style had saturated tech marketing.
visual_markers: Rubbery elongated limbs with tiny heads
Non-naturalistic skin colors such as purple or blue
Flat bright colors on white, no outlines
Floating blobs and simple geometric plants
styles.prompt_fragment: in the Corporate Memphis tech-illustration style: flat vector figures with disproportionately long rubbery limbs and tiny heads, non-naturalistic skin colors such as purple or blue, bright saturated colors on white, no outlines, simple geometric plants and floating abstract blobs, cheerful generic poses, clean landing-page composition
styles.avoid: Don't add texture, grain or realistic proportions; this is the deliberately generic baseline and serves as the contrast example.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders reliably because it is close to what models produce by default when asked for a 'flat illustration of people'.
styles.sensitivity_note: Originated in Facebook/Meta's Alegria system; don't name the company or reproduce its exact characters.
styles.short_de: Flache Vektorfiguren mit gummiartig langen Gliedmaßen, winzigen Köpfen und blauer oder lila Haut, verbreitet durch Facebooks Alegria-System von 2017, ab etwa 2020 Corporate Memphis genannt.
styles.short_en: Flat vector figures with rubbery long limbs, tiny heads and blue or purple skin, spread by Facebook's 2017 Alegria system and named Corporate Memphis around 2020.
markers_de: unnatürliche Hautfarben wie Lila oder Blau
flache, bunte Farben auf Weiß, ohne Konturen
markers_en: non-naturalistic skin colours such as purple or blue
flat bright colours on white, no outlines
styles.sensitivity_de: Stammt aus dem Alegria-System eines Social-Media-Konzerns; den Konzern nicht nennen und keine Originalfiguren nachbilden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Originated in a social-media company's Alegria system; do not name the company or reproduce its characters.

styles.era_origin: Grew from about 2017 as illustrators added grain and stipple brushes to flat vector work; ubiquitous in 2020s editorial, brand and app illustration.
visual_markers: Grain or noise shading instead of smooth gradients
Muted retro palette of teal, mustard, coral and cream
Directional light shown by grainy highlights
styles.prompt_fragment: as a 2020s grainy textured vector illustration: simplified flat shapes shaded with stippled noise and grain brushes instead of gradients, soft retro palette of dusty teal, mustard, coral and cream, subtle paper texture, slightly rounded geometric forms, light from one side shown by grainy highlights, calm editorial composition
styles.avoid: Avoid smooth airbrushed gradients and glossy highlights, which turn it back into generic digital art.
styles.feasibility_note: Grain renders well, though it sometimes becomes uniform overall noise instead of shading that follows the forms.
styles.short_de: Flache Vektorformen, die statt mit Verläufen mit Grain- und Punktpinseln schattiert sind, in staubigen Retrofarben; seit etwa 2017 verbreitet in Editorial- und Markenillustration.
styles.short_en: Flat vector shapes shaded with grain and stipple brushes instead of gradients, in dusty retro colours, common in editorial and brand illustration since about 2017.
markers_de: gedämpfte Retropalette aus Petrol, Senf, Koralle, Creme
markers_en: grain or noise shading instead of gradients
muted retro palette of teal, mustard, coral, cream

styles.era_origin: Rooted in the isometric projection codified by William Farish in 1822 and in 1980s-90s video games; a major tech and infographic trend in the 2010s.
visual_markers: 30-degree parallel projection with no vanishing point
Three consistent face tones for top, left and right
styles.prompt_fragment: as an isometric illustration: strict 30-degree axonometric projection with no vanishing points, everything built from clean blocks on an invisible grid, flat colors with three consistent tones per surface for top, left and right faces, tiny simplified figures, crisp vector edges, diorama-like cut-out base floating on a plain background
styles.avoid: Avoid perspective distortion and glossy 3D-render lighting; keep it a flat vector grid, not a toy-like 3D diorama.
styles.feasibility_note: The projection mostly holds, but exact 30-degree angles drift and the image can slip into a glossy 3D render.
styles.short_de: Vektorszenen in 30-Grad-Parallelprojektion ohne Fluchtpunkte, je Fläche ein flacher Ton; Wurzeln in technischer Zeichnung und Videospielen der 1980er, Tech-Trend der 2010er.
styles.short_en: Vector scenes in 30-degree parallel projection without vanishing points, one flat tone per face, rooted in technical drawing and 1980s games and a 2010s tech trend.
styles.era_de: Projektion seit 1822; Trend der Tech-Illustration in den 2010ern
styles.era_en: projection since 1822; tech illustration trend of the 2010s
markers_en: three consistent face tones (top, left, right)

styles.era_origin: Builds on Dada and Constructivist photomontage of the 1910s-20s; a staple of 2010s-2020s op-ed and magazine illustration.
visual_markers: Torn or scissor-cut edges with slight shadows
Two or three bold spot colors
styles.prompt_fragment: as a mixed-media editorial collage: black-and-white halftone photo cutouts combined with flat colored paper shapes, torn and scissor-cut edges, visible paper grain, overlapping layers with slight drop shadows, surreal scale shifts, a limited palette of two or three bold spot colors, scanned-print texture, conceptual opinion-page composition
styles.avoid: Avoid seamless photo compositing; every element must look cut out and layered, not blended.
styles.feasibility_note: Cut edges and halftones look convincing; keep the number of elements low so the layering stays legible.
styles.sensitivity_note: Don't use photos of identifiable real people in misleading political compositions.
styles.short_de: Collage aus ausgeschnittenen Schwarzweiß-Rasterfotos und farbigen Papierflächen mit Rissrändern und surrealen Größensprüngen, in der Tradition der Dada-Fotomontage; verbreitet auf Meinungsseiten seit den 2010ern.
styles.short_en: Collage of black-and-white halftone photo cut-outs and flat coloured paper with torn edges and surreal scale shifts, drawing on Dada photomontage; common in 2010s–2020s op-ed illustration.
markers_de: gerissene oder geschnittene Kanten mit leichtem Schatten
markers_en: torn or cut edges with slight shadows
two or three bold spot colours
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine Fotos erkennbarer realer Personen in irreführenden politischen Montagen verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not use photos of identifiable real people in misleading political compositions.

styles.era_origin: Spread across productivity and SaaS websites around 2018-2021 as a counter-trend to colorful Corporate Memphis.
visual_markers: One accent color or light gray fills
styles.prompt_fragment: as a minimal monochrome hand-drawn illustration: confident black ink lines of slightly varying weight, mostly white, sparse flat fills in a single accent color or light gray, simplified expressive faces with dots for eyes, quirky imperfect proportions, lots of empty space, friendly modern documentation-page feel, no shading
styles.avoid: Avoid full color fills and Corporate Memphis proportions; keep it mostly black line on white.
styles.feasibility_note: Simple black line art renders cleanly; keep the accent color minimal or the model fills everything in.
styles.sensitivity_note: The common alias names a software brand's illustration system; don't use the brand name or imply affiliation.
styles.short_de: Überwiegend schwarze Tuschelinien auf Weiß mit eigenwilligen Proportionen, Punktaugen und einer Akzentfarbe, verbreitet auf Websites von Produktivitäts- und Softwarefirmen um 2018–2021.
styles.short_en: Mostly black ink line drawings on white with quirky proportions, dot eyes and one accent colour, used on productivity and software websites around 2018–2021.
markers_en: one accent colour or light grey fills
styles.sensitivity_de: Ein gängiger Spitzname verweist auf die Illustrationen einer Softwaremarke; den Markennamen nicht verwenden und keine Verbindung suggerieren.
styles.sensitivity_en: A common nickname refers to a software brand's illustrations; do not use the brand name or imply affiliation.

styles.era_origin: Commercial clip-art CD-ROMs and the galleries bundled with office software in the late 1980s and 1990s.
visual_markers: Flat primaries with crude linear gradients
styles.prompt_fragment: as 1990s office clip art: simple vector drawing with thick uniform black outlines, flat saturated primary colors with crude linear gradients, cartoony generic proportions, plain white background, slightly jagged edges from low-resolution rasterization, cheerful cliché poses, early desktop-publishing look
styles.avoid: Avoid modern polish, soft shadows and refined shapes; it should feel crude and dated.
styles.feasibility_note: The model tends to over-polish; stress crude gradients and low resolution.
styles.sensitivity_note: Associated with the clip galleries of specific office suites; don't reference those products or reproduce known clip-art pieces.
styles.short_de: Grobe Vektorzeichnungen mit dicken schwarzen Konturen, Grundfarben und plumpen Verläufen, wie sie auf Clipart-CD-ROMs und in Office-Programmen der 1990er mitgeliefert wurden.
styles.short_en: Crude vector drawings with thick black outlines, flat primaries and clumsy gradients, sold on clip-art CD-ROMs and bundled with office software in the 1990s.
markers_de: leicht gezackte Kanten in niedriger Auflösung
markers_en: flat primaries with crude linear gradients
styles.sensitivity_de: Mit den Clipart-Sammlungen bestimmter Office-Pakete verbunden; diese Produkte nicht nennen und keine bekannten Cliparts nachbilden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Linked to the clip galleries of specific office suites; do not reference those products or reproduce known clip-art pieces.

styles.era_origin: Goes back to 18th-century British caricature and topographical drawing; classic in British picture books, cartoons and editorial work through the 20th century.
visual_markers: Scratchy nib line with varying weight
Transparent washes spilling over the lines
styles.prompt_fragment: as a line-and-wash illustration: loose scratchy pen-and-ink drawing with nib variation, transparent watercolor washes laid in freely and not always within the lines, white paper left for highlights, blooms and pooled pigment edges, quick gestural energy, sparse backgrounds dissolving into white, British picture-book and editorial-cartoon tradition
styles.avoid: Avoid tight photoreal watercolor and fully painted backgrounds; the ink line should lead.
styles.feasibility_note: Holds well; asking for less detail keeps the line loose.
styles.sensitivity_note: Several defining practitioners are still alive; don't name them.
styles.short_de: Lockere, kratzige Federlinie mit transparenten Aquarelllasuren, die über die Konturen laufen, und ausgespartem Papierweiß; britische Tradition von der Karikatur des 18. Jahrhunderts bis zum Bilderbuch.
styles.short_en: Loose, scratchy pen line with transparent watercolour washes spilling over it and white paper left open, a British tradition from 18th-century caricature to picture books.
markers_de: transparente Lasuren über die Linien hinaus
markers_en: scratchy nib line with varying weight
styles.sensitivity_de: Mehrere prägende Vertreter leben noch; sie nicht namentlich nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Several defining practitioners are still alive; do not name them.

styles.era_origin: Developed in American and European picture books from the 1960s onward.
visual_markers: Shapes cut from hand-painted textured papers
Brush, sponge and comb textures inside each shape
styles.prompt_fragment: as a painted-paper collage: shapes cut from hand-painted tissue papers with visible brushstroke, sponge and comb textures, layered and glued with slightly translucent overlaps, bold saturated colors on a white background, simple chunky forms, no outlines except occasional crayon marks, handmade picture-book look, scanned flat
styles.avoid: Avoid smooth flat vector fills; every shape needs its own painted texture.
styles.feasibility_note: Painted textures and cut edges render well; without explicit texture cues it falls back to flat vector fills.
styles.sensitivity_note: Strongly associated with a famous late picture-book author; don't name him or copy his characters.
styles.short_de: Collage aus Formen, die aus selbst bemalten Seidenpapieren mit Pinsel- und Schwammstrukturen geschnitten sind, kräftig farbig auf Weiß; seit den 1960ern in amerikanischen und europäischen Bilderbüchern.
styles.short_en: Collage of shapes cut from hand-painted tissue papers with brush and sponge textures, bold colours on white, common in American and European picture books since the 1960s.
markers_de: Pinsel-, Schwamm- und Kammstrukturen in jeder Form
markers_en: brush, sponge and comb textures in each shape
styles.sensitivity_de: Eng mit einem bekannten verstorbenen Bilderbuchautor verbunden; ihn nicht nennen und keine seiner Figuren kopieren.
styles.sensitivity_en: Strongly linked to a famous late picture-book author; do not name him or copy his characters.

styles.era_origin: Children's books from state publishers in Czechoslovakia, Poland, the USSR and the GDR, roughly 1950s-1980s.
visual_markers: Textured gouache or tempera with lithographic grain
Earthy palette with sudden bright accents
Worn offset print on thick paper
styles.prompt_fragment: in the tradition of Eastern European picture-book illustration of the 1960s-70s: naive folk-influenced stylization, textured gouache and tempera with lithographic grain, earthy muted palette with sudden bright accents, flattened perspective, decorative patterns in clothing and landscape, whimsical elongated figures, slightly worn offset printing on thick paper
styles.avoid: Avoid the polished, warm Western 'vintage storybook' look; keep the flat perspective, grain and odd stylization.
styles.feasibility_note: The model gets the folk naivety but can blur it into generic vintage storybook art; emphasize grain and flat perspective.
styles.sensitivity_note: Associated with Soviet-bloc state publishing; keep to the visual tradition and avoid propaganda motifs and folk-costume stereotypes.
styles.short_de: Naive, volkskunstnahe Bilderbuchillustration in strukturierter Gouache mit flacher Perspektive und Ornamentik, aus Staatsverlagen der Tschechoslowakei, Polens, der UdSSR und der DDR, 1950er–80er.
styles.short_en: Naive, folk-inspired picture-book art in textured gouache with flattened perspective and decorative patterns, from state publishers in Czechoslovakia, Poland, the USSR and GDR, 1950s–80s.
markers_de: strukturierte Gouache oder Tempera mit Lithokorn
markers_en: textured gouache or tempera with litho grain
earthy palette with sudden bright accents
worn offset print on thick paper
styles.sensitivity_de: Mit dem staatlichen Verlagswesen im Ostblock verbunden; bei der Bildtradition bleiben, keine Propagandamotive und keine Trachten-Klischees.
styles.sensitivity_en: Tied to Soviet-bloc state publishing; keep to the visual tradition and avoid propaganda motifs and folk-costume stereotypes.

styles.era_origin: Rooted in 16th-century Netherlandish panoramic painting; defined as a German picture-book genre by Ali Mitgutsch's 'Rundherum in meiner Stadt' (1968).
visual_markers: Dozens of tiny figures in simultaneous mini-stories
Clear outlines and flat bright colors
styles.prompt_fragment: as a Wimmelbild busy-scene illustration: a high-angle panoramic double-page spread crowded with dozens of tiny busy figures and simultaneous mini-stories, every corner filled with detail, clear black outlines, flat bright colors, no single focal point, consistent oblique perspective, small humorous incidents, children's board-book print quality
styles.avoid: Avoid a central hero composition and cinematic depth of field; everything must be equally sharp and busy.
styles.feasibility_note: Tiny figures repeat or turn to mush; limit the scope or crop to one section.
styles.short_de: Panorama aus erhöhter Sicht voller winziger Figuren und gleichzeitiger Kleingeschichten ohne Bildzentrum; deutsches Bilderbuchgenre seit Ali Mitgutschs „Rundherum in meiner Stadt“ von 1968.
styles.short_en: High-angle panorama crowded with tiny figures in simultaneous mini-stories and no focal point, a German picture-book genre since Ali Mitgutsch's 1968 'Rundherum in meiner Stadt'.
styles.era_de: seit 1968, Deutschland (Wurzeln in der niederländischen Malerei des 16. Jh.)
markers_de: dicht gefülltes Panorama aus erhöhter Sicht
markers_en: dozens of tiny figures in mini-stories
clear outlines and flat bright colours

styles.era_origin: Coloring books from around 1880; an adult coloring book boom around 2015.
styles.prompt_fragment: as a coloring book page: clean closed black outlines of uniform medium weight on pure white, no shading, no fills, no gray tones, clearly separated areas ready to be colored in, simplified details, generous spacing between lines, crisp printable line art
styles.avoid: Avoid hatching, gradients and any color; the lines must form closed regions.
styles.feasibility_note: Clean line art renders reliably; stray gray shading occasionally appears.
styles.short_de: Geschlossene schwarze Konturen in gleichmäßiger Strichstärke auf Weiß, ohne Schattierung und Füllung, zum Ausmalen; Malbücher für Kinder seit etwa 1880, für Erwachsene als Boom um 2015.
styles.short_en: Closed black outlines of even weight on white with no shading or fill, made to be coloured in; children's colouring books since about 1880, adult boom around 2015.
styles.era_en: since c. 1880, USA; adult boom c. 2015

styles.era_origin: The Zentangle method was created in the USA around 2004; 'zendoodle' became the generic term.
visual_markers: Repetitive structured patterns such as orbs, scales and grids
styles.prompt_fragment: as a zendoodle pattern drawing: black fine-tip pen on a small square of white paper, every area subdivided into sections filled with repetitive structured patterns such as orbs, grids, scales, waves and stripes, delicate pencil shading at section edges, high contrast, meditative intricate detail, small hand-drawn irregularities
styles.avoid: Avoid color and machine-perfect repetition; the patterns should feel hand-drawn.
styles.feasibility_note: Patterns render well, though the repetition can become machine-uniform.
styles.sensitivity_note: Zentangle is a registered trademark; 'zendoodle' is the safer generic name.
styles.short_de: Zeichnung mit feinem schwarzem Stift, deren Flächen in Felder mit sich wiederholenden, handgezeichneten Mustern geteilt sind; nach der um 2004 in den USA entwickelten Zentangle-Methode.
styles.short_en: Fine black pen drawing in which every area is divided into sections filled with repetitive hand-drawn patterns, from the Zentangle method created in the USA around 2004.
markers_en: repetitive patterns such as orbs, scales and grids
styles.sensitivity_de: Zentangle ist eine eingetragene Marke; in Prompts den Gattungsbegriff Zendoodle verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Zentangle is a registered trademark; use the generic term zendoodle in prompts.

styles.era_origin: British and French luxury gift books of about 1900-1920, within the Golden Age of Illustration (c. 1880-1920) made possible by color halftone printing.
visual_markers: Sepia pen line with gnarled, sinuous detail
Muted transparent washes in browns, olive and faded blue
styles.prompt_fragment: as a Golden Age fairy-tale book plate from around 1905-1920: fine sepia pen-and-ink drawing with sinuous gnarled lines, muted transparent watercolor washes in browns, olive greens and faded blues, tipped-in gift-book plate on cream paper, delicate decorative silhouettes, eerie whimsical atmosphere, soft aged tone
styles.avoid: Avoid saturated colors and glossy fantasy painting; keep it muted, ink-led and slightly melancholic.
styles.feasibility_note: The muted ink-and-wash look holds; the model may oversaturate.
styles.short_de: Sepiafarbene Federzeichnung mit knorrigen, geschwungenen Linien und gedämpften Lasuren, als eingeklebte Farbtafel in britischen und französischen Geschenkbüchern um 1900–1920 gedruckt.
styles.short_en: Sepia pen drawing with gnarled, sinuous lines and muted transparent washes, printed as tipped-in plates in British and French gift books of about 1900–1920.

markers_en: sepia pen line with gnarled, sinuous detail
muted washes in browns, olive and faded blue

styles.name_en: American Golden Age narrative painting (Brandywine School)
styles.era_origin: Howard Pyle and his students in Pennsylvania and Delaware, roughly 1895-1930s.
visual_markers: Earthy ochre, deep red and blue-green palette
styles.prompt_fragment: as an American Golden Age narrative illustration from around 1900-1930: oil painting on canvas with bold confident brushwork, dramatic theatrical lighting, strong value contrast, rich earthy palette of ochres, deep reds and blue-greens, heroic staging like a frozen moment from an adventure novel, printed as a full-page book plate
styles.avoid: Avoid smooth digital painting and glowing rim light; the paint should feel thick and the staging literary.
styles.feasibility_note: Oil texture is good; there is a risk of slick digital-painting polish.
styles.short_de: Pastos gemalte Ölillustrationen mit theatralischem Licht und erdigen Farben, die einen eingefrorenen Moment aus Abenteuerromanen zeigen; Howard Pyle und seine Schüler in Delaware und Pennsylvania.
styles.short_en: Thickly painted oil illustrations with theatrical light and earthy colours, staging a frozen moment from adventure fiction, by Howard Pyle and his students in Delaware and Pennsylvania.

markers_en: ochre, deep red and blue-green palette

styles.era_origin: 1890s London and Munich (the magazine 'Jugend' appeared from 1896), the high point of black-and-white line-block printing.
visual_markers: Pure black and white with no gray
Large solid black masses against thin lines
Stark asymmetry with dramatic empty space
styles.prompt_fragment: as an 1890s Art Nouveau black-and-white book illustration: pure black ink on white with no gray, large solid black masses balanced by delicate thin lines, sinuous whiplash curves, elongated stylized forms, flat decorative patterns, ornamental border frame, stark asymmetrical composition with dramatic empty space
styles.avoid: Avoid color and soft shading, and avoid drifting into the colorful Art Nouveau poster look.
styles.feasibility_note: Strong black-and-white graphics render reliably.
styles.sensitivity_note: Some 1890s originals are erotic or grotesque; keep it decorative.
styles.short_de: Reine Schwarzweiß-Strichzeichnung mit großen schwarzen Flächen, Peitschenhieblinien und ornamentalen Rahmen, als Strichätzung gedruckt im London und München der 1890er-Jahre.
styles.short_en: Pure black-and-white line drawing with large solid black masses, whiplash curves and ornamental borders, printed by line block in 1890s London and Munich.
markers_de: große schwarze Flächen neben feinen Linien
markers_en: pure black and white, no grey
large solid black masses against thin lines
styles.sensitivity_de: Manche Vorbilder aus den 1890ern sind erotisch oder grotesk; dekorativ bleiben.
styles.sensitivity_en: Some 1890s originals are erotic or grotesque; keep it decorative.

styles.era_origin: Chromolithography was patented in 1837; Victorian die-cut scraps and advertising trade cards peaked between 1870 and 1900.
visual_markers: Saturated layered litho colors with stipple grain
styles.prompt_fragment: as a Victorian chromolithograph scrap: richly saturated layered lithographic colors with fine stipple grain, sentimental idealized rendering, embossed die-cut edges with subtle relief shading, glossy varnished surface, gold accents, decorative floral framing, slightly misaligned color plates, aged trade-card paper
styles.avoid: Avoid modern smooth digital color and photographic realism; keep the stipple grain and embossed cut-out edges.
styles.feasibility_note: Rich colors work; the embossing and stipple grain are often smoothed away.
styles.sensitivity_note: Period trade cards often carried racist caricatures; don't reproduce them.
styles.short_de: Geprägte, ausgestanzte Chromolithografien mit Glanzlack und Goldakzenten, auf Bögen durch kleine Stege verbunden; um 1880–1910 in Deutschland, Österreich und England viel gesammelt.
styles.short_en: Embossed, die-cut chromolithographed figures with glossy varnish and gold accents, sold in sheets joined by small paper tabs; collected in Britain, Germany and Austria around 1880–1910.
markers_en: saturated layered litho colours with stipple grain
styles.sensitivity_de: Zeitgenössische Sammelbilder zeigten teils rassistische Karikaturen; diese nicht nachbilden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Period scraps and trade cards sometimes carried racist caricatures; do not reproduce them.

styles.era_origin: American pulp fiction magazines, peaking in the 1930s-40s.
styles.prompt_fragment: as a 1930s-40s pulp magazine cover painting: lurid saturated oils, high-drama action frozen at its peak, exaggerated expressions, hard theatrical lighting with deep shadows, garish complementary colors such as red against green, cheap pulp-paper printing with coarse color reproduction, space reserved for a bold masthead and tagline
styles.avoid: Avoid modern cinematic digital painting with teal-orange grading; keep it coarse, garish and printed.
styles.feasibility_note: Dramatic oil look and cover layout work well; masthead text may need correction.
styles.sensitivity_note: Historic pulp covers often contained sexist damsel-in-distress tropes and racist villains; don't reproduce them.
styles.short_de: Reißerische Ölbilder mit Actionszenen auf dem Höhepunkt, hartem Licht und grellen Komplementärfarben, grob gedruckt auf Titeln amerikanischer Pulp-Magazine der 1930er und 1940er.
styles.short_en: Lurid oil paintings of action at its climax with hard lighting and garish complementary colours, printed coarsely on the covers of American pulp magazines of the 1930s–40s.
styles.sensitivity_de: Historische Pulp-Cover bedienten oft sexistische Motive der bedrohten Frau und rassistische Schurkenbilder; diese nicht übernehmen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Historic pulp covers often used sexist damsel-in-distress tropes and racist villains; do not reproduce them.

styles.era_origin: American calendars, magazines and aircraft nose art of the 1930s-50s.
visual_markers: Smooth, luminous oil or gouache modeling
Vignette fading into a plain background
styles.prompt_fragment: as a 1940s-50s pin-up illustration: smooth oil or gouache painting with soft luminous modeling, idealized glamorous pose, playful situational humor, clean pastel and candy-red palette, crisp vignette fading into a plain light background, calendar-print reproduction quality
styles.avoid: Avoid photoreal skin and modern glamour-photo lighting; keep the painted calendar-print softness.
styles.feasibility_note: The rendering is easy, but content filters can block or water it down; keep it non-explicit.
styles.sensitivity_note: Rooted in sexualized depictions of women; keep it non-explicit and avoid objectification. It can also be applied to any gender, or to objects, with irony.
styles.short_de: Weich modellierte Öl- oder Gouachemalerei idealisierter, glamouröser Figuren in verspielten Situationen vor schlichtem Grund, aus amerikanischen Kalendern und Magazinen der 1930er bis 1950er.
styles.short_en: Smoothly modelled oil or gouache paintings of idealised glamorous figures in playful situations, fading into plain backgrounds, from American calendars and magazines of the 1930s–50s.

Vignette, die in schlichten Grund übergeht
markers_en: smooth, luminous oil or gouache modelling
vignette fading into a plain background
styles.sensitivity_de: Wurzelt in sexualisierten Frauenbildern; nicht explizit werden und nicht objektifizieren, gern auch ironisch auf andere Geschlechter oder Gegenstände übertragen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Rooted in sexualised images of women; keep it non-explicit and avoid objectification, or apply it ironically to any gender or to objects.

styles.era_origin: US magazine advertising, about 1945-1960.
visual_markers: Idealized figures in gouache or casein
Turquoise, coral, butter yellow and cherry red
styles.prompt_fragment: as a 1950s American advertising illustration: gouache and casein painting with idealized smiling figures, optimistic consumer-paradise mood, clean bright palette of turquoise, coral, butter yellow and cherry red, crisp edges, soft airbrushed backgrounds, magazine-page halftone printing, white space reserved for copy
styles.avoid: Avoid sepia 'vintage filter' aging and modern photoreal faces; it should feel freshly printed in 1955.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders reliably; text in ad copy may need correction.
styles.sensitivity_note: Period ads carry rigid gender roles and almost exclusively white families; choose the casting consciously.
styles.short_de: Gouache- und Kaseinmalerei mit idealisierten, lächelnden Figuren in Türkis, Koralle und Kirschrot, gemalt für Anzeigen in amerikanischen Zeitschriften von etwa 1945 bis 1960.
styles.short_en: Gouache and casein paintings of idealised smiling figures in a bright turquoise, coral and cherry-red palette, made for American magazine advertisements of about 1945–1960.
markers_de: idealisierte Figuren in Gouache oder Kasein
markers_en: idealised figures in gouache or casein
turquoise, coral, butter yellow and cherry red
styles.sensitivity_de: Zeitgenössische Anzeigen zeigen starre Geschlechterrollen und fast nur weiße Familien; die Besetzung bewusst wählen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Period ads show rigid gender roles and almost only white families; choose the casting deliberately.

styles.era_origin: Tarot decks date from 15th-century Italy; today's dominant visual template comes from an English deck published in 1909.
visual_markers: Flat muted fills in mustard, sky blue and brick red
styles.prompt_fragment: as a tarot card illustration: tall vertical card format with a thin border and a title cartouche at the bottom, bold black ink outlines, flat muted watercolor-like fills in mustard yellow, sky blue, brick red and grass green, frontal symbolic staging with emblematic objects, early-20th-century printed look on cream card
styles.avoid: Avoid dark glossy fantasy rendering and glowing mystical effects; keep it flat, emblematic and printed.
styles.feasibility_note: The card format and flat style render well; card titles may be misspelled.
styles.sensitivity_note: Tarot has spiritual meaning for practitioners; don't copy specific cards from historic decks (some later recolorings are under copyright).
styles.short_de: Hochformatige Karten mit Rahmen und Titelfeld, kräftigen Konturen und gedämpften Flachfarben; Tarot stammt aus dem Italien des 15. Jahrhunderts, die heutige Bildsprache aus einem englischen Deck von 1909.
styles.short_en: Tall bordered cards with title cartouche, bold outlines and flat muted colours in symbolic scenes; tarot began in 15th-century Italy, today's look follows a 1909 English deck.
markers_en: flat muted mustard, sky blue and brick red
styles.sensitivity_de: Tarot hat für Praktizierende spirituelle Bedeutung; keine Karten historischer Decks kopieren, manche spätere Neukolorierungen sind urheberrechtlich geschützt.
styles.sensitivity_en: Tarot has spiritual meaning for practitioners; do not copy specific cards from historic decks, as some later recolourings are still under copyright.

styles.era_origin: Developed for a US financial newspaper from 1979, imitating 19th-century engraved portraits.
visual_markers: Stipple dots combined with engraving-like lines
styles.prompt_fragment: as a hedcut illustration: black ink on white built entirely from stippled dots and fine directional engraving-like lines that follow the contours of the form, tone made by modulating dot size and spacing, no color, no gray wash, crisp newspaper-engraving precision, plain white background
styles.avoid: Avoid halftone screen patterns and photographic grayscale; dots and lines must be clearly hand-placed.
styles.feasibility_note: Dot and line patterns often turn into noise or a mechanical halftone; works best large and simple.
styles.sensitivity_note: Strongly associated with a specific financial newspaper; don't imply affiliation, and don't render real people deceptively.
styles.short_de: Kleines Schwarzweiß-Porträt aus von Hand gesetzten Punkten und stichartigen Linien, die der Form folgen; 1979 vom Wall Street Journal eingeführt.
styles.short_en: Small black-and-white portrait built from hand-placed stipple dots and engraving-like lines following the form, introduced by The Wall Street Journal in 1979.
markers_en: stipple dots combined with engraving-like lines
styles.sensitivity_de: Eng mit einer bestimmten Wirtschaftszeitung verbunden; keine Zugehörigkeit suggerieren und reale Personen nicht irreführend darstellen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Strongly linked to one financial newspaper; do not imply affiliation or render real people deceptively.

styles.era_origin: Flourished in the 17th-19th centuries with European expeditions and herbaria; continues in scientific and botanic-garden art.
visual_markers: Dissection details and cross-sections around the main subject
styles.prompt_fragment: as a scientific botanical illustration: precise watercolor over fine graphite on white paper, subject isolated on a blank background, accurate proportions, crisp edges, subtle transparent layering, small detail studies and cross-sections arranged around the main subject, discreet scale bar and Latin-style label, museum-plate clarity
styles.avoid: Avoid loose decorative 'botanical print' florals and moody backgrounds; it must read as scientific documentation.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders reliably; Latin labels may be nonsensical.
styles.short_de: Präzises Aquarell über feiner Bleistiftzeichnung, die Pflanze freigestellt auf Weiß mit Detail- und Schnittstudien; Blütezeit mit europäischen Expeditionen und Herbarien im 17. bis 19. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Precise watercolour over fine graphite showing a plant isolated on white with dissections and cross-sections, flourishing with European expeditions and herbaria of the 17th–19th centuries.
styles.era_en: 17th–19th c., Europe; practised to this day
markers_de: Detail- und Schnittstudien um das Hauptmotiv
markers_en: dissections and cross-sections around the subject

styles.era_origin: Ernst Haeckel's lithographic plates in 'Kunstformen der Natur' (1899-1904), which influenced Art Nouveau.
visual_markers: Multiple variants in radial or mirror symmetry
styles.prompt_fragment: as a symmetrical natural-history lithograph plate from around 1900: multiple variants of the subject arranged in strict radial or mirror symmetry on a dark or cream ground, ornamental Art Nouveau elegance, finely detailed lithographic shading, harmonious muted color, small numbered figures, scientific yet decorative
styles.avoid: Avoid fantasy glow and kaleidoscope effects; the variants should look like plausible specimens, not a mandala.
styles.feasibility_note: Symmetric arrangements render well; organisms may become ornamental fantasy rather than plausible species.
styles.sensitivity_note: Haeckel also promoted racial-hierarchy theories; the plate aesthetic is uncontroversial, but never apply it to human 'types'.
styles.short_de: Viele Varianten eines Organismus in strenger Radial- oder Spiegelsymmetrie mit feiner lithografischer Schattierung, nach Ernst Haeckels Tafelwerk „Kunstformen der Natur“ (1899–1904), das den Jugendstil beeinflusste.
styles.short_en: Many variants of an organism arranged in strict radial or mirror symmetry with fine lithographic shading, after Ernst Haeckel's 'Kunstformen der Natur' (1899–1904), which inspired Art Nouveau.
markers_de: viele Varianten in Radial- oder Spiegelsymmetrie
markers_en: many variants in radial or mirror symmetry
styles.sensitivity_de: Haeckel vertrat auch rassenhierarchische Theorien; der Tafelstil ist unbedenklich, aber nie auf menschliche „Typen“ anwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Haeckel also promoted racial-hierarchy theories; the plate style is unproblematic, but never apply it to human 'types'.

styles.era_origin: Modern comparative field guides, from 1934 onward.
visual_markers: Consistent scale and lighting for comparison
styles.prompt_fragment: as a field-guide plate: several variants painted in gouache and watercolor in strict side profile on a plain white or pale background, consistent scale and lighting for comparison, numbered figures with short labels and pointer lines to identifying marks, clean even rendering, no environment, tidy grid arrangement
styles.avoid: Avoid dramatic action poses and habitat backgrounds; it is a comparison sheet, not a scene.
styles.feasibility_note: Grid layouts render well; labels may be garbled and variants inconsistent.
styles.short_de: Mehrere Arten oder Varianten im strengen Seitenprofil und im gleichen Maßstab, mit Nummern und Zeigerlinien zu Bestimmungsmerkmalen, nach dem Vorbild von Roger Tory Petersons Vogelführer von 1934.
styles.short_en: Several species or variants painted in strict side profile at the same scale, with numbers and pointer lines to field marks, following Roger Tory Peterson's 1934 guide.
markers_de: gleicher Maßstab und gleiches Licht zum Vergleich
markers_en: same scale and lighting for comparison

styles.era_origin: Professionalized from 1911 with the first academic medical-illustration department at Johns Hopkins; the classic 20th-century atlas style.
visual_markers: Conventional color coding: red arteries, blue veins, yellow nerves
styles.prompt_fragment: as a modern medical illustration: clean semi-realistic rendering with soft airbrushed shading, a layered cutaway revealing internal structures, conventional color coding of red, blue and yellow for different systems, clear leader lines with labels on white, didactic textbook clarity, neutral lighting, no dramatic atmosphere
styles.avoid: Avoid glossy 3D sci-fi renders and dramatic lighting; it should look like a calm textbook plate.
styles.feasibility_note: The look renders well, but labels and anatomy can be wrong; check them before publishing.
styles.sensitivity_note: Anatomical content can trigger content filters; keep it educational, and don't present invented anatomy as fact.
styles.short_de: Halbrealistische, mit Airbrush schattierte Darstellungen mit Schichtschnitten, Farbcode in Rot, Blau und Gelb und beschrifteten Hinweislinien auf Weiß; als Beruf etabliert seit 1911 an der Johns Hopkins University.
styles.short_en: Semi-realistic airbrushed drawings with layered cutaways, red-blue-yellow colour coding and labelled leader lines on white; a profession since Johns Hopkins' first department in 1911.
styles.era_de: seit 1911, USA; klassischer Atlasstil des 20. Jh.
markers_de: Arterien rot, Venen blau, Nerven gelb
markers_en: red arteries, blue veins, yellow nerves
styles.sensitivity_de: Anatomische Inhalte können Inhaltsfilter auslösen; sachlich-lehrhaft bleiben und keine erfundene Anatomie als Tatsache ausgeben.
styles.sensitivity_en: Anatomical content can trigger content filters; keep it educational and do not present invented anatomy as fact.

styles.era_origin: From mid-19th-century reconstructions to the classic museum murals and popular books of about 1900-1970.
styles.prompt_fragment: as classic museum paleoart: naturalistic oil painting with careful reconstructed detail, the subject placed in a believable ancient environment with period-appropriate vegetation, soft hazy atmospheric perspective, earthy muted palette, calm documentary staging rather than action, slightly dated mid-20th-century natural-history-book reproduction
styles.avoid: Avoid blockbuster-movie action, roaring poses and cinematic CGI lighting.
styles.feasibility_note: Painterly naturalism renders well; anatomical plausibility varies.
styles.sensitivity_note: Older paleoart gave early humans racialized features; avoid that.
styles.short_de: Naturalistische Ölgemälde, die ausgestorbene Tiere in glaubwürdigen Urzeitlandschaften mit dunstiger Tiefe und erdigen Farben rekonstruieren, wie auf Museumswandbildern und in Sachbüchern von etwa 1900 bis 1970.
styles.short_en: Naturalistic oil paintings reconstructing extinct animals in believable ancient landscapes with hazy depth and earthy colours, as in museum murals and popular books of about 1900–1970.
styles.era_de: ca. 1900–1970, USA und Europa (Wurzeln im 19. Jh.)
styles.era_en: c. 1900–1970, USA and Europe (roots in the 19th c.)
styles.sensitivity_de: Ältere Paläokunst gab Frühmenschen rassistisch gefärbte Züge; das vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Older paleoart gave early humans racialised features; avoid that.

styles.era_origin: Mid-20th-century astronomical painting (1940s-60s) for magazines and popular-science books, continued by space-agency art programs.
visual_markers: Huge planets or moons in black skies
Hard unfiltered sunlight with sharp shadows
styles.prompt_fragment: as classic mid-20th-century space art: realistic gouache and oil rendering set under black skies with crisp starfields, a huge planet or moon on the horizon, hard unfiltered sunlight with razor-sharp shadows, plausible rugged geology, airbrushed atmospheric glows, vintage popular-science magazine reproduction
styles.avoid: Avoid modern nebula-saturated wallpaper art and lens flares; keep it sober, sharp and painted.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders well; tends to add colorful nebulae unless told not to.
styles.short_de: Realistische Gouache- und Ölbilder von Planeten und Monden unter schwarzem Sternenhimmel mit hartem Sonnenlicht, gemalt für Magazine und Sachbücher der 1940er bis 1960er.
styles.short_en: Realistic gouache and oil paintings of planets and moons under black, star-filled skies with hard sunlight, made for 1940s–60s magazines and popular-science books.
markers_de: riesige Planeten oder Monde am Horizont
markers_en: huge planets or moons on the horizon

styles.era_origin: Printed for German-speaking and other European classrooms from the mid-19th century to around the 1970s.
visual_markers: Linen backing, hanging rods and fold creases
styles.prompt_fragment: as a vintage school wall chart from 1900-1960: large lithographic print on linen-backed paper, clear didactic composition with numbered details, muted naturalistic colors, crisp outlines with soft painted modeling, legend strip along the bottom, wooden hanging rods at top and bottom, fold creases and classroom wear
styles.avoid: Avoid modern infographic flatness and glossy colors; it should feel lithographed and well used.
styles.feasibility_note: The format and aging render well; legend text is often garbled.
styles.sensitivity_note: Historic charts sometimes showed racial 'types' or colonial imagery; don't reproduce them.
styles.short_de: Lithografierte Lehrtafeln mit nummerierten Details, gedämpft naturalistischen Farben und Legendenleiste, auf Leinen mit Holzstäben, in europäischen Klassenzimmern von etwa 1850 bis 1970 genutzt.
styles.short_en: Lithographed teaching charts with numbered details, muted naturalistic colours and a legend strip on linen with wooden rods, used in European classrooms from about 1850 to 1970.
markers_en: linen backing, hanging rods and fold creases
styles.sensitivity_de: Historische Tafeln zeigten teils „Rassentypen“ oder koloniale Motive; diese nicht nachbilden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Historic charts sometimes showed racial 'types' or colonial imagery; do not reproduce them.

styles.era_origin: Industrial manuals, catalogs and service documentation throughout the 20th century.
visual_markers: Precise black line in three-quarter axonometric view
Line weights separating outer and inner edges
Minimal parallel-line or flat gray shading
styles.prompt_fragment: as a technical illustration: precise black line drawing in three-quarter axonometric view, heavier line weight for outer contours and thinner for interior edges, minimal tonal shading with parallel lines or flat gray, numbered callouts with leader lines, no background, manual-and-catalog clarity, consistent light from the upper left
styles.avoid: Avoid artistic sketchiness and photoreal rendering; keep it clean, measured and documentary.
styles.feasibility_note: Clean line art works; mechanical logic and part consistency can be off.
styles.short_de: Exakte schwarze Strichzeichnungen von Objekten in axonometrischer Ansicht, mit abgestuften Linienstärken und Positionsnummern, wie in Handbüchern, Katalogen und Wartungsunterlagen des 20. Jahrhunderts.
styles.short_en: Precise black line drawings of objects in axonometric view, with graded line weights and numbered callouts, as found in 20th-century manuals, catalogues and service documentation.
markers_en: Precise black line in three-quarter axonometric view
Heavier outer contours, thinner inner edges
Sparse parallel-line or flat grey shading

styles.era_origin: Precursors in Renaissance engineering notebooks; standard in 20th-century assembly and repair documentation from the 1940s.
visual_markers: Components floating apart along shared axes
styles.prompt_fragment: as an exploded-view technical illustration: the subject separated into its component parts floating apart along shared axes, dashed alignment lines showing how pieces fit together, consistent axonometric angle, clean line art with light flat shading, numbered part callouts, white background, engineering-manual precision
styles.avoid: Avoid dramatic perspective, motion blur and glossy product-render lighting.
styles.feasibility_note: The overall look is convincing, but parts can be inconsistent or nonsensical; simple subjects work best.
styles.short_de: Technische Zeichnung, in der die Einzelteile eines Objekts entlang ihrer Montageachsen auseinandergezogen schweben; seit Mitte des 20. Jahrhunderts Standard in Montage- und Reparaturanleitungen.
styles.short_en: Technical drawing in which an object's parts float apart along their assembly axes, linked by dashed lines; standard in assembly and repair manuals since the mid-20th century.
styles.era_de: Vorläufer in der Renaissance; Standard seit den 1940ern, technische Dokumentation
styles.era_en: Renaissance precursors; standard since the 1940s, engineering documentation
markers_en: Parts floating apart along shared axes

styles.era_origin: Formal patent-office drawing conventions since the 19th century; rules still require black ink line drawings.
visual_markers: Black line on white with uniform weight
Fine hatching and surface shading lines
Reference numerals with thin leader lines
styles.prompt_fragment: as a patent drawing: black ink line drawing on white, uniform medium line weight, fine hatching and surface-shading lines, no color, reference numerals connected by thin leader lines, 'FIG. 1' style labels, multiple orthographic or perspective views on one sheet, sparse margins, archival photocopy texture
styles.avoid: Avoid sepia 'vintage patent poster' toning and decorative fonts; real patent sheets are stark and plain.
styles.feasibility_note: The conventions are rendered convincingly; numerals may repeat or be misplaced.
styles.sensitivity_note: Don't imitate an actual granted patent or present the drawing as a real legal document.
styles.short_de: Schwarze Tuschezeichnungen auf Weiß mit feiner Schraffur, Bezugszeichen und „FIG.“-Beschriftung, nach den formalen Vorgaben der Patentämter seit dem 19. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Black ink line drawings on white with fine hatching, reference numerals and 'FIG.' labels, following the formal conventions of patent offices since the 19th century.
styles.era_de: seit dem 19. Jh., Patentämter in den USA und Europa
styles.era_en: since the 19th century, patent offices in the USA and Europe
markers_de: Schwarze Linie auf Weiß, gleichmäßige Stärke
markers_en: Black line on white, uniform weight
Reference numerals with thin leader lines
styles.sensitivity_de: Kein echtes erteiltes Patent nachahmen und die Zeichnung nicht als echtes Rechtsdokument ausgeben.
