styles.era_origin: Wordless flat-pack furniture and toy instructions from the 1970s-80s onward.
visual_markers: Clean outlines with uniform line weight
Motion arrows and magnified detail circles
Parts counts like '2x', no explanatory text
styles.prompt_fragment: as wordless assembly-instruction drawings: clean black outlines with uniform line weight, no shading, numbered step panels, arrows showing motion and direction, magnified detail circles, simple neutral figures demonstrating actions, small parts counts like '2x', white background, no explanatory text
styles.avoid: Avoid color, shading and decorative style; it must stay neutral, functional and wordless.
styles.feasibility_note: Step layouts render well, but step logic can be inconsistent from panel to panel.
styles.sensitivity_note: Widely associated with a Swedish furniture retailer; don't use its name, typography or logo.
styles.short_de: Textlose Schritt-für-Schritt-Strichzeichnungen mit nummerierten Feldern, Pfeilen, Detaillupen und neutralen Figuren, wie sie seit den 1970er/80er-Jahren Möbelbausätzen und Spielzeug beiliegen.
styles.short_en: Wordless step-by-step line drawings with numbered panels, arrows, magnified details and neutral figures, as used in flat-pack furniture and toy instructions since the 1970s–80s.

styles.sensitivity_de: Stark mit einem schwedischen Möbelhändler verbunden; dessen Namen, Schrift und Logo nicht verwenden.

styles.era_origin: Beaux-Arts and competition presentation drawings of the 19th-20th centuries; continues in hand-drawn architectural presentation.
visual_markers: Loose transparent washes for sky and materials
Sketchy human figures and trees around the building
styles.prompt_fragment: as an architectural watercolor rendering: precise pencil perspective underdrawing with ruled lines, loose transparent watercolor washes for sky and materials, white paper left for light, soft violet-gray cast shadows, sketchy figures and trees, unfinished vignetted edges fading into white, competition-presentation charm
styles.avoid: Avoid photoreal CGI and fully filled, edge-to-edge painting; let the ruled lines and white paper show.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders reliably; ruled lines sometimes wobble or the perspective bends.
styles.short_de: Mit dem Lineal gezogene Bleistiftperspektiven von Gebäuden, locker und transparent aquarelliert, mit ausgespartem Papierweiß und violettgrauen Schatten; Präsentationstechnik der Beaux-Arts- und Wettbewerbszeichnung.
styles.short_en: Ruled pencil perspectives of buildings washed with loose transparent watercolor, white paper for light and violet-grey shadows, as in Beaux-Arts and competition presentations of the 19th–20th centuries.
styles.era_de: 19.–20. Jh., Beaux-Arts- und Wettbewerbszeichnungen, Europa und USA
styles.era_en: 19th–20th centuries, Beaux-Arts and competition drawings, Europe and USA
markers_de: Lockere, transparente Lasuren für Himmel und Material
Skizzenhafte Figuren und Bäume, auslaufende Ränder
markers_en: Loose transparent washes for sky and materials
Sketchy figures and trees, vignetted edges

styles.era_origin: European architecture practices of the 2010s, reacting against photoreal CGI renders.
visual_markers: Pasted-in cut-out photo figures and plants
styles.prompt_fragment: as a post-digital architectural collage: flat orthographic or one-point perspective view, large flat color fields in soft pastel tones, paper-like textures, cut-out photographic figures and plants pasted in, no realistic lighting or cast shadows, painterly art-historical references, deadpan quiet atmosphere, deliberately naive flatness
styles.avoid: Avoid photoreal rendering, lens effects and dramatic sky lighting; flatness is the point.
styles.feasibility_note: Flat fields and cut-out figures render well; figures may come out painted instead of photographic.
styles.short_de: Flache Architekturansichten aus pastelligen Farbflächen und eingeklebten Fotofiguren, ohne realistisches Licht; eine europäische Gegenbewegung der 2010er-Jahre zum fotorealistischen Rendering.
styles.short_en: Flat architectural views built from pastel colour fields and pasted-in cut-out photo figures, without realistic light; a 2010s European counter-trend to photoreal renderings.
markers_en: Pasted-in cut-out photo figures and plants

styles.era_origin: European copperplate cartography of the 16th-18th centuries.
visual_markers: Hand-colored outline borders in soft green, pink and yellow
Ornate cartouche and compass rose with rhumb lines
Ships and sea creatures in empty areas
Aged, foxed paper with a fold line
styles.prompt_fragment: as an antique engraved map of the 16th-18th century: copperplate line engraving with hand-colored outline borders in soft greens, pinks and yellows, stippled seas with wave lines, ornate title cartouche, compass rose and rhumb lines, sailing ships and sea creatures in empty areas, aged foxed paper with a central fold
styles.avoid: Avoid the coffee-stained parchment fantasy-map cliché with burnt edges; keep the engraving crisp and the coloring delicate.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable look; lettering and coastlines are invented.
styles.sensitivity_note: Historic maps carry colonial naming and imagery; be careful with depictions of Indigenous peoples in cartouches.
styles.short_de: In Kupfer gestochene Landkarten mit handkolorierten Grenzlinien, prunkvollen Kartuschen, Windrosen und Seeungeheuern auf vergilbtem Papier, wie in europäischen Atlanten des 16. bis 18. Jahrhunderts.
styles.short_en: Copperplate-engraved maps with hand-coloured borders, ornate cartouches, compass roses and sea monsters on aged paper, as published in European atlases of the 16th–18th centuries.
markers_de: Handkolorierte Grenzen in Grün, Rosa und Gelb
Schiffe und Seeungeheuer auf leeren Flächen
markers_en: Hand-coloured borders in green, pink and yellow
Ornate cartouche, compass rose and rhumb lines
Ships and sea creatures in empty areas
Foxed paper with a centre fold
styles.sensitivity_de: Alte Karten transportieren koloniale Ortsnamen und Bildmotive; Darstellungen indigener Menschen in Kartuschen mit Vorsicht behandeln.
styles.sensitivity_en: Historic maps carry colonial place names and imagery; take care with depictions of Indigenous peoples in cartouches.

styles.era_origin: Fashion design sketches throughout the 20th century; a high point in 1950s-80s magazine illustration.
visual_markers: Loose marker or watercolor fills leaving white
Emphasis on drape, texture and silhouette
styles.prompt_fragment: as a fashion illustration: elongated nine-head croquis proportions, confident gestural pencil and ink contours, loose marker or watercolor fills that leave white paper showing, emphasis on fabric drape, texture and silhouette, face barely suggested, dynamic runway stance, generous empty background, designer sketchbook page feel
styles.avoid: Avoid photoreal faces, fully rendered backgrounds and the glossy beauty-portrait look.
styles.feasibility_note: Elongated gestural figures render well; the model may over-render the face.
styles.sensitivity_note: Extreme elongation can reinforce unhealthy body ideals; vary body types where possible.
styles.short_de: Überlange Modefiguren in schwungvoller Bleistift- und Tuschelinie mit lockerer Marker- oder Aquarellfüllung, wie aus Entwurfsskizzenbüchern und Modemagazinen des 20. Jahrhunderts.
styles.short_en: Elongated fashion figures drawn with gestural pencil and ink and loose marker or watercolor fills, from designers' sketchbooks and fashion magazines of the 20th century.
styles.era_de: 20. Jh. bis heute; Blütezeit in Modemagazinen 1910er–1950er, Paris und New York
styles.era_en: 20th century to today; magazine heyday 1910s–1950s, Paris and New York
markers_de: Lockere Marker- oder Aquarellflächen mit Papierweiß
Fokus auf Faltenwurf, Stoff und Silhouette
markers_en: Loose marker or watercolor fills leaving white
Focus on drape, texture and silhouette
styles.sensitivity_de: Extreme Streckung kann ungesunde Körperideale verstärken; wo möglich unterschiedliche Körperformen zeigen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Extreme elongation can reinforce unhealthy body ideals; vary body types where possible.

styles.era_origin: Developed in American animation studios in the early 1930s; standard in film and advertising since.
visual_markers: Quick gray marker and pencil rendering
Shot framing varying from wide to close-up
styles.prompt_fragment: as a storyboard sheet: a sequence of rectangular panels in a grid on white paper, quick gray marker and pencil rendering with loose gestural lines, camera framing changing from wide shot to close-up, motion arrows and camera-move notes, scene and shot numbers, short handwritten action notes under each panel
styles.avoid: Avoid finished full-color comic panels; it should look like fast working sketches.
styles.feasibility_note: Panel layouts work; character consistency across panels and the notes' text may drift.
styles.short_de: Raster aus schnell skizzierten Bleistift- und Graumarker-Bildern, die Einstellungen und Kamerabewegungen planen; Anfang der 1930er in US-Trickfilmstudios entstanden, heute Standard in Film und Werbung.
styles.short_en: Grids of quick pencil and grey-marker panels planning shots and camera moves; developed in US animation studios in the early 1930s, now standard in film and advertising.
styles.era_en: since the early 1930s, US animation studios
markers_de: Wechselnde Einstellungsgrößen von Totale bis Nahaufnahme
markers_en: Quick grey marker and pencil rendering
Framing from wide shot to close-up

styles.era_origin: Film and video game pre-production; digital speed painting has dominated since the 2000s.
styles.prompt_fragment: as digital concept art: painterly speed painting with large textured brush strokes, strong value grouping, cinematic wide composition, atmospheric perspective, dramatic rim lighting, a saturated accent color against desaturated surroundings, loose unfinished edges, production-design keyframe feel
styles.avoid: This is close to the default AI look; push visible brush marks and unfinished edges, and avoid teal-orange grading and glow on everything.
styles.feasibility_note: Trivial for the model; the hard part is making it look like anything other than default AI art.
styles.short_de: Lockere digitale Malerei mit breiten, texturierten Pinselstrichen, klaren Helligkeitsgruppen und filmischem Licht, mit der seit den 2000ern der Look von Filmen und Games entwickelt wird.
styles.short_en: Loose digital paintings with broad textured strokes, strong value groups and cinematic light, used since the 2000s to develop the look of films and video games.
styles.era_de: seit den 2000ern, Film- und Game-Vorproduktion, international
styles.era_en: since the 2000s, film and game pre-production, international

styles.era_origin: Glass matte paintings in early-1900s cinema; digital since the 1990s.
styles.prompt_fragment: as a cinematic matte painting: photoreal digital painting extending the scene into a vast environment, epic scale, seamless photographic textures, volumetric light shafts, layered atmospheric haze, ultra-wide framing, carefully matched perspective and lighting, film-production polish
styles.avoid: This is essentially the generic AI epic look; use it only as contrast or add a period cue such as a visible glass-painting brush edge.
styles.feasibility_note: The model's default comfort zone.
styles.short_de: Fotorealistisch digital gemalte Landschaften und Kulissen von großer Weite, mit Dunst und Lichtbahnen; seit den 1990ern zur Erweiterung von Sets in Film, Fernsehen und Games eingesetzt.
styles.short_en: Photoreal, digitally painted environments of epic scale with haze and light shafts, used since the 1990s to extend sets and build vistas for film, TV and games.
styles.era_de: seit den 1990ern, Film-, Fernseh- und Spieleproduktion
styles.era_en: since the 1990s, film, TV and game production

styles.era_origin: Standard throughout the 20th century wherever cameras are barred from courtrooms, for example US federal courts and German courts during hearings.
visual_markers: Pastel and colored pencil on toned paper
Quickly blocked color with visible strokes
styles.prompt_fragment: as a courtroom-style reportage sketch: fast drawing in pastels and colored pencil on toned paper, gestural outlines, quickly blocked color with visible strokes, compressed theatrical composition, faces captured with approximate likeness, unfinished edges, the paper color showing through, urgent live-observation energy
styles.avoid: Avoid clean finished illustration and photoreal faces; speed and approximation are the defining traits.
styles.feasibility_note: Pastel on toned paper renders well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Depicting real trials or identifiable people raises privacy and defamation concerns; use fictional scenes.
styles.short_de: Schnelle Zeichnungen mit Pastell und Buntstift auf getöntem Papier, die Prozessszenen und Gesichter festhalten; üblich, wo Kameras im Gerichtssaal verboten sind, etwa an US-Bundesgerichten und in Deutschland.
styles.short_en: Fast pastel and coloured-pencil drawings on toned paper capturing trial scenes and approximate likenesses, standard wherever cameras are barred from courtrooms, as in US federal and German courts.
styles.era_de: 20. Jh. bis heute, USA, Deutschland, Großbritannien
styles.era_en: 20th century to today, USA, Germany, UK
markers_de: Pastell und Buntstift auf getöntem Papier
Schnell gesetzte Farbflächen mit sichtbarem Strich
markers_en: Pastel and coloured pencil on toned paper
Quickly blocked colour with visible strokes
styles.sensitivity_de: Echte Prozesse oder erkennbare Personen berühren Persönlichkeitsrechte; nur fiktive Szenen darstellen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Depicting real trials or identifiable people raises privacy and defamation issues; use fictional scenes.

styles.era_origin: US tattoo flash of the 1920s-50s, especially in tattoo shops of navy ports.
visual_markers: Limited palette of red, yellow, green and blue
styles.prompt_fragment: as American traditional tattoo flash: bold heavy black outlines, solid black and whip-shaded areas, a limited palette of red, yellow, green and blue, flat color with no gradients, iconic simplified forms, small white highlights, presented on a flash sheet of yellowed paper with ink labels
styles.avoid: Avoid realistic shading and thin lines; boldness and readability at distance define it.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable.
styles.sensitivity_note: A related artist's name is now also a commercial liquor trademark; don't use it.
styles.short_de: Kräftige schwarze Konturen, satte schwarze Schattierung und flaches Rot, Gelb, Grün und Blau auf Flash-Bögen, aus US-Tattoostudios in Marinehäfen der 1920er- bis 1950er-Jahre.
styles.short_en: Bold black outlines, solid black shading and flat red, yellow, green and blue on flash sheets, from US tattoo shops in naval port towns of the 1920s–50s.
markers_de: Nur Rot, Gelb, Grün und Blau
markers_en: Red, yellow, green and blue only
styles.sensitivity_de: Der Name eines prägenden Tätowierers ist heute eine Spirituosenmarke; ihn nicht verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: A related tattooer's name is now a commercial liquor trademark; do not use it.

styles.era_origin: Emerged in the 1990s-2000s as an elaboration of American traditional tattooing.
visual_markers: Bold outlines with varied line weight
Jewel-tone palette of burgundy, teal and gold
styles.prompt_fragment: as a neo-traditional tattoo design: bold outlines with varied line weight, a rich jewel-tone palette of burgundy, teal and gold, smooth color blending and dimensional shading, ornate Art Nouveau-inspired framing with jewels, filigree and flowers, illustrative depth while keeping strong readable silhouettes
styles.avoid: Avoid photoreal tattoo realism and the flat primaries of old school; it sits between them.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders well.
styles.short_de: Tattoomotive mit kräftigen, variierenden Konturen, Juwelenfarben, weichen Verläufen und Jugendstil-Ornamenten, in den 1990er- und 2000er-Jahren aus dem American Traditional weiterentwickelt.
styles.short_en: Tattoo designs with bold, varied outlines, jewel-tone colours, smooth shading and Art Nouveau-style ornament, developed in the 1990s–2000s from American traditional tattooing.
markers_en: Bold outlines with varied line weight
Jewel tones: burgundy, teal and gold

styles.era_origin: Edo-period Japan (late 18th-19th century), inspired by woodblock-printed hero illustrations.
visual_markers: Black backgrounds of wind bars, waves and clouds
Saturated red, green and blue fills
styles.prompt_fragment: in a Japanese irezumi tattoo style: bold black outlines, a large flowing composition, background of wind bars, waves and clouds in black gradation, saturated red, green and blue fills, scattered maple leaves or cherry blossoms, dramatic stylized forms derived from woodblock-print iconography
styles.avoid: Avoid generic 'Asian-inspired' decoration and watercolor tattoo softness; respect the strict compositional conventions.
styles.feasibility_note: Iconography and color render well; compositional conventions are approximated.
styles.sensitivity_note: Irezumi carries cultural weight and social stigma in Japan through its yakuza association; avoid careless use of Buddhist deities and caricatured Japanese tropes.
styles.short_de: Großflächige, fließende Tattookompositionen mit kräftigen Konturen, schwarzen Wind-, Wellen- und Wolkenhintergründen und satten Farben, entstanden im Japan der Edo-Zeit nach Holzschnittvorbildern.
styles.short_en: Large flowing tattoo compositions with bold outlines, black wind, wave and cloud backgrounds and saturated colour, developed in Edo-period Japan from woodblock-printed hero imagery.
markers_de: Schwarzer Hintergrund aus Wind, Wellen und Wolken
markers_en: Black wind bars, waves and clouds
styles.sensitivity_de: Irezumi ist in Japan durch die Verbindung zur Yakuza stigmatisiert; buddhistische Gottheiten und Japan-Klischees nicht beliebig einsetzen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Irezumi carries social stigma in Japan through its yakuza association; avoid careless use of Buddhist deities and Japanese clichés.

styles.era_origin: Rooted in ancient Polynesian and other Indigenous tattooing; contemporary illustrative blackwork boomed in the 2010s.
styles.prompt_fragment: as a blackwork tattoo design: solid saturated black ink only, large bold areas of pure black, high-contrast shapes carved out as negative space, graphic illustrative or ornamental forms, crisp edges, no color and no gray wash, woodcut-like boldness
styles.avoid: Avoid gray shading and color; contrast comes from black mass against bare skin or paper.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable.
styles.sensitivity_note: Traditional blackwork draws on sacred Polynesian and other Indigenous tattoo motifs; don't copy those motifs.
styles.short_de: Tattoomotive ausschließlich in sattem Schwarz, mit großen Schwarzflächen und Formen aus Negativraum; illustratives Blackwork verbreitete sich in den 2010er-Jahren stark.
styles.short_en: Tattoo designs in solid black ink only, with large black areas and shapes cut out as negative space; contemporary illustrative blackwork spread widely in the 2010s.
styles.era_de: 2010er, international; Wurzeln in polynesischer und anderer indigener Tätowierung
styles.era_en: 2010s, international; roots in Polynesian and other Indigenous tattooing
styles.sensitivity_de: Manches Blackwork greift auf sakrale polynesische und andere indigene Motive zurück; diese nicht kopieren.
styles.sensitivity_en: Some blackwork draws on sacred Polynesian and other Indigenous motifs; do not copy them.

styles.era_origin: Contemporary tattooing of the 2000s-2010s, related to hand-poke techniques.
visual_markers: Shading made only of stippled dots
styles.prompt_fragment: as a dotwork tattoo design: shading made entirely of stippled black dots with smooth density gradients, fine geometric line work, radial symmetry with circles and framing lines, black ink only, delicate yet graphic, crisp on skin or paper
styles.avoid: Avoid gray-wash shading and color; every tone is built from dots.
styles.feasibility_note: Geometry renders well, but dot gradients often become a gray blur.
styles.sensitivity_note: Mandalas and sacred geometry draw on Hindu and Buddhist religious symbols; use them respectfully.
styles.short_de: Tattoomotive, deren Schattierung ganz aus gestochenen schwarzen Punkten besteht, oft mit feinen geometrischen Linien und radialer Symmetrie; seit den 2000er-Jahren verbreitet.
styles.short_en: Tattoo designs shaded entirely with stippled black dots, often combined with fine geometric lines and radial symmetry; widespread in contemporary tattooing since the 2000s.
styles.sensitivity_de: Mandalas und heilige Geometrie stammen aus hinduistischer und buddhistischer Symbolik; respektvoll einsetzen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Mandalas and sacred geometry derive from Hindu and Buddhist religious symbols; use them respectfully.

styles.era_origin: Grew out of single-needle black-and-grey work of the 1970s-80s; became mainstream through Los Angeles studios and social media in the 2010s.
visual_markers: Small scale with lots of negative space
Tiny dots and stars as accents
styles.prompt_fragment: as a fine-line tattoo design: ultra-thin single-needle black lines, minimal delicate detail, soft whisper shading in light gray, small scale with lots of negative space, elegant understated composition, tiny dots and stars as accents, healed-on-skin look
styles.avoid: Avoid bold outlines and heavy black fills; restraint is the whole style.
styles.feasibility_note: Thin lines hold well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Several defining practitioners are still alive; don't name them.
styles.short_de: Kleine, zarte Tattoos aus hauchdünnen Single-Needle-Linien mit hellgrauer Schattierung und viel freier Haut; seit den 2010ern über Studios in Los Angeles und soziale Medien populär.
styles.short_en: Small, delicate tattoos in ultra-thin single-needle lines with light grey shading and much negative space; mainstream since the 2010s through Los Angeles studios and social media.
styles.era_de: Wurzeln in den 1970er/80ern; seit den 2010ern verbreitet, Los Angeles und weltweit
styles.era_en: roots in the 1970s–80s; mainstream since the 2010s, Los Angeles and worldwide
markers_de: Winzige Punkte und Sterne als Akzente
markers_en: Tiny dots and stars as accents
styles.sensitivity_de: Mehrere prägende Tätowierer leben noch; sie nicht namentlich nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Several defining practitioners are alive; do not name them.

styles.era_origin: Chicano and prison tattooing in Los Angeles in the 1970s.
visual_markers: Clouds, rays of light, roses and filigree
styles.prompt_fragment: as a Chicano black-and-grey tattoo design: smooth soft gray-wash shading with single-needle detail, high-contrast black, ornate script lettering banners, clouds, rays of light, roses and filigree, no color, photographic yet hand-drawn feel
styles.avoid: Avoid color and bold traditional outlines; smooth gray gradients and script define it.
styles.feasibility_note: Gray-wash shading renders well; script lettering may garble.
styles.sensitivity_note: Rooted in Mexican-American and prison culture, with Catholic iconography; avoid stereotypes and gang symbolism.
styles.short_de: Weich schattierte Grauton-Tattoos mit feinen Single-Needle-Details, Schriftzügen, Rosen, Wolken und Lichtstrahlen, entstanden in der Chicano- und Gefängnistätowierung im Los Angeles der 1970er.
styles.short_en: Smooth grey-wash tattoos with fine single-needle detail, script lettering, roses, clouds and light rays, from Chicano and prison tattooing in 1970s Los Angeles.
markers_en: Clouds, light rays, roses and filigree
styles.sensitivity_de: Wurzelt in mexikanisch-amerikanischer Kultur und Gefängniskultur mit katholischer Bildsprache; Stereotype und Gang-Symbole vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Rooted in Mexican-American and prison culture with Catholic iconography; avoid stereotypes and gang symbols.

styles.era_origin: Developed in Würzburg, Germany, by the Buena Vista Tattoo Club in the late 1990s.
visual_markers: Aggressive red and black brush strokes and splatters
styles.prompt_fragment: as a Trash Polka tattoo design: collage of photorealistic black-and-grey imagery with aggressive red and black brush strokes, splatters, smears and geometric shapes, fragments of typewriter and stencil lettering, chaotic layered composition, only black and red ink, raw graphic energy
styles.avoid: Avoid additional colors and tidy layouts; the tension between realism and trash collage is the point.
styles.feasibility_note: Red-black collage renders well; text fragments become gibberish, which is acceptable here.
styles.sensitivity_note: Coined by a specific German studio; use it as a genre term and don't imitate the studio's individual works.
styles.short_de: Collageartige Tattoos aus fotorealistischen Schwarzgrau-Motiven, roten und schwarzen Pinselstrichen, Farbspritzern und Schriftfragmenten, ab 1998 in Würzburg entwickelt.
styles.short_en: Collage tattoos combining photorealistic black-and-grey imagery with red and black brush strokes, splatters and type fragments, developed in Würzburg, Germany, from 1998.
markers_de: Rote und schwarze Pinselstriche und Spritzer
markers_en: Red and black brush strokes and splatters
styles.sensitivity_de: Von einem Würzburger Studio geprägt; als Gattungsbegriff nutzen, ohne einzelne Arbeiten des Studios nachzuahmen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Coined by one German studio; use it as a genre term without imitating the studio's individual works.

styles.era_origin: Skate and street sticker culture since the 1980s-90s; booming with online sticker shops and messaging stickers in the 2010s.
visual_markers: Flat vibrant colors with simple cel shading
styles.prompt_fragment: as a die-cut vinyl sticker: bold simplified illustration with thick clean outlines, flat vibrant colors with simple cel shading, a wide white die-cut border following the silhouette, subtle drop shadow beneath, slight vinyl gloss sheen, isolated on a plain background, cute graphic readability
styles.avoid: Avoid glossy 3D-render cuteness; keep it flat, outlined and printable.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable, and close to the model's default cute-icon look.
styles.short_de: Vereinfachte Illustrationen mit dicken Konturen und flachen, kräftigen Farben, entlang der Silhouette mit breitem weißem Rand ausgeschnitten; aus der Skate- und Streetsticker-Kultur seit den 1980ern.
styles.short_en: Simplified illustrations with thick outlines and flat bright colours, cut along the silhouette with a wide white border, from skate and street sticker culture since the 1980s–90s.
styles.era_de: seit den 1980er/90ern, Skate- und Streetkultur; Onlineboom in den 2010ern
styles.era_en: since the 1980s–90s, skate and street culture; online boom in the 2010s
markers_de: Flache, kräftige Farben mit einfachem Cel-Shading
markers_en: Flat bright colours with simple cel shading

styles.era_origin: Brussels, 1930s-1950s Belgian adventure albums; the term was coined by a Dutch cartoonist in 1977.
visual_markers: uniform-weight black outlines on every form
completely flat color fills, no hatching or gradients
simplified cartoon figures against meticulously realistic backgrounds and machines
even daylight with minimal, often illuminated cast shadows
clean hand-lettered balloons in a regular panel grid
styles.prompt_fragment: ligne claire comic panel: crisp uniform-weight black ink outlines, completely flat bright color fills with no hatching, gradients or rendered shading, simplified cartoon figures set against meticulously accurate architecture and machinery, even daylight, minimal shadows, mid-century European album printing on smooth paper, clean hand-lettered speech balloons
styles.avoid: Avoid gradient shading, glossy highlights and swelling brush lines, otherwise it slides into modern digital comics or the Marcinelle style.
styles.feasibility_note: Clean even lines and flat fills hold well; the model sometimes sneaks in soft gradients that must be explicitly forbidden.
styles.sensitivity_note: Strongly associated with one famous Belgian series whose estate enforces its rights aggressively; never reproduce its characters, quiff hairstyle or white terrier.
styles.short_de: Comics mit gleichmäßig starker schwarzer Kontur und flachen Farben ohne Schraffur, einfache Figuren vor exakt gezeichneten Kulissen; Brüsseler Schule der 1930er–50er, 1977 von einem Niederländer benannt.
styles.short_en: Comics with uniform black outlines and flat colours without hatching, simple figures against precisely drawn settings; Brussels school of the 1930s–50s, named by a Dutch cartoonist in 1977.
markers_de: Flache Farbflächen ohne Schraffur und Verlauf
markers_en: Flat colour fills, no hatching or gradients
Simple figures against detailed realistic backgrounds
Hand-lettered balloons in a regular grid
styles.sensitivity_de: Eng mit einer berühmten belgischen Serie verbunden, deren Rechteinhaber streng vorgehen; deren Figuren, Haartolle und weißen Terrier nie nachbilden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Strongly tied to one famous Belgian series whose estate enforces its rights strictly; never reproduce its characters, quiff or white terrier.

styles.era_origin: Belgium, late 1940s-1960s, cartoonists around a weekly humor magazine edited in Marcinelle near Charleroi; defined as the dynamic counterpart to ligne claire.
visual_markers: lively brush-and-nib line that swells and tapers
motion lines, sweat drops and dust puffs
flat cheerful album colors with occasional hatching
styles.prompt_fragment: Franco-Belgian humor comic in the Marcinelle tradition: lively brush-and-nib ink line that swells and tapers, big-nosed rubbery caricatured figures caught mid-gesture, motion lines, sweat drops and dust puffs, slightly skewed energetic perspective, flat cheerful album colors with occasional hatching, 1950s-60s print feel, hand-lettered balloons
styles.avoid: Avoid the static uniform outlines of ligne claire and any 3D rendering or glossy highlights.
styles.feasibility_note: Expressive line renders well; without stressing big-nosed caricature the model drifts to generic cartoon proportions.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid recreating trademarked series characters from this school (blue forest gnomes, the lonesome cowboy, the bellhop hero and his squirrel).
styles.short_de: Dynamischer frankobelgischer Humorcomic mit schwellender Pinsellinie, knollennasigen Gummifiguren und Bewegungseffekten, entstanden ab Ende der 1940er im Umfeld einer Wochenzeitschrift aus Marcinelle in Belgien.
styles.short_en: Dynamic Franco-Belgian humor comics with swelling brush lines, big-nosed rubbery figures and motion effects, from the circle of a weekly magazine based in Marcinelle, Belgium, late 1940s–60s.
markers_en: Lively brush line that swells and tapers
Motion lines, sweat drops and dust clouds
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine geschützten Figuren dieser Schule nachbilden (blaue Waldzwerge, einsamer Cowboy, Hotelpage mit Eichhörnchen).
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not recreate trademarked characters of this school (blue forest gnomes, the lonesome cowboy, the bellhop and his squirrel).

styles.era_origin: Belgium and France, 1950s-1980s adventure albums (westerns, aviation, history).
visual_markers: anatomically realistic figures with weathered faces
dense pen hatching and feathered brush shadows
wide cinematic panels with researched period detail
earthy, sun-bleached flat colors under black line
visible offset dot screen and slight misregistration
styles.prompt_fragment: realistic Franco-Belgian adventure album art: anatomically accurate figures, dense pen hatching and feathered brush shadows, weathered faces with expressive wrinkles, cinematic wide panels, researched period detail, flat earthy sun-bleached colors laid under black line, visible dot screen and slight misregistration of 1970s offset album printing
styles.avoid: Avoid smooth digital airbrushing and glossy superhero anatomy; hatching and earthy flat color are essential.
styles.feasibility_note: Hatching and flat earthy color work well; tends to come out a little too clean unless print artifacts are requested.
styles.sensitivity_note: Western genre material can carry colonial-era stereotypes of Indigenous peoples; avoid them.
styles.short_de: Frankobelgische Abenteueralben mit anatomisch genauen Figuren, dichter Federschraffur, recherchierten historischen Details und erdigen Flächenfarben; Belgien und Frankreich, späte 1940er bis 1980er.
styles.short_en: Franco-Belgian adventure albums with anatomically realistic figures, dense pen hatching, researched period detail and earthy flat colours; Belgium and France, late 1940s to 1980s.
markers_en: Dense pen hatching and feathered brush shadows
Wide cinematic panels with period detail
Visible offset dot screen, slight misregistration
styles.sensitivity_de: Westernstoffe transportieren oft koloniale Stereotype über indigene Völker; diese vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Western-genre material can carry colonial stereotypes of Indigenous peoples; avoid them.

styles.era_origin: France and Belgium from the 1970s-80s (color painted straight onto the original board), paralleled by painted US graphic novels from the late 1980s.
visual_markers: each panel fully painted in watercolor, gouache or acrylic
line art partly dissolved into paint
visible brushstrokes and cold-press paper grain
atmospheric light and strong color temperature
white gutters and lettered balloons over paintings
styles.prompt_fragment: painted bande dessinée panel in couleur directe: color painted straight onto the drawing board in watercolor, gouache and acrylic, line art partly dissolved into paint, visible brushstrokes and cold-press paper grain, atmospheric light and moody color temperature, soft lost edges, white gutters and hand-lettered balloons sitting on the painting
styles.avoid: Avoid smooth digital painting with sharp rim lights; brushwork, paper and comic framing must stay visible or it becomes a generic illustration.
styles.feasibility_note: Painterly panels render well; balloons and gutters must be requested, otherwise it reads as a standalone painting.
styles.short_de: Comicpanels, die direkt mit Aquarell, Gouache oder Acryl gemalt sind, sodass Linie und Farbe verschmelzen; in französischen und belgischen Alben seit Mitte der 1970er etabliert.
styles.short_en: Comic panels painted directly in watercolor, gouache or acrylic so that line and colour merge, established in French and Belgian albums from the mid-1970s.
styles.era_de: seit Mitte der 1970er, Frankreich und Belgien; gemalte US-Graphic-Novels ab Ende der 1980er
styles.era_en: since the mid-1970s, France and Belgium; painted US graphic novels from the late 1980s
markers_de: Linie teils in der Farbe aufgelöst
Weiße Zwischenräume, Sprechblasen über der Malerei
markers_en: Line art partly dissolved into paint
White gutters, balloons over the painting

styles.era_origin: France, mid-1970s, adult science-fiction comics magazines and their circle of artists.
visual_markers: tiny figures in vast empty dreamlike vistas
pale airy pastel and acid-tinted flat washes
lots of open sky and calm surreal stillness
styles.prompt_fragment: 1970s French adult science-fiction comic art: ultra-fine technical-pen linework, stippling and parallel hatching, tiny figures in vast empty dreamlike vistas, strange organic-mechanical architecture and vehicles, pale airy pastel and acid-tinted flat color washes, lots of sky, calm surreal stillness, offset print texture
styles.avoid: Avoid neon cyberpunk glow, lens flares and glossy digital chrome, which turn it into generic sci-fi concept art.
styles.feasibility_note: Pastel palette and spacious composition hold well; very fine stippling is often simplified or smudged.
styles.sensitivity_note: Tied to a few named masters (one deceased, others living) and to a trademarked magazine title; keep prompts generic and never name artists or the magazine.
styles.short_de: Hauchfeine Federzeichnung und blasse Pastelllasuren mit winzigen Figuren in weiten Traumlandschaften und organischen Maschinen, aus französischen Science-Fiction-Comicmagazinen für Erwachsene ab Mitte der 1970er.
styles.short_en: Ultra-fine pen linework and pale pastel washes showing tiny figures in vast dreamlike landscapes and organic machines, from French adult science-fiction comics magazines of the mid-1970s.
styles.era_de: Mitte der 1970er bis Anfang der 1980er, Frankreich
markers_de: Winzige Figuren in weiten, leeren Landschaften
Blasse Pastell- und Säuretöne als Flächen
markers_en: Tiny figures in vast empty vistas
Pale pastel and acid-tinted flat washes
styles.sensitivity_de: Eng mit wenigen Zeichnern (einer verstorben, andere lebend) und einem geschützten Magazintitel verbunden; Prompts allgemein halten, keine Namen nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Tied to a few artists (one deceased, others living) and a trademarked magazine title; keep prompts generic and never name them.

styles.era_origin: Italy, from the late 1940s; black-and-white monthly digest comics that peaked in the 1960s-90s (similar British pocket war libraries).
visual_markers: pure black and white, no gray tones
realistic figures in brush and dip-pen hatching
regular grid of about six panels
cheap off-white digest paper with ink spread
styles.prompt_fragment: Italian popular fumetti page in black and white: realistic figures drawn with confident brush and dip-pen hatching, deep spotted blacks, no gray tones, regular six-panel grid, cinematic framing, neat mechanical-style lettering in balloons, printed on cheap off-white digest paper with slight ink spread
styles.avoid: Avoid color, screentones and manga eyes; this is Western realistic black ink only.
styles.feasibility_note: Black-and-white hatching is reliable; the six-panel grid sometimes becomes irregular.
styles.sensitivity_note: 'Bonelli' is a publisher name used only as a format descriptor; do not reproduce the cowboy, detective or nightmare-investigator series heroes.
styles.short_de: Italienische Monatshefte in Schwarzweiß mit realistischen Figuren in Pinsel und Feder, tiefem Schwarz und regelmäßigem Sechs-Panel-Raster auf billigem Papier, erschienen seit Ende der 1940er.
styles.short_en: Black-and-white Italian monthly comics with realistic brush and pen figures, deep blacks and a regular six-panel grid on cheap paper, published since the late 1940s.
markers_de: Realistische Figuren in Pinsel und Feder
Regelmäßiges Raster aus etwa sechs Panels
Billiges, gelbliches Papier mit verlaufender Tinte
markers_en: Pure black and white, no grey
Regular grid of about six panels
Cheap off-white paper with ink spread
styles.sensitivity_de: „Bonelli“ ist ein Verlagsname und dient nur als Formatbezeichnung; dessen Cowboy-, Detektiv- und Albtraumermittler-Helden nicht nachbilden.
styles.sensitivity_en: 'Bonelli' is a publisher's name used only as a format label; do not reproduce its cowboy, detective or nightmare-investigator heroes.

styles.era_origin: Italy, 1947, then across Europe and Latin America; German teen-magazine photo stories from the 1970s onward.
visual_markers: staged photographs arranged as comic panels
speech balloons and caption boxes pasted over photos
styles.prompt_fragment: fotoromanzo photo comic page: staged photographs of posed actors arranged in a grid of panels, white speech balloons and yellow caption boxes pasted over the photos, melodramatic expressions and gestures, direct on-camera flash, slightly faded magazine print colors and halftone grain, thin white gutters
styles.avoid: Avoid polished cinematic photography; it should feel staged, flash-lit and cheaply printed.
styles.feasibility_note: Photo panels and balloons work well; balloon text is often garbled, so supply short exact dialogue.
styles.sensitivity_note: Photorealistic people: never generate identifiable real persons; teen-magazine photo stories are linked to specific magazine brands, so keep it generic.
styles.short_de: Gestellte Fotos posierender Darsteller, als Comicpanels angeordnet und mit Sprechblasen versehen; 1947 in Italien entstanden, später fester Bestandteil von Jugendzeitschriften in ganz Europa.
styles.short_en: Staged photographs of posing actors arranged as comic panels with pasted-on speech balloons, from Italy in 1947, later common in teen magazines across Europe.
styles.era_de: ab 1947, Italien; Europa und Lateinamerika; deutsche Jugendzeitschriften ab den 1970ern
styles.era_en: from 1947, Italy; Europe and Latin America; German teen magazines from the 1970s
markers_de: Sprechblasen und Textkästen auf den Fotos
markers_en: Staged photos arranged as comic panels
Speech balloons and caption boxes over photos
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine erkennbaren realen Personen erzeugen; Fotostorys sind an bestimmte Zeitschriftenmarken gebunden, daher allgemein halten.
styles.sensitivity_en: Never generate identifiable real people; teen-magazine photo stories are tied to specific brands, so keep it generic.

styles.era_origin: Switzerland and Germany, 1830s-1890s, picture stories reproduced as wood engravings and lithographs with verse captions.
visual_markers: sequential framed images without speech balloons
rhymed captions set beneath each picture
lively caricatural pen line in wood-engraving reproduction
styles.prompt_fragment: 19th-century German picture story: sequence of framed images without speech balloons, rhymed caption verse set in old serif or blackletter type beneath each picture, lively caricatural pen line reproduced as wood engraving, sparse hatching, occasional loose hand-applied watercolor tints, foxed cream paper
styles.avoid: Avoid speech balloons and modern comic coloring; the text belongs under the images.
styles.feasibility_note: The engraved pen line holds; blackletter and verse captions will be pseudo-text unless kept very short.
styles.sensitivity_note: Some celebrated 19th-century picture stories contain antisemitic and ethnic caricatures; do not reproduce those types.
styles.short_de: Folgen gerahmter, karikaturhafter Bilder ohne Sprechblasen, unter jedem Bild ein gereimter Vers; die Bildergeschichte der Schweiz und Deutschlands zwischen 1830 und 1890.
styles.short_en: Sequences of framed caricatural pictures without speech balloons, with rhymed verse beneath each, from Swiss and German picture stories of the 1830s–1890s.
markers_en: Lively caricatural line as wood engraving
styles.sensitivity_de: Einige berühmte Bildergeschichten des 19. Jahrhunderts enthalten antisemitische und rassistische Karikaturen; diese nicht übernehmen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Some celebrated 19th-century picture stories contain antisemitic and ethnic caricatures; do not reproduce them.

styles.era_origin: USA, 1938-1970, comic books printed in four colors on newsprint.
visual_markers: Ben-Day dot tints in flat areas
yellowed pulpy newsprint with ink bleed
styles.prompt_fragment: 1950s-60s four-color newsprint comic panel: bold brush-inked outlines, flat primary color fills with visible Ben-Day dot tints, slight color misregistration, limited CMYK palette, dynamic foreshortened poses, hand-lettered balloons and bursting sound effects, yellowed pulpy paper with ink bleed and fiber specks
styles.avoid: Avoid glossy gradients, painted rendering and clean white paper; the dots, flat colors and aged newsprint are essential.
styles.feasibility_note: The overall look is reliable; dot patterns appear but are not geometrically exact or consistently sized.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not reproduce trademarked superhero costumes, chest emblems, logos or publisher cover trade dress.
styles.short_de: US-Comichefte mit kräftigen Pinselkonturen, flachen Grundfarben, Ben-Day-Rasterpunkten und Passerversatz auf vergilbendem Zeitungspapier, gedruckt zwischen 1938 und etwa 1970.
styles.short_en: American comic books with bold brush outlines, flat primary colours, Ben-Day dot tints and misregistration on yellowing newsprint, printed between 1938 and about 1970.
markers_en: Ben-Day dot tints in flat areas
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine geschützten Superheldenkostüme, Brustembleme, Logos oder Cover-Gestaltungen von Verlagen nachbilden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not reproduce trademarked superhero costumes, emblems, logos or publisher cover trade dress.

styles.era_origin: USA, about 1950-1954, before the Comics Code of 1954 restricted the genre.
visual_markers: lurid sickly greens, purples and blood reds
styles.prompt_fragment: early-1950s pre-Code horror comic panel: dense pen cross-hatching and heavy pooled blacks, grimacing wide-eyed faces, lurid flat colors of sickly green, bruise purple and blood red, dot tints on cheap newsprint, crowded caption boxes of breathless narration, moody low-angle lighting, ink bleed
styles.avoid: Avoid modern horror-film realism and gore photography; keep it inked, lurid and printed.
styles.feasibility_note: Palette and hatching work well; the model may soften the grotesque faces.
styles.sensitivity_note: The genre invites graphic violence; keep the content mild in a public catalog.
styles.short_de: Reißerische Horror- und Krimicomics mit dichter Kreuzschraffur, tiefen Schwarzflächen, verzerrten Gesichtern und kränklichem Grün und Violett, erschienen in den USA um 1950–54 vor dem Comics Code.
styles.short_en: Lurid horror and crime comics with dense cross-hatching, pooled blacks, grimacing faces and sickly greens and purples, published in the USA around 1950–54 before the Comics Code.
markers_en: Lurid sickly greens, purples and blood reds
styles.sensitivity_de: Das Genre lädt zu drastischer Gewalt ein; Inhalte für einen öffentlichen Katalog zurückhaltend halten.
styles.sensitivity_en: The genre invites graphic violence; keep content mild for a public catalogue.

styles.era_origin: USA, 1930s-1960s comic books, then widely adopted in European children's comics from the 1950s.
visual_markers: round rubbery cartoon figures, animals with human posture
clean confident brush outline with gentle thick-thin
styles.prompt_fragment: classic funny-animal comic-book style: round rubbery cartoon figures, animals given human posture and clothes, clean confident brush outlines with gentle thick-thin variation, flat bright color fills, dot or pie-cut eyes, expressive slapstick poses, detailed adventure backgrounds, mid-century comic printing with soft dot tints
styles.avoid: Avoid 3D shading and any resemblance to specific trademarked mouse, duck or rabbit characters.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders easily; the main risk is drifting toward famous studio characters.
styles.sensitivity_note: Strong pull toward trademarked studio characters; never prompt for sailor-suited ducks, gloved mice and the like.
styles.short_de: Comics mit runden, gummiartigen Tierfiguren in menschlicher Kleidung und Haltung, sauberen Pinselkonturen und flachen bunten Farben; aus US-Heften der 1930er–60er, später auch in europäischen Kindercomics.
styles.short_en: Comics with round, rubbery animal characters in human clothes and poses, clean brush outlines and flat bright colours, from 1930s–60s US comic books and later European children's comics.
markers_de: Runde, gummiartige Tiere mit menschlicher Haltung
markers_en: Round rubbery animals with human posture
Clean brush outline with gentle thick-thin
styles.sensitivity_de: Starker Sog zu geschützten Studiofiguren; nie Enten im Matrosenanzug, Mäuse mit Handschuhen oder Ähnliches anfordern.
styles.sensitivity_en: Strong pull toward trademarked studio characters; never prompt for sailor-suited ducks, gloved mice and the like.

styles.era_origin: USA, early to mid 1990s creator-owned superhero boom.
visual_markers: obsessive fine hatching on every surface
early-Photoshop airbrush gradients and lens flares
oversized gear with pouches and straps
styles.prompt_fragment: early-1990s 'extreme' superhero comic art: hyper-exaggerated muscular anatomy, gritted teeth and squinting eyes, obsessive fine hatching on every surface, extreme foreshortening, early-Photoshop airbrush gradients, lens flares and neon glows, oversized gear with pouches and straps, splash-page energy, glossy coated paper
styles.avoid: Avoid subtle realism and clean modern rendering; the excess and the hatching are the point.
styles.feasibility_note: Exaggeration and hatching come through well; early digital gradients render convincingly.
styles.sensitivity_note: The era's hypersexualized female anatomy should be toned down; avoid trademarked characters and the publisher's name.
styles.short_de: Superheldenzeichnungen mit übertriebener Muskelanatomie, obsessiver Feinschraffur, extremen Verkürzungen und frühen Photoshop-Verläufen samt Lens Flares, aus dem US-Comicboom der frühen 1990er.
styles.short_en: Superhero art with hyper-muscular anatomy, obsessive fine hatching, extreme foreshortening and early Photoshop gradients and lens flares, from the early-1990s US creator-owned comics boom.
markers_de: Überdimensionierte Ausrüstung mit Taschen und Gurten
markers_en: Oversized gear with pouches and straps
styles.sensitivity_de: Die übersexualisierte Frauendarstellung der Ära abschwächen; keine geschützten Figuren und keinen Verlagsnamen verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Tone down the era's hypersexualized female anatomy; avoid trademarked characters and the publisher's name.

styles.era_origin: USA, 2000s to the present, digitally colored mainstream comics.
visual_markers: clean digital inks with tapered lines
rendered gradients, rim lights and glows
styles.prompt_fragment: contemporary mainstream comic book art: clean digital inks with tapered lines, fully rendered digital coloring with soft gradients, rim lighting, glowing effects and subtle texture overlays, cinematic widescreen panels, saturated but controlled palette, crisp glossy-paper reproduction
styles.avoid: This is close to the default AI comic look; keep visible ink lines and panel borders so it does not dissolve into generic concept art.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable, which is also why it looks generic.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid trademarked heroes and publisher trade dress.
styles.short_de: Mainstream-Comiczeichnung mit sauberer digitaler Tusche und voll ausmodellierter Digitalkolorierung mit Verläufen, Kantenlicht, Glüheffekten und Texturen, typisch für US-Comics seit den 2000ern.
styles.short_en: Mainstream comic art with clean digital inks and fully rendered digital colour, including gradients, rim lights, glows and texture overlays, typical of US comics since the 2000s.
markers_de: Saubere digitale Tuschelinien mit spitzen Enden
markers_en: Clean digital inks with tapered lines
Rendered gradients, rim lights and glows
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine geschützten Helden und keine verlagstypische Cover-Gestaltung verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid trademarked heroes and publisher trade dress.

styles.era_origin: USA, rooted in 1940s crime strips and comics; revived as a stark graphic-novel look in the early 1990s.
visual_markers: pure black and white, no gray
forms defined by negative space and silhouette
styles.prompt_fragment: high-contrast noir comic panel: pure black ink and stark white paper with no gray, forms defined by negative space and silhouette, rain streaks drawn as white lines on black, hard venetian-blind and street-lamp shadows, a single spot color accent, bold graphic composition, heavy brush and ruling-pen strokes
styles.avoid: Avoid grayscale rendering, gradients and photographic film-noir looks.
styles.feasibility_note: Strong results; the model sometimes adds gray tones, so insist on 'no gray'.
styles.sensitivity_note: Closely associated with a living comics artist's crime series; never name him.
styles.short_de: Comiczeichnung in reinem Schwarzweiß, Formen aus Negativraum, weißer Regen auf Schwarz und harte Schatten; wurzelt in Krimicomics der 1940er und wurde Anfang der 1990er wiederbelebt.
styles.short_en: Pure black-and-white comic art with forms carved from negative space, white rain on black and hard shadows, rooted in 1940s crime comics and revived in early-1990s graphic novels.
markers_en: Pure black and white, no grey
Forms defined by negative space and silhouette
styles.sensitivity_de: Eng mit der Krimireihe eines lebenden Comiczeichners verbunden; ihn nie namentlich nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Closely tied to a living comics artist's crime series; never name him.

styles.era_origin: USA (San Francisco), late 1960s-1970s self-published adult comics.
visual_markers: black ink or crude two-color on newsprint
styles.prompt_fragment: 1960s-70s underground comix page: obsessive pen cross-hatching and stipple, rubbery lumpy figures with big feet and leering grins, crowded hand-lettered captions with wobbly baselines, black ink on cheap newsprint or crude two-color overlay, grotesque satirical exaggeration, cramped psychedelic backgrounds
styles.avoid: Avoid tidy mainstream inking and digital color; it must feel cramped, rough and self-published.
styles.feasibility_note: Cross-hatching and rubbery figures work; long lettering degrades into pseudo-text.
styles.sensitivity_note: The genre historically includes explicit sex, drug content and racist caricature; keep the content clean and avoid those stereotypes.
styles.short_de: Selbstverlegte Comics für Erwachsene mit obsessiver Kreuzschraffur, klobigen Figuren mit großen Füßen, wackeliger Handschrift und grotesker Satire, aus dem San Francisco der späten 1960er und 1970er.
styles.short_en: Self-published adult comics with obsessive cross-hatching, lumpy big-footed figures, wobbly hand lettering and grotesque satire, from San Francisco in the late 1960s and 1970s.
markers_de: Gummiartige, klobige Figuren mit großen Füßen
Schwarz oder grober Zweifarbdruck auf Zeitungspapier
markers_en: Black ink or crude two-colour on newsprint
styles.sensitivity_de: Das Genre enthält historisch explizite Sexualität, Drogen und rassistische Karikaturen; Inhalte sauber halten und diese Stereotype vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: The genre historically includes explicit sex, drug content and racist caricature; keep content clean and avoid those stereotypes.

styles.era_origin: North America and Europe, late 1980s-2000s small-press and literary graphic novels.
visual_markers: muted palette of two or three flat tones
quiet static framing with negative space
styles.prompt_fragment: literary alternative-comics panel: thin even ink line, restrained deadpan faces, quiet static framing with generous negative space, muted limited palette of two or three flat tones such as dusty blue, ochre and pale gray, small regular panels, matte uncoated book paper, melancholy everyday atmosphere
styles.avoid: Avoid dramatic lighting, action poses and saturated colors.
styles.feasibility_note: Restraint is achievable; the model may add unwanted shading unless 'flat tones only' is stressed.
styles.sensitivity_note: Defined by several living cartoonists; never name them.
styles.short_de: Stille, literarische Comics mit dünner, gleichmäßiger Linie, zwei bis drei gedämpften Flächenfarben, ruhigen Bildausschnitten und unbewegten Gesichtern; Kleinverlage in Nordamerika und Europa, späte 1980er bis 2000er.
styles.short_en: Quiet literary comics with thin even lines, two or three muted flat tones, static framing and deadpan faces, from North American and European small presses, late 1980s–2000s.
markers_en: Two or three muted flat tones
Quiet static framing with negative space
styles.sensitivity_de: Von mehreren lebenden Zeichnern geprägt; sie nie namentlich nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Defined by several living cartoonists; never name them.

styles.era_origin: USA, from the 1900s; the classic economical daily format runs from mid-century to the 1990s.
visual_markers: one horizontal row of three or four panels
black line with occasional mechanical gray tone on newsprint
styles.prompt_fragment: classic daily newspaper comic strip: one horizontal row of three or four bordered panels, simple economical cartoon figures, minimal suggested backgrounds, hand-lettered dialogue balloons, crisp black pen line with occasional mechanical gray tone, gag rhythm leading to a punchline panel, printed on newsprint
styles.avoid: Avoid full-page layouts, rendered shading and color gradients.
styles.feasibility_note: Panel structure is reliable; dialogue lettering may contain typos.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid recognizable syndicated characters (round-headed boy, lasagna cat, etc.).
styles.short_de: Eine waagerechte Reihe aus drei oder vier Panels mit sparsam gezeichneten Figuren, angedeuteten Hintergründen und Pointe, schwarz auf Zeitungspapier; in US-Tageszeitungen seit den 1900er-Jahren.
styles.short_en: One horizontal row of three or four panels with economical cartoon figures, sparse backgrounds and a punchline, printed in black on newsprint in US dailies since the 1900s.
styles.era_de: seit den 1900ern, USA; klassische Form Mitte des 20. Jh. bis 1990er
styles.era_en: since the 1900s, USA; classic format mid-century to 1990s
markers_de: Eine Reihe aus drei oder vier Panels
Schwarze Linie mit Rasterton auf Zeitungspapier
markers_en: One row of three or four panels
Black line with mechanical grey tone on newsprint
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine bekannten Zeitungscomic-Figuren nachbilden (rundköpfiger Junge, lasagneliebender Kater und Ähnliches).
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid recognizable syndicated characters (a round-headed boy, a lasagna-loving cat and the like).

styles.era_origin: USA, about 1895-1930, full-color newspaper Sunday supplements.
visual_markers: broadsheet layout with panels of changing size
elegant fine pen line with art-nouveau ornament
soft hand-separated Ben-Day tints in faded colors
styles.prompt_fragment: turn-of-the-century newspaper Sunday comic supplement page: large broadsheet layout with panels of changing size, elegant fine pen linework with art-nouveau ornament, soft hand-separated Ben-Day color tints in faded red, ochre and sky blue, whimsical dreamlike architecture and perspective, hand-lettered balloons, yellowed brittle newsprint
styles.avoid: Avoid modern comic-book coloring and digital crispness.
styles.feasibility_note: Single panels work well; full multi-panel pages can become chaotic and incoherent.
styles.sensitivity_note: Many period strips contain racist caricatures; do not reproduce those types.
styles.short_de: Großformatige farbige Comicseiten mit wechselnden Panelgrößen, feiner Federlinie, Jugendstil-Ornamentik und zarten Ben-Day-Rastern, aus den Sonntagsbeilagen US-amerikanischer Zeitungen von etwa 1895 bis 1930.
styles.short_en: Full-colour broadsheet comic pages with panels of varying size, fine pen line, art-nouveau ornament and soft Ben-Day tints, from US Sunday newspaper supplements of about 1895–1930.
markers_en: Broadsheet layout with panels of varying size
Fine pen line with art-nouveau ornament
styles.sensitivity_de: Viele Strips dieser Zeit enthalten rassistische Karikaturen; diese nicht übernehmen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Many period strips contain racist caricatures; do not reproduce them.

styles.era_origin: USA, 1929-1950s, illustrative daily and Sunday adventure strips.
styles.prompt_fragment: 1930s-50s realistic adventure newspaper strip: illustrator-grade realistic figures drawn with feathered sable-brush strokes and bold spotted blacks, dramatic chiaroscuro, period or exotic settings in rich detail, typeset narrative caption boxes, muted printed color on newsprint with soft halftone
styles.avoid: Avoid superhero exaggeration and modern digital coloring.
styles.feasibility_note: Feathered brushwork comes through well; captions become pseudo-text.
styles.sensitivity_note: Period adventure strips often carried colonial and 'exotic' stereotypes; avoid them.
styles.short_de: Abenteuerstrips mit illustrativ-realistischen Figuren, fein auslaufenden Pinselstrichen, kräftigen Schwarzflächen und gesetzten Erzähltexten, erschienen in US-Zeitungen von 1929 bis in die 1950er.
styles.short_en: Newspaper adventure strips with illustrator-grade realistic figures, feathered brush strokes, bold spotted blacks and typeset captions, published in US papers from 1929 into the 1950s.
markers_de: Fein auslaufende Striche mit dem Rotmarderpinsel
styles.sensitivity_de: Abenteuerstrips dieser Zeit transportieren oft koloniale und „exotische“ Stereotype; diese vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Period adventure strips often carried colonial and 'exotic' stereotypes; avoid them.

styles.era_origin: Britain and USA, from mid-19th-century humor magazines; the modern understated form dates from the 1920s.
visual_markers: single panel with typeset caption below
styles.prompt_fragment: single-panel magazine gag cartoon: loose spontaneous dip-pen and brush line, soft gray ink-wash shading, generous white space, deadpan understated figures, simple suggested setting, a one-line italic serif caption set beneath the frame, reproduced on cream magazine paper
styles.avoid: Avoid speech balloons, multi-panel layouts and saturated color.
styles.feasibility_note: Wash and loose line work well; supply the exact caption text.
styles.short_de: Witzzeichnung in einem Bild mit lockerer Federlinie, grauer Lavierung und gesetzter Bildunterschrift; aus den Witzblättern des 19. Jahrhunderts, in der trockenen modernen Form seit den 1920ern.
styles.short_en: Single-panel joke drawing with loose pen line, grey wash and a typeset caption below; from 19th-century humor magazines, in its dry modern form since the 1920s.
styles.era_de: ab den 1840ern, Großbritannien und USA; moderne Form seit den 1920ern
styles.era_en: 1840s onward, Britain and USA; modern form from the 1920s

styles.era_origin: Britain in the 18th century, then USA and Germany in the 19th; the modern newspaper format dates from the 20th century.
visual_markers: single panel built on a visual metaphor
styles.prompt_fragment: newspaper editorial cartoon: single panel built around a visual metaphor, exaggerated caricatured figures, symbolic objects bearing hand-lettered labels, bold pen-and-ink crosshatching with gray wash or limited flat color, small speech balloon or caption, newsprint reproduction
styles.avoid: Avoid a neutral illustration; it needs a metaphor and labels, but never target real politicians.
styles.feasibility_note: Metaphor composition works; short labels are reliable but long text is not.
styles.sensitivity_note: Political content: avoid real politicians, ethnic or national stereotypes and propaganda tropes.
styles.short_de: Zeitungszeichnung in einem Bild, die das politische Geschehen über eine Bildmetapher, überzeichnete Figuren und beschriftete Gegenstände kommentiert; Wurzeln in der britischen Satire des 18. Jahrhunderts.
styles.short_en: Single-panel newspaper cartoon commenting on politics through a visual metaphor, caricatured figures and labeled objects; rooted in 18th-century British satire, a newspaper staple since about 1900.
styles.era_de: seit dem 18. Jh., Großbritannien; später USA und Deutschland
styles.era_en: 18th century onward, Britain; later USA and Germany
markers_en: single panel built on a visual metaphor
styles.sensitivity_de: Politischer Inhalt: keine realen Politiker, keine ethnischen oder nationalen Stereotype und keine Propagandamotive.
styles.sensitivity_en: Political content: avoid real politicians, ethnic or national stereotypes and propaganda tropes.

styles.era_origin: Italy in the late 16th century, Britain in the 18th century; popular magazine and street caricature in the 20th century.
visual_markers: oversized head on a small body
marker or watercolor washes with white highlights
styles.prompt_fragment: caricature drawing: oversized head on a small body, distinctive features exaggerated with affectionate wit, confident pen outline, rendered with marker or transparent watercolor washes and white-gouache highlights, simple vignette background, slight paper texture
styles.avoid: Avoid grotesque ethnic exaggeration and photoreal 3D bobblehead rendering.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable; the degree of exaggeration needs tuning.
styles.sensitivity_note: Never caricature identifiable real private individuals; avoid ethnic or body-shaming exaggeration.
styles.short_de: Porträtzeichnung, die markante Gesichtszüge übersteigert, oft mit großem Kopf auf kleinem Körper in Feder und Aquarell; aus Italien um 1590, heute vor allem als Straßenkarikatur verbreitet.
styles.short_en: Portrait drawing that exaggerates a person's defining features, often a big head on a small body in pen and watercolor; from late-16th-century Italy, today common as street caricature.
markers_de: Marker- oder Aquarelllasuren mit weißen Lichtern
markers_en: oversized head on a small body
marker or watercolor washes, white highlights
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine erkennbaren Privatpersonen karikieren und keine ethnisch oder körperlich abwertenden Übertreibungen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Never caricature identifiable private individuals, and avoid ethnic or body-shaming exaggeration.

styles.era_origin: South Korea, early 2000s, vertical-scroll comics for web and mobile.
visual_markers: tall vertical layout with large gaps between panels
soft cel shading with airbrushed glow
styles.prompt_fragment: Korean webtoon panel for vertical scrolling: tall narrow composition, panels floating on white with generous vertical gaps, clean thin digital line art, soft cel shading with airbrushed gradients and glowing highlights, pastel-saturated palette, fashionable slender characters, oval speech bubbles with simple sans-serif text
styles.avoid: Avoid page grids, screentones and halftone print textures.
styles.feasibility_note: Easy to produce; a vertical aspect ratio helps.
styles.short_de: Digitaler Comic zum senkrechten Scrollen mit weit auseinanderliegenden Panels, sauberer dünner Linie und weicher, leuchtender Cel-Schattierung; entstanden Anfang der 2000er auf koreanischen Webportalen.
styles.short_en: Vertical-scroll digital comic with panels spaced far apart, clean thin lines and soft glowing cel shading; developed on Korean web portals in the early 2000s.
markers_de: hohes Hochformat mit großen Abständen zwischen Panels
markers_en: tall vertical layout, wide gaps between panels
soft cel shading with airbrushed glow

styles.era_origin: Internet, 2000s.
styles.prompt_fragment: minimalist stick-figure webcomic: circle-headed stick figures drawn in thin uniform black pen line, no color, plain white background, only the props essential to the joke, hand-lettered sentence-case dialogue, simple rectangular panels, occasional diagram or graph in the same scribbly style
styles.avoid: Avoid shading, color and detailed anatomy.
styles.feasibility_note: The model adds detail unless restricted; the minimalism holds when stated firmly.
styles.sensitivity_note: Strongly associated with one living webcomic author; do not reference him.
styles.short_de: Webcomic aus Strichmännchen mit Kreiskopf, dünne schwarze Linie auf Weiß, nur die nötigsten Requisiten, oft mit gekritzelten Diagrammen; im Netz verbreitet seit den 2000ern.
styles.short_en: Webcomic of circle-headed stick figures in thin black line on white, with only the props a joke needs; popular online from the 2000s, often with scribbled charts.
styles.sensitivity_de: Stark mit einem lebenden Webcomic-Autor verbunden; weder ihn noch seinen Comic nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Strongly associated with one living webcomic author; do not reference him or his comic.

styles.era_origin: Internet, late 1990s-2010s, mouse-drawn comics in basic paint programs.
styles.prompt_fragment: crude early-internet webcomic drawn with a mouse in a basic paint program: jagged aliased one-pixel lines, wobbly shapes, bucket-fill flat colors leaking or leaving white gaps, default system-font text, uneven hand-drawn panel borders, low-resolution screenshot feel with JPEG artifacts
styles.avoid: Avoid anti-aliased smooth lines and any polish.
styles.feasibility_note: The model tends to over-polish; real pixel aliasing is hard to fake convincingly.
styles.sensitivity_note: 'MS Paint' is a Microsoft product name, used only as a descriptor; specific rage-comic faces are meme assets of unclear ownership.
styles.short_de: Mit der Maus in einem einfachen Malprogramm gezeichneter Comic: zackige Pixellinien, Farbfüllungen mit Lücken, Systemschrift; verbreitet in Foren und auf Imageboards, späte 1990er bis 2010er.
styles.short_en: Mouse-drawn comic from a basic paint program: jagged pixel lines, leaky bucket fills, system-font text; common on forums and image boards, late 1990s to 2010s.
markers_de: wacklige, mit der Maus gezogene Formen
styles.sensitivity_de: „MS Paint“ ist ein Microsoft-Produktname und dient nur der Beschreibung; einzelne Rage-Comic-Gesichter sind Meme-Vorlagen mit unklaren Rechten.
styles.sensitivity_en: 'MS Paint' is a Microsoft product name used only descriptively; specific rage-comic faces are meme assets of unclear ownership.

styles.era_origin: China, Shanghai, 1920s-1980s, pocket-size picture-story books.
visual_markers: printed caption block beneath the image
fine even pen line influenced by baimiao outline drawing
styles.prompt_fragment: Chinese lianhuanhua picture-story page: one meticulously drawn image per page with a block of printed caption text beneath, fine even pen line influenced by traditional baimiao outline drawing, careful hatching, realistic figures in detailed settings, monochrome black or sepia ink on off-white paper, small pocket-book proportions
styles.avoid: Avoid speech balloons and manga conventions.
styles.feasibility_note: Line quality is good; Chinese captions will be pseudo-characters.
styles.sensitivity_note: Much 1950s-70s output was state propaganda; do not reproduce Cultural Revolution iconography uncritically, and avoid fake Chinese text that looks like real writing.
styles.short_de: Chinesisches Bildgeschichtenbuch im Taschenformat mit einer detaillierten Tuschezeichnung pro Seite über einem gedruckten Textblock; entstanden im Shanghai der 1920er, Massenware bis in die 1980er.
styles.short_en: Pocket-size Chinese picture-story book with one detailed ink drawing per page above a printed caption; formed in 1920s Shanghai and mass-produced until the 1980s.
markers_en: printed caption block below the image
styles.sensitivity_de: Viele Hefte der 1950er–70er waren Staatspropaganda: Bildsprache der Kulturrevolution nicht unkritisch übernehmen und keine Schein-Schriftzeichen erzeugen, die wie echtes Chinesisch wirken.
styles.sensitivity_en: Much 1950s–70s output was state propaganda: do not reproduce Cultural Revolution iconography uncritically, and avoid fake Chinese text that looks like real writing.

styles.era_origin: Hong Kong, 1970s-1990s martial-arts comics.
visual_markers: realistic muscular figures in flowing robes
swirling qi-energy trails and speed blur
styles.prompt_fragment: 1980s-90s Hong Kong wuxia manhua art: fully painted color with airbrush and gouache, realistic muscular figures in flowing robes and windswept hair, swirling energy trails and speed blur, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, cinematic diagonal panels, bold brush-calligraphy sound effects, glossy saturated print
styles.avoid: Avoid Japanese screentone and big manga eyes; this is painted, realistic and full color.
styles.feasibility_note: The painted martial-arts look works; calligraphic sound effects are unreliable.
styles.short_de: Durchgehend gemalter Kampfkunst-Comic aus Hongkong mit muskulösen, realistischen Kämpfern, wirbelnden Energiespuren und dramatischem Licht; Blütezeit vom Kung-Fu-Boom der 1970er bis in die 1990er.
styles.short_en: Fully painted Hong Kong martial-arts comic with muscular realistic fighters, swirling energy trails and dramatic lighting; flourished from the 1970s kung-fu boom into the 1990s.
markers_de: muskulöse, realistische Figuren in wehenden Gewändern
markers_en: muscular realistic figures in flowing robes
swirling qi trails and speed blur

styles.era_origin: Japan, boys' weekly magazines from the late 1950s; the modern action look from the 1980s onward.
visual_markers: radiating speed lines and impact bursts
styles.prompt_fragment: black-and-white shonen manga panel: bold G-pen ink lines, radiating speed lines and impact bursts, dot and gradient screentones for shading, dynamic diagonal composition with extreme perspective, intense determined expressions, hand-drawn katakana sound effects woven into the art, white paper with slight scan grain
styles.avoid: Avoid full color and soft digital painting; keep it inked and screentoned.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable; katakana sound effects come out as plausible pseudo-script.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not reproduce popular series characters, signature spiky hairstyles or uniforms.
styles.short_de: Schwarz-weißer Action-Manga mit kräftiger G-Pen-Linie, Speedlines, Screentones und extremer Perspektive; aus japanischen Wochenmagazinen für Jungen seit Ende der 1950er, heutiger Look ab den 1980ern.
styles.short_en: Black-and-white action manga with bold G-pen lines, speed lines, screentones and extreme perspective; from Japanese boys' weekly magazines of the late 1950s, its modern look from the 1980s.
markers_en: radiating speed lines and impact bursts
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine Figuren, markanten Stachelfrisuren oder Uniformen bekannter Serien nachbilden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not reproduce characters, signature spiky hairstyles or uniforms from popular series.

styles.era_origin: Japan; the visual language crystallized in 1970s girls' magazines.
visual_markers: large luminous eyes with layered star highlights
long flowing hair in fine strands
styles.prompt_fragment: classic shojo manga page: delicate fine pen lines, large luminous eyes with layered star highlights, long flowing hair rendered in fine strands, backgrounds of flowers, bubbles and sparkle screentones, borderless overlapping panels and full-figure insets, soft gradient tones, dreamy romantic mood, black and white on cream paper
styles.avoid: Avoid hard action lines and heavy blacks; keep it airy and decorative.
styles.feasibility_note: Sparkle tones and eyes render convincingly.
styles.short_de: Romantischer Mädchen-Manga mit großen Augen voller sternförmiger Glanzlichter, feiner Federlinie, Blumen- und Glitzerrastern in randlosen, überlappenden Panels; geprägt in japanischen Mädchenmagazinen der 1970er.
styles.short_en: Romantic girls' manga with large star-highlighted eyes, fine pen lines, flowers and sparkle screentones in borderless overlapping panels; its look took shape in 1970s Japanese magazines.
markers_en: large luminous eyes with star highlights

styles.era_origin: Japan, adult men's magazines from the late 1960s onward.
styles.prompt_fragment: seinen manga panel: realistic adult proportions and smaller naturalistic eyes, dense nib hatching and cross-hatching, meticulously detailed backgrounds drawn from photographic reference, layered screentones and heavy blacks, restrained gritty mood, cinematic framing, black ink on white with print grain
styles.avoid: Avoid chibi proportions, sparkles and bright color.
styles.feasibility_note: Detailed hatching holds; backgrounds may be over-busy.
styles.short_de: Manga für erwachsene Leser mit realistischen Proportionen, dichter Schraffur, nach Fotos gezeichneten Hintergründen und satten Schwarzflächen; entstanden mit den japanischen Seinen-Magazinen ab Ende der 1960er.
styles.short_en: Manga for adult readers with realistic proportions, dense hatching, photo-referenced backgrounds and heavy blacks; grew from Japanese magazines for grown men launched in the late 1960s.
markers_de: dichte Schraffur und Kreuzschraffur mit der Feder

styles.era_origin: Japan; the term was coined in 1957 for adult rental-library comics, and the style flourished into the 1970s.
visual_markers: rough expressive brush and pen work
styles.prompt_fragment: 1960s-70s Japanese gekiga panel: rough expressive brush and pen work, heavy pools of black, gritty urban back alleys and cramped apartments, weary realistic faces, film-like cinematic framing, coarse hatching instead of screentone, cheap yellowed rental-book paper with ink bleed
styles.avoid: Avoid cute anime faces and clean digital lines.
styles.feasibility_note: Tends to drift into modern seinen polish; stress rough brushwork and the era.
styles.short_de: Düsterer, realistischer Comic aus Japan mit rauem Pinselstrich, schweren Schwarzflächen und filmischen Einstellungen aus dem Großstadtelend; Begriff von 1957 für Leihbuch-Manga, Blüte bis in die 1970er.
styles.short_en: Gritty realist Japanese comics with rough brushwork, heavy blacks and cinematic framing of urban squalor; named in 1957 for rental-library books, it flourished into the 1970s.
markers_en: rough expressive brush and pen work

styles.era_origin: Japan, late 1940s-1950s cheap 'red book' comics and monthly children's magazines.
visual_markers: round simple figures with big shiny eyes
rubbery limbs influenced by American animation
clean even brush line, almost no tone
black plus one spot color on rough paper
styles.prompt_fragment: 1950s Japanese postwar children's manga: round simple cartoon figures with big shiny eyes and rubbery limbs, clean even brush line, almost no screentone, cinematic sequential panels, printed in black plus one spot color of red or blue on rough yellowed paper
styles.avoid: Avoid modern anime proportions, gradients and dense screentone.
styles.feasibility_note: The two-color print works; designs drift toward modern anime unless the era is stressed.
styles.sensitivity_note: Strongly identified with a deceased manga pioneer and his trademarked robot-boy character; avoid.
styles.short_de: Runde Cartoonfiguren mit großen, glänzenden Augen und gummiartigen Gliedmaßen in klarer Pinsellinie, kaum Raster; aus Japans billigen Akahon-Heften („rote Bücher“) und Kindermagazinen der späten 1940er und 1950er.
styles.short_en: Round cartoon figures with big shiny eyes and rubbery limbs in clean brush line with little tone; from Japan's cheap 'red book' comics and children's magazines, late 1940s–1950s.
markers_de: runde, einfache Figuren mit großen Glanzaugen
Schwarz plus eine Schmuckfarbe auf rauem Papier
markers_en: round simple figures with big shiny eyes
clean even brush line, almost no tone
black plus one spot colour on rough paper
styles.sensitivity_de: Stark mit einem verstorbenen Manga-Pionier und seiner geschützten Roboterjungen-Figur verbunden; beides nicht nachahmen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Strongly identified with one deceased manga pioneer and his trademarked robot-boy character; avoid copying either.

styles.era_origin: Japan, newspaper four-panel strips from the early 20th century, later a staple of magazines.
styles.prompt_fragment: yonkoma manga: four equal-size panels stacked in a single vertical column, read top to bottom, simple cute character designs with minimal backgrounds, setup-development-twist-punchline rhythm, small vertical text balloons, light screentone, clean black line on white
styles.avoid: Avoid a horizontal strip layout and heavy rendering.
styles.feasibility_note: The four-panel vertical structure is reliable; telling a coherent joke across panels is less so.
styles.short_de: Vier gleich große Panels untereinander, von oben nach unten gelesen als Einleitung, Entwicklung, Wendung und Pointe; japanische Zeitungsstrip-Form seit dem frühen 20. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Four equal panels stacked in one column, read top to bottom as setup, development, twist and punchline; Japanese newspaper strip form since the early 20th century.
markers_de: vier gleiche Panels in einer Spalte
markers_en: four equal panels in one vertical column

styles.era_origin: Japan, 1980s parody manga, anime and merchandise.
visual_markers: figures two to three heads tall
