flat pastel colors with one cel-shade step
emotion symbols like sweat drops and blush lines
styles.prompt_fragment: chibi super-deformed style: figures only two to three heads tall with huge heads, oversized glossy eyes, tiny stubby limbs and mitten hands, simplified features, clean rounded outlines, flat pastel colors with one step of cel shading, playful emotion symbols like sweat drops and blush lines
styles.avoid: Avoid realistic proportions and glossy 3D vinyl-toy rendering.
styles.feasibility_note: Extremely reliable, and therefore close to common AI output.
styles.short_de: Figuren, auf zwei bis drei Kopflängen gestaucht, mit riesigen Glanzaugen, Stummelgliedern und flachen Pastellfarben; verbreitet seit Parodie-Manga, Anime und Merchandise der 1980er in Japan.
styles.short_en: Figures squashed to two or three heads tall with huge glossy eyes, stubby limbs and flat pastel colours; spread through 1980s Japanese parody manga, anime and merchandise.
markers_de: Figuren zwei bis drei Kopflängen groß
markers_en: figures two to three heads tall
flat pastels with one cel-shade step
sweat drops, blush lines and other emotion symbols

styles.era_origin: Japan, 1970s stationery character goods; regional mascot boom in the 2000s.
visual_markers: tiny wide-set dot eyes and minimal mouth
styles.prompt_fragment: kawaii mascot character design: extremely simple soft rounded silhouettes, tiny dot eyes set wide apart, minimal mouth, pink blush ovals, thick even rounded outlines, flat pastel fills with no shading, objects often given simple faces, stationery-sticker cuteness on a plain background
styles.avoid: Avoid detailed anime eyes and glossy 3D rendering.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid resemblance to trademarked character goods (mouthless white cat, lazy egg yolk and similar).
styles.short_de: Figurendesign aus weichen, runden Formen mit Punktaugen, rosa Wangen und flachen Pastellfarben; aus japanischen Schreibwaren-Figuren der 1970er, ab den 2000ern auch bei regionalen Maskottchen (Yuru-Chara).
styles.short_en: Character design reduced to soft rounded shapes, dot eyes, blush ovals and flat pastels; from Japanese 1970s stationery characters, later also regional mascots (yuru-chara) from the 2000s.
styles.era_en: 1970s onward, Japan; regional mascot boom from 2007
markers_de: winzige, weit auseinanderstehende Punktaugen, kaum Mund
markers_en: tiny wide-set dot eyes, minimal mouth
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine Ähnlichkeit mit geschützten Figuren wie der mundlosen weißen Katze oder dem faulen Eigelb.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid resemblance to trademarked character goods such as the mouthless white cat or the lazy egg yolk.

styles.era_origin: Japan, mid-1970s alternative manga and illustration magazines.
visual_markers: deliberately clumsy, childlike but confident lines
crude flat colors missing the outlines
styles.prompt_fragment: Japanese heta-uma 'bad-good' drawing: deliberately clumsy, childlike yet confident marker and brush lines, wonky proportions and naive perspective, crude flat colors that miss the outlines, scrawled handwritten text, absurd deadpan humor, rough paper, aggressively anti-polished
styles.avoid: Avoid sweet children's-book naivety; keep it raw, absurd and confident.
styles.feasibility_note: Models struggle to be convincingly 'bad'; results tend to look like cute naive illustration.
styles.short_de: Absichtlich ungelenke, kindlich wirkende, aber selbstbewusste Zeichnung mit schiefen Proportionen, schludrigen Farben und hingekritzelter Schrift; „schlecht, aber gut“, aus Japans Alternativ-Manga der 1970er.
styles.short_en: Deliberately clumsy, childlike but confident drawing with wonky proportions, sloppy colours and scrawled text; a 'bad but good' counter-style from Japanese alternative manga and illustration of the 1970s.
markers_de: grobe Flächenfarben, die über die Konturen gehen
markers_en: crude flat colours missing the outlines

styles.era_origin: Japan, about 1930-1950s street storytelling with hand-painted picture cards.
visual_markers: simplified bold shapes with thick dark outlines
strong value contrast for distance viewing
styles.prompt_fragment: Japanese kamishibai storytelling card: single horizontal hand-painted board meant to be read from a distance, simplified bold shapes with thick dark outlines, opaque poster-paint colors, strong value contrast, minimal background, worn card edges and creases, 1930s-50s Showa street-theater feel
styles.avoid: Avoid fine detail and digital gradients; it must read from across a street.
styles.feasibility_note: Poster-paint look works; the worn physical card may be omitted unless requested.
styles.short_de: Handgemalte Bildkarte im Querformat mit kräftigen Konturen und deckenden Farben, auf Fernwirkung angelegt; Requisit japanischer Straßenerzähler von etwa 1930 bis Ende der 1950er.
styles.short_en: Hand-painted horizontal picture card with bold outlines and opaque colours, made to read from afar; used by Japanese street storytellers from about 1930 until the late 1950s.
markers_de: vereinfachte Formen mit dicken dunklen Konturen
markers_en: bold simplified shapes, thick dark outlines
strong value contrast for distance viewing

styles.era_origin: Comics production practice, about 1930s-2000s, before fully digital workflows.
visual_markers: yellowed Bristol board with tape stains
styles.prompt_fragment: photographed original comic art board: black India ink over visible non-photo-blue pencil underdrawing, white correction paint patches, pasted-on lettering corrections, ruled panel borders, handwritten margin notes and registration marks, slightly yellowed Bristol board with tape stains, shot flat under even light
styles.avoid: Avoid printed color; this is the uncolored physical artifact.
styles.feasibility_note: Blue pencil under ink renders convincingly; margin notes become pseudo-text.
styles.short_de: Fotografierte Comic-Originalseite: schwarze Tusche über blauer Vorzeichnung auf Bristolkarton, mit Deckweiß, aufgeklebten Lettering-Korrekturen und Randnotizen; üblich von den 1930ern bis zur digitalen Produktion.
styles.short_en: Photographed original comic page: black ink over blue pencil on Bristol board, with white-out, pasted-on lettering and margin notes; standard from the 1930s until digital workflows.

styles.era_origin: Hand-drawn studio animation, 1920s-2000s.
visual_markers: punched animation paper with peg holes
blue and red construction lines under graphite
faint onion-skin ghost of the previous pose
styles.prompt_fragment: hand-drawn animation key drawing on punched animation paper: loose blue and red pencil construction lines under rough graphite, circles and action lines for structure, faint onion-skin ghost of the previous pose, frame number and small timing chart in the corner, peg holes along the edge, eraser smudges
styles.avoid: Avoid finished color and clean ink; the process must stay visible.
styles.feasibility_note: Rough pencil look is reliable; peg-hole placement is sometimes odd.
styles.short_de: Bleistift-Rohzeichnung für den Zeichentrickfilm auf gelochtem Papier, mit farbigen Hilfslinien, durchscheinender vorheriger Pose und Bildnummern; Studioalltag von den 1920ern bis in die 2000er.
styles.short_en: Rough pencil drawing for hand-drawn animation on punched paper, with coloured construction lines, ghosted previous pose and frame numbers; standard studio material from the 1920s to the 2000s.
markers_de: blaue und rote Hilfslinien unter Graphit
markers_en: blue and red construction lines under graphite
faint ghost of the previous pose

styles.era_origin: Animation studios from the 1930s onward, as a design-consistency reference.
visual_markers: front, three-quarter, profile and back views
styles.prompt_fragment: animation model sheet: the same design shown in front, three-quarter, profile and back views aligned to horizontal height guide lines, a row of expression heads, construction circles left visible, small callout notes and arrows, flat color swatch chips, clean line on off-white paper
styles.avoid: Avoid a single hero pose; it must be a consistent multi-view reference.
styles.feasibility_note: Layout is reliable; consistency between the views is imperfect.
styles.short_de: Referenzblatt, das eine Figur von vorn, im Dreiviertelprofil, seitlich und von hinten auf gemeinsamen Höhenlinien zeigt, dazu Mimik und Notizen; Studiostandard im Trickfilm seit den 1930ern.
styles.short_en: Reference sheet showing one character from front, three-quarter, side and back on shared height lines, plus expressions and notes; animation-studio standard since the 1930s.
markers_en: front, three-quarter, side and back views

styles.era_origin: Cel animation, about 1915-1990s; cels later collected as physical art.
visual_markers: flat opaque gouache on clear acetate
styles.prompt_fragment: photographed vintage animation production cel: character painted in flat opaque gouache on the back of clear acetate with crisp inked outlines, laid over a soft watercolor painted background, faint shadow cast by the cel, dust specks, fine scratches, slightly uneven paint thickness and a soft glare on the acetate
styles.avoid: Avoid digital flatness; the physical layering, dust and glare are what make it work.
styles.feasibility_note: Layering is convincing; glare and cel shadow are sometimes omitted.
styles.short_de: Von Hand konturierte und kolorierte Figur auf klarer Folie über einem gemalten Hintergrund, fotografiert mit Staub, Kratzern und Lichtreflex; Arbeitsgrundlage des Cel-Trickfilms, etwa 1915–1990er.
styles.short_en: Hand-inked and painted character on clear acetate laid over a painted background, photographed with dust, scratches and glare; the basis of cel animation, about 1915–1990s.
markers_de: flache, deckende Farbe auf klarer Folie
markers_en: flat opaque paint on clear acetate

styles.era_origin: UK and USA, late 1980s-1990s experimental graphic novels and comic covers.
visual_markers: distressed photographs layered with paint and ink
torn paper and small found objects
styles.prompt_fragment: mixed-media experimental comic art: layered collage of distressed photographs, smeared acrylic, scratchy ink drawing, torn paper and small found objects, double exposures and scanned textures, desaturated palette with sudden saturated accents, fragmented dreamlike composition, typewritten caption strips
styles.avoid: Avoid clean template-like digital collage; keep it physical, scanned and dark.
styles.feasibility_note: Layered collage is a strength of the model; typewritten text is pseudo-text.
styles.sensitivity_note: Closely associated with a living British artist; never name him.
styles.short_de: Comicbilder aus geschichteten verwitterten Fotos, Farbe, kratziger Tusche, Papierfetzen und Fundstücken, fragmentiert und traumartig; aus experimentellen Graphic Novels und Covern Großbritanniens und der USA, späte 1980er und 1990er.
styles.short_en: Comic art layering distressed photos, paint, scratchy ink, torn paper and found objects into fragmented dreamlike pages; from British and American experimental graphic novels and covers, late 1980s–1990s.
markers_de: verwitterte Fotos, überlagert von Farbe und Tusche
markers_en: distressed photos layered with paint and ink
torn paper and small found objects
styles.sensitivity_de: Eng mit einem lebenden britischen Künstler verbunden; ihn nie namentlich nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Closely associated with one living British artist; never name him.

styles.era_origin: USA, 1920s to mid-1930s theatrical cartoon shorts.
styles.prompt_fragment: 1930s rubber-hose cartoon frame: black-and-white or early two-strip color, jointless bendy tube limbs, pie-cut eyes, white four-finger gloves, round bouncy bodies, anthropomorphic objects dancing, simple inked backgrounds, flickering film grain, dust, scratches and dark vignette of worn nitrate film
styles.avoid: Avoid crisp modern 'retro-inspired' vector looks; age it with film damage.
styles.feasibility_note: Very convincing, including film damage.
styles.sensitivity_note: The white gloves and some designs derive from blackface minstrelsy; avoid racial caricature, and avoid trademarked mouse, cat and flapper-girl characters.
styles.short_de: Cartoon-Look mit gelenklosen Schlauchgliedern, Tortenstück-Augen, weißen Handschuhen und federnden Körpern, meist schwarz-weiß; aus amerikanischen Kino-Kurzfilmen der 1920er bis Mitte der 1930er.
styles.short_en: Cartoon look with jointless bendy limbs, pie-cut eyes, white gloves and bouncing bodies, mostly black and white; from American theatrical shorts of the 1920s to mid-1930s.
markers_en: black and white or early two-strip colour
styles.sensitivity_de: Weiße Handschuhe und manche Figuren gehen auf Blackface-Minstrel-Shows zurück: keine rassistischen Karikaturen und keine geschützten Maus-, Katzen- oder Flapper-Figuren.
styles.sensitivity_en: White gloves and some designs derive from blackface minstrelsy: avoid racial caricature, and avoid trademarked mouse, cat and flapper-girl characters.

styles.era_origin: USA, late 1930s-1950s studio theatrical shorts.
styles.prompt_fragment: 1940s theatrical cartoon short frame: saturated three-strip Technicolor palette, lush hand-painted gouache backgrounds with soft perspective, inked cel characters with full squash-and-stretch volume and exaggerated slapstick poses, subtle cel shadows, warm film grain and slight softness of 35mm projection
styles.avoid: Avoid flat cartoon-modern simplification and modern digital lines.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable; it gravitates toward famous studio characters.
styles.sensitivity_note: Steer away from trademarked rabbit, duck and cat-and-mouse designs; some 1940s shorts contain racist and wartime propaganda caricatures.
styles.short_de: Satt gefärbter Technicolor-Cartoon mit üppig gemalten Hintergründen, voller Squash-and-Stretch-Animation und Slapstick-Posen; Look amerikanischer Kino-Kurzfilme der späten 1930er bis 1950er.
styles.short_en: Saturated Technicolor cartoon with lush painted backgrounds, full squash-and-stretch animation and slapstick poses; the look of American studio theatrical shorts from the late 1930s to the 1950s.
styles.sensitivity_de: Geschützte Hasen-, Enten- und Katz-und-Maus-Figuren vermeiden; manche Kurzfilme der 1940er enthalten rassistische Karikaturen und Kriegspropaganda.
styles.sensitivity_en: Steer away from trademarked rabbit, duck and cat-and-mouse designs; some 1940s shorts contain racist and wartime propaganda caricatures.

styles.era_origin: USA, 1959-1980s, when animators' drawings were photocopied onto cels instead of hand-inked.

styles.era_origin: Britain and the USA, c. 1830-1900, when large wood type made cheap letterpress handbills, playbills and auction notices possible.

black and one red on cream paper

styles.sensitivity_de: Zeitgenössische Etiketten zeigten oft rassistische oder exotisierende Karikaturen; diese Muster nicht übernehmen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Period labels often used racist or exoticising caricatures; do not reproduce those tropes.

styles.era_origin: Paris, c. 1880-1900, colour lithographic posters for cabarets, theatres and consumer products.
visual_markers: Large flat colour silhouettes with loose crayon contours
Japanese-print cropping and tilted floor planes
Hand-drawn lettering woven into the image
Visible stone grain on off-white paper
styles.prompt_fragment: as a Parisian Belle Epoque lithographic poster: large flat colour silhouettes with loose crayon contour lines, Japanese-print-style cropping and tilted floor planes, crachis spatter texture, a few inks of olive, black, orange and yellow, hand-drawn lettering woven into the image, visible stone grain on off-white paper
styles.avoid: Do not drift into ornamental Art Nouveau halos and floral frames; keep it sketchy, spattered and silhouette-driven.
styles.feasibility_note: Silhouettes and lettering work; spatter and crayon grain often come out too clean or as digital noise.
styles.short_de: Pariser Farblithografien mit großen, flächigen Silhouetten, lockeren Kreidekonturen, Anschnitten nach japanischem Vorbild und Spritztechnik, für Kabaretts, Theater und Markenartikel um 1880–1900.
styles.short_en: Parisian colour lithograph posters with large flat silhouettes, loose crayon contours, Japanese-style cropping and spatter texture, made for cabarets, theatres and products around 1880–1900.
markers_de: Anschnitte wie im japanischen Farbholzschnitt, gekippte Böden
markers_en: large flat silhouettes with crayon contours

styles.era_origin: Europe, c. 1890-1910 (Paris, Brussels, Munich, Vienna).
visual_markers: Whiplash curves of even line weight
Circular mosaic halo behind the central element
Stylised floral borders and ornamental panels
Muted sage, dusty rose, ochre and gold
Custom organic lettering in decorative panels
styles.prompt_fragment: as an Art Nouveau lithographic poster: sinuous whiplash contour lines of even weight, central element framed by a circular mosaic halo, stylised floral borders and ornamental panels, custom organic lettering, muted palette of sage, dusty rose, ochre and gold, flat colour fills on aged paper
styles.avoid: Avoid glossy fantasy-art rendering and photoreal faces; keep flat lithographic fills, uniform outlines and strict ornamental framing.
styles.feasibility_note: One of the most reliably rendered historical styles; text inside ornamental panels may need retries.
styles.sensitivity_note: Aliases naming a deceased artist are common; keep the prompt descriptive rather than name-based.
styles.short_de: Dekorative Lithografie-Plakate mit Peitschenhieb-Linien, rundem Nimbus hinter der Hauptfigur, Blütenbordüren und organischer Schrift in gedämpftem Salbei, Altrosa und Gold; Europa 1890–1910.
styles.short_en: Decorative lithograph posters with whiplash curves, a round halo behind the central figure, floral borders and organic lettering in muted sage, rose and gold, Europe 1890–1910.
markers_de: gedämpftes Salbei, Altrosa, Ocker und Gold
markers_en: whiplash curves of even line weight
circular halo behind the central motif
muted sage, dusty rose, ochre and gold
styles.sensitivity_de: Gängige Bezeichnungen nennen oft einen verstorbenen Künstler; Prompts lieber beschreibend als namensbasiert formulieren.
styles.sensitivity_en: Common aliases name a deceased artist; keep prompts descriptive rather than name-based.

styles.era_origin: Vienna, 1897-c. 1915: Secession exhibition posters and the journal Ver Sacrum.
visual_markers: Rectilinear ornament of small squares and chequer bands
Large calm empty fields and strict symmetry
Black, white and gold with one muted accent
styles.prompt_fragment: as a Vienna Secession exhibition poster: tall narrow format, strict symmetry, rectilinear ornament of small squares and chequer bands, blocky geometric hand-drawn capitals, large calm empty fields, flat black, white and gold with one muted accent colour, forms dissolved into flat patterned surfaces
styles.avoid: Avoid French Art Nouveau curls and floral excess; Secession is squared, sparse and geometric.
styles.feasibility_note: The gold-and-pattern look is well known to the model, but it slides into generic Art Nouveau unless the geometry is stressed.
styles.short_de: Wiener Ausstellungsplakate und Zeitschriftengrafik mit strenger Symmetrie, Quadratornamentik, kantigen handgezeichneten Versalien und großen Leerflächen in Schwarz, Weiß und Gold, 1897–1915.
styles.short_en: Viennese exhibition posters and magazine graphics with strict symmetry, square-grid ornament, blocky hand-drawn capitals and large empty fields in black, white and gold, 1897–1915.
markers_de: Ornament aus kleinen Quadraten und Schachbrettbändern
Schwarz, Weiß und Gold mit einem Akzent
markers_en: ornament of small squares and chequer bands
black, white and gold with one accent

styles.era_origin: England from 1891 (private presses reviving incunabula), later German and American private presses.
visual_markers: Heavy roman or semi-gothic type in solid black
Handmade deckle-edged paper with deep impression
styles.prompt_fragment: as an Arts and Crafts private-press page: dense black woodcut border of interlaced vines and leaves, heavy roman type in solid black with red rubricated headings, an oversized ornamental initial, woodcut illustration boxed within the border, deep impression on handmade deckle-edged paper
styles.avoid: Avoid glossy fantasy filigree and digital scrollwork; it must stay monochrome woodcut, dense and printed.
styles.feasibility_note: Borders render well; continuous body text becomes pseudo-text, which is fine as texture but not readable.
styles.short_de: Buchseiten nach dem Vorbild der Inkunabeln, mit dichten Rankenbordüren im Holzschnitt, schwerer schwarzer Type, roten Überschriften und großen Initialen; englische Privatpressen ab 1891.
styles.short_en: Book pages modelled on early printed books, with dense vine-and-leaf woodcut borders, heavy black type, red headings and large initials, from English private presses after 1891.
styles.era_de: ab 1891, England; später Deutschland und USA
styles.era_en: from 1891, England; later Germany and USA
markers_de: dichte Ranken- und Blattbordüren im Holzschnitt

styles.era_origin: Berlin, c. 1905-1918, starting with Lucian Bernhard's match poster of 1905/06 and the printer Hollerbaum & Schmidt.
visual_markers: One product as the only image
One bold hand-drawn word, usually the brand
Two to four flat colours, no gradients
styles.prompt_fragment: as an early German Sachplakat: the subject shown large and flat on a plain solid background, two to four flat lithographic colours without gradients, thick simplified outlines, one bold hand-drawn word of lettering, no slogan and no decoration, a strong silhouette readable from across the street
styles.avoid: Avoid adding scenery, extra figures, slogans or glossy 3D product rendering; the whole idea is radical reduction.
styles.feasibility_note: Simple flat compositions with a single word of type are a strong suit.
styles.sensitivity_note: Use invented product names; many brands from the period are still trademarked.
styles.short_de: Deutsches Werbeplakat, das nur das Produkt groß und flächig vor schlichtem Grund zeigt, dazu ein kräftig gezeichnetes Markenwort; um 1905 in Berlin entstanden.
styles.short_en: German advertising poster that shows only the product, large and flat on a plain ground, with one bold hand-drawn brand word; begun in Berlin around 1905.
markers_en: one product as the only image
styles.sensitivity_de: Erfundene Produktnamen verwenden; viele Marken jener Zeit sind noch geschützt.
styles.sensitivity_en: Use invented product names; many brands of the period are still trademarked.

styles.era_origin: Munich, c. 1906-1930, lithographic posters for fashion, coffee, sport and travel.
visual_markers: Forms built from interlocking flat colour patches
Hard sunlight and shadow as separate shapes, edges dissolving into the paper
Checked and striped textiles used as graphic fields
Compact block lettering in a band or corner
styles.prompt_fragment: as a Munich lithographic poster of the 1910s: forms built from interlocking flat colour patches, hard sunlight and shadow rendered as separate shapes with edges dissolving into the paper, checked and striped textiles as graphic fields, mottled overprinted ink textures, warm earthy palette, compact block lettering
styles.avoid: Avoid smooth painterly shading and heroic monumental posing; light should be flat patches and the mood relaxed and commercial.
styles.feasibility_note: Flat light-and-shadow patching works when spelled out; the mottled overprint texture is often lost.
styles.sensitivity_note: Ludwig Hohlwein (d. 1949) joined the NSDAP in 1933 and produced Nazi propaganda. Draw on the pre-1930s commercial look only and never on the later heroic propaganda imagery.
styles.short_de: Münchner Lithografie-Plakate für Mode, Kaffee und Reisen, aufgebaut aus verzahnten Farbflächen mit harten Licht- und Schattenformen und fleckigem Farbauftrag, ca. 1906–1930.
styles.short_en: Munich lithograph posters for fashion, coffee and travel, built from interlocking flat colour patches with hard light and shadow shapes and mottled ink, c. 1906–1930.
markers_de: Karo- und Streifenstoffe als grafische Flächen
markers_en: hard light and shadow as separate shapes
checked and striped fabrics as graphic fields
styles.sensitivity_de: Ludwig Hohlwein († 1949) trat 1933 der NSDAP bei und gestaltete NS-Propaganda; nur den kommerziellen Stil vor 1930 aufgreifen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Ludwig Hohlwein (d. 1949) joined the NSDAP in 1933 and made Nazi propaganda; use only the pre-1930s commercial look.

styles.era_origin: Basel, Switzerland, c. 1920-1955, lithographed product posters, peaking in the 1940s-50s.
visual_markers: One everyday object painted hyper-realistically and enlarged
Soft cast shadow anchoring the object
A slight surreal twist of scale or placement
A single brand word or very short slogan
styles.prompt_fragment: as a Swiss magic-realist object poster: the subject painted with meticulous hyper-real lithographic detail, enlarged and isolated on a flat single-colour background, a soft cast shadow, a subtle surreal twist of scale or placement, a single brand word in clean lettering, quiet, precise, generous empty space
styles.avoid: Avoid photographic packshots and glossy CGI; it must read as precisely painted lithography with a slight surreal twist.
styles.feasibility_note: Hyper-real isolated objects are easy; the risk is drifting into photography, so stress 'painted lithograph'.
styles.sensitivity_note: Use invented brand names.
styles.short_de: Schweizer Produktplakate mit einem einzelnen Alltagsgegenstand in überscharfer Malerei, vergrößert vor flachem Grund mit weichem Schatten; Basel, Höhepunkt in den 1940er- und 1950er-Jahren.
styles.short_en: Swiss product posters showing one everyday object painted with hyper-real precision, enlarged on a flat background with a soft shadow; Basel, at its height in the 1940s–50s.
markers_de: ein Gegenstand, überscharf gemalt und vergrößert
styles.sensitivity_de: Erfundene Markennamen verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Use invented brand names.

styles.era_origin: France and Europe, c. 1925-1940: posters for ocean liners, railways and aperitifs.
visual_markers: Monumental low-angle perspective with converging lines
Smooth airbrushed gradients on faceted planes
Streamlined forms and parallel speed lines
Tall geometric or stencil capitals in a band
Navy, black, vermilion, gold and cream
styles.prompt_fragment: as a 1930s Art Deco poster: monumental low-angle geometry with converging perspective, smooth airbrushed gradients on faceted planes, streamlined forms and parallel speed lines, tall geometric or stencil capital lettering in a band, limited palette of navy, black, vermilion, gold and cream, lithographic print
styles.avoid: Avoid gold-filigree 'Gatsby party' ornament; the poster version is geometric, airbrushed and monumental.
styles.feasibility_note: Well represented in training; airbrush gradients render cleanly.
styles.sensitivity_note: Real shipping-line and railway names may still be trademarks; describe the style instead of naming deceased masters.
styles.short_de: Französische und europäische Plakate für Ozeandampfer, Eisenbahnen und Aperitifs mit monumentaler Untersicht, gespritzten Verläufen, Tempolinien und hohen geometrischen Versalien, ca. 1925–1940.
styles.short_en: French and European posters for liners, railways and aperitifs with monumental low-angle geometry, airbrushed gradients, speed lines and tall geometric capitals, c. 1925–1940.
markers_de: Marineblau, Schwarz, Zinnober, Gold und Creme
markers_en: navy, black, vermilion, gold and cream
styles.sensitivity_de: Namen von Reedereien und Bahnen können noch geschützt sein; den Stil beschreiben, statt verstorbene Meister zu nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Shipping-line and railway names may still be trademarks; describe the style rather than naming deceased masters.

styles.era_origin: Combatant nations, 1914-1918 and 1939-1945.
visual_markers: A single painted figure addressing the viewer directly
Bold imperative slogan in heavy capitals at top and bottom
Gouache rendering with simplified planes of shading
Red, navy, khaki and cream palette
Close cropping and a strong diagonal
styles.prompt_fragment: as a 1940s home-front poster: the subject painted in direct address to the viewer, gouache rendering with simplified planes of shading, a bold imperative slogan in heavy capitals across top and bottom, limited palette of red, navy, khaki and cream, lithographic texture, close cropping and a strong diagonal
styles.avoid: Avoid modern glossy rendering, and never reuse real slogans, flags or military insignia.
styles.feasibility_note: Figure and slogan come out reliably; use invented, harmless slogans (recycling, public health, civic topics).
styles.sensitivity_note: Propaganda format. Never use Nazi, fascist or other extremist symbols (in Germany §86a StGB applies), real wartime slogans or racist enemy caricatures.
styles.short_de: Plakate beider Weltkriege, auf denen eine gemalte Figur den Betrachter direkt anspricht, mit fettem Appell in Versalien und einer Palette aus Rot, Marineblau und Khaki.
styles.short_en: Posters of both world wars in which a painted figure addresses the viewer, with an imperative slogan in heavy capitals and a red, navy and khaki palette.
markers_de: gemalte Figur spricht den Betrachter an
styles.sensitivity_de: Propagandaformat: keine NS-, faschistischen oder anderen extremistischen Symbole (in Deutschland gilt § 86a StGB), keine echten Kriegsparolen, keine rassistischen Feindbilder.
styles.sensitivity_en: A propaganda format: never use Nazi, fascist or other extremist symbols (§86a StGB applies in Germany), real wartime slogans or racist enemy caricatures.

styles.era_origin: Italy, 1909-1930s: Futurist manifestos, books and posters.
visual_markers: Words exploding across the sheet at many angles and sizes
Red, black and silver on off-white
styles.prompt_fragment: as an Italian Futurist typographic composition: words and letters exploding across the sheet at many angles and sizes, onomatopoeic fragments, radiating lines of force, fragmented repeated forms suggesting speed and noise, mixed bold sans and slab type, red and black ink with silver accents on off-white paper
styles.avoid: Avoid tidy grids and calm Swiss balance; everything should be in motion and deliberately loud.
styles.feasibility_note: Scattered type works; precise, legible words at steep angles are inconsistent.
styles.sensitivity_note: Futurism was closely tied to Italian Fascism; keep to its formal language and leave out its political imagery.
styles.short_de: Italienische Avantgarde-Layouts, in denen Wörter und Buchstaben in vielen Winkeln und Größen über das Blatt explodieren, mit Lautwörtern und Kraftlinien; 1909 bis in die 1930er.
styles.short_en: Italian avant-garde layouts in which words and letters burst across the page at many angles and sizes, with sound words and lines of force, 1909 to the 1930s.
markers_de: Wörter in vielen Winkeln und Größen
Rot, Schwarz und Silber auf gebrochenem Weiß
markers_en: words exploding at many angles and sizes
red, black and silver on off-white
styles.sensitivity_de: Der Futurismus war eng mit dem italienischen Faschismus verbunden; nur die Formensprache nutzen, keine politischen Motive.
styles.sensitivity_en: Futurism was closely tied to Italian Fascism; use its formal language and leave out political imagery.

styles.era_origin: Soviet Russia, c. 1919-1932.
visual_markers: Black-and-white photomontage cut-outs combined with geometric wedges, circles and bars
Heavy condensed sans-serif in angled blocks
Cheap paper, letterpress and offset texture
styles.prompt_fragment: as a Russian Constructivist poster: hard diagonal composition, red, black and off-white only, black-and-white photomontage cut-outs combined with flat geometric wedges, circles and bars, heavy condensed sans-serif lettering set in angled blocks, letterpress and offset texture on cheap paper
styles.avoid: Avoid adding hammer-and-sickle or real Soviet slogans by default, and avoid smooth digital vector polish.
styles.feasibility_note: Iconic and well learned; Cyrillic often comes out as pseudo-Cyrillic, so use Latin text or none.
styles.sensitivity_note: Communist political iconography; keep the use formal rather than ideological and avoid nonsensical fake Cyrillic.
styles.short_de: Sowjetische Avantgarde-Plakate mit harten Diagonalen, Fotomontage, geometrischen Keilen und schweren Groteskblöcken in Rot, Schwarz und gebrochenem Weiß, ca. 1919–1932.
styles.short_en: Soviet avant-garde posters with hard diagonals, photomontage cut-outs, geometric wedges and heavy sans-serif blocks in red, black and off-white, c. 1919–1932.
markers_de: nur Rot, Schwarz und gebrochenes Weiß
Fotomontage mit geometrischen Keilen und Balken
schwere, schmale Grotesk in schrägen Blöcken
markers_en: photomontage with geometric wedges and bars
heavy condensed sans-serif in angled blocks
styles.sensitivity_de: Trägt kommunistische Bildsprache; formal statt ideologisch einsetzen und kein sinnloses Pseudo-Kyrillisch erzeugen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Carries communist political iconography; use it formally, not ideologically, and avoid nonsensical fake Cyrillic.

styles.era_origin: Germany: Bauhaus Weimar and Dessau 1919-1933, and Tschichold's 'Die neue Typographie' (1928).
visual_markers: Circle, square and triangle as building blocks
Asymmetric layout with heavy bars and rules
Red, black and yellow on off-white
styles.prompt_fragment: as a Bauhaus-era poster: asymmetric layout built from circles, squares and triangles, heavy black bars and rules, geometric sans-serif lettering in lowercase, some lines rotated ninety degrees, red, black and yellow on off-white paper, flat offset print with slight registration shift
styles.avoid: Avoid the wallpaper cliché of random pastel shapes; keep a functional typographic hierarchy and the primary palette.
styles.feasibility_note: Well learned; lowercase geometric type renders reliably at large sizes.
styles.sensitivity_note: 'Bauhaus' is also a registered trademark of a hardware retail chain; use it only as a historical style term.
styles.short_de: Moderne deutsche Gebrauchsgrafik mit asymmetrischem Aufbau aus Kreisen, Quadraten und schweren Balken, kleingeschriebener geometrischer Grotesk und Rot-Schwarz auf Weiß; Bauhaus, 1919–1933.
styles.short_en: German modernist graphics with asymmetric layouts of circles, squares and heavy bars, lowercase geometric sans-serif and red and black on white, Bauhaus and New Typography, 1919–1933.
markers_de: Kreis, Quadrat und Dreieck als Grundformen
Rot, Schwarz und Gelb auf gebrochenem Weiß
markers_en: circle, square and triangle as building blocks
red, black and yellow on off-white
styles.sensitivity_de: „Bauhaus“ ist auch eine eingetragene Marke einer Baumarktkette; nur als historischen Stilbegriff verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: 'Bauhaus' is also a registered trademark of a hardware chain; use it only as a historical style term.

styles.era_origin: Vienna, 1925-1934 (Gesellschafts- und Wirtschaftsmuseum), later The Hague and Oxford.
visual_markers: Quantities shown as rows of repeated, identical pictograms
Brick red, slate blue, black and ochre on cream
styles.prompt_fragment: as an Isotype pictorial statistic: quantities shown as rows of repeated identical flat silhouette pictograms, one symbol per fixed unit and never enlarged, strict horizontal rows, muted flat colours of brick red, slate blue, black and ochre on cream paper, plain sans-serif labels, no gradients or 3D
styles.avoid: Avoid glossy modern infographic icons, pie charts and scaled-up symbols; counts are always repetitions of equal-sized pictograms.
styles.feasibility_note: Style and repetition are good; exact pictogram counts are unreliable, so check every number.
styles.short_de: Bildstatistik, die Mengen als Reihen gleicher, flacher Piktogramme darstellt, von denen jedes für eine feste Anzahl steht; ab 1925 in Wien entwickelt, um 1935 Isotype genannt.
styles.short_en: Pictorial statistics that show quantities as rows of identical flat pictograms, each standing for a fixed amount, developed in Vienna from 1925 and named Isotype around 1935.
styles.era_de: 1925–1934, Wien; danach Den Haag und Oxford
styles.era_en: 1925–1934, Vienna; then The Hague and Oxford
markers_de: Ziegelrot, Schieferblau, Schwarz und Ocker auf Creme
markers_en: brick red, slate blue, black and ochre on cream

styles.era_origin: Soviet Union from 1932; Eastern Bloc and China c. 1949-1976.
visual_markers: Idealised heroic forms seen from slightly below
Red-dominated palette with gold and sky blue
Large slogan banner in heavy capitals
styles.prompt_fragment: as a mid-century socialist realist poster: the subject idealised and heroic, seen from slightly below, confident and gazing toward a radiant sunburst horizon, smooth gouache rendering with rosy highlights, red-dominated palette with gold and sky blue, crowds or fields receding behind, bold slogan banner in heavy capitals
styles.avoid: Avoid real party emblems, leader portraits and real slogans, and avoid the photoreal 'epic AI' look; it must stay a painted print.
styles.feasibility_note: Painted heroic posters are well represented; slogans need to be short.
styles.sensitivity_note: Strong political connotations (Stalinism, Maoism). Never depict real leaders, party emblems or real slogans; some of these symbols are legally restricted in several countries.
styles.short_de: Staatliche Plakate mit idealisierten Heldenfiguren in Untersicht vor strahlender Sonne, in glatter Gouache mit Rot, Gold und Himmelblau; Sowjetunion ab 1932, China bis 1976.
styles.short_en: State posters showing idealised heroic figures from below against a radiant sunburst, in smooth gouache with red, gold and sky blue, from the Soviet Union and Mao-era China.
styles.era_de: ab 1932, Sowjetunion; ca. 1949–1976, Ostblock und China
styles.era_en: from 1932, USSR; c. 1949–1976, Eastern Bloc and China
markers_de: rotdominierte Palette mit Gold und Himmelblau
markers_en: idealised heroic figures seen from below
red-dominated palette with gold and sky blue
large slogan banner in heavy capitals
styles.sensitivity_de: Stark stalinistisch und maoistisch besetzt; keine realen Führer, Parteiembleme oder echten Parolen zeigen, manche dieser Symbole sind in mehreren Ländern verboten.
styles.sensitivity_en: Strong Stalinist and Maoist connotations; never show real leaders, party emblems or real slogans, as some of these symbols are legally restricted in several countries.

styles.era_origin: USSR, 1957-1970s, after Sputnik and the first crewed spaceflight.
visual_markers: Deep navy cosmos with stylised stars and a curved planet limb
Rockets on bold upward diagonals with long exhaust trails
Flat red, white and pale blue shapes
styles.prompt_fragment: as a 1960s space-age poster: deep navy cosmos with stylised stars and the curved limb of a planet, bold upward diagonals trailing long white exhaust, flat shapes of red, white and pale blue, orbital ellipses, simplified gouache figures and machines, heavy condensed lettering, offset print on matte paper
styles.avoid: Avoid photoreal space photography and glossy sci-fi concept art; keep it flat, graphic and optimistic.
styles.feasibility_note: Flat cosmic compositions render reliably.
styles.sensitivity_note: Soviet state emblems and Cyrillic slogans carry political weight; use invented text and leave out emblems.
styles.short_de: Flächige, optimistische Plakate mit Raketen, Umlaufbahnen und Kosmonauten vor nachtblauem All, entstanden in der Sowjetunion nach Sputnik und Gagarins Flug.
styles.short_en: Flat, optimistic posters of rockets, orbits and cosmonauts against deep navy space, produced in the Soviet Union after Sputnik and Gagarin's flight.
markers_de: Nachtblauer Himmel mit stilisierten Sternen und gekrümmtem Planetenrand
Raketen auf steilen Diagonalen mit langen Abgasstreifen
markers_en: Deep navy sky with stylised stars and a curved planet edge
Rockets on steep diagonals with long exhaust trails
Flat red, white and pale blue
styles.sensitivity_de: Sowjetische Staatssymbole und kyrillische Parolen sind politisch aufgeladen; besser erfundenen Text verwenden und Embleme weglassen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Soviet state emblems and Cyrillic slogans carry political weight; use invented text and leave out emblems.

styles.era_origin: Paris, May-June 1968, printed overnight in the occupied Ecole des Beaux-Arts.
visual_markers: One flat ink colour on cheap thin white paper
Crude bold silhouette drawn fast with a brush
styles.prompt_fragment: as a 1968 street-protest silkscreen: one flat ink colour on cheap thin white paper, a crude bold silhouette drawn fast with a brush, hand-cut stencil lettering for a short slogan, uneven squeegee coverage with pinholes and blotches, extreme reduction, urgent and handmade
styles.avoid: Avoid polished vector political graphics and multi-colour printing; it must look made overnight in a single colour.
styles.feasibility_note: One-colour crude prints render well; ask explicitly for imperfect ink.
styles.sensitivity_note: A political protest format; avoid reproducing real 1968 slogans or using it for real partisan campaigning.
styles.short_de: Grobe einfarbige Siebdruckplakate mit hastig gepinselten Silhouetten und knappen Schablonenparolen, im Mai 1968 nachts in der besetzten Pariser Kunsthochschule gedruckt.
styles.short_en: Crude one-colour silkscreen posters with brush-drawn silhouettes and short stencilled slogans, printed overnight in the occupied Paris art school in May 1968.
markers_de: Eine einzige flache Farbe auf dünnem Billigpapier
Ungleichmäßiger Farbauftrag mit Löchern und Flecken
markers_en: One flat ink on thin cheap paper
Uneven squeegee coverage with pinholes and blotches
styles.sensitivity_de: Ein politisches Protestformat; keine echten Parolen von 1968 nachbauen und nicht für reale Parteiwerbung einsetzen.
styles.sensitivity_en: A political protest format; do not reproduce real 1968 slogans or use it for actual party campaigning.

styles.era_origin: USA, 1935-1943, poster divisions of the WPA Federal Art Project.
visual_markers: Three to five flat opaque silkscreen inks
Simplified, streamlined shapes and stylised figures
Bold condensed sans-serif lettering in a top/bottom hierarchy
Matte layered ink with slight misregistration
styles.prompt_fragment: as a 1930s New Deal public-service silkscreen poster: three to five flat opaque inks, simplified streamlined shapes and stylised figures, bold condensed sans-serif lettering in a clear top-and-bottom hierarchy, muted palette of rust, teal, mustard and cream, matte layered ink with slight misregistration
styles.avoid: Avoid gradients and photoreal detail, and do not let it default to a national-park landscape print.
styles.feasibility_note: Flat silkscreen look is reliable; mild misregistration needs to be requested.
styles.short_de: Plakate für Behörden, Gesundheitskampagnen und Veranstaltungen in wenigen flachen Siebdruckfarben, mit stromlinienförmigen Figuren und kräftiger Grotesk, entstanden im Federal Art Project des New Deal.
styles.short_en: Public-service and event posters in a few flat silkscreen inks with streamlined shapes and bold sans-serif type, made by the New Deal Federal Art Project.
markers_de: Drei bis fünf flache, deckende Farben
Kräftige schmale Grotesk oben und unten
markers_en: Three to five flat opaque inks
Bold condensed sans-serif at top and bottom

styles.era_origin: USA, WPA national park series c. 1938-1941; widely revived since the 2000s.
visual_markers: Landscape built from layered flat colour planes
Heavy title band of slab capitals along the bottom
Grainy ink texture and a thin border
styles.prompt_fragment: as a vintage national park silkscreen poster: the scene built from layered flat colour planes receding into distance, a banded sunset sky, crisp foreground silhouettes, five or six muted inks with slight registration offsets and grainy ink texture, a heavy title band of bold slab capitals along the bottom, thin border
styles.avoid: Avoid photoreal landscape rendering and the over-polished 'vintage overlay' look of mass-produced reproductions.
styles.feasibility_note: Very well learned; the danger is that it looks too generic, not that it fails.
styles.sensitivity_note: The modern revival is dominated by commercial studios; do not copy their series or the park service's arrowhead emblem (a trademark).
styles.short_de: Landschaften aus gestaffelten Farbflächen mit kräftigem Titelband, nach dem Vorbild der WPA-Nationalparkserie von 1938–41 und seit den 2000ern als Retrostil wieder verbreitet.
styles.short_en: Landscapes built from layered flat colour planes with a heavy title band, based on the WPA national park series of 1938–41 and widely revived since the 2000s.
markers_en: Landscape in layered flat colour planes

styles.avoid: Avoid modern photoreal sci-fi concept art; keep the airbrush grain and paperback wear.
styles.feasibility_note: Airbrushed retro sci-fi is well represented.

styles.short_en: Airbrush and gouache paintings of colossal spacecraft and structures against glowing horizons, with tiny figures for scale; British, American and European paperbacks of about 1968 to 1985.

styles.era_origin: c. 2017-present, mainly US literary fiction and nonfiction; named in 2019 press coverage.
visual_markers: Enormous fat lettering filling the cover
Built to read as a thumbnail
styles.prompt_fragment: as a contemporary literary book cover: enormous fat lettering filling most of the cover, bright amorphous colour blobs and organic shapes overlapping behind and through it, flat saturated palette, no photography, built to read at thumbnail size, matte soft-touch finish
styles.avoid: Included as a contemporary-cliché reference; for distinctiveness, combine it with an unusual palette or hand-painted lettering.
styles.feasibility_note: Easy; large type is rendered accurately.
styles.short_de: Riesige fette Schrift über knalligen, amorphen Farbflecken füllt das ganze Cover, flächig und ohne Foto, auf Wirkung als Thumbnail angelegt; US-Belletristik und Sachbuch ab etwa 2017.
styles.short_en: Covers filled by huge fat lettering over bright amorphous colour blobs, flat and without photos, designed to read as thumbnails; US literary fiction and nonfiction from about 2017.

markers_en: Enormous fat lettering filling the cover
Built to read as a thumbnail

styles.era_origin: The 'Big Book Look' dates from the 1960s-70s; the current thriller formula has been standard since the 1990s.
visual_markers: Author name larger than the title, embossed metallic
Subject reduced to a small silhouette
Moody desaturated photo with one colour accent
styles.prompt_fragment: as a mass-market thriller cover: author name in huge embossed metallic capitals larger than the title, the subject reduced to a small lonely silhouette, moody desaturated photographic backdrop with one colour accent, bold condensed sans-serif title, short ominous tagline, glossy laminate
styles.avoid: Use it as a genre contrast; it differentiates by making typography dominant and keeping the image small.
styles.feasibility_note: Formulaic and easy to hit.
styles.short_de: Thriller-Cover, auf dem der geprägte Metallic-Autorenname größer ist als der Titel und das Motiv zur kleinen Silhouette schrumpft; Bestsellerformel, hervorgegangen aus dem „Big Book Look“ von 1956.
styles.short_en: Thriller cover where the embossed metallic author name dwarfs the title and the image shrinks to a small silhouette; mass-market formula rooted in the 1956 'Big Book Look'.
styles.era_de: seit den 1980ern, USA und Großbritannien; Wurzeln im „Big Book Look“ ab 1956
styles.era_en: since the 1980s, USA and UK; roots in the 1956 'Big Book Look'
markers_de: Autorenname größer als der Titel, metallisch geprägt
Motiv auf eine kleine Silhouette reduziert
Düsteres, entsättigtes Foto mit einer Akzentfarbe
markers_en: Author name larger than the title, embossed metallic
Subject reduced to a small silhouette
Moody desaturated photo with one colour accent

styles.era_origin: German book series from 1912 onward, building on the decorative-paper tradition since the 17th century.
visual_markers: Classic serif type with thin ornamental rules
styles.prompt_fragment: as a small hardcover bound in decorative patterned paper: the subject stylised into an all-over repeating print in two or three muted inks, a small pasted-on rectangular title label with classic serif type and thin ornamental rules, slightly raised label edge, worn corners
styles.avoid: Avoid photographic or illustrated full-bleed covers; the subject appears only as a stylised repeating pattern.
styles.feasibility_note: Repeating patterns and small labels render well.
styles.sensitivity_note: The best-known example is a publisher's series and brand; describe it and do not reproduce its marks.
styles.short_de: Kleiner Pappband in flächig gemustertem Buntpapier mit aufgeklebtem Titelschild; deutsche Buchreihen seit 1912, in der Tradition älterer Buntpapiereinbände.
styles.short_en: Small hardcover bound in all-over patterned decorative paper with a pasted-on title label; German book series since 1912, continuing the older decorative-paper binding tradition.
markers_en: Classic serif type with thin ornamental rules
styles.sensitivity_de: Bekanntestes Beispiel ist eine Verlagsreihe und Marke; den Look beschreiben, ihre Zeichen nicht nachbilden.
styles.sensitivity_en: The best-known example is a publisher's series and brand; describe the look without its marks.

styles.era_origin: New York, c. 1955-1967: independent modern-jazz labels.
visual_markers: Grainy black-and-white photo tinted one flat colour
Bold condensed sans stacked and repeated like rhythm
styles.prompt_fragment: as a late-1950s modern jazz record sleeve: square format, grainy high-contrast black-and-white photograph tinted in a single flat colour such as blue or orange, radical asymmetric cropping, bold condensed sans-serif lettering stacked and repeated like rhythm, flat colour blocks, worn cardboard sleeve with ring wear
styles.avoid: Avoid generic smoky-saxophone scenes; the typography and tinted crop make the style.
styles.feasibility_note: Tinted photos and condensed type render reliably.
styles.sensitivity_note: Strongly identified with one still-active label's trade dress; avoid its logo and name.
styles.short_de: Quadratische Hüllen mit körnigen, einfarbig getönten Schwarzweißfotos, radikalen Anschnitten und gestapelter schmaler Grotesk; unabhängige New Yorker Jazzlabels etwa 1955 bis 1967.
styles.short_en: Square sleeves with grainy black-and-white photos tinted one flat colour, radical cropping and stacked condensed sans type; independent New York modern-jazz labels around 1955 to 1967.
markers_de: Fette schmale Grotesk, rhythmisch gestapelt und wiederholt
markers_en: Grainy black-and-white photo tinted one flat colour
Bold condensed sans stacked and repeated like rhythm
styles.sensitivity_de: Eng mit dem Erscheinungsbild eines noch aktiven Labels verbunden; dessen Logo und Namen meiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Strongly tied to one still-active label's trade dress; avoid its logo and name.

styles.era_origin: UK and USA, 1970s-1990s.
visual_markers: Apocalyptic sky, lightning and fire glow
Angular chrome-and-flame logo across the top
Deep blacks, molten orange and steel blue
styles.prompt_fragment: as a 1980s heavy-metal album cover: square dark-fantasy acrylic painting with apocalyptic sky, lightning and fire glow, dramatic low angle, sharp angular chrome-and-flame logo across the top, deep blacks, molten orange and steel blue, slightly over-rendered airbrushed highlights
styles.avoid: Avoid the smoothness of modern digital matte painting; keep traditional paint and chrome lettering.
styles.feasibility_note: Fantasy painting and chrome logos are strengths.
styles.sensitivity_note: Several defining painters are living; do not name them.
styles.short_de: Quadratische Dark-Fantasy-Acrylmalerei mit Weltuntergangshimmel, Blitzen, Feuerschein und kantigem Chrom-Logo; britische und amerikanische Metal-Platten der 1970er bis 1990er.
styles.short_en: Square dark-fantasy acrylic paintings with apocalyptic skies, lightning, fire glow and an angular chrome logo; British and American metal records of the 1970s to 1990s.
markers_de: Kantiges Logo aus Chrom und Flammen am oberen Rand
Tiefes Schwarz, glühendes Orange und Stahlblau
markers_en: Apocalyptic sky, lightning and fire glow
Angular chrome-and-flame logo across the top
Deep blacks, molten orange and steel blue
styles.sensitivity_de: Mehrere prägende Maler leben noch; sie nicht namentlich nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Several defining painters are still alive; do not name them.

styles.era_origin: Norway and Scandinavia, early 1990s.
visual_markers: Illegible symmetrical logo of thorns and roots
styles.prompt_fragment: as an early-1990s black metal record sleeve: grainy high-contrast black-and-white photocopy look, bleak nocturnal atmosphere, an illegible symmetrical hand-drawn logo of thorns, roots and spikes, no colour at all, crushed blacks and lo-fi print damage, cold and hostile
styles.avoid: Avoid shiny heavy-metal chrome and fantasy colour; this is monochrome, lo-fi and frozen.
styles.feasibility_note: Illegible logos are easy because legibility is not required.
styles.sensitivity_note: Parts of the scene are linked to church arson and National Socialist black metal; avoid extremist symbols and church-burning imagery.
styles.short_de: Körnige, wie fotokopiert wirkende Schwarzweißhüllen mit unleserlichem Logo aus Dornen und Wurzeln und trostloser Winterstimmung; norwegischer und skandinavischer Black Metal der frühen 1990er.
styles.short_en: Grainy, photocopied-looking black-and-white sleeves with an illegible logo of thorns and roots and a bleak winter mood; Norwegian and Scandinavian black metal of the early 1990s.
markers_de: Unleserliches symmetrisches Logo aus Dornen und Wurzeln
markers_en: Illegible symmetrical logo of thorns and roots
styles.sensitivity_de: Teile der Szene stehen für Kirchenbrände und NS-Black-Metal; keine extremistischen Symbole und keine brennenden Kirchen zeigen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Parts of the scene are linked to church arson and neo-Nazi black metal; avoid extremist symbols and church-burning imagery.

styles.era_origin: Southern USA, c. 1995-2005: independent rap labels and mixtapes.
visual_markers: Maximalist early-Photoshop composite with cut-out edges
Bevel, emboss and outer glow everywhere
styles.prompt_fragment: as a late-1990s independent rap cover: maximalist early-Photoshop composite with obvious cut-out edges, chrome, gold and diamond-encrusted 3D lettering with bevel, emboss and outer glow, flames, sparkles and explosions, luxurious props stacked to excess, saturated purple-gold palette, crowded layout
styles.avoid: Avoid tasteful modern hip-hop minimalism; excess and visible Photoshop effects are the point.
styles.feasibility_note: Chrome type and composites render easily; deliberately crude cut-out edges need to be requested.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid racial stereotypes and glorification of guns or drugs. The best-known studio of this look is a trade name; do not name it.
styles.short_de: Überladene frühe Photoshop-Collagen mit 3D-Schrift aus Chrom und Diamanten, Flammen, Funkeln und gestapelten Luxusrequisiten; Cover unabhängiger Rap-Labels der US-Südstaaten etwa 1995 bis 2005.
styles.short_en: Overloaded early-Photoshop composites with chrome-and-diamond 3D lettering, flames, sparkles and stacked luxury props; covers for Southern US independent rap labels around 1995 to 2005.
markers_de: Überall Ebeneneffekte: abgeflachte Kante, Relief, Schein nach außen
Vollgestopftes Layout in Lila und Gold
markers_en: Maximalist early-Photoshop composite with cut-out edges
Bevel, emboss and outer glow everywhere
styles.sensitivity_de: Rassistische Klischees und die Verherrlichung von Waffen oder Drogen vermeiden; das bekannteste Studio des Looks nicht nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid racial stereotypes and glorifying guns or drugs; do not name the studio best known for the look.

styles.era_origin: Manchester and London, c. 1978-1985.
visual_markers: Little or no text on the front
Tiny precise sans type and catalogue number
styles.prompt_fragment: as a post-punk record sleeve: a single found image such as a technical diagram, classical fragment or industrial photograph recontextualised on a large calm flat colour field, little or no text on the front, tiny precise sans-serif type and a catalogue number, cool palette, subtle emboss on uncoated card
styles.avoid: Avoid punk collage and band photos; it is detached, cool and conceptual.
styles.feasibility_note: Restraint is achievable when 'little or no text' is stated.
styles.sensitivity_note: Associated with a living designer and a record label; do not name them or recreate famous sleeves.
styles.short_de: Kühle, konzeptuelle Plattenhüllen aus einem einzelnen Fundbild auf ruhiger Farbfläche mit winziger, präziser Typografie; Post-Punk aus Manchester und London, etwa 1978 bis 1985.
styles.short_en: Cool, conceptual record sleeves built from one found image on a calm flat colour field with tiny precise type; Manchester and London post-punk of about 1978 to 1985.
markers_de: Kaum oder kein Text auf der Vorderseite
markers_en: Little or no text on the front
Tiny precise sans type and catalogue number
styles.sensitivity_de: Mit einem lebenden Gestalter und einem Label verbunden; beide nicht nennen und keine bekannten Hüllen nachbauen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Associated with a living designer and a record label; do not name them or recreate famous sleeves.

styles.era_origin: Jamaica, 1970s-1990s, spreading to the sound-system scenes of London and New York.
visual_markers: Huge bold block lettering in clashing colours
Comic-style explosion starbursts with shouting text
Flat ink on brightly coloured stock
styles.prompt_fragment: as a Jamaican dancehall sound-system poster: huge bold block lettering stacked in clashing bright colours, comic-style explosion starbursts with shouting text, cut-out photo heads, dense line-up and venue text, flat letterpress or screenprint ink on brightly coloured stock, hand-made energy
styles.avoid: Avoid reggae clichés (lions, red-gold-green flags, cannabis leaves) and slick modern flyer templates.
styles.feasibility_note: Starbursts and block type render; dense line-up text becomes partly garbled.
styles.sensitivity_note: Jamaican cultural tradition; avoid using Rastafarian sacred symbols as decoration and avoid stereotypes.
styles.short_de: Straßenplakate für Soundsystem-Partys mit gestapelten fetten Blockbuchstaben in grellen Farben, Explosionssternen und dichtem Line-up auf Leuchtpapier; Jamaika ab den 1970ern, später London und New York.
styles.short_en: Street posters for sound-system dances: stacked bold block letters in clashing inks, starbursts and line-ups on bright paper; Jamaica from the 1970s, later London and New York.
styles.era_de: 1970er–1990er, Jamaika; später London und New York
styles.era_en: 1970s–1990s, Jamaica; later London and New York

Dichter Text zu Line-up und Ort

styles.sensitivity_en: Jamaican cultural tradition; do not use Rastafarian sacred symbols as decoration and avoid stereotypes.

styles.era_origin: Mumbai and other Indian cities, c. 1950s-1990s, before digital flex printing.
visual_markers: Painted collage of several faces at different scales
Saturated magenta, cyan, scarlet and yellow
Glossy highlights and coloured rim light
styles.prompt_fragment: as a hand-painted Indian film poster of the 1970s-80s: dramatic painted collage of several close-up faces at different scales, saturated magenta, cyan, scarlet and yellow, glossy highlights and coloured rim light, extruded three-dimensional title lettering, action vignettes, visible brushwork on a large painted hoarding
styles.avoid: Avoid modern digital film key art; it must read as hand-painted, high-saturation and collaged.
styles.feasibility_note: Saturated painted collage renders well; Devanagari text is often garbled.
styles.sensitivity_note: Indian cultural tradition; avoid stereotypes, do not depict real actors and avoid pseudo-Devanagari.
styles.short_de: Handgemalte Filmplakate und Großtafeln mit collagierten Gesichtern in verschiedenen Größen, satten Farben und plastischen Titeln; indisches Kino von den 1950ern bis zum Aufkommen des Digitaldrucks.
styles.short_en: Hand-painted film posters and hoardings with collaged faces at different scales, saturated colours and extruded 3D titles; Indian cinema from the 1950s until digital printing took over.
markers_de: Gemalte Collage mehrerer Gesichter in verschiedenen Größen
Sattes Magenta, Cyan, Scharlachrot und Gelb
markers_en: Painted collage of several faces at different scales
Saturated magenta, cyan, scarlet and yellow
Glossy highlights and coloured rim light
styles.sensitivity_de: Indische Kulturtradition; Klischees, Gesichter realer Schauspieler und Pseudo-Devanagari vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Indian cultural tradition; avoid stereotypes, real actors' likenesses and pseudo-Devanagari.

styles.era_origin: Hollywood, c. 1975-1990.
visual_markers: Airbrush and coloured-pencil montage of stacked figures
Warm golden backlight and glowing edges
Condensed billing block at the bottom
styles.prompt_fragment: as a 1980s painted adventure movie one-sheet: airbrush and coloured-pencil montage of stacked figures and floating faces at different scales, warm golden backlight and glowing edges, cascading action vignettes, chrome-gradient title logo, condensed billing-block text at the bottom, slightly yellowed paper
styles.avoid: Avoid modern photo-composite key art with teal-and-orange grading; it must be visibly hand-rendered.
styles.feasibility_note: Painted montage is a strength; the billing block becomes pseudo-text.
styles.sensitivity_note: Some iconic painters are living; do not name them or recreate specific posters. Studio logos are trademarks.
styles.short_de: Mit Airbrush und Farbstift gemalte Montagen aus gestaffelten Helden und schwebenden Gesichtern im warmen Gegenlicht unter einem Chrom-Titel; Hollywood-Abenteuerplakate etwa 1975 bis 1990.
styles.short_en: Airbrushed and pencil-rendered montages of stacked heroes and floating faces in warm backlight under a chrome title; Hollywood adventure and blockbuster posters of about 1975 to 1990.
markers_de: Montage gestaffelter Figuren in Airbrush und Farbstift
markers_en: Airbrush and coloured-pencil montage of stacked figures
Warm golden backlight and glowing edges
Condensed billing block at the bottom
styles.sensitivity_de: Einige prägende Plakatmaler leben noch; sie nicht nennen, keine konkreten Plakate nachbauen und keine Studiologos zeigen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Some defining painters are alive; do not name them or recreate specific posters, and avoid studio logos.

styles.era_origin: Became ubiquitous with flat design and content-marketing infographics around 2012-2016, spread through stock template marketplaces.
visual_markers: solid flat shapes with no texture or outlines
teal, coral, navy and mustard palette
numbered steps on a ribbon or zigzag path
styles.prompt_fragment: flat vector infographic, clean geometric shapes with no texture or outlines, harmonious teal, coral, navy and mustard palette, rounded icons in circle badges, oversized numerals, ribbon banners and numbered step markers, centered symmetrical layout on a light background, generous white space, crisp sans-serif labels
styles.avoid: Use only as a deliberate contrast specimen; adding glossy gradients or 3D depth turns it into the glossy-icon default instead.
styles.feasibility_note: The model's home turf; headings and big numbers render legibly, but body text in many small boxes garbles and chart values are decorative, never data-accurate.
styles.short_de: Flache Vektor-Infografik im Vorlagenlook mit Formen in Petrol, Koralle, Marineblau und Senfgelb, Icons in Kreisen und übergroßen Zahlen; seit etwa 2012 allgegenwärtig im Content-Marketing.
styles.short_en: Template-like flat vector infographic with teal, coral, navy and mustard shapes, icons in circle badges and oversized numbers; ubiquitous in content marketing from about 2012.
markers_de: Flache Vollflächen ohne Textur oder Kontur
Palette aus Petrol, Koralle, Marineblau und Senfgelb
Nummerierte Schritte auf Band oder Zickzackpfad
markers_en: Flat solid shapes, no texture or outlines
Teal, coral, navy and mustard palette
Numbered steps on a ribbon or zigzag path

styles.era_origin: Spread through 2020s app and SaaS marketing with 3D icon packs and glassmorphism; now strongly associated with AI output.
visual_markers: shiny rounded plastic icons with specular highlights
objects floating with soft drop shadows
styles.prompt_fragment: glossy 3D rendered infographic, shiny rounded plastic icons with specular highlights floating above frosted translucent glass panels, soft violet-to-blue gradient background, gentle drop shadows, subtle glow, studio lighting, perfectly smooth surfaces, bold sans-serif numbers on pill-shaped cards
styles.avoid: Use only as a contrast specimen; anything meant not to read as AI should drop this whole vocabulary of gloss, glow and gradient.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders effortlessly; short labels on glass cards are usually legible, though copy tends toward generic filler and numbers do not match chart geometry.
styles.short_de: Infografik mit glänzenden 3D-Plastikicons über Milchglas-Paneelen vor Verläufen von Violett zu Blau; Look des App- und SaaS-Marketings der 2020er, heute typisch für KI-Bilder.
styles.short_en: Infographic of shiny plastic 3D icons floating over frosted glass panels on violet-to-blue gradients; 2020s app and SaaS marketing look, now widely read as AI output.
markers_de: Weiche Verläufe von Violett zu Blau
markers_en: Shiny rounded plastic icons with specular highlights
Floating objects with soft drop shadows

styles.era_origin: 2020s tech-marketing and social-media trend borrowing from claymation and soft 3D renders.
visual_markers: tabletop miniature photographed on seamless paper
styles.prompt_fragment: handmade clay infographic, every element sculpted from matte modelling clay, chunky rounded numbers and arrows, visible fingerprints, slight lumps and tool marks, uneven edges, pastel but slightly dusty palette, photographed as a tabletop miniature on seamless paper with soft daylight and shallow shadows
styles.avoid: Avoid flawless glossy CG clay; insist on fingerprints, imperfect seams and a photographed tabletop so it reads as real stop-motion craft rather than a render.
styles.feasibility_note: Clay surfaces render well and a few sculpted numbers stay legible; drifts to perfect CG smoothness unless imperfections are demanded, and small text on clay plaques garbles.
styles.short_de: Infografik aus matter Knetmasse mit klobigen Zahlen und Pfeilen, Fingerabdrücken und Werkzeugspuren, als Tischminiatur fotografiert; Marketingtrend der 2020er in Anlehnung an Knetanimation.
styles.short_en: Infographic sculpted from matte modelling clay, with chunky numbers and arrows, fingerprints and tool marks, shot as a tabletop miniature; 2020s marketing trend borrowing from claymation.

styles.era_origin: Rooted in technical isometric projection and 1980s-90s game graphics; a dominant tech-explainer look of the 2010s.
visual_markers: three flat tones per object (top, left, right)
objects floating on a plain ground
styles.prompt_fragment: isometric explainer illustration in strict 30-degree parallel projection, no perspective convergence, modular platforms and blocks linked by paths and arrows, each surface in three flat tones for top, left and right faces, tiny simplified figures, thin consistent outlines, calm limited palette, floating on a plain off-white ground
styles.avoid: Avoid gradients, glossy materials and neon accents, or it slides into the generic SaaS hero illustration.
styles.feasibility_note: Projection mostly holds but angles drift in complex scenes; labels placed on isometric surfaces get distorted, so keep text on flat margins.
styles.verdict_reason: Confirmed duplicate of isometric-illustration. Both specify a 30-degree parallel projection with no vanishing point, three face tones, tiny figures and a floating plain ground, so they would produce the same image. The target already carries the alias 'Isometric infographic', and this entry even lists 'isometric illustration' as its own alias. Move the alias '2.5D explainer' to the target.
styles.short_de: Erklärgrafik in strenger 30-Grad-Isometrie mit modularen Plattformen, Verbindungswegen und drei flachen Tönen je Objekt; vorherrschender Look technischer Erklärgrafiken der 2010er.
styles.short_en: Explainer graphics in strict 30-degree isometric projection with modular platforms linked by paths and three flat tones per object; dominant tech-explainer look of the 2010s.
markers_en: Objects floating on a plain ground

styles.era_origin: 2010s online animated explainer videos and science channels.
visual_markers: saturated vector shapes on deep navy or purple
subtle radial gradients and soft glows
styles.prompt_fragment: still frame from an animated vector explainer, simplified rounded shapes in saturated colours against a deep navy background, subtle radial gradients and soft inner glows, scattered small dots and sparkles, rim-lit edges, cinematic wide composition, minimal on-screen text, crisp clean vector edges
styles.avoid: Keep on-screen text to a word or two and do not name or imitate any specific channel, studio or mascot.
styles.feasibility_note: Very easy for the model; a single title word renders cleanly, but any data labels or numbers are decorative.
styles.sensitivity_note: The look is strongly tied to particular popular explainer channels; describe it generically and never reference a channel name or mascot.
styles.short_de: Standbild aus einem animierten Vektor-Erklärvideo: runde, satte Formen auf tiefem Marineblau mit weichem Glühen, Funkeln und Kantenlicht; Wissenschaftskanäle im Netz der 2010er.
styles.short_en: Still from an animated vector explainer: rounded saturated shapes on deep navy with soft glows, sparkles and rim light; online science-explainer channels of the 2010s.
markers_de: Satte Vektorformen auf tiefem Marineblau oder Lila
markers_en: Saturated vector shapes on deep navy or purple
Subtle radial gradients and soft glows
styles.sensitivity_de: Eng mit bestimmten bekannten Erklärkanälen verbunden; allgemein beschreiben, nie Kanal oder Maskottchen nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Closely tied to particular popular explainer channels; describe it generically and never name a channel or mascot.

styles.era_origin: Developed by newspaper graphics desks from the 1980s and refined in 2010s online data journalism.
visual_markers: serif headline with one-line subhead above the chart
hairline gridlines and direct labels instead of legends
annotation callouts with short leader lines
styles.prompt_fragment: editorial data-journalism graphic, off-white page, bold serif headline with a one-line subhead, restrained grey data with one accent colour highlighting the key series, hairline gridlines, direct labels and short annotation callouts with thin leader lines, small sans-serif axis labels, tiny source line at bottom left, no decoration
styles.avoid: Avoid icons, gradients and drop shadows, and never name a real publication; the restraint and the annotation are the style.
styles.feasibility_note: Headline and a few quoted labels render well; dense axis numbers and annotation sentences often garble, and plotted values never match real data.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not imitate the masthead, fonts or chart branding of a specific newspaper.
styles.short_de: Zurückhaltende Zeitungsgrafik mit Serifen-Headline, grauen Daten und einer Akzentfarbe, Direktbeschriftung, Anmerkungen und winziger Quellenzeile; Grafikredaktionen ab den 1980ern, online verfeinert.
styles.short_en: Restrained newspaper charts with serif headline, grey data and one accent colour, direct labels, annotations and a tiny source line; graphics desks from the 1980s, refined online.
styles.era_de: seit den 1980ern, Zeitungen in den USA und Europa
styles.era_en: since the 1980s, US and European newspapers
markers_en: Hairline gridlines and direct labels instead of legends
Annotation callouts and a tiny source line
styles.sensitivity_de: Zeitungskopf, Schriften oder Grafik-Branding einer bestimmten Zeitung nicht nachahmen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not imitate a specific newspaper's masthead, fonts or chart branding.

styles.era_origin: Codified in 1980s information-design theory that maximises data-ink and rejects chartjunk.
visual_markers: no boxes, fills or heavy gridlines
greys with a single muted red
styles.prompt_fragment: minimalist information graphic on cream book paper, maximal data-ink, small multiples arranged in a precise grid, word-sized sparklines inline with text, no frames, boxes or background fills, range-frame axes, classic oldstyle serif typography, black and warm grey with a single muted red accent, quiet scholarly layout
styles.avoid: Avoid icons, colour fills and legends that reintroduce chartjunk, and keep the theorist's name out of the prompt.
styles.feasibility_note: Thin lines hold well; many tiny charts become repetitive filler, and small numerals and running text turn into pseudo-text.
styles.sensitivity_note: The popular label refers to a living author; use the descriptive principles, not his name, in prompts.
styles.short_de: Sparsame, gelehrt wirkende Diagramme mit Small Multiples, Sparklines und Range-Frame-Achsen in Grau mit einem gedämpften Rot; folgt der Informationsdesign-Lehre der 1980er gegen Chartjunk.
styles.short_en: Sparse, scholarly charts with small multiples, sparklines and range-frame axes in greys with one muted red; follows 1980s information-design theory that rejects chartjunk.
markers_de: Keine Rahmen, Flächen oder kräftigen Gitterlinien
markers_en: No boxes, fills or heavy gridlines
Greys with a single muted red

styles.era_origin: Conventions of 20th-century journal figures, standardised by scientific plotting software from the 1990s onward.
visual_markers: multi-panel layout with bold panel letters
white background with black axes and outward ticks
scatter points, error bars and fitted lines
styles.prompt_fragment: scientific journal figure, multi-panel layout with bold lowercase panel letters, plain white background, black axes with outward ticks and unit labels, scatter points with error bars and fitted lines, small sans-serif labels, default plotting-software colour cycle, one schematic panel in simple line art, dense caption text block beneath
styles.avoid: Avoid infographic decoration, icons and gradients; the look depends on dry, functional plotting conventions.
styles.feasibility_note: Layout and axes look convincing; tick numbers and the caption are mostly gibberish and must never be read as real data.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not present generated figures as real research results.
styles.short_de: Nüchterne mehrteilige Forschungsabbildung mit Buchstaben-Panels, schwarzen Achsen, Fehlerbalken und Fitkurven in Standardfarben; Konventionen der Fachzeitschriften, seit den 1990ern durch Plot-Software vereinheitlicht.

Scatter points, error bars and fitted lines
