styles.era_origin: Shaped by large strategy consultancies from the 1970s and standardised in presentation software in the 1990s.
visual_markers: navy, slate and one accent colour
styles.prompt_fragment: management consulting slide, full-sentence takeaway title at top in dark navy, clean waterfall chart or two-by-two matrix, Harvey balls, chevron process arrows, navy, slate grey and a single teal accent, thin rules, dense but orderly text boxes, tiny footnotes and source line at the bottom, white background
styles.avoid: Avoid stock photos and decorative icons that turn it into a generic marketing slide, and do not reproduce any firm's template or logo.
styles.feasibility_note: Title and chart structure render well; bullet text and footnotes become pseudo-text and waterfall arithmetic does not add up.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid naming or mimicking a specific consulting firm's branding.
styles.short_de: Dichte, geordnete Folie mit der Kernaussage als ganzem Satz im Titel, Wasserfalldiagramm oder Vier-Felder-Matrix, Harvey Balls und Fußnoten in Marineblau und Grau; Strategieberatungen seit den 1970ern.
styles.short_en: Dense, orderly slide with a full-sentence takeaway title, waterfall chart or two-by-two matrix, Harvey balls and footnotes in navy and grey; strategy consultancies since the 1970s.
markers_en: Navy, slate and one accent colour
styles.sensitivity_de: Branding einer bestimmten Beratungsfirma weder nennen noch nachahmen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not name or mimic a specific consulting firm's branding.

styles.era_origin: 1980s-90s news magazines and newspapers, where staff artists drew charts as illustrated objects.
visual_markers: bars and pies drawn as real objects
styles.prompt_fragment: 1980s news-magazine pictorial chart, data drawn as illustrated objects such as stacked items or a sliced object instead of plain bars, airbrushed gradients and highlights, a playful figure interacting with the graph, bold condensed headline, compact caption and source line, bright print colours on white, visible offset-print texture
styles.avoid: Avoid flat vector icons and modern minimal charts; the humorous, hand-airbrushed object metaphor is essential.
styles.feasibility_note: Object metaphors render well; object sizes rarely match values and numbers on the bars are often wrong.
styles.sensitivity_note: Associated with a living information designer; describe the approach without using his name.
styles.short_de: Diagramme als gezeichnete Gegenstände mit Airbrush-Glanzlichtern und einer verspielten Figur, die mit den Daten hantiert; Grafiker von Nachrichtenmagazinen und Zeitungen der 1980er und 1990er.
styles.short_en: Charts drawn as illustrated objects with airbrushed highlights and a playful figure interacting with the data; staff artists at news magazines and newspapers of the 1980s and 1990s.
markers_de: Balken und Torten als echte Gegenstände gezeichnet
Figur, die mit dem Diagramm interagiert
markers_en: Bars and pies drawn as real objects
styles.sensitivity_de: Mit einem lebenden Informationsdesigner verbunden; den Ansatz ohne seinen Namen beschreiben.
styles.sensitivity_en: Associated with a living information designer; describe the approach without his name.

styles.era_origin: Early-to-mid-1990s desktop presentation and spreadsheet software.
visual_markers: heavily extruded 3D pie and bar charts
arched gradient title text with drop shadow
styles.prompt_fragment: early-1990s desktop presentation chart, chunky extruded 3D pie and bar charts in default bright primary colours, arched gradient title text with drop shadow, cartoon clip-art figures pasted beside the chart, two-colour linear background gradient, bevelled buttons, slight pixel dithering and jagged low-resolution edges, cramped legend box
styles.avoid: Keep the jaggies, dithering and clumsy clip-art so the model does not clean it up into a modern 3D render; never name software brands.
styles.feasibility_note: Recognisable quickly; the model over-sharpens and must be pushed toward low resolution; arched title words usually hold, legend text garbles.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid real software logos, interface chrome and trademarked clip-art characters.
styles.short_de: Klobige, extrudierte 3D-Torten- und Balkendiagramme in grellen Standardfarben mit Verlaufstiteln, Cliparts und Treppchenkanten; Präsentationssoftware der frühen 1990er.
styles.short_en: Chunky extruded 3D pie and bar charts in default bright colours with gradient titles, clip-art figures and jagged pixels; desktop presentation software of the early 1990s.
markers_en: Heavily extruded 3D pie and bar charts
Arched gradient title with drop shadow
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine echten Software-Logos, Programmoberflächen oder geschützten Clipart-Figuren.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid real software logos, interface chrome and trademarked clip-art characters.

styles.era_origin: Standard for scientific and business lectures from the 1960s to the 1980s, made by contact-printing high-contrast negatives onto diazo film.
visual_markers: saturated blue field with white or pale cyan lines
styles.prompt_fragment: 1970s diazo lecture slide, saturated cobalt-blue background with white and pale cyan line art and lettering, technical-pen stencil lettering, simple white line charts, soft halation around strokes, dust specks and faint uneven exposure, seen as a 35mm slide in a grey plastic mount or projected on a screen
styles.avoid: Avoid modern gradients and razor-crisp vector edges; the faintly blurred single-colour film quality is the point.
styles.feasibility_note: Blue-and-white palette is easy; halation and authentic stencil lettering often come out too clean; a short title reads, small axis numbers blur.
styles.short_de: 35-mm-Vortragsdia mit weißen oder hellcyanfarbenen Linien und Beschriftung auf sattem Blau, leicht unscharf, mit Staub und Lichthof; Wissenschafts- und Geschäftsvorträge der 1960er bis 1980er.
styles.short_en: 35mm lecture slide with white or pale cyan lines and lettering on saturated blue, slightly soft with dust and halation; scientific and business talks, 1960s–1980s.
markers_de: Sattes Blau mit weißen oder hellcyanfarbenen Linien
markers_en: Saturated blue field with white or pale cyan lines

styles.era_origin: Text-mode computer terminals of the 1970s and 1980s.
visual_markers: green or amber glowing characters on black
tables and bars built from box-drawing characters
styles.prompt_fragment: text-mode computer terminal display, glowing green phosphor monospaced characters on black, tables and bar charts built from box-drawing and block characters, visible scanlines, phosphor bloom and slight ghosting, curved glass with faint room reflection, blinking block cursor, subtle flicker banding
styles.avoid: Avoid neon cyberpunk overlays and HUD elements; keep it strictly character-cell based, low-resolution and monochrome.
styles.feasibility_note: Glow and scanlines are reliable; strict character-grid alignment and readable lines of text are hit-and-miss, short words work best.
styles.short_de: Grün oder bernsteinfarben leuchtende Monospace-Schrift und Diagramme aus Rahmenzeichen auf Schwarz, mit Zeilenstruktur, Überstrahlung und gewölbtem Glas; Textterminals der 1970er und 1980er.
styles.short_en: Glowing green or amber monospaced text and box-drawing charts on black with scanlines, bloom and curved glass; text-mode computer terminals of the 1970s and 1980s.
markers_de: Grün oder bernsteinfarben leuchtende Zeichen auf Schwarz
markers_en: Green or amber glowing characters on black
Tables and bars built from box-drawing characters

styles.era_origin: School and office duplication with spirit duplicators from the 1950s to the 1980s (in Germany Matrize, in the GDR Ormig).
visual_markers: blurry blue-violet ink on yellowish paper
ink density fading across the sheet
punched holes and ruled answer lines
styles.prompt_fragment: spirit-duplicator school worksheet, every line and letter in fuzzy blue-violet aniline ink on slightly yellowed cheap paper, typewriter text mixed with hand-drawn diagrams and ruled answer lines, uneven ink density fading toward one side, doubled and smeared strokes, two punched holes, photographed flat
styles.avoid: Keep it strictly single-colour violet and soft; crisp black print or clean vector diagrams break the illusion.
styles.feasibility_note: Violet ink and paper tone come out well; typewriter text is partly gibberish and the model tends to make lines too sharp.
styles.verdict_reason: Confirmed duplicate of spirit-duplicator-copy. Both are the same process with the same violet aniline look, fuzzy lines, one-sided fade and cheap paper, and the target's fragment already says 'typed or hand-drawn worksheet character'. Punched holes and answer lines describe the subject, not a separate style. Move the aliases 'ditto sheet' and 'Ormig-Abzug' to the target.
styles.short_de: Schularbeitsblatt in verschwommener blauvioletter Anilinfarbe auf vergilbtem Papier, getippt und mit Handskizzen, ungleichmäßig verblassend; Matrizenabzüge der 1950er bis 1980er.
styles.short_en: School worksheet in fuzzy blue-violet aniline ink on yellowed paper, typewritten with hand-drawn diagrams and unevenly fading; spirit-duplicator copies of the 1950s to 1980s.
markers_de: Verschwommene blauviolette Farbe auf gelblichem Papier
markers_en: Blurry blue-violet ink on yellowish paper
Punched holes and ruled answer lines

styles.era_origin: Stencil duplicators of the 1980s, embraced by independent designers and zine makers from the 2010s.
visual_markers: two or three fluorescent spot inks
styles.prompt_fragment: risograph-printed data zine page, two fluorescent spot inks such as pink and blue overprinting to create a third colour, grainy patchy ink coverage, visible misregistration offsets, coarse halftone dot fills, bold hand-cut shapes and simple charts, uncoated off-white paper with a stapled fold
styles.avoid: Limit strictly to spot colours; smooth digital gradients or full colour erase the print character.
styles.feasibility_note: Grain and overprint are approximated well; true misregistration is inconsistent; bold headings render, small text garbles.
styles.sensitivity_note: 'Risograph' is a manufacturer's product name used generically for the print process.
styles.verdict_reason: Confirmed duplicate of risograph, which is a lead style. Both use the same spot inks, overprint, grain, misregistration and uncoated paper, and the target already has the alias 'Riso zine'. Charts and the stapled fold are the subject, not a different image. Move the alias 'riso infographic' to the target.
styles.short_de: Daten-Zine in zwei oder drei Leuchtfarben mit Überdrucken, Körnung, Passerversatz und grobem Raster; Schablonendruck, seit den 2010ern bei unabhängigen Gestaltern verbreitet.
styles.short_en: Data zine pages in two or three fluorescent spot inks with overprints, grain, misregistration and coarse halftones; stencil-duplicator printing taken up by independent designers from the 2010s.
markers_de: Zwei oder drei Leuchtfarben als Sonderfarben
markers_en: Two or three fluorescent spot inks
styles.sensitivity_de: „Risograph“ ist ein Produktname des Herstellers und wird allgemein für das Verfahren gebraucht.
styles.sensitivity_en: 'Risograph' is a manufacturer's product name used generically for the process.

styles.era_origin: Switzerland, 1950s-60s, centred on the Zurich and Basel design schools.
visual_markers: asymmetric layout with large white space
styles.prompt_fragment: Swiss International Typographic Style information graphic, strict modular grid, flush-left ragged-right neo-grotesque type in several weights, asymmetric composition with generous white space, black, white and a single signal red, geometric bars and circles, objective black-and-white photography, numbers used as large typographic elements, offset print
styles.avoid: Avoid centred symmetric layouts, icons and decorative illustration that pull it back toward a corporate template.
styles.feasibility_note: Grid and type hierarchy are handled well; big numerals and short headings are crisp, text columns become pseudo-text.
styles.short_de: Informationsgrafik auf strengem Raster mit linksbündiger Grotesk, Schwarz, Weiß und Signalrot und großen Ziffern; Schweizer Grafik aus Zürich und Basel der 1950er und 1960er.
styles.short_en: Information graphics on a strict modular grid with flush-left neo-grotesque type, black, white and signal red and large numerals; Swiss design from Zurich and Basel, 1950s–60s.

styles.era_origin: 1920s Weimar and Dessau Bauhaus and the Neue Typografie movement.
visual_markers: primary red, yellow and blue with black
circles, squares and triangles as data marks
styles.prompt_fragment: 1920s Bauhaus information graphic, primary red, yellow and blue with black on aged off-white paper, data shown with circles, squares, triangles and heavy rules, dynamic diagonal composition, lowercase geometric sans-serif lettering, thick black bars, letterpress print texture, functional yet bold
styles.avoid: Avoid the modern pastel 'Bauhaus-inspired' pattern-art look; keep it functional, data-carrying and print-textured.
styles.feasibility_note: Shapes and palette are very reliable; a few lowercase words render, numbers inside shapes often duplicate.
styles.short_de: Datengrafik aus Kreisen, Quadraten, Dreiecken und kräftigen Balken in Rot, Gelb, Blau und Schwarz, beschriftet in kleingeschriebener Grotesk; Bauhaus und Neue Typografie, Deutschland, 1920er.

Kreis, Quadrat und Dreieck als Datenzeichen

Circles, squares and triangles as data marks

styles.era_origin: Soviet Union, late 1920s-1930s, including the Izostat institute's adaptation of the Vienna Method.
visual_markers: steep diagonals and stepped rising bars
styles.prompt_fragment: 1930s constructivist statistical poster, steep diagonal composition, rising stepped bars and giant arrows, red and black on cream paper, photomontage fragments of workers and machines, bold blocky sans-serif lettering, lithographic flat colour with slight misregistration, heroic low-angle perspective
styles.avoid: Leave out state emblems and slogans unless historically intended, and request Latin lettering rather than Cyrillic.
styles.feasibility_note: Composition, palette and photomontage are strong; Latin headlines render, Cyrillic text garbles and numbers are decorative.
styles.sensitivity_note: Carries Soviet propaganda connotations; avoid political symbols and propaganda messaging unless the historical context is explicit.
styles.short_de: Statistikplakate mit steilen Diagonalen, ansteigenden Treppenbalken, Riesenpfeilen und Fotomontage in Rot und Schwarz auf Creme; sowjetische Fünfjahresplan-Grafik und IZOSTAT-Institut, späte 1920er–1930er.
styles.short_en: Statistical posters with steep diagonals, rising stepped bars, giant arrows and photomontage in red and black on cream; Soviet Five-Year-Plan graphics and the IZOSTAT institute, late 1920s–1930s.
markers_en: Steep diagonals and rising stepped bars
Bold blocky sans lettering and giant arrows
styles.sensitivity_de: Trägt sowjetische Propagandabezüge; politische Symbole und Parolen nur bei klarem historischem Kontext verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Carries Soviet propaganda connotations; avoid political symbols and slogans unless the historical context is explicit.

styles.era_origin: American and European magazine, annual-report and educational graphics of the 1950s-60s.
visual_markers: flat cut-paper shapes offset from the line drawing
mustard, teal, tomato red and olive
styles.prompt_fragment: 1950s mid-century modern infographic, flat cut-paper colour shapes slightly offset from their black line drawing, palette of mustard ochre, teal, tomato red and olive on warm off-white, stylised playful figures with dot eyes, quirky hand-lettered display type, dry-brush and screen-print textures, airy asymmetric layout
styles.avoid: Avoid textureless 'retro' vector flatness; the line-to-colour offset and print grain are what make it period-true.
styles.feasibility_note: Palette, figures and textures render reliably; hand-lettered headlines mostly hold, small captions garble.
styles.short_de: Illustrierte Statistik mit flachen, versetzt gedruckten Farbflächen unter lockerer Strichzeichnung in Senfgelb, Petrol und Tomatenrot, dazu Handlettering; Zeitschriften, Geschäftsberichte und Lehrmittel der 1950er und 1960er.
styles.short_en: Illustrated statistics with flat cut-paper colour shapes offset from loose line drawings in mustard, teal and tomato red, plus hand-lettering; 1950s–60s magazines, annual reports and schoolbooks.
markers_en: Flat cut-paper shapes offset from the line drawing
Mustard, teal, tomato red and olive

styles.era_origin: From Playfair's engraved charts of 1786 through Nightingale's 1858 polar-area diagrams and Minard's 1869 flow map to French statistical albums of 1879-1899.
visual_markers: polar wedges, flow bands or time-series lines
styles.prompt_fragment: 19th-century statistical plate, copperplate-engraved lines with elegant script and roman titles, hand-tinted watercolour washes in muted ochre, rose, slate blue and sage, polar wedges, flow bands or time-series lines on a finely engraved grid, small engraved legend, foxing and slight wear on cream rag paper
styles.avoid: Avoid modern sans-serif type and flat digital fills; colour must look hand-applied and slightly uneven.
styles.feasibility_note: Engraving texture and palette are excellent; script titles and year labels are only partly legible and values are invented.
styles.short_de: Gestochene oder lithografierte Statistiktafeln mit Schreibschrifttiteln und handkolorierten Lasuren, von Zeitreihen über Polardiagramme bis zu Flusskarten; das „goldene Zeitalter“ der Statistikgrafik, 1786–1899.
styles.short_en: Engraved or lithographed statistical charts with script titles and hand-tinted washes, from time-series lines to polar wedges and flow maps; the 'golden age' of statistical graphics, 1786–1899.
markers_en: Polar wedges, flow bands or time-series lines

styles.era_origin: Hand-drawn by W.E.B. Du Bois and Atlanta University students for the 1900 Paris Exposition.
visual_markers: ink and gouache on worn board
flat crimson, gold, green, pink, umber and black
spirals, curving bars and fan wedges
sparse composition with large colour masses
styles.prompt_fragment: hand-painted 1900 sociological data portrait in ink and gouache on worn cream board, bold flat masses of crimson, gold, emerald green, pink, umber and black, unconventional spirals, curving bars and fan-shaped wedges, hand-lettered all-capital titles and labels, slightly uneven brush edges, sparse centred composition, faint pencil guide lines
styles.avoid: Avoid vector precision and gradients; edges and lettering must look hand-painted and the colour fields flat.
styles.feasibility_note: Palette and spiral forms render well; hand-lettered capitals occasionally misspell and the shapes do not encode real values.
styles.sensitivity_note: Rooted in a landmark documentation of Black American life; credit the tradition and avoid using it to trivialise or stereotype race-related content.

styles.era_origin: Oliver Byrne's colour-printed edition of Euclid's Elements, London 1847.

small coloured shapes substituted for words in the text
classic serif text with red drop capitals

styles.avoid: Keep shapes flat and pure and the page bookish; drifting into a modern Bauhaus poster composition or adding shading breaks it.
styles.feasibility_note: Geometric primitives and palette are reliable; inline shape-in-text substitution and running serif text are mostly pseudo-text.

styles.era_origin: European monastic manuscripts, roughly 700-1400 (cosmological wheels, computus tables, T-O maps).

brown iron-gall ink, vermilion and lapis blue

black on cream laid paper with plate mark

styles.era_origin: Anatomical atlases from the 16th to the early 20th century, especially 19th-century lithographed and hand-coloured plates.

hand-tinted reds, ochres and slate blue
numbered leader lines to Latin labels

styles.avoid: Avoid glossy 3D medical renders and gore; keep it a calm, scholarly printed plate.
styles.feasibility_note: Drawing quality is high; anatomy and Latin labels are not accurate, so results must never serve as medical reference.
styles.sensitivity_note: Historic plates often derive from unconsented bodies and sometimes carry racial pseudo-science; do not reproduce such framings.

styles.prompt_fragment: newspaper weather page, simplified regional map filled with banded temperature colour zones from blue to red, weather fronts drawn with triangles and half-circles, H and L pressure markers, thin isobars, small sun, cloud and rain symbols with temperatures, compact forecast table beside it, newsprint texture
styles.avoid: Avoid glossy TV-studio 3D; flat newsprint colour and compact density are the style.
styles.feasibility_note: Symbols and colour bands render well; temperature numbers and city names in the table are often scrambled.
styles.short_de: Vereinfachte Regionalkarte mit farbigen Temperaturbändern, Wetterfronten, Hoch- und Tiefmarkierungen und kleinen Wettersymbolen, üblich auf farbigen Zeitungswetterseiten seit den 1980er-Jahren.
styles.short_en: Simplified regional map with banded temperature colours, fronts, H and L markers and small weather symbols, standard on colour newspaper weather pages since the 1980s.
markers_en: small sun, cloud and rain symbols

styles.era_origin: Satellite-image analysis in journalism and research since the 2000s, widespread in 2020s open-source investigations.
styles.prompt_fragment: annotated satellite image analysis, top-down high-resolution aerial photograph with slight atmospheric haze, thin yellow outlines and boxes around points of interest, small white labels with arrows, scale bar and north arrow, date stamp and imagery credit in a corner, one magnified inset panel
styles.avoid: Avoid sci-fi HUD glow and targeting reticles; keep the overlays sober and analytical.
styles.feasibility_note: Aerial texture is convincing; short labels hold, dates and coordinates are arbitrary.
styles.sensitivity_note: Military and surveillance connotations; never create fake evidence about real places or events.
styles.short_de: Satellitenaufnahme von oben mit dünnen gelben Markierungen, kleinen Beschriftungen, Maßstab, Datumsangabe und vergrößertem Ausschnitt, wie in Journalismus und OSINT-Recherchen seit den 2000er-Jahren.
styles.short_en: Top-down satellite photo with thin yellow outlines, small labels, scale bar, date stamp and magnified inset, used in journalism and open-source investigations since the 2000s.
styles.era_de: seit den 2000ern, verbreitet in den 2020ern, international
markers_de: Satellitenfoto von oben mit leichtem Dunst
markers_en: scale bar, north arrow, date stamp
styles.sensitivity_de: Militärische und überwachende Anklänge; niemals gefälschte Belege zu realen Orten oder Ereignissen erzeugen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Carries military and surveillance connotations; never fabricate evidence about real places or events.

styles.era_origin: Visual note-taking popularised in the late 2000s-2010s, building on graphic facilitation since the 1970s.
visual_markers: black fineliner plus one or two marker accents
styles.prompt_fragment: hand-drawn sketchnote, black fineliner lettering in varied sizes and styles, one or two marker accent colours, speech-bubble and banner containers, connector arrows and bullet dots, simple stick figures and quick icons, grey marker drop shadows, slightly wobbly lines on a notebook page
styles.avoid: Avoid vector-perfect icons and typeset fonts; it must look like real fineliner on paper.
styles.feasibility_note: Short hand-lettered phrases are legible; many small text items garble and lettering styles become repetitive.
styles.short_de: Handgeschriebene Notizen mit schwarzem Fineliner, ein bis zwei Markerfarben, Rahmen, Pfeilen und Strichmännchen; als visuelle Mitschrift seit Ende der 2000er-Jahre verbreitet.
styles.short_en: Hand-lettered notes in black fineliner with one or two marker accents, containers, arrows and stick figures, popularised as visual note-taking in the late 2000s–2010s.
styles.era_de: seit Ende der 2000er; Graphic Facilitation seit den 1970ern, USA und international
styles.era_en: late 2000s onward; graphic facilitation since the 1970s, USA and international
markers_de: schwarzer Fineliner mit ein, zwei Markerfarben
markers_en: black fineliner with one or two marker accents

styles.era_origin: Office and classroom whiteboards since the 1980s-90s; whiteboard animation explainers since the late 2000s.
visual_markers: black, blue, red and green dry-erase strokes
styles.prompt_fragment: dry-erase marker drawing on a glossy whiteboard, black, blue, red and green marker strokes with streaky ink, quickly drawn boxes, arrows and underlines, hasty handwriting, faint ghost traces of earlier erased drawings, ceiling-light reflections on the surface, aluminium frame and marker tray at the edge
styles.avoid: Avoid a clean digital white background with a fake marker brush; the board surface and ghosting sell it.
styles.feasibility_note: Surface and strokes are reliable; a few handwritten words read, longer notes become scribble.
styles.verdict_reason: Confirmed duplicate of whiteboard-marker-sketch. Both have the same German name and nearly the same fragment: four marker colours, streaky ink, ghosting, ceiling-light glare, boxes and arrows. The alias 'whiteboard animation still' suggests a genuinely different look: clean black line art on plain white, as in RSA Animate or VideoScribe. This entry does not describe that look, though. If it is wanted, it should be a new entry.
styles.short_de: Schnelle Kästen, Pfeile und Handschrift in Schwarz, Blau, Rot und Grün auf glänzender Tafel mit Wischresten, verbreitet in Büros und Schulen seit den 1980er-/90er-Jahren.
styles.short_en: Quick boxes, arrows and handwriting in black, blue, red and green dry-erase marker on a glossy board with ghosting, common in offices and classrooms since the 1980s–90s.
markers_de: Markerstriche in Schwarz, Blau, Rot, Grün
markers_en: black, blue, red and green marker strokes

styles.era_origin: Classroom chalkboards since the 19th century.
visual_markers: white and pastel chalk on dark green slate
styles.prompt_fragment: classroom chalkboard drawing, white and pastel-coloured chalk on dark green slate, powdery uneven strokes, ruler-straight lines mixed with freehand curves, cursive teacher handwriting, cloudy eraser smears and residue of earlier lessons, chalk dust on the wooden tray below
styles.avoid: Avoid decorative café-menu chalk lettering; it should look like a teacher's working board.
styles.feasibility_note: Chalk texture and smears are excellent; short words and formulas read, longer handwriting becomes scribble.
styles.verdict_reason: Confirmed duplicate of chalkboard-drawing, which is a lead style. Both specify white and pastel chalk on dark green slate, powdery or broken strokes, eraser ghosts and chalk dust on the wooden ledge, so they would produce the same image. The café-versus-classroom split lives only in this entry's avoid text, not in the target's fragment. The point about 'Tafelbild' also holds: in art history it means panel painting.
styles.short_de: Weiße und farbige Kreide auf dunkelgrüner Tafel mit gelinealten Linien, Schreibschrift und Wischspuren – das klassische Tafelbild im Unterricht seit dem 19. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: White and pastel chalk on dark green slate with ruled lines, cursive handwriting and eraser smears, the classroom board drawing since the 19th century.
markers_de: weiße und farbige Kreide auf dunkelgrüner Tafel
markers_en: white and pastel chalk on dark green slate

styles.era_origin: Long-standing business-culture trope of ideas sketched on napkins, envelopes or beer mats.
visual_markers: ballpoint ink bleeding into soft napkin fibres
rough boxes, arrows and circled numbers
coffee ring on a café table
styles.prompt_fragment: quick ballpoint sketch on a crumpled paper napkin, blue ink bleeding slightly into the soft fibres, embossed napkin border pattern, rough boxes, arrows and circled numbers, crossed-out words, a faint coffee ring stain, photographed from above on a café table in natural window light
styles.avoid: Avoid neat diagram lines and even layout; it must look spontaneous and cramped.
styles.feasibility_note: Material realism is strong; a few scribbled words and numbers read, more become scrawl.
styles.short_de: Grobe Kugelschreiber-Kästchen, Pfeile und durchgestrichene Wörter, die in eine Papierserviette oder einen Bierdeckel verlaufen – das Klischee der am Tisch skizzierten Geschäftsidee.
styles.short_en: Rough ballpoint boxes, arrows and crossed-out words bleeding into a paper napkin or beer mat, the business-culture trope of an idea sketched at the table.
markers_en: ballpoint ink bleeding into napkin fibres
rough boxes, arrows and circled numbers
coffee ring on a café table

styles.era_origin: Laboratory, engineering and school practice before computer plotting, still common in notebooks.
visual_markers: plotted crosses joined by uneven lines
styles.prompt_fragment: hand-plotted chart on orange millimetre graph paper, pencil and black fineliner, hand-ruled axes with handwritten labels and tick numbers, plotted crosses joined by slightly uneven lines, coloured-pencil shading, eraser smudges and corrected points, paper slightly curled, lit from the side
styles.avoid: Avoid crisp digital plot lines; jitter, erasures and the visible grid paper are essential.
styles.feasibility_note: Paper grid and pencil feel are reliable; handwritten tick numbers are mostly plausible but not sequentially correct.
styles.short_de: Von Hand gezogene Achsen, eingetragene Kreuze und ungleichmäßige Verbindungslinien in Bleistift und Fineliner auf orangem oder grünem Millimeterpapier, aus Labor, Technik und Schule vor dem Computerplot.
styles.short_en: Hand-ruled axes, plotted crosses and uneven connecting lines in pencil and fineliner on orange or green millimetre paper, from lab, engineering and school practice before computer plotting.
markers_en: plotted crosses joined by uneven lines

styles.era_origin: Naturalists' field notebooks since the 18th century, revived as nature journaling.
visual_markers: loose watercolour studies with pen sketches
water ripples on thick sketchbook paper
styles.prompt_fragment: naturalist field journal spread, loose watercolour studies mixed with fine pen sketches, handwritten notes with dates, weather and measurements, small colour swatches and scale bars, arrows pointing to details, a taped-in label, bleed-through and water ripples on thick cream sketchbook paper
styles.avoid: Avoid polished botanical-plate precision; it should feel observed on site and in progress.
styles.feasibility_note: Watercolour and paper are excellent; handwriting is mostly illegible, short headings sometimes hold.
styles.short_de: Lockere Aquarellstudien und Federskizzen mit handschriftlichen Notizen zu Datum, Wetter und Maßen, Farbproben und Maßstäben, nach dem Vorbild naturkundlicher Feldbücher seit dem 18. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Loose watercolour studies and pen sketches with handwritten dates, weather notes, colour swatches and scale bars, from naturalists' field notebooks since the 18th century.
styles.era_de: seit dem 18. Jh.; Nature-Journaling-Revival seit den 2000ern
styles.era_en: 18th century onward; nature-journaling revival since the 2000s
markers_en: loose watercolour studies with pen sketches
water ripples on thick sketchbook paper

styles.era_origin: Design-thinking and agile workshops since the 1990s-2000s.
visual_markers: square notes in yellow, pink, mint and blue
clusters with hand-drawn circles and headers
curled corners on a glass wall
styles.prompt_fragment: workshop wall of square sticky notes in yellow, pink, mint and blue, short handwritten marker words in capitals, notes clustered into groups with hand-drawn circles and headers, dot-vote stickers and masking-tape labels, a few curled corners, photographed slightly off-angle on a glass wall in office light
styles.avoid: Avoid tidy digital-whiteboard rendering; physical paper curl, shadows and real handwriting are key.
styles.feasibility_note: Very convincing; one or two capitalised words per note are legible, longer notes scramble.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid the trademarked sticky-note brand name in prompts.
styles.short_de: Quadratische Haftnotizen in Gelb, Pink, Mint und Blau mit Marker-Großbuchstaben, zu Gruppen geclustert, mit Klebepunkten bewertet – aus Design-Thinking- und Agile-Workshops seit den 1990er-Jahren.
styles.short_en: Square sticky notes in yellow, pink, mint and blue with marker capitals, clustered under hand-drawn headers with dot-vote stickers, from design-thinking and agile workshops since the 1990s.
markers_de: quadratische Zettel in Gelb, Pink, Mint, Blau
Cluster mit gezeichneten Kreisen und Überschriften
markers_en: square notes in yellow, pink, mint and blue
clusters with hand-drawn circles and headers
curled corners on a glass wall
styles.sensitivity_de: Den geschützten Markennamen für Haftnotizen nicht im Prompt verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid the trademarked sticky-note brand name in prompts.

styles.era_origin: Crime film and television trope since the 1970s-90s, now a widespread meme format.
visual_markers: cork board with photos, clippings and index cards
styles.prompt_fragment: investigation corkboard, pinned instant photos, newspaper clippings, maps and handwritten index cards, red string stretched between brass push pins linking items, circled words and question marks in marker, overlapping tape, warm desk-lamp light raking across the cork texture
styles.avoid: Avoid identifiable real people and real case names; keep photos generic.
styles.feasibility_note: Materials and string geometry are reliable; index-card and clipping text is pseudo-text.
styles.sensitivity_note: Associated with conspiracy thinking; do not use it to lend credibility to real conspiracy claims or to cast identifiable people as suspects.
styles.short_de: Fotos, Zeitungsausschnitte und Karteikarten auf Kork, mit roten Fäden verbunden – ein Motiv aus Krimifilm und Fernsehen seit den 1970er- bis 1990er-Jahren, heute ein Meme-Format.
styles.short_en: Photos, clippings and index cards pinned to cork and linked by red string, a crime-film and TV trope since the 1970s–90s and now a meme format.
markers_de: Korkwand mit Fotos, Ausschnitten und Karteikarten
markers_en: cork board with photos, clippings and index cards
styles.sensitivity_de: Steht für Verschwörungsdenken; nicht nutzen, um reale Verschwörungserzählungen zu stützen oder erkennbare Personen als Verdächtige darzustellen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Associated with conspiracy thinking; do not use it to lend credibility to real conspiracy claims or to cast identifiable people as suspects.

styles.era_origin: Ancient roots in tallies and tokens; named as a field in the 2010s data-visualisation community.
visual_markers: chart built from wood blocks, yarn, beads or paper
styles.prompt_fragment: physical data sculpture photographed on a wooden table, values built from real materials such as stacked wooden blocks, coloured yarn, beads, pins and folded paper, small handwritten paper tags, slightly irregular heights and alignments, soft window daylight with real cast shadows, documentary craft photography
styles.avoid: Avoid CG-render perfection and toy-brand bricks; it must look handmade and actually photographed.
styles.feasibility_note: Materials and light are convincing; heights do not match exact values and handwritten tags are only partly legible.
styles.short_de: Daten aus Holzklötzen, Wolle, Perlen oder gefaltetem Papier, auf einem echten Tisch fotografiert; als eigenes Feld der Datenvisualisierung in den 2010er-Jahren benannt.
styles.short_en: Data built from wooden blocks, yarn, beads or folded paper and photographed on a real table; named as a visualisation field in the 2010s.
styles.era_de: antike Wurzeln; als Begriff seit den 2010ern, international
styles.era_en: ancient roots; named in the 2010s, international
markers_de: Diagramm aus Holzklötzen, Wolle, Perlen oder Papier
markers_en: chart built from wood blocks, yarn, beads or paper

styles.era_origin: Data-humanism movement of the mid-2010s promoting small, personal, hand-drawn data.
styles.prompt_fragment: hand-drawn data drawing, each data point a small custom glyph whose shape, colour and marks encode different attributes, colourful fineliners and coloured pencil on white card, dense rhythmic arrangement like a pattern, carefully hand-drawn legend explaining the symbols, small personal annotations
styles.avoid: Avoid standard bar or pie charts and vector precision; the invented glyph vocabulary is the point.
styles.feasibility_note: Glyph patterns look beautiful; the legend logic is rarely consistent with the glyphs and its text is mostly pseudo-text.
styles.sensitivity_note: The term 'Data Humanism' is associated with a living designer; describe the approach without naming her.
styles.short_de: Jeder Datenpunkt als kleines eigenes Zeichen in Fineliner und Buntstift, zu dichten Mustern geordnet und mit handgezeichneter Legende – aus der Data-Humanism-Bewegung Mitte der 2010er-Jahre.
styles.short_en: Each data point drawn as a small custom glyph in fineliner and coloured pencil, arranged into dense patterns with a hand-drawn legend, from the mid-2010s data-humanism movement.
styles.era_de: seit Mitte der 2010er, Europa und USA
styles.sensitivity_de: Der Begriff „Data Humanism“ ist mit einer lebenden Designerin verbunden; den Ansatz beschreiben, ohne sie zu nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: The term 'Data Humanism' is tied to a living designer; describe the approach without naming her.

styles.era_origin: Computational art since the 1960s; data-driven generative work flourished from the 2000s.
visual_markers: thousands of hair-thin lines or particles
luminous accents on near-black or plotter ink on white
styles.prompt_fragment: generative data art, thousands of hair-thin lines and tiny particles forming flowing emergent structures, each trace following an underlying dataset, luminous accent colours on near-black or fine pen-plotter ink on white, extreme detail and subtle density variation, minimal tiny monospaced caption in a corner
styles.avoid: Avoid glowing sci-fi tunnels and nebula clichés; the structure should feel algorithmic and rule-driven.
styles.feasibility_note: Fine-line density renders well; the image only suggests data, and the tiny caption is usually illegible.
styles.short_de: Tausende haarfeine Linien oder Partikel bilden aus einem Datensatz gewachsene Strukturen, leuchtend auf Schwarz oder geplottet auf Weiß; Computerkunst seit den 1960ern, datengetrieben seit den 2000ern.
styles.short_en: Thousands of hair-thin lines or particles forming emergent structures driven by a dataset, glowing on black or plotter-drawn on white, from computational art since the 1960s.
styles.era_de: seit den 1960ern; datengetrieben seit den 2000ern, international
styles.era_en: 1960s onward; data-driven work since the 2000s, international
markers_de: Leuchtakzente auf Fastschwarz oder Plottertinte auf Weiß
markers_en: thousands of hair-thin lines or particles
luminous accents on near-black or plotter ink on white

styles.era_origin: Fictional user interfaces in film and games from the 1990s, peaking in 2010s blockbusters.
visual_markers: thin glowing cyan lines on dark
styles.prompt_fragment: futuristic heads-up display infographic, thin glowing cyan line work on a dark translucent field, concentric circular gauges, radial tick marks, angular brackets, tiny monospaced readouts, hexagon grids and scan lines, holographic transparency with chromatic fringing, symmetrical cockpit-like layout
styles.avoid: Use as a contrast specimen; to look less generic, restrict to one colour, remove bloom and give the readouts a real hierarchy.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders instantly; big numbers are legible, small readouts are deliberate gibberish.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid recreating interfaces from specific films or franchises.
styles.short_de: Dünne, leuchtend cyanfarbene Linien auf dunklem, durchscheinendem Grund mit Rundinstrumenten, Klammern, Sechseckrastern und winzigen Messwerten – fiktive Benutzeroberflächen aus Film und Games seit den 1990ern.
styles.short_en: Thin glowing cyan lines on a dark translucent field with circular gauges, brackets, hexagon grids and tiny readouts, from fictional film and game interfaces since the 1990s.
styles.era_de: seit den 1990ern, Höhepunkt 2010er, Kino und Games
markers_en: thin glowing cyan lines on dark
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine Interfaces aus bestimmten Filmen oder Franchises nachbauen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid recreating interfaces from specific films or franchises.

styles.era_origin: From Priestley's 1765 Chart of Biography via Adams' 1871 Synchronological Chart and the 1931 Histomap to Arno Peters' 1952 Synchronoptische Weltgeschichte.
visual_markers: time running along a long scroll
parallel coloured streams that swell and narrow
pastel lithographic colour on folded paper
styles.prompt_fragment: synchronoptic history chart, time running along a long vertical scroll with century markers in the margins, parallel coloured streams that swell, narrow and merge, small labels written inside each band, soft pastel lithographic colours on aged fold-out paper with crease lines, dense yet orderly encyclopedic layout
styles.avoid: Avoid the corporate dots-on-a-line timeline; swelling parallel streams and encyclopedic density define it.
styles.feasibility_note: Stream structure renders well; most of the many small labels and dates become pseudo-text, so treat them as texture.
styles.sensitivity_note: Historic examples embed Eurocentric or religious chronologies; be mindful when reusing their framing.
styles.short_de: Parallele Farbströme, die entlang einer langen Zeitleiste anschwellen und schmaler werden – wie in Geschichtstafeln von Priestley (1765) über die Histomap (1931) bis zu Arno Peters (1952).
styles.short_en: Parallel coloured streams swelling and narrowing along a long time scroll, as in history charts from Priestley (1765) via the 1931 Histomap to Arno Peters (1952).
markers_de: Zeit verläuft entlang einer langen Bahn
parallele Farbströme, die anschwellen und schrumpfen
markers_en: time running along a long scroll
parallel coloured streams that swell and narrow
pastel lithographic colour on folded paper
styles.sensitivity_de: Historische Vorbilder folgen eurozentrischen oder religiösen Chronologien; ihre Deutung nicht ungeprüft übernehmen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Historic examples embed Eurocentric or religious chronologies; be careful when reusing their framing.

styles.era_origin: Hand-drawn data-processing flowcharts of the 1950s-70s drawn with plastic templates; standardised in Germany as DIN 66001 (1966).
visual_markers: process rectangles, decision diamonds, terminals, parallelograms
shapes traced with a plastic stencil
pencil and ink on coding paper
styles.prompt_fragment: hand-drafted 1960s data-processing flowchart, standard process rectangles, decision diamonds, rounded terminals and parallelogram input shapes traced with a plastic stencil template, orthogonal connectors with small arrowheads, neat uppercase engineer's lettering inside each symbol, pencil and ink on gridded coding paper, eraser marks
styles.avoid: Avoid colourful flowchart-app styling with rounded shadows; keep it monochrome and hand-drafted.
styles.feasibility_note: Symbol shapes are correct; the logic rarely flows coherently and text inside symbols garbles beyond one or two words.
styles.short_de: Rechtecke, Entscheidungsrauten und Grenzstellen, mit einer Kunststoffschablone gezeichnet und durch rechtwinklige Pfeile verbunden – Programmablaufpläne der 1950er- bis 1970er-Jahre, in Deutschland genormt als DIN 66001.
styles.short_en: Process boxes, decision diamonds and terminals traced with a plastic stencil and joined by orthogonal arrows, as in hand-drawn data-processing flowcharts of the 1950s–70s.
markers_en: shapes traced with a plastic stencil
pencil and ink on coding paper

styles.era_origin: Popularised as a note-taking method in the 1970s.
visual_markers: central image with thick organic branches
each branch tapering in its own colour
styles.prompt_fragment: hand-drawn radial mind map on landscape paper, central illustrated idea with thick organic branches radiating outward, each branch tapering and in its own felt-pen colour, single keywords written along the lines, small doodled icons at branch tips, playful but balanced layout
styles.avoid: Avoid boxy software mind-map nodes with drop shadows; branches must be organic and hand-drawn.
styles.feasibility_note: Radial structure and colour branches are reliable; single keywords mostly legible, curved text along branches sometimes warps.
styles.sensitivity_note: 'Mind Map' is a registered trademark in some jurisdictions; the generic term is widely used.
styles.short_de: Zentrales Bild mit dicken, sich verjüngenden Ästen in verschiedenen Farben, einzelnen Stichwörtern auf den Linien und kleinen Kritzeleien; als Notiztechnik in den 1970ern in Großbritannien populär geworden.
styles.short_en: A central image with thick tapering branches in different colours, single keywords along the lines and small doodles, popularised as a note-taking method in 1970s Britain.
markers_de: zentrales Bild mit dicken, organischen Ästen
jeder Ast verjüngt sich in eigener Farbe
markers_en: central image with thick organic branches
each branch tapering in its own colour
styles.sensitivity_de: „Mind Map“ ist in einigen Ländern eine eingetragene Marke; der allgemeine Begriff ist dennoch üblich.
styles.sensitivity_en: 'Mind Map' is a registered trademark in some countries; the generic term is widely used.

styles.era_origin: Third-generation home consoles and 8-bit computers of c. 1983-1990, revived by indie games since the late 2000s.
visual_markers: large crisp square pixels on a ~256x240 grid
at most 3-4 flat colours per sprite from a small fixed palette
styles.prompt_fragment: 8-bit pixel art at roughly 256x240 resolution, upscaled with nearest-neighbour so every pixel is a crisp uniform square, tiny fixed palette with at most three or four flat colours per sprite, no gradients, no anti-aliasing, hard stair-stepped edges, tile-based repeating background, simple readable silhouettes, solid colour sky
styles.avoid: Avoid smooth gradients, glow, sub-pixel blur and inconsistent pixel sizes, which push it toward generic 'retro-inspired' illustration or hi-bit pixel art.
styles.feasibility_note: The overall look is easy, but the model often mixes pixel sizes, adds anti-aliased edges and exceeds the palette; stating a grid size and nearest-neighbour upscaling helps.
styles.sensitivity_note: NES is a Nintendo trademark; use it only as a descriptive alias and do not reproduce franchise sprites.
styles.short_de: Große quadratische Pixel, drei bis vier Flächenfarben pro Sprite, harte Treppenkanten und gekachelte Hintergründe – die Grafik der 8-Bit-Konsolen und Heimcomputer von etwa 1983 bis 1990.
styles.short_en: Large square pixels, three or four flat colours per sprite, hard stair-stepped edges and tiled backgrounds, from 8-bit consoles and home computers of c. 1983–1990.
styles.era_de: ca. 1983–1990, Japan und USA; Indie-Revival seit Ende der 2000er
styles.era_en: c. 1983–1990, Japan and USA; indie revival since the late 2000s
styles.sensitivity_de: NES ist eine Marke von Nintendo; nur beschreibend verwenden und keine Franchise-Sprites nachbilden.
styles.sensitivity_en: NES is a Nintendo trademark; use it only as a descriptive alias and do not reproduce franchise sprites.

styles.era_origin: Fourth-generation consoles and arcade boards, c. 1988-1996.
visual_markers: ordered dithering in skies and gradients
styles.prompt_fragment: 16-bit pixel art at about 256x224 resolution with crisp nearest-neighbour pixels, rich but limited palette, each material shaded with three to five hand-placed colour ramps, selective coloured outlines, ordered dithering in skies, layered parallax background planes, detailed tilework, bright saturated early-1990s console colours, no anti-aliasing blur
styles.avoid: Avoid bloom, soft lighting and high colour counts that turn it into modern hi-bit pixel art, and avoid mushy uneven pixel grids.
styles.feasibility_note: Reads convincingly at a glance; strict pixel grid and palette discipline drift, and details may look painted rather than pixel-placed.
styles.sensitivity_note: SNES and Mega Drive are console trademarks; use them only as aliases and avoid copying franchise sprites.
styles.short_de: Scharfe Pixel mit drei- bis fünfstufigen Farbabstufungen, selektiven Farbkonturen, geditherten Himmeln und Parallax-Ebenen – Grafik der 16-Bit-Konsolen und Arcade-Automaten von etwa 1988 bis 1996.
styles.short_en: Crisp pixels with three-to-five-step colour ramps, selective outlines, dithered skies and parallax layers, from fourth-generation consoles and arcade boards of c. 1988–1996.
styles.sensitivity_de: SNES und Mega Drive sind Marken; nur beschreibend verwenden und keine Franchise-Sprites kopieren.
styles.sensitivity_en: SNES and Mega Drive are console trademarks; use them only as aliases and do not copy franchise sprites.

styles.era_origin: Indie games of the 2010s onward that keep the pixel grid but drop retro hardware limits.
visual_markers: visible pixel grid at widescreen resolution (~480x270)
large palette with moody colour grading
dynamic coloured light sources, bloom and glow
styles.prompt_fragment: modern hi-bit pixel art with a crisp visible pixel grid at around 480x270 widescreen, large palette with moody colour grading, dynamic coloured light sources, soft bloom glow, drifting particles and layered fog, painterly hand-placed pixel clusters, atmospheric depth, contemporary indie game look beyond any retro hardware limits
styles.avoid: Avoid letting glow and gradients dissolve the pixel grid into a smooth digital painting.
styles.feasibility_note: Moody lighting is a strength, but pixels tend to blend into soft painting; insist on a uniform visible pixel grid.
styles.short_de: Sichtbares Pixelraster in Breitbildauflösung mit großer Palette, farbigem Licht, Bloom, Nebel und Partikeln – Indie-Games seit den 2010er-Jahren, ohne die Grenzen alter Hardware.
styles.short_en: Visible pixel grid at widescreen resolution with a large palette, coloured light, bloom, fog and particles, used in indie games since the 2010s without retro hardware limits.

styles.era_origin: 1980s-90s strategy and simulation games; a standalone art form in the early-2000s pixel-art community.
visual_markers: dimetric view with no vanishing point
three-tone face shading from one consistent light
dense miniature detail on plain background
styles.prompt_fragment: isometric pixel art in true 2:1 dimetric projection, every diagonal built from clean two-pixels-across one-pixel-up steps, no perspective vanishing points, three-tone face shading with light from top-left, tidy outlined blocks and tiles, crisp nearest-neighbour pixels, limited palette, dense miniature detail on a plain background
styles.avoid: Avoid true perspective, smooth 3D rendering and soft shadows, which turn it into an isometric 3D diorama.
styles.feasibility_note: Isometric layout works well; exact 2:1 pixel lines and consistent pixel size are unreliable.

markers_en: photo textures stretched over simple geometry
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine erkennbaren Inseln oder Rätselmaschinen bestimmter Spiele nachbauen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid recreating recognisable islands or puzzle machines from specific games.

styles.era_origin: Mid-1990s 16-bit console and PC games that reduced workstation-rendered 3D models to sprites (c. 1994-1997).
visual_markers: glossy smooth-shaded 3D forms crushed into low-res pixels
specular highlights as bright pixel clusters
limited palette with banding and dithering
styles.prompt_fragment: mid-1990s pre-rendered 3D sprite graphics: glossy smooth-shaded computer-rendered forms shrunk down to low-resolution pixel sprites, limited palette with banding and dithering, specular highlights preserved as bright pixel clusters, lush pre-rendered backgrounds, side-on game composition, slightly jagged edges
styles.avoid: Avoid both clean hand-placed pixel art and full-resolution 3D; it needs rendered shading crushed into pixels.
styles.feasibility_note: The model grasps 'rendered then pixelated' only moderately; results can look like a blurred render.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid recreating specific franchise characters from the era.
styles.short_de: Glänzende, auf Workstations gerenderte 3D-Modelle, zu grob aufgelösten Pixel-Sprites verkleinert, mit Farbabrissen und Dithering; 16-Bit-Konsolen- und PC-Spiele um 1994–1997.
styles.short_en: Glossy workstation-rendered 3D models shrunk into low-resolution pixel sprites with banding and dithering, from 16-bit console and PC games of c. 1994–1997.
markers_de: begrenzte Palette mit Farbabrissen und Dithering
markers_en: glossy 3D forms crushed into low-res pixels
specular highlights as bright pixel clusters
limited palette with banding and dithering
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine Figuren bestimmter Spielereihen der Zeit nachbilden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid recreating specific franchise characters of the era.

styles.era_origin: 32-bit consoles of 1994-2000; revived by indie 'PSX horror' games since c. 2018.
visual_markers: low-poly models with tiny unfiltered pixelated textures
warped affine texture mapping and vertex jitter
short draw distance swallowed by fog
styles.prompt_fragment: mid-1990s 32-bit console 3D graphics, low-poly models with tiny unfiltered pixelated textures, warped wobbly affine texture mapping, jittery vertex snapping, visible colour banding and dithering, 320x240 resolution, short draw distance swallowed by dark fog, slightly uncanny stiff figures
styles.avoid: Avoid smooth texture filtering, soft blur and modern shadows; crisp pixelated textures and warping separate it from the blurrier N64 look.
styles.feasibility_note: Low-poly plus pixelated textures work; affine warping and jitter are motion artefacts that a still can only hint at.
styles.sensitivity_note: PlayStation/PS1 are Sony trademarks: use only as a descriptive alias, never in prompts or branding.
styles.short_de: Low-Poly-3D mit winzigen ungefilterten Texturen, die sich verziehen und zittern, mit Farbabrissen und dichtem Nebel; 32-Bit-Konsolen 1994–2000, wiederbelebt von Indie-Horrorspielen.
styles.short_en: Low-poly 3D with tiny unfiltered textures that warp and jitter, colour banding and dense fog, from 32-bit consoles of 1994–2000; revived by indie horror games.
styles.era_en: 1994–2000, Japan; indie revival since the late 2010s
markers_en: low-poly models with tiny pixelated textures
warped affine textures and vertex jitter
short draw distance lost in fog
styles.sensitivity_de: PlayStation und PS1 sind Marken von Sony und nur als beschreibende Aliasse zu verwenden, nie im Prompt oder Branding.
styles.sensitivity_en: PlayStation and PS1 are Sony trademarks; use them only as descriptive aliases, never in prompts or branding.

styles.era_origin: 64-bit console generation, 1996-2001.
visual_markers: chunky low-poly models with smooth Gouraud shading
tiny textures smeared by bilinear filtering
many surfaces vertex-coloured instead of textured
styles.prompt_fragment: late-1990s 64-bit console 3D graphics, chunky low-poly models with smooth Gouraud shading, tiny textures smeared soft by bilinear filtering, thick coloured distance fog, bright saturated primary colours, many surfaces coloured by vertex colour instead of texture, slight blur over the whole frame
styles.avoid: Avoid crisp pixelated textures (that is the PS1 look) and modern lighting; the signature is blur, fog and cheerful flat colour.
styles.feasibility_note: Achievable, but the model often defaults to modern cartoon 3D; stress blurry filtered textures and fog.
styles.sensitivity_note: 'N64' refers to a Nintendo product; use only as an alias and avoid franchise characters.
styles.short_de: Klobige Low-Poly-Modelle mit weicher Schattierung, winzigen, durch Filterung verwaschenen Texturen und dichtem farbigem Nebel in kräftigen Grundfarben; 64-Bit-Konsolen 1996–2001.
styles.short_en: Chunky low-poly models with smooth shading, tiny textures blurred by filtering and thick coloured fog in bright primaries, from 64-bit consoles of 1996–2001.
markers_en: tiny textures smeared by bilinear filtering
styles.sensitivity_de: „N64“ bezeichnet ein Nintendo-Produkt; nur als Alias verwenden und keine Figuren bekannter Spielereihen zeigen.
styles.sensitivity_en: 'N64' refers to a Nintendo product; use only as an alias and avoid franchise characters.

styles.era_origin: Sixth-generation consoles, 2000-2006.
visual_markers: mid-poly models with slightly angular silhouettes
styles.prompt_fragment: early-2000s sixth-generation console graphics, mid-poly models with slightly angular silhouettes, low-resolution textures with baked-in lighting and painted detail, glossy plastic-looking skin, heavy bloom glow on bright areas, crushed dark shadows, 480i interlaced jagged edges, flat static environment lighting
styles.avoid: Avoid modern physically based materials and soft shadows; it needs the slightly glossy, jagged early-2000s compromise.
styles.feasibility_note: The era is understood loosely; output may drift to PS1 or modern unless technical cues are spelled out.
styles.sensitivity_note: PS2 is a Sony trademark used only as an alias.
styles.short_de: Modelle mit mittlerer Polygonzahl und kantigen Silhouetten, grob aufgelöste Texturen mit eingebackenem Licht, plastikhaft glänzende Haut und starker Bloom; Konsolen der sechsten Generation, 2000–2006.
styles.short_en: Mid-poly models with angular silhouettes, low-res baked-light textures, glossy plastic skin and heavy bloom, from sixth-generation consoles of 2000–2006.
markers_de: Modelle mit mittlerer Polygonzahl, kantige Silhouetten
styles.sensitivity_de: PS2 ist eine Marke von Sony und erscheint nur als Alias.
styles.sensitivity_en: PS2 is a Sony trademark, used only as an alias.

styles.era_origin: Mid-to-late-2000s HD consoles (c. 2006-2012), associated with popular deferred-lighting engines.
visual_markers: desaturated brown/grey-green grade with yellow tint
styles.prompt_fragment: late-2000s HD console game graphics, heavily desaturated brown and grey-green colour grading with a sickly yellow tint, excessive bloom haloing every highlight, wet-looking specular normal-mapped surfaces, grime and rubble everywhere, bulky chunky proportions, crushed shadows, vignette, gritty self-serious atmosphere
styles.avoid: Avoid vivid colour and clean modern lighting; the dull brown filter and overdone bloom define it.
styles.feasibility_note: Colour grading and bloom are easy and render convincingly.
styles.sensitivity_note: Strongly associated with military-shooter imagery; keep subjects neutral to avoid militaristic glorification.
styles.short_de: Entsättigte Braun- und Graugrüntöne mit Gelbstich, übertriebener Bloom und nass glänzende Normal-Map-Oberflächen; typisch für Spiele der HD-Konsolengeneration um 2006–2012.
styles.short_en: Desaturated brown and grey-green grading with a yellow tint, excessive bloom and wet normal-mapped surfaces, typical of HD console games c. 2006–2012.
markers_en: desaturated brown/grey-green grade with yellow tint
styles.sensitivity_de: Stark mit Militär-Shootern verbunden; Motive neutral halten, um keine Kriegsverherrlichung zu erzeugen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Strongly tied to military-shooter imagery; keep subjects neutral to avoid glorifying militarism.

styles.era_origin: Home-computer demoscene from the mid-1980s (Amiga, C64, Atari ST, DOS); listed as intangible cultural heritage in Finland (2020) and Germany (2021).
styles.prompt_fragment: oldschool home-computer demo screen: shiny beveled pixel-shaded chrome logo at the top, horizontal rainbow copper raster bars, scrolling sine-wave text in a bitmap font, starfield or plasma effect in a vivid limited palette, 320x256 low resolution, black backdrop, mathematically precise effects, crisp pixels
styles.avoid: Avoid modern glossy 3D and smooth gradients; colour bands must look stepped and the logo pixel-shaded.
styles.feasibility_note: Logos and raster bars work; sine-scroll text tends to be garbled.
styles.short_de: Glänzende, abgeschrägte Pixel-Logos, Regenbogen-Rasterbalken, Sinus-Scrolltexte und Sternenfelder auf Schwarz; aus Heimcomputer-Demos und Cracktros seit Mitte der 1980er.
styles.short_en: Shiny bevelled pixel logos, rainbow raster bars, sine-wave scrolltexts and starfields on black, from home-computer demos and crack intros since the mid-1980s.
styles.era_de: seit Mitte der 1980er, Europa (Amiga, C64, Atari ST, PC)
styles.era_en: since the mid-1980s, Europe (Amiga, C64, Atari ST, PC)
markers_de: niedrige Auflösung, begrenzte Palette auf Schwarz

styles.era_origin: Stylised low-polygon 3D art trend from c. 2012 in indie games, motion design and illustration.
visual_markers: deliberately few polygons with visible facets
soft ambient occlusion and gentle light
styles.prompt_fragment: stylised low-poly 3D render with deliberately few polygons, every facet clearly visible and flat-shaded, harmonious muted palette with subtle colour gradients across faces, soft ambient occlusion and gentle directional light, geometric simplified forms, clean minimal background, calm toy-like tidiness
styles.avoid: Avoid smoothed normals, glossy materials and high detail, which pull it toward generic cute 3D.
styles.feasibility_note: Faceted geometry renders well.
styles.short_de: Stilisiertes 3D mit bewusst wenigen, deutlich sichtbaren Facetten, gedämpften Farben und weichem Licht; seit etwa 2012 verbreitet in Indie-Spielen, Motion Design und Illustration.
styles.short_en: Stylised 3D with deliberately few, clearly visible flat-shaded facets, muted harmonious colours and soft light; a trend in indie games, motion design and illustration from c. 2012.
markers_de: flach schattierte Flächen mit leichten Verläufen

styles.era_origin: Voxel engines since the 1990s; voxel art boomed in the 2010s with free voxel editors and block-building games.
visual_markers: everything built from uniform cubes on a strict grid
soft global illumination with AO in crevices
styles.prompt_fragment: voxel art 3D render, every object built from uniform cubes on a strict grid, one flat colour per voxel, stair-stepped curves, soft global illumination with ambient occlusion in crevices, orthographic three-quarter camera, slight depth of field, clean pastel or earthy palette, miniature scene
styles.avoid: Avoid mixing smooth geometry with cubes or using recognisable block-game textures; keep cube size uniform.
styles.feasibility_note: Voxel scenes render well; cube size may vary.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid textures and characters from known block-building games (trademarks).
styles.short_de: 3D-Szenen vollständig aus gleich großen, einfarbigen Würfeln auf einem Raster, mit treppenförmigen Rundungen und weicher Umgebungsverdeckung; Voxel-Engines seit den 1990ern, Boom in den 2010ern.
styles.short_en: 3D scenes built entirely from uniform coloured cubes on a grid, with stair-stepped curves and soft ambient occlusion; voxel engines since the 1990s, boom in the 2010s.
styles.era_de: seit den 1990ern; Boom in den 2010ern, international
styles.era_en: since the 1990s; boom in the 2010s, international
markers_de: aus gleichen Würfeln im Raster aufgebaut
markers_en: built from uniform cubes on a grid
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine Texturen oder Figuren bekannter Klötzchenbau-Spiele verwenden; sie sind markenrechtlich geschützt.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid textures and characters from known block-building games, which are trademarks.

styles.era_origin: 3D illustration trend of the late 2010s-2020s on portfolio platforms; now heavily replicated by AI generators.
visual_markers: square cutaway slab floating on plain background
soft area light with gentle AO
cut base revealing floor or soil layers
styles.prompt_fragment: isometric 3D diorama render: a square cutaway slab floating on a plain soft-coloured background, orthographic isometric camera, densely packed miniature props, clean rounded geometry, soft area lighting with gentle ambient occlusion, restrained matte palette, crisp edges of the cut base revealing floor or soil layers
styles.avoid: Avoid the default over-cute glossy toy finish and warm haze; matte materials and a restrained palette keep it from looking generic.
styles.feasibility_note: Extremely reliable, but also one of the most overused AI looks.
styles.short_de: Quadratischer Ausschnitt mit dicht gestellten Miniaturobjekten, schwebend vor schlichtem Hintergrund in orthografischer Isometrie; ein 3D-Illustrationstrend der späten 2010er.
styles.short_en: A square cutaway slab packed with miniature props, floating on a plain background under an orthographic isometric camera; a 3D illustration trend of the late 2010s.
markers_de: quadratischer Ausschnitt, schwebend vor leerem Grund
markers_en: square cutaway slab floating on plain ground
soft area light with gentle AO
cut base showing floor or soil layers

styles.era_origin: 3D illustration trend of 2020-2022, tied to 'claymorphism' in UI design (2021).
visual_markers: rounded chunky forms with generous bevels
large softbox light and soft contact shadows
styles.prompt_fragment: soft clay 3D render, rounded chunky forms with generous bevels, matte non-reflective clay-like material with faint fingertip-smoothed surface variation, pastel near-monochrome palette, diffused large softbox lighting, soft contact shadows, plain seamless background, simple friendly shapes, no outlines

styles.feasibility_note: The model excels at this; the risk is excessive cuteness.

styles.short_en: Rounded, chunky 3D forms in a matte clay-like material and pastel tones under soft studio light; a 3D illustration and UI trend of 2020–2022 ('claymorphism').
markers_de: runde, klobige Formen mit großen Fasen
markers_en: rounded chunky forms with big bevels
softbox light and soft contact shadows

styles.era_origin: Typography, product and motion-design trend of 2021-2023.
visual_markers: forms puffed up like air-filled vinyl
bright candy colours on plain backdrop
styles.prompt_fragment: inflated 3D render, every form puffed up like an air-filled vinyl balloon or pool float, bulging rounded volumes with pinched seams and creases where surfaces are welded, satin-glossy plastic sheen, soft studio lighting, bright candy colours on a plain backdrop, slightly squashed against the ground
styles.avoid: Avoid hard edges and solid-looking volumes; the seams and air-pressure bulge separate it from clay or glossy icons.
styles.feasibility_note: Inflated forms render convincingly, especially lettering.
styles.short_de: Formen, aufgeblasen wie luftgefülltes Vinyl, mit eingezogenen Nähten, Satinglanz und Bonbonfarben; ein Trend in Typografie, Produkt- und Motion-Design 2021–2023.
styles.short_en: Forms puffed up like air-filled vinyl with pinched seams, satin sheen and candy colours; a typography, product and motion-design trend of 2021–2023.
markers_en: forms puffed up like air-filled vinyl
bright candy colours on plain backdrop

styles.era_origin: 3D emoji and icon sets from c. 2020; became the default output when image generators are asked for 'a 3D icon'.
visual_markers: shiny plastic with bright specular highlights
soft drop shadow on pastel gradient
styles.prompt_fragment: glossy 3D icon render, single centred object with rounded bevelled edges, shiny smooth plastic material with bright specular highlights, saturated gradient colours, soft drop shadow, plain pastel gradient background, studio lighting, polished clean marketing finish
styles.avoid: This is the contrast case and the generic AI default; pair it with a deliberately distinct style when originality is the goal.

styles.era_origin: Anime-styled 3D games and real-time toon shaders of the 2010s.
visual_markers: cool rim light and soft bloom
bright clean saturated environments with painted skies
styles.prompt_fragment: anime-style toon-shaded 3D render, sharp two-tone shadow edges and thin coloured outlines, glossy band highlights on hair and smooth materials, cool rim light, bright clean saturated environment with painted sky, soft bloom, crisp real-time game render, polished stylised surfaces
styles.avoid: Avoid heavy ink hatching (comic cel-shading) and realistic skin, and steer away from stock glossy anime-character clichés.
styles.feasibility_note: Rendered well; the model tends to default to youthful or sexualised characters, so specify neutral subjects.
styles.sensitivity_note: Close to specific commercial game IP; avoid copying characters or UI. Watch for sexualisation and youthful-character defaults.

styles.sensitivity_de: Nah an kommerziellen Spielemarken: keine Figuren oder Oberflächen kopieren und auf sexualisierte oder kindlich wirkende Standardfiguren achten.
styles.sensitivity_en: Close to specific commercial game IP; avoid copying characters or UI, and watch for sexualised or childlike character defaults.

warm saturated palette, painted edge wear

warm saturated palette, painted edge wear

bold rounded buttons with thick outlined lettering

visual_markers: dynamic pose on a strong diagonal
crisp rim light on focal area
styles.prompt_fragment: painterly digital game splash art, subject in a dynamic heroic pose on a strong diagonal, dramatic warm-versus-cool colour-split lighting, crisp rim light, highly rendered focal area dissolving into looser painted strokes at the edges, swirling particles and debris, cinematic widescreen framing, saturated high-contrast palette

styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid imitating specific games' champions or named artists.

crisp rim light on focal area

styles.era_origin: Collectible card games since 1993.
visual_markers: richly painted illustration in an upper window
name banner, type line and rules-text box
cost and stat icons in corners
holographic foil sheen and card-stock texture
styles.prompt_fragment: collectible trading card design, a richly painted fantasy-style illustration in an upper window framed by an ornate original card border, name banner at the top, type line and short rules-text box below, small cost and stat icons in the corners, subtle holographic foil sheen, slight card-stock edge and print texture

styles.feasibility_note: Frame and illustration come out well; rules text is often garbled, so keep text minimal.

name banner, type line, rules text box
cost and stat icons in corners

grid-lined border and diagonal colour banners

styles.sensitivity_note: Do not reproduce real publishers' logos, rating badges or console seals.

grid border and diagonal colour banners

markers_en: lens flare, chromatic aberration and grain

styles.era_origin: Photoreal architectural rendering since the 2000s.
visual_markers: perfectly vertical lines in corrected two-point perspective
balanced daylight or blue-hour dusk with warm interior glow

styles.avoid: Avoid tilted verticals and dramatic fantasy lighting; the genre is calm, aspirational and technically corrected.

styles.era_origin: Commercial product CGI since the 2000s, now ubiquitous in e-commerce and advertising.
visual_markers: flawless object on seamless backdrop or podium
softbox reflections as clean gradient highlights
styles.prompt_fragment: commercial product CGI packshot, flawless object on a seamless backdrop or geometric podium, controlled studio softbox reflections forming clean gradient highlights, frozen liquid splashes or floating elements, perfect symmetry, razor-sharp edges, zero dust or wear, colour-matched background, advertising polish
styles.avoid: Close to the AI default; specify an unusual lighting setup or camera angle and avoid the purple-teal gradient backdrop.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid real brand logos and packaging.
styles.short_de: Am Rechner erzeugtes Produktbild: makelloses Objekt auf nahtlosem Hintergrund oder Podest, saubere Softbox-Lichtkanten, oft eingefrorene Spritzer; seit den 2000ern Alltag in Werbung und Onlinehandel.
styles.short_en: Computer-rendered product shot: a flawless object on a seamless backdrop or podium, clean softbox highlights, often frozen splashes; ubiquitous in e-commerce and advertising since the 2000s.
markers_de: makelloses Objekt auf nahtlosem Hintergrund oder Podest
markers_en: flawless object on seamless backdrop or podium
softbox reflections as clean gradient highlights
styles.sensitivity_de: Echte Markenlogos und Verpackungen vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid real brand logos and packaging.

styles.era_origin: Motion-design culture of the 2010s built around desktop 3D packages and GPU renderers.
visual_markers: balanced arrangement of spheres, tubes, ribbons
material contrast: frosted glass, iridescent film, chrome, velvet
styles.prompt_fragment: abstract 3D motion-design still, balanced arrangement of spheres, tubes and ribbons, materials mixing frosted glass, iridescent film, brushed chrome and velvet, soft caustics and refraction, smooth pastel gradient backdrop, gentle studio lighting, satisfying physics-simulation stillness
styles.avoid: Avoid neon cyberpunk glow and generic tech blue; keep the material contrast central.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable.
styles.sensitivity_note: Octane and Cinema 4D are product names used only as aliases.
styles.short_de: Abstraktes Standbild aus dem 3D-Motion-Design: Kugeln, Röhren und Bänder aus Milchglas, Chrom oder Samt vor pastelligen Verläufen, verbreitet in den 2010er-Jahren.
styles.short_en: Abstract still from 3D motion design: spheres, tubes and ribbons in contrasting materials such as frosted glass, chrome and velvet against pastel gradients, popular in the 2010s.

Materialkontrast: Milchglas, irisierende Folie, Chrom, Samt

material contrast: frosted glass, iridescent film, chrome, velvet
