styles.era_origin: Consumer photogrammetry and phone 3D-scanning apps since the 2010s; Gaussian splatting since 2023.
visual_markers: realistic photo texture baked onto a lumpy mesh
flat baked lighting in a neutral viewer void
styles.prompt_fragment: photogrammetry 3D scan displayed in a viewer, realistic photo texture baked onto a lumpy mesh, melted smeared edges and holes where the cameras could not see, stretched texture streaks, ragged irregular cut-off boundary of the scanned area, flat baked-in lighting, floating against a neutral grey void
styles.avoid: Avoid clean modelled geometry; the uncanny scanning glitches are the point.
styles.feasibility_note: The ragged scanned look can be imitated but often comes out too clean.
styles.sensitivity_note: Scanning real people raises likeness and consent questions; keep subjects anonymous.
styles.short_de: Ansicht eines Photogrammetrie-Scans im 3D-Viewer: echte Fototextur auf klumpigem Mesh, zerlaufene Kanten, Löcher und verzogene Streifen; verbreitet seit den Scan-Apps der 2010er-Jahre.
styles.short_en: A photogrammetry scan in a 3D viewer: real photo texture on a lumpy mesh, melted edges, holes and stretched streaks; common since 2010s consumer scanning apps.
markers_de: flaches, eingebranntes Licht vor grauem Nichts
markers_en: photo texture baked onto a lumpy mesh
flat baked lighting in a grey void
styles.sensitivity_de: Scans realer Personen berühren Persönlichkeitsrechte und Einwilligung; Motive anonym halten.
styles.sensitivity_en: Scanning real people raises likeness and consent issues; keep subjects anonymous.

styles.era_origin: Laser scanning in surveying since the 1990s; mainstream visual aesthetic through autonomous vehicles and music videos in the 2010s.
visual_markers: surfaces made only of tiny dots
height-coded colour ramp or grey intensity
concentric scan rings on the ground
styles.prompt_fragment: LiDAR point cloud visualisation, every surface rendered as millions of tiny luminous dots on a black background, colour-coded by height from blue to red or by grey intensity, empty scan shadows behind objects, concentric scan rings on the ground, sparse dissolving edges, technical survey aesthetic
styles.avoid: Avoid solid surfaces and magic-dust sparkle; it must read as measured scan data.
styles.feasibility_note: Point clouds render convincingly; ring patterns and point density are approximations.
styles.short_de: Visualisierung von Laserscan-Daten: Oberflächen bestehen nur aus winzigen Punkten vor Schwarz, nach Höhe eingefärbt, mit Scanschatten; aus der Vermessung, bekannt durch Musikvideos und autonomes Fahren.
styles.short_en: Visualised laser-scan data: every surface made of tiny dots on black, colour-coded by height, with scan shadows; from surveying, popularised by music videos and self-driving cars.
styles.era_de: seit den 1990er-Jahren (Vermessung), als Bildästhetik seit ca. 2008
styles.era_en: since the 1990s in surveying; visual aesthetic since c. 2008
markers_en: surfaces made only of tiny dots
height-coded colour ramp or grey intensity
concentric scan rings on the ground

styles.era_origin: 3D modelling viewports since the 1980s; standard 'topology breakdown' in 3D-artist portfolios.
visual_markers: thin dark wireframe showing quad topology
styles.prompt_fragment: 3D modelling viewport render, matte grey clay shading overlaid with thin dark wireframe showing clean quad mesh topology, neutral grey gradient background, faint grid floor, orthographic three-quarter view, untextured technical breakdown look, soft ambient light only
styles.avoid: Avoid glowing neon lines on black (that is the vector display) and decorative sci-fi effects.
styles.feasibility_note: A wireframe appears, but topology is often chaotic or incoherent.
styles.short_de: Technische Präsentationsansicht aus der 3D-Modellierung: graues Clay-Shading mit überlagertem Drahtgitter, das die Mesh-Topologie zeigt; Standard in Portfolios von 3D-Artists.
styles.short_en: Technical presentation render from 3D modelling: grey clay shading overlaid with a thin wireframe that shows the mesh topology, standard in 3D-artist portfolios.
markers_en: thin dark wireframe of quad topology

styles.era_origin: Tech and corporate imagery from the mid-2000s to the early 2010s; the term was coined in 2017 by the Consumer Aesthetics Research Institute.
visual_markers: translucent aqua glass and gel surfaces with gloss highlights
green grass hills under clear blue sky
styles.prompt_fragment: mid-2000s glossy eco-tech aesthetic, translucent aqua glass and gel surfaces with bright gloss highlights, water droplets and bubbles, fresh green grass hills under a clear blue sky, flowing aurora light streaks, crystal-clear water, clean humanist sans-serif typography, optimistic utopian brightness
styles.avoid: Avoid dark modern moodiness and flat design; keep it bright, wet and glossy.
styles.feasibility_note: Bubbles, gloss and blue skies are easy.
styles.sensitivity_note: The name refers to a typeface designer and an operating-system theme; avoid real OS logos and wallpapers.
styles.short_de: Glänzende Tech-Bildsprache von Mitte der 2000er bis Anfang der 2010er: Aqua-Glas, Wasserblasen, grüne Hügel unter blauem Himmel und Polarlicht-Schlieren; der Name entstand erst 2017.
styles.short_en: Glossy tech imagery of the mid-2000s to early 2010s: aqua glass, water bubbles, green hills under blue sky and aurora streaks; the name was coined only in 2017.
markers_en: translucent aqua glass and gel surfaces
green grass hills under clear blue sky
styles.sensitivity_de: Der Name verweist auf einen Schriftgestalter und ein Betriebssystem-Design; echte OS-Logos und Wallpaper vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: The name cites a typeface designer and an operating-system theme; avoid real OS logos and wallpapers.

styles.era_origin: Music-driven retro-1980s aesthetic from the mid-2000s, peaking in the 2010s.
styles.prompt_fragment: synthwave retro-80s render, glowing magenta and cyan wireframe grid floor receding to the horizon, large striped gradient sun, purple-black starry sky, silhouetted palm trees and mountains, chrome lettering with neon outlines, scanline glow and bloom, nostalgic night-drive mood
styles.avoid: Avoid generic cyberpunk rain and grime; the clean grid and sun are the core grammar.
styles.feasibility_note: Very easy to produce.
styles.sensitivity_note: 'Outrun' derives from an arcade game title; avoid using it as branding.
styles.short_de: Neon-Retrolook der 1980er aus der Synthwave-Musikszene: Gitterboden in Magenta und Cyan, gestreifte Sonne, Palmensilhouetten und Chromschrift; verbreitet seit Mitte der 2000er.
styles.short_en: Retro-1980s neon look from the synthwave music scene: magenta and cyan grid floor, striped setting sun, palm silhouettes and chrome lettering, spreading from the mid-2000s.
styles.era_de: seit Mitte der 2000er, Höhepunkt in den 2010ern, international
styles.era_en: mid-2000s onward, peak in the 2010s, international
markers_en: neon magenta and cyan grid floor
styles.sensitivity_de: „Outrun“ stammt von einem Arcade-Spieltitel; nicht als Markenname verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: 'Outrun' comes from an arcade game title; don't use it as branding.

visual_markers: pastel pink, teal and lavender palette
classical marble busts and palm plants in a void
early-90s OS pop-up windows and cursors

markers_en: marble busts and palms in a void
early-1990s OS pop-up windows and cursors
styles.sensitivity_de: Dekorativ eingesetzte japanische Schrift kann exotisierend wirken; Pseudo-Japanisch und echte OS-Logos vermeiden.

styles.era_origin: Computer-art pioneers using pen plotters in the 1960s; revived in the 2010s generative-art scene.
visual_markers: algorithmic hatching and systematic repetition with variation
one or two ink colours on paper
styles.prompt_fragment: pen plotter drawing on off-white paper, thousands of thin uniform ink lines laid down by a machine, algorithmic hatching and repeated geometric elements with gradual systematic variation, one or two ink colours, faint ink pooling at stroke starts, precise yet slightly wobbly mechanical marks, generous white margin
styles.avoid: Avoid hand-sketch gestures and colour fills; every mark must look machine-drawn by rule.
styles.feasibility_note: Line quality is good; the systematic logic is imitated rather than computed.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not reproduce specific historical works by early computer-art pioneers.
styles.short_de: Von Stiftplottern nach Algorithmen gezeichnete Blätter: dünne, gleichmäßige Tuschelinien, systematische Schraffuren und variierte Wiederholung; Pionierzeit der Computerkunst in den 1960ern, Revival seit den 2010ern.
styles.short_en: Drawings made by pen plotters from algorithms: thin uniform ink lines, systematic hatching and repetition with variation; pioneered in 1960s computer art, revived since the 2010s.
markers_de: ein bis zwei Tintenfarben auf Papier
markers_en: one or two ink colours on paper
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine konkreten historischen Werke der Computerkunst-Pioniere nachbilden.

styles.era_origin: Creative-coding culture (Processing from 2001) and the generative-art boom of 2020-2022.
visual_markers: thousands of curved strokes following a noise vector field
rhythm of dense and sparse areas
styles.prompt_fragment: generative flow-field artwork, thousands of thin curved strokes following an invisible smooth noise vector field, streams bending in parallel without crossing, curated five-colour palette on warm paper-white ground, rhythmic variation between dense and sparse areas, crisp vector precision, purely algorithmic composition
styles.avoid: Avoid figurative illustration taking over; the subject should emerge from, or be outlined by, the field lines.
styles.feasibility_note: Flow-field patterns render convincingly.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid copying recognisable long-form generative collections.
styles.short_de: Algorithmisches Bild aus Tausenden gekrümmter Linien, die einem unsichtbaren Rauschfeld folgen, in kuratierter Palette auf Papierweiß; aus dem Creative Coding, Höhepunkt im Generative-Art-Boom 2020–2022.
styles.short_en: Algorithmic artwork of thousands of curved lines following an invisible noise field, in a curated palette on paper white; from creative coding, peaking in the 2020–2022 generative-art boom.
markers_de: Tausende gekrümmte Striche entlang eines Rauschfelds
Wechsel aus dichten und lichten Zonen
markers_en: thousands of curved strokes following a noise field
rhythm of dense and sparse areas
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine erkennbaren Generative-Art-Kollektionen kopieren.

styles.era_origin: Computer visualisations of Mandelbrot and Julia sets from 1980; a popular poster and screensaver aesthetic of the 1980s-90s.
styles.prompt_fragment: escape-time fractal visualisation, infinitely self-similar boundary of spirals and seahorse curls, smooth iteration-count colour banding cycling through a vivid palette, deep black interior regions, razor-fine mathematical detail at extreme zoom, recursive symmetric structures
styles.avoid: Avoid organic painterly textures; the pattern must look computed and mathematically recursive.
styles.feasibility_note: It looks fractal, but the exact mathematical structure is only approximated; subjects can be hidden in the boundary.
styles.short_de: Berechnete Bilder der Mandelbrot-Menge („Apfelmännchen“) und der Julia-Mengen: selbstähnliche Spiral- und Seepferdchenränder in Farbbändern um schwarze Innenflächen; beliebtes Poster- und Bildschirmschoner-Motiv der 80er und 90er.
styles.short_en: Computed images of the Mandelbrot and Julia sets: self-similar spiral and seahorse edges in banded colour around black interiors; a poster and screensaver favourite of the 1980s–90s.
styles.era_de: seit 1980, international; populär in den 1980er- und 1990er-Jahren

styles.era_origin: Fractal flame algorithm from 1992, popularised by free flame editors in the 2000s.
styles.prompt_fragment: fractal flame artwork, glowing silky filaments and translucent luminous veils twisting in spirals on a pure black background, smoke-like logarithmic density gradients, intricate iterated curves, saturated neon colour gradients, highly detailed symmetrical or swirling composition
styles.avoid: Avoid hard-edged geometry and generic galaxy nebulae; the filaments should be silky and mathematically repeated.
styles.feasibility_note: Glowing filament fractals render well.
styles.short_de: Fraktale aus iterierten Funktionssystemen, gerendert als leuchtende, seidige Filamente und Lichtschleier auf Schwarz; Algorithmus von 1992, verbreitet durch kostenlose Flame-Editoren in Online-Communities der 2000er.
styles.short_en: Iterated-function fractals rendered as glowing silky filaments and luminous veils on black; algorithm from 1992, spread by free flame editors in 2000s online art communities.

styles.era_origin: 3D fractals from 2009 (Mandelbulb, Mandelbox), rendered with distance-estimated ray marching.
visual_markers: bulbs, spikes and cavities at every scale
styles.prompt_fragment: 3D fractal render, infinitely recursive alien architecture of bulbs, spikes and cavities, self-similar detail at every scale, deep ambient-occlusion shadows in crevices, soft fog and glow, metallic or bone-white material, impossible cathedral-like spaces, computed mathematical surface
styles.avoid: Avoid organic biology and hand-modelled sci-fi; the detail must repeat recursively.
styles.feasibility_note: Fractal architecture renders convincingly.
styles.short_de: Per Raymarching gerenderte dreidimensionale Fraktale wie Mandelbulb oder Mandelbox: rekursive, fremdartige Architektur aus Knollen, Stacheln und Höhlen mit tiefen Schatten; entdeckt 2009–2010.
styles.short_en: Ray-marched renders of three-dimensional fractals such as the Mandelbulb or Mandelbox: recursive alien architecture of bulbs, spikes and cavities with deep shadows; discovered in 2009–2010.
markers_de: Knollen, Stacheln und Höhlen in jeder Größe
markers_en: bulbs, spikes and cavities at every scale

styles.era_origin: Demoscene 4k/64k intros of the 2000s, popularised by browser shader communities from 2013.
visual_markers: smooth primitives melting together with liquid joins
infinitely repeated forms receding into fog
analytic gradient sky with faint banding
styles.prompt_fragment: ray-marched signed-distance-field shader render, smooth primitives melting together with liquid blended joins, infinitely repeated forms receding into fog, soft penumbra shadows and ambient occlusion, simple procedural materials, analytic gradient sky, crisp mathematical surfaces with faint colour banding, real-time GPU demo look
styles.avoid: Avoid detailed textures and photoscanned realism; everything should look made from equations.
styles.feasibility_note: Soft-blended shapes work, but the clean equation-made look may give way to generic render detail.
styles.sensitivity_note: Shadertoy is a community site name used only as an alias.
styles.short_de: Vollständig im GPU-Shader aus Distanzfunktionen berechnete Bilder: weich ineinanderfließende Formen, endlose Wiederholungen im Nebel, sanfte Schatten; aus der Demoszene und Browser-Shader-Communities.
styles.short_en: Images computed entirely in a GPU shader from distance functions: smoothly blending shapes, endless repetitions into fog, soft shadows; from the demoscene and browser shader communities.
markers_en: infinitely repeated forms receding into fog
analytic gradient sky with faint banding
styles.sensitivity_de: Shadertoy ist der Name einer Community-Website und steht nur als Alias.
styles.sensitivity_en: Shadertoy is a community site name and appears only as an alias.

styles.era_origin: Simulations of natural pattern formation (Turing 1952) used in generative art and computational design since the 1990s.
styles.prompt_fragment: procedural morphogenesis pattern, labyrinthine reaction-diffusion stripes and spots, crinkled differential-growth folds and Voronoi cell structures, organic yet clearly simulated, uniform line weights and consistent spacing, two-tone graphic or soft white 3D-printed surfaces, scientific simulation precision
styles.avoid: Avoid hand-drawn organic texture; the regularity of simulation is the signature.
styles.feasibility_note: Such patterns render well.
styles.short_de: Simulierte natürliche Musterbildung: labyrinthartige Reaktions-Diffusions-Streifen, gekräuselte Wachstumsfalten und Voronoi-Zellen, eingesetzt in generativer Kunst und computergestütztem Design seit den 1990ern.
styles.short_en: Simulated natural pattern formation: labyrinthine reaction-diffusion stripes, crinkled differential-growth folds and Voronoi cells, used in generative art and computational design since the 1990s.

styles.era_origin: 2D vector trend of the early 2010s for portraits, wallpapers and logos.
visual_markers: flat 2D image made of flat-coloured triangles
each triangle averages the underlying colour
denser smaller triangles in detailed areas
styles.prompt_fragment: 2D triangulated polygon mosaic, image broken into flat-coloured triangles averaging the underlying colours, smaller denser triangles in detailed areas and large ones in flat regions, crisp vector edges, faceted gem-like surface, no outlines, no gradients inside triangles
styles.avoid: Avoid 3D lighting and rendered depth; it is a flat vector mosaic, not a low-poly scene.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable.
styles.short_de: Flaches 2D-Bild aus Dreiecken, jedes in der gemittelten Farbe darunter gefüllt und in Detailzonen kleiner; Vektortrend für Porträts und Wallpaper Anfang der 2010er-Jahre.
styles.short_en: Flat 2D image broken into triangles, each filled with the averaged colour beneath and smaller in detailed areas; an early-2010s vector trend for portraits and wallpapers.
markers_de: jedes Dreieck trägt die gemittelte Farbe
markers_en: flat image made of flat-coloured triangles
each triangle averages the underlying colour

styles.era_origin: Net-art and music-video aesthetic since the 1990s, consolidated as 'glitch art' in the 2000s.
visual_markers: JPEG macroblock corruption and datamosh smears
intact areas next to broken ones
styles.prompt_fragment: digital glitch art, RGB channels split and offset, horizontal slices displaced sideways, blocky JPEG macroblock corruption and datamosh smears dragging pixels across the frame, bursts of corrupted colour noise, repeated tile bands, stark digital error next to otherwise intact image areas
styles.avoid: Avoid a light chromatic-aberration filter alone; real glitch needs structural corruption.
styles.feasibility_note: Glitch effects reproduce well.
styles.short_de: Kunst aus digitalen Fehlern: verschobene RGB-Kanäle, versetzte Bildstreifen, JPEG-Blockartefakte und Datamosh-Schlieren neben intakten Bildteilen; aus Netzkunst und Musikvideos seit den 1990ern.
styles.short_en: Art made from digital errors: split RGB channels, displaced slices, JPEG block corruption and datamosh smears beside intact areas; from net art and music videos since the 1990s.
styles.era_de: seit den 1990ern, als Begriff gefestigt in den 2000ern, international
styles.era_en: since the 1990s, term established in the 2000s, international
markers_en: JPEG macroblock corruption and datamosh smears

styles.era_origin: Algorithmic glitch technique popularised around 2010.
visual_markers: long straight streaks of pixels sorted by brightness
sharp transitions between intact and melted areas
styles.prompt_fragment: pixel-sorted image, sections of the picture dissolving into long straight streaks where pixels are reordered by brightness, smooth sorted gradient bands cascading vertically, sharp transitions between intact image areas and melted streaks, threshold-based patterns, digital algorithmic distortion
styles.avoid: Avoid motion blur or paint drips; the streaks must be crisp sorted-pixel gradients.
styles.feasibility_note: Pixel sorting renders convincingly.
styles.sensitivity_note: The technique is strongly associated with a living artist; do not name artists in prompts.
styles.short_de: Algorithmische Glitch-Technik, bei der Pixelreihen nach Helligkeit neu sortiert werden, sodass Bildteile in lange, gerade Verlaufsstreifen zerfließen; populär seit etwa 2010.
styles.short_en: Algorithmic glitch technique that reorders rows of pixels by brightness, so parts of the image melt into long straight gradient streaks; popularised around 2010.
markers_de: lange, gerade Streifen nach Helligkeit sortierter Pixel
harte Grenze zwischen intakten und zerflossenen Zonen
markers_en: long straight streaks of brightness-sorted pixels
sharp border between intact and melted areas
styles.sensitivity_de: Die Technik ist eng mit einem lebenden Künstler verbunden; keine Künstlernamen im Prompt.
styles.sensitivity_en: The technique is closely tied to a living artist; don't name artists in prompts.

styles.era_origin: Cathode-ray tube screens, dominant until the mid-2000s; emulated by shader filters since the 2000s.
styles.prompt_fragment: image shown on a curved cathode-ray tube screen, visible horizontal scanlines, RGB phosphor mask texture, soft glow blooming around bright areas, slight colour bleed and convergence fringing, curved edges with dark vignette, faint reflections on the glass, subtle flicker banding
styles.avoid: Avoid flat digital sharpness; the screen texture must be visible across the whole image.
styles.feasibility_note: Scanlines and glow render well; a precise phosphor mask is approximated.
styles.short_de: Bild wie auf einer Bildröhre: sichtbare Zeilen, RGB-Lochmaske, Überstrahlung und Farbsäume, gewölbtes Glas mit dunklen Ecken; Standard bis Mitte der 2000er, heute als Filter nachgeahmt.
styles.short_en: An image on a cathode-ray tube: visible scanlines, RGB phosphor mask, bloom, colour bleed and curved glass with dark corners; standard until the mid-2000s, now emulated by filters.
styles.era_de: bis Mitte der 2000er; heute als Filter nachgeahmt
styles.era_en: until the mid-2000s; emulated by filters today

styles.era_origin: Neural-network feature visualisation published in May 2015.
visual_markers: eyes, dog-like faces, bird heads and pagodas emerging everywhere
styles.prompt_fragment: 2015-style neural-network hallucination, the image overgrown by recursive swirling patterns where countless small eyes, dog-like faces, bird heads and pagoda shapes emerge from every surface, oversaturated iridescent psychedelic colours, fractal repetition at many scales, algorithmic pareidolia over an otherwise ordinary picture
styles.avoid: Avoid generic psychedelic illustration; the tiny eyes and faces emerging out of textures are the signature.
styles.feasibility_note: Approximated, but it tends to become tidy psychedelic illustration; stress many tiny emerging faces.
styles.sensitivity_note: Dense eye clusters can be disturbing (trypophobia-like). 'DeepDream' is a Google project name used only as the established term.
styles.short_de: 2015 von Google veröffentlichte Visualisierung neuronaler Netze, die aus jeder Textur Augen, Hundegesichter und Pagoden wuchern lässt, in übersättigten, wirbelnden psychedelischen Farben.
styles.short_en: Neural-network visualisation published by Google in 2015 that makes eyes, dog faces and pagodas sprout from every texture in oversaturated, swirling psychedelic colours.
markers_de: Augen, Hundegesichter, Vogelköpfe und Pagoden überall
markers_en: eyes, dog faces, bird heads and pagodas emerging everywhere
styles.sensitivity_de: Dichte Augenhäufungen können verstörend wirken; „DeepDream“ ist ein Google-Projektname und hier der etablierte Begriff.
styles.sensitivity_en: Dense eye clusters can be disturbing; 'DeepDream' is a Google project name used as the established term.

styles.era_origin: Open-source text-guided GAN image generation, 2021.
visual_markers: motif fragments repeated and tiled across the canvas
melting perspective with no single horizon
smeared textures riddled with high-frequency noise
styles.prompt_fragment: 2021 text-guided GAN aesthetic, dreamlike incoherent composition with motif fragments repeated and tiled across the canvas, melting perspective with no single horizon, smeared painterly textures riddled with high-frequency noise, collage-like semantic jumble, low-resolution square crop, eerie half-legible shapes
styles.avoid: Avoid coherent anatomy and clean modern AI polish; deliberate incoherence and repetition are the point.
styles.feasibility_note: Modern models resist incoherence and tidy the result; only an approximation is achievable.
styles.sensitivity_note: Explicitly an AI aesthetic; label it clearly as such in the catalog.
styles.short_de: Optik der frühen Open-Source-Text-zu-Bild-Generierung von 2021: traumartige, zusammenhanglose Kompositionen, über das Bild verteilte Motivfragmente, zerfließende Perspektive und verrauschte, verschmierte Texturen.
styles.short_en: The look of early open-source text-to-image generation in 2021: dreamlike, incoherent compositions with motifs tiled across the frame, melting perspective and noisy smeared textures.
markers_en: motif fragments tiled across the canvas
styles.sensitivity_de: Eine ausdrücklich KI-generierte Ästhetik; im Katalog entsprechend kennzeichnen.
styles.sensitivity_en: An explicitly AI-generated aesthetic; label it as such in the catalogue.

styles.era_origin: Consumer text-to-image generation from 2022 onward.
visual_markers: warm golden rim light with teal-orange grade
over-smooth airbrushed skin and glossy surfaces
shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh
hazy volumetric glow and uniform hyper-detail
styles.prompt_fragment: generic contemporary AI-image look, centred symmetrical subject, warm golden rim light with teal-orange grading, over-smooth airbrushed skin and glossy surfaces, shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh, hazy volumetric glow, hyper-detailed everywhere, epic cinematic polish without any specific medium
styles.avoid: This is the contrast case; to escape it, specify medium, era, imperfections and lighting explicitly.
styles.feasibility_note: This is the default output.
styles.short_de: Generischer Look von Text-zu-Bild-Ergebnissen seit 2022: zentriertes Motiv, goldenes Gegenlicht, Teal-Orange-Grading, glattgebügelte Oberflächen, cremiges Bokeh und überall gleich viel Detail.
styles.short_en: The generic look of consumer text-to-image output since 2022: centred subject, golden rim light, teal-orange grade, airbrushed surfaces, creamy bokeh and uniform hyper-detail.
markers_de: dunstiges Volumenlicht, überall gleich viel Detail
markers_en: golden rim light with teal-orange grade
shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh

styles.era_origin: Adventure and visual-novel graphics on Japanese NEC PC-9801 computers (1982 to the early 2000s), revived as an online aesthetic in the 2010s.
visual_markers: fine high-resolution pixel art with a strict 16-color palette
dense checkerboard dithering on skies and skin
anime-style figures with crisp dark outlines
cool muted teal, violet and dusky pink
melancholic night or interior scenes in a game-window frame
styles.prompt_fragment: as late-1980s/1990s Japanese home-computer game art: fine 640x400 pixel art with a strict 16-color palette, dense checkerboard dithering for skies, skin and shadows, crisp dark outlines, cool muted teal, violet and dusky pink tones, quiet melancholic atmosphere, framed like a visual-novel scene window
styles.avoid: Don't drift into bright 8-bit console sprites or smooth modern anime; the dithering and limited palette have to stay visible.
styles.feasibility_note: The mood and the dithering come through. Palette discipline and a consistent pixel grid are unreliable.
styles.sensitivity_note: PC-98 is an NEC product name, used as a technical era descriptor.
styles.short_de: Pixel-Art japanischer Adventures und Visual Novels auf NECs PC-9801: feine, hochaufgelöste Pixel, strenge 16-Farben-Palette, dichtes Dithering und Anime-Figuren; online wiederentdeckt in den 2010ern.
styles.short_en: Pixel art of Japanese adventure games and visual novels on the NEC PC-9801: fine pixels, a strict 16-colour palette, dense dithering, anime figures; revived online in the 2010s.
styles.era_de: 1982 bis Ende der 1990er, Japan; Online-Revival seit den 2010ern
styles.era_en: 1982 to the late 1990s, Japan; online revival since the 2010s
markers_de: kühles, gedämpftes Türkis, Violett und Altrosa
markers_en: fine pixel art in a strict 16-colour palette
anime figures with crisp dark outlines
cool muted teal, violet and dusky pink
melancholic scenes in a game-window frame
styles.sensitivity_de: PC-98 ist ein NEC-Produktname und dient nur als technische Epochenangabe.
styles.sensitivity_en: PC-98 is an NEC product name, used only as a technical era descriptor.

styles.era_origin: Web, motion-graphics and wallpaper design of roughly 1998 to 2005; named retrospectively by the Consumer Aesthetics Research Institute.
visual_markers: deformed abstract 3D shapes in chrome and bead-blasted metal
dark blurry backgrounds with lens glows
thin HUD lines, grids and technical microtext
steel blue-grey with orange or acid-green accents
styles.prompt_fragment: in late-1990s Metalheart tech-abstract style: abstract deformed 3D metal shapes in chrome and bead-blasted steel, dark blurred background with lens glows, thin interface lines, grids, crosshairs and tiny technical microtext, squared futuristic type, cool steel blue-grey palette with sharp orange or acid-green accents
styles.avoid: Avoid the cheerful bubbly pastel Y2K look and cinematic modern sci-fi; keep it dark, abstract and graphic-designer techy.
styles.feasibility_note: Chrome and HUD elements render well. Microtext comes out as pseudo-text, which suits the style.
styles.sensitivity_note: Don't name the design studios that pioneered it; several are still active.
styles.short_de: Dunkles, technoides Web- und Wallpaper-Design von etwa 1998 bis 2005: verformte Formen aus Chrom und gestrahltem Metall, unscharfe Hintergründe, HUD-Linien und Mikrotext; benannt nach einem Designbuch von 2001.
styles.short_en: Dark tech-abstract web and wallpaper design of about 1998–2005: deformed chrome and bead-blasted metal shapes, blurred backgrounds, HUD lines and microtext; named after a 2001 design book.
markers_de: verformte abstrakte 3D-Formen aus Chrom und gestrahltem Metall
feine HUD-Linien, Raster und technischer Mikrotext
markers_en: deformed abstract 3D shapes in chrome and bead-blasted metal
dark blurred backgrounds with lens glows
thin HUD lines, grids and technical microtext
steel blue-grey with orange or acid-green accents
styles.sensitivity_de: Die Pionier-Studios nicht nennen; mehrere sind noch aktiv.
styles.sensitivity_en: Don't name the pioneering design studios; several are still active.

styles.era_origin: Amateur personal homepages on free hosts from 1995 to 2002, revived by 'old web' communities since about 2013.
visual_markers: small animated-GIF clip art (construction signs, spinning globes, flames)
clashing default fonts and blue underlined links
styles.prompt_fragment: as a late-1990s amateur personal homepage screenshot: tiled starfield or textured background, clashing bright text in default serif and comic fonts, rainbow divider bars, small GIF clip art (spinning globe, construction sign, flames), visitor counter, tiny 88x31 badges, blue underlined links, table-based centered layout, 256-color dithering
styles.avoid: Avoid a clean modern website mockup or a pastel vaporwave reading of it; it should look sincerely amateur.
styles.feasibility_note: Handles chaotic web collage well. Small text is often only pseudo-legible.
styles.sensitivity_note: GeoCities was a Yahoo service; the name is used only as a historic descriptor.
styles.short_de: Private Homepages bei Gratis-Hostern, etwa 1995–2002: gekachelte Sternenhintergründe, animierte Clipart-GIFs, Regenbogen-Trennlinien, Besucherzähler und wild gemischte Standardschriften.
styles.short_en: Amateur personal homepages on free hosts, about 1995–2002: tiled starfield backgrounds, animated clip-art GIFs, rainbow dividers, visitor counters and clashing default fonts.
markers_de: wild gemischte Standardschriften, blaue unterstrichene Links
markers_en: clashing default fonts, blue underlined links
styles.sensitivity_de: GeoCities war ein Yahoo-Dienst; der Name dient nur als historische Bezeichnung.
styles.sensitivity_en: GeoCities was a Yahoo service; the name is used only as a historical descriptor.

styles.era_origin: Mid-1990s desktop operating systems, used as found-image collage material by the vaporwave and webcore scenes since the 2010s.
visual_markers: grey bevelled 3D windows with navy title bars
stacked error and alert dialog boxes
teal desktop background and bottom taskbar
styles.prompt_fragment: as a mid-1990s desktop operating system collage: grey bevelled 3D windows with navy gradient title bars, stacked error and alert dialog boxes, pixelated 32x32 icons, arrow and hourglass cursors, teal desktop background, taskbar along the bottom, small bitmap UI font, the subject framed inside a low-color window
styles.avoid: Avoid sleek modern UI and glassy later styling; stick to flat grey bevels and 16- or 256-color icons.
styles.feasibility_note: Highly recognizable and renders well. Make sure no real logos appear.
styles.sensitivity_note: Windows is a Microsoft trademark; don't reproduce the real logo or the branded start button.
styles.short_de: Collage aus Desktop-Elementen der mittleren 1990er: graue, abgeschrägte Fenster mit dunkelblauen Titelleisten, gestapelte Fehlermeldungen, Pixel-Icons und türkiser Desktop; aufgegriffen von Vaporwave und Webcore seit den 2010ern.
styles.short_en: Collage of mid-1990s desktop interface parts: grey bevelled windows, navy title bars, stacked error dialogs, pixel icons, teal desktop; reused by vaporwave and webcore since the 2010s.
styles.era_de: Mitte der 1990er; als Collage seit den 2010ern
markers_de: graue, abgeschrägte Fenster mit dunkelblauen Titelleisten
markers_en: grey bevelled windows with navy title bars
styles.sensitivity_de: Windows ist eine Marke von Microsoft; echtes Logo und Startknopf nicht nachbilden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Windows is a Microsoft trademark; don't reproduce the real logo or the branded start button.

styles.era_origin: Online forums and amateur art communities of about 2003 to 2010, fed by free brush packs and render plugins.
visual_markers: heavy lens flares and light rays
tiny pixel-font tagline with outer glow
styles.prompt_fragment: as a mid-2000s amateur digital photomanipulation: subject cut out with soft glowing edges, heavy lens flares and light rays, grunge splatter and abstract swirl brushes, render-cloud textures, smudge-tool streaks, abstract 3D shards, tiny pixel-font tagline with outer glow, saturated teal-orange or blue-black palette
styles.avoid: Avoid restrained professional retouching; overusing effects is what defines the style.
styles.feasibility_note: Effect-heavy composites are easy. They can look too polished unless the amateur traits are stressed.
styles.sensitivity_note: Photoshop is an Adobe trademark, used as an era descriptor.
styles.short_de: Amateurhafte Bildmontagen aus Foren und Kunst-Communities der 2000er: freigestellte Motive unter Lens Flares, Grunge-Pinseln, Render-Wolken und abstrakten Splittern, oft als Forensignatur-Banner.
styles.short_en: Amateur photo manipulations from 2000s forums and art communities: cut-out subjects drowned in lens flares, grunge brushes, render clouds and abstract shards, often as forum signature banners.
markers_de: winziger Pixelschrift-Slogan mit Schein nach außen
markers_en: heavy lens flares and light rays
tiny pixel-font tagline with outer glow
styles.sensitivity_de: Photoshop ist eine Marke von Adobe und steht nur als Epochenangabe im Namen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Photoshop is an Adobe trademark, used only as an era descriptor in the name.

styles.era_origin: Social profiles and online photo editors of 2006 to 2010 that stamped sparkles onto photos.
visual_markers: pasted hearts, crowns, butterflies and tiaras
styles.prompt_fragment: as a 2007 glitter-graphic photo edit: glittering sparkle stamps and twinkling star overlays layered over the image, glitter-textured cursive text, pasted pink hearts, crowns and butterflies, low-res 256-color GIF dithering and jagged cut-out edges, a frame of rhinestones, maximal cute clutter
styles.avoid: Avoid elegant glitter photography and modern glossy sparkles; it must look like low-res stamped web edits.
styles.feasibility_note: The sparkle stamps work. GIF dithering and stamped edges tend to get smoothed, and a still image can't show the animation.
styles.sensitivity_note: Blingee is a website name, used only as an alias.
styles.short_de: Fotobearbeitungen aus Social-Profilen und Online-Editoren der späten 2000er: funkelnde Glitzer-Stempel, Glitzer-Schreibschrift, aufgeklebte Herzen und Krönchen, alles in grob gerasterter GIF-Qualität.
styles.short_en: Photo edits from late-2000s social profiles and online editors: twinkling glitter stamps, glitter cursive text, pasted hearts and crowns, all in low-res dithered GIF quality.
styles.sensitivity_de: Blingee ist der Name einer Website und steht nur als Alias.
styles.sensitivity_en: Blingee is a website name and appears only as an alias.

styles.era_origin: Club flyers, electronic-music covers and sportswear graphics of the late 1990s to mid 2000s; the name comes from the Consumer Aesthetics Research Institute.
visual_markers: flat high-contrast colors (signal orange, acid green, black) on neutral grey
arrows, barcodes, numbers and tiny technical labels
styles.prompt_fragment: in late-1990s Vectorheart graphic style: sharp angular maximalist 2D vector shapes, flat high-contrast colors (signal orange, acid green, black) on neutral light grey, blocky futuristic typefaces, arrows, barcodes, numbers and tiny technical labels, Swiss-grid layout with an industrial utilitarian feel
styles.avoid: Avoid soft gradients, chrome and cute bubbly Y2K; this is flat, sharp and utilitarian.
styles.feasibility_note: Flat shapes and the layout come through. Typographic precision and microtext are only approximate.
styles.sensitivity_note: Don't name the design studios that pioneered it; several are still active.
styles.short_de: Flache, scharfkantige Vektorgrafik der späten 1990er aus Clubflyern, Techno-Covern und Spieleverpackungen: kantige Formen, Signalfarben auf Grau, blockige Schriften, technische Beschriftungen; Name nachträglich vergeben.
styles.short_en: Flat, sharp vector graphics from late-1990s club flyers, techno covers and game packaging: angular shapes, signal colours on grey, blocky type and technical labels; named retrospectively.
markers_de: flaches Signalorange, Giftgrün und Schwarz auf Grau
Pfeile, Barcodes und winzige technische Beschriftungen
markers_en: flat signal orange, acid green and black on grey
arrows, barcodes and tiny technical labels
styles.sensitivity_de: Die Pionier-Studios nicht nennen; mehrere sind noch aktiv.
styles.sensitivity_en: Don't name the pioneering design studios; several are still active.

styles.era_origin: Stock graphics, ads, T-shirts and album art from the early 2000s to the early 2010s.
visual_markers: dense swirling flourishes and curling stems
vector flowers, butterflies, birds and hearts
flat fills mixed with dramatic gradients
styles.prompt_fragment: as a 2000s vector-flourish illustration: dense maximalist swirling flourishes and curling stems, vector flowers, butterflies, birds and hearts, silhouetted forms, halftone dot clusters and paint splatters, flat fills mixed with dramatic gradients, black, hot pink, teal and white palette, glossy stock-graphic finish
styles.avoid: Avoid tasteful botanical illustration and true Art Nouveau; it should feel digital, clip-art-like and over-ornamented.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders easily and holds a consistent style.
styles.short_de: Maximalistische Vektorillustration von Mitte der 2000er bis Anfang der 2010er: Schnörkelranken, Blumen, Schmetterlinge, Silhouetten, Rasterpunkte und Farbspritzer in Kontrastfarben, allgegenwärtig in Stockgrafik und Werbung.
styles.short_en: Maximal vector illustration of the mid-2000s to early 2010s: swirling flourishes, flowers, butterflies, silhouettes, halftone dots and splats in high-contrast colours, ubiquitous in stock graphics and ads.
markers_en: dense swirling flourishes and curling stems
vector flowers, butterflies, birds and hearts
flat fills mixed with dramatic gradients

styles.era_origin: Websites, startup logos and app icons of roughly 2004 to 2009.
visual_markers: glossy gel highlight across the upper half
mirror reflection fading on a white floor
rounded bubbly sans-serif and diagonal pinstripes
styles.prompt_fragment: in mid-2000s Web 2.0 style: glossy gel surfaces with a bright highlight across the upper half, mirror reflection fading below on a white floor, starburst 'beta' badge, soft gradients in lime green, sky blue and tangerine, rounded bubbly sans-serif lettering, subtle diagonal pinstripe background, clean and optimistic
styles.avoid: Avoid modern flat design and the nature imagery of Frutiger Aero; focus on glossy UI-like objects and reflective floors.
styles.feasibility_note: Gloss and reflections render reliably.
styles.short_de: Glanzoptik von Websites, Start-up-Logos und App-Icons Mitte der 2000er: Gel-Glanzlichter, Spiegelungen auf Weiß, sternförmige Beta-Störer und Verläufe in Limette, Himmelblau und Mandarine.
styles.short_en: Glossy look of mid-2000s websites, startup logos and app icons: gel highlights, mirror reflections on white, starburst beta badges and lime, sky-blue and tangerine gradients.
markers_de: Verläufe in Limette, Himmelblau und Mandarine
runde, pummelige Grotesk und diagonale Nadelstreifen
markers_en: glossy gel highlight on the upper half
rounded bubbly sans and diagonal pinstripes

styles.era_origin: Peaked in smartphone and desktop app design from 2007 to 2013, before the shift to flat design.
visual_markers: imitated materials: stitched leather, felt, brushed metal, wood
realistic dials and toggles on linen texture
styles.prompt_fragment: in early-2010s skeuomorphic style: everything imitating physical materials (stitched leather, green felt, brushed aluminium, wood grain, torn notepaper) with embossed letterpress text, deep soft drop shadows, glossy rounded-square highlights, realistic dials and toggles, fine grey linen background texture, warm studio lighting
styles.avoid: Avoid photographing real objects; it should feel like crafted digital interface rendering, not reality.
styles.feasibility_note: The material textures are convincing. Keep the number of elements small.
styles.sensitivity_note: Don't copy real platform app icons.
styles.short_de: Digitale Oberflächen, die echte Materialien wie genähtes Leder, Filz, gebürstetes Metall und Holz nachahmen, mit geprägter Schrift und tiefen Schatten; prägend im App-Design 2007–2013.
styles.short_en: Digital interfaces imitating physical materials such as stitched leather, felt, brushed metal and wood, with embossed text and deep shadows; dominant in app design from 2007 to 2013.
markers_de: nachgeahmtes Nahtleder, Filz, gebürstetes Metall, Holz
realistische Drehregler und Schalter auf Leinenstruktur
markers_en: imitated stitched leather, felt, brushed metal, wood
realistic dials and toggles on linen texture
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine echten Plattform-App-Icons kopieren.
styles.sensitivity_en: Don't copy real platform app icons.

styles.era_origin: The flat-design wave of 2012 to 2015 in icons, web and infographics.
visual_markers: solid flat shapes with no gradients
45-degree long shadow running to the edge
turquoise, emerald, sunflower and coral palette
styles.prompt_fragment: in 2013 flat design style: simple solid-color geometric shapes with no gradients or texture, a long diagonal 45-degree shadow trailing to the frame edge, bright flat-UI palette of turquoise, emerald, sunflower yellow and coral red on a saturated circle or tile, thin geometric sans-serif labels
styles.avoid: Avoid soft 3D or glossy depth; the only shading is the hard long shadow.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable, though shadow angles are sometimes inconsistent.
styles.short_de: Flat-Design-Variante um 2013: einfarbige Formen ohne Verlauf, die einen harten 45-Grad-Schatten bis zum Bildrand werfen, in Türkis, Smaragd, Sonnenblumengelb und Koralle.
styles.short_en: Flat-design variant of about 2013: solid shapes without gradients casting a hard 45-degree shadow to the frame edge, in turquoise, emerald, sunflower yellow and coral.
markers_de: Palette aus Türkis, Smaragd, Sonnenblumengelb und Koralle
markers_en: hard 45-degree long shadow to the edge
turquoise, emerald, sunflower and coral palette

styles.era_origin: Branding and web-design trend of about 2020 to 2023.
visual_markers: soft blurred color fields melting together
vivid orange, magenta, cobalt and violet
blurry glowing orbs and soft silhouettes
styles.prompt_fragment: in grainy-gradient style: soft out-of-focus color fields melting into each other in vivid orange, magenta, cobalt and violet, fine film-like noise grain over everything, blurry glowing orbs and soft silhouettes instead of hard edges, minimal clean typography, flat and matte rather than glossy
styles.avoid: Avoid glossy 3D and sharp outlines; the subject should show only as soft silhouettes in the haze.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders well. The grain sometimes gets smoothed away unless it is stressed.
styles.short_de: Branding- und Webtrend von etwa 2020 bis 2023: weiche, unscharfe Farbfelder in kräftigem Orange, Magenta, Kobalt und Violett, überzogen mit feinem Rauschkorn, matt statt glänzend.
styles.short_en: Branding and web trend of about 2020–2023: soft, blurred colour fields in vivid orange, magenta, cobalt and violet, overlaid with fine noise grain, matte rather than glossy.
markers_de: kräftiges Orange, Magenta, Kobalt und Violett
unscharf leuchtende Kugeln und weiche Silhouetten
markers_en: soft blurred colour fields melting together
vivid orange, magenta, cobalt and violet
blurry glowing orbs and soft silhouettes

styles.era_origin: Packaging, fashion and web-graphics trend of about 2016 to 2019, echoing 1980s holograms.
styles.prompt_fragment: with a holographic iridescent finish: surfaces shimmering in shifting pastel rainbow foil (pink, cyan, lilac and mint), crinkled metallic foil textures, pearlescent highlights and prismatic edge glints, oil-slick color shifts, soft bright studio lighting on a pale background
styles.avoid: Avoid plain rainbow gradients without the metallic foil sheen.
styles.feasibility_note: The foil sheen renders well.
styles.short_de: Oberflächen, die wie Hologrammfolie in wechselnden Pastell-Regenbogentönen mit Perlmuttglanz schimmern; Trend in Verpackung, Mode und Webdesign um 2016–2019, angelehnt an Hologramme der 80er.
styles.short_en: Surfaces shimmering like holographic foil in shifting pastel rainbow tones with pearlescent highlights; a packaging, fashion and web trend of about 2016–2019 echoing 1980s holograms.

styles.era_origin: Tech ads, music videos and fashion of about 1995 to 2004, around the millennium.
visual_markers: icy baby blue, lilac and silver with iridescence
thin digital grids and bubbly or wide techno lettering
styles.prompt_fragment: in late-1990s Y2K futurism: liquid chrome and brushed silver surfaces, blobby organic tech shapes, icy baby blue, lilac and silver palette with iridescent sheen, glossy early-CGI rendering, thin digital grids and orbital rings, bubbly or wide techno lettering, optimistic millennium sleekness
styles.avoid: Avoid dark gritty cyberpunk and modern hyperreal renders; keep it pale, silvery and early-CGI.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders reliably. Stress 'early CGI' to avoid modern photoreal chrome.
styles.short_de: Optimistischer Millenniums-Look aus Tech-Werbung, Musikvideos und Mode um 1995–2004: flüssiges Chrom, blobartige Tech-Formen, Eisblau, Flieder und Silber sowie glänzende frühe CGI.
styles.short_en: Optimistic millennium look of tech ads, music videos and fashion around 1995–2004: liquid chrome, blobby tech shapes, icy blue, lilac and silver, and glossy early CGI.
markers_de: feine Digitalraster, runde oder breite Techno-Schrift
markers_en: icy baby blue, lilac and silver
thin digital grids, bubbly or wide techno type

styles.era_origin: Consumer electronics and accessories with transparent colored housings, about 1998 to 2003.
visual_markers: see-through tinted plastic in blueberry, tangerine, lime and grape
styles.prompt_fragment: made of late-1990s translucent candy-colored plastic: see-through tinted housings in blueberry, tangerine, lime and grape, visible internal circuitry and screws, frosted and glossy surfaces with soft refraction, bubbly rounded forms, bright seamless white studio backdrop, crisp catalog lighting
styles.avoid: Avoid crystal glass and modern minimal aluminium; the plastic should feel cheap and candy-tinted.
styles.feasibility_note: Translucency and internal parts render convincingly.
styles.sensitivity_note: Closely associated with a famous 1998 desktop computer; don't reproduce branded products or logos.
styles.short_de: Elektronik und Zubehör aus durchscheinend gefärbtem Kunststoff in Blaubeere, Mandarine oder Limette, mit sichtbarer Platine und rundlichen Formen; Produktdesign-Trend etwa 1998–2003.
styles.short_en: Consumer electronics and accessories in see-through tinted plastic such as blueberry, tangerine or lime, with visible circuitry and bubbly forms; a product-design trend of about 1998–2003.
markers_en: see-through tinted plastic in fruit colours
styles.sensitivity_de: Eng mit einem bekannten Desktop-Computer von 1998 verbunden; keine Markenprodukte oder Logos nachbilden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Closely tied to a famous 1998 desktop computer; don't reproduce branded products or logos.

styles.era_origin: About 1996 to 2002, named by a member of the Consumer Aesthetics Research Institute and revived on TikTok in 2023.
visual_markers: cool muted aqua, steel blue, frosted grey
small minimal sans-serif with wide tracking
styles.prompt_fragment: in late-1990s Gen X Soft Club style: cool muted palette of pale aqua, steel blue, frosted grey and white, soft-focus and motion-blurred photography, translucent overlapping layers, small minimal sans-serif type with wide tracking, calm downtempo club mood, sleek understated futurism without chrome or glitter
styles.avoid: Avoid shiny Y2K chrome and neon; everything should be hushed, cool and blurred.
styles.feasibility_note: The mood is subtle, so the model may drift into generic blue-tinted stock or Y2K chrome.
styles.short_de: Gedämpftes, urbanes Gegenstück zum Y2K-Chrom, späte 1990er bis frühe 2000er: weichgezeichnete, verwischte Fotos in kühlen, gedeckten Tönen, transparente Ebenen und kleine, weit gesperrte Grotesk.
styles.short_en: Hushed, urban counterpart to Y2K chrome, late 1990s to early 2000s: soft-focus, blurred photography in cool muted tones, translucent layers and small wide-tracked sans type.
styles.era_de: späte 1990er bis frühe 2000er, v. a. Großbritannien
markers_de: kühles, gedämpftes Aqua, Stahlblau und Frostgrau
kleine, schlichte Grotesk mit weiter Sperrung
markers_en: cool muted aqua, steel blue and frosted grey
small minimal sans with wide tracking

styles.era_origin: Fashion and pop-culture look of about 2000 to 2008, peaking 2003-2008; the term comes from the Consumer Aesthetics Research Institute.
styles.prompt_fragment: in mid-2000s McBling style: hot pink and bubblegum palette, rhinestones, glitter and bling everywhere, velour and faux-fur textures, oversized sunglasses, chunky jewelry and flip-phone-era accessories, harsh direct on-camera flash with paparazzi feel, sparkly cursive typography, tacky celebrity glamour
styles.avoid: Avoid tasteful pastel; this is loud and trashy, and it shouldn't show real logos.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders easily. The model may try to add fake designer logos; tell it not to.
styles.sensitivity_note: Strongly tied to real fashion brands and celebrities; describe it generically and show no logos or likenesses.
styles.short_de: Greller Glamour-Look der 2000er-Jahre aus Mode und Boulevard: Pink, Strass, Velours und Paparazzi-Blitz; nachträglich benannt vom Consumer Aesthetics Research Institute.
styles.short_en: Loud, glitzy pop and fashion look of the 2000s: hot pink, rhinestones, velour and paparazzi flash, named retrospectively by the Consumer Aesthetics Research Institute.
styles.era_en: c. 2000–2008, USA and Western pop culture
styles.sensitivity_de: Eng mit echten Modemarken und Prominenten verknüpft; allgemein beschreiben, ohne Logos oder erkennbare Gesichter.
styles.sensitivity_en: Closely tied to real fashion brands and celebrities; keep it generic, without logos or recognizable faces.

styles.era_origin: Emerged in late-2010s techno and rave circles and the tattoo scene; mainstream in fashion and graphics since about 2020.
visual_markers: ink on pale ground or chrome on black
styles.prompt_fragment: in cybersigilism style: delicate thin black linework of spiky thorn-like strokes branching and radiating symmetrically, tapering needle points, chaotic yet balanced sigil forms, generous negative space, monochrome ink on pale ground or chrome-silver on black, half organic and half circuit-like
styles.avoid: Avoid bold traditional tribal tattoo shapes and Celtic knots; the lines have to stay hairline-thin and spiky.
styles.feasibility_note: Fine linework holds well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Echoes 'tribal' tattoo forms that have roots in Polynesian and other Indigenous traditions; keep it abstract and don't copy sacred patterns.
styles.short_de: Haarfeine, stachelige Schwarzlinien, die sich symmetrisch wie Dornen oder Leiterbahnen verzweigen; entstanden Ende der 2010er in Techno- und Tattooszene, seit etwa 2020 in der Mode.
styles.short_en: Hairline-thin, spiky black linework that branches symmetrically like thorns or circuitry; from the late-2010s techno and tattoo scene, in fashion since about 2020.
styles.era_de: Ende 2010er, Techno- und Tattooszene (u. a. Berlin); ab ca. 2020 Mainstream
styles.era_en: late 2010s, techno and tattoo scene (incl. Berlin); mainstream from c. 2020
markers_de: Tinte auf Hell oder Chrom auf Schwarz
markers_en: ink on pale ground or chrome on black
styles.sensitivity_de: Erinnert an „Tribal“-Tattoos mit Wurzeln in polynesischen und anderen indigenen Traditionen; abstrakt halten, keine sakralen Muster übernehmen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Echoes 'tribal' tattoo forms rooted in Polynesian and other Indigenous traditions; keep it abstract and copy no sacred patterns.

styles.era_origin: Literary genre of the early 1980s; its visual vocabulary has been shaped by films, comics and games since 1982.
visual_markers: cybernetic details on aging concrete megastructures
styles.prompt_fragment: in classic cyberpunk style: rain-slicked night streets under dense layered neon signage, magenta and teal light reflecting in puddles, steam and haze, cables and makeshift tech bolted onto aging concrete megastructures, cybernetic details, cramped vertical composition, high-tech low-life grit
styles.avoid: It sits very close to the AI default, so push toward gritty, cramped detail lit by practical sources and away from glossy hero shots.
styles.feasibility_note: Effortless for the model, and generic for exactly that reason.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid Orientalist 'exotic Asia' clichés and garbled pseudo-Asian signage.
styles.short_de: Neonbeleuchtete, verregnete Megastädte bei Nacht, in denen Hightech auf Verfall trifft; Science-Fiction-Genre der frühen 1980er, visuell geprägt durch Film, Manga und Games.
styles.short_en: Neon-lit, rain-soaked megacity nights where high tech meets decay; a science-fiction genre of the early 1980s whose look was set by film, manga and games.
styles.era_de: seit Anfang der 1980er, USA und Japan
styles.era_en: since the early 1980s, USA and Japan
markers_en: magenta and teal reflections in puddles
styles.sensitivity_de: Orientalistische Asien-Klischees und sinnlose Pseudo-Schriftzeichen auf Schildern vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid Orientalist 'exotic Asia' clichés and garbled pseudo-Asian signage.

styles.era_origin: The term dates from about 2008 and developed on Tumblr around 2014 as an optimistic counterpart to cyberpunk.
visual_markers: vertical gardens and vines on buildings
organic Art Nouveau curves and stained glass
solar panels and small wind turbines as ornament
styles.prompt_fragment: in solarpunk style: optimistic sustainable future, lush vertical gardens and vines covering organic Art Nouveau-curved buildings, solar panels and small wind turbines integrated as ornaments, stained glass and natural wood, warm golden daylight, community-made craft technology, bright green, white and sun-yellow palette
styles.avoid: Avoid sterile glass-skyscraper eco renders; stress the handmade, communal and ornamental.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable, but it drifts toward generic green architectural visualization if the craft and ornament are left out.
styles.short_de: Zuversichtliche grüne Zukunft mit bepflanzten, verzierten Bauten und selbstgebauter Solartechnik; der Begriff stammt von 2008, die Bildsprache entstand um 2014 auf Tumblr.
styles.short_en: Hopeful green future of plant-covered, ornamented buildings and hand-built solar technology; the term dates from 2008, the look took shape on Tumblr around 2014.
styles.era_en: since 2008 (term), visual style from c. 2014, internet
markers_de: vertikale Gärten und Ranken an Fassaden
markers_en: vertical gardens and vines on buildings
Art Nouveau curves and stained glass
solar panels and small wind turbines as ornament

styles.era_origin: Imagined futures of the early 1970s to mid-1990s; the term gained traction online in the 2010s.
visual_markers: chunky beige and off-white plastic hardware
boxy CRT monitors with monochrome readouts
rows of toggle switches, push buttons and tape drives
styles.prompt_fragment: in cassette futurism style: chunky beige and off-white plastic hardware, boxy CRT monitors with monochrome green or amber readouts, rows of toggle switches, push buttons, cassette and tape drives, ribbon cables, utilitarian industrial panels with stencil labels, muted beige, brown and safety-orange palette, flat fluorescent lighting
styles.avoid: Avoid sleek touchscreens and holograms; everything should be tactile and analog.
styles.feasibility_note: Hardware detail renders well.
styles.short_de: Retro-Science-Fiction aus klobiger beiger Hardware, Röhrenmonitoren, Kippschaltern und Bandlaufwerken, so wie man sich die Zukunft von den 1970ern bis Mitte der 1990er vorstellte.
styles.short_en: Retro sci-fi built from chunky beige hardware, CRT monitors, toggle switches and tape drives, as the future was imagined from the 1970s to the mid-1990s.
markers_de: kastige Röhrenmonitore mit grüner oder bernsteinfarbener Schrift
markers_en: boxy CRTs with green or amber readouts
toggle switches, buttons and tape drives

styles.era_origin: An online micro-scene on Tumblr and Twitter in 2011-2012.
styles.prompt_fragment: in 2011 seapunk style: aqua, turquoise and seafoam palette, glossy early-3D rendered water and waves, floating dolphins, shells and yin-yang symbols, rainbow gradients, tiled 90s web textures, low-poly ocean surfaces, deliberately cheesy digital collage
styles.avoid: Avoid realistic underwater photography; it should be kitsch digital collage, not vaporwave pastel.
styles.feasibility_note: Tends to drift into vaporwave, so emphasize the aquatic motifs and turquoise palette.
styles.sensitivity_note: The yin-yang is a Taoist symbol that the original scene used decoratively; use it respectfully.
styles.short_de: Kitschige Unterwasser-Webcollage in Türkis und Meeresgrün mit glänzendem 3D-Wasser, Delfinen und Yin-Yang; eine kurzlebige Tumblr- und Twitter-Szene von 2011 bis 2012.
styles.short_en: Kitschy aquatic web collage in turquoise and seafoam with glossy 3D water, dolphins and yin-yangs; a short-lived Tumblr and Twitter micro-scene of 2011–2012.
styles.sensitivity_de: Das Yin-Yang ist ein daoistisches Symbol, das die Szene dekorativ verwendete; respektvoll einsetzen.
styles.sensitivity_en: The yin-yang is a Taoist symbol the scene used as decoration; use it with respect.

styles.era_origin: Social-network profiles and music subculture of about 2005 to 2010.
visual_markers: low-res webcam or early digicam quality
black with hot pink and electric blue
glittery pixel text and star doodles
styles.prompt_fragment: in mid-2000s scene/emo social profile style: high-angle arm-length selfie framing, harsh low-res digital camera or webcam quality, black palette with hot pink and electric blue neon accents, zebra and leopard print, star and heart doodles, glittery pixel text, heavily edited contrast
styles.avoid: Avoid sharp modern smartphone selfies; the image quality must be low and the edits tacky.
styles.feasibility_note: The selfie angle and low-res look work well.
styles.sensitivity_note: MySpace is a brand name. The original scene included many minors, so depict adults only.
styles.short_de: Pixelige Selfies von schräg oben in Schwarz, Pink und Neonblau mit Tierprints und Glitzerschrift; Netzwerk- und Musikszene der Jahre etwa 2005 bis 2010.
styles.short_en: Low-res high-angle selfies in black, hot pink and electric blue with animal prints and glitter text; social-network and music subculture of about 2005 to 2010.
markers_de: Selfie mit ausgestrecktem Arm von oben
markers_en: black with hot pink and electric blue
glittery pixel text and star doodles
styles.sensitivity_de: MySpace ist ein Markenname; zur Szene gehörten viele Minderjährige, daher nur Erwachsene darstellen.
styles.sensitivity_en: MySpace is a brand name; the original scene included many minors, so show adults only.

styles.era_origin: Party blogs and nightlife photography of about 2006 to 2012; the term was coined in 2021.
styles.prompt_fragment: as late-2000s indie sleaze party photography: harsh direct on-camera flash, overexposed foreground against a pitch-black background, sweaty skin and smudged eyeliner, candid messy moments, slightly tilted framing, point-and-shoot digital noise, red-eye, deliberately unflattering and spontaneous
styles.avoid: Avoid polished editorial lighting and smooth skin; it has to look like a party-blog snapshot.
styles.feasibility_note: The flash look works very well. Skin tends to be over-smoothed, so stress sweat and texture.
styles.sensitivity_note: Associated with a fashion retailer and specific party photographers, who shouldn't be named. Depict adults and don't glamorize drug use.
styles.short_de: Harter Direktblitz, verschwitzte Haut und verschmierter Eyeliner vor Schwarz: Partyblog-Fotografie der Jahre 2006 bis 2012, seit 2021 als „Indie Sleaze“ bezeichnet.
styles.short_en: Harsh on-camera flash, sweaty skin and smudged eyeliner against black: party-blog photography of about 2006 to 2012, called 'indie sleaze' since 2021.
styles.sensitivity_de: Mit einer Modekette und bestimmten Partyfotografen verbunden, die ungenannt bleiben sollen; nur Erwachsene zeigen, Drogenkonsum nicht verklären.
styles.sensitivity_en: Linked to a fashion retailer and specific party photographers, who should not be named; show adults only and do not glamorize drug use.

styles.era_origin: Tumblr fashion and image culture of 2012 to 2014.
visual_markers: washed-out lavender, baby pink and mint mixed with black
sheer fabrics, flower crowns and chokers
small moons, crosses and smiley doodles
lowercase handwritten captions in a square crop
styles.prompt_fragment: in 2013 Tumblr pastel grunge style: washed-out faded pastels (lavender, baby pink, mint) mixed with black, light leaks and film grain, sheer fabrics, flower crowns and chokers, small moons and smiley doodles, melancholic dreamy mood, lowercase handwritten caption text, square crop with soft vignette
styles.avoid: Avoid bright kawaii cuteness and polished fashion editorials; keep it faded, moody and DIY.
styles.feasibility_note: The mood and palette render reliably.
styles.sensitivity_note: The original scene sometimes romanticized self-harm and depression imagery; exclude that. Crosses were used as decoration, so use religious symbols with care.
styles.short_de: Verwaschene Pastelltöne mit Schwarz, Lichtlecks, Blumenkränze und Choker im melancholischen Quadratformat; Mode- und Bildkultur auf Tumblr von 2012 bis 2014.
styles.short_en: Faded pastels with black, light leaks, flower crowns and chokers in a moody square crop; Tumblr fashion and image culture of 2012 to 2014.
markers_de: verwaschenes Lavendel, Rosa und Mint mit Schwarz
markers_en: washed-out lavender, pink and mint with black
sheer fabrics, flower crowns and chokers
styles.sensitivity_de: Die Szene verklärte teils Selbstverletzung und Depression; das weglassen und Kreuze wie andere religiöse Symbole mit Bedacht einsetzen.
styles.sensitivity_en: The scene sometimes romanticized self-harm and depression; leave that out, and use crosses and other religious symbols with care.

styles.era_origin: Tumblr, T-shirt and poster design of 2011 to 2014.
visual_markers: subject filled or framed with purple-blue nebula texture
thin white geometric triangles and lines
thin uppercase sans with wide tracking
styles.prompt_fragment: in 2012 hipster Tumblr style: subject filled with or framed by a purple-blue galaxy nebula texture, thin white geometric triangles and lines overlaid, crossed arrows and X marks, double-exposure silhouette, faded vintage filter, thin uppercase sans-serif with wide letter-spacing, centered badge-like composition
styles.avoid: Avoid serious space art; this is decorative and slightly ironic.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders well.
styles.short_de: Galaxie-Füllungen, dünne weiße Dreiecke, gekreuzte Pfeile und Doppelbelichtungen mit gesperrten Versalien; Tumblr-, T-Shirt- und Plakatdesign der Jahre 2011 bis 2014.
styles.short_en: Galaxy-nebula fills, thin white triangles, crossed arrows and double exposures with widely spaced capitals; Tumblr, T-shirt and poster design of 2011 to 2014.
markers_en: thin white geometric triangles and lines

styles.era_origin: Late 1980s and 1990s interiors, fashion and pop culture, named by the Consumer Aesthetics Research Institute and revived on TikTok from about 2021.
visual_markers: deep jewel tones: plum, burgundy, forest green, midnight blue
crushed velvet, brocade and sheer lace
gold sun, moon and star motifs
styles.prompt_fragment: in 1990s whimsigoth style: deep jewel tones of plum, burgundy, forest green and midnight blue, crushed velvet, brocade and sheer lace, gold sun, moon and star motifs, stained glass and wrought iron, flickering candlelight, slightly soft-focus 90s film look, mystical but cozy
styles.avoid: Avoid hard black goth and modern minimalist witchiness; keep it romantic, velvety and celestial.
styles.feasibility_note: Palette and textures render well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Uses occult and tarot imagery as decoration; avoid caricaturing living spiritual practices.
styles.short_de: Samt, Brokat und goldene Sonnen- und Mondmotive in Pflaume, Bordeaux und Mitternachtsblau; Wohn- und Modestil der späten 1980er und 1990er, seit etwa 2021 auf TikTok wiederbelebt.
styles.short_en: Velvet, brocade and gold sun-and-moon motifs in plum, burgundy and midnight blue; late-1980s and 1990s decor and fashion, revived on TikTok since about 2021.
markers_en: jewel tones: plum, burgundy, forest green, midnight blue
crushed velvet, brocade and sheer lace
gold sun, moon and star motifs
styles.sensitivity_de: Nutzt Okkultes und Tarot als Dekor; gelebte spirituelle Praktiken nicht karikieren.
styles.sensitivity_en: Uses occult and tarot imagery as decoration; do not caricature living spiritual practices.

styles.era_origin: Branding, coffeehouses and packaging from the late 1980s to the early 2000s; the term was coined in 2018 by a co-founder of the Consumer Aesthetics Research Institute.
visual_markers: earthy terracotta, mustard, sage and plum
hand-drawn primitivist suns, spirals and stars
collaged woodcut-like stamps and torn edges
styles.prompt_fragment: in 1990s Global Village Coffeehouse style: earthy terracotta, mustard, sage and plum palette, hand-drawn primitivist suns, spirals, stars and squiggles, rough recycled-paper and burlap textures, quirky hand-lettered type, collaged woodcut-like stamps and torn edges, warm, artisanal faux-handmade feel
styles.avoid: Avoid sleek modern craft-coffee minimalism; it should be busy, warm and naively 'worldly'.
styles.feasibility_note: The palette and doodles come through, but the specific 90s quality can get modernized.
styles.sensitivity_note: Borrows loosely from African, Latin American and Indigenous motifs; keep the ornament generic and don't copy sacred or specific cultural patterns.
styles.short_de: Erdiges Terrakotta, Senfgelb und Salbei mit naiven Sonnen, Spiralen und Handlettering auf rauem Papier; Café- und Verpackungsdesign von den späten 1980ern bis Anfang der 2000er.
styles.short_en: Earthy terracotta, mustard and sage with naive suns, spirals and hand lettering on rough paper; café and packaging design from the late 1980s to early 2000s.
markers_en: naive hand-drawn suns, spirals and stars
styles.sensitivity_de: Bedient sich lose an afrikanischen, lateinamerikanischen und indigenen Motiven; Ornamente allgemein halten, keine sakralen oder kulturspezifischen Muster kopieren.
styles.sensitivity_en: Borrows loosely from African, Latin American and Indigenous motifs; keep ornament generic and copy no sacred or culture-specific patterns.

styles.era_origin: Japanese album covers and ads of the 1980s, revived online since about 2017.
visual_markers: flat clean areas of saturated color
deep cobalt sky with airbrushed gradient
pools, palms and white modernist architecture
styles.prompt_fragment: in 1980s Japanese city pop illustration style: flat clean areas of saturated color, deep cobalt sky with airbrushed gradient, crisp hard-edged shadows, turquoise pools, palm trees and white modernist architecture, sparse calm composition, bright endless-summer light, subtle print grain
styles.avoid: Avoid anime characters and neon nights; this is daylight with airbrushed, silkscreen-like flatness.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders reliably. Figures should stay small or absent.
styles.sensitivity_note: Don't name the defining illustrators, some of whom are living.
styles.short_de: Flächige, satte Farben, airbrushte kobaltblaue Himmel, Pools, Palmen und weiße Villen im stillen Sommerlicht; japanische Plattencover der 1980er, seit etwa 2017 online wiederentdeckt.
styles.short_en: Flat saturated colour, airbrushed cobalt skies, pools, palms and white modernist villas in still summer light; Japanese record-cover art of the 1980s, revived online from about 2017.
markers_de: Pools, Palmen, weiße Architektur der Moderne
markers_en: pools, palms and white modernist architecture
styles.sensitivity_de: Die prägenden Illustratoren, teils noch lebend, nicht namentlich nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not name the defining illustrators, some of whom are living.

styles.era_origin: Cover and loop art for 'lo-fi beats' livestreams and playlists from about 2017.
visual_markers: rainy window with distant city lights
warm desk lamp against cool blue-violet shadow
styles.prompt_fragment: in lo-fi study anime style: soft painterly digital anime illustration, cozy cluttered interior at dusk with a rainy window and distant city lights, warm desk-lamp glow against cool blue-violet shadows, houseplants, books and a steaming mug as props, gentle grain, calm looping stillness
styles.avoid: Avoid hyper-detailed glossy anime and bright daytime scenes.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable and fairly close to the default 'cozy' AI look.
styles.sensitivity_note: A well-known streaming channel's character is trademarked; don't recreate it.
styles.short_de: Weich gemalte Anime-Szenen: gemütliches Zimmer in der Dämmerung, Regen am Fenster, warme Schreibtischlampe; Loop-Bilder für Lo-Fi-Hip-Hop-Streams seit etwa 2017.
styles.short_en: Soft painterly anime scenes of a cozy room at dusk, rain on the window and a warm desk lamp; loop art for lo-fi hip-hop streams since about 2017.
markers_de: vollgestelltes, gemütliches Zimmer in der Dämmerung
markers_en: rainy window with distant city lights
warm desk lamp against blue-violet shadow
styles.sensitivity_de: Die Figur eines bekannten Streaming-Kanals ist markenrechtlich geschützt; nicht nachbilden.
styles.sensitivity_en: A well-known streaming channel's character is trademarked; do not recreate it.

styles.era_origin: Japanese sticker photo booths since 1995, peaking in the 2000s, with a global revival in the 2020s.
visual_markers: colorful hand-drawn doodles and handwriting on top
sheet divided into small sticker frames
styles.prompt_fragment: as a Japanese purikura photo-booth sticker sheet: bright frontal flash with blown-out highlights, playful cute poses, colorful hand-drawn doodles, hearts, stars and handwritten text scribbled on top, sparkly stamps and glitter frames, pastel backgrounds, divided into small sticker frames, glossy print finish
styles.avoid: Avoid photorealistic studio portraits; the doodle overlays and sticker-sheet layout are essential.
styles.feasibility_note: Doodles and frames render well. The handwritten text is often pseudo-text.
styles.sensitivity_note: 'Purikura' derives from a trademarked product name. Use the eye-enlarging beauty filter sparingly so it doesn't reinforce distorted beauty norms.
styles.short_de: Grell geblitzte Automatenporträts mit Kritzeleien, Handschrift, Glitzerstempeln und Rahmen auf einem Stickerbogen; japanische Fotosticker-Automaten seit 1995.
styles.short_en: Bright flash-lit booth portraits covered in doodles, handwriting, sparkle stamps and frames on a sticker sheet; Japanese photo-sticker booths since 1995.
styles.era_en: since 1995, Japan; peak in the 2000s, revival in the 2020s
markers_en: hand-drawn doodles and handwriting on top
sheet split into small sticker frames
styles.sensitivity_de: „Purikura“ leitet sich von einem Markennamen ab; den augenvergrößernden Beautyfilter sparsam einsetzen, um verzerrte Schönheitsideale nicht zu verstärken.
styles.sensitivity_en: 'Purikura' derives from a trademarked product name; use the eye-enlarging beauty filter sparingly so it does not reinforce distorted beauty norms.

styles.era_origin: Video-compression art from the mid-2000s, widely seen in music videos from about 2008.
visual_markers: macroblocks of one scene bleeding into another
ghost outlines of a previous frame
styles.prompt_fragment: as a datamoshed video frame: compression macroblocks of one scene bleeding and melting into another, smeared motion-vector trails dragging pixels across forms, blocky colorful melt, ghost outlines of the previous frame, chunky 16x16 artefacts, low-bitrate digital video texture
styles.avoid: Avoid simple RGB glitches and scanlines; this is a liquid pixel smear between two images.
styles.feasibility_note: Hard to fake convincingly in a still; it often reads as generic glitch or a paint smear.
styles.short_de: Videobilder, in denen Kompressionsblöcke einer Szene in die nächste schmieren und zerfließen; Codec-Trick seit Mitte der 2000er, ab 2009 auch in Musikvideos.
styles.short_en: Video frames where compression blocks of one scene smear and melt into the next; a codec hack from the mid-2000s, seen in music videos from 2009.
styles.era_de: seit Mitte der 2000er, Netzkunst und Musikvideos
styles.era_en: since the mid-2000s, net art and music videos
markers_de: Makroblöcke einer Szene bluten in die nächste
markers_en: macroblocks of one scene bleeding into another
ghost outlines of the previous frame

styles.era_origin: A 2010s digital-design effect imitating lens defects and broken displays.
visual_markers: red, green and blue layers offset a few pixels
magenta and cyan fringes on every edge
styles.prompt_fragment: with strong RGB channel split: red, green and blue layers shifted a few pixels apart so every edge shows magenta and cyan fringing, stronger toward the frame edges, otherwise a clean image, slight softness, dark contrasty background, digital lens-defect feel
styles.avoid: Avoid data-corruption blocks, and avoid the depth-based red-cyan doubling of anaglyph 3D.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders reliably.
styles.short_de: Rot-, Grün- und Blaukanal um wenige Pixel versetzt, sodass jede Kante magenta und cyan gesäumt ist; digitaler Designeffekt der 2010er, der Objektivfehler imitiert.
styles.short_en: Red, green and blue channels shifted a few pixels apart so every edge shows magenta and cyan fringes; a digital design effect of the 2010s mimicking lens flaws.
markers_de: Magenta- und Cyan-Säume an allen Kanten
markers_en: RGB layers offset by a few pixels
magenta and cyan fringes on every edge

styles.era_origin: An online horror web-series genre since about 2015.
visual_markers: blocky white text on solid blue or black
desaturated, sickly tones and eerie stillness
styles.prompt_fragment: in analog horror style: degraded late-80s broadcast video with heavy noise, tracking errors and signal dropout, flat emergency-alert or instructional graphics with blocky white text on solid blue or black, color-bar fragments, desaturated sickly tones, something subtly wrong, unsettling stillness
styles.avoid: Avoid gore and jump-scare monsters; the dread comes from mundane graphics and signal decay.
styles.feasibility_note: The atmosphere is strong. Long warning texts garble.
styles.sensitivity_note: Don't imitate real emergency-alert systems or real broadcaster logos, since that could be mistaken for genuine warnings.
styles.short_de: Verrauschtes Fernsehbild mit nüchternen Warn- und Anleitungsgrafiken, klobiger Schrift auf Blau und Signalausfällen; Horror-Webserien-Genre auf YouTube, verbreitet seit etwa 2015.
styles.short_en: Degraded broadcast video with flat emergency or instructional graphics, blocky text on blue and signal dropouts; an online horror web-series genre since about 2015.
markers_de: klobige weiße Schrift auf Blau oder Schwarz
markers_en: blocky white text on solid blue or black
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine echten Warnsysteme oder Senderlogos nachahmen, da die Bilder sonst für echte Warnungen gehalten werden könnten.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not imitate real emergency-alert systems or broadcaster logos, since the images could be mistaken for genuine warnings.

styles.era_origin: An internet trend since 2019, sparked by the 'Backrooms' creepypasta.
visual_markers: empty transitional architecture with no people
monotonous yellowish or sterile tiled surfaces repeating
styles.prompt_fragment: as a liminal space photograph: empty transitional architecture with no people, flat buzzing fluorescent overhead light, monotonous yellowish or sterile tiled surfaces repeating into the distance, slightly low-resolution early digital camera quality with mild noise, eye-level documentary framing, eerie familiar stillness
styles.avoid: Avoid dramatic horror lighting and ruins; it should be banal and clean, yet wrong.
styles.feasibility_note: Works best without people; for a people motif, show them tiny, distant or only implied.
styles.short_de: Leere Flure, Büros und Schwimmhallen unter flachem Neonröhrenlicht, aufgenommen wie pixelige Schnappschüsse; Internettrend seit 2019, ausgelöst durch die Creepypasta „Backrooms“.
styles.short_en: Empty corridors, offices and pools under flat fluorescent light, shot like low-res snapshots; an internet trend since 2019, sparked by the Backrooms creepypasta.

styles.era_origin: An internet aesthetic of about 2019-2020, alongside weirdcore.
visual_markers: hazy soft-focus pastels with blooming highlights
