surreal placements like doors in the sky
empty green fields and blue skies
styles.prompt_fragment: in dreamcore aesthetic: hazy soft-focus pastel colors with blooming highlights, surreal impossible placements like doors in the sky or stairs into clouds, empty green fields and blue sky, childhood-nostalgic objects, faint low-resolution compression, gentle but unsettling dream logic
styles.avoid: Avoid polished fantasy matte paintings; it has to look low-fi and uncanny.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders well. It can become too polished unless low resolution is stressed.
styles.short_de: Diesige Pastellbilder mit surrealen Setzungen wie Türen im Himmel, leeren Wiesen und Kindheitsobjekten; Internetästhetik, verbreitet seit etwa 2019.
styles.short_en: Hazy pastel scenes with surreal placements such as doors in the sky, empty meadows and childhood objects; an internet aesthetic that spread from about 2019.
markers_de: surreale Setzungen wie Türen im Himmel
leere grüne Wiesen und blauer Himmel
markers_en: hazy soft-focus pastels with blooming highlights
surreal placements like doors in the sky
empty green fields and blue skies

styles.era_origin: An online aesthetic that emerged around 2017 to 2020.
visual_markers: cryptic centered captions in plain system fonts
crudely pasted eyes, arrows and symbols
harsh flash or flat daylight and compression
styles.prompt_fragment: in weirdcore aesthetic: low-quality amateur digital photo with harsh flash or flat daylight, cryptic centered caption in plain white or red system font with short unsettling sentences, crude pasted eyes, arrows and cut-out symbols, crude paint-program edits, compression artefacts, disorienting and lonely
styles.avoid: Avoid gore, and avoid the dreamy pastel softness that belongs to dreamcore.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders reliably. Keep captions to a few words.
styles.short_de: Schlechte Amateurfotos mit kryptischen Sätzen in Systemschrift, eingeklebten Augen und Pfeilen und groben Paint-Bearbeitungen; Netzästhetik, entstanden Ende der 2010er.
styles.short_en: Low-quality amateur photos with cryptic captions in system fonts, pasted eyes and arrows and crude paint-program edits; an online aesthetic emerging in the late 2010s.
markers_en: cryptic centred captions in system fonts

styles.era_origin: An internet aesthetic around 2019-2020, nostalgic for 1990s childhood.
visual_markers: loud primary red, yellow, blue and rainbow
crayon scribbles, foam letters and puffy stickers
styles.prompt_fragment: in kidcore aesthetic: loud primary red, yellow, blue and rainbow palette, glossy plastic toy textures, crayon scribbles, foam letters and puffy stickers, playground-and-classroom props, bright on-camera flash, chunky rounded shapes, nostalgic 1990s childhood clutter
styles.avoid: Avoid sophisticated pastel nursery design and polished toy-ad renders.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders reliably.
styles.sensitivity_note: Show adults or objects rather than real-looking children in adult contexts; some adjacent online communities have problematic subgroups.
styles.short_de: Knallige Grundfarben, glänzendes Plastikspielzeug, Wachsmalkritzeleien, Moosgummibuchstaben und Puffy-Sticker; Internetästhetik um 2019 mit Sehnsucht nach der Kindheit der 1990er.
styles.short_en: Loud primary colours, glossy plastic toys, crayon scribbles, foam letters and puffy stickers; an internet aesthetic of around 2019 nostalgic for 1990s childhood.
markers_en: primary red, yellow, blue and rainbow
crayon scribbles, foam letters, puffy stickers
styles.sensitivity_de: Erwachsene oder Gegenstände statt realistisch wirkender Kinder in Erwachsenenkontexten zeigen; angrenzende Online-Communities haben problematische Untergruppen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Show adults or objects rather than real-looking children in adult contexts; some adjacent online communities have problematic subgroups.

styles.era_origin: Square-format phone photo filters of about 2010 to 2013.
visual_markers: heavy warm yellow or cross-processed tint
styles.prompt_fragment: as an early-2010s filtered phone photo: square 1:1 crop, low-resolution phone camera sensor with noise, heavy warm yellow or cross-processed teal-and-magenta tint, crushed contrast with lifted faded blacks, strong dark vignette, thin white or film-border frame, slight over-sharpening
styles.avoid: Avoid the clarity of modern computational HDR; the phone camera should look weak.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders reliably.
styles.sensitivity_note: Instagram is a brand name; describe filters generically rather than by their app names.
styles.short_de: Quadratische, verrauschte Handyfotos mit kräftigem Warm- oder Crossentwicklungs-Stich, flauen Schwarztönen, Vignette und dünnem Rand; App-Filterlook der Jahre 2010 bis 2013.
styles.short_en: Square, noisy phone photos with heavy warm or cross-processed tints, faded blacks, vignettes and thin borders; app filter look of about 2010 to 2013.
styles.sensitivity_de: Instagram ist ein Markenname; Filter allgemein beschreiben, nicht mit ihren App-Namen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Instagram is a brand name; describe filters generically, not by their app names.

styles.era_origin: Mobile film-emulation presets of about 2014 to 2018.
visual_markers: lifted matte blacks and low contrast
airy minimal composition with negative space
styles.prompt_fragment: with a mid-2010s faded film preset: lifted matte blacks, low contrast, desaturated olive and teal greens, soft creamy highlights, slightly cool shadows, natural daylight, airy minimal composition with plenty of negative space, subtle simulated film grain
styles.avoid: Avoid strong vignettes and saturated colors, which belong to the earlier filter era.
styles.feasibility_note: Easy, but close to many generic 'aesthetic' photo outputs.
styles.sensitivity_note: VSCO is a brand name.
styles.short_de: Matte, kontrastarme Fotos mit angehobenen Schwarztönen, gedämpftem Oliv- und Petrolgrün und viel Luft im Bild; Filmemulations-Presets für Handy-Apps, etwa 2014 bis 2018.
styles.short_en: Matte, low-contrast photos with lifted blacks, muted olive and teal greens and airy negative space; mobile film-emulation presets of about 2014 to 2018.
styles.sensitivity_de: VSCO ist ein Markenname.
styles.sensitivity_en: VSCO is a brand name.

styles.era_origin: Amateur and wedding photo trend of about 2003 to 2012, via consumer editing apps.
visual_markers: one element in vivid saturated color, often red
styles.prompt_fragment: as a 2000s selective-color photo edit: the entire image converted to high-contrast black and white except one key element kept in vivid saturated color, often red, slightly imprecise masking edges with faint color halos, consumer photo-editor feel
styles.avoid: Avoid duotone grading; only one isolated element is colored.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable.
styles.short_de: Kontrastreiches Schwarzweißfoto, in dem ein einziges Element, oft rot, farbig bleibt; Amateur- und Hochzeitsfoto-Trend der 2000er, verbreitet durch Bildbearbeitungsprogramme.
styles.short_en: High-contrast black-and-white photo in which a single element, often red, stays in full colour; amateur and wedding-photo trend of the 2000s, spread by consumer editing software.
markers_de: ein Element in kräftiger Farbe, oft Rot
markers_en: one element in vivid colour, often red

styles.era_origin: Instant aura-camera portraits since the 1970s-80s, revived on Instagram from about 2018 to 2023.
visual_markers: soft clouds of saturated colored fog around the subject
blurred chromatic halos in magenta, yellow, green and blue
styles.prompt_fragment: as an instant-film aura portrait: soft glowing clouds of saturated magenta, orange, yellow, green and blue color fog surrounding and partially veiling the subject, blurred chromatic halos, dark backdrop, slightly soft instant-film rendering, white instant-print border, mystical yet analog
styles.avoid: Avoid digital neon glows and sharp lens flares; the color fog has to be soft and photographic.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Tied to pseudoscientific claims; present it as an aesthetic, not a diagnosis.
styles.short_de: Sofortbild-Porträts, umhüllt von weichen Farbwolken in Magenta, Gelb, Grün und Blau; aufgenommen mit Biofeedback-Aurakameras seit den 1980er/90er-Jahren, um 2018–2023 auf Instagram beliebt.
styles.short_en: Instant portraits veiled in soft clouds of magenta, yellow, green and blue; made with biofeedback aura cameras since the 1980s/90s, popular on Instagram around 2018–2023.
markers_de: weiche, satte Farbnebel um die Person
verschwommene Höfe in Magenta, Gelb, Grün, Blau
markers_en: soft clouds of saturated coloured fog around the subject
blurred halos in magenta, yellow, green and blue
styles.sensitivity_de: Mit pseudowissenschaftlichen Behauptungen verbunden; als Ästhetik zeigen, nicht als Diagnose.
styles.sensitivity_en: Tied to pseudoscientific claims; present it as an aesthetic, not a diagnosis.

styles.era_origin: Branding and interior trend of about 2016 to 2019, typical of direct-to-consumer start-ups and photogenic pop-up spaces.
visual_markers: overhead flat-lay or symmetric frontal framing
clean even daylight with minimal type
styles.prompt_fragment: in late-2010s millennial pink style: dominant dusty blush pink with terracotta, sage and brass accents, terrazzo and velvet surfaces, arched shapes and monstera leaves, clean overhead flat-lay or symmetric frontal framing, soft even daylight, minimal sans-serif or rounded serif type, curated DTC brand polish
styles.avoid: Avoid bubblegum hot pink (that's McBling); keep it dusty and curated.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable, and close to generic lifestyle imagery.
styles.short_de: Staubiges Altrosa mit Terrazzo, Samt, Messing, Bögen und Monstera in klarem Tageslicht; Branding- und Interiorlook etwa 2016 bis 2019, typisch für Direct-to-Consumer-Start-ups.
styles.short_en: Dusty blush pink with terrazzo, velvet, brass, arches and monstera in clean daylight; branding and interior look of about 2016 to 2019, typical of direct-to-consumer start-ups.

styles.era_origin: Tumblr and TikTok aesthetic of about 2018 to 2020.
visual_markers: muted sage, butter yellow and faded rose
styles.prompt_fragment: in cottagecore aesthetic: soft hazy golden-hour light, rustic countryside cottage settings, wildflowers, linen, gingham and lace, fresh-baked bread and handmade crafts as props, muted creamy palette of sage, butter yellow and faded rose, gentle film grain, slow idyllic mood
styles.avoid: Avoid glossy fantasy; keep it homespun, natural and slightly faded.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable, and close to the default warm AI look.
styles.sensitivity_note: Critics note it can romanticize colonial or 'traditional' rural life; avoid nationalist or exclusionary framing.
styles.short_de: Diesiges Abendlicht über Cottages, Wiesen, Leinen, Vichy-Karo, frischem Brot und Handarbeit in verblichenem Salbei und Buttergelb; Tumblr- und TikTok-Ästhetik um 2018 bis 2020.
styles.short_en: Hazy golden-hour light on cottages, meadows, linen, gingham, fresh bread and handicrafts in faded sage and butter yellow; Tumblr and TikTok aesthetic of about 2018 to 2020.
markers_en: muted sage, butter yellow and faded rose
styles.sensitivity_de: Kritiker bemängeln eine Verklärung kolonialen oder „traditionellen“ Landlebens; nationalistische oder ausgrenzende Deutungen vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Critics note it can romanticize colonial or 'traditional' rural life; avoid nationalist or exclusionary framing.

styles.era_origin: Internet aesthetic since about 2019, popular on TikTok in 2020.
visual_markers: jumbles of found objects and shiny trinkets
styles.prompt_fragment: in goblincore aesthetic: damp forest-floor textures, moss, mushrooms, lichen, snails, frogs and beetles as props, curated jumbles of found objects like pebbles, bones and shiny trinkets, earthy muddy browns and mossy greens, close-up macro framing, overcast diffuse light, celebrating the messy and overlooked
styles.avoid: Avoid pretty fairytale mushrooms and glowing fantasy forests; it should feel damp and real.
styles.feasibility_note: Textures render well.
styles.short_de: Feuchter Waldboden in Nahaufnahme: Moos, Pilze, Schnecken, Frösche und gesammelter Krimskrams in Schlammbraun und Moosgrün; Internetästhetik seit etwa 2019, 2020 auf TikTok populär.
styles.short_en: Damp forest floor in close-up: moss, mushrooms, snails, frogs and collected trinkets in muddy browns and greens; internet aesthetic since about 2019, big on TikTok in 2020.
markers_en: jumbles of found objects and trinkets

styles.era_origin: Tumblr aesthetic from about 2015, mainstream on TikTok in 2020.
visual_markers: deep brown, burgundy, forest green and black
styles.prompt_fragment: in dark academia aesthetic: moody low-key light from candles and green banker's lamps, old wood-paneled libraries, leather-bound books, handwritten notes, tweed and wool textures, deep brown, burgundy, forest green and black palette, classical busts, film grain, scholarly melancholy
styles.avoid: Avoid fantasy magic-school spectacle; keep it realistic, quiet and bookish.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable, and close to the default moody AI look.
styles.sensitivity_note: Criticized for Eurocentric and elitist undertones; vary the cultural references where you can.
styles.short_de: Holzgetäfelte Bibliotheken im Kerzen- und Lampenlicht, ledergebundene Bücher, Tweed und antike Büsten in Braun, Bordeaux und Tannengrün; Tumblr-Ästhetik ab etwa 2015, 2020 durch TikTok verbreitet.
styles.short_en: Candle- and lamp-lit wood-paneled libraries, leather-bound books, tweed and classical busts in brown, burgundy and forest green; Tumblr aesthetic from about 2015, mainstream on TikTok in 2020.
markers_en: brown, burgundy, forest green and black
styles.sensitivity_de: Wird für eurozentrische und elitäre Untertöne kritisiert; kulturelle Bezüge nach Möglichkeit variieren.
styles.sensitivity_en: Criticized for Eurocentric and elitist undertones; vary the cultural references where possible.

styles.era_origin: Look of independent lifestyle magazines and Instagram from 2011.
visual_markers: muted oatmeal, clay, olive and charcoal
linen, handmade ceramics and raw wood
unposed hands and quiet moments with thin serif type
styles.prompt_fragment: in slow-living editorial style: soft natural window light, muted earthy palette of oatmeal, clay, olive and charcoal, linen, handmade ceramics and raw wood, generous negative space, quiet unposed moments and close-up hands, matte film grain, thin elegant serif typography, calm and unhurried
styles.avoid: Avoid glossy luxury and bright white Scandi interiors; this is warm, earthy and matte.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable.
styles.sensitivity_note: Kinfolk is a magazine trademark; prompt with 'slow-living editorial' instead.
styles.short_de: Weiches Fensterlicht, Leinen, handgemachte Keramik und rohes Holz in Hafer- und Tontönen mit viel Leerraum; Look unabhängiger Lifestyle-Magazine und Instagram-Feeds seit 2011.
styles.short_en: Soft window light, linen, handmade ceramics and raw wood in oatmeal and clay tones with ample empty space; the look of indie lifestyle magazines and Instagram since 2011.
markers_de: gedämpftes Hafer, Ton, Oliv und Anthrazit
markers_en: muted oatmeal, clay, olive and charcoal
linen, handmade ceramics and raw wood
styles.sensitivity_de: Kinfolk ist eine geschützte Magazinmarke; im Prompt besser „slow-living editorial“ verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Kinfolk is a magazine trademark; prompt with 'slow-living editorial' instead.

styles.era_origin: Interior and design-blog trend of the 2010s, rooted in mid-century Nordic design.
visual_markers: bright white walls and pale birch or ash
crisp black accents and graphic line-art prints
styles.prompt_fragment: in Scandinavian minimalist style: bright white walls and pale birch and ash wood, crisp black accents and simple graphic line-art prints, chunky knits and sheepskin, soft grey and oat textiles, a single potted plant, clean airy diffuse daylight, uncluttered symmetric composition, functional calm
styles.avoid: Avoid the warm, aged texture of wabi-sabi and glossy luxe interiors.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable.
styles.short_de: Weiße Wände, helle Birke und Esche, schwarze Akzente, grober Strick und Schaffell im luftigen Tageslicht; Interior- und Blogtrend der 2010er mit Wurzeln im nordischen Design der Nachkriegsmoderne.
styles.short_en: White walls, pale birch and ash, black accents, chunky knits and sheepskin in airy daylight; 2010s interior and design-blog trend rooted in mid-century Nordic design.
styles.era_de: 2010er, international; Wurzeln in Skandinavien ab den 1950ern
markers_de: weiße Wände, helle Birke oder Esche
markers_en: white walls, pale birch or ash
crisp black accents and line-art prints

styles.era_origin: A Japanese aesthetic concept that became a Western interior and Instagram trend from about 2016.
visual_markers: raw unglazed clay and weathered wood
umber, ash grey and moss tones
styles.prompt_fragment: in wabi-sabi aesthetic: rough imperfect handmade surfaces, raw unglazed clay, weathered wood, limewashed plaster and cracked patina, asymmetrical sparse arrangement, muted dark earth tones of umber, ash grey and moss, dim directional side light with deep soft shadows, quiet signs of age and decay
styles.avoid: Avoid bright, clean minimalism; imperfection and age must show.
styles.feasibility_note: Textures render well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Rooted in Japanese aesthetics and Zen-influenced tea culture; avoid stereotyped 'Zen' props and misuse of tea-ceremony objects.
styles.short_de: Raue, handgemachte Oberflächen, unglasierter Ton, verwittertes Holz und rissiger Putz im gedämpften Seitenlicht; Schönheitsideal der japanischen Teekultur, im Westen Interiortrend seit etwa 2016.
styles.short_en: Rough handmade surfaces, unglazed clay, weathered wood and cracked plaster in dim side light; an ideal from Japanese tea culture, a Western interior trend since about 2016.
styles.era_de: Ideal seit dem 15./16. Jh., Japan; westlicher Interiortrend ab ca. 2016
styles.era_en: ideal since the 15th–16th c., Japan; Western interior trend from c. 2016
markers_en: raw unglazed clay and weathered wood
umber, ash grey and moss tones
styles.sensitivity_de: Wurzelt in japanischer Ästhetik und zenbeeinflusster Teekultur; klischeehafte „Zen“-Requisiten und zweckentfremdetes Teegerät vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Rooted in Japanese aesthetics and Zen-influenced tea culture; avoid stereotyped 'Zen' props and misused tea-ceremony objects.

styles.era_origin: Internet image macros of about 2004 to 2015.
visual_markers: single low-res photo filling the frame
bold white all-caps condensed sans with thick black outline
styles.prompt_fragment: as a classic internet image macro meme: a single low-resolution photo filling the frame, bold white all-caps condensed sans-serif captions with a thick black outline at the top and bottom, slight JPEG compression, deadpan humor framing
styles.avoid: Avoid modern meme templates with caption boxes; keep the outlined top and bottom text.
styles.feasibility_note: Text rendering is good now. Keep captions short.
styles.sensitivity_note: Don't use recognizable private individuals or copyrighted meme photos.
styles.short_de: Ein einzelnes, pixeliges Foto mit fetten weißen, schwarz umrandeten Versalien oben und unten; das klassische Meme-Format im Netz von etwa 2004 bis 2015.
styles.short_en: A single low-res photo with bold white, black-outlined capitals at top and bottom; the classic internet meme format of about 2004 to 2015.
styles.era_en: c. 2004–2015, internet forums and social networks
markers_de: fette weiße Versalien mit dicker schwarzer Kontur
markers_en: single low-res photo filling the frame
bold white all-caps with thick black outline
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine erkennbaren Privatpersonen und keine urheberrechtlich geschützten Meme-Fotos verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not use recognizable private individuals or copyrighted meme photos.

styles.era_origin: A meme style of about 2017 to 2019.
styles.prompt_fragment: as a deep-fried meme: brutally oversaturated and contrast-crushed colors with a burnt orange-red cast, massive JPEG compression blocks and noise from repeated re-saving, glowing lens-flare eyes, scattered emoji clusters, bulge distortion, crunchy sharpening halos
styles.avoid: Avoid tidy glitch art; it should look ruined by repeated recompression.
styles.feasibility_note: Oversaturation works, but the result is often too clean; real JPEG mush is hard.
styles.short_de: Absichtlich zerstörte Memes: Kontrast und Sättigung bis zum Anschlag, verbrannter Orangerot-Stich, grobe JPEG-Blöcke, leuchtende Augen und Emoji-Haufen; Meme-Stil von etwa 2017 bis 2019.
styles.short_en: Memes degraded on purpose: crushed contrast, burnt orange-red oversaturation, heavy JPEG blocks, glowing eyes and emoji clusters; a meme style of about 2017 to 2019.

styles.era_origin: A webcomic meme format of about 2008 to 2012.
visual_markers: grid of uneven white panels with thin borders
shaky mouse-drawn lines with little color
plain sans-serif dialogue and a punchline panel
styles.prompt_fragment: as a 2010-era rage comic: a grid of uneven white panels with thin black borders, crude stick-figure bodies with oversized exaggerated black-line faces, shaky mouse-drawn lines, minimal or no color, plain sans-serif dialogue text, a final punchline panel
styles.avoid: Avoid polished webcomic art, and don't reproduce the original copyrighted meme faces; invent new ones.
styles.feasibility_note: The crude look works. The model may reach for famous faces, and dialogue can garble.
styles.sensitivity_note: Several classic rage faces are copyrighted (the troll face, for example); create original faces.
styles.short_de: Grobe, mit der Maus gezeichnete Strichmännchen mit übergroßen, überzeichneten Gesichtern in ungleichen weißen Panels, die auf eine Pointe zulaufen; Webcomic-Meme etwa 2008 bis 2012.
styles.short_en: Crude mouse-drawn stick figures with oversized, exaggerated faces in uneven white panels building to a punchline; a webcomic meme format of about 2008 to 2012.
markers_de: ungleiche weiße Panels mit dünnem Rahmen
markers_en: uneven white panels with thin borders
plain sans dialogue and punchline panel
styles.sensitivity_de: Mehrere klassische Rage Faces, etwa das Trollface, sind urheberrechtlich geschützt; eigene Gesichter erfinden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Several classic rage faces, such as the troll face, are copyrighted; draw original faces.

styles.era_origin: A TikTok video-collage trend of 2022-2023, translated here into a still grid.
visual_markers: chaotic mosaic of unrelated screenshots and stills
white subtitle captions with melancholic fragments
styles.prompt_fragment: as a corecore-style still collage: chaotic mosaic of unrelated low-resolution video stills and screenshots in mixed aspect ratios, white subtitle captions with melancholic fragments, compression artefacts, a mix of news footage, nature and everyday scenes, desaturated and dark, a sense of alienation and information overload
styles.avoid: Avoid tidy moodboard grids; the collage must feel chaotic and emotionally loaded.
styles.feasibility_note: It is a video form, so stills read as generic collage, and subtitles garble.
styles.sensitivity_note: Don't use real news imagery of tragedies or real people.
styles.short_de: Chaotisches Raster aus zusammenhanglosen Videostills und Screenshots mit melancholischen Untertiteln und Kompressionsartefakten; überträgt einen TikTok-Collagetrend von 2021 bis 2023 ins Standbild.
styles.short_en: Chaotic grid of unrelated video stills and screenshots with melancholic subtitles and compression artefacts; translates a 2021–2023 TikTok video-collage trend into a still image.
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine echten Nachrichtenbilder von Katastrophen und keine realen Personen verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not use real news images of tragedies or real people.

styles.era_origin: A viral pop-album cover and meme format from summer 2024.
visual_markers: one short lowercase word in plain default sans
any imagery reduced to a tiny low-res inset
styles.prompt_fragment: in 2024 lime-green lowercase minimal style: flat saturated chartreuse background filling the frame, one short lowercase word in plain default sans-serif, slightly blurred and horizontally stretched as if low-resolution, black type, any imagery reduced to a tiny blurry low-res inset or omitted, deliberately lazy and confrontational
styles.avoid: Avoid adding graphics, gradients or designer typography; it has to stay almost empty.
styles.feasibility_note: Easy. The model may make the type too crisp, so stress the blur.
styles.sensitivity_note: Strongly identified with one living musician's album branding; describe it generically and don't reproduce the original cover or its word.
styles.short_de: Grelles Limettengrün als flache Fläche, darauf ein einziges unscharfes, in die Breite gezogenes Wort in Kleinbuchstaben; nach einem viralen Popalbum-Cover von 2024 und den „Brat Summer“-Memes.
styles.short_en: A flat chartreuse field with one blurry, stretched lowercase word in a plain default sans; from a viral 2024 pop-album cover and its 'brat summer' memes.
styles.era_de: Sommer 2024, Pop und Social Media, international
styles.era_en: summer 2024, pop music and social media, international
markers_de: ein kurzes Wort in Kleinbuchstaben, schlichte Standardschrift
Bilder höchstens als winziger, pixeliger Einschub
markers_en: one short lowercase word in plain default sans
imagery reduced to a tiny low-res inset
styles.sensitivity_de: Eng mit dem Album-Branding einer lebenden Musikerin verbunden; allgemein halten, weder das Originalcover noch sein Wort nachbilden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Strongly identified with a living musician's album branding; keep it generic and do not reproduce the original cover or its word.

styles.era_origin: Generative avatar collections from 2017, peaking in 2021-2022.
visual_markers: single character bust in a fixed template pose
styles.prompt_fragment: as a generative profile-picture avatar: square format, a single character bust in a fixed side or three-quarter template pose, flat solid pastel background, flat cartoon shading with uniform outlines, stacked random trait accessories like hats, sunglasses and earrings, odd fur or skin colors, collectible-series look
styles.avoid: Avoid copying the trait sets of real collections; invent new traits.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable.
styles.sensitivity_note: Major collections are trademarked and associated with crypto speculation and scams; don't imitate specific collections or imply real tokens.
styles.short_de: Quadratische Avatar-Büsten in fester Schablonenpose vor flachem Pastellgrund, behängt mit zufälligen Merkmalen; generative NFT-Profilbild-Kollektionen seit 2017, Höhepunkt 2021–2022.
styles.short_en: Square avatar busts in a fixed template pose on flat pastel grounds, stacked with random traits; generative NFT profile-picture collections from 2017, peaking in 2021–2022.
markers_en: single bust in a fixed template pose
styles.sensitivity_de: Große Kollektionen sind markenrechtlich geschützt und mit Kryptospekulation und Betrug verbunden; keine bestimmte Kollektion nachahmen, keine echten Token andeuten.
styles.sensitivity_en: Major collections are trademarked and tied to crypto speculation and scams; imitate no specific collection and imply no real tokens.

styles.era_origin: Neo-Assyrian palaces of Nimrud and Nineveh, 9th-7th century BCE, echoed in Achaemenid Persepolis.
visual_markers: low relief in pale gypsum-alabaster slabs
strict profile figures with frontal almond eye
rows of tight ringlet curls in beards and hair
cuneiform inscription band running across figures
styles.prompt_fragment: carved as a Neo-Assyrian palace low relief in pale gypsum alabaster, forms in strict profile with frontal almond eyes, rows of tight ringlet curls, stylised muscular calves, horizontal registers, a band of cuneiform-like inscription cutting across the scene, chipped weathered stone surface, raking side light
styles.avoid: Steer away from Egyptian painted colour and hieroglyphs and from glossy marble; keep matte chipped gypsum and dense incised detail.
styles.feasibility_note: Relief lighting and stone render well; cuneiform becomes pseudo-script.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not present outputs as genuine antiquities; many reliefs are tied to looting and destruction contexts.
styles.short_de: Flachreliefs auf hellen Gipsalabaster-Platten mit Figuren in strengem Profil, gelockten Bärten, muskulösen Waden und Keilschriftbändern; neuassyrische Paläste in Nimrud und Ninive, 9.–7. Jh. v. Chr.
styles.short_en: Low reliefs on pale gypsum slabs with strict profile figures, ringlet beards, muscular calves and inscription bands; Neo-Assyrian palaces of Nimrud and Nineveh, 9th–7th century BCE.
markers_de: Reihen enger Ringellocken in Bart und Haar
markers_en: low relief in pale gypsum alabaster
strict profile figures with frontal almond eye
rows of tight ringlet curls in beards and hair
styles.sensitivity_de: Ergebnisse nicht als echte Antiken ausgeben; viele Reliefs sind mit Plünderung und gezielter Zerstörung verbunden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not present outputs as genuine antiquities; many reliefs are tied to looting and deliberate destruction.

styles.era_origin: Neo-Babylonian Babylon, 6th century BCE, continued in Achaemenid Susa.
visual_markers: raised moulded forms glazed ochre yellow and white
mortar joints of bricks running through the image
styles.prompt_fragment: moulded relief in Neo-Babylonian glazed brick, deep cobalt-turquoise glaze ground, raised forms glazed in ochre yellow, white and brown, mortar joints of individual bricks running through the whole image, rows of white-and-yellow rosettes as border, crackled glossy glaze with chips, flat frontal daylight
styles.avoid: Do not let it become a smooth digital blue poster; brick grid and glaze crackle must stay visible.
styles.feasibility_note: Brick grid and glaze hold well; works best with bold silhouettes.
styles.short_de: Tiere und Rosetten als Relief aus glasierten Ziegeln, gelb und weiß auf tiefblauem Grund – bekannt vom Ischtar-Tor in Babylon und den achämenidischen Friesen in Susa.
styles.short_en: Animals and rosettes moulded in relief from glazed bricks, yellow and white on deep blue, as on Babylon's Ishtar Gate and later Achaemenid friezes at Susa.
styles.era_de: 6. Jh. v. Chr., Babylon; später achämenidisches Susa
styles.era_en: 6th century BCE, Babylon; later Achaemenid Susa
markers_de: plastische Figuren in Gelb, Weiß und Braun glasiert
markers_en: moulded forms glazed yellow, white and brown
brick joints running through the image

styles.era_origin: Etruscan necropolises of Tarquinia and Cerveteri, 6th-4th century BCE.
visual_markers: flat earth pigments on rough plaster
red-brown male and pale female skin convention
animated profile figures with archaic smiles
slender stylised trees, birds and dolphins
styles.prompt_fragment: Etruscan tomb wall painting on rough plaster, flat earth pigments of red ochre, black, ochre yellow and blue-green, red-brown male and pale female skin convention, animated profile poses with archaic smiles and long gesturing hands, slender stylised trees and birds, banded checker borders, flaking patches and damp stains
styles.avoid: Avoid sliding into Greek vase figures or Pompeian illusionism; keep forms loose, flat and joyful on bare plaster.
styles.feasibility_note: Tends toward generic Roman fresco unless the skin-colour convention and archaic smile are named.
styles.short_de: Flächige Wandmalerei mit Erdfarben in etruskischen Kammergräbern wie in Tarquinia: bewegte Profilfiguren, Männer rotbraun, Frauen hell, dazu Gelage, Tänzer und stilisierte Bäume.
styles.short_en: Flat earth-pigment wall paintings in Etruscan chamber tombs at Tarquinia, with lively profile figures, red-brown men and pale women, banquets, dancers and stylised trees.
markers_de: schlanke stilisierte Bäume, Vögel und Delfine
markers_en: flat earth pigments on rough plaster
lively profile figures with archaic smile
slender stylised trees, birds and dolphins

styles.era_origin: Athens, mainly 5th century BCE, especially funerary lekythoi.
visual_markers: faded matte washes of red, mauve, pale blue
curved vessel surface with meander band
styles.prompt_fragment: Attic white-ground vase painting, chalky cream-white slip ground on a curved ceramic surface, delicate dilute golden-brown and black contour lines, sparse faded washes of matte red, mauve and pale blue, quiet restrained composition with much empty ground, meander band above, worn fugitive pigment
styles.avoid: Avoid black-figure or red-figure contrast; this must look pale, linear and fragile.
styles.feasibility_note: Fine outlines hold; model drifts to black-ground red-figure unless 'white ground' is stressed.
styles.short_de: Attische Vasenmalerei auf kreidig weißem Überzug mit feinen goldbraunen Umrissen und blassen Farblasuren, vor allem auf Grablekythen des 5. Jahrhunderts v. Chr.
styles.short_en: Attic vase painting on a chalky white slip, with fine golden-brown outlines and faded colour washes, used mainly for 5th-century BCE funerary lekythoi.
markers_de: verblasstes mattes Rot, Mauve und Hellblau
markers_en: faded matte red, mauve and pale blue
curved vessel surface with meander band

styles.era_origin: Eurasian steppe nomads (Scythians, Saka, Pazyryk), c. 7th-3rd century BCE.
visual_markers: antlers ending in scrolls or bird heads
styles.prompt_fragment: Scytho-Siberian animal-style goldwork, a cast and chased gold plaque with the form compressed into a compact closed silhouette, body twisted and curled back on itself, limbs and antlers ending in stylised scrolls and bird heads, cells inlaid with turquoise and carnelian, worn soft-gold surface on dark ground
styles.avoid: Avoid shiny modern jewellery rendering and realistic anatomy; contortion and scroll stylisation are essential.
styles.feasibility_note: Gold rendering is easy; the twisting stylisation needs strong prompting and works best for animals.
styles.short_de: Gold- und Bronzebeschläge der eurasischen Steppennomaden, auf denen Tiere eingerollt, verdreht und zu geschlossenen Silhouetten verdichtet sind, teils mit Türkis- oder Karneoleinlagen.
styles.short_en: Gold and bronze plaques of Eurasian steppe nomads showing animals curled, twisted and compressed into closed silhouettes, sometimes with turquoise or carnelian inlays.
styles.era_de: ca. 7.–3. Jh. v. Chr., eurasische Steppe
markers_en: antlers ending in scrolls or bird heads

styles.era_origin: Iron Age Celtic Europe, c. 450 BCE to 1st century BCE.
visual_markers: swelling asymmetrical trumpet spirals and triskeles
styles.prompt_fragment: Iron Age La Tène Celtic metalwork, engraved and repoussé bronze with swelling asymmetrical curves, trumpet spirals, triskeles and lentoid voids, compass-drawn arcs, small red enamel studs, stylised faces half hidden in the ornament, aged golden-brown bronze with green patina, museum-object lighting
styles.avoid: Do not drift into Insular knotwork or modern Celtic tattoo knots; La Tène is curvilinear spirals, not knots.
styles.feasibility_note: Spirals render well; the model may default to knotwork interlace.
styles.short_de: Ornamentik der eisenzeitlichen Kelten aus schwellenden, asymmetrischen Spiralen, Trompetenmustern und Triskelen auf Bronze und Gold, in denen sich oft Gesichter verbergen.
styles.short_en: Early Celtic metalwork ornament of swelling asymmetrical spirals, trumpet curves and triskeles on bronze and gold, sometimes hiding faces, from Iron Age Europe.
styles.era_de: ca. 450 v. Chr. bis 1. Jh. v. Chr., keltisches Europa
styles.era_en: c. 450 BCE – 1st century BCE, Celtic Europe
markers_en: swelling asymmetrical trumpet spirals and triskeles

styles.era_origin: Worldwide from the Paleolithic onward (Scandinavian Bronze Age, Val Camonica, American Southwest, Sahara, Australia).
visual_markers: pecked and incised outlines in rock
pale pecking marks on dark desert varnish
marks following cracks of the stone
styles.prompt_fragment: petroglyph rock carving, simplified forms pecked and incised into a sun-baked rock face, pale stippled pecking marks against dark brown desert varnish, stick-limbed figures, spirals and concentric circles scattered loosely, lines following the natural cracks and curves of the stone, low raking sunlight
styles.avoid: Avoid painted cave-wall colours or clean vector pictograms; it must read as marks hammered into real stone.
styles.feasibility_note: Stone texture and pecking render convincingly.
styles.sensitivity_note: Many petroglyph sites are sacred to Indigenous peoples; avoid copying specific known sacred motifs.
styles.short_de: In Fels gepickte oder geritzte Figuren, Spiralen und Zeichen, weltweit seit der Altsteinzeit – von Skandinavien und den Alpen bis in die Sahara und den Südwesten der USA.
styles.short_en: Figures, spirals and signs pecked or incised into rock, made worldwide since the Palaeolithic, from Scandinavia and the Alps to the Sahara and the American Southwest.
markers_de: gepickte und geritzte Umrisse im Fels
Linien folgen den Rissen im Stein
markers_en: pecked and incised outlines in rock
pale peck marks on dark desert varnish
lines following cracks in the stone
styles.sensitivity_de: Viele Felsbildstätten sind indigenen Gemeinschaften heilig; bekannte sakrale Motive sollten nicht kopiert werden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Many petroglyph sites are sacred to Indigenous peoples, so specific known sacred motifs should not be copied.

styles.era_origin: Anglo-Norman England/Normandy, late 11th century.
visual_markers: long horizontal frieze on unbleached linen
laid-and-couched wool fillings in terracotta, ochre, sage, blue-black
styles.prompt_fragment: medieval narrative embroidery on unbleached linen, long horizontal frieze, forms filled with laid-and-couched wool in terracotta, ochre, sage green and dark blue, stem-stitch outlines, oddly coloured horses and stylised trees dividing scenes, narrow border strips of beasts, an inscription in stitched Latin capitals above
styles.avoid: Avoid generic cross-stitch or painted manuscript looks; wool texture on bare linen and the frieze format are essential.
styles.feasibility_note: Embroidery texture renders well; Latin text becomes pseudo-letters.
styles.short_de: Langer Erzählfries aus farbiger Wolle in Klosterstich auf ungebleichtem Leinen, mit stilisierten Pferden, Bäumen und lateinischen Beischriften, nach dem Vorbild des Teppichs von Bayeux.
styles.short_en: Long narrative frieze in coloured wool laid and couched on plain linen, with stylised horses, trees and Latin captions, modelled on the 11th-century Bayeux Tapestry.
markers_de: Wollflächen in Klosterstich: Terrakotta, Ocker, Salbeigrün, Blauschwarz
markers_en: long horizontal frieze on unbleached linen
laid-and-couched wool in terracotta, ochre, sage and blue-black
border strips with beasts, Latin captions above

styles.era_origin: Northern Iberia, 10th-11th century Apocalypse commentaries.
visual_markers: stacked flat background bands of saffron, red, green, violet
styles.prompt_fragment: Mozarabic Iberian manuscript illumination, forms set against stacked horizontal bands of flat saturated saffron yellow, vermilion, deep green and violet-blue, no shading, wide-staring almond eyes, drapery as flat stripes, horseshoe arches and interlaced frames, matte pigment on vellum with cracks
styles.avoid: Avoid gold-leaf Gothic illumination and naturalistic modelling; flat colour bands and ornament-like figures are key.
styles.feasibility_note: Colour bands render well; the model tends to add gold and Gothic modelling.
styles.short_de: Buchmalerei der nordspanischen Beatus-Apokalypsen des 10. und 11. Jahrhunderts: unschattierte Figuren mit starren Augen vor flachen Querstreifen in Safrangelb, Rot, Grün und Violett.
styles.short_en: Illuminations in 10th–11th-century Iberian Beatus Apocalypse manuscripts: unshaded figures with staring eyes set against flat horizontal bands of saffron, red, green and violet.
markers_en: stacked flat colour bands as background

styles.era_origin: Viking Age Scandinavia; Urnes style mid-11th to early 12th century.
visual_markers: slender ribbon-bodied beasts in loose figure-of-eight interlace
styles.prompt_fragment: Viking Age Scandinavian animal-style carving, slender ribbon-bodied beasts and serpents biting each other in loose figure-of-eight interlace, almond-shaped eyes, curling lappets and tendrils, carved in relief into weathered tarred pine planks, deep shadows in the cuts, northern overcast daylight
styles.avoid: Avoid dense Insular knot panels and fantasy-game rune ornaments; keep the open, thin, sinuous interlace on real wood.
styles.feasibility_note: Interlace logic often breaks; looks right at a glance.
styles.sensitivity_note: Norse imagery is appropriated by white-supremacist groups; avoid runes such as Odal and sun-wheel motifs.
styles.short_de: Skandinavische Ornamentik der späten Wikingerzeit mit schlanken, bandförmigen Tieren und Schlangen in lockeren Achterschlingen, geschnitzt oder gegossen, benannt nach der Stabkirche von Urnes.
styles.short_en: Late Viking Age Scandinavian ornament of slender ribbon-like beasts and serpents in loose figure-of-eight loops, carved in wood or cast in metal, named after Urnes stave church.
markers_en: slender ribbon-bodied beasts in loose figure-of-eight interlace
styles.sensitivity_de: Nordische Bildwelten werden von Rechtsextremen vereinnahmt; Runen wie die Odal-Rune und Sonnenrad-Motive weglassen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Norse imagery is appropriated by white-supremacist groups; leave out runes such as Odal and sun-wheel motifs.

styles.era_origin: Europe from the mid-12th century, continuing in civic, ecclesiastical and family arms.
visual_markers: flat tinctures under the rule of tincture
stylised rampant/passant charges with exaggerated claws and tongues
styles.prompt_fragment: medieval heraldic painting, the subject stylised as a heraldic charge on a shield, flat tinctures of red, blue, green and black against gold and silver metals with strict contrast, bold black outlines, exaggerated claws, tongues and manes, acanthus mantling and helm above, gouache and gold leaf on parchment
styles.avoid: Avoid esports or sports-club logos and shiny 3D crests; keep flat tinctures and hand-painted medieval stylisation.
styles.feasibility_note: Flat heraldic stylisation is reliable.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not reproduce real arms of existing families, states or cities; some heraldic eagles carry political connotations.
styles.short_de: Wappen mit stilisierten Tieren und Figuren in flachen, streng kontrastierenden Tinkturen, mit Schild, Helm, Helmzier und Helmdecke – in Europa seit dem 12. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Coats of arms with stylised animals and charges in flat, strongly contrasting tinctures on a shield with helm, crest and mantling, practised in Europe since the 12th century.
markers_de: stilisierte Wappenfiguren mit übertriebenen Klauen und Zungen
markers_en: flat tinctures following the rule of tincture
stylised charges with exaggerated claws and tongues
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine realen Wappen von Familien, Staaten oder Städten nachbilden; manche Wappenadler sind politisch belastet.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not reproduce the real arms of existing families, states or cities; some heraldic eagles carry political connotations.

styles.era_origin: Jewish manuscripts from the 9th-10th century (Near East, then Sephardic and Ashkenazi Bibles), revived in 19th-century prints.
visual_markers: contours built entirely from lines of minute script
styles.prompt_fragment: micrographic drawing in which every contour and pattern is built from lines of minute handwritten script, tiny letters following curves, scrolls and geometric frames, no ordinary drawn lines, sepia iron-gall ink on parchment, occasional touches of gold and colour, manuscript carpet-page layout
styles.avoid: Avoid word-cloud typography or bold calligraphy; letters must be tiny and act purely as linework.
styles.feasibility_note: Tiny script turns to noise; convincing from a distance, but letters are pseudo-glyphs.
styles.sensitivity_note: Traditional micrography uses sacred biblical and masoretic text; label outputs as pseudo-script and avoid mocking subjects.
styles.short_de: Jüdische Buchkunst, in der Umrisse und Ornamente ganz aus Zeilen winziger hebräischer Schrift bestehen – von Bibelhandschriften des 9./10. Jahrhunderts bis zu Drucken des 19. Jahrhunderts.
styles.short_en: Jewish manuscript art in which outlines and ornaments are formed entirely from lines of tiny Hebrew script, from 9th–10th-century Bibles to 19th-century prints.
styles.era_de: ab dem 9./10. Jh., Vorderer Orient, Sefarad und Aschkenas
styles.era_en: from the 9th–10th century, Near East, Sepharad and Ashkenaz
markers_en: contours built from lines of minute script
styles.sensitivity_de: Traditionelle Mikrografie verwendet heilige Bibel- und Masora-Texte; erzeugte Zeichen als Pseudoschrift behandeln und keine spöttischen Motive wählen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Traditional micrography uses sacred biblical and Masoretic text; treat generated letters as pseudo-script and avoid mocking subjects.

styles.era_origin: English medieval embroidery, 12th-14th century, for vestments; goldwork continues in church and ceremonial embroidery.
visual_markers: couched gold-thread grounds in chevron and diaper patterns
split-stitch silk faces worked in spirals
styles.prompt_fragment: medieval ecclesiastical goldwork embroidery, background of couched gold thread laid in chevron and diaper patterns, faces and hands in fine split-stitch silk worked in spirals, padded raised gold areas, Gothic arcaded frames, faded silk and tarnished gilt on velvet, soft gleam under candlelight
styles.avoid: Avoid smooth golden 3D renders; individual couched threads and worn silk must stay visible.
styles.feasibility_note: Gold sheen easy; thread direction detail simplifies.
styles.sensitivity_note: Associated with Christian liturgical vestments; respect sacred context.
styles.short_de: Englische Kirchenstickerei des Mittelalters mit Gründen aus angelegtem Goldfaden in Zickzack- und Rautenmustern und Gesichtern in feinem Spaltstich aus Seide, europaweit begehrt um 1250–1350.
styles.short_en: Medieval English church embroidery with grounds of couched gold thread in chevron and diaper patterns and faces in fine split-stitch silk, prized across Europe c. 1250–1350.
markers_de: angelegte Goldgründe in Zickzack- und Rautenmustern
markers_en: couched gold grounds in chevron and diaper patterns
split-stitch silk faces worked in spirals
styles.sensitivity_de: Die Technik gehört zu christlichen Messgewändern; den sakralen Kontext respektieren.
styles.sensitivity_en: The technique belongs to Christian liturgical vestments; treat the sacred context with respect.

styles.era_origin: Resist-dyed yarn weaving across Central Asia, Indonesia, India, Japan and Guatemala, centuries old.
styles.prompt_fragment: ikat woven textile, motifs formed by threads resist-dyed before weaving, every edge blurred and feathered with a slight horizontal stagger, bold stepped medallions and diamonds, saturated magenta, saffron, indigo and green on silk-cotton, visible weave texture and soft sheen
styles.avoid: Avoid crisp printed edges; the characteristic blur between colour areas must be present.
styles.feasibility_note: Blur effect renders; figurative motifs lose legibility.
styles.sensitivity_note: Patterns can belong to specific communities; avoid copying named heritage designs.
styles.short_de: Gewebe, dessen Garne vor dem Weben abgebunden und gefärbt werden, sodass die Muster verschwommen ausfransen; seit Jahrhunderten in Zentralasien, Indonesien, Indien, Japan und Lateinamerika verbreitet.
styles.short_en: Woven textile whose yarns are resist-dyed before weaving, giving motifs blurred, feathered edges; made for centuries in Central Asia, Indonesia, India, Japan and Latin America.
styles.era_de: seit Jahrhunderten; Zentralasien, Indonesien, Indien, Japan, Lateinamerika
styles.era_en: for centuries; Central Asia, Indonesia, India, Japan, Latin America
styles.sensitivity_de: Manche Muster gehören bestimmten Gemeinschaften; benannte traditionelle Entwürfe nicht kopieren.
styles.sensitivity_en: Some patterns belong to specific communities; avoid copying named heritage designs.

styles.era_origin: Europe from the 16th century (Flanders, Venice, Erzgebirge); machine lace from the 19th century.
visual_markers: dense cloth-stitch motifs joined by net ground or bars
styles.prompt_fragment: handmade bobbin lace in fine ecru linen thread, motifs worked in dense cloth stitch and half stitch, held together by an airy net ground and bars with tiny picots, scalloped edge, laid flat on dark velvet so the openwork reads in silhouette, soft macro lighting
styles.avoid: Avoid paper-doily or vector-ornament looks; thread crossings and open net must be visible.
styles.feasibility_note: Overall lace look reliable; thread logic simplifies on close inspection.
styles.short_de: Durchbrochene Spitze aus Fäden, die mit Klöppeln gekreuzt und gedreht werden, dichte Motive auf Netzgrund oder Stegen – seit dem 16. Jahrhundert in Flandern, Italien und im Erzgebirge.
styles.short_en: Openwork lace of threads crossed and twisted on bobbins, dense motifs joined by net ground or bars, made in Flanders, Italy and the Erzgebirge since the 16th century.
styles.era_de: seit dem 16. Jh., Flandern, Italien, Erzgebirge
styles.era_en: since the 16th century, Flanders, Italy, Erzgebirge
markers_de: dichte Leinenschlag-Motive auf Netzgrund oder Stegen
markers_en: dense cloth-stitch motifs on net ground or bars

styles.era_origin: Bavaria and Austria, c. 1500-1540.
styles.prompt_fragment: Danube School painting of the early sixteenth century, oil on panel, surroundings turned into a primeval forest of towering spruces hung with lichen and feathery dripping foliage, figures small against the wilderness, glowing yellow-orange sunset sky, river valley and Alpine crags, fine Northern Renaissance detail with expressive energy
styles.avoid: Avoid hazy 19th-century Romantic landscapes and idealised Italianate trees; foliage must be dense, fibrous and slightly fantastical.
styles.feasibility_note: Panel-painting texture good; may drift to Romanticism.
styles.short_de: Malerei in Bayern und Österreich um 1500–1540, in der urwüchsige Wälder aus flechtenbehangenen Fichten und glühende Himmel die Figuren klein erscheinen lassen; Wiege des reinen Landschaftsbildes.
styles.short_en: Early 16th-century painting in Bavaria and Austria in which wild forests of lichen-hung spruces and glowing skies dwarf the figures; among the earliest pure landscapes.

styles.era_origin: Venice and Rome, 18th century.
visual_markers: luminous clear sky with soft clouds
tiny staffage figures with flicked highlights
styles.prompt_fragment: eighteenth-century Venetian veduta, oil on canvas, wide topographically precise view with ruled perspective, luminous clear sky with soft white clouds, warm sunlight raking stone facades, tiny lively staffage figures with quick flicked highlights, reflective water, crisp yet painterly detail
styles.avoid: Avoid tourist-poster saturation and HDR glow; keep a calm, slightly cool, accurate painterly perspective.
styles.feasibility_note: Perspective and light render very well.
styles.short_de: Topografisch genaue Stadtansichten mit konstruierter Perspektive, klarem Licht und winziger Staffage, gemalt für Grand-Tour-Reisende im Venedig und Rom des 18. Jahrhunderts.
styles.short_en: Topographically precise city views with ruled perspective, clear light and tiny staffage figures, painted for Grand Tour travellers in 18th-century Venice and Rome.

styles.era_origin: Dutch and Flemish 17th century; revived in 19th-century American trompe-l'oeil.
visual_markers: extremely shallow space on a board
papers tucked behind crossed straps or ribbons
styles.prompt_fragment: trompe-l'oeil quodlibet painting, everything arranged in a very shallow space on a wooden board, tucked behind crossed leather straps or pinned with nails, curling paper notes, cards and prints with dog-eared corners, crisp cast shadows, varnished oil glazing with fool-the-eye precision
styles.avoid: Avoid deep perspective and photographic blur; the illusion relies on shallow depth and painted precision.
styles.feasibility_note: Shallow-space illusion is a strength; text on papers is pseudo-text.
styles.short_de: Augentäuschendes Stillleben aus Briefen, Zetteln und Drucken, hinter Lederriemen an ein Brett gesteckt, in extrem flachem Raum – Niederlande im 17., USA im 19. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Fool-the-eye still life of letters, notes and prints tucked behind straps on a board in very shallow space, from the 17th-century Netherlands and 19th-century America.
styles.era_de: 17. Jh., Niederlande und Flandern; Wiederbelebung im 19. Jh., USA
styles.era_en: 17th century, Netherlands and Flanders; revived 19th century, USA
markers_de: extrem flacher Raum vor einem Brett
markers_en: extremely shallow space on a board

styles.era_origin: Tudor England from the 1520s; watercolour-on-ivory miniatures flourished in the 18th-19th century.
styles.prompt_fragment: portrait miniature in an oval gilt locket frame, watercolour and gouache on vellum or ivory-like ground, intense ultramarine background, face modelled with minute stippled and hatched brushstrokes, luminous translucent complexion, lace and jewels picked out in shell gold, a fine gold inscription arching around
styles.avoid: Avoid full-size oil-portrait rendering; it must read as a tiny jewel-like object with stipple texture.
styles.feasibility_note: Locket object and blue ground reliable; stipple fineness varies.
styles.sensitivity_note: Real ivory is restricted; describe as imitation ground.
styles.short_de: Winzige Bildnisse in Aquarell und Deckfarbe auf Pergament oder Elfenbein, oft in ovalen Medaillons vor tiefblauem Grund – vom England der Tudors bis ins 19. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Tiny portraits in watercolour and gouache on vellum or ivory, often set in oval lockets against intense blue backgrounds, from Tudor England to the 19th century.
styles.era_de: 1520er bis 19. Jh., England, dann ganz Europa
styles.era_en: 1520s to 19th century, England, then all of Europe
markers_de: Gesicht in Punkten und Strichlagen modelliert
markers_en: tiny oval in a gilt locket
stippled and hatched modelling of the face
styles.sensitivity_de: Echtes Elfenbein unterliegt Handelsbeschränkungen; den Malgrund als Imitat beschreiben.
styles.sensitivity_en: Real ivory is trade-restricted; describe the ground as an imitation.

styles.era_origin: Europe, late 17th-18th century (Baroque and Rococo).
visual_markers: slender flowering branches with birds and peonies
pale celadon or silver silk ground
styles.prompt_fragment: European eighteenth-century chinoiserie, hand-painted on pale celadon or silver-grey silk wallpaper, slender flowering branches, birds and peonies rising in airy asymmetric arrangement, small fanciful pavilions and bridges, delicate gouache with gilded accents, Rococo lightness and faint craquelure
styles.avoid: Avoid authentic Chinese ink painting and modern restaurant clichés; this is a European decorative fantasy.
styles.feasibility_note: Decorative wallpaper look renders well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Orientalist fantasy; avoid caricatured East Asian figures.
styles.short_de: Europäische China-Fantasie mit Blütenzweigen, Vögeln, Pavillons und Brücken auf heller Seide oder Tapete, in Mode in Interieurs des Barock und Rokoko im späten 17. und 18. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: European decorative fantasy of China with flowering branches, birds, pavilions and bridges on pale silk or wallpaper, fashionable in late 17th- and 18th-century Baroque and Rococo interiors.
markers_de: schlanke Blütenzweige mit Vögeln und Päonien
markers_en: slender flowering branches with birds and peonies
pale celadon or silver silk ground
styles.sensitivity_de: Orientalistische Fantasie; keine karikierten ostasiatischen Figuren.
styles.sensitivity_en: An Orientalist fantasy; avoid caricatured East Asian figures.

styles.era_origin: Renaissance Italy after the rediscovery of Nero's Domus Aurea c. 1480; spread by ornament prints.
visual_markers: pale ground with Pompeian red and pale blue
styles.prompt_fragment: Renaissance grotesque ornament, symmetrical vertical candelabra composition on a pale cream ground, thin acanthus tendrils sprouting hybrid creatures, masks, sphinxes and garlands, small framed cameo medallions, delicate fresco pigments of Pompeian red, pale blue and ochre, fine brush linework
styles.avoid: Avoid 'grotesque' as horror; keep it airy, ornamental and symmetrical.
styles.feasibility_note: Symmetry holds; the model may over-darken or make it macabre.
styles.short_de: Symmetrisches Kandelaberornament aus dünnen Ranken, Mischwesen, Masken und Medaillons auf hellem Grund, entstanden in Italien nach der Wiederentdeckung der Domus Aurea um 1480.
styles.short_en: Symmetrical candelabra ornament of thin tendrils, hybrid creatures, masks and medallions on a pale ground, revived in Italy after the Domus Aurea was rediscovered around 1480.
styles.era_de: ab ca. 1480, Italien; über Ornamentstiche in ganz Europa
styles.era_en: from c. 1480, Italy; spread across Europe through ornament prints
markers_de: heller Grund mit Pompejanischrot und Hellblau
markers_en: pale ground with Pompeian red and pale blue

styles.era_origin: c. 1790-1830 illustrated epics and archaeological publications in Britain and Germany.
visual_markers: generous white paper with plate caption
styles.prompt_fragment: neoclassical outline engraving, forms drawn purely in clean even contour lines with no hatching, shading or background, frieze-like arrangement as on a classical relief, idealised antique proportions and drapery, generous empty white paper, small serif plate number and caption below
styles.avoid: Avoid modern minimal line icons and continuous-line doodles; the line should be engraved, classical and figure-centred.
styles.feasibility_note: Clean linework is reliable; model may add shading unless forbidden.
styles.short_de: Illustrationen zu antiken Epen in reinen, gleichmäßigen Umrisslinien ohne Schattierung, angeordnet wie ein antiker Relieffries; um 1790–1830 in England und Deutschland verbreitet.
styles.short_en: Illustrations of classical epics drawn in pure, even contour lines without shading, arranged like an antique relief frieze; popular in Britain and Germany around 1790–1830.
markers_en: generous white paper with plate caption

styles.era_origin: Florence, late 16th century; Mughal parchin kari in the 17th century.
visual_markers: natural mineral veining used as shading
styles.prompt_fragment: pietra dura hardstone inlay, image formed from precisely cut polished semi-precious stones such as lapis lazuli, malachite, jasper, agate and chalcedony set seamlessly into glossy black marble, natural mineral veining used for shading and texture, mirror-polished tabletop surface with soft reflections
styles.avoid: Avoid tile mosaic tesserae and grout lines; pieces are large, shaped and seamless.
styles.feasibility_note: Stone textures render well; seamless joints sometimes become grout lines.
styles.short_de: Bildhafte Einlegearbeit aus passgenau geschnittenen, polierten Halbedelsteinen in schwarzem Marmor, deren Maserung als Schattierung dient – aus dem Florenz des späten 16. Jahrhunderts und dem Mogulreich.
styles.short_en: Pictorial inlay of shaped, polished semi-precious stones set seamlessly into black marble, using natural veining as shading; from late 16th-century Florence and Mughal India.
styles.era_en: late 16th century, Florence; 17th century, Mughal India

styles.era_origin: Spanish and Spanish-American Baroque, 16th-18th century; also German late-Gothic altarpieces.
visual_markers: carved wood with lifelike glossy flesh paint
garments gilded then painted and scratched to reveal gold
styles.prompt_fragment: polychrome carved wooden sculpture in the Baroque estofado technique, garments covered in gold leaf then painted and scratched to reveal gilded floral patterns, lifelike glossy flesh tones, glass eyes, deeply carved swirling folds, crackled varnish and worn gilding, dramatic chapel lighting
styles.avoid: Avoid smooth plastic figurine or porcelain looks; carved wood, gilding and scratched patterns must show.
styles.feasibility_note: Gilding and carving render convincingly.
styles.sensitivity_note: Mostly Catholic devotional images; profane or mocking subjects in this idiom may offend.
styles.short_de: Geschnitzte Holzfiguren mit lebensnah glänzendem Inkarnat und vergoldeten Gewändern, deren Farbschicht zu Goldmustern ausgekratzt ist – typisch für den spanischen und lateinamerikanischen Barock.
styles.short_en: Carved wooden figures with lifelike glossy flesh paint and gilded robes painted over and scratched to reveal gold patterns, typical of Spanish and Latin American Baroque.
markers_de: geschnitztes Holz mit glänzendem, lebensnahem Inkarnat
markers_en: carved wood with glossy, lifelike flesh tones
gilded robes painted and scratched to show gold
styles.sensitivity_de: Überwiegend katholische Andachtsbilder; profane oder spöttische Motive in dieser Formensprache können verletzen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Mostly Catholic devotional images; profane or mocking subjects in this idiom may offend.

styles.era_origin: Ancient to present (Bronze Age, Achaemenid, Gothic reliquaries, Indian and Andean silverwork).
visual_markers: thin sheet metal hammered into soft bulges
styles.prompt_fragment: repoussé and chased metal relief, forms hammered up from the back of a thin sheet of silver or copper into soft rounded bulges, background densely punched with matting tools, outlines chased crisply, visible hammer facets and dark tarnish in the recesses, polished highlights on raised areas
styles.avoid: Avoid cast-bronze solidity and CGI chrome; the thin hammered sheet with tool marks is key.
styles.feasibility_note: Metal relief renders reliably.
styles.short_de: Relief, das von der Rückseite aus dünnem Silber-, Kupfer- oder Goldblech getrieben und von vorn ziseliert wird – eine Technik seit der Bronzezeit.

styles.era_origin: Whaling ships, late 18th-19th century, New England and the Pacific.
visual_markers: needle-scratched lines filled with black soot
styles.prompt_fragment: scrimshaw engraving, fine needle-scratched lines rubbed with black soot ink on the curved creamy surface of polished bone, naive but meticulous linework and cross-hatching, occasional red ink accent, hairline cracks and yellowed patina, object lit against dark wood
styles.avoid: Avoid clean modern line art on paper; it must be ink-filled scratches on an aged curved surface.
styles.feasibility_note: Object look good; line fineness inconsistent.
styles.sensitivity_note: Whale ivory trade is restricted; frame as bone or imitation.
styles.short_de: Mit der Nadel in Walzähne oder Knochen geritzte und mit Ruß eingefärbte Bilder, angefertigt von Walfängern auf amerikanischen und britischen Schiffen des 18. und 19. Jahrhunderts.
styles.short_en: Pictures scratched with a needle into whale teeth or bone and rubbed with soot ink, made by whalers on 18th- and 19th-century American and British ships.
styles.era_en: late 18th–19th century, whaling ships (New England, Pacific)
markers_en: needle-scratched lines filled with black soot
styles.sensitivity_de: Der Handel mit Walelfenbein ist beschränkt; das Material als Knochen oder Imitat darstellen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Trade in whale ivory is restricted; present the material as bone or imitation.

visual_markers: flat calm planes of grey, ochre, dusty rose
styles.prompt_fragment: Purist painting, objects reduced to clean standardised silhouettes seen in both plan and elevation, interlocking and overlapping contours that share edges, calm flat planes of grey, ochre, dusty rose, white and black, no gestural brushwork, rigorous architectural order and machine-age clarity
styles.avoid: Avoid fractured Analytic Cubism and bright Synthetic collage; Purism is calm, smooth and orderly.
styles.feasibility_note: May drift toward generic Cubism; muted palette helps.
styles.short_de: Nachkubistische Malerei, die Alltagsgegenstände wie Flaschen und Gläser auf genormte Silhouetten in ruhigen, flachen Farbflächen reduziert; 1918 in Paris begründet.
styles.short_en: Post-Cubist painting that reduces everyday objects such as bottles and glasses to standardised silhouettes in calm, flat planes; launched in Paris in 1918.
markers_de: ruhige Flächen in Grau, Ocker und Altrosa
markers_en: calm flat planes of grey, ochre and dusty rose

styles.era_origin: Paris, c. 1910s-1920s; term coined by a critic for cylinder-based Cubist painting.
visual_markers: forms built from shaded cylinders and cones
styles.prompt_fragment: machine-age tubular Cubism, forms built from shaded cylinders, cones and pipes with metallic grey modelling, bold flat planes of primary red, yellow and blue, thick black contours, gears, discs and ladders interlocking, robust mechanical rhythm, matte oil paint
styles.avoid: Avoid sci-fi robot rendering; keep painted volumes and flat colour fields of early modernism.
styles.feasibility_note: Cylindrical stylisation renders; may veer into robots.
styles.sensitivity_note: The term is tied to one deceased painter; name only the technique, not the artist.
styles.short_de: Aus dem Kubismus abgeleitete Malerei, die Figuren und Maschinen aus schattierten Zylindern, Kegeln und Röhren vor flachen Grundfarben aufbaut; der Name war 1911 Kritikerspott.
styles.short_en: Cubist-derived painting that builds figures and machines from shaded cylinders, cones and tubes against flat primary colours; the name began as a critic's jibe in 1911.
markers_de: Formen aus schattierten Zylindern und Kegeln
markers_en: forms built from shaded cylinders and cones
styles.sensitivity_de: Der Begriff ist an einen einzelnen verstorbenen Maler gebunden; die Technik beschreiben, nicht den Künstler nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: The term is tied to one deceased painter; describe the technique rather than naming the artist.

styles.era_origin: Italy, 1929 manifesto to early 1940s.
visual_markers: land dissolving into tilted geometric patches
smooth matte oil in sky blue, silver, ochre
styles.prompt_fragment: Futurist aeropainting, the scene seen from a diving aircraft, plunging spiralling bird's-eye perspective, landscape and city dissolving into tilted geometric patches, propeller arcs and dynamic force lines, smooth matte oil in sky blue, silver, rust and ochre, vertiginous rotating composition
styles.avoid: Avoid photographic drone imagery; it should feel painted, geometric and dynamically distorted.
styles.feasibility_note: Aerial distortion works; risk of generic aerial illustration.
styles.sensitivity_note: Closely tied to Fascist-era Italian aviation propaganda; avoid militaristic glorification and Fascist symbols.
styles.short_de: Malerei der italienischen Futuristen aus der Flugzeugperspektive: stürzende, kreisende Blickwinkel, in denen Land und Städte in gekippte geometrische Felder zerfallen – 1929 bis Anfang der 1940er.
styles.short_en: Italian Futurist painting of the view from an aircraft: plunging, spiralling perspectives in which land and cities break into tilted geometric patches, from 1929 to the early 1940s.
markers_de: Land zerfällt in gekippte geometrische Felder
glatte, matte Ölfarbe in Himmelblau, Silber und Ocker
markers_en: land breaking into tilted geometric patches
smooth matte oil in sky blue, silver and ochre
styles.sensitivity_de: Eng mit der Luftfahrtpropaganda des faschistischen Italien verbunden; keine militaristische Verherrlichung, keine faschistischen Symbole.
styles.sensitivity_en: Closely tied to Fascist-era aviation propaganda; avoid militaristic glorification and Fascist symbols.

Ruinen und Menhire mit belebten Formen
markers_en: gouache, ink, wax resist and scratched crayon
acid yellow and moss green against inky black
ruins and standing stones taking animate forms

styles.era_origin: Montevideo, Uruguay, from the mid-1930s.
visual_markers: hand-painted orthogonal grid of unequal compartments
simple pictographic signs in each cell
earthy ochre, brick red, slate grey
styles.prompt_fragment: Constructive Universalist painting, the image organised by a hand-painted orthogonal grid of unequal compartments, each holding a simple flat pictographic sign such as sun, fish, ladder, house, figure or anchor, tempered earthy palette of ochre, brick red, slate grey and black, matte oil on board with brushy edges
styles.avoid: Avoid primary-colour Neo-Plastic grids and clean vector icons; symbols should be hand-painted and earthy.
styles.feasibility_note: Grid and pictograms render reliably.
styles.sensitivity_note: Tied to a specific deceased artist and his workshop; prompt by movement, not name.

styles.short_en: Painting organised by a hand-painted grid of unequal compartments, each holding a simple sign such as sun, fish or anchor, in earthy tones; Montevideo from the mid-1930s.

simple pictographic sign in each cell
earthy ochre, brick red and slate grey
styles.sensitivity_de: An einen verstorbenen Künstler und seine Werkstatt gebunden; über die Bewegung beschreiben, nicht über den Namen.

styles.era_origin: South Korea, 1970s.

styles.avoid: Avoid crisp Western minimalism and digital gradients; the handmade repeated texture is the image.
styles.feasibility_note: Hard to balance subject legibility with monochrome restraint.

styles.short_en: Korean monochrome painting of the 1970s in off-white, beige or umber, built from repeated gestures such as lines scored into wet paint or pigment pushed through hemp.

markers_en: near-monochrome field of off-white, beige or umber

visual_markers: layers of street posters ripped back
fragments of letterforms and halftone faces
white fibrous paper edges at tears

markers_en: layers of street posters ripped back
fragments of type and halftone faces
white fibrous edges at the tears
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine echten Markenlogos in den Fragmenten.

horizontal dry-brush blur of wet paint

crisp rectangular aperture in a contrasting colour

styles.era_origin: Japan, from the 1880s (Meiji period).

styles.prompt_fragment: Nihonga painting, crushed mineral pigments bound with animal glue on washi or silk, granular velvety matte texture, soft blurred washes without hard outlines, subtle gradations of malachite green, azurite and shell white, touches of gold and silver leaf, calm modern Japanese elegance

styles.era_origin: Japan, mainly Edo period (17th-19th century), painted by Zen monks.

styles.sensitivity_note: Rooted in Zen Buddhist practice; avoid pseudo-calligraphy implying real sacred text.

styles.short_en: Quick, sparse ink paintings by Japanese Zen monks of the Edo period: a few rough, often humorous brushstrokes beside a bold calligraphic inscription on a hanging scroll.

styles.sensitivity_de: Wurzelt in der Zen-Praxis; Pseudo-Kalligrafie darf nicht als echter religiöser Text erscheinen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Rooted in Zen Buddhist practice; avoid pseudo-calligraphy that passes for real sacred text.

styles.feasibility_note: Wood texture renders; may polish into Shin-hanga.

styles.era_origin: Tibetan Buddhist ritual practice, still active.
styles.prompt_fragment: Tibetan sand mandala technique, image laid out in fine grains of brightly dyed sand, radial concentric symmetry with square gates and ringed borders, saturated red, yellow, blue, green and white, slightly raised sand ridges and grain texture visible up close, top-down view on a wooden platform
styles.avoid: Avoid smooth digital mandalas and colouring-book outlines; individual grains and ridged lines must read.
styles.feasibility_note: Sand texture renders; strict symmetry sometimes breaks.
styles.sensitivity_note: Sacred ritual work made by monks and ritually dissolved; avoid replicating specific deity mandalas or using it as casual decoration.
styles.verdict_reason: Confirmed, because the tradition is sacred. The mandala depicts a deity's palace. Monks make it as a consecrated ritual and dismantle it ceremonially, the deity syllables in a fixed order, then carry the sand to flowing water (Wikipedia). Monks often build them in public, so viewing is not secret. But the object is never a commodity, and a prompt that turns logos or any subject into one contradicts both its ritual purpose and the entry's own 'not casual decoration' note. The difference from tibetan-thangka, which keeps its prompt, is defensible: thangka painting is also a lay and commercial craft.
styles.short_de: Rituelle Darstellungen des Palasts einer Gottheit, von tibetisch-buddhistischen Mönchen Korn für Korn aus gefärbtem Sand gestreut, radialsymmetrisch mit vier Toren und danach zeremoniell aufgelöst.
styles.short_en: Ritual diagrams of a deity's palace laid grain by grain in dyed sand by Tibetan Buddhist monks, in radial symmetry with four gates, then ceremonially swept away.
styles.era_en: Tibetan Buddhism, practised to this day
markers_en: raised sand ridges seen from above
styles.sensitivity_de: Ein geweihtes Ritualobjekt, das Mönche nach der Zeremonie wieder auflösen; der Grundriss stellt den Palast einer Gottheit dar und taugt nicht als Dekor für beliebige Motive.
styles.sensitivity_en: A consecrated ritual object that monks dissolve after the ceremony; its layout is a deity's palace and should not be reused as decoration for arbitrary subjects.

styles.era_origin: Ontario, Canada, from the 1960s.
visual_markers: heavy flowing black formlines linking beings
styles.prompt_fragment: Woodland School painting, forms drawn with heavy flowing black lines that link animals, humans and plants into one composition, x-ray interiors showing spirit lines and organs as coloured compartments, flat saturated acrylic colours on a plain ground, curving lines of power radiating between beings
styles.avoid: Avoid Northwest Coast formline ovoids; Woodland lines are thicker, more fluid and filled with bright flat colour.
styles.feasibility_note: Bold line and colour render; may drift to formline.
styles.sensitivity_note: Rooted in Anishinaabe spiritual teachings; avoid clan and sacred imagery, and never present AI output as Indigenous-made art.
styles.verdict_reason: Confirmed. Its imagery comes from Ojibwe/Anishinaabe birchbark scrolls (wiigwaasabak), and Morrisseau himself was criticised because his images 'disclosed traditional spiritual knowledge'; he 'broke this taboo' (Wikipedia). It is therefore sacred, ceremonially sensitive material, and today it is a strongly identity-bound Indigenous movement. Police in 2023 called the forgeries (an estimated 4,500 to 6,000 works) 'the biggest art fraud in world history', so an imitation prompt is a real harm. For consistency, huichol-yarn-painting (also a sacred tradition turned market art, currently with a prompt) should get the same scrutiny.
styles.short_de: In der Anishinaabe-Kultur verwurzelte Malerbewegung aus Ontario seit den 1960er-Jahren, mit kräftigen, fließenden schwarzen Linien, Röntgenblick auf Geistlinien und flachen, satten Acrylfarben.
styles.short_en: Anishinaabe-rooted painting movement from Ontario since the 1960s, with heavy flowing black lines, x-ray views of spirit lines and flat saturated acrylic colours.
markers_de: kräftige, fließende schwarze Linien, die Wesen verbinden
markers_en: heavy flowing black lines linking beings
styles.sensitivity_de: Lebendige indigene Bewegung mit Wurzeln in spirituellen Lehren der Anishinaabe, seit Langem von Fälschungen betroffen; Clan- und Sakralbilder sind tabu, KI-Bilder dürfen nie als indigene Kunst gelten.
styles.sensitivity_en: A living Indigenous movement rooted in Anishinaabe spiritual teachings and long hit by forgeries; clan and sacred imagery are off-limits, and AI output must never pass as Indigenous-made.

styles.prompt_fragment: Shipibo kené pattern work, dense labyrinthine geometry of thick primary lines and fine secondary lines branching into crosses, stepped squares and spirals covering every surface, hand-painted or embroidered in dark brown and black on undyed cotton, slight hand wobble and asymmetry

styles.feasibility_note: Line labyrinths render; subjects become silhouettes filled with pattern.
styles.sensitivity_note: Declared Peruvian national cultural heritage (2008) and tied to Shipibo cosmology and healing songs; avoid commodifying it as psychedelic decor.
styles.verdict_reason: Confirmed as community-owned. Kené is a collective Shipibo-Konibo design system, declared Patrimonio Cultural de la Nación by Resolución Directoral Nacional 540/INC on 16 April 2008. Two of the reviewer's arguments are overstated. Scholars dispute that kené encodes icaro healing songs as a 'score' (Spanish Wikipedia). I also could not verify that the declaration aimed specifically at outside commercial use. The decision rests on collective ownership and the living tradition, not on those claims.

styles.prompt_fragment: Māori whakairo wood carving, deeply carved forms coated in red-brown ochre, eyes inlaid with iridescent pāua shell, every surface covered in rhythmic notched ridges and double spirals, bold rounded relief, carved panel format in soft overcast light
styles.avoid: Avoid generic tiki souvenirs; specific surface patterns and shell eyes matter.

styles.sensitivity_note: Whakairo are taonga depicting ancestors, with tapu associations; Māori groups oppose commercial misuse. Avoid ancestral figures and use with care.
styles.verdict_reason: Confirmed. Whakairo are taonga that depict named ancestors, carry tapu, and are made by trained carvers under iwi protocols. This prompt targets portrait, people and character subjects, so in practice it turns a person into an ancestral figure, which is the same problem as tā moko. The line against kowhaiwhai, which keeps its prompt, holds: rafter patterns are widely used in public design, while carved ancestors are not.
styles.short_de: Holzschnitzkunst der Māori mit rotem Ocker, Augen aus Pāua-Muschel und dichten Spiralen und Kerbleisten, für Versammlungshäuser, Kanus und Speicher, oft Darstellungen benannter Ahnen.
styles.short_en: Māori wood carving with red-ochre surfaces, pāua-shell eyes and dense spirals and notched ridges, made for meeting houses, canoes and storehouses, often depicting named ancestors.
styles.era_en: pre-colonial to present, Aotearoa New Zealand
markers_en: deep carving coated in red-brown ochre
styles.sensitivity_de: Whakairo sind Taonga, die Ahnen darstellen und tapu sind; geschnitzt wird nach den Regeln der Iwi, kommerzielle Nachahmung lehnen Māori ab – daher kein Prompt.
styles.sensitivity_en: Whakairo are taonga that depict ancestors and carry tapu; carving follows iwi protocols and Māori oppose commercial imitation, so no prompt is offered.

styles.era_origin: Hawaii, from the 19th century.
visual_markers: solid red or green on white
styles.prompt_fragment: Hawaiian appliqué quilt, a single large radially symmetrical cut-fabric design folded and cut like a paper snowflake, solid red or deep green appliqué on white cotton, dense echo quilting following every contour in rippling parallel lines, two colours only, flat top-down view
styles.avoid: Avoid multi-patch American quilts; one large symmetric cutout with echo quilting is key.
styles.feasibility_note: Symmetry and echo lines mostly hold.
