styles.short_de: Zweifarbige Quilts mit einer großen, radialsymmetrischen Applikation, wie ein Papierschneestern geschnitten und von Echo-Steppnähten umspielt; entstanden im 19. Jahrhundert auf Hawaii.
styles.short_en: Two-colour quilts with one large, radially symmetric appliqué cut like a paper snowflake and surrounded by rippling echo quilting; developed in Hawaii in the 19th century.
markers_de: einfarbig Rot oder Grün auf Weiß
markers_en: solid red or green on white
dense echo quilting following the contours
styles.sensitivity_de: Traditionell gilt ein Quiltmuster als Eigentum seiner Urheberin; bekannte, benannte Familienmuster nicht kopieren.
styles.sensitivity_en: Traditionally a quilt pattern belongs to its maker; do not copy specific named family designs.

styles.era_origin: Dalarna, Sweden, c. 1780-1870.
visual_markers: flat brick red, Prussian blue, green, ochre
styles.prompt_fragment: Swedish Dala folk painting, figures in eighteenth-century rural costume set among huge curling kurbits gourd-flowers and leafy scrolls, flat tempera colours of brick red, Prussian blue, green and ochre on a pale ground, arched panel frames and simple inscriptions, naive yet elegant brushwork
styles.avoid: Avoid scroll-only Norwegian rosemaling; Dala painting is figurative with big kurbits.
styles.feasibility_note: Kurbits ornament renders; costumes vary.
styles.short_de: Schwedische Bauernmalerei auf Wänden, Wandbehängen und Möbeln: biblische Szenen in ländlicher Tracht des 18. Jahrhunderts zwischen riesigen, eingerollten Kurbits-Blumen.
styles.short_en: Swedish folk painting on walls, wall hangings and furniture, showing biblical scenes in 18th-century rural dress among huge curling kurbits gourd-flowers.
markers_de: Figuren in ländlicher Kleidung des 18. Jh.
flaches Ziegelrot, Preußischblau, Grün und Ocker
markers_en: flat brick red, Prussian blue, green and ochre

styles.era_origin: Zhostovo near Moscow, from 1825; related to 18th-century European tole ware.
visual_markers: lush flower bouquets in layered translucent strokes
styles.prompt_fragment: Zhostovo lacquer tray painting on a glossy jet-black metal ground, framed by lush bouquets painted in layered translucent oil strokes with bright glints, rich roses, peonies and berries in crimson, white and gold-green, a fine gilded ornamental border, mirror-like lacquer reflections
styles.avoid: Avoid Khokhloma's gold-red wood patterns and Palekh miniatures; this is black-ground floral painting.
styles.feasibility_note: Black-ground florals render well.
styles.short_de: Russische Lackmalerei mit üppigen Blumensträußen in Öllasuren auf schwarzen Metalltabletts mit feinem Goldrand; seit etwa 1825 in Schostowo bei Moskau gefertigt.
styles.short_en: Russian lacquer painting of dense flower bouquets in layered oil glazes on black metal trays with a fine gilded rim, made in Zhostovo near Moscow since about 1825.
markers_en: flower bouquets in layered translucent strokes

styles.era_origin: Sicily, 19th-20th century.
styles.prompt_fragment: Sicilian painted cart decoration, the scene set in rectangular narrative panels in a chivalric folk-epic manner, bright saturated red, cobalt, green and white on a sunny yellow ground, dense geometric and floral scrollwork borders, glossy enamel paint on carved wood, naive heroic poses
styles.avoid: Avoid tourist-souvenir kitsch; keep the panel structure and yellow ground with bold folk narrative.
styles.feasibility_note: Panel and colour render; carving detail approximate.
styles.short_de: Bemalung sizilianischer Esels- und Pferdekarren mit Ritterepen und historischen Szenen in gerahmten Feldern, leuchtendes Rot, Blau und Grün auf Gelb, dazu geschnitztes Rankenwerk.
styles.short_en: Decoration of Sicilian donkey and horse carts with paladin legends and historical scenes in framed panels, bright red, blue and green on yellow, plus carved scrollwork.
markers_de: leuchtendes Rot, Kobalt, Grün und Weiß
markers_en: bright red, cobalt, green and white

styles.era_origin: Stage and disco lighting from the 1970s; a dominant portrait and music-promo look since cheap LED panels arrived in the 2010s.
visual_markers: two saturated light colours hitting from opposite sides
colour blend on skin where the gels overlap
coloured rim light on hair and edges
dark seamless backdrop with faint coloured spill
styles.prompt_fragment: lit by two hard coloured gel lights from opposite sides, saturated magenta on one side and electric cyan on the other, colours mixing where they overlap, deep unlit shadows, coloured rim light on edges, dark seamless studio backdrop with faint coloured spill, crisp digital capture, no ambient fill
styles.avoid: Avoid drifting into a cyberpunk street scene with neon signs and rain; the look comes from two gelled sources on a plain set, not from props.
styles.feasibility_note: Coloured light on skin renders well; name both directions or the model washes everything in one purple.
styles.short_de: Porträtlicht aus zwei kräftig eingefärbten Lichtquellen von gegenüberliegenden Seiten, deren Farben sich auf der Haut mischen, vor dunklem Hintergrund; seit günstigen LED-Panels der 2010er verbreitet.
styles.short_en: Portrait lighting with two strongly coloured gelled lights from opposite sides that blend on the skin against a dark backdrop; widespread since cheap LED panels in the 2010s.
markers_de: zwei satte Farben von gegenüberliegenden Seiten
markers_en: two saturated colours from opposite sides
colour blend where they overlap on skin
dark backdrop with faint colour spill

styles.era_origin: Studio-era film lighting tool (cucoloris/'cookie'), revived as a signature look in 2010s-20s portrait and product photography.
visual_markers: sharp stripes or window/leaf shadow patterns cast across subject and wall
warm 'late sun' colour inside the lit bands
styles.prompt_fragment: hard light projected through a gobo, crisp bands of venetian-blind stripes or window-frame and leaf shadows falling across the subject and the wall behind, the pattern bending over every form, large areas left in cool shade, warm late-sun colour inside the lit stripes
styles.avoid: Avoid soft even lighting and noir costume clichés; the cast shadow pattern itself is the style.
styles.feasibility_note: Stripe shadows render convincingly; very fine geometric patterns may warp on curved surfaces.
styles.short_de: Hartes Licht fällt durch eine Schablone und wirft scharfe Jalousie-, Fenster- oder Blattschatten auf Motiv und Wand; ein Werkzeug der Filmstudios, wiederentdeckt in Porträt- und Produktfotografie der 2010er.
styles.short_en: Hard light through a cut-out template throws crisp blind, window or leaf shadows across subject and wall; a film-studio tool revived in 2010s portrait and product photography.
markers_de: warmes Spätsonnenlicht in den hellen Streifen
markers_en: sharp blind, window or leaf shadow patterns
warm late-sun colour in the lit bands

styles.era_origin: Rooted in 1970s-80s Riviera fashion and colour photography; a defining look of 2010s-20s fashion and brand campaigns.
visual_markers: direct high sun with razor-sharp black shadows
graphic shadow shapes on walls and ground
styles.prompt_fragment: photographed in direct harsh midday sunlight with no fill, crisp black cast shadows with hard edges, saturated colours bordering on overexposed, bright clean highlights, graphic shadow shapes thrown onto walls and ground, deep blue sky, contrasty slightly flattened film-like tones
styles.avoid: Avoid golden-hour glow, soft backlight and lens-flare haze, which are the AI default; the sun must be high and unforgiving.
styles.feasibility_note: The model tends to soften shadows and add fill; insist on 'no fill' and 'black shadows'.
styles.short_de: Mode- und Markenfotografie in direkter, hoher Sonne ohne Aufhellung, mit messerscharfen schwarzen Schatten, satten, fast überbelichteten Farben und tiefblauem Himmel; prägend für Kampagnen der 2010er/20er.
styles.short_en: Fashion and brand photography in direct high sun without fill, with razor-sharp black shadows, near-overexposed saturated colour and deep blue sky; prominent in 2010s–20s campaigns.
styles.era_de: Wurzeln in der Riviera-Mode der 1970er/80er; prägend 2010er–2020er
styles.era_en: roots in 1970s–80s Riviera fashion; defining in the 2010s–2020s
markers_de: direkte hohe Sonne, messerscharfe schwarze Schatten
satte Farben am Rand der Überbelichtung
grafische Schattenformen auf Wand und Boden
markers_en: direct high sun, razor-sharp black shadows
graphic shadow shapes on walls and ground

styles.era_origin: Spread from 2006 by an online small-flash lighting community and ubiquitous on photo-sharing sites in the late 2000s.
visual_markers: ambient deliberately underexposed into a dark saturated sky
subject popped out by a hard speedlight from the side
styles.prompt_fragment: late-2000s off-camera flash look, ambient exposure pulled two stops down so the sky turns dark saturated blue with dramatic clouds, the subject popped out by a hard speedlight from one side, crisp specular highlights, heavy clarity and vignetting, low heroic camera angle
styles.avoid: Avoid natural-looking fill flash; the subject should look obviously flash-lit against an almost night-like sky.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders reliably; stating 'two stops underexposed sky' helps.
styles.sensitivity_note: The name comes from a photography blog community; it is not used in the prompt.
styles.short_de: Look mit entfesseltem Aufsteckblitz aus den späten 2000ern: Das Umgebungslicht wird zu einem dunklen, satten Himmel unterbelichtet, ein harter seitlicher Blitz hebt das Motiv heraus.
styles.short_en: Off-camera speedlight look of the late 2000s: ambient light underexposed into a dark, saturated sky while a hard side flash pops the subject out.
markers_de: Umgebungslicht zu dunklem, sattem Himmel unterbelichtet
markers_en: ambient underexposed into a dark saturated sky
subject lit by a hard side speedlight
styles.sensitivity_de: Der Name stammt von einem Fotografie-Blog und gehört nicht in den Prompt.
styles.sensitivity_en: The name comes from a photography blog; leave it out of the prompt.

styles.era_origin: Named after a Polish photographer's early-2000s portraits; widely copied as a Photoshop recipe around 2005-2012.
visual_markers: hard side light on dark ground
styles.prompt_fragment: gritty high-structure portrait retouch, every pore, wrinkle and hair exaggerated by high-pass sharpening, desaturated metallic skin tones with a sickly sheen, crushed near-black shadows, glowing highlights, hard side light, dark background, intense 2000s dodge-and-burn
styles.avoid: Avoid any beauty smoothing and avoid HDR halos in the background, which belong to tone mapping.
styles.feasibility_note: Texture exaggeration works; the model may still sneak in some skin smoothing.
styles.sensitivity_note: Named after a living photographer; use the descriptive prompt and never the name.
styles.short_de: Raue Porträtretusche, die jede Pore und Falte überzeichnet, die Haut metallisch entsättigt und die Schatten absaufen lässt; um 2005–2012 als Bearbeitungsrezept vielfach nachgeahmt.
styles.short_en: Gritty portrait retouching that exaggerates every pore and wrinkle, desaturates skin to a metallic sheen and crushes the shadows; widely copied as a retouching recipe around 2005–2012.
markers_en: hard side light on a dark ground
styles.sensitivity_de: Nach einem lebenden Fotografen benannt; nur die Beschreibung verwenden, nie den Namen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Named after a living photographer; use the descriptive prompt, never the name.

styles.era_origin: Devised in the 1980s by sandwiching a sharp slide with an overexposed blurred one; a common digital landscape preset in the 2000s.
visual_markers: sharp detail under a soft glowing layer
styles.prompt_fragment: a sharp exposure layered with an overexposed out-of-focus copy of itself, luminous blooming highlights, saturated dreamy midtones, slightly deepened shadows, a soft halo around every light edge while fine detail stays visible underneath, enchanted fairy-tale atmosphere
styles.avoid: Avoid plain soft focus or a diffusion filter; the image must remain sharp beneath the glow.
styles.feasibility_note: Glow-over-sharp is easy for the model; keep 'fine detail visible' in the prompt.
styles.sensitivity_note: Technique named after its originator; the name is a generic photography term and is not needed in the prompt.
styles.short_de: Landschaftslook, bei dem ein scharfes Bild mit einer überbelichteten, unscharfen Kopie überlagert wird: leuchtende Lichter über erhaltenen Details; in den 1980ern als Dia-Sandwich entwickelt.
styles.short_en: Landscape look in which a sharp image is layered with an overexposed, blurred copy, giving glowing highlights over intact detail; devised with slide sandwiches in the 1980s.
markers_en: sharp detail under a soft glow
styles.sensitivity_de: Nach seinem Erfinder benannt, inzwischen aber ein Gattungsbegriff; im Prompt nicht nötig.
styles.sensitivity_en: Named after its originator but now a generic term; it is not needed in the prompt.

styles.era_origin: Commercial portrait studios in Bamako, Dakar and other West African cities, late 1940s to 1970s.
visual_markers: pose against a boldly patterned printed-cloth backdrop
patterned clothing clashing with the backdrop
cherished props such as a radio, scooter, watch or flowers
styles.prompt_fragment: mid-century West African studio portrait, square medium-format black-and-white, the subject posed with pride against a boldly patterned printed-cloth backdrop that clashes with patterned clothing, cherished modern props, soft courtyard daylight, frontal camera at chest height, rich grey tones, matte fibre print
styles.avoid: Avoid ethnographic or safari framing; these were modern, urban, self-fashioned portraits.
styles.feasibility_note: Pattern-on-pattern backdrops render well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Present it as a tradition of African self-representation. Do not copy named photographers' specific portraits or caricature dress.
styles.short_de: Selbstbewusst inszenierte Studioporträts aus Bamako, Dakar und anderen westafrikanischen Städten, vor kräftig gemusterten Stoffhintergründen mit geschätzten Requisiten, meist in Schwarzweiß.
styles.short_en: Proud, self-styled studio portraits from Bamako, Dakar and other West African cities, posed against bold printed-cloth backdrops with treasured props, mostly in black-and-white.
markers_de: Requisiten wie Radio, Motorroller oder Uhr
markers_en: props such as a radio, scooter or watch
styles.sensitivity_de: Als afrikanische Selbstdarstellung behandeln; keine Porträts bekannter Fotografen kopieren und keine Kleidung karikieren.
styles.sensitivity_en: Present it as African self-representation; do not copy named photographers' portraits or caricature dress.

styles.era_origin: Contre-jour exposure since the 19th century; perennial in sunset, dance and travel photography.
visual_markers: subject reduced to a pure black shape
styles.prompt_fragment: contre-jour exposure metered for the bright background, the subject reduced to a pure black silhouette with crisp readable outline and gesture, no detail inside the dark shapes, luminous graduated sky or bright window behind, minimal composition with generous negative space
styles.avoid: Avoid filling the shadows or adding glowing rim light; the subject must stay a flat black shape.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable; the model occasionally lifts shadow detail unless told 'pure black'.
styles.short_de: Gegenlichtaufnahmen, belichtet auf den hellen Himmel oder ein Fenster, sodass das Motiv zur rein schwarzen Fläche mit klarer, lesbarer Kontur wird.
styles.short_en: Contre-jour photographs exposed for a bright sky or window, so the subject becomes a pure black shape with a clean, readable outline.
markers_en: subject as a pure black shape

styles.era_origin: US big-city tabloid press of the 1930s-50s, shot on 4x5 press cameras with single-use flashbulbs.
visual_markers: background dropping to ink black within metres
styles.prompt_fragment: 1940s tabloid press photograph made with a 4x5 press camera and on-camera flashbulb, harsh frontal light blasting the foreground nearly white, background falling to ink black within a few metres, startled faces and curious onlookers, glossy black-and-white print, gritty night-city atmosphere
styles.avoid: Avoid colour paparazzi glamour and red carpets; this is gritty mid-century night news.
styles.feasibility_note: Flash falloff renders well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not depict real crime victims or graphic violence.
styles.short_de: Nächtliche Nachrichtenfotos der US-Boulevardpresse, aufgenommen mit 4x5-Pressekamera und Blitzbirne, die den Vordergrund grell ausleuchtet und den Hintergrund schwarz absacken lässt.
styles.short_en: Night news photographs from US big-city tabloids, shot on 4x5 press cameras with a single flashbulb that blasts the foreground and drops the background to black.
markers_en: background falling to black within metres
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine echten Verbrechensopfer und keine drastische Gewalt zeigen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not depict real crime victims or graphic violence.

styles.era_origin: Rooted in 1970s-80s newspaper fashion columns; exploded with fashion blogs in 2005-2015.
visual_markers: full-length figure caught mid-stride on a sidewalk
telephoto lens blurring the street behind
styles.prompt_fragment: street-style fashion snapshot, full-length figure caught mid-stride on a city sidewalk, long telephoto lens compressing and blurring the street behind, open-shade daylight, candid yet aware glance, outfit and accessories crisp, vertical frame, natural colour with slight cool cast
styles.avoid: Avoid studio poses and golden-hour glow; it should feel caught on a real street between shows.
styles.feasibility_note: Easy for the model; risk of drifting into generic stock lifestyle.
styles.short_de: Ganzkörperaufnahmen von Outfits, mit langer Brennweite auf dem Gehweg erwischt, die Straße unscharf dahinter; Wurzeln in Zeitungskolumnen der 1970er/80er, Boom mit den Modeblogs der 2000er.
styles.short_en: Full-length outfit photos caught on the pavement with a long lens, the street blurred behind; rooted in 1970s–80s newspaper columns and booming with 2000s fashion blogs.
markers_de: Ganzkörperfigur im Gehen auf dem Gehweg
markers_en: full-length figure mid-stride on a sidewalk

styles.era_origin: European and American mail-order and department-store catalogues, 1960s-1990s.
visual_markers: flat frontal studio flash with soft shadow
styles.prompt_fragment: 1970s-80s mail-order catalogue photograph, models in stiff cheerful poses presenting the goods, flat frontal studio flash with a soft shadow on a plain coloured paper backdrop, warm slightly yellowed offset printing with visible screen, mid saturation, small item numbers printed beside each piece
styles.avoid: Avoid modern e-commerce cut-outs on white and any irony; sincerity and stiffness are the charm.
styles.feasibility_note: Offset texture may come out too clean.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid real retailer names and logos.
styles.short_de: Fröhlich-steif posierende Models vor einfarbigem Papierhintergrund im flachen Studioblitz, leicht vergilbter Offsetdruck mit Artikelnummern; typisch für Versandhauskataloge der 1970er und 80er.
styles.short_en: Cheerful, stiffly posed models on plain coloured paper under flat studio flash, printed in slightly yellowed offset with item numbers; typical of 1970s–80s mail-order catalogues.
markers_en: flat frontal studio flash with soft shadow
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine echten Versandhausnamen oder Logos verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid real retailer names and logos.

styles.era_origin: Paris and New York fashion magazines, c. 1947-1962.
visual_markers: elongated sculptural poses with arched wrists
painted grey backdrop or grand location
styles.prompt_fragment: 1950s haute couture fashion photograph, elongated sculptural pose with arched wrists and lifted chin, garment silhouette treated as a graphic shape, crisp black-and-white with silvery mid-greys, one large soft key light against a painted grey backdrop or grand location, aloof aristocratic poise
styles.avoid: Avoid contemporary casualness and messy hair; everything is lacquered and deliberate.
styles.feasibility_note: Works well; poses may become too modern unless specified.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not recreate specific famous fashion photographs.
styles.short_de: Schwarzweiße Modefotos aus Pariser und New Yorker Magazinen der New-Look-Ära, mit gestreckten, skulpturalen Posen und Roben als grafische Silhouetten.
styles.short_en: Black-and-white fashion photographs from Paris and New York magazines of the New Look era, with elongated sculptural poses and gowns treated as graphic silhouettes.
markers_de: gemalter grauer Hintergrund oder prunkvoller Ort
markers_en: gown silhouette as a graphic shape
painted grey backdrop or grand location
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine bekannten Modefotografien nachstellen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not recreate specific famous fashion photographs.

styles.era_origin: French and American fashion magazines and luxury campaigns, c. 1970-1985.
visual_markers: bold crops cutting figures at the frame edge
styles.prompt_fragment: 1970s surreal colour fashion photograph, hyper-saturated glossy lipstick reds and teals, hard flash with deep shadows, provocative cropping that cuts the figure at the frame edge, staged enigmatic narrative, flat graphic colour backgrounds, luxurious hotel or poolside set, dense slide-film colour
styles.avoid: Avoid nudity and explicitness; the provocation should be compositional and narrative.
styles.feasibility_note: Colour and cropping render well; narrative oddness needs explicit cues.
styles.sensitivity_note: The historical genre was often sexualised; keep prompts non-explicit and do not name its photographers.
styles.short_de: Provokante Farbmodefotos aus französischen und amerikanischen Magazinen der 1970er/80er: übersättigtes Rot und Petrol, harter Blitz, rätselhaft inszenierte Szenen, Figuren vom Bildrand angeschnitten.
styles.short_en: Provocative colour fashion photographs from 1970s–80s French and American magazines: hyper-saturated reds and teals, hard flash, enigmatic staged scenes and figures cut off at the frame edge.
markers_en: bold crops at the frame edge
styles.sensitivity_de: Das historische Genre war oft sexualisiert; Prompts nicht explizit formulieren und keine Fotografennamen nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: The historical genre was often sexualised; keep prompts non-explicit and do not name its photographers.

styles.era_origin: West Germany, 1950s, centred on the 'subjektive fotografie' exhibitions of 1951-1958.
visual_markers: velvety blacks and bare paper whites
styles.prompt_fragment: 1950s German subjective photography, black-and-white image abstracted into graphic form, extreme contrast with velvety blacks and bare paper whites, forms isolated and stripped of context, rhythmic repetitions and steep diagonals, occasional negative or solarised passages, exhibition fibre print
styles.avoid: Avoid documentary greys and 1920s New Vision machine optimism; this is post-war, inward and near-abstract.
styles.feasibility_note: May drift into generic minimalist B&W unless abstraction is emphasised.
styles.short_de: Westdeutsche Kunstfotografie der Nachkriegszeit um Otto Steinert, die Gegenstände in kontrastreiche, grafische Schwarzweißformen auflöst, teils mit Negativabzügen oder Solarisation.
styles.short_en: Post-war West German art photography around Otto Steinert that abstracts objects into high-contrast, graphic black-and-white forms, sometimes with negative prints or solarisation.

styles.era_origin: Popularised in the early 1980s by a British painter assembling overlapping prints and instant photos.
visual_markers: each print from a slightly shifted angle and moment
styles.prompt_fragment: photographic joiner, the scene assembled from dozens of overlapping rectangular snapshot prints, each taken from a slightly shifted angle and moment, edges and white borders visible, perspective fractured like cubism, small exposure and colour shifts between prints, pinned flat on a white wall
styles.avoid: Avoid a seamless panorama or neat grid; misalignment and overlapping edges carry the style.
styles.feasibility_note: Often regularises into a tidy grid; ask for overlap and drift.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not name the living artist most associated with the technique.
styles.short_de: Szenen, zusammengesetzt aus Dutzenden überlappender Einzelabzüge aus wechselnden Blickwinkeln und Momenten, mit kubistisch zersplitterter Perspektive; Anfang der 1980er von einem britischen Maler bekannt gemacht.
styles.short_en: Scenes assembled from dozens of overlapping snapshot prints shot from shifting angles and moments, giving a fractured, cubist view; popularised by a British painter in the early 1980s.
markers_de: jeder aus leicht verschobenem Winkel und Moment
markers_en: each print from a shifted angle and moment
styles.sensitivity_de: Den lebenden Künstler, mit dem die Technik verbunden ist, nicht nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not name the living artist most associated with the technique.

styles.era_origin: Popularised by digital photomosaic software in the mid-1990s.
visual_markers: image built from hundreds of tiny photos
tiles tinted to match local tone
styles.prompt_fragment: photographic mosaic, the whole image built from hundreds of tiny rectangular photographs arranged on a strict grid, each tile chosen and slightly tinted to match the local tone and colour, the large picture readable from a distance while every small photo stays distinct up close
styles.avoid: Avoid pixel blocks or plain mosaic stones; each tile must read as its own photograph.
styles.feasibility_note: Tiles tend to dissolve into noisy texture rather than legible photos.
styles.short_de: Ein großes Bild aus Hunderten kleiner Fotos im Raster, jedes passend zum lokalen Farbton gewählt und getönt; Mitte der 1990er durch Software populär, Vorläufer ab den 1970ern.
styles.short_en: A large picture assembled from hundreds of small photographs on a grid, each chosen and tinted to match the local tone; popularised by mid-1990s software, with 1970s precedents.
styles.era_de: Mitte der 1990er, USA; Vorläufer ab den 1970ern
markers_de: jede Kachel aus der Nähe erkennbar
markers_en: image built from hundreds of tiny photos
tiles tinted to the local tone
big picture readable at a distance
styles.sensitivity_de: „Photomosaic“ ist eine eingetragene Marke; besser den Gattungsbegriff Fotomosaik verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: 'Photomosaic' is a registered trademark; use the generic term photographic mosaic.

styles.era_origin: Systematic rephotography surveys since the 1970s; the hand-held 'then and now' variant became an internet genre in the 2010s.
visual_markers: old print held up by a hand
print aligned with the present scene behind
styles.prompt_fragment: then-and-now rephotography, a hand holding a faded vintage black-and-white print up in front of the camera, aligned so its edges continue the present-day colour scene behind it, fingers and print border clearly visible, sharp contemporary daylight against old grain
styles.avoid: Avoid a seamless blend; the old print must be a physical object in the frame.
styles.feasibility_note: Alignment between print and background is often imperfect.
styles.short_de: Damals-heute-Bilder, bei denen ein alter, von Hand gehaltener Abzug genau auf denselben Ort von heute ausgerichtet ist; Internetgenre der 2010er mit Wurzeln in Refotografie-Projekten der 1970er.
styles.short_en: Then-and-now photos where a faded print, held up by hand, lines up with the same place today; a 2010s internet genre rooted in 1970s rephotography surveys.
styles.era_de: Refotografie-Projekte ab den 1970ern; Hand-Variante seit den 2010ern
styles.era_en: surveys from the 1970s; hand-held variant since the 2010s
markers_de: Abzug fluchtet mit der Szene dahinter
markers_en: old print held up by a hand
print aligned with the scene behind

styles.era_origin: Optical trick from early cinema onward; a ubiquitous tourist and advertising gag.
visual_markers: near and far elements aligned to seem touching
styles.prompt_fragment: forced perspective trick photograph, near and far elements carefully aligned so they appear to touch, playful impossible scale relationship, deep depth of field with everything sharp, wide-angle lens at eye or ground level, plain daylight snapshot realism
styles.avoid: Avoid obvious digital compositing and shallow focus, which give the trick away.
styles.feasibility_note: The model often renders a literally giant object instead of an aligned illusion.
styles.short_de: Trickfotos, bei denen nahe und ferne Dinge so ausgerichtet sind, dass sie sich zu berühren scheinen und Größenverhältnisse kippen; seit dem frühen Kino genutzt, heute Standard bei Urlaubsfotos.
styles.short_en: Trick photos where near and far objects are lined up so they seem to touch, creating impossible scale; used since early cinema and a staple of tourist snapshots.
markers_de: nahe und ferne Elemente scheinbar in Berührung
markers_en: near and far elements aligned to seem touching

styles.era_origin: Digital composites of the 2000s-2010s built from a locked-off camera over many hours.
visual_markers: progression from morning to night across frame
windows and street lights switching on
styles.prompt_fragment: time-slice composite from a locked-off camera, the same view divided into vertical strips that progress from bright morning on one side through golden hour to blue hour and night with lit windows on the other, identical geometry, clean seams
styles.avoid: Avoid a single sunset gradient; each slice must show a distinct time of day.
styles.feasibility_note: Strips sometimes lose geometric continuity.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not name contemporary practitioners.
styles.short_de: Composing aus einer fest montierten Kamera, in dem Streifen desselben Blicks verschiedene Tageszeiten zeigen, quer durchs Bild vom Morgen bis in die Nacht; digitale Technik der 2000er/2010er.
styles.short_en: Composite from a locked-off camera in which strips of the same view show different hours, running from daylight to night across the frame; a 2000s–2010s digital technique.
markers_de: Verlauf von Morgen bis Nacht über das Bild
markers_en: windows and street lights switching on
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine zeitgenössischen Fotografen namentlich nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not name contemporary practitioners.

styles.era_origin: Popular hobbyist technique of the 2010s.
visual_markers: inverted sharp miniature scene inside the ball
styles.prompt_fragment: photographed through a clear crystal sphere close to the lens, the scene appearing inverted and razor-sharp inside the glass ball while the real surroundings melt into soft blur, bright refraction rim around the sphere, natural light
styles.avoid: Avoid glowing magic orbs; the sphere must behave like real optics with an inverted image.
styles.feasibility_note: Inversion inside the sphere is often rendered upright.
styles.short_de: Fotos durch eine klare Glaskugel vor dem Objektiv: darin eine scharfe, auf dem Kopf stehende Miniatur der Szene, ringsum Unschärfe; beliebte Hobbytechnik der 2010er.
styles.short_en: Photos through a clear glass sphere near the lens: a sharp, upside-down miniature of the scene inside, the surroundings blurred; a hobbyist favourite of the 2010s.
markers_de: scharfe, kopfstehende Szene in der Kugel
markers_en: clear glass sphere in the foreground
sharp inverted scene inside the ball

styles.era_origin: Long-standing in-camera trick; prominent in 2010s editorial and music photography.
visual_markers: doubled ghost reflections of the scene
soft refracted blur at one edge
styles.prompt_fragment: photographed through a glass prism held at the lens edge, rainbow dispersion streaks, doubled ghost reflections of the scene sliding across part of the frame, soft refracted blur along one side, sunlight flares, the main subject still clear
styles.avoid: Avoid digital rainbow overlays and holographic gradients; the effects must look optical and partial.
styles.feasibility_note: Prism doubling may be rendered as generic flare.
styles.short_de: Effekt direkt vor der Linse: Ein Glasprisma am Objektivrand legt Regenbogenstreifen, Geisterbilder und gebrochene Unschärfe über einen Teil des Bildes; verbreitet in Editorials der 2010er.
styles.short_en: In-camera effect from a glass prism held at the lens edge, adding rainbow streaks, ghost doubles and refracted blur to part of the frame; common in 2010s editorials.
markers_de: weiche, gebrochene Unschärfe an einem Rand
markers_en: soft refracted blur at one edge

styles.era_origin: Digital-era hack from the late 2000s: the lens is held loose in front of the camera body.
visual_markers: warm light leaks from the gap
styles.prompt_fragment: freelensing look, lens held loose in front of the camera, a single tilted sliver of sharp focus while the rest swims in uneven blur, warm orange light leaking in from the gap and washing out contrast, irregular flare, dreamy handmade imperfection
styles.avoid: Avoid the tilt-shift miniature effect and clean bokeh; the blur is uneven and leaky.
styles.feasibility_note: May collapse into generic shallow depth of field.
styles.short_de: Ein abgenommenes Objektiv wird lose vor die Kamera gehalten: schräger, schmaler Schärfestreifen, schwimmende Unschärfe und warmes Streulicht; ein Digitalkamera-Trick der späten 2000er.
styles.short_en: A detached lens held loosely before the camera gives a tilted sliver of focus, swimming blur and warm light leaks; a digital hack of the late 2000s.

styles.era_origin: Pronounced in 1960s-70s cinema with long zooms; standard in sports, wildlife and urban photography.
visual_markers: distant background looming huge behind the subject
styles.prompt_fragment: shot with an extreme telephoto lens from far away, perspective flattened so the distant background looms enormous right behind the subject, layers stacked like cardboard flats, heat haze shimmering through the air, slightly soft low-contrast distance, crowded compressed rows
styles.avoid: Avoid wide-angle depth and portrait bokeh; the effect is flattening, not just blur.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders convincingly when 'flattened perspective' is explicit.
styles.short_de: Sehr lange Brennweiten aus großer Distanz stauchen den Raum, sodass der ferne Hintergrund riesig hinter dem Motiv aufragt; markant im Kino der 1960er/70er, Standard in Sport- und Stadtfotografie.
styles.short_en: Long lenses shot from far away flatten depth so the distant background looms huge behind the subject; prominent in 1960s–70s cinema and standard in sports and city photography.
markers_de: ferner Hintergrund riesig hinter dem Motiv
markers_en: distant background looming huge behind the subject

styles.era_origin: Crewed space missions of the 1960s-70s using medium-format cameras with an etched réseau plate.
visual_markers: regular grid of small black crosses over the image
styles.prompt_fragment: 1960s-70s space-mission photograph, square medium-format frame with a regular grid of thin black réseau crosshairs etched over the whole image, harsh unfiltered sunlight, pitch-black starless sky, bright silvery surfaces, slightly warm archival film scan with frame number in the margin
styles.avoid: Avoid sci-fi glow and starfields; in hard sunlight no stars are visible.
styles.feasibility_note: Crosshair grid works, though spacing can be irregular.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid agency logos and mission patches.
styles.short_de: Quadratische Mittelformatfotos bemannter Raumflüge der 1960er/70er mit einem Raster kleiner schwarzer Réseau-Kreuze, hartem Sonnenlicht, schwarzem Himmel und silbrig glänzender Technik.
styles.short_en: Square medium-format photographs from 1960s–70s crewed space missions, overlaid with a grid of small black réseau crosses, with harsh sunlight, black sky and silvery hardware.
markers_de: hartes Sonnenlicht, schwarzer Himmel ohne Sterne
markers_en: regular grid of small black crosses
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine Logos von Raumfahrtbehörden und keine Missionsabzeichen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid agency logos and mission patches.

styles.era_origin: Clinical computed tomography from the 1970s and MRI from the 1980s.
visual_markers: grid of slices at different depths
small annotation text and scale in corners
styles.prompt_fragment: medical tomography rendering, smooth greyscale cross-sections of the subject's internal structure on pure black, several slices tiled in a grid at increasing depths, small white annotation text and a scale bar in the corners, faint noise, clinical viewer display
styles.avoid: Avoid X-ray transparency and glowing blue holograms; this is a sectional slice.
styles.feasibility_note: Internal anatomy of non-human subjects will be invented; treat as stylised.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not imitate real patient data or diagnostic images.
styles.short_de: Medizinische Schnittbilder in weichen Grautönen auf Schwarz, oft als Raster mehrerer Schichten mit kleinen Beschriftungen; klinische CT seit den 1970ern, MRT seit den 1980ern.
styles.short_en: Medical sectional images in smooth greyscale on black, often tiled as a grid of slices with small annotations; clinical CT from the 1970s, MRI from the 1980s.
markers_de: Raster von Schichten in verschiedenen Tiefen
markers_en: grid of slices at different depths
small annotation text and scale bar
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine echten Patientendaten oder Befundbilder nachahmen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not imitate real patient data or diagnostic images.

styles.era_origin: Particle physics laboratories, 1950s-1980s.
visual_markers: fine dotted white tracks on a dark field
styles.prompt_fragment: bubble chamber photograph, the subject's form suggested only by fine strings of tiny bubbles tracing curving lines, tight spirals and branching paths across a dark liquid field, parallel beam tracks entering from one side, small fiducial crosses, grainy black-and-white film with uneven illumination
styles.avoid: Avoid neon sci-fi energy beams; tracks are thin, dotted and monochrome.
styles.feasibility_note: Best for abstract or outline compositions; recognisable subjects are hard.
styles.short_de: Schwarzweiße Aufnahmen der Teilchenphysik, auf denen geladene Teilchen feine Bläschenspuren, Spiralen und Verzweigungen in einer dunklen Flüssigkeit hinterlassen; Laborpraxis der 1950er bis 1980er.
styles.short_en: Black-and-white particle-physics photographs in which charged particles leave fine dotted tracks, spirals and branching paths across a dark liquid; made in laboratories from the 1950s to 1980s.
markers_de: feine gepunktete weiße Spuren auf dunklem Grund
markers_en: fine dotted white tracks on a dark field

styles.era_origin: Airport dual-energy X-ray screening, 1990s to today.
visual_markers: false-colour coding: orange organics, green mixed, blue metals
styles.prompt_fragment: dual-energy security X-ray scan, flat top-down transmission view, overlapping objects shown translucent, organic materials in orange, mixed materials in green, metals in blue and blue-black, densest parts solid black, faint monitor scanlines and scale marks
styles.avoid: Avoid medical X-ray greys and skeleton imagery; the false-colour coding defines it.
styles.feasibility_note: Colour coding usually works; translucency logic can be inconsistent.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not depict weapons or threat items in a way that could read as instructional.
styles.short_de: Draufsichten aus dem Sicherheitsscanner, in denen sich Gegenstände durchscheinend überlagern, in Falschfarben: Orange für Organisches, Grün für Mischstoffe, Blau für Metall; seit den 1990ern Standard an Flughäfen.
styles.short_en: Top-down security-scanner images showing overlapping objects as translucent shapes, false-coloured orange for organics, green for mixed and blue for metals; standard at airports since the 1990s.
markers_de: Orange für Organisches, Grün für Mischstoffe, Blau für Metall
markers_en: orange organics, green mixed, blue metals
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine Waffen oder Gefahrgegenstände so zeigen, dass es wie eine Anleitung wirkt.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not depict weapons or threat items in a way that could read as instructional.

styles.era_origin: Darkfield illumination since the 19th century; classic for plankton and diatoms.
styles.prompt_fragment: darkfield light-microscope photograph, transparent forms glowing with luminous outlines and sparkling edges against a pure black field, delicate internal structures lit obliquely, subtle natural colours, thin focal plane, faint circular vignette of the objective
styles.avoid: Avoid fluorescent neon stains and SEM greyscale; darkfield is natural light glowing on black.
styles.feasibility_note: Glow-on-black is easy; keep colours natural.
styles.short_de: Lichtmikroskopische Aufnahmen, bei denen schräges Licht durchsichtige Präparate mit hellen Konturen auf tiefschwarzem Grund leuchten lässt; seit dem 19. Jahrhundert üblich, klassisch für Plankton und Kieselalgen.
styles.short_en: Light-microscope images where oblique illumination makes transparent specimens glow with bright outlines on a pure black field; in use since the 19th century, classic for plankton and diatoms.

styles.era_origin: Military photo reconnaissance from World War I through the Cold War.
visual_markers: edge data strip with frame number and altitude
styles.prompt_fragment: vertical aerial reconnaissance photograph, straight-down black-and-white view from high altitude, long morning shadows, grainy film with an edge data strip of frame number, date and altitude, white grease-pencil circles, arrows and handwritten labels marking features
styles.avoid: Avoid colourful drone imagery and glossy satellite maps; it is a working analogue print.
styles.feasibility_note: Annotations render well; text may be garbled.
styles.sensitivity_note: Military context; avoid real installations and targeting connotations.
styles.short_de: Senkrechte Schwarzweiß-Luftbilder der militärischen Aufklärung vom Ersten Weltkrieg bis zum Kalten Krieg, mit langen Schatten, Datenleiste am Rand sowie Fettstiftkreisen und Beschriftungen der Bildauswerter.
styles.short_en: Straight-down black-and-white military reconnaissance photos from World War I to the Cold War, with long shadows, an edge data strip and interpreters' grease-pencil circles and labels.
styles.era_en: World War I to the Cold War
markers_en: edge data strip with frame number and altitude
styles.sensitivity_de: Militärischer Kontext; keine realen Anlagen und nichts, was nach Zielerfassung aussieht.
styles.sensitivity_en: Military context; avoid real installations and anything that reads as targeting.

styles.era_origin: Mass adoption from the late 2000s; viral online dashcam videos of the 2010s.
styles.prompt_fragment: dashcam video still, ultra-wide lens looking through a dusty windshield, hood edge at the bottom, dashboard reflection on the glass, blown-out sky, heavy compression blocks and smeared detail, burned-in white timestamp, speed and GPS readout in a corner
styles.avoid: Avoid cinematic grading and clean HD; it must feel captured by a cheap automated camera.
styles.feasibility_note: Overlay text and windshield reflections render well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid depicting real accidents or readable number plates.
styles.short_de: Standbilder aus billigen Autokameras hinter der Windschutzscheibe: Ultraweitwinkel, Spiegelungen des Armaturenbretts, ausgefressener Himmel, starke Kompression und eingeblendeter Zeitstempel; verbreitet seit den späten 2000ern.
styles.short_en: Stills from cheap windshield-mounted car cameras: ultra-wide view, dashboard reflections, blown-out sky, heavy compression and a burned-in timestamp; widespread since the late 2000s.
styles.era_de: seit den späten 2000ern; viral in den 2010ern
styles.era_en: late 2000s to today; viral in the 2010s
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine echten Unfälle und keine lesbaren Kennzeichen zeigen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid real accidents and readable number plates.

styles.era_origin: Compact waterproof action cameras from the mid-2000s, ubiquitous in the 2010s.
visual_markers: hands, handlebars or board in frame
styles.prompt_fragment: action camera point-of-view still, ultra-wide barrel distortion, first-person view with hands, handlebars or board edge intruding into the frame, tilted horizon, water droplets on the lens housing, punchy saturated colour, crisp centre and smeared edges
styles.avoid: Avoid shallow cinematic focus and third-person framing.
styles.feasibility_note: POV framing renders reliably.
styles.sensitivity_note: Common brand names for these cameras are trademarks; describe the camera type only.
styles.short_de: Ich-Perspektive aus kleinen, wasserdichten Actioncams, mit starker Tonnenverzeichnung, Händen oder Lenker im Bild, schiefem Horizont und Wassertropfen; seit den 2010ern allgegenwärtig.
styles.short_en: First-person stills from small waterproof action cameras, with strong barrel distortion, hands or handlebars in frame, tilted horizons and water droplets; ubiquitous since the 2010s.
styles.era_de: ab Mitte der 2000er; allgegenwärtig in den 2010ern
markers_de: Hände, Lenker oder Board im Bild
markers_en: hands, handlebars or board in frame
styles.sensitivity_de: Kameramarken sind geschützt; nur den Kameratyp beschreiben.
styles.sensitivity_en: Camera brand names are trademarks; describe the camera type only.

styles.era_origin: Vehicle-mounted 360° street imagery from 2007; adopted by artists as found photography.
visual_markers: stitched 360° view with slight fisheye bend
styles.prompt_fragment: street-level mapping panorama capture, stitched 360-degree view from a roof-mounted car camera, faces and number plates blurred into soft blobs, visible stitching seams and ghosted half-people, flat midday light, slight fisheye bend, faint overlay arrows on the road
styles.avoid: Avoid a sharp cinematic look and real platform logos.
styles.feasibility_note: Stitching artefacts may be too clean.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid platform branding; do not imply real private individuals or locations.
styles.short_de: Zusammengesetzte 360-Grad-Straßenbilder von Kameras auf Autodächern, mit unscharf gemachten Gesichtern, sichtbaren Nähten und halben Passanten; seit 2007 in Kartendiensten, später von Künstlern als gefundenes Bildmaterial genutzt.
styles.short_en: Stitched 360-degree street imagery from roof-mounted car cameras, with blurred faces, seams and ghosting; online mapping since 2007, later used by artists as found photography.
markers_en: stitched 360° view with slight fisheye bend
styles.sensitivity_de: Kein Plattform-Branding verwenden und keine realen Privatpersonen oder erkennbaren Orte nahelegen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Use no platform branding and do not suggest real private individuals or identifiable locations.

styles.era_origin: Social photo apps of 2020-2022 that capture front and rear cameras at once.
visual_markers: small rounded inset selfie in a corner
styles.prompt_fragment: dual-camera social snapshot, an unposed wide-angle rear-camera photo of an ordinary moment with a small rounded-corner inset of a front-camera selfie in the top left, both slightly soft, uneven exposure, plain smartphone processing, no filters
styles.avoid: Avoid polished influencer composition; the charm is mundanity and imperfect timing.
styles.feasibility_note: Inset layout renders reliably.
styles.sensitivity_note: The format is associated with a specific app brand; use no logos.
styles.short_de: Beiläufiges Handyfoto der Rückkamera mit einem kleinen Selfie als Bild im Bild in der Ecke, beide gleichzeitig aufgenommen; verbreitet durch die französische App BeReal ab 2022.
styles.short_en: A casual rear-camera phone photo with a small rounded selfie inset in the corner, both taken at once; spread by the French app BeReal from 2022.
markers_de: kleines Selfie mit runden Ecken als Einschub
markers_en: small rounded selfie inset in a corner
styles.sensitivity_de: Das Format ist mit einer bestimmten App verbunden; keine Logos oder Oberflächenelemente verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: The format is tied to one app brand; use no logos or interface elements.

styles.era_origin: Spiritualist photography studios from the 1860s to the 1920s.
styles.prompt_fragment: Victorian spirit photograph, formal studio sitting on an albumen print, a faint translucent ghostly figure hovering behind created by double exposure, furniture visible through it, soft cotton-like ectoplasm wisps, sepia-brown tones, foxing and faded edges
styles.avoid: Avoid modern horror ghosts with glowing eyes; the effect is naive, faint and photographic.
styles.feasibility_note: Double-exposure transparency works well.
styles.sensitivity_note: A historical deception genre tied to grief; do not depict real deceased persons.
styles.short_de: Förmliche Atelierporträts mit blasser, durchscheinender Geistergestalt aus Doppelbelichtung oder Inszenierung; spiritistische Fotografen in den USA und England verkauften sie von den 1860ern bis in die 1920er an Trauernde.
styles.short_en: Formal studio portraits with a faint, translucent 'spirit' added by double exposure or staging, sold to grieving clients by Spiritualist photographers in the USA and Britain, 1860s–1920s.
markers_de: blasse, durchscheinende Gestalt hinter der Person
markers_en: faint translucent figure behind the sitter
styles.sensitivity_de: Ein historisches Täuschungsgenre, das von Trauer lebte; keine realen Verstorbenen darstellen.
styles.sensitivity_en: A historical fraud genre that traded on grief; do not depict real deceased people.

styles.era_origin: Invented in 1842; revived by alternative-process photographers since the 2000s.
visual_markers: faint image in one plant colour
brushed emulsion streaks and pooled edges
styles.prompt_fragment: anthotype print made with light-bleached plant juice, faint low-contrast image in a single natural hue such as turmeric yellow, beet magenta or berry violet, uneven brushed emulsion with streaks and pooled edges, soft fuzzy detail, heavy watercolour paper texture, fragile and faded
styles.avoid: Avoid crisp contrast and neutral greys; anthotypes are pale, soft and tinted by one plant.
styles.feasibility_note: The model may push contrast too high; insist on 'faint'.
styles.short_de: Blasse, einfarbige Kontaktabzüge aus Pflanzensaft, der unter einem Positiv im Sonnenlicht ausbleicht; 1842 von John Herschel beschrieben, heute von Anhängern alternativer Verfahren wiederbelebt.
styles.short_en: Faint, single-hued contact prints made by bleaching plant juice in sunlight through a positive; described by John Herschel in 1842, revived by alternative-process photographers.
markers_de: blasses Bild in einer einzigen Pflanzenfarbe
Pinselstreifen und gestaute Ränder der Beschichtung
markers_en: faint image in one plant colour
brushed coating streaks and pooled edges

styles.era_origin: Experimental alternative process, prominent since the 2000s.
visual_markers: image formed inside a green leaf
veins and leaf edges through the picture
styles.prompt_fragment: chlorophyll print, the image formed directly inside a real green leaf by sun-bleaching through a negative, yellow-green highlights and deep green shadows, leaf veins, midrib and serrated edges running through the picture, organic irregular outline, backlit translucency
styles.avoid: Avoid painted or overlaid graphics; the image lives in the chlorophyll itself.
styles.feasibility_note: Can come out as a decal on a leaf; stress bleaching.
styles.sensitivity_note: Popularised by a living artist; describe the process only.
styles.short_de: Ein Bild, das durch ein Negativ in ein grünes Blatt gebleicht wird, sodass Adern und Blattrand durch das Motiv laufen; ein alternatives Verfahren, verbreitet seit etwa 2000.
styles.short_en: An image sun-bleached into a green leaf through a negative, with veins and leaf edges running through the picture; an alternative process prominent since about 2000.
markers_en: image formed inside a green leaf
veins and leaf edges cross the picture
styles.sensitivity_de: Von einem lebenden Künstler bekannt gemacht; das Verfahren beschreiben, nicht seine Werke.
styles.sensitivity_en: Popularised by a living artist; describe the process, not his work.

styles.era_origin: Used by French landscape painters c. 1850s-1870s; occasional modern revivals.
styles.prompt_fragment: cliché-verre, a hand drawing scratched with a needle into blackened glass and contact-printed onto light-sensitive paper, fine dark hatching lines on pale paper, feathery soft shading where the coating was dabbed, warm brown-black photographic print tone, no plate mark, slightly ghostly
styles.avoid: Avoid etching plate marks and inky ridges; it should feel photographic.
styles.feasibility_note: May drift into generic etching.
styles.short_de: Eine mit der Nadel in beschichtetes Glas geritzte Zeichnung, wie ein Negativ auf Fotopapier kopiert, mit feinen dunklen Linien; genutzt von Corot und den Barbizon-Malern, 1850er–1870er.
styles.short_en: A needle drawing scratched into coated glass and printed on photographic paper like a negative, giving fine dark lines; used by Corot and the Barbizon painters, 1850s–1870s.
markers_de: mit der Nadel geritzte, fotografisch kopierte Linien
feine dunkle Schraffur auf hellem Papier
markers_en: fine dark hatching on pale paper

styles.era_origin: 1820s, the earliest permanent camera images on bitumen-coated pewter.
visual_markers: light from both sides due to days-long exposure
styles.prompt_fragment: earliest 1820s heliograph on bitumen-coated pewter, extremely low resolution with blotchy granular forms, sunlight falling from both sides from a days-long exposure, metallic grey sheen, unevenly hardened coating, faint almost illegible image under raking museum light
styles.avoid: Avoid daguerreotype sharpness; the image should be barely legible.
styles.feasibility_note: Tends to become a generic blurry photo rather than a metal-plate object.
styles.short_de: Kaum lesbare Kamerabilder auf Zinnplatten, deren Asphaltschicht über Stunden oder Tage im Licht aushärtete; Nicéphore Niépces Verfahren der 1820er, Ursprung der ältesten erhaltenen Fotografie.
styles.short_en: Barely legible camera images on bitumen-coated pewter, hardened by light over hours or days; Nicéphore Niépce's process of the 1820s, source of the earliest surviving photograph.

styles.era_origin: c. 1920s-1950s, used for advertising and magazine colour photography.
styles.prompt_fragment: 1930s tri-colour carbro print, three pigment layers stacked by hand, intensely saturated lipstick reds, cobalt blues and creamy skin, glossy slightly embossed surface, studio-staged advertising composition under hot even lights, faint colour fringes from layer registration
styles.avoid: Avoid Kodachrome slide grain and modern digital saturation; colours are pigment-dense and painterly.
styles.feasibility_note: Saturation is easy; the pigment relief is subtle.
styles.short_de: Farbabzüge aus drei von Hand passgenau übereinandergelegten Pigmentschichten, mit dichter, satter, malerischer Farbe und leichtem Relief; für Werbe- und Magazinfotografie der 1920er bis 1950er.
styles.short_en: Colour prints built from three hand-registered pigment layers, with dense, saturated, painterly colour and slight relief; used for advertising and magazine photography, 1920s–1950s.
markers_en: glossy pigment surface with slight relief

styles.era_origin: 1891 to c. 1910; Nobel Prize-winning colour process.
visual_markers: iridescent colours like oil on water
prism mount in a museum case
styles.prompt_fragment: 1890s Lippmann interference colour plate, small glass plate with a dark mirror-like surface, colours appearing iridescent like oil on water and shifting with the viewing angle, muted jewel-toned highlights floating in black, mounted behind a wedge prism in a museum case
styles.avoid: Avoid holograms and rainbow foil; the colours are natural, only reflective.
styles.feasibility_note: Iridescence on a dark mirror is rarely rendered convincingly.
styles.short_de: Kleine Glasplatten, deren natürliche Farben durch Lichtinterferenz auf dunkler, spiegelnder Fläche entstehen und durch ein Keilprisma betrachtet werden; Gabriel Lippmanns Verfahren von 1891, Nobelpreis 1908.
styles.short_en: Small glass plates whose natural colours appear by light interference on a dark, mirror-like surface, viewed through a wedge prism; Gabriel Lippmann's process of 1891, Nobel Prize 1908.
markers_en: iridescent colours shifting with the angle

styles.era_origin: Geological surveys and expeditions of the 1860s-1880s.
styles.prompt_fragment: 1870s expedition survey photograph on a mammoth wet-collodion plate, monumental view in immense detail, completely blank paper-white sky, warm albumen brown tones, any people tiny for scale, slight vignetting and silvering at the plate corners
styles.avoid: Avoid dramatic clouds and golden-hour colour; blank skies and stillness define it.
styles.feasibility_note: Blank skies need explicit wording.
styles.sensitivity_note: Survey imagery was tied to colonial expansion; avoid romanticising conquest.
styles.short_de: Weite, gestochen scharfe Landschaften auf riesigen Nasskollodium-Glasplatten, mit leerem weißem Himmel und winzigen Figuren als Maßstab; entstanden für Vermessungsexpeditionen im amerikanischen Westen, 1860er–1880er.
styles.short_en: Vast, razor-sharp landscape views on huge wet-collodion glass plates with blank white skies and tiny figures for scale; made for geological surveys of the American West, 1860s–1880s.
styles.sensitivity_de: Die Vermessungsfotografie diente der kolonialen Landnahme; Eroberung nicht romantisieren.
styles.sensitivity_en: Survey photography served colonial expansion; do not romanticise conquest.

styles.era_origin: Darkroom selenium/sepia toning in the 20th century; later a standard digital grading control.
styles.prompt_fragment: split-toned black-and-white fibre print, highlights warmed to soft sepia while the shadows turn cool selenium purple-blue, gentle two-colour separation through the midtones, deep tonal range, matte paper surface
styles.avoid: Avoid uniform sepia or uniform blue; the two tones must coexist.
styles.feasibility_note: Easy; keep the tones subtle.
styles.short_de: Schwarzweißabzüge mit warmen Lichtern und kühlen Schatten, erzeugt durch teilweise Sepia- und Selentonung in der Dunkelkammer, seit den 2000ern auch per digitaler Teiltonung.
styles.short_en: Black-and-white prints with warm highlights and cool shadows, made by partial sepia and selenium toning in the darkroom and, since the 2000s, by digital split-toning.
styles.era_de: 20. Jh. in der Dunkelkammer; digital seit den 2000ern
markers_en: gentle two-tone transition in the midtones

styles.era_origin: From the mid-1970s artists pushed the still-soft emulsion of integral instant prints with a stylus.
styles.prompt_fragment: manipulated integral instant print, the still-soft emulsion pushed and swirled with a blunt stylus, smeared painterly strokes and dabs, colours blending into warm muddy pastels, impressionist texture, wide white bottom border of the instant frame
styles.avoid: Avoid a plain oil painting look; smears must look photographic and sit inside an instant frame.
styles.feasibility_note: May slip into brushwork; mention the stylus.
styles.sensitivity_note: Polaroid SX-70 is a product name used as technical descriptor.
styles.short_de: Sofortbilder, deren noch weiche Emulsion mit einem stumpfen Stift zu malerischen Schlieren verschoben wurde; von Künstlern ab Mitte der 1970er praktiziert, kurz nach Einführung der SX-70 (1972).
styles.short_en: Integral instant prints whose still-soft emulsion was pushed and swirled with a stylus into painterly smears; practised by artists from the mid-1970s, soon after the SX-70's 1972 launch.
styles.sensitivity_de: Polaroid SX-70 ist ein Produktname und dient hier nur als Fachbegriff.
styles.sensitivity_en: Polaroid SX-70 is a product name, used here only as a technical term.

styles.era_origin: Half-frame 35mm cameras from 1959 on, revived in the 2020s.
visual_markers: two vertical frames side by side
styles.prompt_fragment: half-frame film diptych, two vertical snapshots side by side on one 35mm frame separated by a thin black line, related moments or angles of the same scene, slightly different exposures, visible grain, warm consumer colour-negative scan
styles.avoid: Avoid a clean digital split screen; frames sit on film with an irregular divider.
styles.feasibility_note: Layout works reliably.
styles.short_de: Zwei hochformatige Halbformatbilder nebeneinander auf einem Kleinbildfeld, als Paar gelesen; üblich bei Halbformatkameras seit 1959 und wieder beliebt seit den 2020ern.
styles.short_en: Two vertical half-frame shots side by side on one 35mm frame, read as a pair; common with half-frame cameras since 1959 and again in the 2020s revival.
markers_en: two vertical frames side by side

styles.era_origin: Multi-lens toy film cameras of the 1980s-90s.
visual_markers: four or eight small frames on one print
styles.prompt_fragment: multi-lens toy camera print, four small frames in a 2x2 grid exposed a split second apart, the subject shifting slightly between frames, faint parallax, soft plastic-lens blur, saturated cheap colour negative, thin black dividers
styles.avoid: Avoid comic-panel borders; it is one photo print split into sequential frames.
styles.feasibility_note: Grid sequences render well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Commercial names belong to toy-camera brands; use the descriptor.
styles.short_de: Ein Abzug, aufgeteilt in vier oder acht Bilder, die eine Spielzeugkamera mit mehreren Linsen kurz nacheinander belichtet; gebaut seit den frühen 1990ern, um 2000 durch Lomography populär.
styles.short_en: One print split into four or eight frames shot a split second apart by a multi-lens toy camera; made since the early 1990s, popularised by Lomography around 2000.
markers_de: vier oder acht kleine Bilder auf einem Abzug
Motiv verschiebt sich von Bild zu Bild
markers_en: four or eight small frames on one print
styles.sensitivity_de: Die Produktnamen gehören Spielzeugkamera-Marken; die neutrale Beschreibung verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Product names belong to toy-camera brands; use the generic description.

styles.era_origin: Standard darkroom practice throughout the 20th century.
styles.prompt_fragment: darkroom test print, the image exposed in parallel bands of increasing time so it steps from pale to dark across the sheet, sharp edges between strips, exposure seconds pencilled on each band, black-and-white resin-coated paper, slight wetness and tray reflections
styles.avoid: Avoid an even exposure or smooth gradient; the steps must be distinct.
styles.feasibility_note: Step bands render reliably.
styles.short_de: Ein Dunkelkammerabzug, in Streifen mit steigender Belichtungszeit belichtet, sodass das Bild stufenweise von hell nach dunkel wechselt, oft mit Sekundenangaben in Bleistift; Standardverfahren im 20. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: A darkroom print exposed in parallel bands of increasing time, stepping from pale to dark across the image, often with pencilled seconds; standard practice throughout the 20th century.

styles.era_origin: Analogue camera fault embraced by toy-camera culture since the 1990s and copied in digital presets.
visual_markers: warm orange-red fog from one edge
styles.prompt_fragment: analogue film light leaks, warm orange, red and yellow fogging bleeding in from one edge, part of the frame washed out to bright amber, hint of end-of-roll burn and a cut-off sprocket edge, grainy colour negative
styles.avoid: Avoid digital lens-flare overlays; leaks are diffuse and chemical-looking.
styles.feasibility_note: Common look, renders easily.
styles.short_de: Warme orangerote Schleier, wo Streulicht auf den Film fiel, oft mit verbrannten Bildern am Filmende; ein Kamerafehler, den die Toy-Kamera-Szene der 1990er zum Stilmittel machte, später digital nachgeahmt.
styles.short_en: Warm orange-red fogging where stray light hit the film, often with burned frames at the roll's end; a camera fault embraced by 1990s toy-camera culture, later copied digitally.
styles.era_en: as a style since the 1990s, worldwide
markers_de: warmer orangeroter Schleier von einem Rand
markers_en: warm orange-red fog from one edge

styles.era_origin: Archival microfilming from the 1930s; library reader-printers 1960s-2000s.
visual_markers: very high contrast with lost midtones
styles.prompt_fragment: microfilm reader printout, very high-contrast grey image with clogged blacks and lost midtones, faint scan banding, slight skew and vignetting from the reader lens, white dust specks and scratches, frame number and archive marks along the edge, thin glossy paper
styles.avoid: Avoid crisp scans; it should look like a degraded archival copy.
styles.feasibility_note: Degradation renders well.
styles.short_de: Harte, kontrastreiche Papierkopien vom Mikrofilm aus dem Lese-Rückvergrößerungsgerät der Bibliothek, mit verlorenen Mitteltönen, Streifen, Staub und Bildnummern; verbreitet von den 1960ern bis in die 2000er.
styles.short_en: Harsh, high-contrast paper copies printed from microfilm in library reader-printers, with lost midtones, banding, dust and frame numbers; common from the 1960s to the 2000s.

styles.era_origin: Family photo albums, c. 1910s-1960s.
visual_markers: small deckled prints on black card
styles.prompt_fragment: vintage family photo album page, small deckle-edged black-and-white prints fixed with paper photo corners on black card, captions handwritten in white ink, slight tilt and uneven spacing, glassine tissue edge visible, worn paper texture
styles.avoid: Avoid modern scrapbook stickers and washi tape; the layout is sparse and handwritten.
styles.feasibility_note: Layout works; handwriting may be garbled.
styles.short_de: Kleine Schwarzweißabzüge mit Fotoecken auf schwarzem Karton, beschriftet mit weißer Tusche; das übliche Familienalbum von etwa 1910 bis in die 1960er.
styles.short_en: Small black-and-white prints fixed with paper corners on black card pages and captioned in white ink; the standard family album from about the 1910s to the 1960s.
markers_de: kleine Abzüge mit Büttenrand auf schwarzem Karton
markers_en: small deckle-edged prints on black card

styles.era_origin: US printed postcards c. 1931-1959 on embossed textured stock.
styles.prompt_fragment: 1940s linen-finish postcard, a photograph heavily retouched into bright, flat, almost painted colours, saturated turquoise sky, simplified forms, offset-printed on paper embossed with a woven linen texture, white border, cheerful hand-lettered place title
styles.avoid: Avoid photographic realism; colours were airbrushed and simplified.
styles.feasibility_note: The linen texture may be lost; name it explicitly.
styles.short_de: US-Ansichtskarten auf geprägtem Karton mit Leinenstruktur, die Fotovorlagen zu leuchtenden, flächigen, fast gemalten Farben retuschiert; in Massen gedruckt von etwa 1930 bis in die 1950er.
styles.short_en: US picture postcards printed on embossed linen-textured card, with photographs retouched into bright, flat, almost painted colours; produced in quantity from about 1930 to the 1950s.

styles.era_origin: Internet trend of the 2010s, accelerated by automatic colourisation from c. 2016.
visual_markers: muted guessed colours: brownish skin, olive, khaki, dusty blue
styles.prompt_fragment: digitally colourised archival black-and-white photograph, original grain and tonality intact underneath, muted guessed colours in brownish skin, olive, khaki and dusty blue, slight colour bleeding across edges, some areas left greyish, sepia undertone, plausible but uncanny
styles.avoid: Avoid vivid modern colour; it must read as a B&W photo with guessed tints.
styles.feasibility_note: Comes naturally to the model.
styles.sensitivity_note: Colourising real historical photos can mislead; label results as reinterpretation.
styles.short_de: Schwarzweiße Archivfotos mit erratenen, gedämpften Farben über dem erhaltenen Korn, die oft über Kanten laufen; ein Internettrend seit den 2010ern, beschleunigt durch automatische Werkzeuge.
styles.short_en: Black-and-white archive photos with guessed, muted colours laid over the original grain, often bleeding past edges; an internet trend since the 2010s, sped up by automatic tools.
styles.era_de: seit den 2010ern, online; automatische Verfahren ab etwa 2016
styles.era_en: since the 2010s, online; automatic tools from c. 2016
markers_de: gedämpfte, geratene Farben: bräunliche Haut, Oliv, Khaki, Staubblau
markers_en: muted guessed colours: brownish skin, olive, khaki, dusty blue
styles.sensitivity_de: Nachkolorierte historische Fotos können täuschen; Ergebnisse als Neuinterpretation kennzeichnen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Colourised historical photos can mislead; label results as reinterpretations.

styles.era_origin: Creative colour-shift negative film released in the 2010s.
styles.prompt_fragment: colour-shift film look, green foliage rendered vivid violet and lilac, blue sky turned turquoise-green, yellows shifted toward pink, skin tones nearly natural, saturated grainy analogue negative scan
styles.avoid: Avoid the red-foliage infrared Aerochrome look; here greens go purple and skies go green.
styles.feasibility_note: The model may confuse it with infrared red.
styles.sensitivity_note: LomoChrome is a brand name used as technical descriptor.
styles.short_de: Farbnegativfilm mit verschobenen Farben, der grünes Laub violett und blauen Himmel türkis zeigt, Haut aber fast natürlich lässt; ein Effektfilm von Lomography aus den 2010ern.
styles.short_en: Colour-negative film with shifted colours that turns green foliage violet and blue skies turquoise while skin stays nearly natural; an effect stock released by Lomography in the 2010s.
styles.sensitivity_de: LomoChrome ist ein Markenname und dient hier nur als Fachbegriff.
styles.sensitivity_en: LomoChrome is a brand name, used here only as a technical term.

styles.era_origin: Classic panchromatic landscape and architecture practice since the 1920s.
styles.prompt_fragment: black-and-white panchromatic film exposed through a deep red filter, blue sky rendered almost black, clouds blazing white, green foliage darkened, skin and warm tones lightened and smoothed, dramatic tonal separation, crisp large-format detail
styles.avoid: Avoid HDR halos and flat grey skies.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable.
styles.short_de: Schwarzweißfotos durch ein kräftiges Rotfilter, das blauen Himmel unter weißen Wolken fast schwarz und Laub dunkler macht; gängige Landschaftspraxis, seit sich in den 1920ern panchromatischer Film durchsetzte.
styles.short_en: Black-and-white photographs taken through a deep red filter, turning blue skies nearly black under white clouds and darkening foliage; standard landscape practice since panchromatic film of the 1920s.

styles.era_origin: Toy camcorder of 1987 that recorded onto audio cassettes; adopted by experimental filmmakers in the 1990s.
styles.prompt_fragment: toy cassette camcorder still, tiny very low-resolution black-and-white image inside a thick black border, blocky pixels and smeared grey ghosting, crushed contrast, murky shadows, flickering noise, intimate close framing
styles.avoid: Avoid colour and crisp pixel art; it is murky analogue-digital video.
styles.feasibility_note: Black border and smear may be too clean.
styles.sensitivity_note: The original device is a trademarked toy; use the generic description.
styles.short_de: Trübes, grob aufgelöstes Schwarzweißvideo mit dickem schwarzem Rand, aufgenommen mit einem Spielzeug-Camcorder von 1987, der auf Audiokassetten speicherte; in den 1990ern vom Experimentalfilm entdeckt.
styles.short_en: Murky, low-resolution black-and-white video framed by a thick black border, from a 1987 toy camcorder recording on audio cassettes; adopted by experimental filmmakers in the 1990s.
styles.era_en: from 1987, USA; experimental film from the 1990s
styles.sensitivity_de: Das Originalgerät ist ein markenrechtlich geschütztes Spielzeug; die neutrale Beschreibung verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: The original device is a trademarked toy; use the generic description.

styles.name_en: Kaleidoscopic Overhead Musical Number (Busby Berkeley Style)
styles.era_origin: Early-1930s Hollywood backstage musicals.
visual_markers: dozens of performers forming radial patterns
styles.prompt_fragment: 1930s black-and-white musical number shot from directly overhead, dozens of identically dressed performers forming a radial kaleidoscopic pattern around the subject, mirror-gloss floor, sequins catching hard studio light, perfect symmetry, silvery high-contrast nitrate print
styles.avoid: Avoid colour and modern dance; the geometry of bodies is everything.
styles.feasibility_note: Symmetry holds; body counts and poses get messy.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not name the choreographer; describe the formation.
styles.short_de: Dutzende gleich gekleidete Tänzerinnen bilden kaleidoskopartige Muster, senkrecht von oben auf spiegelnden Böden gefilmt; typisch für Busby Berkeleys Hollywood-Musicals der frühen 1930er.
styles.short_en: Dozens of identically dressed dancers forming kaleidoscopic patterns, filmed from directly overhead on glossy sets; typical of Busby Berkeley's Hollywood musicals of the early 1930s.
markers_en: dozens of performers in radial patterns

styles.era_origin: Hollywood Westerns c. 1939-1962, shot on location in desert valleys.
styles.prompt_fragment: classic Hollywood Western still, saturated three-strip dye-transfer colour, red sandstone buttes under a huge clean sky with cumulus clouds, figures dwarfed by the land, low horizon, dust in the air, crisp deep focus, dark doorway framing in the foreground
styles.avoid: Avoid spaghetti-western extreme close-ups and grime; this is sweeping, clean and mythic.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Classic Westerns often misrepresented Indigenous peoples; avoid stereotypical depictions.
styles.short_de: Außenaufnahmen mit kleinen Figuren vor roten Sandsteinfelsen und riesigem Himmel, in satten Farben und großer Schärfentiefe; Hollywood-Western der Studioära, etwa 1939 bis 1962.
styles.short_en: Location shots of small figures under red sandstone buttes and huge skies, in saturated colour and deep focus; Hollywood's studio-era Westerns, about 1939 to 1962.
markers_en: doorway as frame within the frame
styles.sensitivity_de: Klassische Western stellten indigene Völker oft verzerrt dar; stereotype Darstellungen vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Classic Westerns often misrepresented Indigenous peoples; avoid stereotyped depictions.

styles.era_origin: British New Wave films, 1959-1963.
styles.prompt_fragment: late-1950s British kitchen-sink film still, grainy black-and-white location shooting, rows of terraced houses, factory chimneys and smoggy grey sky, cramped working-class interiors with peeling wallpaper, flat natural light, restless young faces
styles.avoid: Avoid Mediterranean neorealist sunlight; this is northern, damp and industrial.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable.
styles.short_de: Körnige Schwarzweißbilder an Originalschauplätzen: Reihenhausstraßen, Fabrikschlote und enge Arbeiterwohnungen in Nordengland; die Filme der British New Wave von 1959 bis 1963.
styles.short_en: Grainy black-and-white location footage of terraced streets, factory chimneys and cramped working-class rooms in northern England; the British New Wave films of 1959 to 1963.

styles.era_origin: British period films of the 1980s-90s, continuing in TV costume dramas.
visual_markers: restrained greens, creams and dusty rose
styles.prompt_fragment: 1980s-90s British heritage costume-drama still, stately country house and manicured gardens, soft diffuse window light and overcast daylight, impeccable period costume, restrained greens, creams and dusty rose, tasteful balanced composition, fine 35mm grain
styles.avoid: Avoid fantasy glamour and teal-orange grading.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable.
styles.short_de: Herrenhäuser, Parks und makellose historische Kostüme in weichem Fensterlicht und zurückhaltenden Farben; britische Literaturverfilmungen der 1980er und 1990er, fortgeführt in TV-Kostümserien.
styles.short_en: Stately homes, gardens and immaculate period costume in soft window light and restrained colours; British literary adaptations of the 1980s and 1990s, continued in television costume drama.
markers_en: restrained greens, creams and dusty rose

styles.era_origin: East German and Czechoslovak studio fairy-tale films, 1950s-1980s.
styles.prompt_fragment: 1970s Eastern European fairy-tale film still, theatrical folk-inspired costumes with embroidery, real snowy forests and old castles, soft studio-style light, slightly faded cool-cast East European colour stock, painted backdrops at the edges, gentle naive charm
styles.avoid: Avoid glossy Hollywood fantasy and CGI magic.
styles.feasibility_note: Colour stock cast needs explicit mention.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid recreating specific films' famous scenes and costumes.
styles.short_de: Märchenfilme mit folkloristischen Kostümen, echten verschneiten Wäldern und Burgen, gemalten Kulissen und leicht verblasstem Farbfilm; gedreht von der DEFA und tschechoslowakischen Studios, 1950er–1980er.
styles.short_en: Fairy-tale films with folk-inspired costumes, real snowy forests and castles, painted backdrops and slightly faded colour stock; made by DEFA and Czechoslovak studios, 1950s–1980s.
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine berühmten Szenen oder Kostüme bestimmter Filme nachbilden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not recreate famous scenes or costumes from specific films.

styles.era_origin: European spy and pop films, c. 1965-1970.
visual_markers: op-art walls and moulded plastic furniture
styles.prompt_fragment: late-1960s European spy and pop-film still, saturated primary-colour mod sets with op-art walls and moulded plastic furniture, crisp sharp colour, sleek gadgets, graphic stylish poses, hard studio light, wide 2.35 framing
styles.avoid: Avoid modern spy thrillers and noir; this is playful pop.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid franchise characters and logos.
styles.short_de: Agenten- und Popfilme in knallbunten Mod-Interieurs mit Op-Art-Wänden, Kunststoffmöbeln und schicken Gadgets; eine europäische Kinomode der späten 1960er.
styles.short_en: Spy and pop films set in saturated primary-colour mod interiors with op-art walls, moulded plastic furniture and sleek gadgets; a European film fashion of the late 1960s.
markers_en: op-art walls and moulded plastic furniture
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine Figuren oder Logos bekannter Filmreihen verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid franchise characters and logos.

styles.era_origin: Mainland Chinese films, mid-1980s to mid-1990s.
styles.prompt_fragment: late-1980s Chinese Fifth Generation film still, saturated crimson fabric and lanterns against ochre earth, symmetric courtyard architecture, large flat colour fields, ritual stillness, golden dust in the light, painterly composition
styles.avoid: Avoid wuxia action and CG blockbusters.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid generic orientalist 'Chinese style'; this refers to a specific film movement.
styles.short_de: Malerische Bilder aus karmesinroten Stoffen und Laternen vor ockerfarbenem Lössboden und symmetrischen Hofhäusern, in ritueller Ruhe; Filme der Pekinger Filmakademie-Absolventen, Mitte der 1980er bis Mitte der 1990er.
