styles.short_en: Painterly frames of crimson fabrics and lanterns against ochre loess earth and symmetrical courtyards, with ritual stillness; films by Beijing Film Academy graduates, mid-1980s to mid-1990s.
styles.sensitivity_de: Gemeint ist eine bestimmte Filmbewegung, kein pauschaler, orientalisierender „China-Stil“.
styles.sensitivity_en: Refers to a specific film movement; avoid a generic orientalist 'Chinese style'.

styles.era_origin: Nigerian direct-to-video productions from 1992.
styles.prompt_fragment: 1990s-2000s West African direct-to-video melodrama still, consumer video camera with harsh frontal light, oversaturated colours and blown highlights, interlaced edges, real living rooms and compounds as sets, dramatic expressions, yellow burned-in subtitle text
styles.avoid: Avoid cinematic bokeh and condescending clichés.
styles.feasibility_note: Video artefacts render well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Respect Nigerian popular culture; avoid poverty and 'juju' stereotypes.
styles.short_de: Melodramen im Heimvideo-Look mit hartem Frontallicht, übersättigten Farben, echten Wohnhäusern als Kulisse und eingebrannten Untertiteln; Nigerias Direct-to-Video-Filmindustrie ab 1992 bis in die 2000er.
styles.short_en: Consumer-video melodrama with harsh frontal light, oversaturated colour, real homes as sets and burned-in subtitles; Nigeria's direct-to-video film industry from 1992 into the 2000s.
styles.sensitivity_de: Nigerianische Populärkultur respektvoll behandeln; keine Armuts- oder „Juju“-Klischees.
styles.sensitivity_en: Treat Nigerian popular culture with respect; avoid poverty and 'juju' stereotypes.

styles.era_origin: Brazil, early to mid 1960s.
styles.prompt_fragment: 1960s Brazilian Cinema Novo still, blinding unfiltered tropical sun burning the black-and-white image toward white, arid scrubland and cracked earth, harsh shadows under hat brims, grainy handheld framing, faces squinting into the glare, poetic austerity
styles.avoid: Avoid warm golden sunlight; the light is white and harsh.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable.
styles.sensitivity_note: Depict rural hardship with dignity, as the films did; avoid exoticising.
styles.short_de: Harte Schwarzweißbilder aus dem dürren Hinterland unter grellweißer Sonne, aus der Hand gefilmt, körnig und überbelichtet; Brasiliens politisch engagierte Filmbewegung der 1960er.
styles.short_en: Harsh black-and-white images of arid backlands under blinding white sun, shot handheld with grainy, overexposed light; Brazil's politically engaged film movement of the 1960s.
styles.sensitivity_de: Ländliche Not mit Würde zeigen, wie die Filme selbst; nicht exotisieren.
styles.sensitivity_en: Show rural hardship with dignity, as the films did; avoid exoticising.

styles.era_origin: Soviet Armenian, Georgian and Ukrainian poetic cinema of the late 1960s.
visual_markers: earth tones with red and gold accents
styles.prompt_fragment: late-1960s poetic tableau film still, static frontal camera, figures posed flat like an icon or manuscript page, symbolic objects arranged ritually around them, whitewashed walls, muted earth tones with deep red and gold accents, no depth cues, solemn direct stares
styles.avoid: Avoid pastel symmetrical whimsy; this is ritual, symbolic and austere.
styles.feasibility_note: The model tends to add depth and perspective.
styles.sensitivity_note: Draws on Armenian and Caucasian religious and folk culture; treat respectfully and do not copy specific films.
styles.short_de: Statische, frontale Tableaus mit flach wie Ikonen posierenden Figuren zwischen rituellen Gegenständen, in Erdtönen mit Rot und Gold; Sergei Paradschanows Filme ab 1969, Teil des sowjetischen poetischen Kinos.
styles.short_en: Static frontal tableaux with figures posed flat like icons among ritual objects, in earth tones with red and gold; Sergei Parajanov's films from 1969, within Soviet poetic cinema.
markers_de: Erdtöne mit roten und goldenen Akzenten
markers_en: earth tones with red and gold accents
styles.sensitivity_de: Greift armenische und kaukasische Religions- und Volkskultur auf; respektvoll behandeln und keine bestimmten Filme kopieren.
styles.sensitivity_en: Draws on Armenian and Caucasian religious and folk culture; treat it respectfully and do not copy specific films.

styles.era_origin: Associated with an Anglo-American auteur active from the 1960s to the 1990s; widely imitated.
styles.prompt_fragment: wide-angle one-point perspective, vanishing point dead centre, walls, ceiling and floor converging symmetrically, the subject isolated small in the middle of a long space, cold even light from overhead fixtures, clean clinical tones, unsettling stillness
styles.avoid: Avoid pastel whimsy and diorama cuteness; the mood is cold and uncanny.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable composition.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not name the filmmaker.
styles.short_de: Weitwinkelbilder mit dem Fluchtpunkt genau in der Mitte, Wände laufen symmetrisch auf eine kleine, isolierte Figur zu; verbunden mit Stanley Kubricks Filmen ab den 1960ern.
styles.short_en: Wide-angle frames with the vanishing point dead centre and walls converging symmetrically on a small isolated figure; associated with Stanley Kubrick's films from the 1960s on.
styles.sensitivity_de: Den Filmemacher nicht im Prompt nennen, sondern die Komposition beschreiben.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not name the filmmaker in prompts; describe the composition.

styles.era_origin: British films of 1968-1973; revived since the 2010s.
visual_markers: white linen, flower crowns, straw masks

styles.avoid: Avoid night-time jump scares, gore and demons.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid caricaturing living pagan religious practices.
styles.short_de: Ländliche Rituale bei beklemmend hellem Tageslicht, Dorfbewohner in weißem Leinen, mit Blumenkränzen und Strohmasken zwischen Wiesen und Steinkreisen; britische Filme von 1968 bis 1973, seit den 2010ern wiederbelebt.
styles.short_en: Rural rituals in unsettling daylight, with villagers in white linen, flower crowns and straw masks among meadows and standing stones; British films of 1968–1973, revived since the 2010s.
markers_en: white linen, flower crowns, straw masks
styles.sensitivity_de: Gelebte heidnische Religionspraxis nicht karikieren.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not caricature living pagan religious practice.

styles.era_origin: US horror films of 1978-1989.

styles.avoid: Avoid gore and clean modern horror grading.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable.
styles.sensitivity_note: Keep violence implied; no gore.
styles.short_de: Nachtszenen in kaltem, blauem Mondlicht und Nebel, durchschnitten von einem einzelnen Taschenlampenstrahl, Silhouetten in erleuchteten Fenstern; US-Horrorfilme von 1978 bis Ende der 1980er.
styles.short_en: Night scenes in cold blue moonlight and fog, cut by a single flashlight beam, with silhouettes in lit windows; US horror films from 1978 to the late 1980s.
styles.sensitivity_de: Gewalt nur andeuten; kein Blut, keine Verletzungen zeigen.

styles.prompt_fragment: 1980s suburban adventure-film still at dusk, smoky backlit haze with beams of light pouring through, flashlight cones in blue night fog, warm lamp-lit house windows, low camera angle, anamorphic blue flares, 35mm grain

styles.sensitivity_note: Do not name studios or directors and avoid trademarked characters.

styles.prompt_fragment: heavy uniform warm yellow-sepia colour grade, everything tinted like old tobacco, hot blown-out highlights, dusty haze, other hues drained away, high contrast and grain suggesting oppressive heat
styles.avoid: Avoid golden-hour warmth; this is a flat cast applied over everything.
styles.feasibility_note: Easy.
styles.sensitivity_note: Criticised for stereotyping places in the Global South as dirty or dangerous. Use it as a critical contrast example, not to depict real countries.
styles.short_de: Ein flächiger gelb-sepiafarbener Farbstich über dem ganzen Bild, mit grellen Lichtern und entsättigten Farben, der Orte als heiß oder gefährlich markiert; Hollywood-Film und -Serien ab etwa 2000.
styles.short_en: A flat yellow-sepia grade laid over everything, with hot highlights and drained colours, used to mark places as hot or dangerous; Hollywood film and TV from around 2000.
styles.sensitivity_de: Kritisiert, weil er Länder des Globalen Südens als schmutzig oder gefährlich zeigt; nur als kritisches Beispiel nutzen, nicht für reale Länder.
styles.sensitivity_en: Criticised for casting countries of the Global South as dirty or dangerous; use it as a critical example, not to depict real countries.

styles.era_origin: Pioneered with ultra-fast lenses in 1975 and imitated in period films since.
styles.prompt_fragment: lit only by real candles, dozens of small flames creating warm amber pools on faces and surfaces, everything beyond falling into deep brown darkness, ultra-fast lens with razor-thin focus, soft painterly skin, grainy 18th-century interior mood
styles.avoid: Avoid fake fire glow and modern fill light; there is no light other than the candles.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable when 'only candles' is explicit.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not name the film or director.
styles.short_de: Innenräume nur von Kerzen beleuchtet, warme Lichtinseln auf Gesichtern, ringsum tiefe Dunkelheit; erstmals umgesetzt in Stanley Kubricks „Barry Lyndon“ (1975) mit Objektiven der Lichtstärke 0,7.
styles.short_en: Interiors lit only by candles, with warm amber pools on faces and deep darkness beyond; pioneered in Stanley Kubrick's Barry Lyndon (1975) with f/0.7 lenses.
styles.era_de: ab 1975, Großbritannien; seitdem in Historienfilmen nachgeahmt
styles.era_en: from 1975, Britain; imitated in period films since
markers_en: candle flames as the only light
styles.sensitivity_de: Film und Regisseur nicht im Prompt nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not name the film or director in prompts.

styles.era_origin: Late-1960s and 1970s cinema and TV.

styles.avoid: Avoid comic panel borders and modern UI grids.
styles.feasibility_note: Panel consistency across shots varies.

styles.short_en: One frame divided by black bars into several rectangles, each showing another angle or simultaneous moment; a cinema and TV device of the late 1960s and 1970s.

styles.era_origin: NTSC colour from 1954 (US), PAL from 1967 (West Germany), through the 1970s.
styles.prompt_fragment: 1960s-70s colour television broadcast captured off a CRT, oversaturated bleeding reds and oranges, comet-tail smears behind bright highlights, soft low-resolution video detail, flat studio lighting, curved rounded screen corners with faint scanlines
styles.avoid: Avoid B&W kinescope and VHS tracking artefacts.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliable.
styles.short_de: Abfotografiertes Fernsehbild der frühen Farbära mit übersättigten, auslaufenden Farben, nachziehenden Schlieren hinter Lichtern und gewölbtem Röhrenbildschirm; USA ab 1954, Westdeutschland ab 1967.
styles.short_en: Off-screen photo of early colour TV with oversaturated, bleeding colour, comet-tail smears behind highlights and a curved CRT; US from 1954, West Germany from 1967.

styles.era_origin: Electronic news gathering, 1980s-1990s.
styles.prompt_fragment: 1980s-90s TV news footage still, 4:3 broadcast video from a shoulder camera, harsh camera-mounted light, slightly oversharpened edges with interlace combing, lower-third caption bar with name and location text, generic channel bug in a corner
styles.avoid: Avoid VHS home-video warping; this is professional broadcast quality.
styles.feasibility_note: Text in captions may be garbled.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not impersonate real broadcasters or fabricate real news events.
styles.short_de: Standbild aus TV-Nachrichten der 1980er und 90er: 4:3-Video von der Schulterkamera, hartes Kameralicht, überschärfte Kanten mit Zeilensprung und Bauchbinde mit Name und Ort.
styles.short_en: Still from 1980s–90s TV news: 4:3 shoulder-camera video, harsh camera-mounted light, oversharpened interlaced edges and a lower-third caption with name and location.
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine realen Sender nachahmen und keine echten Nachrichtenereignisse fingieren.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not imitate real broadcasters or fabricate real news events.

styles.era_origin: Japanese television variety shows from the 1990s onward.
styles.prompt_fragment: Japanese TV variety-show frame, bright flat studio light, huge colourful outlined caption text with drop shadows splashed across the screen, small picture-in-picture reaction wipe in a corner, comic sound-effect graphics, exaggerated reactions
styles.avoid: Avoid Western talk-show minimalism.
styles.feasibility_note: Japanese text is often garbled.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid caricaturing Japanese people.

styles.short_en: Frame from Japanese TV variety shows since the 1990s: bright flat studio light, huge colourful outlined telop captions, a picture-in-picture reaction window and comic sound-effect graphics.
markers_de: riesige bunte Schrift mit Kontur und Schatten
styles.sensitivity_de: Japanische Menschen nicht karikieren.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid caricaturing Japanese people.

styles.era_origin: The first HD cinema cameras, c. 2000-2008.
styles.prompt_fragment: early-2000s HD digital cinema frame, small-sensor deep depth of field, clipped hard highlights, sickly orange city night sky full of fine digital noise, crisp video-sharp edges, flat low-contrast shadows
styles.avoid: Avoid modern full-frame bokeh; deep focus and noise define it.
styles.feasibility_note: The model leans toward modern cinematic polish.

styles.short_en: Film frame from the first HD digital cinema cameras, c. 2000–2008: deep small-sensor focus, clipped highlights, noisy orange city night skies and video-like sharpness.

pin holes and worn card corners

pin holes and worn card corners

styles.feasibility_note: Easy.

styles.short_en: Glossy smooth video with soft frontal light, dramatic tight close-ups, immaculate hair and lush studio sets; US daytime soaps and Latin American telenovelas since the 1950s.

styles.era_origin: Korean TV dramas from the 2000s onward.

styles.avoid: This sits close to the AI default; use it as contrast and avoid adding extra glow or HDR.
styles.feasibility_note: Very easy, which is exactly why it is a useful contrast entry.
styles.short_de: Helles, weich gestreutes Licht, taufrisch glänzende Haut, Pastell- und Cremetöne und sanfte Unschärfe; die Bildsprache südkoreanischer TV-Serien seit den 2000ern.
styles.short_en: Bright soft diffused light, dewy glowing skin, pastel and cream palette and gentle shallow focus; the look of South Korean TV dramas since the 2000s.

negative space on the looking side

styles.feasibility_note: Reliable.

styles.short_en: Still from 16mm classroom and industrial films of the 1940s–60s: faded magenta-shifted colour, stiffly staged demonstrations, flat even light, scratches and dust.
