styles.era_origin: Term coined by K. W. Jeter in 1987 for Victorian-set science fiction; grew into a maker, fashion and illustration aesthetic in the 2000s.
visual_markers: polished brass, copper and riveted iron machinery
exposed clockwork gears, pressure gauges, valves
goggles, leather straps, mahogany and glass
styles.prompt_fragment: steampunk retro-futurism: Victorian-era technology reimagined in polished brass, oxidised copper and riveted iron, exposed clockwork gears, pressure gauges, valves and leather straps, wisps of steam, warm amber gaslight, sepia and verdigris palette, ornate cast-iron filigree, mahogany and bevelled glass, worn patina on every surface
styles.avoid: Do not glue random decorative gears onto everything or render brass as glossy plastic; machinery should look functional, aged and Victorian, not generic fantasy or neon cyberpunk.
styles.feasibility_note: Model knows the vocabulary well; tends toward gear-overload cliché and overly clean CGI metal.
styles.short_de: Viktorianische Technik als Retro-Science-Fiction: Messing, Kupfer und genietetes Eisen, offene Zahnräder, Manometer, Dampf und Gaslicht; Begriff 1987 von K. W. Jeter, als Ästhetik ab den 2000ern verbreitet.
styles.short_en: Victorian technology as retro science fiction: brass, copper, riveted iron, exposed gears, steam and gaslight; named by K. W. Jeter in 1987, popular since the 2000s.
styles.era_de: 1987 (Begriff), Blüte ab den 2000ern; USA und Großbritannien
styles.era_en: 1987 (term), flourishing from the 2000s; USA and UK
markers_de: poliertes Messing, Kupfer und genietetes Eisen
markers_en: polished brass, copper and riveted iron
goggles, leather straps, mahogany and glass

styles.era_origin: Term coined in 2001 by game designer Lewis Pollak for retro-futurism built on interwar-to-1950s diesel-era technology.
visual_markers: riveted gunmetal and soot-blackened steel at monumental scale
exhaust smoke, oil stains, searchlight beams
desaturated olive, rust and gunmetal with amber highlights
styles.prompt_fragment: dieselpunk retro-futurism: interwar machine-age technology at monumental scale, riveted gunmetal and soot-blackened steel, streamlined Art Deco forms, roaring engines, exhaust smoke and oil stains, searchlight beams cutting through haze, desaturated olive, rust and gunmetal palette with amber highlights, gritty 1930s-40s pulp atmosphere
styles.avoid: Keep it oily, heavy and 1930s-40s; avoid steampunk brass gears and sleek glowing sci-fi.
styles.feasibility_note: Well understood; can drift into generic military video-game concept art.
styles.sensitivity_note: Interwar and WWII imagery can slide into fascist or military-propaganda iconography; keep insignia fictional.
styles.short_de: Retro-Futurismus der Zwischenkriegs- und Kriegszeit: monumentale Maschinen aus rußigem Stahl, stromlinienförmiges Art déco, Abgasdunst und Suchscheinwerfer in Oliv, Rost und Stahlgrau; Begriff seit 2001.
styles.short_en: Retro-futurism of the interwar and war years: monumental soot-blackened machines, streamlined Art Deco, exhaust haze and searchlights in olive, rust and gunmetal; term coined in 2001.
markers_de: entsättigtes Oliv, Rost und Stahlgrau mit Bernstein
markers_en: riveted soot-blackened steel at monumental scale
desaturated olive, rust and gunmetal with amber
styles.sensitivity_de: Bilder aus Zwischenkriegszeit und Zweitem Weltkrieg können in faschistische oder militärische Propaganda-Ikonografie kippen; Abzeichen frei erfinden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Interwar and WWII imagery can slide into fascist or military propaganda iconography; keep insignia fictional.

styles.era_origin: Retro-futurism drawing on 1930s-60s visions of tomorrow, centred on the 1945-1965 Atomic Age; 'Raygun Gothic' was coined by William Gibson in 1981.
visual_markers: chrome rocket ships with tail fins and bubble domes
atom-orbit motifs, ray guns, jet packs
pastel turquoise, coral and cream with chrome
styles.prompt_fragment: atompunk retro-futurism as imagined in the 1950s: gleaming chrome with tail fins and bubble domes, atom-orbit motifs, ray guns and jet packs, sweeping parabolic forms, optimistic pastel turquoise, coral and cream with polished chrome, painted gouache illustration with airbrushed highlights, clean sunny sky, promise of a bright atomic tomorrow
styles.avoid: Avoid dystopian grit and synthwave neon; this is sunny, naive optimism, not cyberpunk.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders reliably; sometimes mixes in 1980s neon unless era is stressed.
styles.short_de: Retro-Futurismus aus der Sicht der 1950er: Chromraketen mit Heckflossen, Atomsymbole, Strahlenpistolen, Parabelarchitektur und sonnige Gouache in Türkis, Koralle und Creme; Bezug auf das Atomzeitalter 1945–1965.
styles.short_en: Retro-futurism as the 1950s imagined it: chrome rockets with tail fins, atom motifs, ray guns and sunny gouache in turquoise, coral and cream; Atomic Age, 1945–1965.
styles.era_de: Atomzeitalter 1945–1965, USA; als Retro-Stil seit den 1980ern
styles.era_en: Atomic Age 1945–1965, USA; revisited since the 1980s
markers_de: Pastelltürkis, Koralle und Creme mit Chrom
markers_en: chrome rockets with tail fins and bubble domes
atom-orbit motifs, ray guns, jet packs
pastel turquoise, coral and cream with chrome

styles.era_origin: Term coined by Mark Dery in 1993 for a tradition reaching back to 1950s-70s Black jazz cosmology; a mainstream visual vocabulary since the 2010s.
visual_markers: speculative futures rooted in African and diasporic cultures
textile patterns, beadwork and adornment fused with advanced technology
gold, indigo, ochre and deep violet
styles.prompt_fragment: Afrofuturist aesthetic: speculative future rooted in African and diasporic cultures, advanced technology fused with textile patterns, beadwork, sculptural adornment and vernacular architectural forms, cosmic backdrops, rich gold, indigo, ochre and deep violet, luminous rim light, regal confident compositions, myth and science fiction intertwined
styles.avoid: Avoid a costume collage of generic 'tribal' patterns; draw on specific, respectful references and integrate technology rather than pasting it on.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders the look but tends to homogenise distinct African cultures into a pan-African pastiche.
styles.sensitivity_note: Rooted in Black cultural expression; risk of appropriation and of flattening diverse cultures into decorative stereotype; do not name specific films, musicians or comic franchises.
styles.short_de: Zukunftsentwürfe aus afrikanischen und diasporischen Kulturen: Textilmuster, Perlen und Schmuck verschmolzen mit Hochtechnologie, kosmische Kulissen, Gold, Indigo und Ocker; Begriff 1993 von Mark Dery.
styles.short_en: Speculative futures rooted in African and diasporic cultures: textiles, beadwork and adornment fused with technology, cosmic backdrops, gold, indigo and ochre; term coined by Mark Dery in 1993.
styles.era_de: Wurzeln in den 1950er–70ern, Begriff 1993; USA und afrikanische Diaspora
styles.era_en: roots in the 1950s–70s, term 1993; USA and African diaspora
markers_de: Zukunftsentwürfe aus afrikanischen und diasporischen Kulturen
Textilmuster, Perlen und Schmuck verbunden mit Technik
Gold, Indigo, Ocker und tiefes Violett
markers_en: futures rooted in African and diasporic cultures
textiles, beadwork and adornment fused with technology
gold, indigo, ochre and deep violet
styles.sensitivity_de: In Schwarzer Kulturproduktion verwurzelt; Gefahr der Aneignung und der Verflachung vielfältiger Kulturen zum dekorativen Klischee; keine konkreten Filme, Musiker oder Comic-Reihen nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Rooted in Black cultural expression; risk of appropriation and of flattening diverse cultures into decorative stereotype; do not name specific films, musicians or comic franchises.

styles.era_origin: Southern California coffee-shop, motel and roadside design c. 1945-1965, named after Googie's coffee shop and critic Douglas Haskell's 1952 article.
visual_markers: upswept cantilevered roofs and boomerang shapes
tall roadside pylon signs with neon and chaser bulbs
styles.prompt_fragment: Googie atomic-age design: upswept cantilevered rooflines, boomerang and kidney shapes, starbursts, atom orbits and Sputnik spheres, tall roadside pylon signs with neon tubing and chaser bulbs, slanted script lettering, turquoise, coral, mustard and chrome, sunny 1950s Southern California optimism, crisp mid-century commercial rendering
styles.avoid: Do not turn it into generic Art Deco or synthwave; keep asymmetric jaunty angles, starbursts and daylight optimism.
styles.feasibility_note: Starbursts and boomerangs render reliably; neon lettering may garble.
styles.short_de: Südkalifornische Coffeeshop-, Motel- und Straßenarchitektur von etwa 1945 bis 1965 mit aufschwingenden Dächern, Bumerangformen, Strahlensternen, Atomsymbolen und hohen Neon-Werbepylonen.
styles.short_en: Southern California coffee-shop, motel and roadside design of c. 1945–1965, with upswept roofs, boomerang shapes, starbursts, atom motifs and tall neon pylon signs.
markers_de: hohe Werbepylone mit Neon und Lauflichtern
markers_en: upswept cantilevered roofs and boomerang shapes
tall pylon signs with neon and chaser bulbs

styles.era_origin: American invented 'South Seas' bar culture from the 1930s, peaking in the 1950s-60s and revived since the 1990s.
visual_markers: carved tiki idols, bamboo, rattan and thatch
hibiscus and palm fronds, torch and puffer-fish lamps
jungle green, lava orange and deep teal
styles.prompt_fragment: 1950s-60s American tiki bar aesthetic: carved wooden tiki totems, bamboo, rattan and thatch, hibiscus and palm fronds, glowing torch and puffer-fish lamps, lush jungle green, lava orange and deep teal, chunky tiki-carved display lettering, kitschy printed menu illustration in limited flat inks
styles.avoid: Do not present it as authentic Polynesian art or a generic tropical resort photo; keep it as mid-century American kitsch.
styles.feasibility_note: Well known; may slide into modern beach-bar photography without era cues.
styles.sensitivity_note: Tiki appropriates Polynesian sacred imagery; avoid sacred Maori or Hawaiian iconography and caricatured islanders.
styles.short_de: In den USA erfundene Südsee-Bar-Kultur mit geschnitzten Tiki-Figuren, Bambus, Rattan, Hibiskus und Kugelfischlampen in Dschungelgrün und Lavaorange; entstanden in den 1930ern, Blüte in den 1950ern und 60ern.
styles.short_en: American invented South Seas bar culture with carved tiki idols, bamboo, rattan, hibiscus and puffer-fish lamps in jungle green and lava orange; from the 1930s, peaking 1950s–60s.
markers_en: carved tiki idols, bamboo, rattan and thatch
hibiscus, palm fronds, torch and puffer-fish lamps
jungle green, lava orange and deep teal
styles.sensitivity_de: Tiki eignet sich sakrale polynesische Bildwelten an; heilige Māori- oder hawaiianische Motive und karikierte Insulaner vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Tiki appropriates sacred Polynesian imagery; avoid sacred Māori or Hawaiian motifs and caricatured islanders.

styles.era_origin: UI trend that spread from Dribbble concepts in late 2019 and peaked in 2020.
visual_markers: elements extruded from or pressed into the same matte background
paired soft shadows: light top-left, dark bottom-right
styles.prompt_fragment: neumorphic soft UI aesthetic: every element extruded from or pressed into one matte monochrome surface, paired soft shadows with a light highlight top-left and dark shadow bottom-right, very low contrast, rounded pills, circles and cards, muted pale grey or pastel base, no outlines, tactile moulded-plastic softness
styles.avoid: Avoid glossy reflections and contrasting colours; elements must share the background colour or it reads as Web 2.0 gloss.
styles.feasibility_note: Model often adds gradients or outlines; subtle dual shadows can collapse into ordinary drop shadows.
styles.short_de: UI-Ästhetik, bei der Elemente aus einer matten, einfarbigen Fläche herausgedrückt oder eingeprägt wirken, mit heller Kante oben links und dunklem Schatten unten rechts; Trend 2019/2020.
styles.short_en: UI aesthetic in which elements seem extruded from or pressed into one matte monochrome surface, lit top-left and shadowed bottom-right; a Dribbble-born trend of 2019–2020.
markers_de: Elemente aus derselben matten Fläche geformt
Schattenpaar: hell oben links, dunkel unten rechts
markers_en: elements extruded from or pressed into the same matte background
paired soft shadows: light top-left, dark bottom-right

styles.era_origin: Named and popularised in 2020, rooted in earlier translucent OS interfaces; revived as refractive 'liquid glass' in 2025.
visual_markers: frosted translucent panels with strong background blur
vivid blurred colour orbs behind the glass
styles.prompt_fragment: glassmorphism aesthetic: layered frosted-glass panels with strong background blur, thin bright rim highlights and faint inner glow, vivid out-of-focus colour orbs glowing behind the glass, subtle refraction and edge distortion, floating translucent cards, clean sans-serif labels, soft depth with minimal shadows
styles.avoid: Avoid Frutiger Aero's bubbles and nature imagery and do not let panels turn opaque.
styles.feasibility_note: Blur and translucency render well; text on glass may garble.
styles.sensitivity_note: 'Liquid Glass' is a platform vendor's product term; use only as alias, not in prompts.
styles.short_de: UI-Stil mit mattierten, durchscheinenden Glasflächen, starker Hintergrundunschärfe, hellen Kantenlichtern und leuchtenden Farbkugeln dahinter; benannt 2020, 2025 als lichtbrechendes Flüssigglas wiederbelebt.
styles.short_en: UI style of frosted translucent glass panels with background blur, bright rim highlights and glowing colour orbs behind; named in 2020, revived as refractive liquid glass in 2025.
markers_de: leuchtende, unscharfe Farbkugeln hinter dem Glas
markers_en: frosted translucent panels with strong background blur
vivid blurred colour orbs behind the glass
styles.sensitivity_de: „Liquid Glass“ ist ein Produktbegriff eines Plattformanbieters; nur als Alias, nicht im Prompt verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: 'Liquid Glass' is a platform vendor's product term; use it only as an alias, not in prompts.

styles.era_origin: Modular tile layout popularised by tech product-launch pages around 2022-2023, named after Japanese bento boxes.
visual_markers: rounded tiles of varied sizes on a strict grid
one idea per tile: big number, icon, photo or mini chart
styles.prompt_fragment: bento grid layout: a tight modular grid of rounded-corner tiles in varied sizes, each holding one idea such as a large number, small icon, cropped photo or mini chart, consistent narrow gutters, neutral background, restrained colour accents, crisp sans-serif typography, product-launch keynote polish
styles.avoid: Avoid scattered floating cards or isometric 3D; tiles must align to a strict grid.
styles.feasibility_note: Grid structure works; consistent gutters and legible small text are unreliable.
styles.short_de: Modulares Layout aus abgerundeten Kacheln unterschiedlicher Größe in strengem Raster, je Kachel eine Aussage; um 2022/23 durch Produktseiten großer Tech-Firmen populär, benannt nach der japanischen Bentobox.
styles.short_en: Modular layout of rounded tiles in varied sizes on a strict grid, one idea per tile; spread by tech launch pages around 2022–23, named after bento boxes.
markers_de: abgerundete Kacheln verschiedener Größe im strengen Raster
eine Aussage pro Kachel: Zahl, Icon, Foto oder Mini-Diagramm
markers_en: rounded tiles of varied sizes on a strict grid
one idea per tile: big number, icon, photo or mini chart

styles.era_origin: Prevailing look of developer-tool and AI-startup launch graphics since about 2021.
visual_markers: violet-to-blue radial glow behind a central element
hairline borders and faint grid lines
styles.prompt_fragment: dark-mode tech launch aesthetic: near-black background, soft violet-to-blue radial glow bleeding from behind a central element, thin hairline borders and faint grid lines, subtle noise, bevelled glassy highlights, gradient headline text fading to grey, sparse precise layout, polished startup keynote mood
styles.avoid: Use as contrast; to escape it drop the black background and purple glow, to reproduce it keep lines hairline-thin rather than neon cyberpunk.
styles.feasibility_note: Reproduces effortlessly; it is close to the model's own tech default.
styles.short_de: Fast schwarzer Hintergrund mit violett-blauem Leuchten hinter einem zentralen Element, Haarlinien, feinem Raster und Verlaufsschrift; seit etwa 2021 typisch für Launch-Grafiken von Entwicklertools und KI-Start-ups.
styles.short_en: Near-black background with a violet-to-blue glow behind a central element, hairline borders, faint grid lines and gradient headlines; typical of developer-tool and AI-startup launch graphics since about 2021.
markers_de: violett-blaues Leuchten hinter einem zentralen Element
markers_en: violet-to-blue radial glow behind a central element
hairline borders and faint grid lines

styles.era_origin: Office-suite text effects of the 1990s and Photoshop layer styles of the late 1990s-2000s, ubiquitous in home-made flyers and early websites.
visual_markers: text warped into arches, waves or receding perspective
hard drop shadow and fuzzy outer glow
styles.prompt_fragment: 1990s-2000s desktop text-effect aesthetic: headline type warped into arches, waves or receding perspective, rainbow or metallic gradient fills, heavy bevel and emboss, hard offset drop shadows and fuzzy outer glow, default system fonts, flat white or tiled background, earnest amateur desktop-publishing energy
styles.avoid: Avoid polished modern 3D type; the charm is default presets, crude warps and over-applied effects.
styles.feasibility_note: Effects render, but the model tends to make them too clean and well-kerned.
styles.sensitivity_note: WordArt is a software feature name; describe effects in prompts.
styles.short_de: Schrift aus Office-Programmen und Photoshop-Ebenenstilen der 1990er und 2000er: in Bögen oder Wellen verzerrt, Regenbogen- oder Metallverläufe, Relief, harte Schlagschatten und Schein nach außen.
styles.short_en: Office-suite text effects and image-editor layer styles of the 1990s–2000s: type warped into arches or waves, rainbow or metallic gradients, bevel and emboss, drop shadows and outer glow.
markers_de: Schrift in Bögen, Wellen oder Fluchtperspektive verzerrt
harter Schlagschatten und unscharfer Schein nach außen
markers_en: text warped into arches, waves or receding perspective
hard drop shadow and fuzzy outer glow
styles.sensitivity_de: WordArt ist ein Software-Funktionsname; im Prompt nur die Effekte beschreiben.
styles.sensitivity_en: WordArt is a software feature name; describe the effects in prompts.

styles.era_origin: Framed corporate motivational posters spread from the mid-1980s; ironic 'demotivator' parodies followed in the late 1990s and became a meme template in the late 2000s.
visual_markers: thin white keyline around a centred photo
one word in widely spaced serif capitals below
earnest stock landscape or nature photo
styles.prompt_fragment: motivational poster format: one photograph centred inside a thick black border with a thin white keyline frame, below it a single word in widely spaced white serif capitals, beneath that one short sentence in smaller serif, sober corporate gravitas, slightly dated stock photography
styles.avoid: Avoid Impact-font image-macro text on the picture; text sits below the image in restrained serif.
styles.feasibility_note: Simple layout holds; short text renders.
styles.short_de: Foto in dickem schwarzem Rahmen, darunter ein gesperrtes Wort in Serifenversalien und ein kurzer Satz; Büroposter ab Mitte der 1980er, ironische Parodien ab Ende der 1990er.
styles.short_en: Photo in a thick black border, below it one widely spaced serif word and a short sentence; corporate posters from the mid-1980s, ironic parodies from the late 1990s.
styles.era_de: ab Mitte der 1980er, USA; Meme-Vorlage ab Ende der 2000er
styles.era_en: mid-1980s onward, USA; meme template from the late 2000s
markers_de: dünne weiße Linie um das zentrierte Foto
ein gesperrtes Wort in Serifenversalien darunter
markers_en: thin white keyline around a centred photo
one word in widely spaced serif capitals below
earnest stock landscape or nature photo

styles.era_origin: Ranking format from gaming communities that became a mainstream meme template in the late 2010s.
visual_markers: coloured label cells S, A, B, C, D, F from red to purple
styles.prompt_fragment: tier list ranking graphic: stacked horizontal rows, each with a coloured label square on the left from red S through orange A, yellow B, green C, blue D to purple F, square thumbnail images packed left to right inside the rows, dark grey background, small gaps, flat screenshot look of an online ranking tool
styles.avoid: Avoid a polished infographic with icons and gradients; it should look like a quick tool screenshot.
styles.feasibility_note: Row structure renders; thumbnails become repetitive and letters can misorder.
styles.short_de: Rangliste aus waagerechten Zeilen mit farbigen Labels S bis F und hineingezogenen Vorschaubildern auf dunkelgrauem Grund; aus Gaming-Communitys, seit Ende der 2010er verbreitete Meme-Vorlage.
styles.short_en: Ranking chart of horizontal rows with coloured labels S to F and dragged-in thumbnails on dark grey; from gaming communities, a mainstream meme template since the late 2010s.
markers_de: farbige Labelfelder S bis F von Rot bis Violett
quadratische Vorschaubilder dicht in den Zeilen
markers_en: coloured label cells S to F from red to purple

styles.era_origin: Collage meme format popular from about 2014.
visual_markers: bold black title line at the top
loose grid of mismatched cut-out photos
each item different resolution, light and crop
styles.prompt_fragment: starter pack meme layout: plain white canvas with a bold black title line at the top, a loose grid of mismatched cut-out photos of objects, each at a different resolution, lighting and crop, slightly overlapping, occasional tiny caption, low-effort internet collage assembled in minutes
styles.avoid: Avoid styled flat-lay or knolling with matched light; pieces must look grabbed from different sources.
styles.feasibility_note: Model tends to unify lighting and rendering style across items.
styles.short_de: Weißer Grund mit fetter schwarzer Titelzeile und lose angeordneten, freigestellten Fotos aus verschiedensten Quellen, jedes anders aufgelöst und beleuchtet; Collage-Meme seit etwa 2014.
styles.short_en: White canvas with a bold black title and a loose grid of mismatched cut-out photos, each with different resolution and light; collage meme format since about 2014.
markers_de: jedes Element anders aufgelöst, beleuchtet und beschnitten
markers_en: bold black title line at the top
loose grid of mismatched cut-out photos
each item different resolution, light and crop

styles.era_origin: Genre named by a Tumblr account in 2015, later a staple across social platforms.
visual_markers: harsh on-camera flash or murky indoor light
styles.prompt_fragment: cursed image aesthetic: low-resolution amateur photo with harsh on-camera flash or murky indoor light, awkward tilted crop, inexplicable and slightly wrong everyday situation, cluttered domestic background, compression artifacts, no caption or context, unsettling yet utterly mundane
styles.avoid: Avoid horror props or deliberate creepiness; the unease comes from mundane wrongness, not monsters (that is Weirdcore or Analog Horror).
styles.feasibility_note: Model over-stages and over-polishes; needs repeated insistence on low quality.
styles.short_de: Niedrig aufgelöstes Amateurfoto mit hartem Blitz oder trübem Licht, schiefem Ausschnitt und einer unerklärlich falschen Alltagsszene ohne Kontext; als Genre 2015 von einem Tumblr-Blog benannt.
styles.short_en: Low-resolution amateur photo with harsh flash or murky light, a tilted crop and an inexplicably wrong everyday scene, no context; named by a Tumblr blog in 2015.
markers_en: harsh on-camera flash or murky indoor light

styles.era_origin: Vernacular photos made for online classifieds and auction sites since the late 1990s.
visual_markers: item placed on carpet, bedspread or kitchen floor
on-camera flash glare or warm tungsten
styles.prompt_fragment: amateur online classifieds listing photo: item placed on carpet, a bedspread or a kitchen floor, on-camera flash glare or warm tungsten room light, cluttered background with stray household objects, tilted angle, photographer's reflection or shadow visible, slightly soft focus, unedited phone-camera image
styles.avoid: Avoid clean e-commerce backdrops and styled lighting; unflattering honesty is the point.
styles.feasibility_note: Model leans toward tidy rooms; clutter and flaws must be spelled out.
styles.sensitivity_note: Platform names belong in aliases only.
styles.short_de: Unbearbeitetes Amateurfoto eines Gebrauchtartikels auf Teppich, Bettdecke oder Küchenboden, mit Blitzreflex, Krimskrams im Hintergrund und Spiegelbild des Fotografen; Kleinanzeigen- und Auktionsportale seit Ende der 1990er.
styles.short_en: Unedited amateur photo of second-hand goods on carpet, bedspread or kitchen floor, with flash glare, clutter and the photographer's reflection; online classifieds since the late 1990s.
markers_de: Gegenstand auf Teppich, Bettdecke oder Küchenboden
Spiegelbild oder Füße des Fotografen sichtbar
markers_en: item placed on carpet, bedspread or kitchen floor
on-camera flash glare or warm tungsten
styles.sensitivity_de: Plattformnamen nur als Alias, nicht im Prompt.
styles.sensitivity_en: Platform names belong in aliases only, not in prompts.

styles.era_origin: USB webcams and built-in laptop cameras of about 1998-2010.
visual_markers: cold blue monitor glow as key light
blown highlights and muddy noisy shadows
fixed wide lens from slightly below
styles.prompt_fragment: early 2000s webcam capture: low 640x480 resolution, subject lit by cold blue monitor glow, blown-out highlights and muddy shadows, heavy colour noise and blocky compression, fixed wide lens from slightly below at arm's length, dim bedroom background, smeared motion, mirror-flipped framing
styles.avoid: Avoid smartphone-sharp selfies and warm flattering light; keep it noisy, cold and low-res.
styles.feasibility_note: Resolution degradation often comes out too mild.
styles.short_de: Webcam-Bild in 640×480 oder weniger, kalt vom Monitor beleuchtet, mit ausgefressenen Lichtern, verrauschten Schatten und Weitwinkel von unten; USB- und Laptop-Kameras etwa 1998 bis 2010.
styles.short_en: Webcam image at 640x480 or lower, lit coldly by the monitor, with blown highlights, noisy shadows and a wide lens from below; USB and laptop cameras, c. 1998–2010.
markers_en: cold blue monitor glow as key light
blown highlights and muddy noisy shadows
fixed wide lens from slightly below

styles.era_origin: Retouching apps from 2013 and real-time AR face filters from 2015 shaped the late-2010s 'Instagram face'.
visual_markers: subtly enlarged eyes, slimmed nose, glossy lips
AR overlays such as sparkles, freckles or cartoon ears
styles.prompt_fragment: smartphone beauty filter selfie: front camera at arm's length with slight wide-angle distortion, skin smoothed to poreless plastic, subtly enlarged eyes and slimmed features, glossy lips, ring-light catchlights, augmented-reality overlays such as sparkles, freckles or cartoon ears tracking the face, bright high-key exposure
styles.avoid: The filter must read as a filter, with visible warping and overlays, otherwise it collapses into the AI-default glossy portrait.
styles.feasibility_note: Easy because it sits near the AI default; overlays and warping must be explicit.
styles.sensitivity_note: Body-image concerns; do not present filtered faces as a natural ideal; avoid minors.
styles.short_de: Frontkamera-Selfie mit porenlos geglätteter Haut, vergrößerten Augen, schmalerer Nase, Ringlicht-Reflexen und AR-Effekten wie Glitzer oder Sommersprossen; Retusche-Apps ab 2013, Echtzeitfilter ab 2015.
styles.short_en: Front-camera selfie with poreless smoothed skin, enlarged eyes, slimmed nose, ring-light catchlights and AR overlays like sparkles or freckles; retouching apps from 2013, real-time filters from 2015.
styles.era_de: 2013 bis heute, international; Höhepunkt Ende der 2010er
markers_de: leicht vergrößerte Augen, schmalere Nase, glänzende Lippen
AR-Overlays wie Glitzer, Sommersprossen oder Comic-Ohren
markers_en: subtly enlarged eyes, slimmed nose, glossy lips
AR overlays such as sparkles, freckles or cartoon ears
styles.sensitivity_de: Körperbild-Problematik: gefilterte Gesichter nicht als natürliches Ideal darstellen; keine Minderjährigen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Body-image concerns: do not present filtered faces as a natural ideal; avoid minors.

styles.era_origin: Instagram travel photography of about 2015-2020, defined by downloadable editing presets.
visual_markers: lone figure from behind in flowing outfit
orange skin tones and teal shadows
styles.prompt_fragment: influencer travel photo aesthetic: lone figure seen from behind in a flowing outfit at a famous-looking viewpoint, scene perfectly empty at sunrise, warm orange highlights and teal shadows from a popular editing preset, lifted matte blacks, wide lens or drone height, symmetrical aspirational composition
styles.avoid: Use as deliberate contrast; to escape it add crowds, overcast light and natural colour.
styles.feasibility_note: Reproduces effortlessly.
styles.short_de: Einzelne Person von hinten in wehendem Outfit vor einer menschenleeren Sehenswürdigkeit, orange Hauttöne, petrolfarbene Schatten und matte Schwarztöne aus Presets; Instagram-Reisefotografie etwa 2015 bis 2020.
styles.short_en: Lone figure seen from behind in a flowing outfit at an empty landmark viewpoint, orange skin, teal shadows and matte blacks from presets; Instagram travel photography, c. 2015–2020.
markers_de: einzelne Person von hinten in wehendem Outfit
markers_en: lone figure from behind in flowing outfit
orange skin tones and teal shadows

styles.era_origin: Performance-marketing format imitating amateur creator content, dominant in social advertising since about 2020.
visual_markers: product held up close to the lens
bathroom counter, car seat or kitchen setting
platform-native caption in rounded white box
styles.prompt_fragment: user-generated-content ad style: vertical phone shot, product held up in one hand close to the lens, everyday setting such as bathroom counter, car seat or kitchen, ring light or window light, slight motion blur, platform-native caption in a white rounded text box, deliberately unpolished testimonial feel
styles.avoid: Avoid studio light and retouched packshots; it must pass as something a customer filmed.
styles.feasibility_note: Holds well; captions short.
styles.sensitivity_note: Can be misused for deceptive fake testimonials; label as advertising.
styles.short_de: Hochkant-Handybild, in dem jemand ein Produkt dicht vor die Linse hält, im Bad, Auto oder in der Küche, mit Ringlicht und Untertitelbox; Social-Media-Werbung seit etwa 2020.
styles.short_en: Vertical phone shot of a product held close to the lens in a bathroom, car or kitchen, with ring light and caption box; social ads since about 2020.
markers_de: Produkt dicht vor die Linse gehalten
Badezimmer, Autositz oder Küche als Kulisse
markers_en: product held up close to the lens
bathroom counter, car seat or kitchen setting
platform-native caption in rounded white box
styles.sensitivity_de: Kann für irreführende Fake-Testimonials missbraucht werden; als Werbung kennzeichnen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Can be misused for deceptive fake testimonials; label as advertising.

styles.era_origin: Editorial and restaurant photography trend from about 2017, borrowing from 1990s snapshots and fashion flash.
visual_markers: direct on-camera flash with crisp hard shadows
styles.prompt_fragment: hard direct-flash food photography: on-camera flash with crisp hard-edged shadows, glossy specular highlights on sauces and surfaces, punchy saturated colour, half-eaten plates, crumbs and smears, crumpled napkins, cheap tablecloth, bright foreground falling off into dark background, candid documentary energy
styles.avoid: Avoid soft window light, shallow depth of field and tidy garnish, the default food-blog look.
styles.feasibility_note: Hard flash renders convincingly when stated explicitly.
styles.short_de: Essen im harten Direktblitz mit scharfen Schatten, glänzenden Saucen, satten Farben und angegessenen Tellern vor dunklem Hintergrund; Trend in Editorial- und Restaurantfotografie seit etwa 2017.
styles.short_en: Food lit by hard direct flash with crisp shadows, glossy sauces, punchy colour and half-eaten plates against dark backgrounds; an editorial and restaurant photography trend since about 2017.
markers_de: Vordergrund fällt in dunklen Hintergrund ab
markers_en: direct on-camera flash with crisp hard shadows

styles.era_origin: Long-form TV infomercials and home-shopping channels of the 1980s-2000s.
visual_markers: yellow-red starbursts and huge price numerals
lower-third phone-number bar, SD video softness
styles.prompt_fragment: TV infomercial still: over-lit studio kitchen set, exaggerated demonstrative gestures, split before-and-after panels with the before in grainy black and white, yellow and red starburst badges, huge price numerals, lower-third bar with a phone number, standard-definition video softness and interlace lines
styles.avoid: Avoid HD polish; keep SD softness, cheesy graphics and over-acted gestures.
styles.feasibility_note: Graphics render; numbers and phone strings may garble.
styles.short_de: Standbild aus Teleshopping und Dauerwerbesendungen: grell ausgeleuchtetes Studio, übertriebene Vorführgesten, Vorher-nachher-Split, gelb-rote Sterne, riesige Preise und Telefonnummer-Balken in weicher SD-Qualität; 1980er bis 2000er.
styles.short_en: Still from TV infomercials and home shopping: over-lit studio, exaggerated demo gestures, before-and-after split, yellow-red starbursts, huge prices and a phone-number bar in soft SD video; 1980s–2000s.
markers_en: before/after split with grainy B&W before
yellow-red starbursts and huge price numerals
lower-third phone-number bar, SD video softness

styles.era_origin: Weekly printed discount circulars of supermarkets and discounters, mass-distributed since the 1970s and still ubiquitous in German-speaking countries.
visual_markers: crowded grid of cut-out product photos
oversized red price numerals with superscript cents
yellow and red starbursts and percentage badges
styles.prompt_fragment: supermarket weekly flyer layout: crowded grid of cut-out product photos, oversized red price numerals with small superscript cents, yellow and red starburst badges, crossed-out old prices and percentage stickers, bold condensed sans headings, cheap thin glossy paper with slight show-through, maximal information density
styles.avoid: Avoid elegant whitespace; prices must dominate and everything should feel cramped.
styles.feasibility_note: Layout and bursts are reliable; dense small text garbles.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid real retailer logos.
styles.short_de: Enges Raster freigestellter Produktfotos mit riesigen roten Preisen, hochgestellten Cents, gelb-roten Störern und durchgestrichenen Altpreisen; Wochenprospekte von Supermärkten und Discountern seit den 1970ern.
styles.short_en: Crammed grid of cut-out product photos with huge red prices, superscript cents, yellow-red starbursts and crossed-out old prices; weekly supermarket and discounter circulars since the 1970s.
styles.era_de: seit den 1970ern, besonders im deutschsprachigen Raum
markers_de: übergroße rote Preise mit hochgestellten Cents
markers_en: crowded grid of cut-out product photos
oversized red prices with superscript cents
yellow and red starbursts and percentage badges
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine echten Händlerlogos verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid real retailer logos.

styles.era_origin: Point-of-sale signs written with chisel markers on fluorescent card in markets and shops since the 1960s.
visual_markers: neon yellow, orange or green card
bold chisel-marker lettering in black with red underlines
styles.prompt_fragment: hand-lettered point-of-sale price card: fluorescent card stock in neon yellow, orange or green cut as a starburst or arrow, bold chisel-marker lettering in black with red underlines and exclamation marks, large price numerals, uneven baselines, curling corners stuck on with tape, slightly sun-faded
styles.avoid: Avoid trained sign-painter finesse; it is quick marker work by shop staff.
styles.feasibility_note: Fluorescent colour works; handwritten words may garble.
styles.short_de: Mit Keilspitzmarker beschriftetes Preisschild auf Leuchtkarton in Neongelb, -orange oder -grün, als Stern oder Pfeil geschnitten, mit schiefen Zeilen und Ausrufezeichen; Läden und Märkte seit den 1960ern.
styles.short_en: Chisel-marker price card on fluorescent neon yellow, orange or green board, cut as a star or arrow, with uneven lines and exclamation marks; shops since the 1960s.
markers_de: fette schwarze Keilspitzmarker-Schrift mit roten Unterstreichungen
markers_en: neon yellow, orange or green fluorescent card
bold black chisel-marker lettering with red underlines

styles.era_origin: Unbranded 'generic' groceries introduced by supermarket chains in the late 1970s and 1980s.
visual_markers: plain white or pale yellow package
contents stated in bold black utilitarian capitals
barcode and mandatory small print only
styles.prompt_fragment: generic no-name packaging design: plain white or pale yellow package printed in a single flat ink, the contents stated in bold utilitarian black sans-serif capitals, no imagery or mascot, small mandatory text and barcode, stark discount-aisle austerity, cheap board with slightly misaligned printing
styles.avoid: Avoid chic designer minimalism; it must look cheap and purely functional.
styles.feasibility_note: Simple typography renders reliably.
styles.short_de: Schlichte weiße oder blassgelbe Packung in einer einzigen Druckfarbe, Inhalt in fetten schwarzen Versalien, ohne Bild oder Maskottchen; No-Name-Ware der Supermärkte ab Ende der 1970er.
styles.short_en: Plain white or pale yellow package in a single ink, contents stated in bold black capitals, no imagery or mascot; supermarket generics from the late 1970s.
markers_en: plain white or pale yellow package
contents in bold black utilitarian capitals
barcode and mandatory small print only

styles.era_origin: Mascot-driven breakfast-cereal packaging codified in US supermarkets from the 1950s and peaking in the 1980s-90s.
visual_markers: exuberant cartoon mascot bursting from the panel
extruded bubbly logo with drop shadow
back panel with mazes and puzzles
styles.prompt_fragment: kids' breakfast cereal box design: exuberant cartoon mascot bursting from the front panel, hero bowl with milk splash, oversized extruded bubbly logo with drop shadow, starburst promo badges, tiny serving-suggestion text, saturated primary colours, back panel with mazes and puzzles, glossy printed cardboard
styles.avoid: Do not use real mascots or logos; invent new ones and keep the loud, cluttered energy.
styles.feasibility_note: Composition holds; may drift toward real-brand look-alikes.
styles.sensitivity_note: Strong trademark associations with existing cereal mascots; invent characters.
styles.short_de: Knallbunte Frühstücksflocken-Schachtel mit Comic-Maskottchen, Schüssel mit Milchspritzer, aufgeblähtem 3D-Logo und Aktionsstörern, hinten Labyrinthe und Rätsel; US-Supermärkte ab den 1950ern, Höhepunkt 1980er und 90er.
styles.short_en: Loud cereal box: cartoon mascot, hero bowl with milk splash, bubbly extruded logo, promo starbursts, mazes on the back; US supermarkets from the 1950s, peaking 1980s–90s.
markers_de: Comic-Maskottchen, das aus der Front springt
markers_en: cartoon mascot bursting from the panel
extruded bubbly logo with drop shadow
back panel with mazes and puzzles
styles.sensitivity_de: Starke Markenbezüge zu bestehenden Cerealien-Maskottchen; eigene Figuren erfinden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Strong trademark associations with existing cereal mascots; invent new characters.

styles.era_origin: Full-wrap illustrated cans of the 2010s craft-brewing boom.
visual_markers: full-wrap illustration around a tall can
saturated flat inks with metallic accents
styles.prompt_fragment: craft beer can art: full-wrap illustration around a tall aluminium can, surreal or psychedelic cartoon imagery, bold custom hand-drawn lettering, saturated flat inks with a few metallic accents, matte shrink-sleeve finish, small technical text panel, cans shown as a collectible series
styles.avoid: Avoid generic vintage brewery badges; the 2010s look is maximal, illustrative and wraps around the can.
styles.feasibility_note: Label art may not follow the can's curvature convincingly.
styles.short_de: Rundum illustrierte hohe Bierdose mit surrealen, psychedelischen oder comichaften Motiven, handgezeichneter Schrift und satten Flächenfarben mit Metallic-Akzenten; Craft-Beer-Boom der 2010er in den USA und Europa.
styles.short_en: Full-wrap illustration on tall cans with surreal, psychedelic or cartoon imagery, hand-drawn lettering and flat saturated inks with metallic accents; 2010s craft-beer boom in the US and Europe.
markers_en: full-wrap illustration around a tall can
saturated flat inks with metallic accents

styles.era_origin: Printed matchbox labels from the mid-19th century, especially prolific in 20th-century Eastern Europe, India, Japan and Scandinavia.
visual_markers: bold reduced graphic with chunky outlines
brown striking strip on a wooden box
styles.prompt_fragment: vintage matchbox label: small rectangular printed label in two or three flat inks, bold simplified graphic with chunky outlines, crude letterpress or offset printing with misregistration and ink spread, compact lettering banner, thin cheap paper glued to a wooden box with brown striking strips at the edges, age-browned
styles.avoid: Avoid detailed rendering or gradients; the tiny scale demands bold reduction.
styles.feasibility_note: Flat reduction holds well.
styles.short_de: Winziges Streichholzetikett in zwei, drei Flächenfarben mit stark vereinfachtem Motiv, dicken Konturen und Passerfehlern; seit Mitte des 19. Jh., besonders in Osteuropa, Indien und Japan.
styles.short_en: Tiny matchbox label in two or three flat inks with bold reduced image, chunky outlines and misregistration; from the mid-19th century, prolific in Eastern Europe, India and Japan.
styles.era_de: seit Mitte des 19. Jh., weltweit; Blüte im 20. Jh.
styles.era_en: mid-19th century onward, worldwide; peak in the 20th century
markers_de: kühn reduziertes Motiv mit dicken Konturen
markers_en: bold reduced graphic with chunky outlines
brown striking strip on a wooden box

styles.era_origin: Printed wrappers for firecracker bricks from Macau, Hong Kong and southern China, c. 1920s-1980s, now a collector genre.
visual_markers: flat red, yellow, green and blue inks
emblematic central image with heavy outlines
decorative border frame and bilingual lettering
styles.prompt_fragment: vintage firecracker brick label: small brightly printed paper wrapper, bold flat red, yellow, green and blue inks, simple emblematic central image with heavy outlines, decorative border frame, bilingual block lettering, crude lithographic printing with misregistration and ink specks, thin glossy paper
styles.avoid: Avoid ornate Victorian chromolithograph detail; keep it cheap, punchy and flat.
styles.feasibility_note: Flat printing renders well; Chinese text will be garbled.
styles.sensitivity_note: Risk of orientalist caricature; avoid stereotyped depictions and pseudo-Chinese text.
styles.short_de: Kleines, grell bedrucktes Papieretikett für Böllerpakete in Rot, Gelb, Grün und Blau mit emblematischem Motiv, Zierrahmen, zweisprachiger Schrift und groben Passerfehlern; Macau, Hongkong und Südchina, ca. 1920–1980.
styles.short_en: Small brightly printed firecracker-brick wrapper in flat red, yellow, green and blue, with emblematic image, ornamental border and bilingual lettering; Macau, Hong Kong and southern China, c. 1920–1980.
styles.era_en: c. 1920s–1980s, Macau, Hong Kong, southern China
markers_de: flaches Rot, Gelb, Grün und Blau
markers_en: flat red, yellow, green and blue inks
emblematic central image with heavy outlines
styles.sensitivity_de: Gefahr orientalistischer Karikatur; stereotype Darstellungen und Pseudo-Chinesisch vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Risk of orientalist caricature; avoid stereotyped depictions and pseudo-Chinese text.

styles.era_origin: Sports cards packaged with gum or tobacco; the classic look dates from the 1950s-70s.
visual_markers: coarse offset dot screen, off-centre print
styles.prompt_fragment: vintage sports trading card: small cardboard card with a hand-tinted portrait or action photo, flat colour-block background, bold border and nameplate banner, simple team-style emblem, coarse offset dot screen, slightly off-centre printing, rounded worn corners and creases, gum-stained cardboard
styles.avoid: Avoid modern holographic cards and fantasy card frames (that is Trading Card Game Art).
styles.feasibility_note: Format and wear render well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid real league or team logos and real athletes.
styles.short_de: Kleine Pappkarten mit kolorierten Spielerfotos, flächigen Farbhintergründen und kräftigem Namensbanner, leicht verrutscht gedruckt – der Look amerikanischer Kaugummi-Sammelkarten der 1950er- bis 1970er-Jahre.
styles.short_en: Small cardboard cards with hand-tinted player photos, flat colour backgrounds and bold name banners, printed off-register; the classic US gum-card look of the 1950s to 1970s.
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine echten Liga- oder Vereinslogos und keine realen Sportler darstellen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid real league or team logos and real athletes.

styles.era_origin: Ubiquitous craft-business branding template of about 2010-2015.
visual_markers: crossed arrows or axes behind a central icon
ribbon banner with condensed slab serif
styles.prompt_fragment: hipster vintage badge logo: circular or shield-shaped emblem, crossed arrows or axes behind a central icon, ribbon banner with condensed slab serif, small established date flanking a central X, thin rules and stars, mix of script and capitals, single dark ink with distressed letterpress texture
styles.avoid: Avoid genuine 19th-century ornament; this is the 2010s template with its stock motifs.
styles.feasibility_note: Badge structure renders reliably.
styles.short_de: Rundes oder wappenförmiges Emblem mit gekreuzten Pfeilen, Schriftband, Slab-Serif und „Est.“-Jahreszahl in einer angerauten Druckfarbe – Branding-Schablone von Cafés und Manufakturen der frühen 2010er.
styles.short_en: Round or shield-shaped emblem with crossed arrows, ribbon banner, slab serif and an 'Est.' date, printed in one distressed ink; a craft-business branding template of the early 2010s.
markers_de: gekreuzte Pfeile oder Äxte hinter zentralem Icon
markers_en: crossed arrows or axes behind a central icon
ribbon banner with condensed slab serif

styles.era_origin: Vector mascot logos of gaming clans and esports teams, standardised in the 2010s.
visual_markers: aggressive stylised head in three-quarter view
styles.prompt_fragment: esports mascot logo: aggressive stylised head in three-quarter view with glaring eyes, thick dark outer outline, sharp angular cel shading in two or three tones, limited bold palette, compact badge silhouette, angular slanted wordmark beneath, crisp vector finish on a plain background
styles.avoid: Avoid soft cartoon mascots or painterly detail; it must be a scalable, aggressive vector emblem.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders cleanly; wordmarks may misspell.
styles.short_de: Aggressiver Maskottchenkopf im Dreiviertelprofil mit dicker Kontur, harter Cel-Schattierung und kantigem Schriftzug – das Standard-Vektorlogo von Gaming-Clans und E-Sport-Teams seit den 2010ern.
styles.short_en: Aggressive mascot head in three-quarter view with thick outlines, hard cel shading and an angular wordmark; standard vector emblem of gaming clans and esports teams since the 2010s.
markers_en: aggressive stylised head in three-quarter view

styles.era_origin: Hand-lettering trend that spread through social media from about 2014.
visual_markers: paired with small spaced sans capitals
watercolour wash or leaves as decoration
styles.prompt_fragment: modern brush lettering: bouncy brush-pen script with thick downstrokes and hairline upstrokes, playful irregular baseline, swashes and flourishes, paired with small spaced sans-serif capitals, a soft watercolour wash or a few painted leaves as decoration, textured white paper, hand-made quote-card composition
styles.avoid: Avoid formal copperplate precision and typeset script fonts; letters should vary like real pen strokes.
styles.feasibility_note: Short words work; long phrases garble.
styles.short_de: Hüpfende Brushpen-Schrift mit kräftigen Ab- und haarfeinen Aufstrichen, Schwüngen und oft Aquarellblättern – ein Handlettering-Trend, der sich ab etwa 2014 über Instagram und Pinterest verbreitete.
styles.short_en: Bouncy brush-pen script with thick downstrokes, hairline upstrokes and swashes, often with watercolour leaves; a hand-lettering trend spread via Instagram and Pinterest from about 2014.
markers_en: small spaced sans capitals as a partner

styles.era_origin: Interior, printable-art and social-media aesthetic of about 2018-2022.
visual_markers: terracotta, sand, rust, sage and blush palette
matte paper grain, warm off-white space
styles.prompt_fragment: modern boho minimal aesthetic: muted earthy palette of terracotta, sand, rust, sage and blush, arch shapes and stacked rainbow arcs, simple sun and moon line motifs, organic blobs, dried pampas grass and rattan, soft matte paper grain, calm airy composition with generous warm off-white space
styles.avoid: Use as contrast; to escape it drop the terracotta-sage palette and arches.
styles.feasibility_note: Reproduces effortlessly.
styles.short_de: Erdige Palette aus Terrakotta, Sand, Rost und Salbei mit Bögen, gestapelten Regenbogenringen, Sonne-Mond-Linienmotiven und Pampasgras – Interior- und Printable-Ästhetik von etwa 2018 bis 2022.
styles.short_en: Earthy terracotta, sand, rust and sage palette with arches, stacked rainbow arcs, sun-and-moon line motifs and pampas grass; an interior and printable-art aesthetic of about 2018–2022.
markers_de: Palette aus Terrakotta, Sand, Rost, Salbei und Altrosa
markers_en: terracotta, sand, rust, sage and blush palette

styles.era_origin: Social-media aesthetic peaking 2022-2024, drawing on Rococo, vintage lingerie and 1990s girlhood.
visual_markers: gilded Rococo frames and heart motifs
styles.prompt_fragment: coquette aesthetic: pale pink, cream and ivory palette, satin ribbon bows tied onto everything, lace, pearls and ruffles, heart motifs, gilded Rococo mirror frames, soft-focus vintage flash or hazy window light, delicate nostalgic romance with gentle film grain
styles.avoid: Avoid generic pink girly clip art; bows, lace and Rococo-vintage references are essential.
styles.feasibility_note: Vocabulary renders easily.
styles.sensitivity_note: Criticised for infantilising femininity; never sexualise minors.
styles.short_de: Zartrosa und cremefarbene Bilder voller Satinschleifen, Spitze, Perlen und vergoldeter Rokoko-Rahmen im weichen Vintage-Blitzlicht – eine Social-Media-Ästhetik mit Höhepunkt 2022 bis 2024.
styles.short_en: Pale pink and cream imagery of satin bows, lace, pearls and gilded Rococo frames in soft vintage flash; a social-media aesthetic peaking 2022–2024.
styles.sensitivity_de: Wird als Verniedlichung von Weiblichkeit kritisiert; Minderjährige dürfen nie sexualisiert werden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Criticised for infantilising femininity; never sexualise minors.

styles.era_origin: Social-media aesthetic of 2022-2023 reviving 1950s-90s upper-class leisure imagery.
visual_markers: navy, cream, camel and bottle green
country estates, tennis courts, sailboats, stables
styles.prompt_fragment: old-money quiet-luxury aesthetic: understated navy, cream, camel and bottle-green palette, cable knit, linen and tweed, country estates, tennis courts, sailboats and stables, soft natural daylight with film grain, candid leisure poses, no visible logos, timeless 1980s-90s editorial restraint
styles.avoid: Avoid bling, gold and logos (that is McBling) and the moody bookishness of Dark Academia.
styles.feasibility_note: Holds well; can turn into generic luxury stock.
styles.sensitivity_note: Glamorises class privilege; avoid exclusionary coding.
styles.short_de: Bilder in Marine, Creme und Camel mit Zopfstrick, Leinen, Tennisplätzen, Segelbooten und Landsitzen im weichen Tageslicht, ohne Logos – eine Social-Media-Ästhetik von 2022/23.
styles.short_en: Navy, cream and camel imagery of cable knit, linen, tennis courts, sailboats and country estates in soft daylight, without logos; a social-media aesthetic of 2022–2023.
markers_en: navy, cream, camel and bottle green
styles.sensitivity_de: Verklärt Klassenprivilegien; ausgrenzende Codes vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Glamorises class privilege; avoid exclusionary coding.

styles.era_origin: Internet music scene of the mid-2010s that was named and popularised by a streaming playlist in 2019.
visual_markers: hyper-saturated pink, lime and electric blue
styles.prompt_fragment: hyperpop visual aesthetic: overprocessed glossy chrome and candy-plastic 3D renders, hyper-saturated pink, lime and electric blue, Y2K stars, butterflies and sparkles, warped stretched typography, glitches and heavy compression, cheap preset effects pushed to excess, cute and abrasive at once
styles.avoid: Avoid tasteful Y2K Futurism or Frutiger Aero; it must feel abrasive, overcompressed and excessive.
styles.feasibility_note: Colours work; the model tends to tidy up the deliberate ugliness.
styles.short_de: Überdrehtes Chrom- und Bonbonplastik-3D, grelles Pink, Limette und Blau, Glitzer und verzerrte Schrift mit Glitches – die Bildwelt einer Internet-Musikszene, die 2019 ihren Namen bekam.
styles.short_en: Overprocessed chrome and candy-plastic 3D, hyper-saturated pink, lime and blue, sparkles and warped type with glitches; the visual side of an internet music scene named in 2019.
markers_en: hyper-saturated pink, lime and electric blue

styles.era_origin: Electronic micro-genre of about 2009-2012 with an occult, symbol-heavy visual identity.
visual_markers: inverted triangles, crosses and unicode-like glyphs
styles.prompt_fragment: witch house aesthetic: grainy low-resolution black-and-white imagery washed with faint purple or blood red, inverted triangles, crosses and unicode-like glyphs, ghostly half-erased figures, VHS noise and harsh contrast, cryptic symbol typography, occult unease with early 2010s internet roughness
styles.avoid: Avoid polished occult fantasy art and black-metal logos; keep it lo-fi, symbol-heavy and internet-born.
styles.feasibility_note: Grain and symbols work; tends toward generic horror unless lo-fi is stressed.
styles.sensitivity_note: Inverted crosses and occult symbols may offend religious viewers.
styles.short_de: Körnige Schwarzweißbilder mit violetter oder blutroter Tönung, umgedrehte Dreiecke, Kreuze und Unicode-Zeichen, geisterhafte Figuren und VHS-Rauschen – die okkulte Bildsprache eines Elektronik-Mikrogenres um 2010.
styles.short_en: Grainy black-and-white images tinted purple or red, inverted triangles, crosses and Unicode glyphs, ghostly figures and VHS noise; the occult look of a 2009–2012 electronic micro-genre.
styles.sensitivity_de: Umgedrehte Kreuze und okkulte Symbole können religiöse Menschen verletzen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Inverted crosses and occult symbols may offend religious viewers.

styles.era_origin: Revives 1990s Memphis rap cassette art; became a mass aesthetic with 2020s drift-phonk edits.
visual_markers: grainy black-and-white or blood-red night photo
styles.prompt_fragment: phonk cover art: grainy black-and-white or blood-red tinted night photograph, drifting smoke and harsh headlight glare, blackletter or chrome-outline title, photocopied cassette-insert texture, VHS noise, crushed blacks, ominous low-budget menace
styles.avoid: Avoid clean synthwave neon; it must be grainy, dark and photocopy-rough.
styles.feasibility_note: Grain and tint render well.
styles.short_de: Körnige Nachtfotos in Schwarzweiß oder Blutrot mit Reifenqualm, Scheinwerferblendung und Frakturtiteln auf Kopiertextur – Vorbild sind Memphis-Rap-Kassetten der 1990er, populär wurde der Look mit Drift Phonk in den 2020ern.
styles.short_en: Grainy black-and-white or blood-red night photos with tyre smoke, headlight glare and blackletter titles on photocopied texture; drawn from 1990s Memphis rap tapes, popularised by 2020s drift phonk.
markers_de: körniges Nachtfoto in Schwarzweiß oder Blutrot
markers_en: grainy black-and-white or blood-red night photo

styles.era_origin: British music and design movement of the mid-2000s (a term critics borrowed from Derrida) evoking 1960s-70s public-sector design and folk horror.
visual_markers: faded 1970s educational and public-service print design
simple geometric emblems and clean grotesque type
muted ochre, olive, brown and dusty teal
eerie empty rural landscapes and concrete towns
occult circles hidden in modernist diagrams
styles.prompt_fragment: hauntological aesthetic: faded 1970s public-service and educational print design, simple geometric emblems and clean grotesque type, muted ochre, olive, brown and dusty teal, eerie empty rural landscapes and concrete new towns, occult circles hidden in modernist diagrams, worn off-register printing, nostalgic unease
styles.avoid: Avoid outright horror and VHS glitch (that is Analog Horror); the eeriness is quiet, institutional and print-based.
styles.feasibility_note: Palette and print feel work; the subtle unease is hard to steer.
styles.short_de: Verblasstes Behörden- und Schulbuch-Design im Stil der 1970er mit geometrischen Emblemen, Grotesk und gedecktem Ocker und Oliv, dazu unheimlich leere Landschaften – britische Musik- und Designströmung der mittleren 2000er.
styles.short_en: Faded 1970s-style public-service print design with geometric emblems, grotesque type and muted ochre and olive, plus eerie rural emptiness; a British music and design current of the mid-2000s.
markers_de: gedecktes Ocker, Oliv, Braun und staubiges Petrol
markers_en: geometric emblems and clean grotesque type
muted ochre, olive, brown and dusty teal
eerie empty landscapes and new towns

styles.era_origin: Painted gatefold album covers of British progressive rock, about 1969-1980.
visual_markers: otherworldly landscapes with floating rock islands
natural arches and organic curving architecture
luminous twilight pastels and deep blues
styles.prompt_fragment: 1970s progressive rock album art: painted gatefold panorama of otherworldly landscapes, floating rock islands, natural arches and organic curving architecture, flowing hand-drawn bubble-like title lettering, airbrush and gouache with smooth gradients, luminous twilight pastels and deep blues, vast scale, dreamy cosmic serenity
styles.avoid: Avoid heavy-metal violence and modern digital matte painting; keep gentle gouache surfaces and organic lettering.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders well; lettering is the weakest part.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid naming specific cover artists; prompt by technique only.
styles.short_de: Gemalte Klappcover-Panoramen mit schwebenden Felsinseln, Naturbögen, organischer Architektur und fließend gezeichneten Titeln in leuchtenden Pastelltönen – Plattencover des britischen Progressive Rock, etwa 1969–1980.
styles.short_en: Painted gatefold panoramas of floating rock islands, natural arches and organic architecture with flowing hand-drawn titles in luminous pastels; British progressive-rock album art, about 1969–1980.
markers_en: otherworldly landscapes with floating rock islands
natural arches and organic curving architecture
luminous twilight pastels and deep blues
styles.sensitivity_de: Nur über die Technik beschreiben, keine konkreten Cover-Künstler nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Prompt by technique only; do not name specific cover artists.

styles.era_origin: Easy-listening, exotica and stereo-demonstration LPs of about 1955-1968.
visual_markers: saturated studio colour photo with theatrical props
playful mix of script and slab lettering
styles.prompt_fragment: 1950s-60s hi-fi easy-listening LP cover: saturated studio colour photograph with theatrically posed subject and props, solid bright backdrop, bold banners announcing stereo sound, playful mix of script and slab lettering, heavy retouching, cardboard sleeve with ring wear and corner dings
styles.avoid: Avoid modern-jazz sleeve minimalism; this is bright, kitschy and photo-led.
styles.feasibility_note: Photo and colour hold; banners may misspell.
styles.sensitivity_note: Exotica covers often exoticised non-Western women and cultures; avoid racial and colonial clichés.
styles.short_de: Satte Studio-Farbfotos mit theatralischen Requisiten vor knalligem Einfarbhintergrund, Banner, die Stereoklang anpreisen, und verspielte Schriftmischungen – Easy-Listening- und Exotica-LPs, etwa 1955 bis 1968.
styles.short_en: Saturated studio colour photos with theatrical props on bright solid backdrops, banners touting stereo sound and mixed script lettering; easy-listening and exotica LP sleeves, about 1955–1968.
markers_de: verspielte Mischung aus Schreib- und Slab-Schrift
markers_en: saturated studio colour photo with theatrical props
playful mix of script and slab lettering
styles.sensitivity_de: Exotica-Cover exotisierten oft nichtwestliche Frauen und Kulturen; rassistische und koloniale Klischees vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Exotica covers often exoticised non-Western women and cultures; avoid racial and colonial clichés.

styles.era_origin: Self-financed records by local bands, church groups and hobbyists, about 1960-1985.
visual_markers: earnest amateur photo with awkward posing
flat on-camera flash or overcast daylight
styles.prompt_fragment: private-press vinyl LP cover: earnest amateur photograph with awkward posing and flat on-camera flash or overcast daylight, off-centre composition, mismatched dry-transfer lettering, single-colour printed frame, cheap sleeve with ring wear, price stickers and thrift-store fading
styles.avoid: Avoid professional label design; awkward sincerity is the essence, without mockery.
styles.feasibility_note: Model tends to over-professionalise posing and type.
styles.short_de: Ernsthafte Amateurfotos mit unbeholfenen Posen und flachem Blitz, schiefem Layout und zusammengewürfelter Abreibeschrift – selbst finanzierte Platten von Lokalbands und Kirchengruppen, etwa 1960 bis 1985.
styles.short_en: Earnest amateur photos with awkward posing and flat flash, off-centre layout and mismatched rub-on lettering; self-financed records by local bands and church groups, about 1960–1985.
markers_en: flat on-camera flash or overcast light

styles.era_origin: Home-video rental cassette sleeves of about 1980-1998, especially lurid horror and action titles.
visual_markers: chrome or neon-outlined title with tagline
rental-store stickers and handwritten price tags
styles.prompt_fragment: 1980s video rental cassette box art: lurid painted or photo-collage cover, chrome or neon-outlined title with tagline above, rating box and corner badges, rental-store stickers and handwritten price tags, scuffed cardboard sleeve with faded edges and tape, shelf-worn plastic sheen
styles.avoid: Avoid clean modern posters; physical sleeve wear and store stickers are key.
styles.feasibility_note: Object and wear render well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid real film titles and studio logos.
styles.short_de: Reißerische gemalte oder collagierte Cover mit Chromtitel, Tagline, Altersfreigabe und Videothekenaufklebern auf abgegriffenen Hüllen – Verleihkassetten von etwa 1980 bis 1998, vor allem Horror und Action.
styles.short_en: Lurid painted or photo-collage covers with chrome titles, taglines, rating boxes and rental stickers on scuffed sleeves; home-video rental cassettes of about 1980–1998, especially horror and action.
markers_en: chrome or neon-outlined title with tagline
rental stickers and handwritten price tags
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine echten Filmtitel oder Studiologos verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid real film titles and studio logos.

styles.era_origin: Digitally composited movie-poster convention from the 1990s to today.
visual_markers: oversized faces stacked in the sky
tiny action scene or skyline at the bottom
styles.prompt_fragment: blockbuster floating-heads movie poster: oversized faces of an ensemble stacked in the sky in descending size, a tiny action scene or skyline at the bottom, orange-and-teal grade with lens flares and smoke, metallic bevelled title, dense condensed billing block at the base, heavily composited photo montage
styles.avoid: Use as deliberate cliché; all faces must be invented characters.
styles.feasibility_note: Easy; billing-block text is gibberish.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid real actor likenesses.
styles.short_de: Übergroße Gesichter des Ensembles, am Himmel gestapelt über einer winzigen Actionszene, Orange-Teal-Grading, Lens Flares und Metalltitel – digital montierte Hollywood-Plakatformel seit den 1990ern.
styles.short_en: Oversized ensemble faces stacked in the sky above a tiny action scene, teal-and-orange grade, lens flares and metallic title; a digitally composited Hollywood poster formula since the 1990s.
markers_en: oversized faces stacked in the sky
tiny action scene or skyline below
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine realen Schauspieler darstellen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid real actor likenesses.

styles.era_origin: Mass-market horror paperbacks of the 1970s-80s horror boom.
visual_markers: lurid hyperreal painting on black ground
styles.prompt_fragment: 1970s-80s mass-market horror paperback cover: lurid hyperreal painted illustration on a black ground, sinister focal figure, embossed metallic foil title in drippy or chiselled lettering, sensational tagline, optional die-cut window revealing an inner painting, cracked spine and yellowed page edges
styles.avoid: Avoid modern minimal horror covers and cheap 3D; keep painted lurid craft and foil.
styles.feasibility_note: Painting and foil render convincingly.
styles.short_de: Reißerische, hyperrealistische Malerei auf Schwarz mit unheimlicher Zentralfigur, geprägtem Folientitel und Stanzfenstern – Taschenbücher des Horrorbooms der 1970er- und 80er-Jahre, vor allem aus den USA und Großbritannien.
styles.short_en: Lurid hyperreal paintings on black grounds with a sinister focal figure, embossed foil titles and die-cut covers; mass-market paperbacks of the 1970s–80s horror boom, mainly US and UK.

styles.era_origin: Mass-market romantic-comedy covers since about 2018.
visual_markers: flat vector characters with simplified faces
styles.prompt_fragment: illustrated romantic comedy book cover: flat digital vector characters with simplified, nearly featureless faces, bright pastel solid background, playful props and confetti shapes, large bouncy hand-lettered title, clean shapes without outlines or gradients, cheerful light-hearted energy
styles.avoid: Avoid Corporate Memphis's distorted limbs; proportions stay normal and the charm comes from flat pastel colour and lettering.
styles.feasibility_note: Flat vector holds well.
styles.short_de: Flache Vektorfiguren mit vereinfachten Gesichtern vor hellem Pastellgrund, verspielte Requisiten und ein großer, hüpfender Handlettering-Titel – das gängige Cover romantischer Komödien seit etwa 2018.
styles.short_en: Flat vector characters with simplified faces on bright pastel grounds, playful props and a large bouncy hand-lettered title; the standard romantic-comedy book cover since about 2018.
markers_en: flat vector characters with simplified faces

styles.era_origin: Fantasy-romance publishing boom of the 2020s with collectible special editions.
visual_markers: deep midnight, forest or burgundy ground
intricate gold or rose-gold foil filigree
ornamental frame with stars, vines, thorns
styles.prompt_fragment: romantasy book cover design: deep midnight, forest or burgundy background, single symbolic object centred within an intricate ornamental frame, gleaming gold or rose-gold foil filigree, stars, vines and thorns, elegant high-contrast serif title with swashes, luxurious special-edition finish
styles.avoid: Avoid painted character covers; the genre signature is object plus ornament plus foil.
styles.feasibility_note: Foil and ornament render well.
styles.short_de: Ein einzelnes Symbolobjekt mittig in verschnörkeltem Goldfolien-Filigran mit Sternen, Ranken und Dornen auf Nachtblau, Waldgrün oder Bordeaux – die Coveroptik des Romantasy-Booms der 2020er.
styles.short_en: A single symbolic object centred in ornate gold-foil filigree with stars, vines and thorns on midnight, forest or burgundy ground; the cover look of the 2020s fantasy-romance boom.
markers_de: Grund in Nachtblau, Waldgrün oder Bordeaux
markers_en: intricate gold or rose-gold foil filigree
ornamental frame with stars, vines, thorns

styles.era_origin: Mass-circulation tabloid newspapers from the 1950s onward.
visual_markers: enormous condensed headline, black and white-on-red
cut-out photos with circles and arrows
dense teaser boxes and exclamation marks
styles.prompt_fragment: tabloid newspaper front page: enormous condensed bold headline in black and reversed white-on-red, red masthead block, cut-out photographs with circled details and arrows, dramatic snapshot crops, dense teaser boxes, exclamation marks, cheap newsprint with coarse halftone and slight ink smudging
styles.avoid: Avoid calm broadsheet columns; it must shout.
styles.feasibility_note: Layout works; headline needs short words.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid real mastheads; realistic fakes could spread misinformation.
styles.short_de: Riesige, schmale Schlagzeilen in Schwarz und Weiß auf Rot, roter Zeitungskopf, freigestellte Fotos mit Kreisen und Pfeilen, grobes Zeitungsraster – Titelseiten der Boulevardpresse seit den 1950ern.
styles.short_en: Huge condensed headlines in black and white-on-red, a red masthead, cut-out photos with circles and arrows and coarse newsprint halftone; mass tabloid front pages since the 1950s.

freigestellte Fotos mit Kreisen und Pfeilen
markers_en: cut-out photos with circles and arrows

tilted neon pink, yellow and cyan blocks
styles.prompt_fragment: 1990s teen pop magazine page: cut-out photos with thick white outlines, neon pink, yellow and cyan blocks tilted at angles, starbursts, hearts and lightning bolts, rounded bubbly headline type, quiz boxes and tiny captions, glossy paper with staples and the folds of a poster pullout
styles.avoid: Avoid sleek fashion-magazine restraint; it must be crowded and exuberant.
styles.feasibility_note: Energy renders; small text garbles.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid real celebrity likenesses.

styles.short_en: Cut-out photos with thick white outlines, tilted neon blocks, starbursts, hearts and bubbly headlines crammed onto glossy pages; pop-music youth magazines at their 1990s peak.

schräge Flächen in Neonpink, Gelb und Cyan

tilted neon pink, yellow and cyan blocks

styles.era_origin: American advertising's 'Creative Revolution' of the late 1950s and 1960s.

three columns of long body copy
lots of white space, honest product view
styles.prompt_fragment: 1960s creative-revolution print advertisement: single large black-and-white photograph with plenty of white space, short witty serif headline set below the image, three neat columns of long body copy, small logo bottom right, honest unglamorous product view, letterpress-era magazine paper
styles.avoid: Avoid illustrated 1950s ads and modern glossy hero shots; restraint and copy-led wit are the point.
styles.feasibility_note: Layout works; body copy will be pseudo-text.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not recreate famous historical ads.

styles.short_en: One large black-and-white photo, a short witty serif headline beneath, three columns of long copy and a small logo; American advertising of the late 1950s and 1960s.

three columns of long body copy
ample white space, honest product view

styles.era_origin: Award-festival print advertising of the 1990s-2010s.
visual_markers: one clever visual metaphor fusing two things
tiny logo and tagline in a corner
styles.prompt_fragment: award-show print advertisement: a single clever visual metaphor fusing two objects into one image, clean uncluttered background, no headline, only a tiny logo and one-line tagline in a corner, seamless photographic compositing, centred and instantly readable idea

styles.feasibility_note: The metaphor must be spelled out in the prompt.
styles.short_de: Eine einzige Bildmetapher, die zwei Dinge zu einem verschmilzt, auf ruhigem Hintergrund, ohne Headline, nur mit kleinem Logo und Claim – typisch für Kreativwettbewerbe der Werbebranche, 1990er bis 2010er.

winziges Logo mit Claim in der Ecke

styles.era_origin: Fragrance and underwear advertising of the late 1980s and 1990s.
styles.prompt_fragment: 1990s black-and-white fragrance campaign: grainy high-contrast monochrome photograph, intimate close crops, natural window or beach light, wind, sheets, water and sand, androgynous minimal styling, vast negative space, small widely spaced sans-serif wordmark centred at the bottom
styles.avoid: Avoid colour glamour and heavy retouching; the mood is raw, intimate and minimal.
styles.feasibility_note: Monochrome grain renders well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Prone to sexualisation; keep it adult and tasteful.
styles.short_de: Körnige, kontrastreiche Schwarzweißfotos mit intimen Anschnitten, Strand- oder Fensterlicht und kleinem, gesperrtem Schriftzug – Parfum- und Wäschekampagnen der späten 1980er und 1990er.
styles.short_en: Grainy high-contrast black-and-white photos with intimate crops, beach or window light and a small spaced wordmark; fragrance and underwear campaigns of the late 1980s and 1990s.
styles.sensitivity_de: Neigt zur Sexualisierung; nur Erwachsene zeigen und zurückhaltend bleiben.
styles.sensitivity_en: Prone to sexualisation; keep it adult and tasteful.

styles.era_origin: Party-political street posters, a standard format in parliamentary democracies since the 1950s.
visual_markers: bold colour band with short slogan
rain streaks, tears, stickers or graffiti

styles.avoid: Avoid real politicians, parties and party colour schemes; keep it generic and fictional.

styles.sensitivity_note: Political content; never depict real politicians or parties; potential for disinformation.

rain streaks, tears, stickers or graffiti
styles.sensitivity_de: Politischer Inhalt: nie reale Politiker oder Parteien darstellen, da Fälschungen der Desinformation dienen können.
styles.sensitivity_en: Political content: never depict real politicians or parties, as fakes can serve disinformation.

block letters with multiple drop shadows and highlight lines
painted canvas banners with dramatic naive figures

brown, orange and gold rainbow stripes

styles.feasibility_note: Format and wear render well.

styles.sensitivity_de: Keine echten Skatemarken-Logos oder berühmten Deck-Grafiken verwenden.

cracked plastisol print on faded black cotton

sun-faded next to fresh glossy stickers

styles.avoid: Avoid neat grids or matching sticker styles; layering must feel accumulated over years.
styles.feasibility_note: Texture renders well; sticker text is gibberish.

thin horizontal split through each tile

vivid translucent inks with thick black outlines
