full tonal range on the subject
black-and-white with filed black negative border
styles.sensitivity_de: Eng mit einigen berühmten Fotografen der Jahrhundertmitte verbunden; den Look beschreiben, keine Namen nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Closely tied to a few famous mid-century photographers; describe the look, never name them.

styles.era_origin: Itinerant street photographers in Afghanistan, Pakistan, India, Latin America and elsewhere, early 20th century to the 2000s, using wooden cameras that develop paper negatives inside the box.
visual_markers: low-contrast greyish print copied from a paper negative
uneven development streaks and chemical stains
plain cloth or wall backdrop in daylight
styles.prompt_fragment: made with a wooden street box camera that develops paper negatives inside the box: low-contrast greyish silver print copied from a paper negative, uneven development streaks and stains, soft focus, slight edge fall-off, outdoor daylight against a plain cloth backdrop, frontal ID-style pose, small curled print
styles.avoid: Avoid crisp studio portraiture and sepia Victorian styling; this is rough, improvised and vernacular.
styles.feasibility_note: Low contrast and stains render well; the model tends to sharpen faces too much.
styles.sensitivity_note: A living craft in communities such as Afghanistan and Latin America; avoid exoticising or war clichés.
styles.short_de: Kontrastarme graue Porträts aus hölzernen Straßenkameras, die Papiernegative im Kasten entwickeln, im 20. Jahrhundert von Wanderfotografen in Afghanistan, Indien und Lateinamerika genutzt.
styles.short_en: Low-contrast grey portraits from wooden street cameras that develop paper negatives inside the box, used by itinerant photographers in Afghanistan, India and Latin America through the 20th century.
styles.era_de: frühes 20. Jh. bis in die 2000er; Afghanistan, Südasien, Lateinamerika
styles.era_en: Early 20th century to the 2000s; Afghanistan, South Asia, Latin America
markers_en: low-contrast greyish print from a paper negative
styles.sensitivity_de: Ein noch lebendiges Handwerk etwa in Afghanistan und Lateinamerika; Exotisierung und Kriegsklischees vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: A living craft in places such as Afghanistan and Latin America; avoid exoticising or war clichés.

styles.era_origin: Film premieres and award shows, standardised from the 1990s onward.
visual_markers: posed subject in front of a repeating logo wall
several simultaneous on-camera flashes giving flat bright light and doubled shadows
specular flash highlights on skin and fabric
styles.prompt_fragment: photographed at a premiere photo call in front of a backdrop wall repeating generic invented sponsor marks, multiple simultaneous on-camera flashes producing flat bright light, faint doubled shadows and specular highlights, red carpet underfoot, slight high angle from the press pen, crisp telephoto, posed over-the-shoulder stance
styles.avoid: Avoid candid paparazzi chaos and cinematic bokeh; use invented generic logos, never real brands.
styles.feasibility_note: Logo walls render well, but repeated text may garble; ask for abstract generic marks.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not reproduce real sponsor, studio or event trademarks, and do not depict real celebrities.
styles.short_de: Gestelltes Eventfoto vor einer Wand mit wiederholten Logos, flach ausgeleuchtet von vielen gleichzeitigen Pressblitzen; seit den 1990ern Standard bei Filmpremieren und Preisverleihungen.
styles.short_en: Posed event photo in front of a repeating logo wall, lit flat by many simultaneous press flashes, standard at film premieres and award shows since the 1990s.
styles.era_en: Since the 1990s, film premieres and award shows
markers_de: leicht erhöhte Perspektive aus dem Pressebereich
markers_en: posed subject before a repeating logo wall
flat light from multiple on-camera flashes
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine echten Sponsoren- oder Veranstaltungsmarken nachbilden und keine realen Prominenten darstellen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not reproduce real sponsor or event trademarks, and do not depict real celebrities.

styles.era_origin: Ubiquitous since the 2000s, when people began photographing TVs, laptops and displays with phones instead of taking screenshots.
visual_markers: visible RGB subpixel grid or refresh banding
room or lamp reflections on glossy glass
device bezel visible at the edge
styles.prompt_fragment: presented as a smartphone photo taken of an LCD screen showing the image: rainbow moiré interference ripples, visible RGB subpixel grid, slight keystone angle and tilt, faint reflection of a ceiling lamp on the glass, blown highlights, dark bezel edge at the frame border, casual off-centre framing
styles.avoid: Avoid a clean screenshot or a CRT scanline look; the camera-of-a-screen artefacts and reflections are the point.
styles.feasibility_note: Moiré is approximated and sometimes too regular; reflections and bezel render well.
styles.short_de: Handyfoto eines Monitors oder Fernsehers mit Regenbogen-Moiré, sichtbaren Subpixeln, Spiegelungen und schräg angeschnittenem Gehäuserand; Alltagspraxis seit den 2000ern.
styles.short_en: Phone snapshot of a monitor or TV showing rainbow moiré, visible subpixels, glare and a tilted bezel; everyday practice since the 2000s.

styles.era_origin: Japanese photobook, film-camera and social-media culture from the 2000s onward, building on quiet everyday colour photography of the 1990s.
visual_markers: cool cyan-green and powder-blue cast in the shadows
quiet banal everyday moments with lots of empty space
styles.prompt_fragment: Japanese airy film photography: deliberately overexposed by one to two stops, low contrast, pale washed cyan-green and powder-blue tones, backlit soft daylight with gentle lens flare, quiet everyday moment with generous empty space, fine colour negative grain, calm off-centre composition
styles.avoid: Avoid warm creamy whites and styled props, which turn it into Western light-and-airy lifestyle blogging, and avoid strong saturation.
styles.feasibility_note: Overexposure and pastel cast hold well; specify 'cool cyan shadows' to separate it from the warm airy look.
styles.short_de: Blasse, überbelichtete, kontrastarme Farbfotos stiller Alltagsmomente mit kühlen cyangrünen Schatten und weichem Gegenlicht, aus der japanischen Film- und Social-Media-Fotografie seit den 2000ern.
styles.short_en: Pale, overexposed, low-contrast colour photos of quiet everyday moments with cool cyan-green shadows and soft backlight, from Japanese film and social-media photography since the 2000s.
markers_en: quiet everyday scene with empty space

styles.era_origin: Made in London in 1916-17 as among the first deliberately abstract photographs, linked to Vorticism.
visual_markers: subject fractured into repeated mirrored facets
fragments of the subject still recognisable
styles.prompt_fragment: photographed through three mirrors clamped into a triangular tube, fracturing the subject into repeated mirrored facets and crystalline angular shards, early-20th-century black-and-white silver print, soft tonal range, irregular overlapping fragments with parts of the subject still recognisable
styles.avoid: Avoid perfect digital radial symmetry and saturated colour; keep it analog, irregular and monochrome.
styles.feasibility_note: The model tends to produce perfect digital kaleidoscopes; ask for irregular, overlapping facets.
styles.short_de: Abstrakte Fotografien, aufgenommen durch drei zu einem Dreieck verbundene Spiegel, die das Motiv in wiederholte kristalline Facetten zerlegen; entstanden 1916–17 in London.
styles.short_en: Abstract photographs made through three mirrors clamped into a triangle, splitting the subject into repeated crystalline facets; created in London in 1916–17.

styles.era_origin: Begun in the 1920s avant-garde and systematised by the German Generative Fotografie movement from 1968.
visual_markers: pure light gradients and curves on photographic paper
glowing arcs, waves or serial grids
styles.prompt_fragment: cameraless luminogram: pure light traced directly onto photographic paper without objects, flowing glowing arcs, gradients and wave forms in systematic serial repetition, black-and-white silver gelatin tonality with deep blacks, soft luminous edges, the subject abstracted into light paths
styles.avoid: Avoid object silhouettes (that is a photogram) and colourful night light painting; it must be abstract light on paper.
styles.feasibility_note: Abstract light forms render well; subject legibility is low by nature.
styles.short_de: Kameralose Schwarzweißbilder aus reinem Licht, direkt auf Fotopapier gezeichnet als leuchtende Bögen, Verläufe und serielle Muster; Avantgarde der 1920er und Generative Fotografie ab 1968.
styles.short_en: Cameraless black-and-white images of pure light traced onto photographic paper as glowing arcs, gradients and serial patterns, from 1920s avant-garde and German Generative Photography after 1968.
styles.era_de: Avantgarde der 1920er; Generative Fotografie ab 1968, Deutschland
markers_de: leuchtende Bögen, Wellen oder serielle Raster
markers_en: pure light gradients on photographic paper
glowing arcs, waves or serial grids

styles.era_origin: Named in American colour nature photography of the 1960s-70s; now a core landscape genre.
visual_markers: contained mid-distance section of forest, rock, leaves or water
pattern and texture over grand vistas
styles.prompt_fragment: composed as an intimate landscape: no sky or horizon, a contained mid-distance section of the scene, soft even overcast light without hard shadows, subtle harmonious colours, emphasis on pattern, texture and rhythm, large-format colour film detail, quiet contemplative framing
styles.avoid: Avoid golden-hour skies, epic vistas and saturated sunsets that drag it into the generic landscape default.
styles.feasibility_note: The model may still add a sky; state 'no sky, no horizon'.
styles.short_de: Landschaftsfotos ohne Himmel und Horizont, die einen kleinen Ausschnitt aus Wald, Fels oder Wasser bei weichem, diffusem Licht zeigen; benannt in der US-Naturfotografie der 1970er.
styles.short_en: Landscape photos without sky or horizon that frame a small section of forest, rock or water in soft overcast light; named in American nature photography of the 1970s.
styles.era_de: 1960er–70er, USA; heute fester Teil der Landschaftsfotografie
styles.era_en: 1960s–70s, USA; now a standard landscape genre
markers_de: weiches Licht bei Bewölkung oder im Schatten
markers_en: pattern and texture instead of vistas

styles.era_origin: Fine-art and social-media architecture photography of the 2010s, rooted in modernist abstraction.
visual_markers: tight crop of facade fragments, stairs or balconies
flat geometric planes against a clear sky
no ground line or context, at most one tiny figure
styles.prompt_fragment: minimalist architectural abstraction: tightly cropped facade fragment reduced to flat geometric planes, curves and repeating lines against a cloudless sky, clean pastel or primary colours, hard midday sun with crisp graphic shadows, no ground line or context, possibly one tiny figure for scale, telephoto flattening
styles.avoid: Avoid wide establishing shots and HDR detail; keep it flat, graphic and reduced.
styles.feasibility_note: Geometric planes and clean skies render cleanly.
styles.short_de: Eng beschnittene Fassadenausschnitte, reduziert auf flache geometrische Flächen in Pastell- oder Grundfarben vor klarem Himmel; verbreitet in Kunst- und Social-Media-Architekturfotografie der 2010er.
styles.short_en: Tightly cropped facade fragments reduced to flat geometric planes in pastel or primary colours against clear sky, common in fine-art and social-media architecture photography of the 2010s.
markers_de: flache geometrische Flächen vor klarem Himmel
keine Bodenlinie, höchstens eine winzige Figur
markers_en: flat geometric planes against clear sky
no ground line, at most one tiny figure

styles.era_origin: Catadioptric mirror telephoto lenses, popular with amateurs in the 1970s-80s.
visual_markers: out-of-focus highlights rendered as hollow rings
styles.prompt_fragment: shot on a 500mm catadioptric mirror telephoto lens: out-of-focus highlights rendered as hollow ring-shaped donut bokeh, busy doubled background texture, low contrast and slight softness, strong telephoto compression, thin focus plane, 1980s colour film
styles.avoid: Avoid the creamy round bokeh balls of the fast-prime default; the rings must be hollow.
styles.feasibility_note: Ring bokeh is sometimes rendered as solid discs; mention 'hollow ring highlights'.
styles.short_de: Teleaufnahmen mit Spiegelobjektiven, deren unscharfe Lichter als hohle Ringe erscheinen, vor unruhigem, kontrastarmem Hintergrund; bei Amateuren der 1970er–80er beliebt.
styles.short_en: Telephoto images from catadioptric mirror lenses, with out-of-focus highlights as hollow rings and a busy, low-contrast background; popular with amateurs in the 1970s–80s.

styles.era_origin: Square resin effect-filter systems sold to amateurs and commercial photographers, c. 1975-1990.
visual_markers: sky tinted tobacco-brown, orange, pink or blue by a half-tinted filter
visible straight transition line across the frame
tint spilling onto anything above the line
styles.prompt_fragment: shot with a 1980s square half-tinted colour graduated filter: upper part of the frame tinted tobacco-brown or sunset orange, visible soft straight transition line that also tints anything crossing it, lower half neutral, saturated colour slide film, calendar-postcard composition
styles.avoid: Avoid natural sunset gradients and modern HDR; the tint must look applied and slightly artificial.
styles.feasibility_note: The model may render a natural sunset; describe the artificial straight transition line.
styles.sensitivity_note: Associated with specific filter brands; describe generically.
styles.short_de: Fotos, deren Himmel durch einen halb eingefärbten Steckfilter künstlich tabakbraun, orange oder rosa getönt ist, mit sichtbarer gerader Übergangskante; bei Amateuren etwa 1975–1990 verbreitet.
styles.short_en: Photos with the sky artificially tinted tobacco, orange or pink by a half-coloured square filter with a visible straight transition, common among amateurs c. 1975–1990.
markers_de: Himmel tabakbraun, orange, rosa oder blau getönt
Tönung greift auf Objekte oberhalb der Linie über
markers_en: sky tinted tobacco, orange, pink or blue
tint spilling onto objects above the line
styles.sensitivity_de: Mit bestimmten Filtermarken verbunden; den Effekt allgemein beschreiben.
styles.sensitivity_en: Associated with specific filter brands; describe the effect generically.

styles.era_origin: Laser holography from the 1960s; rainbow and reflection display holograms popular in the 1970s-80s.
visual_markers: ghostly monochrome image floating in a dark glass or film plate
image appears behind or in front of the surface
styles.prompt_fragment: photographed as a display hologram: subject floating as a ghostly monochrome green-gold image inside a dark glass plate, rainbow colour shift toward the edges, faint laser speckle and interference shimmer, image appearing to hover behind the surface, plate edge and black mount visible, dim gallery light
styles.avoid: Avoid iridescent foil gradients and sci-fi blue projected holograms; this is the real physical plate.
styles.feasibility_note: The model leans toward sci-fi blue projections; specify glass plate and monochrome green-gold.
styles.short_de: Geisterhaftes, einfarbiges oder regenbogenartig changierendes Bild, das in einer Glas- oder Filmplatte schwebt, mit Laser-Speckle; typisch für Display-Hologramme der 1970er und 80er.
styles.short_en: Ghostly monochrome or rainbow-shifting image floating inside a glass or film plate, with laser speckle; typical of display holograms of the 1970s and 80s.
markers_de: grüne, goldene oder regenbogenartig wechselnde Farbe
Bild vor oder hinter der Oberfläche
markers_en: ghostly image floating in a glass plate
image in front of or behind the surface

styles.era_origin: Earth-observation satellites from 1972 onward.
visual_markers: pixel texture, swath edges or cloud shadows
styles.prompt_fragment: rendered as a multispectral false-colour satellite image: strict nadir top-down view, near-infrared composite where vegetation glows red-magenta, water appears near-black, built areas cyan-grey, crisp coarse pixel texture, slight swath edge and thin cloud shadows
styles.avoid: Avoid natural-colour drone aerials and map labels; the colours must follow the false-colour infrared mapping.
styles.feasibility_note: Top-down structure works; adherence to the false-colour mapping varies.
styles.sensitivity_note: Satellite programme names are descriptors only; no agency logos.
styles.short_de: Multispektrale Satellitenbilder in Draufsicht, in denen dank Nahinfrarot Vegetation rot, Wasser schwarz und Städte cyangrau erscheinen; Standard der Fernerkundung seit dem ersten Landsat 1972.
styles.short_en: Top-down multispectral satellite images in which near-infrared turns vegetation red, water black and cities cyan-grey; a remote-sensing standard since the first Landsat in 1972.
markers_en: pixel texture, swath edges, cloud shadows
styles.sensitivity_de: Namen von Satellitenprogrammen nur beschreibend verwenden; keine Logos von Raumfahrtbehörden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Use satellite programme names only as descriptors; no agency logos.

styles.era_origin: Marine survey sonar from the 1960s; familiar from shipwreck discoveries.
visual_markers: monochrome amber-brown or grey acoustic image
dark empty strip down the centre
styles.prompt_fragment: rendered as a side-scan sonar record: monochrome amber-brown acoustic image of the subject lying on a grainy seabed, dark empty water-column strip down the centre, long black acoustic shadows cast sideways, speckled texture, faint range scale lines and track markings
styles.avoid: Avoid photographic underwater colour and 3D renders; it must read as an acoustic scan.
styles.feasibility_note: Rarely rendered accurately; shadow geometry and centre strip need explicit wording.
styles.short_de: Einfarbiges bernsteinbraunes oder graues Schallbild des Meeresbodens mit dunklem Mittelstreifen und langen seitlichen Schatten, aus der Meeresvermessung mit Sonar seit den 1960ern.
styles.short_en: Monochrome amber or grey acoustic image of the seabed with a dark centre strip and long sideways shadows, from marine survey sonar used since the 1960s.
markers_de: dunkler leerer Streifen in der Mitte
markers_en: dark empty strip down the centre

styles.era_origin: Medical and industrial fibre-optic and video endoscopy since the 1960s; cheap USB inspection cameras since the 2010s.
visual_markers: circular image inside a black surround
ring of LED hotspots on glossy surfaces
styles.prompt_fragment: viewed through a borescope inspection camera: circular image inside a black surround, ring-light hotspots on glossy surfaces, extreme barrel distortion, cramped tight space, low-resolution video grain and colour noise, small white timestamp and scale text in a corner
styles.avoid: Avoid clinical gore and sci-fi styling; keep it a mundane inspection feed.
styles.feasibility_note: Circular frame and ring light render well; scale of the cramped space varies.
styles.sensitivity_note: Medical endoscopy can be graphic; prefer industrial inspection contexts.
styles.short_de: Kreisrundes, stark verzerrtes Bild einer Inspektionskamera mit LED-Lichtring-Reflexen, Videorauschen und Zeitstempel; im Einsatz seit den 1960ern, als billige USB-Kamera seit den 2010ern.
styles.short_en: Circular, heavily distorted view from an inspection camera with a ring of LED hotspots, video noise and timestamp; in use since the 1960s, cheap since the 2010s.
styles.era_de: seit den 1960ern; USB-Kameras für Endverbraucher seit den 2010ern
styles.era_en: Since the 1960s; consumer USB cameras since the 2010s
markers_en: circular image in a black surround
styles.sensitivity_de: Medizinische Endoskopie kann drastisch wirken; besser technische Inspektionsmotive wählen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Medical endoscopy can be graphic; prefer industrial inspection contexts.

styles.era_origin: Electron microscopy of ultrathin biological and material sections from the 1950s onward.
visual_markers: flat greyscale cross-section rather than 3D surface
dark stained membranes and dense granules
uneven staining and knife chatter lines
styles.prompt_fragment: rendered as a transmission electron micrograph of an ultrathin section: flat greyscale cross-section, dark heavy-metal-stained membranes and dense granules against a pale granular ground, scale bar and plate number in a corner, slight uneven stain and knife chatter lines
styles.avoid: Avoid the 3D surface relief and colourised false colour of SEM images.
styles.feasibility_note: Greyscale section texture works; the model may slip back into SEM relief.
styles.short_de: Flache Graustufen-Querschnitte durch Zellen oder Materialien mit dunkel kontrastierten Membranen und Granula, Maßstab und Tafelnummer; Elektronenmikroskopie an Ultradünnschnitten seit den 1950ern.
styles.short_en: Flat greyscale cross-sections of cells or materials with dark stained membranes and granules, scale bar and plate number, from electron microscopy of ultrathin sections since the 1950s.
markers_de: ungleichmäßige Kontrastierung und Rattermarken vom Schneiden

styles.era_origin: Scientific, forensic and botanical UV photography since the early 20th century.
styles.prompt_fragment: captured in reflected ultraviolet light: near-monochrome violet-grey tonality, skin freckles and pigmentation dramatically darkened, sunscreen and some fabrics appearing black, hidden UV patterns visible on petals, slight softness from a quartz lens, flat clinical lighting
styles.avoid: Avoid glowing blacklight fluorescence colours; this is reflected UV, not fluorescence.
styles.feasibility_note: The model often confuses it with blacklight fluorescence; emphasise monochrome violet-grey.
styles.short_de: Fast monochrome violettgraue Aufnahmen im reflektierten UV-Licht, in denen Sommersprossen dunkler werden, Sonnencreme schwarz erscheint und Blüten verborgene Saftmale zeigen; wissenschaftlich genutzt seit dem frühen 20. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Near-monochrome violet-grey photos taken in reflected ultraviolet, where freckles darken, sunscreen turns black and flowers show hidden nectar guides; scientific practice since the early 20th century.
styles.era_de: seit dem frühen 20. Jh., Wissenschaft und Forensik
styles.era_en: Since the early 20th century, science and forensics

styles.era_origin: Engineering stress-analysis method from the early 20th century.
styles.prompt_fragment: photographed between crossed polarising filters on a light table: transparent forms filled with vivid rainbow isochromatic fringe bands following internal stress lines, black background, concentric contour-like colour ripples, sharp laboratory documentation style
styles.avoid: Avoid generic iridescent gradients; the colour bands must follow internal stress contours.
styles.feasibility_note: Rainbow fringes render well; physically plausible contours less so.
styles.short_de: Transparente Formen zwischen gekreuzten Polarisationsfiltern, durchzogen von regenbogenfarbigen Streifen, die innere Spannungen nachzeichnen, vor schwarzem Grund; Ingenieursverfahren seit dem frühen 20. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Transparent forms photographed between crossed polarisers, filled with rainbow fringe bands that trace internal stress on a black ground; an engineering method since the early 20th century.

styles.era_origin: Popular in North America and Europe c. 1860-1920: faint enlargements from small photos overdrawn in charcoal, pastel and airbrush.
visual_markers: smoothed airbrushed skin and sharpened drawn eyes
visible charcoal and stump strokes on clothing and hair
oval vignette fading to cream paper
styles.prompt_fragment: presented as a 19th-century crayon portrait: faint photographic enlargement heavily overdrawn with charcoal and pastel, soft airbrushed skin, sharpened drawn eyes, oval vignette fading into cream paper, visible stump and charcoal strokes on clothing, slightly uncanny idealised stare
styles.avoid: Avoid crisp photographic detail and albumen sepia texture; the drawn-over softness defines it.
styles.feasibility_note: Hybrid photo-drawing look works; may drift into pure charcoal drawing.
styles.short_de: Große, weiche Brustbildporträts auf Basis blasser Fotovergrößerungen, mit Kohle, Pastell und Airbrush überzeichnet, mit gezeichneten Augen und ovaler Vignette; beliebt etwa 1860–1920.
styles.short_en: Large soft bust portraits made from faint photographic enlargements overdrawn in charcoal, pastel and airbrush, with drawn eyes and an oval vignette; popular c. 1860–1920.
markers_de: ovale Vignette, die ins cremefarbene Papier ausläuft
markers_en: oval vignette fading to cream paper

styles.era_origin: East German colour negative and slide film from Wolfen, 1960s-1990.
visual_markers: dull brick reds and brownish skin tones
small print with yellowed white border
styles.prompt_fragment: photographed on 1970s East German colour negative film: muted greenish-yellow balance, dull brick reds, brownish skin tones, low saturation and soft contrast, coarse grain, faded small-format print with a slightly yellowed white border
styles.avoid: Avoid warm saturated Western consumer film and the magenta cast of faded American prints.
styles.feasibility_note: The muted green cast works; the model may over-warm it.
styles.sensitivity_note: Brand name used as period descriptor; avoid political propaganda clichés.
styles.short_de: Gedämpfte Farbfotos mit grünlich-gelbem Stich, matten Rottönen, weichem Kontrast und grobem Korn, typisch für DDR-Farbfilm aus Wolfen von den 1960ern bis in die 1990er.
styles.short_en: Muted colour photos with a greenish-yellow cast, dull reds, soft contrast and coarse grain, typical of East German colour film from Wolfen between the 1960s and 1990s.
markers_de: kleiner Abzug mit vergilbtem weißem Rand
markers_en: small print with yellowed white border
styles.sensitivity_de: Markenname nur als Epochenbezeichnung; Propagandaklischees vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Brand name used only as a period descriptor; avoid political propaganda clichés.

styles.era_origin: Decades-long ageing of silver gelatin and albumen paper prints.
visual_markers: white crease lines cracking the emulsion
brown foxing spots and water tide lines
bluish metallic silver mirroring at dark edges
styles.prompt_fragment: presented as a physically damaged old photographic print: white crease lines cracking the emulsion, brown foxing spots, tide-line water stains, bluish metallic silver mirroring in the shadows near the edges, dog-eared torn corner, yellowed fading paper, flatbed scan
styles.avoid: Avoid film-emulsion decay and digital scratch overlays; the damage is to a paper print.
styles.feasibility_note: Creases and stains render convincingly; silver mirroring less consistently.
styles.short_de: Alterungsschäden an Fotoabzügen des 19. und 20. Jahrhunderts: weiße Knickbrüche, braune Stockflecken, Wasserränder, bläulicher Silberspiegel und eingerissene Ecken.
styles.short_en: Ageing damage on 19th- and 20th-century paper photo prints: white crease cracks, brown foxing, water tide lines, bluish silver mirroring and torn corners.
markers_en: white crease lines in the emulsion
brown foxing and water tide lines
bluish silver mirroring at dark edges

styles.era_origin: Glossy colour-photograph postcards printed c. 1939-1970s, succeeding linen postcards.
visual_markers: glossy saturated colour with intensified blue sky
styles.prompt_fragment: printed as a mid-century chrome postcard: glossy offset colour photograph with intensified cyan-blue sky and saturated reds, retouched clean surfaces, thin white border, cheerful script caption overprinted in a corner, crisp halftone sharpness, tourist-brochure composition
styles.avoid: Avoid the matte textured look of linen postcards and the soft pastel of 1890s Photochrom prints.
styles.feasibility_note: Saturated postcard colour and border render well; caption text may garble.
styles.short_de: Glänzende Ansichtskarten nach Farbfotos mit verstärktem Himmelblau, satten Rottönen, retuschierten Flächen und schmalem weißem Rand; verbreitet ab 1939 bis in die 1970er.
styles.short_en: Glossy postcards printed from colour photographs, with intensified blue skies, saturated reds, retouched surfaces and a thin white border; common from 1939 into the 1970s.
markers_de: glänzende, satte Farben mit verstärktem Himmelblau
markers_en: glossy saturated colour, intensified blue sky

styles.era_origin: Album pages made by aristocratic British women in the 1860s-70s.
visual_markers: small cut-out photographic heads and figures
pasted into hand-painted watercolour scenes or ornamental frames
sepia albumen cut-outs against bright watercolour
styles.prompt_fragment: assembled as a Victorian photocollage album page: small sepia albumen photo cut-outs pasted into delicate hand-painted watercolour scenes and ornamental borders, whimsical scale shifts, figures placed inside fanciful frames, gilt-edged album paper, faint foxing
styles.avoid: Avoid harsh Dada photomontage and modern scrapbook stickers; keep it genteel, watercolour and sepia.
styles.feasibility_note: Combining sepia cut-outs and watercolour works; small faces may lose detail.
styles.short_de: Albumseiten, auf denen ausgeschnittene Porträtfotos in handgemalte Aquarellszenen und Zierrahmen geklebt sind; angefertigt von britischen Aristokratinnen in den 1860er- und 1870er-Jahren.
styles.short_en: Album pages where small cut-out photographs of heads and figures are pasted into hand-painted watercolour scenes, made by aristocratic British women in the 1860s–70s.
markers_en: sepia albumen prints against bright colour

styles.era_origin: Mixed-media photographic practice, popular in contemporary photo art and craft.
visual_markers: strips woven over-under into a checker grid
visible paper edges and relief shadows
styles.prompt_fragment: made as a woven photograph: two prints cut into thin vertical and horizontal strips and hand-woven over-under into a checkerboard, alternating image fragments, visible paper edges, slight relief shadows, glossy print sheen, photographed flat
styles.avoid: Avoid digital grid glitch effects; the physical weave must be visible.
styles.feasibility_note: The weave renders well; keeping two coherent source images is harder.
styles.short_de: Fotoabzüge werden in Streifen geschnitten und im Wechsel über- und untereinander zu einem Schachbrett verflochten, sodass zwei Bilder ineinandergreifen; Mischtechnik aus Fotokunst und Bastelpraxis der Gegenwart.
styles.short_en: Photographic prints cut into strips and woven over and under into a checkerboard so that two images interlock; a mixed-media technique of contemporary photo art and craft.
markers_en: visible paper edges with slight relief shadows

styles.era_origin: Optical toy invented 1832-33; printed discs sold throughout the 19th century.
visual_markers: subject repeated in sequential motion phases around the ring
radial arrangement with slight phase changes
styles.prompt_fragment: designed as a Victorian phenakistiscope disc: circular card with evenly spaced radial viewing slots at the rim, the subject repeated in a ring of sequential motion phases, hand-coloured lithograph printing, delicate engraved line, aged cream paper with handling wear
styles.avoid: Avoid mandala symmetry with identical copies; each phase must differ slightly.

styles.era_origin: Developed in 1960s-80s automotive advertising with giant overhead light banks; still the standard for vehicle launch imagery.
visual_markers: long continuous gradient reflections tracing body curves
dark or grey seamless infinity cove
styles.prompt_fragment: automotive studio photography, subject on a seamless dark infinity cove, enormous overhead softbox creating long continuous gradient reflections that trace every curve, crisp strip-light highlights, deep controlled shadows, glossy floor reflection, low three-quarter camera angle, immaculate retouching, high-end launch-campaign polish
styles.avoid: Avoid outdoor sunsets, lens flares and motion blur; the look lives entirely from sculpted studio reflections on a dark cove.
styles.feasibility_note: Reflections render convincingly; matte or organic subjects need to be given a glossy surface to read correctly.
styles.short_de: Fahrzeuge auf dunkler Hohlkehle unter riesigen Flächenleuchten an der Decke, die lange Verlaufsreflexe über die Karosserie ziehen; Standard der Autowerbung, entwickelt in den 1960er bis 1980er Jahren.
styles.short_en: Vehicles shot on a dark infinity cove under huge overhead light banks that draw long gradient reflections along the bodywork; car advertising since the 1960s–80s.
markers_en: long gradient reflections tracing body curves
dark or grey seamless infinity cove

styles.era_origin: Amateur sighting photos of the 1950s-1970s, later imitated by tabloids and internet hoaxes.
visual_markers: coarse grain, faded colour or murky B&W
styles.prompt_fragment: amateur 'evidence' snapshot of an unexplained sighting, the main subject small, distant and ambiguous, motion blurred and slightly out of focus, coarse grain, faded 1960s-70s print colours or murky black and white, tilted horizon over ordinary scenery, accidental framing, marked by a hand-drawn circle
styles.avoid: Avoid sharp, centred, well-lit subjects; ambiguity and poor technique are the point.
styles.feasibility_note: The model tends to render the subject too clearly; insist on distance and blur.
styles.short_de: Amateurschnappschuss einer angeblichen Sichtung: kleines, fernes, verwischtes Objekt über alltäglicher Landschaft, körnig und schief; Fotos der 1950er bis 1970er, später von Boulevardpresse und Internet-Fakes kopiert.
styles.short_en: Amateur snapshot of a supposed sighting: a small, distant, blurred object over ordinary scenery, grainy and badly framed; 1950s–70s photos, later copied by tabloids and online hoaxes.
styles.era_de: 1950er–1970er, v. a. USA und Großbritannien; später Boulevard und Internet
styles.era_en: 1950s–1970s, mainly USA and Britain; later tabloids and internet
markers_de: grobes Korn, verblasste Farben oder trübes Schwarzweiß
markers_en: coarse grain, faded colour or murky black and white

Schlieren und Flecken auf dem Glas

smudges and specks on the glass

scrolling chat column of coloured usernames

curly gold-gradient script with drop shadow

curly gold-gradient script with drop shadow

styles.era_origin: Computer molecular graphics since the 1970s; ribbon conventions codified in 1981; a journal-cover staple since the 1990s.
visual_markers: coiled helix ribbons and flat arrow strands
glossy space-filling atom spheres in red, blue and white
semi-transparent surface envelope on plain ground
styles.prompt_fragment: structural-biology molecular graphics, forms built from coiled helix ribbons, flat arrow-shaped strands and loops, rainbow gradient colouring along the chain, clusters of glossy space-filling atom spheres in red, blue and white, soft ambient-occlusion shading, semi-transparent surface envelope, plain black or white background
styles.avoid: Avoid sci-fi glow and generic DNA-helix stock imagery; follow the sober conventions of scientific visualisation software.
styles.feasibility_note: The visual vocabulary renders well, but the structures are not chemically real.
styles.short_de: Computerdarstellungen von Proteinen als gewundene Helixbänder und Pfeilstränge, mit glänzenden Atomkugeln und weicher Schattierung; Molekülgrafik seit den 1970ern, Bändermodell seit 1981.

styles.era_en: Since the 1970s; ribbon diagrams since 1981, USA

small auto, skip and save buttons

styles.prompt_fragment: rendered as a folded-paper inkblot: mirror-symmetrical black ink stains pressed between paper halves, feathered capillary edges, pooled dense centres, small satellite droplets, a few added fine pen lines, off-white laid paper with visible fold crease down the middle
styles.avoid: Avoid clean vector symmetry or digital mirroring; the blot must look wet, accidental and slightly uneven.
styles.feasibility_note: Symmetry and fold crease hold; the model tends to make blots too tidy or too illustrative.
styles.short_de: Spiegelsymmetrische Tintenkleckse, durch Falten des Papiers entstanden und mit wenigen Federstrichen zu Figuren ergänzt; ab 1857 von Justinus Kerner in Deutschland gepflegt, später Anregung für den Rorschach-Test.
styles.short_en: Mirror-symmetrical blots from folded paper, sometimes turned into figures with pen lines; made by Justinus Kerner in Germany from 1857, later inspiring the Rorschach test.

schwarze oder Sepiatinte auf gebrochen weißem Papier
markers_en: mirror-symmetrical ink blots from folded paper
occasional pen lines turning blots into figures
black or sepia ink on off-white paper

styles.era_origin: Victorian parlour craft and staple of German school art classes, also 1920s poster backgrounds.
visual_markers: fine speckled dot gradients from flicked bristles
styles.prompt_fragment: made with spatter-stencil technique: paint flicked through a sieve with a toothbrush over cut paper masks, fine irregular speckle gradients thickening toward the edges, crisp blank silhouettes where masks lay, occasional larger droplets, two or three ink colours on matte card
styles.avoid: Avoid smooth airbrush gradients or spray-can street-art drips; the dots must be visible, coarse and random.
styles.feasibility_note: Speckle texture renders; the model may substitute airbrush smoothness.
styles.short_de: Mit Zahnbürste und Sieb über Papierschablonen gespritzte Farbe, die feine Sprenkelverläufe um scharf ausgesparte Silhouetten bildet; viktorianisches Salonhandwerk und Klassiker im Kunstunterricht.
styles.short_en: Paint flicked through a sieve with a toothbrush over paper masks, leaving fine speckle gradients around crisp blank silhouettes; a Victorian parlour craft and a school art-class staple.
styles.era_de: seit dem 19. Jh., Großbritannien und USA; später Schulkunst
styles.era_en: since the 19th century, Britain and USA; later school art
markers_en: fine speckled dot gradients from flicked bristles

styles.era_origin: Letterpress and screen-print trick, prominent in 1960s-70s posters and later gig posters.
visual_markers: smooth ink blend between two or three colours across the sheet
flat solid shapes carrying the gradient
slight streaking along the roller direction
styles.prompt_fragment: printed with a split-fountain rainbow roll: one pass of blended inks fading horizontally from one colour to another across every solid shape, slight roller streaks, uneven ink density, flat graphic forms, uncoated poster stock, faint misregistration with a second spot colour
styles.avoid: Avoid digital linear gradients and glossy finish; the blend should look mechanical, streaky and the same across every printed shape.
styles.feasibility_note: Model renders gradients easily but often too smooth and per-object instead of one continuous blend.
styles.short_de: Ein Druckgang, in dem zwei oder drei Farben auf der Walze ineinanderlaufen, sodass alle Flächen denselben streifigen Verlauf tragen; verbreitet in Plakaten der 1960er und 1970er.
styles.short_en: One print pass with two or three inks blending on the roller, so every solid shape carries the same streaky gradient; common in 1960s–70s posters and gig posters.
styles.era_de: Buch- und Siebdruck; prägend in den 1960ern–1970ern, später Gigposter
styles.era_en: letterpress and screen print; prominent in the 1960s–1970s, later gig posters
markers_de: weicher Verlauf zwischen zwei oder drei Farben über den ganzen Bogen
flache Vollflächen, die den Verlauf tragen
markers_en: smooth ink blend between two or three colours across the sheet
flat solid shapes carrying the gradient
slight streaking along the roller direction

styles.era_origin: Developed in the 1850s-1860s and used for fine art reproductions and postcards until the mid-20th century.
visual_markers: cream art paper with platemark-free edges
styles.prompt_fragment: reproduced as an early-20th-century collotype: screenless continuous-tone print with fine worm-like reticulated grain, soft velvety warm blacks, gentle highlight bloom, subtle uneven ink transfer, printed on thick cream art paper with a narrow white margin and small printed caption
styles.avoid: Avoid halftone dots and sharp digital contrast; tones must be grainy but continuous.
styles.feasibility_note: The reticulation grain is too subtle for reliable control; results drift toward generic sepia photo.
styles.short_de: Rasterloser Halbtondruck von Gelatineplatten mit feinem, wurmartigem Runzelkorn und samtigen Schwarztönen; 1855 erfunden und bis Mitte des 20. Jh. für Kunstreproduktionen und Ansichtskarten genutzt.
styles.short_en: Screenless continuous-tone print from gelatine plates with fine worm-like reticulation grain and velvety blacks; invented in 1855, used for art reproductions and postcards until the mid-20th century.
markers_en: cream art paper with platemark-free edges

styles.era_origin: Standard pre-digital print production from the 1950s to the early 1990s.
visual_markers: galley type strips waxed onto illustration board
non-repro blue crop marks and notes
red Rubylith masking film and tissue overlay
dry-transfer letters, tape and cut edges
styles.prompt_fragment: shown as a pre-digital paste-up mechanical: waxed galley type strips and halftone stats glued on white illustration board, non-repro blue pencil guides and handwritten printer notes, crop and registration marks, red masking film overlay, dry-transfer lettering, slight shadows at cut paper edges
styles.avoid: Avoid a finished printed look or a digital mockup; seams, wax, tape and production notes must stay visible.
styles.feasibility_note: Board, overlays and marks render; small type and notes will be gibberish.
styles.sensitivity_note: Letraset is a brand name and is used only as an alias.
styles.short_de: Druckvorlage aus aufgeklebten Satzstreifen und Bildabzügen auf weißem Karton, mit blauen Hilfslinien, Passkreuzen, roter Maskierfolie und Anreibebuchstaben; Standard der Druckvorstufe von den 1950ern bis Anfang der 1990er.
styles.short_en: Camera-ready board with waxed-down galleys and halftone stats, non-repro blue guides, registration marks, red masking film and dry-transfer letters; standard prepress from the 1950s to the early 1990s.
markers_de: nicht reproduzierbare blaue Hilfslinien und Notizen
markers_en: galley type strips waxed onto illustration board
non-repro blue crop marks and notes
red masking film and tissue overlay
dry-transfer letters, tape and cut edges

styles.sensitivity_en: Letraset is a brand name and appears only as an alias.

styles.era_origin: 18th-century English luxury wallpaper, revived in Victorian interiors and 1970s pubs and restaurants.
visual_markers: raised velvety pile pattern on a smooth ground
matte fuzzy surface catching side light
styles.prompt_fragment: executed as flocked wallpaper: raised velvety fibre pile forming a symmetrical damask repeat on a smooth satin ground, soft fuzzy edges, raking light revealing the relief, deep crimson on gold, slight seam joins and wear on the pile
styles.avoid: Avoid flat printed damask; the motif must have tactile velvet relief.
styles.feasibility_note: Relief and pile render; complex motifs collapse into generic damask.
styles.short_de: Tapete mit erhabenem, samtigem Faserflor als symmetrisches Damastmuster, meist in Rot, Gold oder Grün; englische Luxustapete des 18. Jh., später in viktorianischen Salons und 1970er-Kneipen.
styles.short_en: Wallpaper with a raised velvety fibre pile forming a symmetrical damask repeat, mostly in reds, golds and greens; 18th-century English luxury, later Victorian parlours and 1970s pubs.
styles.era_de: 18. Jh., England; Revival im 19. Jh. und in den 1970ern
styles.era_en: 18th century, England; revived in the 19th century and the 1970s

matte fuzzy surface catching side light

styles.era_origin: English 17th-century raised embroidery, revived in contemporary needlework.
visual_markers: silk, metal thread and seed pearls
styles.prompt_fragment: made as stumpwork raised embroidery: padded satin-stitched forms standing off the silk ground, detached wired needlelace petals and wings, couched metal thread outlines, seed pearls and tiny beads, naive 17th-century scale shifts, soft directional light casting stitch shadows
styles.avoid: Avoid flat embroidery or felt toys; the relief must be stitched and sculptural on fabric.
styles.feasibility_note: Relief renders convincingly; fine needlelace detail softens.
styles.short_de: Reliefstickerei mit gepolsterten, plastischen Formen, drahtverstärkten frei stehenden Blüten und Flügeln, Metallfaden und Saatperlen in naiver Komposition; England im 17. Jahrhundert, heute wiederbelebt.
styles.short_en: Raised embroidery with padded sculptural forms, wired free-standing petals and wings, metal thread and seed pearls in naive compositions; 17th-century England, revived in contemporary needlework.
markers_de: drahtverstärkte, frei stehende Blüten und Flügel
markers_en: silk, metal thread and seed pearls

styles.era_origin: Tudor England, associated with 16th-century linen shirts and coifs.
visual_markers: black silk geometric fill patterns on white linen
styles.prompt_fragment: worked in Tudor blackwork embroidery: black silk thread on even-weave white linen, outlines in double-running stitch, areas filled with repeating geometric diaper patterns of varying density to create shading, crisp counted grid, slight linen slub
styles.avoid: Avoid blackwork tattoo ink and cross-stitch pixels; it is linear thread geometry on cloth.
styles.feasibility_note: Fill patterns render; counted precision varies.
styles.short_de: Schwarze Seidenstickerei auf weißem Leinen mit Konturen im Holbeinstich und geometrischen Füllmustern, deren Dichte Schatten erzeugt; Tudor-England, 16. Jahrhundert, auf Hemden und Hauben.
styles.short_en: Black silk embroidery on white linen with double-running outlines and geometric fill patterns whose density creates shading; Tudor England, 16th century, on shirts and coifs.
markers_de: schwarze geometrische Füllmuster in Seide auf weißem Leinen
markers_en: black silk geometric fill patterns on white linen

styles.era_origin: Popular in late-19th-century American and British households using colourfast Turkey-red thread.
styles.prompt_fragment: stitched as redwork embroidery: simple outlines in colourfast Turkey-red cotton thread using stem stitch and backstitch only, no fills, on bleached white muslin, faint pencil transfer lines, slight puckering in the hoop, quilt-block framing
styles.avoid: Avoid coloured fills or printed red lines; only thin stitched outlines.
styles.feasibility_note: Simple outline stitching holds well.
styles.short_de: Reine Konturstickerei in farbechtem türkischrotem Garn, nur Stiel- und Rückstich, ohne Füllungen, auf weißem Baumwollstoff; Haushalte in den USA und Großbritannien im späten 19. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Outline-only embroidery in colourfast Turkey-red thread, stem and backstitch with no fills, on white cotton; popular in American and British households of the late 19th century.

styles.era_origin: Berlin woolwork charts swept Europe in the 1830s-70s; needlepoint is still a domestic craft.
visual_markers: dense slanted tent stitches covering the canvas
stepped pixel-like edges at an angle
styles.prompt_fragment: worked as needlepoint: every area covered in small slanted wool tent stitches on stiff canvas, slightly stepped diagonal edges, fuzzy wool fibres, saturated crimson, magenta and green Victorian aniline dyes, worked on a frame with exposed canvas at margins
styles.avoid: Avoid cross-stitch X stitches on a visible fabric ground; needlepoint covers the canvas fully with slanted stitches.
styles.feasibility_note: Often confused with cross-stitch by the model.
styles.short_de: Stickerei, die den steifen Stramin vollständig mit kleinen schrägen Wollstichen bedeckt, mit treppigen Kanten und kräftigen Farben; als Berliner Wollstickerei nach Vorlagen etwa 1830–1875 in Mode.
styles.short_en: Embroidery covering stiff canvas entirely with small slanted wool tent stitches, giving stepped edges and strong colours; fashionable as Berlin woolwork from charts, c. 1830–1875.
styles.era_de: Berliner Wollstickerei ca. 1830–1875, Europa und USA; bis heute Handarbeit
styles.era_en: Berlin woolwork c. 1830–1875, Europe and USA; still a domestic craft
markers_de: dichte schräge Gobelinstiche, die den Stramin bedecken
markers_en: dense slanted tent stitches covering the canvas
stepped pixel-like edges at an angle

styles.era_origin: Late-Victorian fashion of the 1880s, using silk and velvet scraps.
visual_markers: embroidered feather stitch along every seam
embroidered motifs and initials on patches
styles.prompt_fragment: pieced as a Victorian crazy quilt: irregular angular scraps of velvet, silk, satin and brocade, every seam covered with decorative feather, herringbone and chain stitches in gold and coloured silk, small embroidered flowers, fans and initials, rich jewel tones, worn sheen
styles.avoid: Avoid geometric block patchwork; shapes must be random and seams embroidered.
styles.feasibility_note: Patch randomness holds; embroidery on seams sometimes omitted.
styles.short_de: Patchwork aus unregelmäßigen, schiefwinkligen Resten von Samt, Seide und Brokat, jede Naht mit Zierstichen bestickt, dazu kleine Motive und Initialen; spätviktorianische Mode der 1880er.
styles.short_en: Patchwork of irregular, angular scraps of velvet, silk and brocade, every seam covered in decorative stitches, plus small embroidered motifs and initials; a late-Victorian fashion of the 1880s.
markers_de: Reste von Samt, Seide und Brokat
gestickte Motive und Initialen auf den Flicken
markers_en: embroidered feather stitch along every seam
embroidered motifs and initials on patches

styles.era_origin: Popular from the late 19th century, iconic in 1970s blankets and revived in 2020s fashion.
styles.prompt_fragment: crocheted from granny squares: concentric rounds of treble-stitch clusters in mismatched bright acrylic yarns, open lacy holes, squares joined by cream or black borders, slight stretching and skewing, fuzzy yarn fibres, flat-lay textile view
styles.avoid: Avoid amigurumi figures or knitted stockinette; it should be flat crochet squares with holes.
styles.feasibility_note: Well known in training data; stitch structure renders reliably.
styles.short_de: Gehäkelte Quadrate aus konzentrischen Runden von Stäbchengruppen in bunt gemischten Garnen mit offenen Löchern; seit dem späten 19. Jh., Hochphase in den 1970ern, Revival in den 2020ern.
styles.short_en: Crochet squares of concentric treble-cluster rounds in mismatched bright yarns with open holes; since the late 19th century, peaking in the 1970s and revived in the 2020s.

styles.era_origin: Lucknow white-on-white embroidery associated with the Mughal period.
visual_markers: white thread on fine white muslin
styles.prompt_fragment: worked as chikankari: white cotton thread on sheer white muslin, shadow-work stitches glowing through from the back, delicate floral vines and paisleys, tiny raised knots, small openwork eyelets, backlit to show translucency
styles.avoid: Avoid coloured threads and heavy embroidery; it must be white, translucent and delicate.
styles.feasibility_note: White-on-white contrast is hard; it works best backlit.
styles.sensitivity_note: Credit the Lucknow artisan tradition.
styles.short_de: Weißstickerei mit weißem Baumwollgarn auf feinem weißem Musselin, mit durchscheinendem Schattenstich, zarten Blütenranken, Knötchen und Lochmustern; aus Lucknow, auf die Mogulzeit zurückgeführt.
styles.short_en: White cotton embroidery on fine white muslin with shadow-work glowing through, delicate floral vines, tiny knots and eyelets; from Lucknow, traced back to the Mughal period.
styles.era_en: Mughal period, Lucknow (India); living craft tradition
markers_de: weißes Garn auf feinem weißem Musselin

styles.era_origin: Gujarat and Rajasthan resist-dyeing tradition with records going back millennia.
visual_markers: tiny white dots in patterned clusters
dots arranged in waves, circles and figures
styles.prompt_fragment: dyed as bandhani: thousands of tiny bound-resist dots with soft blurred square-ish edges forming circles, waves and figures on deep crimson, maroon or saffron cloth, slight colour bleed, crinkled cloth texture from tying
styles.avoid: Avoid hippie spiral tie-dye or printed polka dots; the dots must be bound-resist and form patterns.
styles.feasibility_note: Dot fields render; figurative dot arrangements are less exact.
styles.sensitivity_note: Has bridal and religious significance in Gujarat and Rajasthan.
styles.short_de: Abbindebatik aus tausenden winzigen, weich umrandeten Punkten, die Kreise, Wellen und Figuren auf tiefrotem, kastanienbraunem oder safrangelbem Stoff bilden; Gujarat und Rajasthan, belegt seit dem 6. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Tie-resist textile of thousands of tiny soft-edged dots forming circles, waves and figures on deep red, maroon or saffron cloth; Gujarat and Rajasthan, attested since the 6th century.

Grund in Tiefrot, Kastanienbraun oder Gelb
markers_en: tiny white dots in patterned clusters

deep red, maroon or yellow grounds
styles.sensitivity_de: Bandhani hat in Gujarat und Rajasthan Bedeutung für Hochzeiten und religiöse Anlässe.
styles.sensitivity_en: Bandhani carries bridal and religious significance in Gujarat and Rajasthan.

styles.era_origin: Mathura and Vrindavan temple tradition, flourishing in the 15th-16th centuries.
visual_markers: figures and peacocks in a central field
styles.prompt_fragment: cut as Sanjhi paper stencil art: lace-fine scissor-cut paper with dense floral jali borders, peacocks, lotus and vines around a central scene, cut paper laid over a single colour ground or dusted with coloured powder, slightly irregular hand-cut edges
styles.avoid: Avoid Chinese or Polish papercut symmetry; Sanjhi uses dense filigree with narrative scenes.
styles.feasibility_note: Filigree detail renders; the regional character may drift to generic papercut.
styles.sensitivity_note: Devotional Krishna temple art; avoid irreverent sacred imagery.
styles.short_de: Spitzenfein geschnittene Papierschablonen mit dichten Blütenbordüren, Pfauen und Lotus um eine Mittelszene, zum Streuen von Farbpulver genutzt; Tempelkunst aus Mathura und Vrindavan, Blüte im 15.–16. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Lace-fine hand-cut paper stencils with dense floral borders, peacocks and lotus around a central scene, used to sift coloured powder; temple art of Mathura and Vrindavan, 15th-16th centuries.

styles.sensitivity_en: Devotional Krishna temple art; avoid irreverent use of sacred imagery.

styles.era_origin: Developed in Thai refugee camps in the late 1970s by Hmong women.
visual_markers: dense narrative embroidery of village life
bright thread on dark or blue cloth
styles.prompt_fragment: embroidered as a Hmong story cloth: many small stitched figures, animals and houses arranged in rows across a dark cotton field, bright satin-stitch colours, flat naive perspective, mountains and rivers in bands, appliqué border of triangles
styles.avoid: Avoid single hero subject; it's a dense narrative scene.
styles.feasibility_note: Narrative density renders; stitched texture may flatten.
styles.sensitivity_note: Linked to refugee history; treat it respectfully and do not use it as decoration for conflict scenes.
styles.short_de: Bestickte Tücher mit vielen kleinen Figuren, Tieren und Häusern in Reihen, die von Dorfleben, Krieg und Flucht erzählen; entstanden Ende der 1970er in thailändischen Flüchtlingslagern.
styles.short_en: Embroidered cloths crowded with small figures, animals and houses in rows, telling of village life, war and flight; from Thai refugee camps, late 1970s.

styles.era_en: since the late 1970s, refugee camps in Thailand

Leuchtendes Stickgarn auf dunklem oder blauem Stoff

Bright thread on dark or blue cloth
styles.sensitivity_de: Eng mit der Fluchtgeschichte der Hmong verbunden; respektvoll behandeln und nicht als Dekor für Kriegs- oder Konfliktszenen benutzen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Tied to Hmong refugee history; treat it with respect and do not use it as decoration for conflict scenes.

styles.era_origin: Yoruba tradition in Nigeria, especially Abeokuta and Ibadan from the early 20th century.
visual_markers: indigo cloth with pale cassava-paste resist motifs
grid of squares with varied symbols
deep blue to pale blue contrast
styles.prompt_fragment: dyed as Yoruba adire: deep indigo cotton with pale blue cassava-starch resist patterns painted or stencilled in a grid of squares, each square holding different symbols, lines, dots and spirals, slightly cracked resist, uneven dye depth
styles.avoid: Avoid generic shibori or wax-print colours; it is indigo with starch resist in grid panels.
styles.feasibility_note: Indigo and grid render; motif vocabulary is approximate.
styles.sensitivity_note: Yoruba motifs carry meaning; describe them generically and do not invent meanings.
styles.short_de: Indigogefärbter Baumwollstoff mit hellen Reservemustern aus Maniokstärke, meist in Quadratfelder mit wechselnden Zeichen gegliedert; Färbetradition der Yoruba in Südwest-Nigeria, vor allem Abeokuta und Ibadan.
styles.short_en: Indigo-dyed cotton with pale resist patterns in cassava starch, usually divided into squares of varied symbols; a Yoruba dyeing tradition of south-west Nigeria, chiefly Abeokuta and Ibadan.

Ungleichmäßige Farbtiefe, feine Risse in der Reserve

Grid of squares holding varied symbols
Uneven dye depth, fine cracks in the resist

styles.era_origin: 18th-century 'arte povera' imitation of lacquerwork, revived in craft hobby culture.
visual_markers: printed paper motifs glued onto objects
styles.prompt_fragment: applied as decoupage: cut-out printed paper motifs glued onto a painted surface, sealed under many coats of glossy yellowed varnish, small wrinkles and air bubbles, faint torn napkin edges, crackle-glaze finish, slight sanding at corners
styles.avoid: Avoid crisp collage on flat paper; the paper must be fused onto an object under varnish.
styles.feasibility_note: Varnish and wrinkles render well.
styles.short_de: Ausgeschnittene Papiermotive, auf Möbel oder Gegenstände geklebt und unter vielen Lackschichten versiegelt; aus der venezianischen Lacca povera des 18. Jahrhunderts, heute als Serviettentechnik verbreitet.
styles.short_en: Cut-out paper motifs glued onto furniture or objects and sealed under many coats of varnish; from 18th-century Venetian lacca povera, now a popular napkin-craft hobby.
styles.era_de: seit dem 18. Jh., Venedig; Bastelwelle im 20. Jh.
styles.era_en: since the 18th century, Venice; craft revival in the 20th century

Small wrinkles and visible paper edges

styles.era_origin: Developed in American and European papermaking studios from the 1970s.
visual_markers: image made of coloured pulp fibres
styles.prompt_fragment: made as a pulp painting: coloured paper pulp laid wet into the sheet, soft feathered fibre boundaries between colour areas, embedded flecks and fibres, thick deckled sheet edges, matte fibrous surface, subtle relief where pulp builds up
styles.avoid: Avoid watercolour wash on paper; the image is the paper itself, with soft fibrous edges.
styles.feasibility_note: Fibre texture renders; tends to look like watercolour.
styles.short_de: Bild, das aus nasser, gefärbter Papierpulpe direkt im Bogen entsteht, mit weich ausfransenden Farbgrenzen und faseriger Oberfläche; entwickelt seit den 1970ern in Handpapierwerkstätten der USA und Europas.
styles.short_en: Image formed from wet coloured paper pulp within the sheet itself, with soft feathered colour edges and fibrous surface; developed in hand-papermaking studios since the 1970s.

Soft feathered edges between colour areas
Deckle edges and matte fibrous surface

styles.era_origin: Korean najeonchilgi flourished in the Goryeo period; related to Japanese raden and Chinese inlay.
visual_markers: iridescent shell pieces in black lacquer
fine cut shell and crackle shell areas
styles.prompt_fragment: inlaid as mother-of-pearl lacquerware: iridescent abalone and pearl shell pieces cut into fine shapes and crackled mosaic patches, set into glossy black lacquer, shifting rainbow sheen, thin brass wire lines, polished reflections
styles.avoid: Avoid holographic foil or generic iridescence; the shell must be cut pieces set in lacquer.
styles.feasibility_note: Iridescence renders; fine cut patterns soften.
styles.short_de: Schwarz glänzender Lack mit eingelegten, irisierenden Perlmutt- und Abalone-Stücken, oft Blüten, Ranken und Kraniche; Blüte in Korea unter der Goryeo-Dynastie, verwandt mit japanischem Raden.
styles.short_en: Glossy black lacquer set with cut, iridescent mother-of-pearl and abalone pieces, often flowers, scrolls and cranes; flourished in Goryeo Korea, related to Japanese raden and Chinese inlay.

Finely cut shapes and crackled shell areas

styles.era_origin: Islamic and Toledo tradition of gold and silver inlay on blackened steel.
visual_markers: gold and silver wire inlaid into black steel
styles.prompt_fragment: executed as damascene metalwork: thin gold and silver wire hammered into crosshatched blackened steel, fine arabesque and geometric patterns, gold highlights with engraved detail, deep black ground, small polished reflections
styles.avoid: Avoid gold foil printing; the gold must sit in steel as inlaid wire.
styles.feasibility_note: Gold-on-black renders; inlay depth is subtle.
styles.short_de: Gold- und Silberdraht, in geschwärzten Stahl eingehämmert, bildet feine Arabesken und geometrische Muster; seit der Antike bekannt, geprägt von islamischer Metallkunst und dem Kunsthandwerk Toledos.
styles.short_en: Gold and silver wire hammered into blackened steel, forming fine arabesques and geometric patterns; known since antiquity, shaped by Islamic metalwork and the craft of Toledo.
