markers_en: Gold and silver wire inlaid in black steel
Fine engraved lines on the gold

styles.era_origin: Ancient Roman gem tradition, popularised in shell cameos from 18th-century Italy.
visual_markers: white relief on pink-brown layered shell
styles.prompt_fragment: carved as a shell cameo: creamy white relief cut from layered conch shell on a peach-brown ground, delicate translucent thin edges, fine carving lines, oval gold bezel with rope border, close jewellery light
styles.avoid: Avoid flat silhouettes or plastic; it must be translucent carved shell relief.
styles.feasibility_note: Classic cameo look renders reliably.
styles.short_de: Weißes Relief, aus geschichteter Muschelschale vor rosa- oder braunem Grund geschnitten, meist Profilköpfe im ovalen Goldrahmen; seit der Renaissance, Blütezeit im 18. und 19. Jahrhundert in Italien.
styles.short_en: White relief carved from layered shell against a pink or brown ground, usually profile heads in an oval gold mount; since the Renaissance, flourishing in 18th–19th-century Italy.
styles.era_de: seit dem 15. Jh.; Blüte 18.–19. Jh., Italien (Torre del Greco)
styles.era_en: since the 15th century; peak 18th–19th century, Italy (Torre del Greco)
markers_de: Weißes Relief auf rosa- bis braunem Muschelgrund
markers_en: White relief on pink-brown layered shell

styles.era_origin: European and American engraving on firearms, watches and jewellery from the 16th century.
visual_markers: acanthus scroll cuts in polished steel
styles.prompt_fragment: hand-engraved into polished steel: flowing acanthus scrollwork cut with gravers, fine bulino dot shading for tonal areas, bright cut lines catching light, deep shadowed lines, subtle tarnish and fingerprints on metal
styles.avoid: Avoid paper engraving prints; it must be cut into reflective metal.
styles.feasibility_note: Scrollwork renders; bulino tonal fineness inconsistent.
styles.short_de: Mit dem Stichel in poliertes Metall geschnittene Akanthusranken, Tonwerte durch feine Punkt- und Linienschattierung (Bulino); seit dem 16. Jahrhundert auf Waffen, Uhren und Schmuck.
styles.short_en: Acanthus scrolls cut into polished metal with gravers, tones built from fine dot and line shading (bulino); on firearms, watches and jewellery since the 16th century.
styles.era_de: seit dem 16. Jh., Europa; später auch USA
styles.era_en: since the 16th century, Europe; later also the USA
markers_en: Acanthus scrolls cut into polished steel
Polished bare metal as negative space

styles.era_origin: Limoges workshops from the late 15th century.
visual_markers: grisaille white on deep blue or black
styles.prompt_fragment: painted in Limoges enamel: glassy vitreous colour fired onto copper, grisaille white figures on deep blue-black ground, translucent jewel tones, fine gold highlight lines, glossy convex surface with slight crazing and chips
styles.avoid: Avoid cloisonné wire outlines; colours are painted, not compartmentalized.
styles.feasibility_note: Glassy enamel renders; grisaille subtlety can be lost.
styles.short_de: Glasige Emailfarben, wie ein Gemälde auf Kupfer aufgetragen und gebrannt, oft weiße Grisaille auf tiefblauem oder schwarzem Grund mit Goldhöhungen; Limoges, seit dem späten 15. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Glassy enamel colours painted onto copper and fired, often white grisaille on deep blue or black with gold highlights; Limoges, from the late 15th century.
markers_de: Weiße Grisaille auf tiefblauem oder schwarzem Grund
markers_en: White grisaille on deep blue or black

styles.era_origin: English 17th-century earthenware, also German Malhorn pottery.
visual_markers: trailed slip lines in cream on red-brown clay
styles.prompt_fragment: made as slipware: red earthenware clay decorated with trailed cream and dark slip lines, feathered combing and dots, naive figures and lettering, honey-amber lead glaze, slight runs and kiln marks
styles.avoid: Avoid painted porcelain; it's raised slip on earthenware.
styles.feasibility_note: Slip-trailing texture renders; fine feathering is variable.
styles.short_de: Rotbraune Irdenware, mit dem Malhorn in cremefarbenem und dunklem Schlicker verziert, unter honiggelber Bleiglasur; in England und Mitteleuropa vor allem im 17. und 18. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Red-brown earthenware decorated with trailed cream and dark slip under a honey-coloured lead glaze; chiefly 17th–18th-century England and Central Europe.
markers_en: Trailed cream slip lines on red-brown clay

styles.era_origin: Urbino and Castel Durante workshops of the 1520s-1560s.
visual_markers: narrative scenes painted on tin-glazed plates
styles.prompt_fragment: painted as Renaissance istoriato maiolica: a narrative scene covering a tin-glazed earthenware plate, cobalt blue, ochre, orange and copper green, glossy white glaze, flowing brushwork, slight glaze pooling and chips, curved plate surface
styles.avoid: Avoid Delft blue or Talavera; it is full-colour narrative painting on a plate.
styles.feasibility_note: Plate curvature and palette render; narrative detail is variable.
styles.short_de: Zinnglasierte Teller, deren ganze Fläche eine erzählende Szene aus Mythos, Bibel oder Geschichte in Blau, Ocker, Orange und Grün trägt; Italien, etwa 1500–1570, Zentrum Urbino.
styles.short_en: Tin-glazed plates whose whole surface carries a narrative scene from myth, scripture or history in blue, ochre, orange and green; Italy, c. 1500–1570, centred on Urbino.
markers_de: Erzählende Szene über die ganze Tellerfläche
markers_en: Narrative scene across the whole plate
Cobalt, ochre, orange and copper green

styles.era_origin: Abbasid and Hispano-Moresque ceramics, later Victorian lustreware.
visual_markers: metallic golden or copper iridescent glaze
styles.prompt_fragment: glazed as lustreware: metallic golden and copper lustre painted over cream tin glaze, iridescent sheen shifting from gold to red, dense foliate and geometric patterns, slightly uneven reflective patches, polished curved surfaces
styles.avoid: Avoid chrome or metal objects; it is ceramic with metallic glaze sheen.
styles.feasibility_note: Metallic sheen renders; may look like brass.
styles.short_de: Keramik mit metallisch schimmernder Gold- oder Kupferlüsterbemalung über heller Zinnglasur, oft dichte Ranken; aus dem abbasidischen Irak des 9. Jahrhunderts, später Spanien, Italien und England.
styles.short_en: Ceramics painted with metallic gold or copper lustre over pale tin glaze, often in dense foliage; from 9th-century Abbasid Iraq, later Spain, Italy and England.
styles.era_de: seit dem 9. Jh., Irak; später Spanien, Italien, England
styles.era_en: since the 9th century, Iraq; later Spain, Italy, England
markers_en: Metallic gold or copper lustre glaze
Uneven reflective patches on a pale ground

styles.era_origin: 18th-century Florence (La Specola) and 19th-century medical museums.
styles.prompt_fragment: modelled as a 19th-century wax moulage: translucent coloured wax with glossy moist surface, precise anatomical detail, mounted on black-painted wooden board with handwritten paper label, museum glass reflections, soft archive light
styles.avoid: Avoid glossy CGI anatomy; it must be wax in a museum setting.
styles.feasibility_note: Wax translucency renders; avoid graphic medical gore.
styles.sensitivity_note: Some moulages show disease; keep the result non-graphic.
styles.short_de: Lebensecht bemalte Wachsabformungen von Körperteilen mit Krankheitsbildern, auf schwarzem Holzbrett mit Leinenrand und Etikett; Lehrmittel der Medizin von etwa 1800 bis in die 1950er.
styles.short_en: Lifelike painted wax casts of body parts showing disease, mounted on black boards with linen borders and labels; medical teaching aids from about 1800 to the 1950s.
styles.era_en: c. 1800–1950s, European clinics and teaching collections
markers_en: Black wooden board with white linen border
styles.sensitivity_de: Viele Moulagen zeigen Krankheiten; das Ergebnis nicht drastisch oder blutig gestalten.
styles.sensitivity_en: Many moulages show disease; keep the result non-graphic.

styles.era_origin: Medieval scribal tradition revived by the Arts and Crafts movement.
styles.prompt_fragment: lettered in broad-edge pen calligraphy: thick-thin strokes from a square-cut nib, italic or uncial letterforms, faint pencil guidelines, iron-gall black and vermilion ink on cream paper, slight ink pooling at stroke ends
styles.avoid: Avoid digital fonts or brush script; it must show broad-nib contrast.
styles.feasibility_note: Letterforms render; spelling can be wrong.
styles.short_de: Schrift mit der Breitfeder, die dicke und dünne Striche erzeugt, etwa in Unziale oder Kursive; mittelalterliche Schreibpraxis, um 1900 von Edward Johnston wiederbelebt.
styles.short_en: Lettering with a square-cut nib that gives thick and thin strokes in uncial or italic hands; a medieval scribal practice revived around 1900 by Edward Johnston.
styles.era_de: seit dem Mittelalter; Wiederbelebung um 1900, England
styles.era_en: since the Middle Ages; revived around 1900, England
markers_en: Thick-thin contrast from a broad nib

styles.era_origin: Standardised conventions in 20th-century archaeology.
styles.prompt_fragment: drawn as archaeological illustration: ink line drawings with stippling, objects shown in front view and half-section profile with solid black cut sections, scale bar, catalogue numbers, clean white background, precise technical lettering
styles.avoid: Avoid artistic shading; follow scientific conventions.
styles.feasibility_note: Convention renders; precise sections can drift.
styles.short_de: Exakte Tuschezeichnungen von Funden mit Punktierung, Profilschnitt mit schwarz gefülltem Querschnitt, mehreren Ansichten und Maßstab; Konvention der Archäologie, im 20. Jahrhundert vereinheitlicht.
styles.short_en: Precise ink drawings of finds with stippling, half-section profiles with solid black cuts, several views and a scale bar; archaeological convention standardised in the 20th century.
markers_en: Section profiles with solid black fill

styles.era_origin: 19th-century geological survey plates and textbooks.
styles.prompt_fragment: illustrated as a geological block diagram: layered rock strata in muted colour fills and lithology patterns, faults and folds, 3D cutaway landscape surface, thin labels, legend boxes, hand-coloured survey-plate feel
styles.avoid: Avoid photoreal terrain; it's a schematic cutaway.
styles.feasibility_note: Strata render well; labels unreliable.
styles.short_de: Schematischer Schnitt durch Gesteinsschichten oder dreidimensionales Blockbild mit farbig gekennzeichneten Schichten, Verwerfungen und Legende; aus geologischen Landesaufnahmen und Lehrbüchern seit dem 19. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Schematic cut through rock strata or a 3D block view with colour-coded layers, faults and a legend; from geological survey plates and textbooks since the 19th century.
styles.era_de: seit dem frühen 19. Jh., Europa und USA
styles.era_en: since the early 19th century, Europe and USA

styles.era_origin: Systematised by Johann Georg Lehmann in 1799; standard in 19th-century topographic maps.
styles.prompt_fragment: engraved as a hachure relief map: countless fine parallel strokes running downslope, darker where steeper, black ink on cream paper, engraved serif place names, rivers in fine blue line, subtle hand-coloured boundaries
styles.avoid: Avoid shaded relief or contour lines.
styles.feasibility_note: Hatching renders; consistency varies.
styles.short_de: Gelände aus unzähligen feinen Strichen in Gefällerichtung, dichter und dunkler, je steiler der Hang; 1799 von Johann Georg Lehmann systematisiert, Standard topografischer Karten im 19. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Terrain drawn with countless fine strokes running downslope, denser and darker where steeper; systematised by Johann Georg Lehmann in 1799, standard on 19th-century topographic maps.
markers_de: Dichter und dunkler an steilen Hängen
markers_en: Denser and darker on steep ground

styles.era_origin: Fire insurance atlases of US and European cities, 1867-1960s.
styles.prompt_fragment: drawn as a fire insurance atlas sheet: building footprints colour-coded in pastel pink brick, yellow wood and blue stone, fine black outlines, lot numbers and street names, legend symbols, printed on aged paper
styles.avoid: Avoid modern GIS styling.
styles.feasibility_note: Colour coding renders; labels are gibberish.
styles.sensitivity_note: Sanborn is a company name and is used only as an alias.
styles.short_de: Großmaßstäbliche Stadtpläne, deren Gebäudegrundrisse nach Baumaterial eingefärbt sind, rosa für Ziegel, gelb für Holz, blau für Stein, mit Hausnummern; vor allem USA und Großbritannien, ca. 1850–1960er.
styles.short_en: Large-scale city plans with building footprints coloured by material, pink for brick, yellow for wood, blue for stone, plus lot numbers; chiefly USA and Britain, c. 1850–1960s.
markers_en: Pastel pink, yellow and blue fills
styles.sensitivity_de: Sanborn ist ein Firmenname und erscheint nur als Alias, nicht im Prompt.
styles.sensitivity_en: Sanborn is a company name and appears only as an alias, not in the prompt.

styles.era_origin: Printed circuit board design from the 1950s onward.
styles.prompt_fragment: rendered as printed circuit board artwork: copper traces routed at 45-degree angles, round solder pads and vias, green solder mask, white silkscreen labels, ground plane fills, clean technical top-down view
styles.avoid: Avoid sci-fi glowing circuits.
styles.feasibility_note: Common motif; renders well.
styles.short_de: Draufsicht auf eine Platine mit Kupferbahnen im 45-Grad-Winkel, Lötpads, Durchkontaktierungen, grünem Lötstopplack und weißem Bestückungsdruck; Elektronikdesign seit den 1950er-Jahren.
styles.short_en: Top-down view of a circuit board with copper traces at 45-degree angles, solder pads, vias, green solder mask and white silkscreen; electronics design since the 1950s.

styles.era_origin: 19th-century chemistry notation; standardised in modern textbooks.
styles.prompt_fragment: drawn as a skeletal chemical structure diagram: black line zigzags and hexagonal rings, element labels in small sans serif, wedge and dashed bonds, clean white background, textbook precision
styles.avoid: Avoid molecular 3D renders; keep to 2D notation.
styles.feasibility_note: Notation renders; chemical correctness is not guaranteed.
styles.short_de: Zweidimensionale Molekülschreibweise aus schwarzen Zickzacklinien und Sechsecken, Elementsymbolen sowie keilförmigen und gestrichelten Bindungen auf Weiß; seit dem 19. Jahrhundert entwickelt, Standard heutiger Chemielehrbücher.
styles.short_en: Two-dimensional molecular notation of black zigzag lines and hexagonal rings, element symbols and wedge and dashed bonds on white; developed since the 19th century, standard in modern textbooks.
styles.era_en: since the 19th century; modern textbook standard

styles.era_origin: Network visualisation since the 1980s, common in 2000s data art.
styles.prompt_fragment: visualised as a force-directed network graph: hundreds of small nodes linked by thin translucent edges, clustered communities in distinct hues, dense hairball centre, sparse periphery, minimal labels, dark or white background
styles.avoid: Avoid neat flowcharts; it should be organic network structure.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders easily.
styles.short_de: Hunderte kleiner Knoten, durch dünne Kanten verbunden und per Simulation in farbige Cluster mit dichtem Kern verteilt; Netzwerkvisualisierung seit den 1980ern, in der Datenkunst der 2000er verbreitet.
styles.short_en: Hundreds of nodes joined by thin edges and spread by simulation into coloured clusters around a dense core; network visualisation since the 1980s, common in 2000s data art.

styles.era_origin: Avant-garde music of the 1950s-60s.
styles.prompt_fragment: drawn as an experimental graphic music score: abstract lines, dots and shapes across faint staff lines, handwritten instructions, time markings, black ink with occasional red, sparse layout on white paper
styles.avoid: Avoid standard sheet music.
styles.feasibility_note: Abstract marks render; notation authenticity varies.
styles.short_de: Musikpartitur aus abstrakten Linien, Punkten und Formen statt Noten, oft mit handschriftlichen Spielanweisungen; aus der Avantgarde-Musik der 1950er und 1960er, etwa bei Earle Brown und Cornelius Cardew.
styles.short_en: A music score of abstract lines, dots and shapes instead of notes, often with handwritten performance instructions; from 1950s–60s avant-garde music, e.g. Earle Brown and Cornelius Cardew.
markers_en: Geometric marks across faint staff lines

styles.era_origin: Coaching practice throughout the 20th century.
styles.prompt_fragment: sketched as a sports tactics board diagram: X and O player markers, curved movement arrows, dashed passing lines, simplified court or pitch outline, whiteboard marker or chalk strokes, quick handwritten notes
styles.avoid: Avoid polished infographics; keep it hand-drawn.
styles.feasibility_note: Simple and reliable.
styles.short_de: Schnell gezeichnetes Spielfeld mit X- und O-Markierungen für Spieler, Laufpfeilen und gestrichelten Passlinien in Marker oder Kreide; Arbeitsmittel von Trainern seit dem 20. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Quickly drawn court or pitch with X and O player markers, movement arrows and dashed passing lines in marker or chalk; everyday coaching practice since the 20th century.
styles.era_en: since the 20th century, team sports worldwide

styles.era_origin: Egypt, reign of Akhenaten at Tell el-Amarna, c. 1353-1336 BCE.
visual_markers: elongated heads and necks with heavy-lidded almond eyes and full lips
soft rounded bellies, narrow shoulders, wide hips
sunken relief cut into pale limestone with faded paint traces
intimate, informal overlapping poses instead of rigid canon
sun disc with rays ending in small hands
styles.prompt_fragment: Egyptian Amarna-period sunken relief carved into pale limestone with faded ochre, blue and red paint traces; figures with elongated heads and necks, heavy-lidded almond eyes, full lips and soft rounded bellies; tender, informal overlapping poses; a sun disc with rays ending in tiny hands; shallow chiselled contours, chipped and weathered stone edges.
styles.avoid: Avoid the rigid canonical Egyptian profile grid and glossy gold museum-replica look; keep the soft, elongated, slightly uncanny Amarna anatomy and worn stone.
styles.feasibility_note: Sunken relief and elongated anatomy render well, but the model drifts back to standard Egyptian wall-painting proportions unless the anatomy is stressed.
styles.short_de: Ägyptische Reliefs und Skulpturen mit langgezogenen Köpfen, vollen Lippen, weichen Bäuchen und vertraulichen Familienszenen unter der Sonnenscheibe Aton; Zeit Echnatons in Tell el-Amarna, um 1353–1336 v. Chr.
styles.short_en: Egyptian reliefs and sculpture with elongated heads, full lips, soft bellies and intimate family scenes beneath the rayed Aten disc; reign of Akhenaten at Amarna, c. 1353–1336 BCE.
markers_de: Langgezogene Köpfe und Hälse, schwere Lider, volle Lippen
Weiche Bäuche, schmale Schultern, breite Hüften
Versenktes Relief in hellem Kalkstein mit Farbresten
Sonnenscheibe mit in Händen endenden Strahlen
markers_en: Elongated heads and necks, heavy lids, full lips
Soft bellies, narrow shoulders, wide hips
Sunken relief in pale limestone with paint traces
Sun disc with rays ending in hands

styles.era_origin: Japan, Kofun period, 3rd-6th century CE; unglazed clay figures set on burial mounds.
visual_markers: hollow cylindrical bodies of unglazed reddish-orange terracotta
faces reduced to simple cut-out holes for eyes and mouth
stubby limbs and flat applied clay strips for hats, armour, jewellery
vertical scraping marks and coil seams
styles.prompt_fragment: Kofun-period haniwa terracotta: hollow, coil-built, unglazed reddish-orange clay forms on cylindrical bases; faces reduced to simple cut-out holes for eyes and mouth; stubby limbs, flat applied clay strips for hats, armour and jewellery; vertical scraping marks, chips, faded red pigment; plain earthen ground, soft overcast daylight.
styles.avoid: Avoid cute kawaii figurine gloss and smooth vinyl-toy surfaces; keep it raw, porous, archaeological and hollow-eyed.
styles.feasibility_note: Simple forms and clay texture are reliable; specify that eyes stay empty holes or the model paints pupils.
styles.sensitivity_note: Funerary objects of Japanese archaeology; avoid mocking or horror framing.
styles.short_de: Hohle, unglasierte Tonfiguren in Rotorange auf Zylinderfüßen, Gesichter nur aus ausgeschnittenen Augen- und Mundlöchern; aufgestellt auf Grabhügeln der japanischen Kofun-Zeit, 3.–6. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Hollow, unglazed reddish-orange clay figures on cylinder bases, faces reduced to cut-out eye and mouth holes; set on burial mounds in Japan's Kofun period, 3rd–6th century.
markers_de: Hohle Zylinderkörper aus unglasiertem rotorangem Ton
Augen und Mund als ausgeschnittene Löcher
Stummelarme, aufgesetzte Tonstreifen für Hüte und Rüstung
markers_en: Hollow cylindrical bodies of unglazed red-orange clay
Eyes and mouth as cut-out holes
Stubby limbs, applied clay strips for hats and armour
Vertical scraping marks and coil seams
styles.sensitivity_de: Grabbeigaben der japanischen Archäologie; nicht ins Lächerliche oder in Horror ziehen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Funerary objects of Japanese archaeology; avoid mocking or horror framing.

styles.era_origin: Central Nigeria, Nok culture, c. 900 BCE-300 CE (dating debated).
visual_markers: large triangular or D-shaped eyes with pierced pupils under arched brows
elaborate sculpted coiffures of buns, crests and braids
perforated nostrils and ears, stacked bead necklaces
styles.prompt_fragment: Ancient Nok terracotta sculpture: coarse orange-brown fired clay with grainy weathered surface; large triangular eyes with pierced pupils under arched brows, perforated nostrils and ears, elaborate sculpted coiffures of buns and braids, stacked bead necklaces; stylised geometric volumes; fragmentary breaks, museum plinth, raking side light.
styles.avoid: Avoid generic 'tribal mask' cliches and polished dark wood; keep the specific triangular-eye terracotta canon and archaeological wear.
styles.feasibility_note: Eye and hair stylisation hold well; without stress the model drifts toward generic carved African masks.
styles.sensitivity_note: Archaeological heritage with a heavy looting and illicit-trade history; present respectfully, never as 'primitive' or generic 'African art'.
styles.short_de: Figuren und Köpfe aus grobkörnigem, orangebraunem Ton mit dreieckigen Augen, durchbohrten Pupillen und aufwendigen Frisuren; Nok-Kultur in Zentralnigeria, etwa 900 v. Chr. bis 300 n. Chr.
styles.short_en: Heads and figures in coarse orange-brown clay with triangular eyes, pierced pupils and elaborate hairstyles; Nok culture of central Nigeria, roughly 900 BCE to 300 CE.
styles.era_de: um 900 v. Chr.–300 n. Chr. (Datierung umstritten), Zentralnigeria
styles.era_en: c. 900 BCE–300 CE (dating debated), central Nigeria
markers_de: Große dreieckige Augen mit durchbohrten Pupillen
Aufwendig modellierte Frisuren aus Knoten und Zöpfen
markers_en: Large triangular eyes with pierced pupils
Elaborate sculpted coiffures of buns and braids
Perforated nostrils and ears, bead necklaces
styles.sensitivity_de: Archäologisches Erbe mit langer Geschichte von Raubgrabungen und illegalem Handel; respektvoll darstellen, nie als „primitiv“ oder pauschal „afrikanisch“.
styles.sensitivity_en: Archaeological heritage with a heavy history of looting and illicit trade; present it respectfully, never as 'primitive' or generic 'African art'.

styles.era_origin: China, Warring States to Han dynasty, c. 4th century BCE-3rd century CE (e.g. Mawangdui tomb finds).
visual_markers: glossy black lacquer ground with vermilion red brush lines
swirling cloud-scroll volutes and comma curves
tiny elongated leaping figures and animals woven into scrolls
thin border bands on curved vessels
styles.prompt_fragment: Ancient Chinese Han-dynasty painted lacquer: deep glossy black lacquer ground painted with fluid vermilion-red and ochre brush lines; swirling cloud-scroll volutes and comma curves, tiny elongated leaping figures and spirited creatures woven into the scrolls; thin border bands; subtle crazing and warm sheen on a curved lacquer surface.
styles.avoid: Avoid carved cinnabar relief, Japanese gold maki-e and modern glossy enamel; this is flat red-and-black brush painting on lacquer.
styles.feasibility_note: Red-on-black palette is reliable; dynamic cloud scrolls sometimes degrade into generic decorative swirls.
styles.short_de: Schwarz glänzender Lackgrund mit fließenden zinnoberroten Pinsellinien, Wolkenvoluten und kleinen springenden Figuren und Tieren; China, Zeit der Streitenden Reiche bis Han-Dynastie, etwa die Grabfunde von Mawangdui.
styles.short_en: Glossy black lacquer painted with fluid vermilion lines, cloud scrolls and tiny leaping figures and animals; China, Warring States to Han dynasty, as in the Mawangdui tomb finds.
styles.era_de: 4. Jh. v. Chr.–3. Jh. n. Chr., China
markers_de: Glänzend schwarzer Lackgrund mit zinnoberroten Pinsellinien
Kleine gestreckte, springende Figuren und Tiere
markers_en: Glossy black lacquer with vermilion brush lines
Swirling cloud scrolls and comma curves
Tiny elongated leaping figures and animals
Thin border bands on curved vessels

styles.era_origin: South coast of Peru, Paracas Necropolis phase, c. 300 BCE-200 CE.
visual_markers: motif repeated in strict checkerboard grid
colour schemes rotating from tile to tile
dense stem-stitch fill with visible stitch direction
flying, frontal figures with streaming appendages and staffs
deep red, indigo, gold, olive on dark cloth
styles.prompt_fragment: Ancient Paracas embroidered textile: dense camelid-wool stem-stitch embroidery on dark woven cloth; motif repeated in a strict checkerboard grid with colour schemes rotating from tile to tile; flat, frontal or flying stylised figures with streaming appendages; deep madder red, indigo, gold, olive; visible stitch direction, faded, slightly frayed edges.
styles.avoid: Avoid modern cross-stitch neatness and Mexican floral embroidery; keep the rigid repeat grid and stitch-filled colour blocks.
styles.feasibility_note: Grid repetition works; exact colour rotation and stitch texture are inconsistent.
styles.sensitivity_note: Funerary textiles wrapped around ancestral mummy bundles; avoid sensationalising the burial context.
styles.short_de: Dichte Stielstichstickerei aus Wolle auf dunklem Tuch, eine Figur im Schachbrettraster mit wechselnden Farbfolgen wiederholt; Grabmäntel der Paracas-Nekropolis, Südperu, etwa 300 v. Chr.–200 n. Chr.
styles.short_en: Dense stem-stitch wool embroidery on dark cloth, one figure repeated in a checkerboard grid with rotating colours; Paracas Necropolis burial mantles, southern Peru, c. 300 BCE–200 CE.
styles.era_de: um 300 v. Chr.–200 n. Chr., Südküste Perus
styles.era_en: c. 300 BCE–200 CE, south coast of Peru
markers_de: Farbfolgen wechseln von Feld zu Feld
Fliegende, frontale Figuren mit wehenden Anhängseln
Krapprot, Indigo, Gold und Oliv auf dunklem Tuch
markers_en: Motif repeated in a strict checkerboard grid
Colour schemes rotating from tile to tile
Dense stem-stitch fill with visible stitch direction
Flying frontal figures with streaming appendages
Madder red, indigo, gold and olive on dark cloth
styles.sensitivity_de: Grabtextilien, die Mumienbündel von Vorfahren umhüllten; den Bestattungskontext nicht reißerisch ausschlachten.
styles.sensitivity_en: Funerary textiles that wrapped ancestral mummy bundles; avoid sensationalising the burial context.

styles.era_origin: South coast of Peru, Nasca culture, c. 100 BCE-800 CE.
visual_markers: many flat mineral slip colours: cream, terracotta, black, grey, mauve, orange
crisp black outlines around flat colour fields
stylised frontal creatures in horizontal bands
design wrapping around a rounded vessel
styles.prompt_fragment: Ancient Nasca polychrome ceramic: burnished, satin-sheen clay vessel painted in flat mineral slips of cream, terracotta red, black, grey, mauve and orange, with crisp black outlines; stylised frontal figures arranged in horizontal bands wrapping around the curved surface; small chips and worn slip.
styles.avoid: Avoid glossy glaze and Greek vase-painting figure styles; keep matte-satin slip, many earthy colours and bold black contours.
styles.feasibility_note: Flat slip colours render well; wrapping of the design around vessel curvature is inconsistent.
styles.short_de: Polierte, unglasierte Gefäße, bemalt mit vielen flachen Engobefarben und schwarzen Konturen, stilisierte Wesen in umlaufenden Bändern; Nasca-Kultur an der Südküste Perus, etwa 100 v. Chr.–800 n. Chr.
styles.short_en: Burnished, unglazed vessels painted in many flat slip colours with black outlines, stylised creatures in bands around the body; Nasca culture, southern Peru, c. 100 BCE–800 CE.
styles.era_de: um 100 v. Chr.–800 n. Chr., Südküste Perus
styles.era_en: c. 100 BCE–800 CE, south coast of Peru
markers_de: Viele flache Engobefarben: Creme, Terrakotta, Schwarz, Grau, Mauve, Orange
markers_en: Many flat slip colours: cream, terracotta, black, grey, mauve, orange
Crisp black outlines around colour fields
Stylised frontal creatures in horizontal bands
Design wrapping around a rounded vessel

styles.era_origin: Central Mexico, Teotihuacan, c. 200-650 CE.
visual_markers: small profile figures outlined in dark red
jade green, turquoise, ochre and pale pink fills
stacked friezes with interlace borders on burnished lime plaster
styles.prompt_fragment: Teotihuacan-style fresco on burnished lime plaster: flat deep-red hematite background, small figures in profile with dark-red outlines and fills of jade green, turquoise, ochre and pale pink; curling speech scrolls, falling droplets and feather fringes; stacked friezes with interlace border bands; flaking pigment, chalky worn surface.
styles.avoid: Avoid Aztec codex outlines and Mexican muralist modernism; keep the deep red ground and small repeated profile figures.
styles.feasibility_note: Palette and plaster texture work; figure stylisation tends toward generic 'Aztec' clip art.
styles.sensitivity_note: Ritual imagery of an ancient Mesoamerican culture; avoid blending into generic Aztec/Maya stereotypes.
styles.short_de: Wandmalerei auf poliertem Kalkputz: tiefroter Hämatitgrund, kleine Profilfiguren in Jadegrün, Türkis und Ocker, Sprechvoluten; Teotihuacan in Zentralmexiko, etwa 200–650 n. Chr.
styles.short_en: Murals on burnished lime plaster: deep red hematite ground, small profile figures in jade green, turquoise and ochre, speech scrolls; Teotihuacan, central Mexico, c. 200–650 CE.
markers_en: Small profile figures outlined in dark red
Jade green, turquoise, ochre and pale pink
Speech scrolls, droplets and feather fringes
styles.sensitivity_de: Rituelle Bildwelt einer alten mesoamerikanischen Kultur; nicht mit pauschalen Azteken- oder Maya-Klischees vermischen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Ritual imagery of an ancient Mesoamerican culture; avoid blending it into generic Aztec or Maya stereotypes.

styles.era_origin: Andes, Wari (c. 600-1000 CE) and Inca (15th-16th century) tapestry-woven tunics.
visual_markers: grid of small square units, each a different geometric sign
figures compressed or stretched sideways (Wari abstraction)
interlocking tapestry weave with stepped diagonal edges
saturated cochineal red, gold, black, white, indigo
styles.prompt_fragment: Andean Wari-Inca tapestry weave: fine interlocking camelid-wool tapestry with stepped diagonal edges; subject abstracted into a grid of small square units, each a different geometric sign, some compressed or stretched sideways; step-frets, stair motifs, checkerboards; saturated cochineal red, gold, black, white and indigo; visible weft ribs, faded patches.
styles.avoid: Avoid Navajo/Dine weaving layouts and generic 'tribal' patterns; keep the modular square tocapu grid and Andean palette.
styles.feasibility_note: Geometric grid and weave texture are strong; figurative abstraction can become unreadable.
styles.sensitivity_note: Tocapu carried status and possibly heraldic or administrative meaning; avoid treating them as random decoration in commercial use.
styles.short_de: Fein gewirkte Tuniken aus Kamelidenwolle mit Rastern kleiner Quadrate, jedes mit eigenem geometrischem Zeichen, Treppenmotiven und kräftigem Koschenillerot; Anden, Wari um 600–1000, Inka im 15.–16. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Finely woven camelid-wool tunics with grids of small squares, each holding its own geometric sign, step motifs and strong cochineal red; Andes, Wari c. 600–1000, Inca 15th–16th century.
markers_de: Raster kleiner Quadrate mit je eigenem Zeichen
Koschenillerot, Gold, Schwarz, Weiß und Indigo
markers_en: Grid of small squares, each a different sign
Interlocking tapestry weave with stepped edges
Cochineal red, gold, black, white and indigo
styles.sensitivity_de: Tocapu zeigten Rang und hatten womöglich heraldische oder administrative Bedeutung; im kommerziellen Einsatz nicht als beliebiges Dekor behandeln.
styles.sensitivity_en: Tocapu signalled rank and possibly heraldic or administrative meaning; do not treat them as random decoration in commercial use.

styles.era_origin: Central Mexico, Mexica (Aztec) empire, c. 1325-1521.
visual_markers: deep crisp carving in grey volcanic basalt
dense compartmentalised composition filled to the edges
glyph cartouches with dot numerals, feather bundles, claws
bold rounded contours, blocky compressed figures
faint red and blue paint traces
styles.prompt_fragment: Mexica stone relief carved in grey volcanic basalt: deep, crisp chisel cuts; densely packed compartmentalised composition filled edge to edge with rounded contours, feather bundles, scrolls, claws and calendar-like glyph cartouches with dot numerals; blocky compressed figures; faint traces of red and blue pigment; raking light, porous weathered stone.
styles.avoid: Avoid souvenir 'Aztec calendar' kitsch and fantasy-game stone textures; keep the authentic dense carving logic.
styles.feasibility_note: Stone carving depth works; glyphs become pseudo-glyphs and may slide into Maya stela look.
styles.sensitivity_note: Sacred and imperial Mexica imagery; do not conflate with Maya, avoid using sacrificial imagery for shock value.
styles.short_de: Tief und scharf in grauen Basalt gehauene Reliefs, dicht bis an den Rand gefüllt mit Federbündeln, Krallen und Kalenderglyphen mit Zahlpunkten; Mexica-Reich in Zentralmexiko, 1325–1521.
styles.short_en: Reliefs cut deep and crisp into grey basalt, packed edge to edge with feather bundles, claws and calendar glyphs with dot numerals; Mexica empire, central Mexico, 1325–1521.
markers_de: Tiefe, scharfe Meißelarbeit in grauem Basalt
Dicht gefüllte, in Felder gegliederte Komposition
markers_en: Deep crisp carving in grey volcanic basalt
Glyph cartouches with dot numerals, feather bundles, claws
Bold rounded contours, blocky compressed figures
Faint red and blue paint traces
styles.sensitivity_de: Sakrale und imperiale Bildwelt der Mexica; nicht mit Maya vermischen und Opferszenen nicht als Schockeffekt nutzen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Sacred and imperial Mexica imagery; do not conflate it with Maya, and do not use sacrificial imagery for shock value.

styles.era_origin: Iraq and Syria, late 12th-13th century (e.g. illustrated Maqamat copies, 1237).
visual_markers: lively figures with large heads and expressive gestures
plain unpainted cream paper background with a single ground line
Arabic naskh text panels above and below
styles.prompt_fragment: 13th-century Arab manuscript painting: lively figures with large heads, gold haloes and gesturing hands set on plain cream paper with a single ground line and sparse stylised plants; garments with swirling folds in vermilion, lapis blue, green and gold; naskh script panels above and below; slight flaking, worm holes, burnished paper.
styles.avoid: Avoid Persian miniature's dense landscapes, high horizons and jewel-like detail; keep the open background and earthy, theatrical liveliness.
styles.feasibility_note: Open composition and palette work; text panels will be pseudo-Arabic.
styles.sensitivity_note: Script will be illegible pseudo-Arabic; never use for depictions of the Prophet or religious text.
styles.short_de: Lebhafte Figuren mit großen Köpfen, Goldnimben und ausdrucksvollen Gesten auf einer Standlinie vor leerem Papiergrund, dazu Textfelder; Irak und Syrien, spätes 12.–13. Jahrhundert, etwa Maqamat-Handschriften.
styles.short_en: Lively large-headed figures with gold haloes and expressive gestures on a ground line against bare paper, with text panels; Iraq and Syria, late 12th–13th century, e.g. Maqamat manuscripts.
markers_de: Lebhafte Figuren mit großen Köpfen und Gesten
Leerer cremefarbener Papiergrund mit einer Standlinie
Textfelder in Naschi-Schrift darüber und darunter
markers_en: Lively figures with large heads and gestures
Plain cream paper ground with a single ground line
Naskh text panels above and below
styles.sensitivity_de: Die Schrift wird unleserliches Pseudo-Arabisch; nie für Darstellungen des Propheten oder für religiöse Texte verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Script will come out as illegible pseudo-Arabic; never use it for depictions of the Prophet or for religious text.

styles.era_origin: Armenia, 9th-17th century, peak 12th-14th century.
visual_markers: upright slab of pinkish or ochre volcanic tuff
central motif framed by lace-like interlace
deeply undercut openwork and knotwork rosettes
palmettes, vine scrolls, crisp geometric borders
styles.prompt_fragment: Medieval Armenian khachkar stone carving: upright slab of pinkish-ochre volcanic tuff carved in deep undercut openwork; a central motif framed by intricate lace-like interlace, knotwork rosettes, palmettes and vine scrolls filling every surface; crisp geometric borders; weathered edges, lichen spots, raking mountain light.
styles.avoid: Avoid Celtic-knot clip art and polished marble; keep the porous tuff, deep openwork and Armenian geometric density.
styles.feasibility_note: Interlace density is good; true undercut depth tends to flatten into surface pattern.
styles.sensitivity_note: Sacred Christian monuments (UNESCO intangible heritage); avoid profane or mocking use of the cross form.
styles.short_de: Aufrechte Platten aus rosa oder ockerfarbenem Tuff mit zentralem Kreuz, umgeben von tief unterschnittenem, spitzenartigem Flechtwerk und Rosetten; Armenien, 9.–17. Jahrhundert, Blüte im 12.–14. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Upright slabs of pink or ochre tuff with a central cross framed by deeply undercut, lace-like interlace and rosettes; Armenia, 9th–17th century, peaking in the 12th–14th.
markers_de: Aufrechte Platte aus rosa oder ockerfarbenem Tuff
markers_en: Upright slab of pinkish or ochre volcanic tuff
Central motif framed by lace-like interlace
Deeply undercut openwork and knotwork rosettes
Palmettes, vine scrolls, crisp geometric borders
styles.sensitivity_de: Sakrale christliche Denkmäler (immaterielles UNESCO-Kulturerbe); die Kreuzform nicht profan oder spöttisch verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Sacred Christian monuments (UNESCO intangible heritage); avoid profane or mocking use of the cross form.

styles.era_origin: Northern Romania (Moldavia/Bukovina), c. 1530-1600.
visual_markers: frescoes covering outdoor church walls beneath deep shingled eaves
stacked horizontal registers of hieratic figures
ochre haloes and Cyrillic-style inscription bands
styles.prompt_fragment: Late-Byzantine Moldavian exterior fresco: painting covering an outdoor church wall beneath a deep shingled eave, intense azurite-blue ground, stacked horizontal registers of elongated hieratic figures with ochre haloes and flowing robes, Cyrillic-style inscription bands; centuries of rain-faded, eroded patches revealing bare plaster; soft open daylight.
styles.avoid: Avoid indoor gold-leaf icon shine and modern street murals; keep weathered outdoor plaster and the dominant blue.
styles.feasibility_note: Blue ground and registers work; the outdoor architectural context needs explicit mention.
styles.sensitivity_note: Sacred Orthodox imagery on active monasteries (UNESCO); avoid irreverent juxtapositions; inscriptions will be pseudo-script.
styles.short_de: Fresken über die gesamten Außenwände orthodoxer Kirchen unter tiefen Schindeldächern, in gestaffelten Bildstreifen auf leuchtendem Azuritblau; Moldau und Bukowina im Norden Rumäniens, um 1530–1600.
styles.short_en: Frescoes covering the outer walls of Orthodox churches beneath deep shingled eaves, in stacked registers on intense azurite blue; Moldavia and Bukovina, northern Romania, c. 1530–1600.
markers_de: Fresken auf Außenwänden unter tiefen Schindeltraufen
Intensiver Azuritblau-Grund, auch Grün oder Rot
Vom Regen ausgewaschene untere Zonen mit freiliegendem Putz
markers_en: Frescoes on outer walls beneath deep shingled eaves
Intense azurite blue ground, or green or red
Ochre haloes and Cyrillic inscription bands
styles.sensitivity_de: Sakrale orthodoxe Bilder an noch genutzten Klöstern (UNESCO-Welterbe); keine respektlosen Kombinationen, Inschriften werden zu Pseudoschrift.
styles.sensitivity_en: Sacred Orthodox imagery on active monasteries (UNESCO World Heritage); avoid irreverent juxtapositions, and inscriptions will be pseudo-script.

styles.era_origin: Russia and the Orthodox world, 16th-early 20th century.
visual_markers: embossed silver-gilt cover hiding the whole panel
cut-out windows revealing painted faces and hands
repoussé drapery folds and chased floral scrolls
enamel or filigree halo plates, beaded borders
styles.prompt_fragment: Orthodox icon with a silver-gilt oklad: an embossed repoussé metal cover with chased floral scrolls, beaded borders and raised drapery folds hides the whole panel except small cut-out windows revealing dark egg-tempera painted faces and hands; enamel and filigree halo plates; tarnish in the recesses, flickering candle-glow reflections.
styles.avoid: Avoid flat painted icons and modern chrome; the image depends on the metal cover with painted windows.
styles.feasibility_note: Metal detail is strong; the metal-plus-painted-window structure is sometimes fused into one surface.
styles.sensitivity_note: Sacred Orthodox objects of veneration; avoid satirical or commercial misuse of holy imagery.
styles.short_de: Ikone unter getriebenem, vergoldetem Silberbeschlag, der die ganze Tafel bedeckt und nur Gesichter und Hände durch Ausschnitte zeigt; Russland und orthodoxe Welt, 16. bis frühes 20. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Icon under an embossed silver-gilt cover that hides the whole panel, leaving only painted faces and hands visible through cut-outs; Russia and the Orthodox world, 16th–early 20th century.
styles.era_en: 16th–early 20th century, Russia and the Orthodox world
markers_de: Getriebener Silberbeschlag über der ganzen Tafel
Ausschnitte, durch die gemalte Gesichter und Hände sichtbar sind
Nimbenplatten mit Email oder Filigran, Perlrand
markers_en: Embossed silver-gilt cover over the whole panel
Cut-out windows revealing painted faces and hands
Repoussé drapery folds and chased floral scrolls
Enamel or filigree halo plates, beaded borders
styles.sensitivity_de: Sakrale, verehrte Gegenstände der Orthodoxie; nicht satirisch oder kommerziell missbrauchen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Sacred objects of Orthodox veneration; avoid satirical or commercial misuse of holy imagery.

styles.era_origin: England, c. 1530-1610.
visual_markers: flat pale face with minimal shadow
costume as dense ornamental pattern of jewels, pearls, lace ruff, embroidery
dark or blue-green background with gilded Latin inscription and date
oak panel craquelure and darkened varnish
styles.prompt_fragment: Tudor-Elizabethan court panel portrait: stiff frontal or three-quarter pose, flat pale face with minimal shadow, costume rendered as a dense ornamental pattern of jewels, pearls, lace ruff and embroidery; dark or blue-green background with a gilded Latin inscription and date; oil on oak panel, fine craquelure, darkened varnish.
styles.avoid: Avoid Baroque chiaroscuro and soft romantic lighting; keep the flatness, emblematic stiffness and ornamental costume.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable; may add too much modelling to faces unless 'flat' is stressed.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not replicate or name specific royal portraits.
styles.short_de: Steife, emblematische Bildnisse mit flachem, blassem Gesicht und Kostüm als dichtem Ornament aus Juwelen, Perlen, Halskrause und Stickerei, oft mit goldener lateinischer Inschrift; England, etwa 1530–1610.
styles.short_en: Stiff, emblematic portraits with flat pale faces and costume rendered as dense ornament of jewels, pearls, ruff and embroidery, often with a gilded Latin inscription; England, c. 1530–1610.
markers_de: Flaches, blasses Gesicht mit kaum Schatten
Kostüm als dichtes Ornament aus Juwelen, Perlen, Halskrause und Stickerei
Dunkler oder blaugrüner Grund mit goldener lateinischer Inschrift und Jahreszahl

Costume as dense ornament of jewels, pearls, ruff and embroidery
Dark or blue-green ground with gilded Latin inscription and date
