styles.sensitivity_en: Do not replicate or name specific royal portraits.

styles.era_origin: New Spain (Mexico), c. 1650-1750, inspired by Japanese namban lacquer.
visual_markers: mother-of-pearl fragments shimmering through thin oil glazes
wide decorative border of flowers and birds
styles.prompt_fragment: Colonial Mexican enconchado painting: oil on panel inlaid with irregular fragments of mother-of-pearl that shimmer iridescently through thin translucent glazes; fine gold-line outlines and patterning on garments and foliage; wide decorative border of flowers and birds on a dark ground; crackled varnish, warm candlelit museum tone.
styles.avoid: Avoid East Asian black-lacquer inlay and all-over pearlescent sparkle; the shell should glint through painted scenes, not replace them.
styles.feasibility_note: Iridescent inlay under glaze is subtle and may become a generic shiny surface.
styles.sensitivity_note: Often depicts Christian or conquest narratives of colonial Mexico; contextualise.
styles.short_de: Ölbilder auf Holztafeln mit eingelegten Perlmuttstücken, die durch dünne Lasuren schimmern, feinen Goldlinien und breiten Blumen- und Vogelrahmen; Neuspanien (Mexiko), etwa 1660–1740, angeregt von japanischem Namban-Lack.
styles.short_en: Oil on panel inlaid with mother-of-pearl shimmering through thin glazes, fine gold lines and wide flower-and-bird borders; New Spain, c. 1660–1740, inspired by Japanese namban lacquer.
markers_de: Perlmuttstücke, die durch dünne Öllasuren schimmern
Breiter Zierrahmen mit Blumen und Vögeln
markers_en: Mother-of-pearl fragments shimmering through thin oil glazes
Wide decorative border of flowers and birds
styles.sensitivity_de: Zeigt oft christliche Themen oder Eroberungsszenen des kolonialen Mexiko; im historischen Zusammenhang einordnen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Often depicts Christian or conquest narratives of colonial Mexico; place it in historical context.

styles.era_origin: Italy, 13th-15th century fresco practice; many revealed by fresco detachment in the 20th century.
visual_markers: large reddish-brown earth brush drawing on rough plaster
giornata seams and remnants of white intonaco
styles.prompt_fragment: Italian fresco sinopia: a large, loose underdrawing brushed in reddish-brown earth pigment onto rough grey-beige arriccio plaster; searching contour lines, corrections and overlapping pentimenti, faint snapped-string grid; patches of later white plaster and visible day-work seams; chalky, pitted wall surface, flat museum light.
styles.avoid: Avoid neat red-chalk drawing on paper and finished fresco colour; keep brush-on-plaster roughness and unfinished searching lines.
styles.feasibility_note: Monochrome brush line on plaster renders reliably.
styles.short_de: Großformatige Vorzeichnung mit dem Pinsel in rotbrauner Erdfarbe auf rauem Unterputz, mit suchenden Linien und Korrekturen; italienische Freskopraxis des 13. bis frühen 16. Jahrhunderts.
styles.short_en: Large brush underdrawing in reddish-brown earth pigment on rough base plaster, with searching lines and corrections; Italian fresco practice of the 13th to early 16th century.
markers_de: Tagewerksnähte und Reste von weißem Intonaco
markers_en: Reddish-brown earth brush drawing on rough plaster
Giornata seams and remnants of white intonaco

styles.era_origin: Italy and Northern Europe, 15th-16th century full-scale transfer drawings for frescoes and tapestries.
visual_markers: full-scale charcoal and black chalk on joined sheets
every contour perforated by rows of tiny pinholes
sheet seams, patches, stains, repaired edges
styles.prompt_fragment: Full-scale Renaissance workshop cartoon: charcoal and black chalk on several glued sheets of toned paper, every contour perforated by rows of tiny pinholes with grey pounce-dust dots smudged along the lines; white chalk highlights; visible sheet seams, patches, water stains and torn, repaired edges.
styles.avoid: Avoid polished finished drawings and generic sketchbook looks; pricked contours and joined sheets are essential.
styles.feasibility_note: Charcoal drawing is reliable; consistent pinhole rows along contours are hit-or-miss.
styles.short_de: Vorlage in Originalgröße für Fresken und Tapisserien, in Kohle und Kreide auf zusammengeklebten Bögen, Konturen zum Durchstäuben durchstochen; Italien und Nordeuropa, 15.–16. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Full-size design for frescoes or tapestries in charcoal and chalk on joined sheets, its contours pricked for pouncing with charcoal dust; Italy and Northern Europe, 15th–16th century.
markers_de: Kohle und schwarze Kreide auf zusammengesetzten Bögen
markers_en: Charcoal and black chalk on joined sheets
Contours perforated by rows of tiny pinholes
Grey pounce-dust dots along the lines
Sheet seams, patches, stains, repaired edges

styles.era_origin: German-speaking painters in Vienna and Rome, 1809-c. 1840.
visual_markers: firm clear contours and unmodulated local colours
styles.prompt_fragment: Nazarene-style painting: clear, firm contours and evenly lit, unmodulated local colours in clean blue, rose, green and gold; idealised serene faces, calm devotional gestures, symmetrical frieze-like arrangement; smooth fresco-like surface; Italianate background under an even pale sky; nostalgic early-Renaissance revival.
styles.avoid: Avoid Pre-Raphaelite jewel saturation and Friedrich-style moody Romanticism; keep it clean, linear and devotional.
styles.feasibility_note: Linear clarity is reliable; may drift toward generic Renaissance.
styles.short_de: Klare Umrisse, ungebrochene Lokalfarben und ruhige, andächtige Figuren in friesartiger Ordnung: die Malerei deutschsprachiger Künstler in Wien und Rom, die ab 1809 die Frührenaissance wiederbelebten.
styles.short_en: Clear outlines, flat local colours and calm devotional figures in frieze-like order, painted by German-speaking artists in Vienna and Rome who revived early Renaissance art after 1809.
markers_de: glatte, freskohafte Oberfläche, italienische Landschaft im Hintergrund

visual_markers: thick decorative oil brushwork on board
saturated autumn reds, oranges, Prussian blues, violets
stylised banded clouds and rocky ridges
styles.prompt_fragment: Canadian Group of Seven painting: bold, simplified rhythmic shapes and thick decorative oil brushwork on board; saturated autumn reds, oranges, deep Prussian blues and violet; any trees as wind-twisted flat silhouettes, skies in stylised banded clouds, rocky ridges; strong design over detail; rugged northern light.
styles.avoid: Avoid photoreal golden-hour landscape and soft impressionist haze; push stylised, poster-like rhythms.
styles.feasibility_note: Stylised landscape rhythms render well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Historical group name only; landscapes often erased Indigenous presence, worth noting in context.
styles.short_de: Kanadische Wildnis in kräftigen, rhythmisch vereinfachten Formen, pastosem Öl und satten Herbstfarben, gemalt von einer Künstlergruppe aus Toronto zwischen etwa 1913 und 1933.
styles.short_en: Rugged Canadian wilderness reduced to bold rhythmic shapes, thick oil brushwork and saturated autumn colours, painted by a Toronto-based artists' group from about 1913 to 1933.
markers_de: satte Herbstrot- und Orangetöne, Preußischblau, Violett
markers_en: thick decorative oil brushwork on board
saturated autumn reds and oranges, Prussian blue, violet
stylised banded clouds and rocky ridges
styles.sensitivity_de: Die Bilder zeigen das Land als menschenleere Wildnis und blenden seine indigenen Bewohner aus; im Kontext erwähnenswert.
styles.sensitivity_en: The paintings present the land as empty wilderness and leave out its Indigenous inhabitants; worth noting in context.

visual_markers: gaunt twisted bodies, splayed bony fingers
flesh mottled in ochre, rust, olive green, violet
figures isolated on bare buff paper
styles.prompt_fragment: Viennese Expressionist gouache drawing: nervous, angular, wiry pencil contour with abrupt breaks; gaunt twisted bodies, splayed bony fingers, intense staring eyes; flesh mottled in patches of ochre, rust red, olive green and violet; isolated on bare buff paper with sparse watercolour washes; raw, psychologically tense.
styles.avoid: Avoid Die Brücke's flat bold primaries and woodcut look; keep thin contour, mottled skin and empty paper.
styles.feasibility_note: Contour and mottled colour work well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Source works often erotic nudes; keep results tasteful and avoid naming the artists.
styles.short_de: Nervöse, kantige Bleistiftlinien und hagere, verdrehte Figuren mit fleckig in Ocker, Rost und Grün gefärbter Haut auf blankem Papier, entstanden in Wien zwischen etwa 1908 und 1918.
styles.short_en: Nervous, angular pencil lines and gaunt, twisted figures with flesh mottled in ochre, rust and green on bare paper, as drawn in Vienna between about 1908 and 1918.
markers_de: hagere, verdrehte Körper, gespreizte knochige Finger
Haut fleckig in Ocker, Rost, Oliv und Violett
Figuren isoliert auf blankem, bräunlichem Papier
markers_en: gaunt twisted bodies, splayed bony fingers
flesh mottled in ochre, rust, olive and violet
figures isolated on bare buff paper
styles.sensitivity_de: Viele Vorbilder sind erotische Akte; Ergebnisse nicht explizit halten und keine Künstlernamen nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Many source works are erotic nudes; keep results non-explicit and do not name the artists.

styles.era_origin: Buenos Aires, from 1946.
visual_markers: irregular shaped polygonal panels instead of rectangles
flat unmodulated primaries plus black and white
styles.prompt_fragment: Arte Madí concrete painting: an irregular, shaped, polygonal panel instead of a rectangle, with notched and protruding edges; flat unmodulated planes of red, yellow, blue, black and white; interlocking geometric fragments, cut-outs and hinged sections; hard edges, matte enamel; photographed against a white wall with soft cast shadows.
styles.avoid: Avoid De Stijl's strict grid and the standard rectangular canvas; the shaped irregular support is the point.
styles.feasibility_note: Model understands shaped canvases but often reverts to a rectangle.
styles.short_de: Unregelmäßig zugeschnittene, vieleckige Bildtafeln in flachen Grundfarben, Schwarz und Weiß, mit Kerben und beweglichen Teilen; konkrete Kunst einer 1946 in Buenos Aires gegründeten Gruppe.
styles.short_en: Shaped, irregular polygonal panels in flat primaries, black and white, with notched and hinged parts, from the concrete art group founded in Buenos Aires in 1946.
markers_de: flache Grundfarben plus Schwarz und Weiß
markers_en: irregular shaped polygonal panels instead of rectangles
flat primaries plus black and white
cast shadow on a white wall

styles.era_origin: Paris, from 1945.
visual_markers: image built from letters, invented glyphs and rebus signs
mix of Latin letters, numerals, arrows, pictograms
styles.prompt_fragment: Lettrist hypergraphic painting: the image built entirely from hand-painted letters, invented glyphs, rebus pictograms, numerals and arrows covering the canvas densely in varied sizes and directions; sign systems replacing figures; black, red and ochre on off-white ground; visible brushwork and pencil guidelines.
styles.avoid: Avoid modern typographic posters and graffiti tags; keep it painterly, invented and only semi-legible.
styles.feasibility_note: Invented glyphs drift into legible English words; density is fine.
styles.short_de: Leinwände dicht bedeckt mit gemalten Buchstaben, erfundenen Zeichen, Rebus-Piktogrammen und Ziffern, die an die Stelle von Figuren treten; aus der Bewegung um Isidore Isou im Nachkriegs-Paris.
styles.short_en: Canvases densely covered with hand-painted letters, invented signs, rebus pictograms and numerals that replace figures, from Isidore Isou's movement in postwar Paris.
markers_de: Bild aus Buchstaben, erfundenen Zeichen und Rebus-Symbolen
dichtes Gemenge in wechselnden Größen und Richtungen
markers_en: image built from letters, invented glyphs and rebus signs
dense mix of sizes and directions

styles.era_origin: USSR, c. 1957-1970 (term coined 1961).
visual_markers: monumental flattened figures in simplified angular planes
austere slate grey, umber, steel blue, dull ochre
introspective unsmiling faces, laconic frieze-like composition
broad matte oil on coarse canvas
styles.prompt_fragment: Soviet Severe Style painting: monumental, flattened figures built from simplified angular planes and heavy dark contours; austere palette of slate grey, umber, steel blue and dull ochre; laconic, frieze-like composition, introspective unsmiling faces, harsh northern light; broad matte oil on coarse canvas.
styles.avoid: Avoid glossy optimistic Socialist Realism and saturated propaganda posters; keep it sober, muted and modernist.
styles.feasibility_note: Muted flattened figuration renders reliably.
styles.sensitivity_note: Soviet-era art; avoid propaganda framing or political glorification.
styles.short_de: Monumentale, flächige Figuren mit schweren Konturen in herben Grau-, Umbra- und Stahlblautönen, gemalt in der UdSSR des Tauwetters als nüchterne Antwort auf das offizielle Pathos.
styles.short_en: Monumental, flattened figures with heavy contours in austere greys, umbers and steel blues, painted in the USSR during the Khrushchev Thaw as a sober answer to official pomp.
markers_de: monumentale, flächige Figuren aus kantigen Flächen
herbes Schiefergrau, Umbra, Stahlblau, stumpfer Ocker
ernste, in sich gekehrte Gesichter, friesartiger Aufbau
breiter, matter Ölauftrag auf grober Leinwand
markers_en: monumental flattened figures in angular planes
austere slate grey, umber, steel blue, dull ochre
broad matte oil on coarse canvas
styles.sensitivity_de: Kunst aus der Sowjetzeit; keine propagandistische Inszenierung oder politische Verklärung.
styles.sensitivity_en: Soviet-era art; avoid propaganda framing or political glorification.

styles.era_origin: USA and UK, from c. 1970; silicone-based works from the 1990s.
visual_markers: uncannily lifelike pores, veins, implanted hair, glass eyes
styles.prompt_fragment: Hyperrealist silicone sculpture installed in a white-cube gallery: uncannily lifelike with visible pores, veins, implanted real hair and glassy eyes, but at a jarring scale, far oversized or miniature; mundane, slumped everyday pose; polished concrete floor, gallery spotlights, a few visitors for scale.
styles.avoid: Avoid wax-museum celebrity gloss and CGI skin; it must read as a physical object photographed in a gallery.
styles.feasibility_note: Gallery context and scale contrast are reliable.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not depict identifiable real people.
styles.short_de: Täuschend lebensechte Menschenfiguren mit sichtbaren Poren, Adern und echtem Haar, oft in alltäglichen Posen oder irritierendem Maßstab; entstanden seit etwa 1970 in den USA und Großbritannien.
styles.short_en: Uncannily lifelike human figures with visible pores, veins and real hair, often in mundane poses or at jarring scale; made in the USA and Britain since around 1970.
styles.era_de: ab ca. 1970, USA und Großbritannien; Silikonarbeiten ab den 1990ern
styles.era_en: from c. 1970, USA and UK; silicone works from the 1990s
markers_de: lebensechte Poren, Adern, eingesetztes Haar, Glasaugen
White Cube mit Betonboden und Spots
markers_en: lifelike pores, veins, implanted hair, glass eyes
white-cube gallery with concrete floor and spotlights
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine erkennbaren realen Personen darstellen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not depict identifiable real people.

styles.era_origin: International, 1960s-1990s (Fluxus, New York Correspondance School).
visual_markers: rubber-stamp impressions and homemade perforated artist stamps
real postmarks, wavy cancellations, address labels
styles.prompt_fragment: Mail art: a hand-decorated envelope or postcard that has travelled through the post, covered with collage, xeroxed fragments, rubber-stamp impressions, doodles and perforated homemade artist stamps; postmarks, wavy cancellation lines, address labels, airmail stickers; creased corners, smudged ink, layered handling wear.
styles.avoid: Avoid neat scrapbooking and fake vintage postcards; keep DIY, anti-commercial network-art energy.
styles.feasibility_note: Layered collage works; stamp and postmark text will be pseudo-text.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid replicating real postal-authority logos or valid postage.
styles.short_de: Umschläge und Postkarten voller Collagen, Stempelabdrucke, selbstgemachter Künstlermarken und echter Poststempel, verschickt in einem internationalen Künstlernetzwerk ab den 1960er-Jahren.
styles.short_en: Envelopes and postcards covered in collage, rubber stamps, homemade artist stamps and real postmarks, sent through the post in an international artists' network from the 1960s on.
markers_de: von Hand gestaltete Umschläge und Postkarten
markers_en: rubber stamps and perforated homemade artist stamps
creased, worn surfaces from postal handling
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine echten Postlogos oder gültigen Briefmarken nachbilden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not reproduce real postal logos or valid postage.

styles.era_origin: Switzerland, Brazil, Germany, from 1953-1956.
visual_markers: image formed only by repeated and permuted words
one modernist typeface, black on white
spacing, density and rotation create shape
styles.prompt_fragment: Concrete poetry: the image formed solely by repeated and permuted words and letters on a white page, building the subject's shape through spacing, density, rotation and gaps; one typeface (crisp sans-serif or typewriter), black only, rigorous grid or radiating structure; generous empty space; letterpress or offset print.
styles.avoid: Avoid dense ASCII/typewriter shading and ornamental calligrams; keep minimal modernist type with real words.
styles.feasibility_note: Repeated words often get misspelled; shape-forming is moderate.
styles.short_de: Bildformen allein aus wiederholten und vertauschten Wörtern in einer Schrift, schwarz auf weiß, gebildet durch Abstand und Drehung; entstanden in den 1950ern in der Schweiz, Brasilien und Deutschland.
styles.short_en: Shapes formed only from repeated, permuted words in one typeface, black on white, through spacing and rotation; emerged in Switzerland, Brazil and Germany in the 1950s.
markers_de: Bild nur aus wiederholten, vertauschten Wörtern
eine moderne Schrift, schwarz auf weiß
Form durch Abstand, Dichte und Drehung
markers_en: image formed only from repeated, permuted words
one modernist typeface, black on white
shape built by spacing, density and rotation

styles.era_origin: Socialist Yugoslavia, c. 1960-1990.
visual_markers: colossal abstract concrete or steel monument
crystalline shards, wings or petal-like segments
board-marked raw concrete, rain staining, moss
isolated in remote landscape under dramatic sky
styles.prompt_fragment: Yugoslav spomenik-style monument: the subject abstracted into a colossal sculpture of raw board-marked concrete or weathered steel, with crystalline shards, soaring wings or petal-like segments, standing alone in a vast remote landscape under a dramatic sky; tiny human figures for scale; moss and rain staining; sober documentary photograph.
styles.avoid: Avoid sci-fi game megastructures and glossy brutalist renders; keep it real, weathered and memorial.
styles.feasibility_note: Concrete monument in landscape renders convincingly.
styles.sensitivity_note: WWII memorials to victims and partisans; avoid treating them as mere sci-fi spectacle.
styles.short_de: Riesige abstrakte Denkmäler aus rohem Beton oder Stahl, mit Splitter-, Flügel- oder Blütenformen, einsam in entlegener Landschaft; Weltkriegsgedenkstätten im sozialistischen Jugoslawien, etwa 1960–1990.
styles.short_en: Colossal abstract monuments of raw concrete or steel, with shards, wings or petal forms standing alone in remote landscapes; WWII memorials built in socialist Yugoslavia, c. 1960–1990.
markers_de: riesiges abstraktes Monument aus Beton oder Stahl
einsam in weiter Landschaft unter dramatischem Himmel
markers_en: colossal abstract concrete or steel monument
crystalline shards, wings or petal segments
board-marked raw concrete, rain stains, moss
alone in a remote landscape under a dramatic sky
styles.sensitivity_de: Es sind Gedenkstätten für Opfer und Partisanen des Zweiten Weltkriegs; nicht als Science-Fiction-Kulisse behandeln.
styles.sensitivity_en: These are WWII memorials to victims and partisans; do not treat them as sci-fi props.

styles.era_origin: Paris, from 1931; mid-century modernism.
visual_markers: thin black wire arms in asymmetric balance
crisp shadows on a white wall
styles.prompt_fragment: Hanging kinetic mobile: the subject abstracted into flat painted sheet-metal shapes balanced on thin black wire arms, suspended in mid-air in asymmetric equilibrium; red, black, yellow, blue and white; crisp shadows cast on a white gallery wall; a gentle sense of drifting movement.
styles.avoid: Avoid nursery baby mobiles and glossy 3D icon renders; keep modernist painted metal and wire.
styles.feasibility_note: Clear form; balance logic sometimes physically implausible.
styles.sensitivity_note: Generic form; do not name the inventing artist.
styles.short_de: Flache, bemalte Blechformen, an dünnen Drahtarmen ausbalanciert und frei schwebend aufgehängt; die Form entstand 1931 in Paris und prägte die Moderne der Jahrhundertmitte.
styles.short_en: Flat painted sheet-metal shapes balanced on thin wire arms and hung to drift in the air, a form invented in Paris in 1931 and central to mid-century modernism.
markers_de: dünne schwarze Drahtarme im asymmetrischen Gleichgewicht
Rot, Schwarz, Gelb, Blau und Weiß
markers_en: thin black wire arms in asymmetric balance
red, black, yellow, blue and white
crisp shadows on a white wall
styles.sensitivity_de: Allgemeine Form; den Erfinder nicht namentlich nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Generic form; do not name the inventing artist.

styles.era_origin: Situationist International, Paris, 1957-1972.
visual_markers: found comic or ad panels reused
speech balloons replaced with dense typewritten theory
ironic mismatch of image and text
black-and-white photocopy, paste-up edges, correction fluid
styles.prompt_fragment: Situationist détournement: found comic-book or advertising panels re-used with speech balloons replaced by dense typewritten political-philosophical text; ironic mismatch between glossy romance or adventure imagery and message; black-and-white photocopy reproduction, uneven paste-up, visible glue edges and correction fluid.
styles.avoid: Avoid modern meme templates and clean digital lettering; keep 1960s paste-up and typewritten texture.
styles.feasibility_note: Paste-up look works; typewritten text will be pseudo-legible.
styles.sensitivity_note: Radical political content; do not reuse real copyrighted comic characters.
styles.short_de: Gefundene Comic- oder Werbebilder, deren Sprechblasen mit dichtem politischem Text neu gefüllt sind, billig in Schwarzweiß vervielfältigt; eine Praxis der Situationistischen Internationale, Paris 1957–1972.
styles.short_en: Found comic or advertising panels whose speech balloons are refilled with dense political text, cheaply reproduced in black and white by the Situationist International, Paris, 1957–1972.
markers_de: ironischer Bruch zwischen Bild und Text
markers_en: found comic or ad panels reused
speech balloons filled with dense typewritten theory
ironic clash of image and text
black-and-white copy, paste-up edges, correction fluid
styles.sensitivity_de: Radikal politische Inhalte; keine echten, urheberrechtlich geschützten Comicfiguren verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Radical political content; do not reuse real copyrighted comic characters.

styles.era_origin: Global, from c. 2008 (mural festivals).
visual_markers: image across a multi-storey gable wall
spray and roller paint with crisp edges and overspray
styles.prompt_fragment: Contemporary large-scale street mural: the image painted with spray cans and rollers across a multi-storey gable wall, windows, drainpipes and plaster cracks interrupting the paint; bold saturated colours with crisp spray edges and slight overspray; photographed from street level with steep perspective, parked cars and a boom lift at the base.
styles.avoid: Avoid digital wall mock-ups and pristine flat renders; show real wall texture and the urban environment.
styles.feasibility_note: Very reliable; wall interruptions add authenticity.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not imitate specific living muralists' signature styles.
styles.short_de: Großformatige, farbsatte Bilder, mit Sprühdose und Farbrolle über mehrstöckige Brandwände gemalt; typisch für die Mural-Festivals, die sich seit Ende der 2000er-Jahre weltweit verbreitet haben.
styles.short_en: Bold, saturated images painted with spray cans and rollers across multi-storey gable walls, typical of the urban mural festivals that spread worldwide from the late 2000s.
markers_de: Sprühlack und Rolle, scharfe Kanten, leichter Sprühnebel
Fenster, Fallrohre und Putzrisse unterbrechen das Bild
steile Perspektive von der Straße aus
Hubsteiger und parkende Autos am Fuß
markers_en: image spanning a multi-storey gable wall
spray and roller paint, crisp edges, light overspray
windows, drainpipes and cracks interrupting the paint
boom lift and parked cars at the base
styles.sensitivity_de: Nicht die Handschrift bestimmter lebender Muralisten nachahmen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not imitate the signature styles of specific living muralists.

styles.era_origin: From c. 2005 (Houston), worldwide.
visual_markers: knitted and crocheted covers sewn around street objects
styles.prompt_fragment: Yarn bombing: the subject wrapped or formed in hand-knitted and crocheted covers in clashing bright stripes and granny squares, sewn tightly on site around urban street furniture, trees or railings; visible seams, stretched stitches, dirt and rain-felted fibres; documentary daylight photo with everyday city background.
styles.avoid: Avoid cute plush renders and clean crochet product shots; it must be an outdoor intervention.
styles.feasibility_note: Knit texture and urban context are reliable.
styles.short_de: Laternen, Bäume und Geländer, eingehüllt in gestrickte und gehäkelte Überzüge mit grellen, bunt zusammengewürfelten Streifen; eine Guerilla-Handarbeit, die um 2005 in Houston begann.
styles.short_en: Street furniture, trees and railings wrapped in hand-knitted and crocheted covers in clashing bright stripes, a guerrilla craft that started in Houston around 2005.
markers_de: gestrickte und gehäkelte Überzüge, vor Ort um Stadtmobiliar genäht
grelle, wild kombinierte Streifen, Granny Squares
markers_en: knitted and crocheted covers sewn around street objects on site

styles.era_origin: Global, from the late 1990s.
visual_markers: image made from strips of coloured and black adhesive tape
straight torn ends, angular approximated curves
styles.prompt_fragment: Tape art: the image built entirely from strips of coloured and black adhesive tape applied to a wall or floor; straight torn ends, slightly overlapping translucent layers, angular contours approximating curves, faint wrinkles and lifted edges; concrete wall or interior setting, documentary photo.
styles.avoid: Avoid vector flat-design shapes; edges must look like torn tape.
styles.feasibility_note: Tape material is convincing.
styles.short_de: Bilder ganz aus Streifen farbigen Klebebands auf Wand oder Boden, mit abgerissenen Enden und eckig angenäherten Rundungen; Street-Art und Installationskunst seit Ende der 1980er-Jahre.
styles.short_en: Images made entirely from strips of coloured tape on walls or floors, with torn ends and angular curves; street and installation art since the late 1980s.
styles.era_de: seit Ende der 1980er, zuerst USA, dann weltweit
styles.era_en: since the late 1980s, first USA, then worldwide
markers_de: Bild aus Streifen farbigen und schwarzen Klebebands
gerade abgerissene Enden, eckig angenäherte Rundungen
markers_en: image built from strips of coloured and black tape
straight torn ends, angular approximated curves

styles.era_origin: Edo Japan, c. 1760s-1840s.
visual_markers: small square format on thick soft paper
metallic brass and silver dust, mica
styles.prompt_fragment: Edo-period surimono woodblock print: small square format on thick soft paper; refined subdued colours, delicate keyblock lines, sparkling metallic brass and silver dust, mica and colourless blind-embossed textures in fabrics; elegant still-life-like arrangement with columns of flowing kana poetry calligraphy.
styles.avoid: Avoid bold commercial ukiyo-e colour and Shin-hanga gradients; emphasise embossing, metallics and intimacy.
styles.feasibility_note: Embossing and metallics are subtle; calligraphy will be pseudo-Japanese.
styles.sensitivity_note: Pseudo-Japanese script; avoid nonsensical text in culturally sensitive contexts.
styles.short_de: Kleine, privat in Auftrag gegebene Holzschnitte mit Gedichten, Metallpuder und Blindprägung auf dickem Papier, gedruckt für Dichterzirkel im Japan der Edo-Zeit, etwa 1760er–1840er.
styles.short_en: Small, privately commissioned woodblock prints with poems, metallic powders and blind embossing on thick paper, made for poetry circles in Edo-period Japan, about 1760s–1840s.
markers_de: kleines quadratisches Format auf dickem, weichem Papier
markers_en: small square format on thick soft paper
metallic brass and silver powder, mica
styles.sensitivity_de: Generierte japanische Schrift ist meist sinnlos; Scheintext in kulturell heiklen Zusammenhängen vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Generated Japanese script is usually nonsense; avoid fake text in culturally sensitive contexts.

styles.era_origin: Edo Japan, 17th-19th century.
visual_markers: inlaid dark eyes, cord holes underneath
styles.prompt_fragment: Edo-period netsuke: the subject carved as a palm-sized compact toggle in honey-toned boxwood or creamy bone, curled tightly with no fragile protrusions; finely incised fur, fabric and hair, inlaid dark eyes, two small cord holes underneath; smooth worn handling patina; museum macro photo on dark velvet.
styles.avoid: Avoid glossy 3D figurine renders and large sculpture scale; keep the miniature, compact, patinated carving.
styles.feasibility_note: Macro carving look is reliable.
styles.sensitivity_note: Many historic netsuke are ivory; specify boxwood or bone and avoid glamorising ivory.
styles.short_de: Handtellergroße, kompakt geschnitzte Knebel aus Buchsbaum oder Knochen mit fein geritzten Details und Schnurlöchern, mit denen man im Japan der Edo-Zeit Beutel am Kimonogürtel befestigte.
styles.short_en: Palm-sized carved toggles of boxwood or bone, compact and worn smooth, with finely incised detail and cord holes, that fastened pouches to the kimono sash in Edo Japan.
markers_de: handtellergroße, kompakte Schnitzerei ohne abstehende Teile
eingelegte dunkle Augen, Schnurlöcher an der Unterseite
markers_en: inlaid dark eyes, cord holes underneath
styles.sensitivity_de: Viele historische Netsuke sind aus Elfenbein; Buchsbaum oder Knochen vorgeben und Elfenbein nicht verklären.
styles.sensitivity_en: Many historic netsuke are ivory; specify boxwood or bone and do not glamorise ivory.

styles.era_origin: Ainu of Hokkaido, Sakhalin and Kurils; documented from the 18th century, living tradition.
visual_markers: white and red cotton appliqué on deep indigo
styles.prompt_fragment: Ainu-style pattern work: bold symmetrical arrangement of swirling spiral scrolls and thorn-tipped hooks in appliquéd white and red cotton strips on deep indigo cloth, outlined with chain stitching, or the same scrolls shallow-carved into wood; flat, frontal, strong figure-ground balance.
styles.avoid: Avoid generic Celtic spirals and Maori koru; keep Ainu thorn tips and appliqué textile.
styles.feasibility_note: Scrolls drift toward generic spirals; thorn tips need emphasis.
styles.sensitivity_note: Indigenous Ainu heritage long suppressed by assimilation policy; patterns had protective meanings. Avoid commercial appropriation and credit the culture.
styles.short_de: Symmetrische Spiralranken und dornartige Haken aus aufgenähten Stoffstreifen und Kettenstich auf dunklen Gewändern oder in Holz geschnitzt; Ornamentik der Ainu auf Hokkaidō und Sachalin.
styles.short_en: Symmetrical spiral scrolls and thorn-like hooks in appliquéd cloth strips and chain stitch on dark robes, or carved into wood, made by the Ainu of Hokkaido and Sakhalin.
styles.era_de: belegt seit dem 18. Jh., Hokkaidō, Sachalin, Kurilen; lebendige Tradition
styles.era_en: documented from the 18th century, Hokkaido, Sakhalin, Kurils; living tradition
markers_de: weiße und rote Baumwollapplikation auf tiefem Indigo
dieselben Ranken flach in Holz geschnitzt
markers_en: white and red cotton appliqué on deep indigo
styles.sensitivity_de: Die Muster der Ainu, deren Kultur lange durch Assimilationspolitik unterdrückt wurde, hatten schützende Bedeutung; Herkunft nennen und kommerzielle Aneignung vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Ainu patterns, from a culture long suppressed by assimilation policy, had protective meaning; credit the culture and avoid commercial appropriation.

styles.era_origin: Korea, Goryeo dynasty, 12th-13th century.
visual_markers: inlaid white and black slip lines under glaze
fine crackle, pooled darker glaze in recesses
styles.prompt_fragment: Goryeo celadon with sanggam inlay: the subject inlaid in white and black slip beneath a translucent pale jade-green glaze, appearing as thin white and black lines and flat white areas; roundel medallions on a field of floating cloud motifs; fine glaze crackle, darker green pooling in recesses; soft museum light.
styles.avoid: Avoid Chinese blue-and-white porcelain and glossy modern ceramics; keep dreamy jade glaze with inlaid white-black lines.
styles.feasibility_note: Glaze colour works; inlay versus overglaze painting may blur.
styles.short_de: Blassgrün glasiertes Steinzeug mit weißem und schwarzem Schlicker, unter der Glasur als feine Linien, Kraniche, Wolken und Medaillons eingelegt; Korea, Goryeo-Dynastie, 12. und 13. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Pale jade-green glazed stoneware with white and black slip inlaid under the glaze as fine lines, cranes, clouds and roundels, made in Goryeo-dynasty Korea in the 12th–13th centuries.
markers_de: weiße und schwarze Schlickereinlage unter der Glasur
feines Craquelé, dunklere Glasur in Vertiefungen
markers_en: white and black slip inlay under the glaze
fine crackle, darker glaze pooled in recesses

styles.era_origin: China, Neolithic to Qing; peak of virtuosity in 18th-century Qing.
visual_markers: russet skin used for colour accents
styles.prompt_fragment: Chinese jade carving: the subject carved from a single translucent mottled block of nephrite, celadon green, mutton-fat white and russet skin used deliberately for colour accents; soft waxy lustre, rounded edges, delicate openwork and undercutting, light glowing through thin parts; on a carved hardwood stand, soft studio light.
styles.avoid: Avoid glossy green plastic or glass; keep waxy translucency and natural colour variation.
styles.feasibility_note: Translucent stone material renders well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Jade carries ritual and status meaning; avoid 'oriental' kitsch framing.
styles.short_de: Durchscheinender Nephrit, zu gerundeten Formen mit Durchbrüchen und Hinterschneidungen geschnitzt, die rostbraune Rinde als Farbakzent genutzt; in China seit der Jungsteinzeit, Höhepunkt im 18. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Translucent nephrite carved into rounded forms with openwork and undercutting, its russet skin used for colour accents; made in China since the Neolithic, peaking in the 18th century.
styles.era_de: seit der Jungsteinzeit, China; Höhepunkt im 18. Jh. (Qing)
styles.era_en: Neolithic onwards, China; peak in the 18th century (Qing)
markers_en: russet skin used for colour accents
styles.sensitivity_de: Jade hat rituelle und gesellschaftliche Bedeutung; keine orientalisierende Kitsch-Inszenierung.
styles.sensitivity_en: Jade carries ritual and status meaning; avoid 'oriental' kitsch framing.

styles.era_origin: Mongolia, early 20th century, revived from the 1990s.
visual_markers: panoramic high viewpoint crowded with tiny figures
simultaneous daily activities across the picture
fine black contours, flat mineral colours on cotton
styles.prompt_fragment: Mongol zurag painting: panoramic high-viewpoint composition crammed with countless tiny figures and animals engaged in simultaneous daily activities; fine black contour lines and flat mineral colours on primed cotton, vivid green ground, cobalt hills, white, red and ochre; thangka-like precision without perspective diminution; decorative cloud forms.
styles.avoid: Avoid deity-centred thangka layout and Western naive art; keep the panoramic secular scene.
styles.feasibility_note: Crowded panoramas work; tiny figures can melt into noise.
styles.sensitivity_note: Living tradition; avoid exoticising nomadic life.
styles.short_de: Panoramen voller winziger Figuren bei alltäglicher Arbeit, in feinen schwarzen Linien und flachen Mineralfarben auf Baumwolle; mongolische Malerei des frühen 20. Jahrhunderts, nach 1990 wiederbelebt.
styles.short_en: Panoramic scenes crowded with tiny figures at daily work, in fine black lines and flat mineral colours on cotton; Mongolian, early 20th century, revived after 1990.
styles.era_de: frühes 20. Jh., Mongolei; Wiederbelebung seit den 1990ern
styles.era_en: early 20th century, Mongolia; revived from the 1990s
markers_de: Panorama aus hoher Sicht mit unzähligen kleinen Figuren
feine schwarze Konturen, flache Mineralfarben auf Baumwolle
markers_en: panoramic high viewpoint crowded with tiny figures
fine black contours, flat mineral colours on cotton
styles.sensitivity_de: Lebendige Tradition; Nomadenleben nicht exotisieren.
styles.sensitivity_en: Living tradition; avoid exoticising nomadic life.

styles.era_origin: Deccan sultanates (Bijapur, Golconda, Ahmadnagar), c. 1560-1700; later Hyderabad.
visual_markers: intense lilac, purple, emerald, turquoise, pink
tall languid figures in patterned textiles
dreamlike oversized flowers and swirling rocks
styles.prompt_fragment: Deccani court painting: opaque watercolour and lavish gold on burnished paper; tall languid figures in sumptuous patterned textiles; dreamlike setting with oversized flowering plants, swirling rocks and gold sky; intense palette of lilac, deep purple, emerald, turquoise and pink; poetic, mysterious mood; fine gold rules and floral border.
styles.avoid: Avoid Mughal naturalism and Rajasthani flat primaries; keep the unusual purples and dreamlike lushness.
styles.feasibility_note: Palette is achievable; model tends toward generic Mughal miniature.
styles.short_de: Deckfarben und reichlich Gold, hochgewachsene, versonnene Figuren, übergroße Blumen und kräftiges Lila, Purpur und Türkis; Hofmalerei der Dekkan-Sultanate in Indien, etwa 1560–1700.
styles.short_en: Opaque watercolour and lavish gold with tall, languid figures, oversized flowers and intense lilac, purple and turquoise, painted at the courts of the Deccan sultanates, India, c. 1560–1700.
styles.era_en: c. 1560–1700, Deccan sultanates (Bijapur, Golconda, Ahmadnagar), India
markers_de: reichlich Gold in Himmel und Details
kräftiges Lila, Purpur, Smaragd, Türkis, Rosa
hochgewachsene, versonnene Figuren in gemusterten Stoffen
markers_en: intense lilac, purple, emerald, turquoise, pink
tall languid figures in patterned textiles

styles.era_origin: Sri Lanka, Kandyan period, c. 1750-1850.
visual_markers: deep vermilion grounds densely filled with flowers and scrolls
flat figures with yellow-ochre skin and black outlines
limited red, yellow, white, black, green palette
styles.prompt_fragment: Sri Lankan Kandyan temple mural: continuous horizontal narrative registers separated by ornamented bands; deep vermilion background densely filled with stylised flowers and scrolls; flat figures with yellow-ochre faces, black outlines and stylised gestures; limited palette of red, yellow, white, black and green; matte tempera on cracked lime plaster.
styles.avoid: Avoid Thai gold-and-black murals and Indian miniatures; keep strip format and red ground.
styles.feasibility_note: Register layout is good for sequences; figure style may drift to Thai or Indian.
styles.sensitivity_note: Buddhist temple art (Jataka tales); avoid placing Buddha figures in profane contexts.
styles.short_de: Durchlaufende Erzählbänder mit flachen, schwarz umrandeten Figuren auf tiefem Zinnoberrot voller Blüten und Ranken; Malerei buddhistischer Tempel Sri Lankas aus der Kandy-Zeit, etwa 1750–1850.
styles.short_en: Continuous narrative bands of flat, black-outlined figures on deep vermilion grounds filled with flowers and scrolls, painted in Buddhist temples of Sri Lanka's Kandyan period, c. 1750–1850.
markers_de: tiefroter Grund dicht mit Blüten und Ranken
flache Figuren, ockergelbe Haut, schwarze Umrisse
begrenzte Palette aus Rot, Gelb, Weiß, Schwarz, Grün
markers_en: deep vermilion ground dense with flowers and scrolls
flat figures, yellow-ochre skin, black outlines
limited red, yellow, white, black, green palette
styles.sensitivity_de: Buddhistische Tempelkunst mit Jataka-Erzählungen; Buddha-Figuren nicht in profane Zusammenhänge setzen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Buddhist temple art depicting Jataka tales; do not place Buddha figures in profane contexts.

styles.era_origin: Tamil Nadu, Chola dynasty, 9th-13th century.
visual_markers: smooth rounded sinuous figures in triple-bend pose
slender waist, tall crown, finely cast jewellery
dark brown-green patina with golden highlights
styles.prompt_fragment: South Indian Chola lost-wax bronze: smooth, rounded, sinuous form in a graceful triple-bend pose with slender waist and fluid limbs, tall crown and finely cast jewellery; on a lotus pedestal framed by a circular aureole of flames; dark brown-green patina with worn golden highlights; dark museum background, single spotlight.
styles.avoid: Avoid modern resin statues and brass souvenirs; keep the classical proportions and real patina.
styles.feasibility_note: Bronze patina and pose are reliable.

styles.avoid: Avoid embroidery and flat printed patterns; keep raised glossy paint lines and fold symmetry.
styles.feasibility_note: Symmetry is easy; raised-paint relief may look embroidered.
styles.sensitivity_note: Practised by very few families; credit origin.

styles.prompt_fragment: Maya backstrap-loom brocade: subject woven as supplementary-weft motifs with slightly raised floating threads in horizontal bands of zigzags, diamonds and stylised birds; dominant deep red cotton ground with saturated purple, yellow, green, blue and white; tight handwoven texture, panel seams, slightly irregular selvages.

styles.sensitivity_note: Living Indigenous heritage with community-specific designs; Maya weavers campaign against commercial copying, so credit and avoid commercial misuse.
styles.verdict_reason: Confirmed as community-owned. Maya weavers' organisations have pressed an explicit, organised claim to collective intellectual property in their designs. My web check of the specifics failed, so they rest on memory: AFEDES and the Movimiento Nacional de Tejedoras Mayas petitioned the Guatemalan Constitutional Court in 2016, and law initiative 5247 followed in 2017. A prompt that applies their brocade to any subject is exactly what they oppose. One conflict to flag: dine-weaving, also a living Indigenous textile tradition with community concerns, currently keeps its prompt. Both should be decided the same way.
styles.short_de: Broschierte Muster aus Zickzack, Rauten und Vögeln in Bändern auf meist tiefrotem Baumwollgrund, von Maya-Frauen im Hochland Guatemalas und in Chiapas am Rückengurtwebstuhl gewebt; lebendige Tradition.
styles.short_en: Supplementary-weft brocade in bands of zigzags, diamonds and birds on mostly deep red cotton, woven on backstrap looms by Maya women in highland Guatemala and Chiapas; living tradition.
styles.era_de: präkolumbische Wurzeln, lebendige Tradition; Hochland Guatemalas und Chiapas
styles.era_en: pre-Columbian roots, living tradition; highland Guatemala and Chiapas
markers_de: waagrechte Bänder mit Zickzack, Rauten, Vögeln

styles.sensitivity_de: Lebendiges indigenes Erbe mit gemeindespezifischen Mustern, die Maya-Weberinnen als kollektives geistiges Eigentum beanspruchen; deshalb kein Prompt.
styles.sensitivity_en: Living Indigenous heritage with community-specific designs that Maya weavers claim as collective intellectual property; therefore no prompt is offered.

styles.avoid: Avoid glazed ceramics and Greek black-figure; it is matte-on-gloss black only.
styles.feasibility_note: Gloss-versus-matte black contrast is subtle and may be lost.
styles.sensitivity_note: Indigenous Pueblo art; avoid sacred motifs (e.g. avanyu) out of context and credit the pueblos.

styles.era_origin: A variant of Herschel's 1842 cyanotype that alternative-process photographers spread through social media in the 2010s.
visual_markers: Prussian blue base broken by olive, ochre, turquoise and violet blooms
bleeding tide lines and liquid fronts
hand-brushed sensitiser edges on watercolour paper
sharp contact detail only where paper touched the glass

styles.avoid: Avoid clean two-tone blue-and-white cyanotype and digital colour overlays; the colours must look chemically grown, blotchy and organic.
styles.feasibility_note: Mottled chemistry and blooms render well; keeping the underlying image legible needs an explicit instruction.
styles.short_de: Cyanotypien, die feucht und mit Zusätzen wie Essig, Salz oder Kurkuma belichtet werden, sodass das Blau in olivgrüne, ockerfarbene und violette Flecken aufbricht; verbreitet seit den 2010ern.
styles.short_en: Cyanotype prints exposed while damp and treated with additives like vinegar, salt or turmeric, so the blue breaks into olive, ochre and violet blooms; popular since the 2010s.
styles.era_en: since the 2010s, international (based on the 1842 cyanotype)

styles.era_origin: Silver positives on glass backed with powdered gold or bronze in a varnish binder, popular in the United States c. 1900-1930s.
visual_markers: metallic amber-gold glow confined to the highlights
ornate carved and gilded period frame
styles.prompt_fragment: orotone photograph, a silver positive on glass backed with powdered gold pigment, highlights shimmering metallic amber-gold, shadows deep warm umber, soft romantic pictorialist focus, faint reflections on the thick glass surface, mounted in an ornate carved and gilded early-twentieth-century frame
styles.avoid: Avoid flat yellow sepia and glossy digital gold-foil effects; the gold should shimmer from behind the glass, and only in the highlights.
styles.feasibility_note: The metallic shimmer is only approximated, and the model can fall back to a plain gold-tinted photo without the depth of the glass.
styles.sensitivity_note: Closely tied to early-20th-century romanticised 'vanishing race' portraits of Native Americans; avoid reproducing those stereotypes.
styles.short_de: Fotografische Positive auf Glas, rückseitig mit goldfarbenem Pulver hinterlegt, sodass die Lichter metallisch-bernsteinfarben hinter dem Glas schimmern; in den USA etwa 1900 bis in die 1930er verbreitet.
styles.short_en: Photographic positives on glass backed with gold-coloured powder, so highlights shimmer metallic amber behind the glass; popular in the United States c. 1900–1930s.
markers_en: metallic amber-gold glow in the highlights
styles.sensitivity_de: Eng verbunden mit romantisierenden Porträts indigener Nordamerikaner als „aussterbende Rasse“ im frühen 20. Jahrhundert; diese Stereotype nicht wiederholen.

styles.era_origin: A Victorian technique (c. 1880-1910): an albumen print pasted face-down onto convex glass, rubbed translucent and hand-painted from behind.
visual_markers: domed convex glass with curved highlight reflections
porcelain-smooth glowing colours painted from behind
tiny air bubbles and lifting at the edges
styles.prompt_fragment: Victorian crystoleum, a photograph pasted behind domed convex glass, the paper rubbed translucent and painted from the reverse in soft enamel-like colours, porcelain-smooth complexions and pastel backgrounds, curved highlight reflections across the glass, tiny air bubbles and lifting at the edges, set in a gilt oval bezel
styles.avoid: Avoid ordinary hand-tinted prints on flat paper; the domed glass, inner glow and slight delamination are what make it a crystoleum.
styles.feasibility_note: Convex glass reflections render well; the painted-from-behind softness may come out as generic hand-colouring.
styles.short_de: Viktorianische Fotografien, mit der Bildseite hinter gewölbtes Glas geklebt, durchscheinend gerieben und rückseitig bemalt, mit leuchtenden, porzellanglatten Farben; verbreitet um 1880–1910.
styles.short_en: Victorian photographs pasted face-down behind domed glass, rubbed translucent and hand-painted from the back, giving glowing porcelain-smooth colour; popular c. 1880–1910.

styles.era_origin: A darkroom technique that sandwiches a negative and a positive and exposes them with oblique light, codified in Kodak darkroom manuals of the 1960s-70s; equidensity contour film followed around 1970.
visual_markers: photograph reduced to thin black contour lines on white
styles.prompt_fragment: darkroom tone-line conversion, a photograph reduced to fine black contour lines on white like a pen drawing, every edge traced with photographic precision, slightly doubled and uneven line weight from the negative-positive sandwich, no midtones at all, faint grain specks, high-contrast lith paper print
styles.avoid: Avoid loose hand-drawn sketch looks and noisy digital edge-detect filters; the lines must follow photographic contours exactly and stay crisp.
styles.feasibility_note: Line conversion renders well but can drift into freehand illustration.
styles.short_de: Dunkelkammerverfahren, das ein Foto durch ein Sandwich aus Negativ und Positiv auf dünne schwarze Konturlinien auf Weiß reduziert; beschrieben in Laborhandbüchern der 1960er und 70er.
styles.short_en: Darkroom conversion that reduces a photograph to thin black contour lines on white by sandwiching negative and positive; described in darkroom manuals of the 1960s–70s.
