styles.era_origin: A mid-century darkroom effect: a negative and a positive are printed slightly out of register. It featured in camera-club and Kodak darkroom guides of the 1950s-70s.
visual_markers: every edge with a light rim on one side and a dark rim on the other
styles.prompt_fragment: darkroom bas-relief print, negative and positive sandwiched slightly out of register so every edge carries a light rim on one side and a dark rim on the other, flattened mid-grey tones like carved stone relief, monochrome silver gelatin, fine grain, camera-club experimental print
styles.avoid: Avoid shiny 3D emboss filters and coloured bevels; it must stay a flat grey photographic print with offset edge lines.
styles.feasibility_note: The offset-relief logic is sometimes rendered as a generic emboss or sculpture.
styles.short_de: Dunkelkammereffekt: Negativ und Positiv werden leicht versetzt zusammen kopiert, sodass jede Kante einen hellen und einen dunklen Rand wie bei einem Relief erhält; beliebt 1950er–70er.
styles.short_en: Darkroom effect: negative and positive printed slightly out of register, so every edge gets a light and a dark rim like carved relief; popular 1950s–70s.
markers_de: jede Kante mit hellem Rand auf der einen, dunklem auf der anderen Seite
markers_en: light rim on one side and dark rim on the other of every edge
monochrome silver gelatin with fine grain

styles.era_origin: Expressive painting straight onto photographic prints, a strand of postwar European art from the 1960s that is now common in contemporary mixed media.
visual_markers: photo partly obliterated by gestural oil or acrylic strokes
scribbled crayon hatching over faces and edges
drips and thick smears on a glossy print
tension between photographic detail and painted marks
styles.prompt_fragment: photograph overpainted by hand, a glossy black-and-white or colour print partly obliterated by gestural strokes of oil paint and wax crayon, scribbled hatching over faces and contours, drips and thick smears sitting on the surface, raw cardboard mount, raw tension between photographic detail and violent painted marks
styles.avoid: Avoid delicate hand-tinting and digital brush overlays; the paint must sit physically on top and cover parts of the image.
styles.feasibility_note: Paint-on-photo layering renders well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Associated with living artists; do not name them in prompts.
styles.short_de: Fotoabzüge, teilweise mit gestischer Ölfarbe, Wachskreide und Farbläufen übermalt, sodass Malspuren und fotografisches Detail aufeinanderprallen; eine Linie europäischer Kunst seit den 1960ern.
styles.short_en: Photographic prints partly covered with gestural oil paint, crayon and drips, so painted marks clash with photographic detail; a strand of European art since the 1960s.
markers_de: Foto teils von gestischen Öl- oder Acrylstrichen verdeckt
gekritzelte Kreideschraffuren über Gesichtern und Konturen
Farbläufe und dicke Schlieren auf glänzendem Abzug
markers_en: photo partly obliterated by gestural oil or acrylic strokes
scribbled crayon hatching over faces and edges
drips and thick smears on a glossy print
styles.sensitivity_de: Mit lebenden Künstlern verbunden; deren Namen nicht in Prompts verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Associated with living artists; do not name them in prompts.

styles.era_origin: A contemporary mixed-media practice, widespread since the 2000s, of stitching coloured thread straight through vintage or new photographic prints.
visual_markers: bright thread pierced through a paper print
satin-stitch fills over clothing or sky
visible needle holes and paper puckering
styles.prompt_fragment: found vintage photograph embroidered by hand, bright cotton thread stitched straight through the paper print, satin-stitch fills covering parts of clothing or sky, radiating straight thread lines between points, visible needle holes and slight paper puckering, loose thread ends, shot flat on a table
styles.avoid: Avoid fully embroidered textile pictures and digital line overlays; the photograph must remain visible, with real thread pierced through it.
styles.feasibility_note: Thread on paper renders convincingly; stitch logic is sometimes imprecise.
styles.short_de: Alte oder neue Fotoabzüge, mit farbigem Garn in Flachstichflächen und geraden, strahlenförmigen Linien durchstickt; eine seit den 2000ern verbreitete Mixed-Media-Praxis.
styles.short_en: Vintage or new photographic prints stitched through with bright thread in satin fills and straight radiating lines; a mixed-media practice widespread since the 2000s.
markers_de: leuchtendes Garn durch den Papierabzug gestochen
markers_en: bright thread pierced through a paper print
satin-stitch fills over clothing or sky

styles.era_origin: Brush-on silver gelatin emulsions, sold commercially from the 1970s, used to print photographs on wood, stone, ceramics, eggs and fabric.
visual_markers: monochrome image following an uneven substrate
wood grain, slate or ceramic texture showing through
ragged brushed edges and pooled emulsion
styles.prompt_fragment: black-and-white photograph printed with hand-brushed liquid silver emulsion onto a rough found surface such as weathered wood, slate or a broken ceramic shard, the image following the grain and cracks of the material, ragged brushed edges, pooled and flaking emulsion, patchy density, photographed as an object
styles.avoid: Avoid digital texture overlays on a normal photo; the image must physically sit on, and be shaped by, an uneven object.
styles.feasibility_note: Object context renders well; the image may be too clean and lack the patchy coating.
styles.sensitivity_note: 'Liquid Light' is a product name; describe the process generically.
styles.short_de: Schwarzweißfotos, mit aufgepinselter Silberemulsion auf Holz, Stein, Keramik oder Stoff vergrößert, wobei das Bild der Maserung und den Rissen des Materials folgt; verbreitet seit den 1970ern.
styles.short_en: Black-and-white photographs printed with brush-on silver emulsion onto wood, stone, ceramics or fabric, the image following the material's grain and cracks; common since the 1970s.
markers_en: monochrome image following an uneven surface
wood grain, slate or ceramic texture showing through
ragged brushed edges and pooled emulsion
styles.sensitivity_de: „Liquid Light“ ist ein Produktname; das Verfahren allgemein beschreiben.
styles.sensitivity_en: 'Liquid Light' is a product name; describe the process generically.

styles.era_origin: Self-adhesive 'magnetic' albums with clear plastic overlays were the dominant family album format c. 1970-1995.
visual_markers: several snapshots under yellowed clear plastic film
wavy glare and trapped air bubbles
ribbed adhesive strips visible on the cardboard
styles.prompt_fragment: page of a 1970s-80s self-adhesive photo album, several faded rounded-corner colour snapshots pressed under yellowing clear plastic film, wavy glare and trapped air bubbles, ribbed adhesive strips showing through the cardboard, ballpoint captions and dates, slightly lifted corners, photographed straight-on under room light
styles.avoid: Avoid black-page albums with photo corners and pristine scrapbook layouts; the yellowed plastic sheen and adhesive ribbing are key.
styles.feasibility_note: Plastic glare and page layout render well; the individual snapshots may look too uniform.
styles.short_de: Seiten selbstklebender Familienalben mit Schnappschüssen unter vergilbender Klarsichtfolie, gerippten Klebestreifen und Kugelschreiber-Beschriftungen; das gängige Fotoalbum etwa von 1970 bis 1995.
styles.short_en: Pages of self-adhesive family albums with snapshots under yellowing clear plastic, ribbed glue strips and ballpoint captions, the standard home album c. 1970–1995.
markers_en: snapshots under yellowed clear plastic film
wavy glare and trapped air bubbles
ribbed adhesive strips on the card

styles.era_origin: Cardboard discs holding seven pairs of tiny colour transparencies for a handheld stereo viewer, introduced in 1939 and a ubiquitous toy and souvenir through the 1990s.
visual_markers: white cardboard disc with central hole
fourteen tiny rectangular transparencies in a ring
matching image pairs glowing with saturated slide colour
printed title and numbers on the rim
styles.prompt_fragment: white cardboard stereo viewer reel held up to the light, fourteen tiny rectangular colour transparencies arranged in a ring around a central hole, each glowing with saturated mid-century slide colour, opposite windows showing matching image pairs, small printed title and numbers on the rim, slight wear and fingerprints
styles.avoid: Avoid single slide mounts and modern VR headsets; the circular disc of paired micro-transparencies is the signature.
styles.feasibility_note: The disc layout renders well, but keeping consistent tiny images across fourteen windows is unreliable.
styles.sensitivity_note: View-Master is a trademark; use 'stereo viewer reel' in prompts.
styles.short_de: Weiße Pappscheiben mit sieben Paaren winziger Farbdias für einen Stereobetrachter, 1939 eingeführt und bis in die 1990er ein verbreitetes Spielzeug und Souvenir.
styles.short_en: White cardboard discs holding seven pairs of tiny colour transparencies for a handheld stereo viewer, introduced in 1939 and a common toy and souvenir until the 1990s.
markers_de: aufgedruckter Titel und Nummern am Rand
markers_en: white cardboard disc with central hole
fourteen tiny transparencies in a ring
matching image pairs in saturated slide colour
printed title and numbers on the rim
styles.sensitivity_de: View-Master ist eine Marke; in Prompts den Begriff „stereo viewer reel“ verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: View-Master is a trademark; use 'stereo viewer reel' in prompts.

styles.era_origin: Single-image stereograms developed by Christopher Tyler and Maureen Clarke in 1979 and popularised by best-selling poster books in the early 1990s.
visual_markers: dense repeating pattern in vertical strips
subtle horizontal shifts hiding a 3D shape
busy saturated 1990s textures or random dots
two guide dots at the top
styles.prompt_fragment: 1990s autostereogram poster, a dense repeating pattern tiled in vertical strips with subtle horizontal shifts that hide a three-dimensional shape, busy saturated textures of leaves, pebbles or random dots, no visible focal subject at first glance, two small guide dots centred at the top
styles.avoid: Avoid showing the hidden subject plainly or using red-cyan anaglyph; the image should look like pure repeating texture.
styles.feasibility_note: The repeating-pattern look is easy, but a correctly encoded, viewable hidden 3D shape is essentially impossible by prompt alone.
styles.sensitivity_note: 'Magic Eye' is a trademark; use 'autostereogram' in prompts.
styles.short_de: Dichte, in senkrechten Streifen wiederholte Muster, in denen eine 3D-Form verborgen ist, die beim Schielen oder Durchblicken erscheint; 1979 entwickelt, Anfang der 1990er ein Massenphänomen.
styles.short_en: Dense repeating patterns in vertical strips that hide a 3D shape seen by defocused viewing; developed in 1979, a poster-book craze in the early 1990s.
styles.era_de: 1979 entwickelt, Boom Anfang der 1990er, USA und weltweit
styles.era_en: developed 1979, boom in the early 1990s, USA and worldwide
markers_en: dense repeating pattern in vertical strips
subtle horizontal shifts hiding a 3D shape
busy saturated textures or random dots
two guide dots at the top
styles.sensitivity_de: „Magic Eye“ ist eine Marke; in Prompts „autostereogram“ verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: 'Magic Eye' is a trademark; use 'autostereogram' in prompts.

styles.era_origin: Family and travel slide shows on 35mm carousel projectors aimed at beaded screens or living-room walls, c. 1950s-1980s.
visual_markers: bright hot spot falling off to dim corners
styles.prompt_fragment: colour slide projected in a darkened living room onto a beaded screen, bright hot spot in the centre falling off to dim corners, slight keystone distortion and soft focus along one edge, magnified dust and a stray hair, faint screen texture, dusty projector beam and silhouetted heads along the bottom edge
styles.avoid: Avoid clean digital photos on modern screens and slides on a lightbox; the projected falloff and the room context matter.
styles.feasibility_note: Projection falloff and room context render well.
styles.short_de: Farbdias, im abgedunkelten Wohnzimmer auf eine Perlleinwand projiziert, mit hellem Zentrum, Trapezverzerrung und vergrößertem Staub; der Dia-Abend der 1950er bis 1980er.
styles.short_en: Colour slides projected in a darkened living room onto a beaded screen, with hot-spot falloff, keystone distortion and magnified dust; the family slide night of c. 1950s–1980s.
markers_de: helles Zentrum, zu den Ecken abfallend
markers_en: bright hot spot falling off to dim corners

styles.era_origin: 35mm theatrical release prints with frames and an optical soundtrack, standard from the late 1920s until digital projection took over around 2012.
visual_markers: vertical strip of consecutive near-identical frames
wavy variable-area soundtrack beside the frames
scratches and dust on a warm backlit table
styles.prompt_fragment: strip of 35mm motion-picture release print held over a light table, four consecutive frames showing tiny progressive movement, perforations along both edges, a wavy variable-area optical soundtrack running beside the image, thin black frame lines, scratches and dust, warm backlit glow
styles.avoid: Avoid still-camera negative strips with orange mask and frame numbers; this is a positive cinema print with a soundtrack.
styles.feasibility_note: The strip and perforations render well; frame-to-frame consistency and the soundtrack waveform can be imprecise.
styles.short_de: Durchleuchteter Streifen einer 35-mm-Kinokopie mit aufeinanderfolgenden Einzelbildern, Perforation und welliger Lichttonspur; Kinostandard von den späten 1920ern bis etwa 2012.
styles.short_en: Backlit strip of 35mm cinema print with consecutive frames, perforations and a wavy optical soundtrack; the theatrical standard from the late 1920s to about 2012.
markers_de: Kratzer und Staub auf dem Leuchttisch
markers_en: vertical strip of near-identical consecutive frames
wavy variable-area soundtrack beside the frames
scratches and dust on a backlit table

styles.era_origin: Many portraits exposed onto a single plate, aligned at the eyes, introduced by Francis Galton in 1878 and revived digitally as face-averaging from the 1990s.
visual_markers: ghostly multiple outlines of hair, ears and collars
styles.prompt_fragment: composite photographic portrait made by superimposing many faint exposures of different faces aligned at the eyes, eerily smooth averaged features, sharp central eyes, ghostly multiple outlines of hair, ears and collars at the edges, strict frontal pose, Victorian plate tonality on an archival mount
styles.avoid: Avoid a single sharp portrait or an artistic double exposure with landscapes; the effect is many translucent faces averaged into one.
styles.feasibility_note: The ghostly edges work, but the model may render a single face with a mild blur.
styles.sensitivity_note: Historically tied to eugenics and 'criminal type' pseudoscience; never use it to suggest ethnic, racial or criminal types.
styles.short_de: Viele Gesichter, auf eine Platte belichtet und an den Augen ausgerichtet, ergeben ein glattes Durchschnittsgesicht mit geisterhaften Rändern; 1878 von Francis Galton eingeführt.
styles.short_en: Many faces exposed onto one plate and aligned at the eyes, producing a smooth averaged face with ghostly edges; introduced by Francis Galton in 1878.
styles.era_de: ab 1878, England; digital wiederbelebt seit den 1990ern
styles.era_en: from 1878, England; revived digitally since the 1990s
markers_de: geisterhafte Mehrfachkonturen von Haar, Ohren und Kragen
markers_en: ghostly multiple outlines of hair, ears and collars
styles.sensitivity_de: Historisch mit Eugenik und der Pseudowissenschaft vom „Verbrechertyp“ verknüpft; nie zur Darstellung ethnischer, rassischer oder krimineller Typen verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Historically tied to eugenics and 'criminal type' pseudoscience; never use it to suggest ethnic, racial or criminal types.

styles.era_origin: A conservation and archaeology documentation technique, standard since the early 20th century, in which one low-angle light reveals surface relief.
visual_markers: single hard light grazing almost parallel to the surface
every ridge, crack and brushstroke casting long micro-shadows
light falling off to darkness across the frame
styles.prompt_fragment: raking-light documentation photograph, a single hard lamp grazing the surface from one side at a very low angle, every ridge, crack, brushstroke and tool mark casting long micro-shadows, light falling off to darkness across the frame, neutral colour, flat frontal camera, scale bar and grey card at the edge
styles.avoid: Avoid moody product lighting with props; this is flat frontal documentation in which grazing light alone reveals the texture.
styles.feasibility_note: Grazing light and the scale-bar context render reliably.
styles.short_de: Dokumentationsfotos mit einer flach einfallenden Lampe, sodass jeder Riss, jeder Pinselstrich und jede Werkzeugspur einen Schatten wirft; seit dem frühen 20. Jahrhundert Standard in Restaurierung und Archäologie.
styles.short_en: Documentation photos lit by one low grazing lamp, so every crack, brushstroke and tool mark casts a shadow; standard in conservation and archaeology since the early 20th century.
styles.era_de: seit dem frühen 20. Jh., Museums- und Grabungsdokumentation
styles.era_en: since the early 20th century, museum and archaeological documentation
markers_de: einzelnes hartes Licht fast parallel zur Oberfläche
lange Mikroschatten an jedem Grat und Riss
Licht fällt über das Bild ins Dunkel ab
markers_en: single hard light grazing almost parallel to the surface
long micro-shadows from every ridge and crack
light falling off to darkness across the frame

styles.era_origin: Glass-plate astrophotography from the 1880s to the 1990s, for example the Carte du Ciel survey, studied as negatives annotated in ink.
visual_markers: inverted tones: dark specks on pale grey glass
handwritten ink circles, arrows and numbers
styles.prompt_fragment: archival astronomical glass plate negative on a lightbox, inverted tones with dark specks and smudges on pale grey glass, a fine engraved réseau grid, handwritten ink circles, arrows and catalogue numbers on the emulsion side, chipped corners, a paper label strip, dust and scratches
styles.avoid: Avoid colourful nebula astrophotography; tones must be inverted monochrome with handwritten annotation.
styles.feasibility_note: Inversion and annotation work; it may drift into a positive night-sky photo.
styles.short_de: Glasplatten-Negative des Nachthimmels mit dunklen Sternpunkten auf hellem Glas, feinem Gitternetz und handschriftlichen Tuschenotizen; in der Astronomie von den 1880ern bis in die 1990er genutzt.
styles.short_en: Glass-plate negatives of the night sky with dark star specks on pale glass, réseau grids and handwritten ink annotations, used in astronomy from the 1880s to the 1990s.
styles.era_de: 1880er–1990er, Sternwarten weltweit (z. B. Carte du Ciel)
markers_de: umgekehrte Tonwerte: dunkle Punkte auf hellgrauem Glas
markers_en: inverted tones: dark specks on pale grey glass
handwritten ink circles, arrows and numbers

styles.era_origin: A light-microscopy contrast method introduced by Georges Nomarski in the 1950s, standard for unstained living cells.
visual_markers: pseudo-3D embossed relief, as if lit obliquely
one edge bright and the opposite edge shadowed
smooth grey to faint bronze or lavender field
razor-thin focal plane and scale bar
styles.prompt_fragment: differential interference contrast micrograph, translucent structures appearing embossed as if lit obliquely from one side, one edge bright and the opposite edge shadowed, smooth grey to faintly bronze or lavender background, razor-thin focal plane, unstained transparency, small scale bar in a corner
styles.avoid: Avoid neon fluorescence colours and the grey 3D look of SEM; DIC reads as soft relief on a smooth neutral field.
styles.feasibility_note: The relief look is achievable but often drifts toward SEM or generic microscopy.
styles.short_de: Lichtmikroskopische Aufnahmen ungefärbter Zellen, die wie geprägt wirken, an einer Kante hell, an der anderen schattig; ein Verfahren, das Georges Nomarski in den 1950ern einführte.
styles.short_en: Light micrographs of unstained cells and tissues that look embossed, bright on one edge and shadowed on the other; a method introduced by Georges Nomarski in the 1950s.
styles.era_de: ab den 1950ern, Frankreich; heute Standard in der Zellbiologie
styles.era_en: from the 1950s, France; now standard in cell biology
markers_de: eine Kante hell, die gegenüberliegende dunkel
glatter grauer bis leicht bronze- oder lavendelfarbener Grund
markers_en: one edge bright, the opposite edge shadowed
smooth grey to faint bronze or lavender field
thin focal plane and scale bar

styles.era_origin: Volumetric ultrasound with surface rendering, common in obstetric clinics since the early 2000s.
visual_markers: soft lumpy forms with melted detail
murky dark surroundings with speckle noise
styles.prompt_fragment: surface-rendered 3D ultrasound image, waxy smooth amber and copper surfaces emerging from murky darkness, soft lumpy forms with melted detail, speckled acoustic noise and floating debris, clinic overlay text showing probe frequency, date and scale in small white type
styles.avoid: Avoid sharp photoreal skin and the grey fan-shaped 2D scan; it should look like a soft sepia volume rendering.
styles.feasibility_note: The waxy sepia rendering is achievable; anatomy may come out too crisp.
styles.sensitivity_note: Prenatal imagery is emotionally charged and politically contested; never use real patient data.
styles.short_de: Oberflächengerenderter Volumen-Ultraschall mit wachsartigen, bernstein- bis kupferfarbenen Formen, die aus trübem Dunkel und Rauschen auftauchen; in der Geburtsmedizin seit den frühen 2000ern verbreitet.
styles.short_en: Surface-rendered volumetric ultrasound with waxy amber-copper forms emerging from murky darkness and speckle noise, common in obstetric clinics since the early 2000s.
styles.era_en: since the early 2000s, obstetric clinics worldwide
markers_de: weiche, knollige Formen mit verschmolzenen Details
markers_en: soft lumpy forms with melted detail
murky dark surroundings with speckle noise
styles.sensitivity_de: Pränatale Bilder sind emotional aufgeladen und politisch umstritten; nie echte Patientendaten verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Prenatal imagery is emotionally charged and politically contested; never use real patient data.

styles.era_origin: Covert long-lens photography by police and intelligence services, iconic in Cold War and 1960s-90s case files.
visual_markers: grainy pushed black-and-white or faded colour
out-of-focus car frame or foliage in the foreground
grease-pencil circle and typed file label
styles.prompt_fragment: covert surveillance photograph shot from a parked car with a long telephoto lens, compressed perspective, grainy pushed black-and-white film, out-of-focus window frame and foliage in the foreground, unaware subjects mid-gesture, a grease-pencil circle and a typed file label with date and case number
styles.avoid: Avoid fixed high CCTV angles and polished wildlife-telephoto clarity; it must feel hidden, grainy and annotated as evidence.
styles.feasibility_note: The grain, foreground blur and file labels render convincingly.
styles.sensitivity_note: Never use it to depict real, identifiable people as surveillance targets.
styles.short_de: Körnige Teleaufnahmen, heimlich aus Autos oder Fenstern gemacht, mit unscharfem Vordergrund und Fettstiftmarkierungen; typisch für Polizei- und Geheimdienstakten der 1960er bis 1990er.
styles.short_en: Grainy long-lens photographs taken covertly from cars or windows, with blurred foreground framing and grease-pencil marks; typical of police and intelligence files of the 1960s–1990s.
markers_de: körniges, gepushtes Schwarzweiß oder verblasste Farbe
unscharfer Autorahmen oder Laub im Vordergrund
ahnungslose Personen mitten in der Bewegung
markers_en: grainy pushed black-and-white or faded colour
blurred car frame or foliage in the foreground
grease-pencil circle and typed file label
styles.sensitivity_de: Nie verwenden, um reale, erkennbare Personen als Observationsziel darzustellen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Never use it to depict real, identifiable people as surveillance targets.

styles.era_origin: Narrowband still-image transmission over amateur radio since the late 1950s, known to the public from space-station SSTV events.
visual_markers: missing scanlines and half-received bottom rows
styles.prompt_fragment: slow-scan television image received over shortwave radio, low-resolution 320-line picture with horizontal noise streaks, slight slant and smeared colour channels, missing scanlines and sudden static bands, bottom rows only half received, bold coloured callsign text and signal report overlaid in a blocky font
styles.avoid: Avoid VHS tracking noise and modern JPEG artefacts; the damage is line-by-line radio noise and smearing.
styles.feasibility_note: Line noise renders well; slant and the per-line colour smear are less consistent.
styles.sensitivity_note: Callsigns are real personal identifiers; use fictional ones.
styles.short_de: Niedrig aufgelöste Standbilder, zeilenweise über Amateurfunk übertragen, mit Störstreifen, Schräglauf, verschmierten Farben und eingeblendeten Rufzeichen; seit den späten 1950ern in Gebrauch.
styles.short_en: Low-resolution still images sent line by line over amateur radio, with noise streaks, slant, smeared colour and callsign overlays; in use since the late 1950s.
styles.era_de: seit Ende der 1950er, Amateurfunk (USA, dann weltweit)
styles.era_en: since the late 1950s, amateur radio (USA, then worldwide)
styles.sensitivity_de: Rufzeichen identifizieren reale Personen; nur erfundene verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Callsigns are real personal identifiers; use fictional ones.

styles.era_origin: A studio technique of flash-lit incense smoke against black, popular in camera clubs and stock photography since the 2000s.
visual_markers: delicate translucent wisps on pure black
styles.prompt_fragment: smoke-art photograph, thin silky wisps of incense smoke frozen by a side-placed flash against a pure black background, translucent curling tendrils and small vortices forming the shape, a gentle gelled colour tint, fine detail in every strand, nothing solid in the frame
styles.avoid: Avoid fog banks, flames and CGI particle glows; the form must be built only from thin, real smoke strands.
styles.feasibility_note: Smoke wisps render beautifully; recognisable shapes need simple subjects.
styles.short_de: Feine Schwaden von Räucherstäbchenrauch, per Blitz vor reinem Schwarz eingefroren, bilden durchscheinende, gewundene Formen; eine Tabletop-Technik, in Fotoclubs seit den 2000ern beliebt.
styles.short_en: Thin wisps of incense smoke frozen by flash against pure black, forming translucent curling shapes; a tabletop studio technique popular in camera clubs since the 2000s.
styles.era_en: since the 2000s, amateur and stock photography
markers_de: zarte, durchscheinende Schwaden auf reinem Schwarz
markers_en: delicate translucent wisps on pure black

styles.era_origin: Tank photography of ink or paint diffusing in water, widespread in stock imagery and music videos since the 2000s.
visual_markers: billowing dye plumes suspended in clear water
crisp leading edges and soft haze behind
styles.prompt_fragment: ink-in-water photograph, coloured ink plumes billowing through a clear glass tank, soft mushroom-shaped clouds and silky threads suspended mid-diffusion, bright white backdrop, tiny air bubbles, crisp high-speed detail at the leading edges and soft haze behind
styles.avoid: Avoid watercolour on paper and smoke on black; it must read as three-dimensional dye clouds suspended in water.
styles.feasibility_note: Ink plumes render very well.
styles.short_de: Farbige Tinte, fotografiert, während sie in einem Glasbecken mit klarem Wasser aufquillt und schwebende Wolken und seidige Fäden bildet; seit den 2000ern verbreitet in Stockbildern und Musikvideos.
styles.short_en: Coloured ink photographed as it billows through a clear water tank, forming suspended plumes and silky threads; common in stock imagery and music videos since the 2000s.
styles.era_en: since the 2000s, stock imagery and music videos
markers_en: billowing dye plumes suspended in clear water
crisp leading edges with soft haze behind

styles.era_origin: Shooting through fluted or ribbed architectural glass, a recurring device in fashion photography and 2020s design culture.
visual_markers: scene sliced into narrow regular vertical strips
clear edge where the glass ends
styles.prompt_fragment: photographed through vertical reeded glass, the scene sliced into narrow repeating strips, each slightly offset, mirrored and softened, colours blurring into ribbed stripes, glossy highlights along every glass ridge, one clear edge where the glass ends, quiet editorial palette
styles.avoid: Avoid digital glitch stripes and generic frosted-glass blur; the strips must be regular, optical and refractive.
styles.feasibility_note: Reeded refraction renders convincingly.
styles.short_de: Motive, durch senkrecht geriffeltes Glas fotografiert und in regelmäßige, versetzte, weichgezeichnete Streifen zerlegt; wiederkehrendes Mittel in Modefotografie und Interior- und Grafikdesign der 2020er.
styles.short_en: Scenes photographed through vertically ribbed glass, sliced into regular offset and softened strips; a recurring device in fashion photography and 2020s interior and graphic design.
styles.era_de: wiederkehrend in der Modefotografie; verbreitet im Design der 2020er
styles.era_en: recurring in fashion photography; widespread in 2020s design
markers_de: Motiv in schmale, regelmäßige Senkrechtstreifen zerlegt
klare Kante, wo das Glas endet
markers_en: scene sliced into narrow regular vertical strips
clear edge where the glass ends

styles.era_origin: Long, thin probe lenses used in film and commercials since the 1990s, with affordable versions from 2018, allow wide-angle macro from ground level.
visual_markers: exaggerated close perspective with slight barrel distortion
styles.prompt_fragment: wide-angle probe-lens macro shot from millimetres above the ground, a small foreground subject looming huge and in focus while the wider environment stays recognisable behind it, deep depth of field, exaggerated perspective, slight barrel distortion, lens nearly touching surrounding textures
styles.avoid: Avoid conventional macro with creamy bokeh and tilt-shift miniature effects; foreground and background should both be largely sharp.
styles.feasibility_note: The model tends to add background blur from habit; deep focus must be stressed.
styles.sensitivity_note: Lens product names exist; describe the optics generically.
styles.short_de: Weitwinkel-Makro aus Bodenhöhe: Ein winziges Vordergrundmotiv wirkt riesig, die Umgebung dahinter bleibt scharf; im Film seit den 1990ern, erschwinglich seit 2018.
styles.short_en: Ground-level wide-angle macro: a tiny foreground subject looms large while the surroundings stay sharp behind; used in film since the 1990s, affordable since 2018.
styles.era_de: seit den 1990ern (Film und Werbung); Consumer-Objektive ab 2018
styles.era_en: since the 1990s (film and advertising); consumer lenses from 2018
markers_en: exaggerated close perspective with slight barrel distortion
styles.sensitivity_de: Es gibt geschützte Objektiv-Produktnamen; die Optik allgemein beschreiben.
styles.sensitivity_en: Lens product names exist; describe the optics generically.

styles.era_origin: A lensless camera with concentric Fresnel rings in place of a pinhole, used by experimental photographers since the late 19th century.
visual_markers: broad luminous halos around every highlight
low-contrast misty glow over the frame
styles.prompt_fragment: zone plate photograph from a lensless camera with a Fresnel ring plate, every highlight surrounded by broad luminous halos, low-contrast misty glow over the whole frame, soft yet faintly defined cores, gentle vignetting, washed pastel colours or silvery black and white, long-exposure stillness
styles.avoid: Avoid crisp pinhole depth and digital glow filters over a sharp image; everything should be softly radiant.
styles.feasibility_note: The glow renders well, but it may come out as generic Orton or diffusion.
styles.short_de: Linsenlose Aufnahmen durch konzentrische Fresnel-Ringe statt einer Lochblende, mit leuchtenden Höfen um die Lichter und nebligem, kontrastarmem Gesamteindruck; experimentell seit dem späten 19. Jahrhundert.
styles.short_en: Lensless photographs taken through concentric Fresnel rings instead of a pinhole, with glowing halos around highlights and a misty low-contrast look; used experimentally since the late 19th century.
styles.era_en: since the late 19th century, experimental photography
markers_en: broad luminous halos around every highlight

styles.era_origin: Many telephoto frames shot wide open and stitched into a wide view, popularised in wedding photography around 2008.
visual_markers: no wide-angle distortion on the subject
surroundings melting right behind the subject
styles.prompt_fragment: stitched bokeh panorama, a wide environmental view assembled from many telephoto frames shot wide open, subject sharp and natural without wide-angle distortion, surroundings dissolving into very shallow creamy blur immediately behind and in front, impossible-seeming mix of wide field of view and thin focus
styles.avoid: Avoid tight fast-prime portraits and sharp wide-angle environmental shots; the frame must be wide while the focus stays extremely thin.
styles.feasibility_note: Results often look like the ordinary shallow-depth default; the effect is subtle.
styles.sensitivity_note: Named after a living photographer; use the descriptive term in prompts.
styles.short_de: Weite Ansichten, aus vielen offenblendigen Teleaufnahmen zusammengesetzt, verbinden großen Bildwinkel mit extrem geringer Schärfentiefe; um 2008 in der Hochzeitsfotografie populär geworden.
styles.short_en: Wide views stitched from many telephoto frames shot wide open, combining a broad field of view with extremely shallow focus; popularised in wedding photography around 2008.
markers_de: Umgebung zerfließt direkt hinter dem Motiv
markers_en: no wide-angle distortion on the subject
surroundings melting right behind the subject
styles.sensitivity_de: Nach einem lebenden Fotografen benannt; in Prompts die beschreibende Bezeichnung verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Named after a living photographer; use the descriptive term in prompts.

styles.era_origin: Smartphone sweep-panorama mishaps with moving subjects, a viral photo genre since the 2010s.
visual_markers: duplicated, sliced or stretched moving elements
styles.prompt_fragment: smartphone sweep panorama gone wrong, ultra-wide strip format, moving elements duplicated, sliced and stretched where the stitching failed, abruptly cut-off segments and repeated fragments, warped wavy horizon, visible seams and exposure jumps, otherwise a mundane casual daylight scene
styles.avoid: Avoid deliberate surreal composites and colour-channel glitch art; the errors must look accidental and geometric.
styles.feasibility_note: Duplication works; believable seam logic is inconsistent.
styles.sensitivity_note: Body distortions can look grotesque; avoid using it with real, identifiable people.
styles.short_de: Missglückte Smartphone-Schwenkpanoramen, in denen bewegte Menschen und Tiere verdoppelt, zerschnitten oder gestreckt erscheinen und der Horizont sich verbiegt; virales Fotogenre seit den 2010ern.
styles.short_en: Smartphone sweep panoramas gone wrong, with moving people and animals duplicated, sliced or stretched and horizons warped; a viral photo genre since the 2010s.
styles.era_en: since the 2010s, smartphone photography and the internet
markers_de: verdoppelte, zerschnittene oder gedehnte bewegte Elemente
markers_en: duplicated, sliced or stretched moving elements
styles.sensitivity_de: Körperverzerrungen können grotesk wirken; nicht mit realen, erkennbaren Personen verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Body distortions can look grotesque; avoid using it with real, identifiable people.

styles.era_origin: Unwrapped spherical images from stitched rigs and consumer 360 cameras, common since VR photography in the 2010s.
visual_markers: verticals and ceilings curving toward top and bottom
floor and sky stretched into smeared bands
blurred tripod patch at the bottom
styles.prompt_fragment: unwrapped equirectangular 360-degree photograph in a 2:1 frame, straight horizon across the centre, every vertical and ceiling line curving dramatically toward the top and bottom edges, floor and sky stretched into smeared bands, left and right edges continuing seamlessly, a blurred tripod patch at the bottom
styles.avoid: Avoid little-planet circles and ordinary wide panoramas; the distortion must be the stretched 2:1 sphere unwrap.
styles.feasibility_note: The model knows the look, but geometric consistency is approximate.
styles.short_de: Kugelpanoramen, abgewickelt in ein Seitenverhältnis von 2:1, mit gerader Horizontlinie in der Mitte und nach oben und unten gekrümmten Senkrechten; mit 360°-Kameras seit den 2010ern verbreitet.
styles.short_en: Spherical panoramas unwrapped into a 2:1 frame, straight horizon across the middle, verticals curving toward top and bottom; common with 360° cameras since the 2010s.
markers_de: Senkrechte biegen sich nach oben und unten
Boden und Himmel zu verschmierten Bändern gedehnt
markers_en: verticals curving toward top and bottom
floor and sky stretched into smeared bands
blurred tripod patch at the bottom

styles.era_origin: Light from below, used in expressionist theatre and early-1930s horror cinema and in every torch-under-the-chin ghost story.
visual_markers: single hard key light from below
shadows climbing upward over nose and brow
bright underside of chin and nostrils
styles.prompt_fragment: lit only from below by a single hard light source, shadows climbing upward over the nose, cheekbones and brow, bright underside of the chin and nostrils, eye sockets and forehead falling into darkness, unnatural inverted modelling, surroundings swallowed in black
styles.avoid: Avoid conventional low-key side lighting and neon rim light; the inversion of shadows is the whole effect.
styles.feasibility_note: Reliably understood and rendered.
styles.short_de: Eine einzelne harte Lichtquelle von unten wirft die Schatten nach oben über das Gesicht – bekannt aus expressionistischem Theater, Horrorfilmen der frühen 1930er und Taschenlampen-Gruselgeschichten.
styles.short_en: A single hard light from below throws shadows upward across the face, a device of expressionist theatre, early-1930s horror films and torch-lit ghost stories.
styles.era_en: 1910s–1930s, Germany and USA; still in use
markers_de: Schatten steigen über Nase und Stirn
markers_en: shadows climbing over nose and brow
bright underside of chin and nostrils

styles.era_origin: Slides or video projected onto faces and bodies, from 1960s psychedelic photography to 2010s-20s editorial and album art.
visual_markers: projected patterns, text or landscapes wrapping over contours
the same projection continuing on the wall behind
crisp shadow where the body blocks the beam
styles.prompt_fragment: subject in a dark room with a projector throwing a second image across them, projected patterns, text or landscapes bending over facial contours and clothing, the same projection continuing on the wall behind, a crisp shadow outline where the body blocks the beam, saturated projector colours, everything else unlit
styles.avoid: Avoid digital double-exposure blends; the projected image must physically wrap the surfaces and cast a shadow.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders well, and the shadow cue strongly helps realism.
styles.short_de: Dias oder Videobilder werden im dunklen Raum auf eine Person projiziert und legen sich über Körper und Wand; seit der psychedelischen Fotografie der 1960er, heute oft in Editorials.
styles.short_en: Slides or video projected onto a person in a dark room wrap patterns or text over the body; common since 1960s psychedelic photography and in today's album art.
markers_de: projiziertes Muster oder Text folgt den Körperformen
Projektion läuft auf der Wand dahinter weiter
scharfer Schatten, wo der Körper den Strahl verdeckt
markers_en: projected pattern or text wrapping over contours
projection continuing on the wall behind
crisp shadow where the body blocks the beam

styles.era_origin: Sunlight refracted through water or glass, casting dancing nets of light, a staple of poolside fashion, product photography and cinema since the 1960s.
styles.prompt_fragment: hard sunlight refracted through rippling water casting a shimmering net of bright caustic lines across every surface and skin, aqua and turquoise reflected tones, sharp wavy highlights over soft shadow, summery high-contrast light, patterns bending over every contour
styles.avoid: Avoid generic glossy underwater shots and leaf-shadow gobos; the caustic lines must form a bright, interlocking water network.
styles.feasibility_note: Caustics are well understood and render convincingly.
styles.short_de: Durch bewegtes Wasser gebrochenes Sonnenlicht legt ein helles, flirrendes Liniennetz über Haut und Flächen; ein gängiges Mittel in Bademoden- und Produktfotografie sowie im Film.
styles.short_en: Sunlight refracted through rippling water casts a bright, shifting net of lines over skin and surfaces, a long-standing device of poolside fashion, product photography and film.
styles.era_de: seit den 1960ern, Mode, Werbung und Film
styles.era_en: since the 1960s, fashion, advertising and film

styles.era_origin: A pictorialist practice developed in China from the 1930s, combining several negatives into compositions modelled on classical ink landscape painting.
visual_markers: photographic peaks, pines and mist arranged like a scroll
styles.prompt_fragment: pictorialist composite photograph arranged like a classical Chinese ink landscape, several negatives combined into towering misty peaks, gnarled pines and drifting fog in a tall vertical format, soft grey silver tones, wide empty space, a tiny figure or boat, a brushed calligraphy inscription and red seal stamp
styles.avoid: Avoid painted ink brushwork and sharp modern landscape photography; it must be photographic but composed like a hanging scroll.
styles.feasibility_note: Mist and scroll composition render well; calligraphy will be decorative rather than readable.
styles.sensitivity_note: Uses Chinese calligraphy and seals; avoid passing off garbled characters as meaningful text.
styles.short_de: Aus mehreren Negativen montierte Fotos, aufgebaut wie klassische chinesische Tuschlandschaften mit Nebelgipfeln, Kiefern und Inschrift; ab den 1930ern in China entstanden, später in Taiwan fortgeführt.
styles.short_en: Several negatives combined into one photograph composed like a classical Chinese ink landscape, with misty peaks, pines and inscription; developed in China from the 1930s, later in Taiwan.
markers_de: fotografierte Gipfel, Kiefern und Nebel wie auf einer Bildrolle
markers_en: photographed peaks, pines and mist arranged like a scroll
soft grey silver tones and wide empty space
styles.sensitivity_de: Nutzt chinesische Kalligrafie und Siegel; unleserliche Pseudo-Schriftzeichen nicht als echten Text ausgeben.
styles.sensitivity_en: Uses Chinese calligraphy and seals; do not pass off garbled characters as meaningful text.

styles.era_origin: Documentation photography of gallery and museum installations, a standardised genre since the white-cube era of the 1960s-70s.
visual_markers: empty room or a single distant visitor
styles.prompt_fragment: gallery installation view, wide perspective-corrected shot of a white-walled exhibition space, works hung with generous spacing at eye level, pale polished concrete floor, even shadowless daylight from skylights, empty room or a single distant visitor, crisp neutral colour and documentary restraint
styles.avoid: Avoid moody museum lighting, crowds and dramatic angles; the image must be neutral, clean and evenly lit.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders very reliably.
styles.short_de: Sachliche, gleichmäßig ausgeleuchtete Dokumentarfotos von Werken in weißen Ausstellungsräumen, ohne stürzende Linien und mit kaum Besuchern; ein festes Genre seit der White-Cube-Ära der 1960er.
styles.short_en: Neutral, evenly lit documentary photographs of artworks hung in white gallery rooms, with corrected verticals and few or no visitors; a standard genre since the white-cube era.
markers_de: leerer Raum oder ein einzelner Besucher in der Ferne
markers_en: empty room or one distant visitor

styles.name_en: Hong Kong Salon Photography (Light and Shadow)
styles.era_origin: Pictorial street photography from the 1950s-60s camera-club and salon circles of Hong Kong, built on shafts of light through haze and smoke.
visual_markers: single small figure in a shaft of sunlight
haze or smoke making the light visible
bold diagonal light planes and geometric architecture
styles.prompt_fragment: mid-century salon street photograph in black and white, a single small figure caught in a shaft of sunlight cutting through smoke or haze, vast areas of deep shadow, bold diagonal light planes and geometric architecture, carefully dodged and burned pictorial printing, poetic stillness
styles.avoid: Avoid cluttered candid snapshots and gritty push-processed grain; the composition is geometric, luminous and calm.
styles.feasibility_note: Light shafts and geometry render well.
styles.short_de: Schwarzweiße Straßenszenen aus Hongkonger Fotoclubs der 1950er und 60er: einzelne Figuren in Lichtbahnen, die durch Dunst fallen, tiefe Schatten, sorgfältig abgewedelte Abzüge.
styles.short_en: Black-and-white street scenes from 1950s–60s Hong Kong camera clubs, with lone figures in shafts of sunlight through haze, deep shadows and carefully dodged pictorial prints.
markers_de: Dunst oder Rauch macht das Licht sichtbar
markers_en: small figure in a shaft of sunlight
haze or smoke making the light visible

styles.era_origin: Colour street photography of complex multi-plane compositions in hard tropical light, developed on slide film from the 1980s and widely practised today.
visual_markers: several figures on separate depth planes
each figure in its own pocket of hard sunlight
inky black shadows slicing the frame
faces cut off at the frame edges
styles.prompt_fragment: layered colour street photograph, several unrelated figures arranged on separate planes from foreground to distance, each caught in its own pocket of hard tropical sunlight, saturated painted walls, inky black shadows slicing the frame, faces partly cut off at the edges, dense but balanced complexity
styles.avoid: Avoid single centred subjects and deadpan New Color calm; the image must be dense, layered and shadow-heavy.
styles.feasibility_note: The layering is attempted, but often simplified to one or two figures.
styles.sensitivity_note: Associated with living photographers; never name them.
styles.short_de: Farbige Straßenfotos mit mehreren Figuren auf getrennten Tiefenebenen, jede in einem eigenen Fleck harten Tropenlichts; entwickelt ab Ende der 1970er auf Diafilm.
styles.short_en: Colour street photographs stacking several figures on separate depth planes, each in its own pocket of hard tropical light; developed on slide film from the late 1970s.
styles.era_de: seit Ende der 1970er, Karibik und Lateinamerika; heute weltweit
styles.era_en: since the late 1970s, Caribbean and Latin America; now worldwide
markers_de: jede Figur in eigenem harten Sonnenfleck
markers_en: several figures on separate depth planes
each figure in its own patch of hard sunlight
faces cut off at the edges
styles.sensitivity_de: Mit lebenden Fotografen verbunden; diese im Prompt nie namentlich nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Associated with living photographers; never name them in prompts.

styles.era_origin: An outdoor Instagram aesthetic of c. 2014-2019 rooted in the US Pacific Northwest.
visual_markers: small lone figure seen from behind
warm skin against a cold palette
styles.prompt_fragment: moody outdoor social-media grade, desaturated deep evergreen tones pushed toward teal, lifted matte blacks, cool fog and overcast light, a small lone figure in muted outdoor wear seen from behind, warm skin against a cold palette, centred symmetrical framing, sharp but slightly faded
styles.avoid: Avoid warm golden-hour travel saturation and pastel VSCO fades; this look is cold, green-teal and brooding.
styles.feasibility_note: The grade is easy and almost a default for outdoor scenes.
styles.short_de: Kühler, ins Petrol verschobener Outdoor-Look mit angehobenen, matten Schwarztönen, Nebel und einsamer Rückenfigur; ein Instagram-Stil von etwa 2014 bis 2019 aus dem pazifischen Nordwesten der USA.
styles.short_en: Cold, teal-shifted outdoor grade with lifted matte blacks, fog and a small lone figure seen from behind; an Instagram look of about 2014–2019 from the US Pacific Northwest.
markers_en: small lone figure seen from behind
warm skin against a cold palette

styles.era_origin: Standardised clinical photography with fixed framing, twin flash and neutral backdrops, codified from the 1970s.
visual_markers: strict frontal or profile standard views
adhesive scale ruler and ID label
styles.prompt_fragment: standardised clinical documentation photograph, flat shadowless twin flash, plain mid-blue backdrop and surgical drape, strict frontal framing with no styling, an adhesive scale ruler and handwritten ID label in frame, neutral accurate colour, sharp edge-to-edge focus, unglamorous record
styles.avoid: Avoid beauty retouching and dramatic lighting; the image must be clinical, flat and measurement-oriented.
styles.feasibility_note: Clinical framing and props render reliably.
styles.sensitivity_note: Implies patients and medical conditions; never suggest real diagnoses or identifiable patients.
styles.short_de: Standardisierte Dokumentationsfotos mit flachem Doppelblitz, schlichtem blauem Hintergrund, festen Frontal- oder Profilansichten und Maßstab im Bild, wie sie die klinische Fotografie seit den 1970ern vorschreibt.
styles.short_en: Standardised documentation photographs with flat twin flash, plain blue backdrop, fixed frontal or profile views and a scale ruler, as codified in clinical practice from the 1970s.
styles.sensitivity_de: Impliziert Patienten und Krankheitsbilder; keine echten Diagnosen oder erkennbaren Personen andeuten.
styles.sensitivity_en: Implies patients and medical conditions; never suggest real diagnoses or identifiable patients.

styles.era_origin: Hollywood and Italian ancient-world epics of c. 1950-1965, shot in Technicolor and widescreen formats.
visual_markers: saturated Technicolor reds, golds and marble whites
monumental studio columns and painted matte skies
crowds of costumed extras in formation
wide 2.35 frame with soft anamorphic edges
styles.prompt_fragment: 1950s-60s widescreen ancient-world epic film still, saturated Technicolor reds, golds and marble whites, monumental studio columns and painted matte skies, crowds of costumed extras in strict formation, theatrical hard key light, sweeping 2.35 frame, slightly soft anamorphic edges and warm print grain
styles.avoid: Avoid gritty desaturated modern historical epics and teal-orange grading.
styles.feasibility_note: Technicolor epic staging is well understood.
styles.sensitivity_note: The genre relies on orientalist and racially skewed casting conventions; avoid exoticising stereotypes.
styles.short_de: Hollywood- und italienische Antikfilme in satten Technicolor-Farben und Breitwand, mit Marmorkulissen, gemalten Himmeln und Statistenheeren; Blütezeit etwa 1950 bis 1965.
styles.short_en: Hollywood and Italian films set in antiquity, shot in saturated Technicolor and widescreen with marble sets, painted skies and crowds of extras, at their peak c. 1950–1965.
markers_en: saturated Technicolor reds, golds and marble whites
monumental columns and painted matte skies
crowds of costumed extras in formation
styles.sensitivity_de: Das Genre lebt von orientalistischen Klischees und weißer Besetzung; exotisierende Stereotype vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: The genre relies on orientalist clichés and whitewashed casting; avoid exoticising stereotypes.

styles.era_origin: Hong Kong action-melodrama genre of c. 1986-1993 about honour among gangsters and police.
visual_markers: smoke-filled interiors with cold blue backlight
warm tungsten practicals and church candles
styles.prompt_fragment: late-1980s Hong Kong action-melodrama film still, smoke-filled interior cut by cold blue backlight and warm tungsten practicals, slow-motion frozen moment, white doves scattering, flickering church candles, long coats, sweaty operatic close-ups, slightly soft 35mm print with crushed blacks
styles.avoid: Avoid the bright 1970s kung fu look and the 1990s neon step-printed look; this is smoky, operatic and blue-lit.
styles.feasibility_note: Smoke, blue backlight and doves render reliably.
styles.sensitivity_note: The genre centres on gun violence; keep weapons and blood out of prompts for general use.
styles.short_de: Hongkonger Action-Melodramen über Ehre unter Gangstern und Polizisten: blaues Gegenlicht im Rauch, Zeitlupe, Kerzen und auffliegende Tauben; Blütezeit etwa 1986 bis 1993.
styles.short_en: Hong Kong action melodramas about honour among gangsters and police, with smoky blue-backlit interiors, slow motion, candles and scattering doves; flourishing c. 1986–1993.
markers_de: verrauchte Innenräume mit kaltem blauem Gegenlicht
markers_en: smoky interiors with cold blue backlight
warm tungsten practicals and church candles
styles.sensitivity_de: Das Genre kreist um Waffengewalt; Waffen und Blut in allgemeinen Prompts weglassen.
styles.sensitivity_en: The genre centres on gun violence; keep weapons and blood out of prompts for general use.

styles.era_origin: Large-scale science-fiction cinematography of the 2010s-2020s, built on single-colour atmospheric haze and brutalist megastructures.
visual_markers: scene drowned in amber dust or pale fog
colossal brutalist structures fading into murk
styles.prompt_fragment: contemporary large-format science-fiction film still, the scene drowned in a single-colour atmospheric haze of amber dust or pale fog, colossal brutalist structures fading into the murk, tiny solitary figures for scale, minimal geometric composition, soft silhouettes, restrained monochrome palette, oppressive silence
styles.avoid: Avoid neon cyberpunk clutter and teal-orange blockbuster gloss; scale and haze replace detail and colour.
styles.feasibility_note: Haze and scale render very well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Associated with living directors and cinematographers; never name them.
styles.short_de: Science-Fiction-Kamerastil, der kolossale brutalistische Bauten und winzige Figuren in einfarbigem Dunst aus bernsteinfarbenem Staub oder fahlem Nebel versinken lässt; ein Look der 2010er und 2020er.
styles.short_en: Science-fiction cinematography that drowns colossal brutalist structures and tiny figures in single-colour haze of amber dust or pale fog; a large-format look of the 2010s and 2020s.
markers_de: Szene in bernsteinfarbenem Staub oder fahlem Nebel
kolossale brutalistische Bauten verschwimmen im Dunst
markers_en: scene drowned in amber dust or pale fog
colossal brutalist structures fading into murk
styles.sensitivity_de: Mit lebenden Regisseuren und Kameraleuten verbunden; diese nie namentlich nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Associated with living directors and cinematographers; never name them.

styles.era_origin: Natural-light American art cinema from the late 1970s, refined in the 2010s with very wide lenses and floating Steadicam.
visual_markers: shot only at dawn or dusk
sun on the horizon flaring through grass or trees
very wide lens held low and close
hands and fabric drifting in the wind
styles.prompt_fragment: lyrical natural-light cinema still shot at magic hour, sun resting on the horizon and flaring through tall grass or trees, very wide lens held low and close, upward angle with vast sky, hands and fabric drifting in the wind, no artificial light, soft warm-to-cool gradient, contemplative floating framing
styles.avoid: Avoid static golden-hour postcard landscapes and orange-teal grading; it should feel intimate, wide-lens and airborne.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders easily but can collapse into a generic golden-hour shot unless the wide, low lens is stressed.
styles.sensitivity_note: Associated with living directors and cinematographers; never name them.
styles.short_de: Kinobilder im natürlichen Licht der Magic Hour, mit tief geführten Superweitwinkeln und Gegenlicht durch hohes Gras; amerikanisches Autorenkino der späten 1970er, in den 2010ern weiterentwickelt.
styles.short_en: Natural-light cinema shot at dawn or dusk with low, very wide lenses and sun flaring through grass; American art cinema of the late 1970s, refined in the 2010s.
markers_de: nur in Morgen- oder Abenddämmerung gedreht
Sonne blitzt durch Gras oder Bäume
markers_en: shot only at dawn or dusk
sun flaring through grass or trees
very wide lens held low and close
hands and fabric drifting in the wind
styles.sensitivity_de: Mit lebenden Regisseuren und Kameraleuten verbunden; diese nie namentlich nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Associated with living directors and cinematographers; never name them.

styles.era_origin: American surreal-noir cinema and television of the mid-1980s and early 1990s.
visual_markers: isolated pools of warm tungsten in blackness
styles.prompt_fragment: uncanny small-town noir film still, wholesome 1950s Americana settings turned ominous, heavy red velvet curtains, black-and-white zigzag floor, isolated pools of warm tungsten light in surrounding blackness, saturated reds against deep shadow, unnaturally still poses, a flickering lamp and a sense of humming dread
styles.avoid: Avoid classic black-and-white film noir and neon neo-noir; the mix of cosy Americana and dreamlike menace is essential.
styles.feasibility_note: Iconic props and lighting render well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Strongly tied to one director's work; do not name him or copy specific scenes.
styles.short_de: Biedere amerikanische Kleinstadtwelt im Stil der 1950er, ins Bedrohliche gekippt: rote Samtvorhänge, Zickzackböden, Glühlampenlicht in tiefem Dunkel; surreales Noir-Kino und -Fernsehen von 1986 bis 1992.
styles.short_en: Wholesome 1950s-style American small-town settings turned ominous, with red velvet curtains, zigzag floors and pools of tungsten light in darkness; surreal noir film and television of 1986–1992.
markers_en: isolated pools of warm tungsten light
styles.sensitivity_de: Eng an das Werk eines Regisseurs gebunden; ihn nicht nennen und keine konkreten Szenen nachstellen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Strongly tied to one director's work; do not name him or copy specific scenes.

styles.era_origin: Independent art-house horror from the mid-2010s onward.
visual_markers: static symmetrical wide frame with unsettling empty space
barely visible figure in a far doorway
styles.prompt_fragment: contemporary art-house horror film still, muted desaturated palette, static symmetrical wide frame with unsettling empty space, dim natural or practical light, a barely visible figure lingering in a far doorway, quiet domestic interior, fine digital grain, restrained composition that withholds rather than shows
styles.avoid: Avoid jump-scare gore, blue-green horror grading and 1980s slasher colour; the dread comes from stillness and empty space.
styles.feasibility_note: Restraint and empty space render well; the model sometimes adds overt monsters.
styles.sensitivity_note: Linked to a specific independent studio brand; do not name it in prompts.
styles.short_de: Unabhängiger Arthouse-Horror seit Mitte der 2010er: gedämpfte Farben, statische symmetrische Totalen, schwaches Raumlicht und viel Leere statt Schockeffekten.
styles.short_en: Independent art-house horror since the mid-2010s, using muted colour, static symmetrical wide frames, dim practical light and empty space instead of shocks.
styles.era_de: seit Mitte der 2010er, v. a. USA
markers_de: statische symmetrische Totale mit leerem Raum
kaum sichtbare Gestalt in fernem Türrahmen
markers_en: static symmetrical wide frame with empty space
barely visible figure in a far doorway
styles.sensitivity_de: Eng mit einer bestimmten Indie-Studiomarke verbunden; diese im Prompt nicht nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Linked to a specific independent studio brand; do not name it in prompts.

styles.era_origin: A camera rigged to an actor's body and facing them, used from the 1970s and named and popularised in 1990s films and music videos.
visual_markers: face locked dead centre and sharp
surroundings tilted and smeared with motion
styles.prompt_fragment: body-mounted camera shot, face locked dead centre and sharp from a close, low chest-level angle, wide lens slightly distorting the features, entire surroundings tilted and smeared with motion blur as the body lurches, disorienting tension, gritty film grain, harsh available light
styles.avoid: Avoid steady portrait framing and action-camera fisheye; the subject must stay static while the world tilts and smears.
styles.feasibility_note: Static-face-with-moving-world logic is sometimes rendered as plain motion blur.
styles.sensitivity_note: Named after a living filmmaking duo; use 'body-mounted camera' in prompts.
styles.short_de: Eine am Körper des Darstellers befestigte, auf ihn gerichtete Kamera hält das Gesicht starr im Bild, während die Welt dahinter schwankt; seit den 1960ern, benannt Ende der 1990er.
styles.short_en: A camera strapped to an actor's body and facing them keeps the face fixed while the world lurches behind; used since the 1960s, named in the late 1990s.

styles.era_origin: Stacked television installations in video art from the 1960s-80s, and in retail and stage design into the 1990s.

dunkler Raum, nur von den Schirmen erhellt
markers_en: one image split or repeated across screens
dark room lit only by the screens

navy, brick red, beige and pale blue
