visual_markers: mixed black brush script and stencil serif
styles.prompt_fragment: rustic farmhouse décor sign, whitewashed and sanded wooden planks with visible grain and chipped paint, mixed black brush-script and stencilled farmhouse serif lettering, sentimental phrasing, galvanised metal and jute twine accents, soft neutral daylight, styled against a shiplap wall
styles.avoid: Avoid professional sign painting and gilding as well as chalkboard lettering.
styles.feasibility_note: Wood texture and short phrases render well.
styles.short_de: Weiß lasierte, auf alt getrimmte Holzschilder mit gefühligen Sprüchen in Pinselschrift und Schablonen-Antiqua; ein US-Deko-Trend der 2010er, verbreitet durch Renovierungsshows und Bastelmärkte.
styles.short_en: Whitewashed, distressed wooden signs with sentimental phrases in mixed brush script and stencil serif; a US home-décor trend of the 2010s spread by renovation TV and craft stores.
markers_en: black brush script mixed with stencil serif

styles.era_origin: 1930s-60s school readers in the US, UK and German Fibeln.
visual_markers: white margin with large simple reading text
styles.prompt_fragment: mid-century school reader illustration, wholesome idealised everyday scene in bright clean opaque gouache, soft sunny lighting, gently realistic figures in slightly stiff posed action, saturated primary accents, white page margin with a few lines of large simple reading text in a rounded schoolbook font
styles.avoid: Avoid loose watercolour picture-book whimsy and glamorous advertising illustration.
styles.feasibility_note: Gouache realism renders well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Originals mostly showed white middle-class families and fixed gender roles; cast consciously. Ladybird and Dick and Jane are trademarks.
styles.short_de: Helle, saubere Gouache-Szenen eines idealisierten Familienalltags mit etwas steif posierenden Figuren und großer Leseschrift; aus amerikanischen, britischen und deutschen Fibeln der 1930er bis 60er.
styles.short_en: Bright, clean gouache scenes of idealised everyday family life with stiffly posed figures and large simple reading text, from US, British and German school readers of the 1930s–60s.
markers_en: white margin with large reading text
styles.sensitivity_de: Die Vorlagen zeigten meist weiße Mittelschichtfamilien und starre Geschlechterrollen, daher bewusst besetzen; Ladybird und Dick and Jane sind Marken.
styles.sensitivity_en: Originals mostly showed white middle-class families and fixed gender roles, so cast consciously; Ladybird and Dick and Jane are trademarks.

styles.era_origin: 1980s-2000s US mass-marketed inspirational art prints.
styles.prompt_fragment: mass-market inspirational art-print painting, every window and lamp radiating warm golden glow, soft pastel twilight sky, overabundant blossoms and flowering trees, cobblestone paths, haloed light dabs and tiny sparkling specular dots, saccharine idyllic mood, smooth glossy oil-like finish
styles.avoid: Keep the specular-dot highlights and twee staging; avoid cinematic teal-orange or moody realism.
styles.feasibility_note: Very close to model defaults, so it renders easily.
styles.sensitivity_note: Associated with a deceased commercial painter whose name is trademarked; do not name him.
styles.short_de: Massenhaft vertriebene Erbauungsdrucke: Cottages, aus deren Fenstern goldenes Licht strahlt, Pastell-Dämmerung, üppige Blüten und glitzernde Lichtpunkte; US-Kunstdruckgeschäft der 1980er bis 2000er.
styles.short_en: Mass-market inspirational prints of cottages with every window glowing gold under pastel twilight, overflowing flowers and sparkling light dots; US art-print business of the 1980s–2000s.
styles.sensitivity_de: Mit einem verstorbenen Kommerzmaler verbunden, dessen Name als Marke geschützt ist; ihn nicht nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Associated with a deceased commercial painter whose name is a trademark; do not name him.

styles.era_origin: 1970s-2000s US beach boardwalks and fairs; also memorial shirts in hip-hop culture.
styles.prompt_fragment: custom airbrushed T-shirt from a seaside boardwalk stall, soft overspray gradients sprayed directly onto white cotton jersey with visible weave, puffy graffiti bubble-letter lettering with glowing outlines, sunset and palm-tree vignette, hearts and sparkles, slightly uneven stencil edges, garment laid flat
styles.avoid: Avoid clean digital airbrush on paper and print-on-demand vector tees.
styles.feasibility_note: Fabric overspray and bubble letters work well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Airbrushed R.I.P. memorial shirts carry grief meaning in Black American communities; do not use real names.
styles.short_de: Individuell gesprühte Airbrush-Shirts mit weichem Sprühnebel, aufgeblähten Graffiti-Buchstaben, Sonnenuntergang, Palmen und Herzen auf weißer Baumwolle; verkauft an US-Strandpromenaden und auf Jahrmärkten, 1970er–2000er.
styles.short_en: Custom airbrush shirts with soft overspray, puffy bubble letters, sunsets, palms and hearts sprayed onto white cotton; sold at US boardwalks and fairs, 1970s–2000s.
styles.sensitivity_de: Airbrush-Gedenkshirts (R.I.P.) haben in schwarzen US-Communities Trauerbedeutung; keine echten Namen verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Airbrushed R.I.P. memorial shirts carry grief meaning in Black American communities; do not use real names.

styles.era_origin: 1980s-2000s US screen-printed nature apparel; ironic meme status from 2008.
visual_markers: glowing full moon and starry sky
styles.prompt_fragment: photorealistic airbrushed wildlife artwork screen-printed on a black cotton T-shirt, glowing full moon, misty pine silhouettes and starry night sky, piercing luminous eyes, dramatic mystical mood, soft water-based ink with slight cracking and visible fabric texture, earnest souvenir-shop sincerity
styles.avoid: Avoid distressed vintage band tees and flat vector designs; leave out dreamcatchers and headdresses.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders easily; risk of drifting into a plain digital painting without the garment.
styles.sensitivity_note: Genre often appropriates Native American imagery; omit it. Avoid apparel brand names.
styles.short_de: Fotorealistisch gemalte Wölfe, Vollmonde und Sternenhimmel im Siebdruck auf schwarzen Baumwollshirts, seit den 1980ern in US-Souvenirläden verkauft und später ein ironisches Internet-Meme.
styles.short_en: Photoreal airbrushed wolves, moons and starry skies screen-printed on black cotton tees, sold in US souvenir shops since the 1980s and later an ironic meme.
markers_en: glowing full moon and starry sky
styles.sensitivity_de: Das Genre bedient sich oft indigener nordamerikanischer Motive; diese und Markennamen weglassen.
styles.sensitivity_en: The genre often borrows Native American imagery; leave it out and avoid apparel brand names.

styles.era_origin: 1930s Honolulu, golden age of rayon prints in the 1940s-50s.
visual_markers: four to six flat screen-printed colours
styles.prompt_fragment: vintage aloha shirt textile print, dense allover repeat of tropical motifs in four to six flat screen-printed colours on a contrasting ground, slight registration overlaps, silky rayon sheen and drape, mid-century souvenir palette of coral, jade, ochre and navy
styles.avoid: Avoid tiki idol décor and loose watercolour tropical prints.
styles.feasibility_note: Repeat patterns and fabric sheen hold well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Rooted in Hawaiian and Japanese-immigrant textile culture; avoid sacred Hawaiian imagery and hula-girl caricatures.
styles.short_de: Dichte Rapporte aus tropischen Blüten, Fischen und Landschaften in wenigen flächigen Farben auf Viskosehemden, entstanden in den 1930ern in Honolulu, Blütezeit in den 1940ern und 1950ern.
styles.short_en: Dense allover repeats of tropical flowers, fish and scenery in a few flat colours on rayon shirts, from 1930s Honolulu with a 1940s–50s heyday.
markers_en: four to six flat screen-printed colours
styles.sensitivity_de: Wurzelt in hawaiischer und japanisch-migrantischer Textilkultur; keine sakralen hawaiischen Motive und keine Hula-Mädchen-Klischees.
styles.sensitivity_en: Rooted in Hawaiian and Japanese-immigrant textile culture; avoid sacred Hawaiian imagery and hula-girl caricatures.

styles.era_origin: Post-1945 Yokosuka, Japan, souvenir jackets for US servicemen; revived in streetwear.
styles.prompt_fragment: dense machine satin-stitch embroidery on glossy satin jacket fabric, thread sheen catching light in directional stitch fields, bold East Asian souvenir-jacket composition with layered thread-colour gradients, contrasting two-tone satin ground, puckered fabric around the stitching, ribbed knit trim at the edges
styles.avoid: Avoid flat merrowed patches and loose hand embroidery.
styles.feasibility_note: Satin and thread sheen render convincingly.
styles.sensitivity_note: Originals sometimes carry rising-sun motifs or wartime insignia; avoid them.
styles.short_de: Dichte maschinelle Plattstich-Stickerei mit Tigern, Drachen, Adlern und Landkarten auf glänzenden Satinjacken, nach 1945 in Yokosuka als Souvenir für US-Soldaten gefertigt.
styles.short_en: Dense machine satin-stitch embroidery of tigers, dragons, eagles and maps on glossy satin bomber jackets, made as souvenirs for US servicemen in Yokosuka after 1945.
styles.sensitivity_de: Originale zeigen teils Motive der aufgehenden Sonne oder Militärabzeichen; diese weglassen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Originals sometimes carry rising-sun motifs or wartime insignia; leave them out.

styles.era_origin: Late-1990s to 2000s Japanese mobile-phone decoration, later global.
styles.prompt_fragment: decoden craft treatment, surfaces completely encrusted with faceted rhinestones, pearls and flatback charms, piped faux whipped-cream silicone borders, resin candies, bows and miniature sweets, pastel pink and holographic glitter, glossy plastic sparkle under bright soft light
styles.avoid: Avoid Y2K chrome and minimalist product shots.
styles.feasibility_note: Rhinestone density and faux cream render well.
styles.short_de: Handyhüllen und Gegenstände, dicht besetzt mit Strasssteinen, Perlen, Kunstharz-Süßigkeiten und gespritzter Silikon-Sahne; japanisches Kawaii-Handwerk der späten 1990er und 2000er.
styles.short_en: Phone cases and objects encrusted with rhinestones, pearls, resin sweets and piped faux whipped cream, a Japanese kawaii craft from the late 1990s and 2000s.

styles.era_origin: From the late 1920s and 1930s in Japanese restaurant windows.
styles.prompt_fragment: rendered as a Japanese restaurant-window plastic food replica, hyper-glossy vinyl and resin surfaces with too-perfect saturated colour, frozen mid-motion details held in solid resin, waxy unnatural sheen, displayed in a dusty glass showcase with small handwritten price cards under flat fluorescent light
styles.avoid: Avoid appetising real food photography with steam and polymer-clay miniature scale.
styles.feasibility_note: Tends to drift back to real food photography unless the showcase is emphasised.
styles.short_de: Hochglänzende Nachbildungen von Gerichten aus Wachs, Vinyl oder Kunstharz in japanischen Restaurantschaufenstern, mit erstarrten Spritzern und übersatten Farben, seit Ende der 1920er gefertigt.
styles.short_en: Hyper-glossy wax, vinyl or resin copies of dishes displayed in Japanese restaurant windows, with frozen splashes and too-perfect colour, made since the late 1920s.

styles.era_origin: 1990s to today, car advertising with camera booms and long exposures.
styles.prompt_fragment: automotive advertising rig shot, low wide-angle camera locked to the subject so it stays razor sharp while the road and surroundings smear into long horizontal motion streaks, wet asphalt reflections at dusk, crisp specular highlights, deep blue and amber ambient tones, flawless commercial retouching
styles.avoid: Avoid panning shots with a blurred subject and studio car photography.
styles.feasibility_note: Motion streaks with sharp subject render well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid real car-brand badges.
styles.short_de: Autowerbefoto, bei dem ein am Fahrzeug montierter Kameraausleger das Auto gestochen scharf hält, während die Straße zu langen Streifen verwischt; verbreitet seit den 1990ern.
styles.short_en: Car advertising photo in which a camera boom locks onto the vehicle, keeping it razor sharp while the road smears into long streaks; common since the 1990s.
markers_de: Spiegelungen auf nassem Asphalt in der Dämmerung
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine echten Automarken-Embleme zeigen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid real car-brand badges.

styles.era_origin: 2000s-2010s news and political magazine portraiture.
visual_markers: hard frontal light on plain seamless
styles.prompt_fragment: confrontational editorial portrait shot very close with a wide-angle lens from slightly below, subtle barrel distortion enlarging the nearest features, hard direct frontal light, plain seamless white or grey backdrop, crisp high-contrast black-and-white or desaturated colour, razor-sharp texture, unflattering intensity
styles.avoid: Avoid flattering telephoto compression, shallow bokeh and Dragan-style overprocessing.
styles.feasibility_note: Distortion and hard light are achievable when explicitly stated.
styles.sensitivity_note: Strongly associated with a living photographer; describe the technique only.
styles.short_de: Redaktionelles Porträt, sehr nah mit Weitwinkel und leicht von unten aufgenommen, hartes Frontallicht vor neutralem Hintergrund; typisch für Politikerporträts in Nachrichtenmagazinen der 1990er bis 2010er.
styles.short_en: Editorial portrait shot very close with a wide-angle lens from slightly below, with hard frontal light on a plain backdrop, typical of 1990s–2010s news-magazine portraits of leaders.
markers_en: hard frontal light on plain seamless
styles.sensitivity_de: Eng mit einem lebenden Fotografen verbunden; nur die Technik beschreiben, nicht seinen Namen nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Closely associated with one living photographer; describe the technique, not the person.

styles.era_origin: 2000s to today, pharmaceutical marketing and biotech explainer animation.
styles.prompt_fragment: pharmaceutical mechanism-of-action 3D render, translucent glossy organic forms with subsurface scattering and wet sheen floating in a deep blue fluid void, glowing magenta and orange accent highlights, shallow depth of field with drifting bokeh particles, polished cinematic biotech-marketing lighting
styles.avoid: Avoid schematic ribbon diagrams, greyscale SEM and generic circuit-board tech glow.
styles.feasibility_note: Very close to model strengths.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid implying real therapeutic or medical claims.
styles.short_de: Glänzend durchscheinende Zellen, Moleküle und Rezeptoren schweben in tiefblauem Raum mit magentafarbenen Lichtern; die 3D-Optik von Pharmawerbung und Biotech-Erklärfilmen seit den 2000ern.
styles.short_en: Glossy translucent cells, molecules and receptors floating in a deep blue void with magenta glows, the 3D look of pharmaceutical marketing and biotech explainer films since the 2000s.
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine echten Therapie- oder Heilversprechen andeuten.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not suggest real therapeutic or medical claims.

styles.era_origin: 1980s pocket LCD games and toy watches.
visual_markers: faint ghost outlines of unlit segments
styles.prompt_fragment: 1980s pocket electronic LCD game screen, imagery built only from fixed pre-shaped black liquid-crystal segments on a reflective grey-green panel, faint ghost outlines of unlit segments in every possible position, printed colour backdrop overlay behind the glass, seven-segment score digits, brushed metal faceplate and plastic buttons
styles.avoid: Avoid pixel grids and backlit screens; it is not the Game Boy dot-matrix look.
styles.feasibility_note: Ghost segments and fixed-pose logic are approximated, not exact.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid branded handheld names and characters.
styles.short_de: Taschenspiel-Displays aus fest geformten schwarzen Flüssigkristall-Segmenten vor bedrucktem Hintergrund, mit blassen Umrissen der inaktiven Segmente; japanische und US-Handhelds der 1980er und 1990er.
styles.short_en: Pocket game screens built from fixed, pre-shaped black liquid-crystal segments over a printed backdrop, with faint ghosts of unlit segments; 1980s–90s Japanese and US handhelds.
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine Markennamen von Spielgeräten und keine lizenzierten Figuren.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid branded handheld names and licensed characters.

styles.era_origin: 2015 academic algorithm, popularised by 2016 smartphone filter apps.
visual_markers: uniform borrowed brush texture at one scale
styles.prompt_fragment: 2016 neural style transfer filter look, underlying photographic structure and perspective fully intact but uniformly overlaid with a borrowed painterly brushstroke texture at one constant scale, swirls ignoring object boundaries, blotchy transferred palette, faint haloing at edges, slightly low-resolution app output
styles.avoid: Avoid genuine paintings with intentional brushwork and DeepDream eye patterns.
styles.feasibility_note: Model tends to paint properly instead of mimicking the algorithmic uniformity.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not name specific famous paintings as style sources.
styles.short_de: Fotos, über die gleichmäßig die Pinseltextur eines fremden Gemäldes gelegt ist, Striche ohne Rücksicht auf Objektkanten; Algorithmus von 2015, 2016 durch Smartphone-Filter-Apps populär.
styles.short_en: Photos overlaid with a borrowed painting's brush texture at one uniform scale, strokes ignoring object edges, from a 2015 algorithm popularised by 2016 smartphone filter apps.
markers_de: gleichförmige fremde Pinseltextur in einem Maßstab
markers_en: uniform borrowed brush texture at one scale
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine bestimmten berühmten Gemälde als Stilvorlage nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not name specific famous paintings as style sources.

styles.era_origin: 2018-2021 GAN-generated faces.
visual_markers: centred frontal head with fixed eye position
styles.prompt_fragment: 2019-era GAN-generated portrait, centred frontal head-and-shoulders with eyes at a fixed position, convincingly realistic skin, background dissolving into smeared abstract blobs, hair merging with the surroundings, asymmetric mismatched accessories, small iridescent droplet artefacts, square 1024-pixel crop
styles.avoid: Avoid modern diffusion perfection and cinematic lighting.
styles.feasibility_note: Modern models resist producing deliberate GAN artefacts.
styles.sensitivity_note: Associated with fake profiles and deepfakes; label clearly as synthetic.
styles.short_de: Realistische, zentrierte Gesichter mit stets gleich platzierten Augen, verschmierten Hintergrundflecken, ungleichen Ohrringen und Tropfenartefakten; typisch für GAN-Porträts von 2018 bis 2021.
styles.short_en: Realistic centred faces with eyes always in the same spot, smeared blob backgrounds, mismatched earrings and droplet artefacts, typical of GAN-generated portraits from 2018 to 2021.
markers_en: centred frontal head with fixed eye position
styles.sensitivity_de: Mit Fake-Profilen und Deepfakes verbunden; Ergebnisse klar als synthetisch kennzeichnen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Linked to fake profiles and deepfakes; label results clearly as synthetic.

styles.era_origin: Mid-2000s web tag clouds; ubiquitous in presentations after a 2008 web generator.
styles.prompt_fragment: word cloud graphic, words packed tightly into a dense cluster with font size scaled by importance, mix of horizontal and vertical orientations, four or five flat palette colours, bold condensed sans-serif, optionally filling a simple silhouette shape, plain white background, 2000s presentation-slide feel
styles.avoid: Avoid pictures or icons and tonal typographic portraits.
styles.feasibility_note: Many small words turn into gibberish.
styles.sensitivity_note: 'Wordle' is also a trademarked game name.
styles.short_de: Dicht gepackte Wörter, deren Größe ihre Häufigkeit zeigt, waagrecht und senkrecht in wenigen Flächenfarben gesetzt; von Tag-Clouds im Web der 2000er bis zur Präsentationsfolie.
styles.short_en: Words packed into a dense cluster, sized by frequency, set horizontally and vertically in a few flat colours; from mid-2000s web tag clouds to presentation slides.
styles.sensitivity_de: „Wordle“ ist auch ein geschützter Spielname.
styles.sensitivity_en: 'Wordle' is also a trademarked game name.

styles.era_origin: 2007-2012 office presentation software.
visual_markers: default blue, orange and green theme
styles.prompt_fragment: late-2000s office presentation diagram, rounded rectangles, chevrons and cycle arrows with glossy top-lit gradient bevels and soft drop shadows, mirrored reflections beneath shapes, default steel-blue, brick-red and olive-green theme colours, short labels in a humanist sans-serif, white slide with thin title bar
styles.avoid: Avoid flat corporate vector and 1990s clip-art bar charts.
styles.feasibility_note: Gloss bevels and simple shapes are reliable.
styles.sensitivity_note: SmartArt is a Microsoft product name.
styles.short_de: Abgerundete Kästen, Chevrons und Kreislaufpfeile mit glänzenden Verlaufsfasen und Spiegelungen in Standard-Designfarben; die Diagrammoptik von Office-Präsentationen zwischen 2007 und etwa 2012.
styles.short_en: Rounded boxes, chevrons and cycle arrows with glossy gradient bevels and reflections in default theme colours, the diagram look of office presentation software from 2007 to about 2012.
markers_en: default blue, red and olive-green theme colours
styles.sensitivity_de: SmartArt ist ein Microsoft-Produktname; im Prompt nicht verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: SmartArt is a Microsoft product name; keep it out of prompts.

styles.era_origin: 2013-2016 Photoshop tutorial trend.
visual_markers: one side breaking into square fragments
desaturated grade with single accent colour
styles.prompt_fragment: 2010s photo-manipulation dispersion effect, one side of the subject disintegrating into hundreds of small square and shard fragments flying off in a directional stream, smoky dark textured backdrop, dramatic rim light, desaturated high-contrast grade with a single colour accent, obvious brush-made masking
styles.avoid: Avoid polished film VFX, glitch art and pixel sorting.
styles.feasibility_note: Fragments and grade render well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Echoes a superhero film 'dusting' scene; avoid franchise references.
styles.short_de: Fotomontage, bei der ein Teil des Motivs in Hunderte quadratische Splitter zerfällt, die in eine Richtung davonfliegen; ein Photoshop-Tutorial-Trend etwa von 2013 bis 2016.
styles.short_en: Photo manipulation in which part of the subject breaks into hundreds of square shards drifting off in a stream, a Photoshop tutorial trend of roughly 2013 to 2016.
markers_de: eine Seite zerfällt in quadratische Fragmente
markers_en: one side breaking into square fragments
desaturated grade with one accent colour
styles.sensitivity_de: Erinnert an die Zerfallsszene eines Superheldenfilms; keine Franchise-Bezüge.
styles.sensitivity_en: Recalls a superhero film's 'dusting' scene; avoid franchise references.

styles.era_origin: Early-2010s Portland and online scene, peaked around 2014.
styles.prompt_fragment: health goth aesthetic, strictly black, white and silver palette, technical sportswear textures such as mesh, neoprene and reflective tape, glossy synthetic surfaces, sterile gym and laboratory minimalism, cold flash lighting, occasional chrome 3D render elements, clean futuristic sans-serif, austere athletic mood
styles.avoid: Avoid witch-house occult triangles and neon cybergoth colours.
styles.feasibility_note: Monochrome sportswear textures render well.
styles.short_de: Schwarz, Weiß und Silber, Sportkleidung aus Mesh, Neopren und Reflexband, sterile Fitness- und Laborräume, Chrom-3D-Renderings; eine Online-Szene aus Portland mit Höhepunkt 2014.
styles.short_en: Black, white and silver sportswear in mesh, neoprene and reflective tape, sterile gym and lab settings and chrome 3D renders; an online scene from Portland, peaking in 2014.

styles.era_origin: Early-2010s Tumblr, influenced by Harajuku street styles.
visual_markers: baby pink, lavender, mint with black
styles.prompt_fragment: pastel goth aesthetic, baby pink, lavender and mint paired with matte black, cute-macabre ornaments such as tiny bats, skulls, coffin shapes and spikes rendered adorably, glossy plastic and lace textures, soft flat lighting, sticker-like accents, sweet yet spooky
styles.avoid: Avoid whimsigoth velvet and the washed-film pastel grunge look.
styles.feasibility_note: Palette and motifs are reliable.
styles.sensitivity_note: Inverted crosses, if used, may offend Christian viewers.
styles.short_de: Babyrosa, Lavendel und Mint kombiniert mit Schwarz, dazu niedliche Fledermäuse, Totenköpfe, Särge und Nieten; ein süß-gruseliger Look, der sich Anfang der 2010er über Tumblr verbreitete.
styles.short_en: Baby pink, lavender and mint paired with black, with cute bats, skulls, coffins and spikes; a sweet-spooky look that spread on Tumblr in the early 2010s.
markers_de: Babyrosa, Lavendel und Mint mit Schwarz
markers_en: baby pink, lavender and mint with black
styles.sensitivity_de: Umgedrehte Kreuze, falls ergänzt, können christliche Betrachter verletzen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Inverted crosses, if added, may offend Christian viewers.

styles.era_origin: Late-1990s to 2000s UK and German industrial club scene.
visual_markers: toxic neon green and pink synthetic falls
UV blacklight haze and strobe flash
styles.prompt_fragment: cybergoth club aesthetic, glossy black PVC and vinyl paired with toxic neon green, hot pink and UV blue synthetic accents, chunky goggles, respirator masks and hazard symbols, ultraviolet blacklight glow and haze, hard strobe flash against a dark industrial club backdrop, late-1990s flash grain
styles.avoid: Avoid synthwave sunsets and clean cyberpunk cityscapes.
styles.feasibility_note: Neon-on-black club flash renders well.
styles.short_de: Schwarzes PVC mit giftgrünen und pinken Haarfalls, Schutzbrillen, Atemschutzmasken und Warnsymbolen unter Schwarzlicht; Industrial-Clubszene in Großbritannien und Deutschland, späte 1990er bis 2000er.
styles.short_en: Black PVC with toxic neon green and pink hair falls, goggles, respirator masks and hazard symbols under blacklight; industrial club scene in Britain and Germany, late 1990s–2000s.
markers_en: neon green and pink synthetic hair falls
UV blacklight haze and strobe flash

styles.era_origin: Late-2010s to 2020s K-pop fandom.
visual_markers: small glossy photo card in clear toploader
styles.prompt_fragment: K-pop fandom photocard deco, a small glossy photo card slipped into a clear rigid plastic toploader, decorated with layered washi-tape strips, pastel stickers, tiny hearts, stars, ribbons and dangling charms on a ball chain, holographic glitter, flat-lay on a soft pastel desk mat with stationery
styles.avoid: Avoid scrapbook pages and generic sticker bombing.
styles.feasibility_note: Plastic sleeve and sticker layering render well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Never depict real idols; fan images of real people raise likeness issues.
styles.short_de: Eine kleine glänzende Fotokarte in einer festen Klarsichthülle, verziert mit Washi-Tape, Stickern, Bändern und Anhängern; Bastelpraxis von K-Pop-Fans seit Ende der 2010er.
styles.short_en: A small glossy photo card in a clear rigid sleeve, decorated with washi tape, stickers, ribbons and charms, a K-pop fandom craft from the late 2010s onward.
styles.era_en: late 2010s–2020s, K-pop fandom (South Korea and worldwide)
markers_en: small glossy photo card in clear toploader
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine echten Idols darstellen; Fanbilder realer Personen berühren Persönlichkeitsrechte.
styles.sensitivity_en: Never depict real idols; fan images of real people raise likeness-rights issues.

styles.era_origin: Late-1990s Harajuku street fashion.
visual_markers: stickers and plasters on the face
styles.prompt_fragment: Harajuku decora street-style maximalism, every surface layered with dozens of colourful plastic hair clips, bracelets, toy charms, stickers and bandages, clashing rainbow and pastel candy colours, playful overload with no empty space, bright overcast daylight street-snap framing, early-2000s magazine photo grain
styles.avoid: Avoid kidcore primary-colour minimalism and generic anime styling.
styles.feasibility_note: Accessory overload is well within range.
styles.short_de: Dutzende Plastikhaarspangen, Armbänder, Spielzeuganhänger, Sticker und Pflaster in grellen Regenbogenfarben übereinander; Straßenmode aus Harajuku seit den späten 1990ern.
styles.short_en: Dozens of plastic hair clips, bracelets, toy charms, stickers and plasters layered in clashing rainbow colours, a Harajuku street fashion from the late 1990s.
markers_en: stickers and plasters on the face

styles.era_origin: Late-1980s to 2000s Japanese rock scene.
styles.prompt_fragment: 1990s Japanese rock promotional photo, dramatic androgynous styling with heavy eye makeup and sculpted dyed hair, ornate gothic-aristocrat lace and leather, deep purple, crimson and blue colour gels, overexposed highlights, cross-processed film colour, soft-focus haze, ornamental gothic serif logo
styles.avoid: Avoid Western goth band photos and glossy modern K-pop styling.
styles.feasibility_note: Gels and styling render well; logo text may garble.
styles.short_de: Androgyn gestylte japanische Rockmusiker mit starkem Augen-Make-up, toupierten gefärbten Haaren, Spitze und Leder, fotografiert mit Farbfolien und crossentwickeltem Film; späte 1980er bis 2000er.
styles.short_en: Androgynous Japanese rock musicians with heavy eye makeup, sculpted dyed hair and gothic lace and leather, shot with coloured gels and cross-processed film; late 1980s to 2000s.

styles.era_origin: Term coined in the mid-2010s for East Asian-inspired fantasy fiction.
visual_markers: machines of bamboo, silk and paper
ink-wash palette with cinnabar and jade
styles.prompt_fragment: silkpunk retro-futurism, ingenious machines built from bamboo, silk, paper, lacquered wood, rope and cast bronze, kite-like sails and translucent silk membranes, hand-carved gears, ancient East Asian engineering logic, muted ink-wash palette with cinnabar and jade accents, painterly concept-art rendering
styles.avoid: Avoid brass-and-leather steampunk Victoriana and orientalist kitsch.
styles.feasibility_note: Tends to slide into steampunk or generic Chinese fantasy.
styles.sensitivity_note: Draw on East Asian traditions respectfully; avoid orientalist clichés.
styles.short_de: Retrofuturistische Maschinen aus Bambus, Seide, Papier, Lack und Bronze mit Segeln wie Papierdrachen, angelehnt an die ostasiatische Antike; der Begriff entstand Mitte der 2010er für Fantasy-Literatur.
styles.short_en: Retro-futurist machines of bamboo, silk, paper, lacquer and bronze with kite-like sails, based on East Asian antiquity; the term was coined in the mid-2010s for fantasy fiction.
styles.era_de: Mitte der 2010er, US-Fantasyliteratur mit ostasiatischen Vorbildern
styles.era_en: mid-2010s, US fantasy fiction drawing on East Asian antiquity
markers_de: Maschinen aus Bambus, Seide und Papier
markers_en: machines of bamboo, silk and paper
ink-wash palette with cinnabar and jade
styles.sensitivity_de: Ostasiatische Traditionen respektvoll aufgreifen, orientalistische Klischees vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Draw on East Asian traditions with care and avoid orientalist clichés.

styles.era_origin: 1980s-90s science-fiction subgenre.
visual_markers: wet translucent tissues fused with lab gear
styles.prompt_fragment: biopunk aesthetic, technology grown rather than built, wet translucent organic tissues fused with cheap lab equipment, tubes, petri dishes and incubators, sickly green-yellow fluorescent light, slick mucous sheen and veined membranes, grimy underground laboratory atmosphere, unsettling biological intimacy
styles.avoid: Avoid neon cyberpunk cities and biomechanical tattoo patterning.
styles.feasibility_note: Organic textures render strongly.
styles.sensitivity_note: Body-horror imagery can disturb viewers.
styles.short_de: Gewachsene statt gebaute Technik: nasses, durchscheinendes Gewebe verschmilzt mit billigem Laborgerät unter fahlgrünem Neonlicht; ein Science-Fiction-Subgenre der 1980er und 1990er.
styles.short_en: Technology grown rather than built: wet translucent tissue fused with cheap lab gear under sickly green fluorescent light, from 1980s and 1990s science fiction.
markers_en: wet translucent tissue fused with lab gear
styles.sensitivity_de: Body-Horror-Motive können verstören.
styles.sensitivity_en: Body-horror imagery can disturb viewers.

styles.era_origin: Early-2020s online offshoot of solarpunk.
styles.prompt_fragment: lunarpunk aesthetic, sustainable eco-futurist setting at night, bioluminescent plants and fungi glowing turquoise and violet, soft moonlight, organic architecture with hanging lanterns and discreet solar technology, mystical communal calm, deep indigo and silver palette with gentle glow
styles.avoid: Avoid sunny solarpunk and neon cyberpunk.
styles.feasibility_note: Glow and night palette render easily.
styles.short_de: Die Nachtseite des Solarpunk: ökofuturistische Siedlungen im Licht biolumineszenter Pflanzen und Pilze, Laternen und Mondschein in Indigo und Silber; eine Online-Ästhetik der frühen 2020er.
styles.short_en: Solarpunk's night side: eco-futurist villages lit by bioluminescent plants and fungi, lanterns and moonlight in indigo and silver, an online aesthetic from the early 2020s.

styles.era_origin: Late-1980s British tabletop wargame art, now a broad genre aesthetic.
styles.prompt_fragment: gothic grimdark science fiction, colossal machinery shaped like cathedrals with buttresses, gargoyles and skull ornaments, brass, iron and parchment scrolls with wax seals, candlelight and incense smoke in vast gloomy halls, oppressive scale, dark umber, rust and tarnished gold palette, painterly heavy-metal illustration
styles.avoid: Avoid sleek chrome spaceships and steampunk Victoriana.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders well; avoid franchise insignia drift.
styles.sensitivity_note: Closely tied to a trademarked wargame franchise; avoid its insignia and names.
styles.short_de: Riesige Maschinen in Kathedralenform mit Wasserspeiern, Totenköpfen, Pergamentsiegeln und Kerzenlicht in Rost und angelaufenem Gold; wurzelt in britischer Tabletop-Kunst der späten 1980er.
styles.short_en: Colossal cathedral-shaped machines with gargoyles, skulls, parchment seals and candlelight in rust and tarnished gold, rooted in British tabletop wargame art from the late 1980s.
styles.sensitivity_de: Eng mit einem markenrechtlich geschützten Tabletop-Franchise verbunden; dessen Symbole und Namen meiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Closely tied to a trademarked wargame franchise; avoid its insignia and names.

styles.era_origin: Term coined around 2012 by Qatari-American and Kuwaiti artists.
visual_markers: glass towers rising from desert haze
warm sand and cold blue palette
styles.prompt_fragment: gulf futurism aesthetic, glittering glass towers and gold-tinted luxury interiors rising abruptly from hazy desert, empty air-conditioned malls and highway interchanges, polished marble and LED facades, sterile architectural-render perfection mixed with dusty heat haze, isolation within extreme wealth, warm sand and cold blue palette
styles.avoid: Avoid orientalist souk clichés and Arabian Nights fantasy.
styles.feasibility_note: Easily becomes a generic luxury-real-estate render without the alienation cues.
styles.sensitivity_note: Concerns real Gulf societies; avoid orientalism and religious caricature.
styles.short_de: Glastürme und goldgetönte Malls, die aus Wüstendunst ragen, leere Autobahnkreuze und renderhafte Sterilität; ein Begriff, den eine katarisch-amerikanische und eine kuwaitische Künstlerin um 2012 prägten.
styles.short_en: Glass towers and gold-tinted malls rising from desert haze, empty highways and render-like sterility; a term coined around 2012 by Qatari-American and Kuwaiti artists.
markers_de: Palette aus warmem Sand und kaltem Blau
markers_en: glass towers rising from desert haze
warm sand and cold blue palette
styles.sensitivity_de: Betrifft reale Golfgesellschaften; Orientalismus und religiöse Karikatur vermeiden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Concerns real Gulf societies; avoid orientalism and religious caricature.

styles.era_origin: 2013-2018 Instagram and senior-portrait trend.
styles.prompt_fragment: photographed amid dense billowing coloured smoke from handheld smoke grenades, saturated plumes of pink, teal or orange swirling through the frame, backlit by low sun so the smoke glows, outdoor field or forest setting, shallow depth of field, 2010s Instagram edit with lifted shadows
styles.avoid: Avoid studio fog machines and festival colour powder.
styles.feasibility_note: Smoke and backlight are reliable.
styles.sensitivity_note: Do not conflate with Holi festival colours, which have religious significance.
styles.short_de: Porträts in dichten pinken, türkisen oder orangen Rauchschwaden aus Handrauchfackeln, im Gegenlicht draußen fotografiert; ein Instagram- und Abschlussfoto-Trend etwa von 2013 bis 2018.
styles.short_en: Portraits shot amid dense billowing pink, teal or orange smoke from handheld smoke grenades, backlit outdoors; an Instagram and senior-portrait trend of about 2013 to 2018.
styles.sensitivity_de: Nicht mit den Holi-Farben verwechseln, die religiöse Bedeutung haben.
styles.sensitivity_en: Do not confuse with Holi festival colours, which carry religious meaning.

styles.era_origin: 2015-2018 smartphone augmented-reality lenses.
visual_markers: cartoon animal ears, nose and whiskers
styles.prompt_fragment: mid-2010s front-camera selfie with an augmented-reality face filter, cartoon animal ears, nose and whiskers or a floating flower crown tracked onto the face with slight misalignment, airbrushed skin smoothing, sparkle overlays, front-camera wide-angle distortion, vertical frame with an app caption bar
styles.avoid: Avoid professional retouching; this is not the pure beauty-filter smoothing look.
styles.feasibility_note: Overlay elements render convincingly.
styles.sensitivity_note: Lens and app names are trademarks.
styles.short_de: Frontkamera-Selfies mit Comic-Hundeohren, -nasen und -schnurrhaaren oder schwebenden Blumenkränzen, leicht versetzt aufs Gesicht gelegt; AR-Filter von Smartphone-Apps etwa 2015 bis 2018.
styles.short_en: Front-camera selfies with cartoon dog ears, noses, whiskers or floating flower crowns tracked onto the face, slightly misaligned; smartphone AR lenses of roughly 2015 to 2018.
markers_en: cartoon animal ears, nose and whiskers
styles.sensitivity_de: Filter- und App-Namen sind Marken.
styles.sensitivity_en: Lens and app names are trademarks.

styles.era_origin: 1917-18 British and US naval camouflage, revived in WWII and in contemporary art and automotive testing.
visual_markers: wedges and curves across all surfaces
black, white, pale blue and slate grey
styles.prompt_fragment: covered in dazzle camouflage, bold high-contrast intersecting stripes, zigzags, wedges and curves painted across every surface to break up form and perspective, black, white, pale blue and slate grey with occasional ochre, flat marine paint with weathering, deliberately disorienting geometry
styles.avoid: Avoid woodland or digital military camo and Op Art moiré.
styles.feasibility_note: Geometric surface patterns hold well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Military connotations.
styles.short_de: Kräftige, sich kreuzende Streifen, Zickzacks und Keile in Schwarz, Weiß, Grau und Blau auf Schiffen, die Kurs und Entfernung verschleiern sollten; ab 1917 bei britischer und US-Marine.
styles.short_en: Bold intersecting stripes, zigzags and wedges in black, white, grey and blue painted across ships to confuse range and course, used by British and US navies from 1917.
styles.era_de: 1917–1918 und Zweiter Weltkrieg, Großbritannien und USA
markers_de: kräftige, sich kreuzende Streifen und Zickzacks
Keile und Bögen über alle Flächen
markers_en: wedges and curves across all surfaces
black, white, pale blue and slate grey
styles.sensitivity_de: Hat militärische Konnotationen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Carries military connotations.

styles.era_origin: 2022-2023 fashion and marketing trend.
styles.prompt_fragment: hot-pink maximalism, every element in saturated magenta, bubblegum and fuchsia, glossy injection-moulded plastic surfaces, life-size dollhouse set design with painted flat backdrops, retro 1960s glamour styling, high-key even studio light, sparkle accents, playful artificial perfection
styles.avoid: Avoid pale millennial pink minimalism and coquette bows and lace.
styles.feasibility_note: Monochrome pink sets render easily.
styles.sensitivity_note: Name refers to a trademarked doll brand; the prompt avoids it, and logos must not be reproduced.
styles.short_de: Alles in sattem Magenta und Fuchsia, glänzendes Plastik, Puppenhauskulissen in Lebensgröße und Glamour-Styling der 1960er in hellem, gleichmäßigem Licht; ein Mode- und Marketingtrend 2022/23.
styles.short_en: Everything in saturated magenta and fuchsia, glossy plastic, life-size dollhouse sets and 1960s glamour styling under even bright light; a fashion and marketing trend of 2022–23.
markers_de: alles in sattem Magenta und Fuchsia
markers_en: everything in saturated magenta and fuchsia
styles.sensitivity_de: Der Name verweist auf eine geschützte Puppenmarke; Name und Logos nicht im Prompt verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: The name refers to a trademarked doll brand; keep it and its logos out of prompts.

styles.era_origin: 1930s British-American over-piping method, viral revival from about 2020.
styles.prompt_fragment: vintage Lambeth-method buttercream decoration, every edge layered with over-piped shell borders, ruffles, swags, scallops and rosettes stacked in tiers, glossy maraschino cherries and silver dragées, pastel or retro saturated icing colours, slightly imperfect handmade piping, soft daylight
styles.avoid: Avoid smooth sculpted fondant and minimalist modern cakes.
styles.feasibility_note: Piping texture renders well.
styles.short_de: Torten mit mehrfach übereinander gespritzten Muschelbordüren, Rüschen, Girlanden und Bögen nach einer britischen Methode der 1930er, in den 2020ern als viraler Vintage-Cake-Trend zurück.
styles.short_en: Cakes covered in tiers of over-piped shell borders, ruffles, swags and scallops, after a 1930s British method, revived as a viral vintage-cake trend in the 2020s.
styles.era_de: 1930er–1950er, Großbritannien und USA; Revival in den 2020ern
styles.era_en: 1930s–1950s, Britain and USA; revival in the 2020s

styles.era_origin: Mid-to-late-2000s US premium streetwear and club fashion.
visual_markers: winged ornaments, roses and script banners
styles.prompt_fragment: late-2000s premium bling T-shirt print, tattoo-flash motifs printed allover in metallic foil and puff ink with rhinestone studs, winged ornaments, roses, script banners and gothic crosses, distressed cracked print, heavy contrast stitching, oversized placement wrapping around the seams
styles.avoid: Avoid clean American traditional tattoo flash on paper and the faded vintage band tee.
styles.feasibility_note: Foil and rhinestone textures render well.
styles.sensitivity_note: Associated with trademarked fashion labels and a living tattoo artist; describe the look only.
styles.short_de: Tattoo-Flash-Motive wie geflügelte Herzen, Rosen und Schriftbänder, flächig in Metallicfolie und mit Strasssteinen gedruckt; US-Premium-Streetwear und Clubmode etwa 2005 bis 2010.
styles.short_en: Tattoo-flash motifs such as winged hearts, roses and script banners printed allover in metallic foil with rhinestones; US premium streetwear and club fashion of about 2005–2010.
markers_en: winged ornaments, roses and script banners
styles.sensitivity_de: Mit geschützten Modemarken und einem lebenden Tätowierer verbunden; nur den Look beschreiben, keine Namen nennen.
styles.sensitivity_en: Linked to trademarked fashion labels and a living tattoo artist; describe the look, not the names.

styles.era_origin: Relief prints cut in metal plates, Germany and the Lower Rhine, c. 1450-1500.
visual_markers: dense black ground punched with white dots and star punches
styles.prompt_fragment: 15th-century dotted metalcut (criblé) relief print, solid black ground broken by countless punched white dots, small stars and rosettes, figures left as white contour lines, stiff late-Gothic drawing, faint hand-colouring in red and green, slightly uneven rubbed ink on laid paper
styles.avoid: Do not turn it into a white-line woodcut or a modern stipple. The punched-dot texture on a black field is the point.
styles.feasibility_note: The black-with-dots texture works; consistent punch shapes drift.
styles.sensitivity_note: Most subjects are Christian devotional images; neutral when used for secular motifs.
styles.short_de: Hochdrucke von Metallplatten mit schwarzem Grund voller eingeschlagener weißer Punkte, Sterne und Rosetten, Figuren als weiße Umrisse ausgespart; Deutschland, um 1450–1500.
styles.short_en: Relief prints from metal plates with a black ground punched full of white dots, stars and rosettes and figures left as white outlines; Germany, c. 1450–1500.
markers_de: schwarzer Grund mit eingeschlagenen weißen Punkten und Sternen
markers_en: black ground punched with white dots and stars
styles.sensitivity_de: Die meisten erhaltenen Blätter sind christliche Andachtsbilder; bei weltlichen Motiven unproblematisch.
styles.sensitivity_en: Most surviving prints are Christian devotional images; neutral when used for secular motifs.

styles.era_origin: A standard school and kindergarten craft in Europe since the early 20th century.
visual_markers: starchy, blotchy ink with mottled voids
slightly different pressure on each repeat
thick poster paint on cheap sugar paper
styles.prompt_fragment: potato print made with cut potato halves and thick poster paint, chunky simple stamp shapes repeated by hand, mottled starchy ink coverage with pale speckles, wobbly edges, uneven spacing and pressure, overlapping colours, cheap coloured sugar paper
styles.avoid: Do not produce crisp rubber-stamp edges or vector-perfect repeats. Keep the irregular, starchy texture.
styles.feasibility_note: Textured stamp impressions render well.
styles.short_de: Einfache, klobige Formen, mit halbierten Kartoffeln und dicker Plakatfarbe von Hand gestempelt, fleckiger Farbauftrag und ungleichmäßige Wiederholungen; Bastelklassiker in europäischen Schulen seit dem frühen 20. Jh.
styles.short_en: Chunky shapes stamped by hand with cut potato halves and thick poster paint, with mottled starchy coverage and uneven repeats; a European school craft since the early 1900s.
markers_de: fleckiger, stärkehaltiger Farbauftrag mit hellen Lücken
markers_en: starchy, blotchy ink with mottled voids
thick poster paint on cheap sugar paper

styles.era_origin: The Persian/Kashmiri boteh motif, mass-printed in Paisley (Scotland) from c. 1800, later on bandanas and 1960s fashion.
visual_markers: limited palette on red, navy or cream
styles.prompt_fragment: printed paisley textile pattern, curling teardrop boteh motifs packed with tiny florals, vines and dotted outlines, nested borders, dense all-over repeat, slight print misregistration and fabric weave visible, limited palette of madder red, indigo, mustard and cream
styles.avoid: Avoid a loose 'boho' vector doodle. Keep the dense historical density and textile surface.
styles.feasibility_note: Pattern density holds; strict repeats loosen.
styles.sensitivity_note: The motif comes from Persian and Kashmiri textiles. Credit that origin rather than presenting it as Western-only.
styles.short_de: Geschwungene Tropfenmotive (Boteh) voller winziger Blüten in dichtem Rapport, aus persischen und kaschmirischen Schals, ab etwa 1800 im schottischen Paisley nachgewebt und später auf Bandanas gedruckt.
styles.short_en: Curling teardrop boteh motifs packed with tiny florals in dense repeats, from Persian and Kashmiri shawls, copied in Paisley, Scotland, from about 1800 and later on bandanas.
styles.era_de: ab ca. 1800, Schottland, nach persischen und kaschmirischen Vorbildern
styles.era_en: from c. 1800, Scotland, after Persian and Kashmiri models
markers_de: begrenzte Palette auf rotem, marineblauem oder cremefarbenem Grund
markers_en: limited palette on red, navy or cream ground
styles.sensitivity_de: Das Motiv stammt aus persischen und kaschmirischen Textilien; diese Herkunft benennen, statt es als rein westlich darzustellen.
styles.sensitivity_en: The motif comes from Persian and Kashmiri textiles; credit that origin rather than presenting it as Western-only.

styles.era_origin: Photocopy or magazine images rubbed onto paper with solvent; neo-Dada drawings of the late 1950s, later a common art-school technique.
visual_markers: directional rubbing hatch marks across the image
combined with pencil and watercolour notes
styles.prompt_fragment: solvent transfer drawing, photocopied and printed images rubbed onto paper with solvent, faint mirror-reversed fragments, visible diagonal burnishing strokes, patchy incomplete transfer, greyish toner with washed colour, loose pencil marks and watercolour touches, collage-like layering
styles.avoid: Do not make a clean photomontage. The transferred images must look faint, broken and hatch-rubbed.
styles.feasibility_note: The faded transfer works; the burnishing hatch may come out too uniform.
styles.short_de: Zeitschriften- oder Kopiebilder, mit Lösungsmittel auf Papier abgerieben, sodass blasse, seitenverkehrte Fragmente und schraffurartige Reibspuren bleiben; entwickelt im Neo-Dada der späten 1950er.
styles.short_en: Magazine or photocopied images rubbed onto paper with solvent, leaving faint mirror-reversed fragments and hatch-like burnishing marks; developed in late-1950s Neo-Dada, later an art-school staple.

styles.era_origin: A contemporary textile and paper craft popularised in the 2000s.
visual_markers: exact leaf silhouettes and vein prints
rust, ochre, olive and tannin-brown hues
printed on silk, wool or watercolour paper
styles.prompt_fragment: botanical eco-print made by steaming leaves bundled against silk or paper, precise leaf shapes and veins printed in tannin browns, rust orange, olive and iron grey, soft halos and mordant blotches, overlapping ghostly imprints, natural fibre texture
styles.avoid: Do not produce crisp pressed flowers or a cyanotype. The colour comes from the plants' own dyes.
styles.feasibility_note: Natural dye texture works well.
styles.short_de: Blätter, auf Seide, Wolle oder Papier gebündelt und gedämpft, hinterlassen exakte Umrisse und Adern in Gerbstoffbraun, Rost und Oliv; ein Naturfärbe-Handwerk, populär seit den 2000ern.
styles.short_en: Leaves bundled against silk, wool or paper and steamed, leaving exact leaf shapes and veins in tannin browns, rust and olive; a natural-dye craft popularised in the 2000s.
markers_en: exact leaf silhouettes and vein prints
rust, ochre, olive and tannin-brown hues

styles.era_origin: Consumer inkjet printers on plain paper, late 1990s-2010s.
visual_markers: colour cast from an empty cartridge
styles.prompt_fragment: home inkjet printout on plain copy paper, visible horizontal banding streaks, one colour cartridge running low causing a strong colour cast, coarse dithered gradients, ink slightly feathered into the fibres, mildly cockled wavy paper, photographed flat
styles.avoid: Do not make a clean photo print or a photocopy look. The banding and colour shift are essential.
styles.feasibility_note: The model tends to fix the colours. Name the missing ink explicitly.
styles.short_de: Heimdrucker-Ausdrucke auf Normalpapier mit waagrechten Streifen, Farbstich durch eine leere Patrone, grob gerasterten Verläufen und leicht welligem Papier; späte 1990er bis 2010er.
styles.short_en: Home inkjet prints on plain paper with horizontal banding, a colour cast from an empty cartridge, coarse dithered gradients and slightly wavy paper; late 1990s to 2010s.
markers_en: colour cast from an empty cartridge

styles.era_origin: Lithographed advertising stamps for brands, exhibitions and events, Germany and Austria c. 1900-1920.
visual_markers: flat lithographic colours with a lettering band
styles.prompt_fragment: early 20th-century poster stamp, a miniature lithographic poster on a perforated gummed stamp, bold simplified drawing, flat saturated colours, decorative frame and short lettering band, slight colour misregistration, aged paper with hinge marks
styles.avoid: Not an engraved postage stamp. This is lithographic, graphic and advertising-driven.
styles.feasibility_note: Perforations and small format work; small text may be garbled.
styles.short_de: Lithografierte Miniaturplakate auf gezähnten, gummierten Marken mit kräftiger Zeichnung, flächigen Farben und Schriftband; Werbung für Marken und Ausstellungen in Deutschland und Österreich um 1900–1920.
styles.short_en: Miniature lithographed posters on perforated, gummed stamps with bold drawing, flat colours and a lettering band, advertising brands and events in Germany and Austria around 1900–1920.
markers_de: kräftige Zeichnung im Jugendstil oder Sachplakat-Stil
markers_en: flat litho colours with a lettering band

styles.era_origin: Lithographed hotel and steamship labels, 1920s-1950s.
visual_markers: round, oval or shield-shaped die-cut label
stylised landmark vignette with hotel name
scuffs, glue stains and overlapping on leather
styles.prompt_fragment: vintage hotel luggage label, die-cut oval or round lithographed sticker, simplified travel vignette with sky gradient, bold Art Deco lettering, flat saturated inks, scuffed and partly torn, glue stains, layered among other labels on worn leather suitcase
styles.avoid: Not a modern flat travel poster. Keep the small die-cut sticker format and wear.
styles.feasibility_note: Works well; invented names may contain garbled lettering.
styles.sensitivity_note: Avoid real hotel names and brands.
styles.short_de: Kleine gestanzte Lithoaufkleber mit stilisiertem Wahrzeichen und Hotelnamen in flächigen Farben, in Schichten auf Lederkoffer geklebt; Hotel- und Dampferreisen der 1920er bis 1950er.
styles.short_en: Small die-cut lithographed labels with a stylised landmark and hotel name in flat colours, stuck in layers on leather suitcases; hotel and steamship travel of the 1920s–1950s.
markers_de: Abrieb, Leimflecken und Überlappungen auf Leder
markers_en: round, oval or shield-shaped die-cut label
stylised landmark vignette with hotel name
scuffs, glue stains and overlaps on leather
styles.sensitivity_de: Keine echten Hotelnamen oder Marken verwenden.
styles.sensitivity_en: Avoid real hotel names and brands.

styles.era_origin: Owner's marks pasted in books from the 15th century, with a collector's art boom c. 1890-1930.
visual_markers: small vertical plate with 'Ex Libris' and owner's name
ornamental border, cream paper pasted in a book
styles.prompt_fragment: ex libris bookplate, small vertical printed plate with an emblematic vignette and banner reading Ex Libris, fine etched or wood-engraved linework, ornamental border, black or two-colour ink, cream laid paper pasted inside a book cover, slight plate mark
styles.avoid: Avoid a glossy modern sticker. Keep the small intaglio or engraved printed plate.
styles.feasibility_note: Fine line holds; lettering needs checking.
styles.short_de: Kleine gedruckte Besitzvermerke, in Bücher eingeklebt, mit Sinnbild-Vignette, dem Schriftzug „Ex Libris“ und dem Namen des Eigners; seit dem 15. Jh., Sammlerboom um 1900.
styles.short_en: Small printed owner's labels pasted inside books, with an emblematic vignette, the words Ex Libris and the owner's name, used since the 15th century and collected around 1900.
styles.era_de: seit dem 15. Jh.; Sammlerboom ca. 1890–1930, Europa
styles.era_en: since the 15th century; collector boom c. 1890–1930, Europe
markers_de: kleines Hochformat mit „Ex Libris“ und Besitzername
Sinnbild-Vignette wie Bücher, Eulen oder Bäume
markers_en: small vertical plate with 'Ex Libris' and owner's name
emblematic vignette such as books, owls or trees

styles.era_origin: Embossed, gilt-blocked cloth trade bindings, c. 1850-1910.
styles.prompt_fragment: Victorian publisher's cloth binding, coloured fine-grain bookcloth with gold-blocked pictorial vignette and ornate title lettering, blind-stamped decorative borders, black ink accents, rubbed gilt, bumped corners and faded spine, photographed on a library table
styles.avoid: Do not make a printed paper cover or leather-tooled antique. It is cloth with gilt stamping.
styles.feasibility_note: Material and gold blocking render well.
styles.short_de: Farbiges, fein genarbtes Buchleinen mit Goldprägung in Bild und Titel und blindgeprägten Rahmen, wie es britische und amerikanische Verlage etwa 1850 bis 1910 verwendeten.
styles.short_en: Coloured, finely grained bookcloth with gold-blocked pictures and lettering and blind-stamped borders, as used on British and American trade books from about 1850 to 1910.

styles.era_origin: English roundhand (18th century) and American Spencerian script (19th century), written with a flexible pointed nib.
visual_markers: iron-gall or black ink on cream paper
styles.prompt_fragment: pointed-pen copperplate calligraphy, flexible nib producing swelling shaded downstrokes and hairline upstrokes, consistent 55-degree slant, elaborate oval flourishes and entry strokes, iron-gall ink on cream laid paper, slight ink pooling at stroke ends
styles.avoid: Not modern brush lettering or broad-edge calligraphy. Contrast comes from pressure, not pen angle.
styles.feasibility_note: The look is easy to get; correct spelling in script is unreliable.
styles.short_de: Geneigte, verbundene Schreibschrift mit flexibler Spitzfeder, druckverstärkten Abstrichen und haarfeinen Aufstrichen; im 18. Jahrhundert als englische Roundhand entstanden, in den USA weitergeführt.
styles.short_en: Slanted joined script written with a flexible pointed nib, with pressure-swelled downstrokes and hairline upstrokes; English roundhand of the 18th century and its American successors.
markers_de: Eisengallus- oder Schwarztinte auf cremefarbenem Papier
markers_en: iron-gall or black ink on cream paper

styles.era_origin: Contemporary book art practice from the 1960s onward, popular since the 2000s.
visual_markers: old book with pages carved, folded or cut into relief
layers of printed text and engravings exposed
scene emerging out of the book block
styles.prompt_fragment: altered book sculpture, an old hardcover book with pages meticulously carved, cut and folded so the scene rises from the open book block, exposed layers of printed text and antique engravings, yellowed page edges, delicate paper relief, soft museum lighting
styles.avoid: Not a generic pop-up book. The material is the cut-into old book itself.
styles.feasibility_note: Renders convincingly as an object photo.
styles.short_de: Ein altes Buch, dessen Seiten geschnitzt, geschnitten oder gefaltet sind, sodass eine Reliefszene aus dem Buchblock wächst; Buchkunst seit den 1960er-Jahren, verbreitet seit den 2000ern.
styles.short_en: An old book whose pages are carved, cut or folded so that a relief scene rises from the text block; a book-art practice since the 1960s.
